author: Jeloni W
content: Within the last 48 hours, I've probably uninstalled and reinstalled this apt close to 10 times. When the app finally backs-up photos, it's missing some (photos that are in my albums on my phone aren't showing up in app). Also when I click on a photo in the app, it opens a different picture. I'm thinking to uninstall app entirely. You'd think Google, of all software out there, could get this right!

author: Judy
content: Your last update is terrible. You removed the blur option which was AMAZING for blurring the background of my photos of flowers. The flowers would just pop with a heavy blur. The portrait blur is not nearly as good, especially when I use blur and depth to get my flowers to look how I want them to. It DOES look good, but when I save it, the blur almost disappears. Your "upgrade" is really a downgrade.

author: Deb Tolley
content: ugh! what have you done to the editing controls!! get rid of the inefficient and inaccurate AI garage and bring back the custom controls that let me rotate and keystone and crop! AI framing isn't even close to correct! and the manual controls are now so limited I can't even select the correct borders or rotate correctly. the old controls were so much better! one click would pretty closely grab the correct outline and then I could tweak. not anymore!!!

author: Bee
content: the new update makes zero sense, I likes it where I was able to just watch all my albums in one go, instead now it's all folder inside of folder?! I have bad memory and can't always remember if I've backed up a photo already, or if it's still on my device, not to mention now there's a pets and people tab, which you'd think would be nice, but no! I get constant reminders of people I don't want to see anymore with photos I thought were gone! thanks a lot Google, and not in a nice way!

author: Lizzi
content: Since the update, I can't choose separate photos for my lock screen wallpaper or main wallpaper. There is only an option for "wallpaper" now, which stretches and distorts the photo to fit the size of the screen! Also in order to continue editing a photo, I have to revert back to the original and edit all over again! Please go back to the original options; why do companies feel the need to constantly change everything every couple months, and not to their users' preference?? So frustrating!

author: kanana
content: i really don't like this app. i don't like the 'moments' it randomly creates that can't be turned off. i don't like that albums aren't on the same level as the default categories (for example if you take a photo from the downloads category and put it in an album it still exists in the downloads category.) i don't like the facial detection grouping, it rarely works and just adds to the already messy layout. i could say more but i'm running out of characters.

author: Erich Friesen
content: This is a terrible app. Yet another example of Google hiding basic functionality and usability from their users, whom Google clearly doesn't care for. Prime example: a photo's details used to be easily available, from a simple menu selection, but aren't any more. And no, the swipe up doesn't bring the details up. Just looking to use my phone, Google!

author: Jenn Goble
content: Photos used to be the perfect photos app. it had the best search funding of any app. I used to race iphone users to see how far we could find the same photo and I always won. Now this near perfect search function has been replaced by AI, which not only doesn't return the photos I'm looking for, it actually acts as a stumbling block to me finding them. It's slow and inefficient. Another perfectly good tool ruined in the name of trying to convince us that AI is inevitable.

author: Ryan Jeffries
content: why would you take away the ability to share multiple photos at once? I had to send 10 separate emails, with one photo attached a piece, because you took the ability to share multiple photos away! Such a stupid change. In response to Google. No you can not. when you click on a single photo now, you get a share button, if you select multiple photos, the share button is no longer there after the update

author: Mackenna Finley (Mackennafinn)
content: App freezes/crashes every time I go into collections. it's nearly completely unusable. I went online to find help and it's an issue other people are having but there's no workable solution and doesn't seem to be widespread enough to hope for a patch. I tried emailing the support email listed in the play store but it isn't monitored anymore because google doesn't care about users on its free services. I have tried everything I can think of but nothing helps.

author: lucy simmons
content: In the more section of the app, I can no longer send, print, email, etc. I have tried everything. Every time i download photos from google messages, it doesn't go in the same day I downloaded it. It downloads whatever month or year they took the photo, which is annoying. It takes take me forever to find it. Every update it gets worse. Are you listening to what people are telling you. Stop sending us links to try to fix the problem you caused. That's what you get paid for.

author: Aileen T
content: Every update the app gets worse and worse. The options less and less. And AI slop more and more. I can no longer assign faces, the primary reason I enjoyed the app. Oh but I can steal art styles from hard working artists and make a lifeless recreation of an important moment. Gee. Thanks. -_- --- I wish I had the option to delete the photos in the archive suggestions rather than have to dig around and find them and delete them. I also wish there was a way to delete duplicate images.

author: Rebekah
content: This app DOES NOT duplicate photos, so if you plan on keeping your photos in the original app you were using, you won't. All of my albums are missing photos because they were taken and placed into google photos, once restored all the photos are mixed together. Also when the photo is "stacked" it only restores one photo. I have over 7,000 photos I was transferring and now everything is so disorganized and there's no easy way to fix it without spending hours trying to figure it out. I am so upset!

author: Thats Bill
content: Just Terrible for the Users. No adjustments can be made for my convenience. It's the Apps way or No Way! can't delete from Google storage from the app, and just a crazy incomprehensible organization of photos and videos. This is what happens in Monopolies. They only care about franchising your data, not catering to your needs. ask yourself, when was the last time this app made finding my pics easier without paying a privacy price? Never is my answer.

author: B.A. S
content: So annoying!! Yes I know I'm out of storage. The app completely inundates you with annoying popups, reminding you that you're out of storage, making it impossible to actually, you know, clean up space. I'm going to download all of my photos and videos off of your service, delete the app and never use it again because you annoyed me so much

author: kyla evans-moon
content: After a certain amount of time, the app stops labeling photos of a certain person and won't even let me manually label it because it refuses to list the photo of having a face in it. I believe it only happens with people of color, because it has not happened to me with any other photos.

author: Scarlet Red
content: The photos aren't lost, they are 6 yr old photos that are present in the Google Photos Cloud. I restored them to a phone so I may edit them and use them. Restored images are sitting on their original calendar dates instead of the top. How can you expect anyone using a photo editing app or other app to spend time scrolling through 2026 to 2020 images when they have a lot of images? It never used to be like this. Your links are not relevant to the issue. Something changed on the backend. Thanks

author: Kari Robinson
content: I am paying for Google photo storage for 3TB.... yet there is no customer support to help you when the features don't work. I finally got all my photos uploaded and the face recognition stopped working. it does not see that there is even a face....and when it does, it is not automatically tagging a person. I have face groups turned on, I have cleared the cache, and sent feedback multiple times with requests to email me to troubleshoot.... but I get no help.

author: Ryan Williams
content: Photos is forcing AI generated "creations" that use your photos. If you want to use the image search and ask questions about pictures, you have to have this enabled. There is no way to disable it. I have turned everything off except the AI itself so I can still image search, but it is analyzing my photos without me telling it to. And it's generating extremely ugly AI images and pinning them at the top of my gallery in giant tiles that can't be hidden... Yet another awful addition in a long line.

author: J Thomas
content: Search doesn't work like it used to, so it kind of makes this app worthless to me! With nearly 60k photos I can no longer search for SOME family and friends names in label descriptions I've make over many years, very frustrating. I've contaced google and they cannot find a resolution! Oh, and also something new, the app actually erases what I type on the description! I have to remember to copy text so I can cut and paste, or I have to retype everything!

author: Eduardo Sanz
content: First of all, when people write a review, they are looking for a solution, not for an evasive reply ("yea, yeah, whatever. Next!) Your app has basically hijacked my pictures. Every time I open it, it will give me a screen telling me to continue using the arrange my photos by face group, or something like that. No opportunity is provided to "proceed" or "decline" this feature. Basically, I no longer have access to any graphic information that was created, copied, downloaded, or produced.

author: Erik Venderbush
content: Why have thumbnails of different sizes for photos. I dictate which of my pics are important, NOT Google. Even then, I want an easily browsable system, not a social media wannabe with useless "Remix" and "Memories" features. Just be the damned file system you are supposed to be. Can't even swipe to select multiple anymore. Also, there is not an option to have your photos ONLY on device. No, I don't need to pay for more Google One storage when my phone has 300 free gigs left for photos and videos.

author: Daniel Beyda
content: I don't know how this hasn't been addressed yet, but there has to be a way to stop the little motion preview you get while swiping through motion photos!!! Even with autoplay motion toggle off, there is still a second long preview of the motion in the photo for some reason! It's frustratingly annoying! Especially when trying to swipe through and compare multiple similar photos to see which ones are best, its so jarring that you can't even see the differences fast enough because of the motion!

author: Paul Fearghail (OpusWolf)
content: along with the Constant bugs I have with the phone in general, pixel 10 pro XL, now I can't even crop an image without the app shrinking the image to the point I can barely see it, then when I take my finger off the screen, it jumps back to the original size and the edit is completely wonky. I thought Google was supposed to SET the bar for Android phones, not cause people to switch OS entirely. 👍 edit: you can pass the feedback along to the teams. It's literally your job. 🫡

author: Judy Jones
content: What have you done to this app? I noticed that a couple of my album covers have been changed; not by me, and the simple instructions for changing album covers seem to have disappeared. The instructions for changing wallpaper remain; thankfully you haven't seen fit to change that unasked. Another case of it's not broken, so let's break it?

author: Jeremy Harrington
content: I have a problem. in the app it only shows about 1/20 of the photos and videos I actually have. buy if I go to photos in a browser it shows all of them.. this has been happening for years. I don't know how to fix it. all emails and feedback are disregarded or are ignored completely. so ive started using terracotta. one terabytes of storage free.

author: Tim Brtis
content: It has great features but after years of allowing us free storage when uploading in storage saver mode, they changed their policy and I'm out of storage. It feels like they intentionally did this after first trying to hook us and this idea turns me away from wanting to give them my money for more storage (which I imagine would run out pretty quickly).

author: Jackie Duarte
content: the widget doesn't let you pick albums or favorites. only people+pets and memories. but just because I took a picture of my fridge so I could use it at the grocery store, or notes so I could keep them for later, doesn't mean I need them in "my memories"? I take pictures of documents too. but with this widget it'd be on full display at some point. I can't use it. Google it can't be that hard to change that. it's useless with "my memories" showing random photos, including things I DONT WANT SHOWN

author: Jose Paz
content: Rating: ⭐☆☆☆☆ A Total Storage Trap! They makes it incredibly easy to upload your photos, but the moment you hit your storage limit, it becomes a total nightmare. ​They essentially force you to delete your pictures one by one, making it impossible to easily clean out your account or manage your files in bulk. It feels like a trap designed to frustrate you into paying for more space. ​Do yourself a favor: skip the cloud headache and just buy an external hard drive on Amazon.

author: Kelsie Niffenegger
content: Forcing a multisized photo layout is the most insane design choice I've seen from google in a long time. I want to be able to view my photos in order, which requires them to be the same size. This isn't a social media page, it's a personal photo gallery. I don't want to be forced to have it look "aesthetically pleasing" (which it is not...) when I really just need functionality.

author: Kenny
content: Next time I'll get a phone under another name. I hate this app. Constantly trying to trick you into using their backup so they can charge you more. Search function sucks. They put Screenshots in random places, sometimes *even* in a Screenshots collection, sometimes not. Also, they will actually *REMOVE * photos from your device if you have backup turned on - found that out the hard way one day when I had no internet access, photos were gone from device. I'll look for another app. This is POS.

author: Chris Husted
content: UGH. Now every time I edit a photo, I can't access it from any apps for some time. Google, are you looking at all of these reviews? Things used to work well. Now I frequently can't find photos and your links to "help" aren't helpful. Basic functionality should be prioritized over bells and whistles. The editing is awful, Magic Eraser doesn't work, AI editing is terrible, etc.

author: B Nagle
content: Google has lost hundreds of my pictures over the years. Usually by recommending certain actions. The first time it happened was when Google photos suggested I try a secure folder. After I tried the feature & I went to open the secure folder... the pictures were not in there, and they were not in the trash... they were permanently deleted. Another thing they do is recommend freeing up space, but they don't tell you that they take your photos from your phone gallery and put them in the cloud.

author: Corina Ocanto
content: update: it's been months and no fix has happened. Completely unacceptable for a paid service from a tech giant. Fix this or make storage free! Shared albums won't sync! Now when others I've shared albums with try to upload photos, I can't see them on my end, online or on the phone. This was the only workaround sharing photos across device types for years and now it's useless. What's the point?!

author: Nathan Quinby
content: App is fine other than the fact it is impossible to disable automatic playback of motion photos. This means if you swipe through your photos, nearly every single one shakes for half a second and then changes color. It is extremely disorienting, and I can't imagine a single scenario in which this is useful instead of annoying. Motion photos themselves can be useful, but the way this app displays them is aggravating.

author: Sarah
content: I used to be able to search for memes and find them. Now when I search for the same things I have been, I am being told "nothing found". I don't always have time to put the pictures in their folders. Since switching phones all my photos got all mixed up and I can't find anything anymore! I liked the Samsung gallery better. I have even tried downloading photo sorting apps to help and paid apps but still the Google photos stays a mess. I have even tried to adjust settings to auto update folders!

author: Terryl Westerhold
content: Enshitification in progress. Recent updates have made it so you constantly see a banner at the top of the app if you don't allow Photos to send you notifications. Another similar banner keeps popping up if you haven't identified your face in the app. Neither of these things are needed for an app to store and organize my photos. Please stop making the app worse!

author: richard bidinger
content: I have multiple folders in my gallery. The app doesn't give me the choice of what folder I want. When doing photo to video, I try to scroll down, but the app keeps switching between different folders randomly, and there's no way to stop it. Also, every picture I choose gets to about 45%, then stops. No explanation. Out of 30 or 40 pictures I tried, only 3 were turned into videos. Honestly, this sucks. I would uninstall this if it let me, but it won't.

author: Jazz Miss
content: This is the worst photo app I've ever used. Instead of having a list of galleries, it creates "collections" which require extra clicks to get to where you need to be. On top of that, in some apps there's not always an option to speed scroll so I have to spend minutes slowly scrolling through thousands of pics. Why is such a basic feature not available in all instances? If I had a choice, I wouldn't use it at all, but I'm forced to use it to send photos and videos through messages and some apps.

author: Terrence Hill
content: Worst gallery I have used and seen. You don't want your photos online? No problem, you can't make your own album or edit. You are forced to upload. I know there is an alternate Gallery, but you can't access it as the default gallery app from within the camera. I'll never buy another Pixel phone again. I really hate my phone and barely have it long enough.Another blow to choice and joy.

author: Natalie Marino (natzaratti)
content: Just like all the other apps that started out great then they want to charge you. Can't get rid of duplicates easy. one time the app took a close up of every single face on every single photo I had ever stored and saved them as new photos. Including ones I was in process of editing, including memes, including screenshots of chats or whatever face happened to be in the picture the app blew it up. Nightmare.

author: June H
content: 🤬 Omg, STOP adding new features and STOP reorganizing the photo editing buttons! Previous versions were easier and now more difficult to find what I'm looking for. Also, where are the crop features that allow me to adjust individual corners and rotate by degree? bring those back please. STOP UPDATING it!!! If the app was good, don't fix what isn't broken. Seriously. Update: I needed the actual coordinates of my photos, not to open it in GMaps and go to a street address!!!

author: M
content: It wasn't a great experience to share. All my photos were gone! Nowhere to be found! Used Google Takeout only finding around 16 and continued to go on and on, using zip files I guess. Files not supported or file resized! Over 200 pictures were lost! Later I found out if a picture isn't backed up before archiving it's gone! How special!! Thanks Google for yet another error proof improvement!

author: Mark Potnick
content: More AI enshittification to an otherwise decent photo app. Slow. Unresponsive. Features I couldn't care less about. I literally care about two things: backup and adding photos to multiple albums. Backup works fine. Adding photos to multiple albums at once? A mess. I keep thinking it can't get any worse and I'm constantly proven wrong.

author: Lindsay Sheldon
content: Again, this latest "update" has made things worse - the Magic Eraser tool doesn't work at all, AGAIN. I go through the process to erase things in my picture, and while I'm actively in that mode, it looks like it's (mostly) working. But when I click the check mark to indicate I'm done, to then save the edited picture, it reverts back to the original and ALL my erasing is undone! Still asks if I'd like to save it as a copy. Feature doesn't work anymore!! FIX IT!

author: Diane Antonio
content: Not a secure place to store pics even when paying for space seeing as one can easily lose complete access to their Google Account. This is how easy: - working on a laptop - need to approve account changes on phone - accidentally click NO on phone - lose access on laptop (good) - lose access on phone (WHY?!!!) No 'Try another way' option. No 'Start Appeal' option. No recovery options whatsoever! and Google cannot escalate. wow. Reason? We noticed unusual activity, that's all! Beware!!

author: Chris Arena
content: Up until the recent update, I'd give it a 4-5. I really hate the new "improved" look. I already know what my albums cover picture is, I don't need to see it when I open my album. Also, the blurred task bar at the bottom as well as the small search bar at the top, are just distracting and add nothing to the functionality of the camera roll.

author: Caroline R
content: terrible photos app. takes photos organized in albums and puts them into random collections and is missing 5 years of items which can be found with a search but dont show up anywhere and you cant seem to change the "collections". its a giant pain when you have 19000 items in the gallery. i regret getting a pixel phone entirely due to this app and the lack of customer service

author: Seagull
content: AI search is slower, less accurate, and more presumptuous than the version we had before. When AI search first came out, we even had a choice between the two, no longer. It's forced AI that interests the companies' surveillance more than the customers' choice, and I'll be switching to another storage provider as soon as possible. For work, I'd look up "maps" to pull up maps of locations I service, but the AI assumes I want Google Maps or "map view" and takes over my phone's control to switch.

author: Jordan Wolf
content: I've been thinking about writing a review since the change in the way I can edit my own photos, but I thought it'd be fine. It's not. This sucks. Google lens is no longer in the suggested actions at the bottom, instead you have to tap on the three dots in the upper right corner, which is just unnecessary and annoying. The editor is actually trash now, like I'd rather download an extra app to edit/crop my pics and everytime I want to look through my albums it opens the search function.

author: Steve Prior
content: Another failed update, still no perspective correction and I note that you can no longer select a different frame from motion photos anymore, used to be able to bring up all frames in a line and slide back and forth to select a different one from the one this daft SW wants to use. However the crop tool has been returned to how it was which is a start. might give this a second star if you ever put perspective correction back in! AI just can't figure it out properly.

author: Jayne de Catte
content: Editing photos is terrible since the new update. Cropping is incredibly difficult and was far better before. There's not even "rotate frame" when cropping. The edited photo will be small (frankly difficult to see) in the middle surrounded by black then when you hold to compare to original picture that goes full screen (impossible to compare how the look because the propations are so vastly different. The brush that selects parts of the photo pain in the neck now, it should be given it's own tab

author: Elli
content: It won't let me merge peoples labels or import my photos from Google drive. So after another few years of Google photos and drive, I'm about to give up on this service. It's good, yes. But expensive! The amount of duplicates I have of stuff and photos isn't easely mended either. Now that I'm trying to mend all of that and need to download all my stuff from both photos and drive, it's extremely difficult! For some reason Google hasn't got a select all photos! Google takeout is rubbish too.

author: Cherry Hamlett
content: Why is this update?! So cramming full of AI junk is a reason to remove half the functions of the app? what was wrong with the old one? I now cannot apparently reshape my images properly, most of the use I have for the editing app is reshaping photos I take of my paintings. That is apparently not possible now. The 'AI' auto frame doesn't seem to understand 'square, border images' or have a clue what a user might want from an effort to edit one. Useless.

author: Jay Mastacholi
content: Horrible app. Having the app downloaded eats over half of your "free 15 GB" of storage. Updates constantly shuffle around your photos on social media camera rolls. This app is further proof that I will not purchase a Google smartphone from here on out. If there's one thing I can't stand in photography, it's apps like these that constantly mess with your ability to organize and share your work. Pay for extra storage? That's your answer. Get real and kick rocks Google.

author: Holly Bordon
content: I hate the latest update. please change it back. it takes so long to edit something now because you have to scroll across to access the different sliders and you can only see 2 at a time, so you have no idea how long you'll be scrolling for. Light and Colour options are on different menus and you have to exit one to access the other. I used to use both simultaneously. Who designed this?! Have you purposely made it difficult to use because you'll be releasing a paid version? it's infuriating.

author: Mateja Bešlaj Domankušić
content: Extremely aggressive in trying to get me to back up my photos, turned on auto-backup without my knowing, but what's most annoying is when I deleted from google photos to free up space, it also deleted the same items from my phone. I'm mad and disappointed, I want to be able to delete from one while keeping the other. What's the point of a separate storage space if it forces me to have all the same things stored?

author: A Google user
content: After using this app for decades, since it was created, I just turned the backup option off aam quitting it! So much frustration with the aggressive storage sales tactics, which keep re-uploading images I removed from my online storage to free space for new ones. That is an idiotic and unprofessional approach to force me into buying additional storage... Well, I now cut you altogether! Mr. Sunday Pichai - you better step your game up before becoming an obsolete company.

author: Anados Defered
content: You ruined a perfectly great app with your recent 2 updates. Collections? They're albums. Memories (here) useless. I don't need the reminders. You keep trying to find ways to force location and place identification. The 'on this device' ridiculous as all are ON this device. Stop the infinitely micro management.

author: Matthew Cotham
content: YEARS WORTH OF PHOTOS GONE!! There is NO separation between cloud save and local files. I had years worth of photos, important information, close memories, all wiped, because Google photos attempted to cloud save, didn't have enough cloud save storage, so instead of just leaving cloud save off or keeping the files locally on my device, IT TOOK PRIORITY OVER MY LOCAL GALLERY FILES AND WIPED YEARS WORTH OF DATA. I will never use Google photos again

author: Matt Phillips
content: I just want to crop an image, where has crop gone? I don't want a stupid frame around it. this app gets worse with every update. Going back to Samsung with my next phone, yes there are other apps but Google is too restrictive as a whole, wish I never switched in the first place.

author: Stupid_Person
content: Can we stop adding unnecessary features no one asked for??? I just noticed there are "Automatic albums" where it also allows you to archive photos after 30 days, while it may be useful in some aspects, it's completely useless. The automatic sorting isn't even correct 90% of the time. I DON'T WANT my photos to be sorted like that in unnecessary albums named "Documents". If you really want to keep this feature, at least make it so we can choose to have it or not!!

author: Katryna Rael
content: I wish this app was more like Amazon Photos where I can select click on groups of photos and add them to Folders. Now you can only click on them individually which is extremely TEDIOUS. Also, I hate that any photos I delete from this app also deletes them from my phone and there is no way to retrieve them!!! I accidentally deleted loads of precious family and travel photos from my phone before I realized this. NOT happy.

author: Ilia Kostarev
content: Since last update, the app messed up with my photos a lot, deleted some of my memories. Is that so hard not to delete photos that I probably have there for a reason? Separate issue, is how much that app relies on ai to create albums and sort out people. All ai features are clearly underdeveloped and forced on a user. I can give an example with the way it sorts people in albums. It considers one person, as different people and doesn't allow to manually insert photos to distinguish the person

author: Ilya Shebalin
content: I truly hate how pushy the app is when you run out of storage, I have no intention to buy more than I'm paying for now and it keeps telling me how I'm going to lose my photos whenever I open it, there needs to be an option to shut up about that and let me manage in peace. I've been a long time customer and I have been paying for 200 gb for years now. There needs to be an option to turn off the reminder to buy more and I will change my review.

author: Throgmorton Bandersnatch
content: A year and a half on from my original review complaining about its insistance that I use 'backup' and a few updates later and this app has continued trying to get me to turn on 'backup'. It's well over a dozen times now! I don't want to use Google backup/storage at all so why keep insisting I use it? Once more and I disable the app and use a different one for my photo's!

author: Jessica Huynh
content: I edit a photo, save and it no longer shows up in any social media apps to share. The only work around is deleting from device and redownloading. Or saving as a copy but I prefer not to clog up storage. If I edit the same photo twice and save (not save as copy) then the image self duplicates into 3 copies. Never had an issue until recently, please fix. edit to response; that does not solve the root of the issue, only an extra work around. I am on the latest version of the app.

author: Tiyani Mhlarhi
content: I don't think I've used a more unwieldy app in my life. No finer control as to what counts as the "Camera Roll", so by default, Google Photos for some reason sees restored photos as "Camera Roll", leading to duplicate backups everytime I download a photo. Reverting back to original simply doesn't work. The app does not have a notification for downloading, so there is no way to tell how far it is or to stop it. And now the app won't load my photos. I might switch backup providers at this rate.

author: Moana Daymond
content: I use to love this app but I don't know what the heck you guys have done to it but it's become utter rubbish. It lags when loading a photo, I have to close it and come back to do anything with another photo or if I try anything with one photo straight after another, it does load it at all. Can you please undo whatever you did, it was perfectly fine until you guys decided to "improve" it.. or fix something that wasn't broken. c'mon Google, get it together.

author: Aria Shelton
content: Terrible to use. Ideally saving photos & creating albums should be easy to do & view. Albums shouldn't triplicate the photos. Where photos go when downloaded - who designed this?! The functionality- does it have any that adds value? Horrible setup, layout & functionality. Basic edits frequently save with purple squares throughout the photo - why? Updates (same as any Google product) Dont provide any desperately needed improvements.

author: Authnell Smith
content: Google Photos makes it incredibly hard to organize my library when new photos come in from cloud sync tools like MultCloud. Every single new photo arrives “loose,” and I have to manually sort it into albums all over again when I already did this! Auto‑albums can’t be shared or used by smart frames, so they don’t help. Please give us a simple way to see photos not in any manual album, or a way to auto‑assign albums. This constant manual sorting is exhausting.

author: Dan Thatcher
content: The one plus side, it stores my photos. The negative is that when ever I click download to put them back into my gallery it never works. like what's the point for storing your photos when you can't redownload them when you want? it's clearly an app issue but it's been an issue for years. Also the copying to my Galaxy gallery isn't really an option? I just have a download option.

author: Veronique Medcalf
content: I used to love this app at first. Then Google started making changes and the editing tool became very frustrating. author: Justin Wren
content: Service has steadily declined for years now. Lots of features just completely don't work, for example saving a new frame from a motion photo. They removed the ability to search your photos if they aren't backed up. The cherry on top is recently they added an effect to your memories so that a large number comes in and shows you how many years it's been, unfortunately this new effect has ruined to quality of every single photo it shows. I really don't know how some of this leaves beta.

author: Matt Handler
content: this app used to be perfect, but the quality has gone downhill. the new ai search rarely finds the photos i want in comparison to the old search where i'd find my photos every time. there's also a recent bug where adding photos to an album sometimes creates duplicates, and they are really hard to get rid of. it seems to be related to a delay when pressing the button to add a collection of photos, sometimes this hangs for like 10 seconds and i think if i press it twice i get duplicates.

author: Caroline Russell
content: Not intuitive for digital art, which most of my pictures are. The Memories and Face Recognition and such only pay attention to the (very few) actual photos and thus are not helpful. AI tools are trash. If this app wasn't conveniently synced to my Google account I would uninstall and find something else. Also, make the "folders" button easier to get to, and then STOP MOVING IT AROUND! And stop rearranging the order of the *comic panels* in my *album*.

author: J T
content: Even with the latest updates, it would not let you edit or add location to the backup photos. Some of the photos detected the wrong person or pet or face, and again, it would not let you edit with correct categories. There are many little things like that they need to be more detail oriented when they come out with new/update version.

author: Tiffany McElroy
content: This app continues to get enshitified. In 2026 I thought I could send an album to Google photos without any issues but that's not supported. Instead, I selected each individual image and uploaded them thinking they'd be easy to find under recently uploaded. They were not. They were mixed in with my thousands of other pictures, which I'm obviously not going to look through. I'm just going to use another platform to make an album in the cloud. Crazy Google photos can no longer do that with ease.

author: Nancy J. Smyth
content: There have been multiple recent updates and there have been many editing options that have been created. They are great options! However once you edit a photo even just a little (like cropping), the photo frequently becomes unavailable for posting in another app. You get a message that the photo is processing and this can take hours. So, essentially you can't edit a photo if you want to use it immediately in some other app, which is of course often the point of editing a photo. 🤦‍♀️🤷‍♀️

author: Jowanna Williams
content: My photos are disappearing. I've been using Google Photos for years and even bought extra storage, but for the past four months, I've regretted not just getting a flash drive instead. Many of my photos have vanished, including ones that were very important to me and my family. It's particularly upsetting regarding photos from when my children were younger. Given all the issues with these companies, including their hacks and overall practices, this situation is really frustrating.

author: Ghost Girl
content: I'm so flipping frustrated, every time I take a photo a little too similar to the last one or hold down the button, it stacks them. And every time I look for a button to unstack it, I can either never find it or it doesn't exist. it takes up so much storage; Please fix this, I press every button on that photo, and even the stack itself and I can't fix it. Also, I just don't want the usage of ai on a photo app, it's unnecessary and I wish I could disable it.

author: anne pavlos
content: Google photos is the only option my phone came with. It's been fine until this last update. Before the last update, when you opened the app your photos would be shown by month/year taken so you only needed to scroll down to see older ones. It was easy and organized. With the new update, the organization is gone. All photos/videos are now shown in a haphazard mess. Sad. This app came with the phone and cannot be deleted and replaced.

author: Chris Turner
content: What a terribly oversimplified Android app, you can't select photos from anywhere but your camera roll. If I use a file application, there's "upload to photos" after tapping the share icon, but that disappears as an option when you select more than one photo. I could upload them to Drive however, so I did that only to find out on the Android photos app you can't add photos from your Google Drive. It's too Appley "stay in this single lane" of an experience.

author: J Ben
content: Changes in app aren't reflected in Google photos on desktop. I only used the app because I can't see stacks of photos in the browser version. I thought this would be a good way to find and remove duplicate photos, since Google still does not have a duplicate removal tool. (I assume that this is because they want us to waste space in our accounts, so we have to pay for it.) After using the app on my Chromebook, I was disgusted to find that none of the photos I'd removed had actually been deleted.

author: Arctic Breeze
content: The app is absolute garbage. Apparently it saves your files to the cloud and when you remove them, the files are also removed from your device. and Google purposefully made it so that no contact could be made with them directly for this issue or really any issue. i keep getting notified about the storage from Goodle being low and that the options are to remove files or to pay for more storage. To basically continue to send or receive emails.

author: Ivy
content: New: "Deleting from device" even though it is backed up just deletes it from my photos. No longer showing any of my older photos that are stored in the cloud, but my "best of" highlights end up showing more than the photos that are showing up. View day on said highlights lead nowhere. I have paid for extra storage for years to be able to access these files whenever but am no longer able to do so. New update has not fixed any of these problems, nor has the advice given in the reply.

author: Philip Kahn
content: Been steadily getting worse for years, dressed up as being smarter. Any setting I choose or directive I issue I mean absolutely unconditionally, but the app invents "but I know better" options. To be clear, devs — on a roaming mobile network of bad quality with 3% battery at silicon-melting temps, if I say to backup a 1TB file now, I mean fully saturate my upload bandwidth immediately and until the phone is dead, even if it's dead forever by my choices.

author: Lori O'Ferell
content: Meh. Adequate, at best. Easier to do things with your photos via website - and even then, it ain't great. Tools are not consistently available for all images. App is best for image storage and retrieval. Don't try to do anything fancy, or beyond basic. And ordering prints?! LOL. Your options for cropping, adjusting anything are WOEFULLY limited. Disappointing.

author: Thomas Randle
content: You changed the photo editing format and buried all the useful tools deep inside and I can't tell you how annoying I find it . I used to be able to edit photos in seconds flat and now it takes me 5 times longer . For What ? Leave well enough alone . I have read multiple other peoples conversations on multiple platforms and you have frustrated millions of people, for what ? Why ? What have you achieved other than making it harder on users instead of easier .?? Please put it back how it was .TY

author: U L
content: It's okay to store your photos, but there are a lot of issues. The Issues started for me when AI was added. What's ridiculous is.... it can't even follow the most simple instructions. Constantly it will State things like, "I don't have the capabilities to do that." Seriously!!!!!! You can't cut the dog out of a photo, to make her into a sticker?????? Then there's the "Once Loved" Editing Tools.. I used to be able to take a photo of a cat, and blur everything around the cat. Horrible!

author: Oliver Grover
content: I used to really like this app but things have gotten so confusing that it's nearly impossible to find pictures. I don't understand why sometimes pictures from the cloud show up and sometimes they don't. Why can I not see all my pictures in the main feed? Often I'll save a picture and it will be seemingly nowhere. Screenshots are the worst. The only features I can appreciate are sorting people by face and the AI search to find specific things (when it works).

author: Collin Knoff
content: I've generally enjoyed the photo app over the years, but recently I've had issues with photos syncing across devices, or even on my own device after making edits. For example, 20 minutes ago I simply rotated a photo 90° in the phone app. The file has not updated on my desktop computer, and the image no longer shows up when I try and access it from any outside program like Instagram or Teams. In the photos app though it looks correct and is telling me that it has synced.

author: caleb wheeler (alias for privacy)
content: Google lost many of my photos. At first I thought it was just all new albums, which are lists of photos, no big deal. Upon exiting China, my Pixel phone's Photos app sync was unblocked and it proceeded to"back up." The sync deleted some of my most important new photos. 😩 I found some in the web version but most are unrecovered.

author: Awl Night
content: have to punch threw several options, files, folders, just to see the picture/video that I just took. Plus after several attempts and additional time spent trying to disable the "don't miss out, update and backup all your personal photos to China" prompt from appearing and interfering every time opening the app, is ineffective. which incurs additional waste of time attempting to navigate the app.

author: Emery Kato
content: It used to be easy to search through photos, but ever since the update? I can no longer find things with search even if I am typing exactly what I wrote for a description. It's become way more difficult to use and looks very chaotic for absolutely no reason. While some people may like the new layout, I hate it since there's no space between months so it's hard to separate the timeline, the photos are unevenly organized depending on the size, etc. Please bring back an option for the old format.

author: Mike Olson
content: Beware! The app is very good for saving pictures and videos but the part they don't tell you about is every picture & video taken during your normal day or event, even one's you take double or triple of to be sure you got a good photo is uploaded to this app, did you read the part that said "EVERYTHING" I found out by getting an overage charge by my provider. This app uploads every picture you take immediately, yep, even those private ones!

author: derp derpstein
content: Why do images display on a white background? Makes them harder to see. The app really struggles with images, zooming and panning and gestures. It's impossible to find the gallery of photos I'm tagged in that my friend sent without the URL. Shouldn't I be able to find this easily in the app or bookmark it somehow? It's simply not there. You can't even change the sort order on photos within an album. Too many unlabelled hieroglyphics buttons, I don't know what a cloud with an arrow means.

author: Xx Depersonalized xX
content: I like how my card had to be replaced, So i had to rebuy a subscription, and instead of charging me the 2.99 for 5TB a month, a plan i had for almost a year, they will now be charging 9.99 after three months with the same plan. Just waiting for any inconvenience to charge us more money! Ontop of this there is no way to cancel mistakes because i made three purchases within three minutes on the other plans thinking they were TB when in fact they were GB, because i couldnt back up any photos.

author: A Google user
content: The app is great for backing up photos from different devices and having them in one central location. Still needs a lot of work though. Not being able to organize photos is annoying, and not being able to sort photos via name, date, size and etc can make finding photos very time consuming. The search feature is nice, but rarely finds what I'm looking for. A "recently uploaded" feature would most certainly be nice as well. It's very irritating uploading photos from a PC and having to scroll for hours on my phone to find the photos (because the search feature is almost useless). Also, please! I repeat, please! Change the "free up space feature"! Nothing aggravates me more than hitting a wrong button and deleting all the photos off my device. No permissions (like are you sure you want to do this? And explanation of what it does). No way to stop it. Just stare at your screen in horror as your photos get deleted off your phone with no way to stop it. Scramble to force close the app, but too late! Gone! Back to the abyss of Google photos to try to find your photos. Decent app, but for how long it's been out and how few features it contains, it feels as if it should still be in beta testing mode. Definitely not photographer friendly.

author: Casey Brehm (Raven West)
content: It just randomly uploads, but most of the time it wont. I have it turned on to backup using wifi and unlimited data, both signals are strong. Unrestricted battery use is turned on for this app, battery saving mode is turned off on the device. All folders are checked. Some of these are just photos it isnt even backing up ffs. I am at a loss and have been for two or three months now.

author: Kenneth Yuen
content: Goggle photos were great at one point!! But, lately after each updates!! This app is mixing up the majority of my photos that were already organized!! Or it would asked me to add their names, again!! It frustrating to have to go back in & doing it, all over again!! And lately, it is so slow for it to backup my photos & videos!! It's getting worse with each updates, instead of making it better!! And, I'm a paying customer for storage, every month!! Unbelievable!! 😡😠🤬

author: A Google user
content: This is the only photo program available on the Google phone. It can be difficult to find photos. Sometimes they end up in the cloud and not available on the device. Sometimes they are on the device. There seems to be no rhyme or reason to which location takes priority and features to move/download photos are not always present. Google falls short with this. I miss the ease of use of iPhone's photo app.

author: Travis Washburn
content: How much would we like YouTube if it wasn't free to upload? Such a huge bummer that they took that away with Photos. I have free photo backup with Amazon prime, so there's not a good reason to stay here and start paying double. I'm seriously super bummed though. I was this app's biggest advocate. /// ... Also wish you could edit a photo from the album view... Also wish they had a blemish tool.

author: Gene Hedden
content: Annoying, inconvenient, time consuming problem when I save some photos from the Web, Facebook or Pinterest to the Google Photos gallery. They don't always show up at the top of the gallery like you'd expect. I find them(if I'm lucky) buried hundreds of photos deep in the gallery instead of at the top! Why do they do that? Does it have to do with the source for the photo, the date of the original photo?

author: S inSF
content: NO! As soon as my photos were backed up, they disappeared off my phone and were not placed in the folders I had created. And I can no longer find thousands of them. This is going to be a big time wasting mess! Don't do it! One other problem... now that the photos have disappeared from my device I cannot even retrieve them when I'm trying to attach them to messages or any other app. This is extremely frustrating and I wish they would just allow me to undo those changes.

author: Drew Payment
content: Feels like focus on the Photos app has cooled off. Recently ran into a random limitation of photos in a live album with no way to create a new non-duplicative album and the responses to the community on the forums are "that's enough photos, you should delete some".... It's a product I pay monthly to use with my storage subscriptions, don't tell me how to use it random non-Google employee. It would be nice to see this resolved by setting a start date on an album.

author: Bennet Drover
content: Ok, it does a few things well. Overall, photo app for idiots. Cannot do anything even remotely beyond the begginner level. Can't even figure out how to make new albums from existing albums on the phone... It doesn't give the option! Can't add from an existing album to a shared album. No, I don't want to select hundreds of photos individually from a sorted by date screen. I already have it sorted and just need to share it. Basically, inflexible, doesn't play well with other apps, and unintuitive

author: Joey Hawkins
content: The app has turned into a monster. It used to be such a good app. Now my thoughts have changed. The photos don't sync properly. You can't select an account. You can't select what comes, but you can select what goes. The backup and sync has turned for the worse, AND to top it all off, the last questionable things are why photos turn grey on the load screen and why the backup freezes when there's no way to get into the photos that may be causing it. The only good parts are simplicity and location

author: A Google user
content: Problem! Can't delete from Google Photos without them deleting them from all synced devices. At least give an option to delete them from just the cloud or from cloud and devices. Good for sharing pics. Use to be good for backing up your photos but I'm always getting notifications that I've used all my space so I don't use it for that anymore. Works well though, if you don't mind paying for enough storage. I like that they give you the option of photo quality and which folders to back up.

author: Mel Zigzagoon
content: I loved this app for the past three years I've had it. As someone who has a habit of taking a lot of pictures and videos, the idea of an app with free, unlimited storage that cleaned out my phone for me was amazing. Now that that's going away, I might switch to an alternative in June. I understand that it's hard to keep any app up for free, but maybe instead of getting rid of unlimited storage, you could add some ads to the app in order to make money off of it? Just throwing out a suggestion. Nonetheless, your app has served me well for three years, and I hope you take some of mine and other reviewers' suggestions. Thanks!

author: Kevin Kraft
content: it's great at backing up photos. But when trying to delete large number of photos, you have to select in groups (as you cannot select all, even with scrolling). With large number of photos, this is a pain and takes way too much time. In one forum I found you have to search (in my case, search by year) and then select those photos to delete. Could improve on managing storage. They seem to want to push you into paying for more cloud storage.

author: Katrina Svperstar
content: I hate how it splits up my photos and arranges them how IT thinks my albums should be. It's hard to organize correctly and it's frustratingly difficult to find one specific picture when I've got to look through 50 random albums I didn't even make to get to it. I like the date stamps it puts on everything. I also like being able to share things with a wide range of apps, but this app itself is a nightmare.

author: A Google user
content: There are longstanding issues that need to be addressed. First, it's incredibly unhelpful how often my photos are automatically rotated. Please allow me to turn this off if you're not going to improve it. Maybe if text is recognized, you could have the photo oriented that direction. Second, making any slight edit to a photo seems to be taking forever to implement lately. So once I've taken a photo of a recipe, for example, I'll inevitably need to rotate it, which takes 30 sec/photo.

author: Naomi Nistler
content: Don't order prints! There's no way to get help when you're order is messed up or MISSING. Part of my order never showed it was even shipped out! I got charged for it and 2 weeks later still hasn't showed up . I received all my other prints in a few days. BTW they all come from different states. With one size each. 8x10 one shipment, 5x7 one shipment, ect.. App is good for storing your photos just not in order of date taken most of the time. Anyway, I will never order anything again!

author: A Google user
content: Lost pictures on two very important occasions through this app. It tells you how to retrieve photos but it's not helpful at all. You're better off printing your memories rather than trying to save them on this app. Don't trust this app with your precious memories. I lost mine of my son's last game. I will change my review if google can retrieve my photos.

author: Chris Hatfield-Lee
content: Their is a lot to like about the photo app. the editing tools are great and very easy to use. The new AI edits are quite impressive. However, facial recognition! This used to work well but has become a complete mess recently to the point it's useless to even try and search by name. Random people in backgrounds are being assigned key family members. It ignores 50% of the people clearly in the foreground. And there is no way to manually assign people to help fix errors, Apart from remove photo.

author: Ricky Walker
content: Sorting and searching options are good. However, I just want my photos to show up from most recent. I used to could select the library option, then select the screenshots, camera roll, downloaded, or whatever. Now its complicated and not worth my time. Just give the option to show all the dang photos on the device as soon as the app opens, and sort them by date and time...

author: A Google user
content: I used to think this app was wonderful on my phone and tablet. Bu due to all the updates, downloading and sharing photos is difficult and cumbersome. I feel like you have taken my photos hostage. On my laptop it's still impossible to control the scrolling. It jumps. Does this have something to do with my screen resolution? Is there a way to fix it?

author: Graham Kavanagh (Kav)
content: Used to be a good, March update ruined it. Moved all the editing options. onto different categories, no makes little sense. won't let you re-edit a photo you've already edited. instead makes you revert to original and do all the work again if you want to re-crop or similar. once you then save a copy that becomes almost impossible to find. doesn't get out next to the original or at the top of the gallery like before. only found mine in recently added, which obviously, they are not, Just edited.

author: Whit Diane
content: Really wish there was a way to unselect the Camera folder from auto backup. I delete half the photos I take and really don't want them saved in the first place until I decide to. Also, I spend time organizing the files into folders on my phone, and it would be so easy and nice if Photos on desktop recognized that instead of mashing all the photos in a single stream.

author: Laura Cobb
content: "If it ain't broke, don't fix it." I do not like the new updates at all, they have made the app more difficult to use and find things. It was great before and they should have left it alone. They took away the "sharing" link and now I can't find photos and videos my son has shared. They also took away the link (I think it may have been labeled "for you"?) that took you to all of the collages, animated pictures, movies that Google made from your photos.

author: Yaima Garcia
content: I was extremely happy with his app, but the fact that they're planning to discontinue the free unlimited storage makes me think I should get another way to back up my items, like an external kind of memory. Isn't fair that something that started free now decides to charge a fee without thinking or caring about the customers that can't pay. I'll uninstall and stop using once the change takes place.

author: A Google user
content: Why is it that Google took away the most useful feature of this app from Android but left it for Apple? (i.e. the cloud icon in the upper corner of the photo thumbnails to let you know if a photo is backed up or not). It made managing your backed up photos so much easier! Now you have to guess, unless you choose to have everything backed up to your account (including all your useless and junk photos). At least make it an option to turn on or off! This isn't rocket science Google!

author: A Google user
content: The app is fine for the most part. My issue is I had a folder on my device that I spent hours renaming pictures and organizing. I didn't realize the folder was in the backup and so when I saved and deleted my pictures off my phone, the folder went as well and I can't get that back. It's unfortunate that Photos doesn't save folders as well. Just frustrated with this.

author: A Google user
content: I wish that it functioned in a way that was more similar to how "my files" on a desktop works. If i want to move a bunch of images to one specific folder, then i only want to see them in THAT folder. I don't want it copied there and wherever else, THAT DUPLICATES MY FILES AND RUNS MY STORAGE OUT! If that were an option, hands down, id give a 5+star rating all day, every day. This is my most used app but i need it to work for me, not against me. Thank you!

author: Steven Lewis
content: The new editing interface is trash. I do not care about, nor do I want automatic editing suggestions. The layout is less intuitive than it used to be. And as a bonus, for the life of me I can no longer find how I'm supposed to edit foreground and background blur independently for shots taken in portrait mode, when that used to be a simple thing to do. Stop breaking what used to work Google.

author: Dipper Pines
content: Is there a way to go back to the version before the update? It sucks. It was way easier being able to swipe to the side and access your phone's library and archives and etc. Now I have to relearn an app that had once been so easy to use for YEARS. Please make an option to downgrade the app or go back to the old default. Highly disappointed with the new layout. It honestly kinda feels like y'all are trying to compete with Iphones gallery when there was no need for it.

author: A Google user
content: Here's the deal, when you want to share,say an album, that's in photos, it is a monumental pain in the ass!¿! There should be a direct line from messenger, to photos, instead you are met with way over the top complexity trying to do something as simple as sharing a file. I could increase your sales by no less than 30% with a few, very simple modifications, I guarantee it!¿! You have my email, Hit me back, just to chat, truly yours, your biggest fan, it's Callaghan!¿!

author: A Google user
content: I have used Google Photos app., I do Intend on keeping it. Thus far i have no complaints .It ill take time to honestly say if I would keep it as my main choice being there are so many others which are more versatile and not so kind of out dated. Maybe it performs better for others and its just my lack of not using it the way others do. Have A Wonderful Evening.

author: Christina Osborn
content: This app has way too many categories. I would just like to be able to view my photos. And it's always trying to get me to do things and look at things. I just want the damn phone to be a tool rather than an advertising platform, I wouldn't recommend Moto g in general (that is the type of phone I'm using) and Google photos is just too busy for my taste. The edit features are fine. I do like the option to keep photos in a locked photo album.

author: David Martinez
content: UPDATE: reducing from 3 to 2. Photos makes neat collages etc. I click on a notification to see one. Wait too long, poof it's gone. Random slideshow starts, no way to find the collages. Didn't save in time. Reducing from 5 to 3. The backup is solid. But I hate the new galleries / "this date x years ago" view. I can't zoom, I'm always fighting it going forward and backward, and it skips off to other years. I find myself fighting the UI and frustrated with it almost always when viewing.

author: A Google user
content: The new update makes the app unfortunately cumbersome to use. I liked having all of my pictures in one area, and being able to exclude libraries when necessary. Now, different folders are segregated and I have to go to library and find the photo folders I use most often. Cannot find a way to change this. Will be switching applications to something more usable and streamlined.

author: A Google user
content: Update 11/30/19 Google photos is no longer auto generating albums for me or collages for me to save, since this past spring. I absolutely loved that feature and am so disappointed it's not available to me anymore. ‐------------------------- I love that my pictures are backed up to google photos. I like the Google assistant and the rediscover this day feature. I like being able to go into the app and find pics from June 2013 (or whenever) so easy!

author: John Jack
content: Orig review: "I have a pixel XL and the photos app with unlimited storage is absolutely great." New review: I have pixel 4xl now. They removed unlimited storage of full res images. That sucks. They are using my data as a training set for image processing models and who knows what else, the least they could do is let me store photos for free at full res if they are going to just use them as a data set.

author: A Google user
content: I expect far better from Google. I have had create and recreate an album 3 times, and it doesn't even show up when I click the Albums button. I have to search for the title of it and then it appears. Many times I go to add photos and it take 20-30 seconds to add 10 pics to the album, only to then tell me "0 items added." I also shared the album with someone, and then the entire album was gone. Almost like I had physically sent it off to them, rather than just share the link. Bad Google

author: A Google user
content: I get so frustrated when putting photos together. I can find some stuff, but can never seem to really find what I am looking for. I dig and dig and even if it is a brand new picture, if I edit it, the edits disappear and I can never post them. sometimes it takes my picture sideways, and it is really frustrating to not be able to have a rotated copy on hand. I do not like several of the updates. I thoroughly miss the option to make a "hidden" photo option as well.

author: Patricia Leslie
content: Its cool, but is google really struggling so much for money that they can't allow us to back up pics and vidoes for free? I'm going to have to start using a couple external hard drives cause I'm not paying for it anymore....especially when they keep finding ways to charge more. Also, months ago, when I first started having to pay, I had a lot of storage and then randomly, in a very short period of time without adding much of anything it said I was completely out and had to pay.

author: Sabrina Absher
content: Loved Google Photos. Always demonstrating to people how easy it was to find a photo i.e. 'Dog in a hat'. Now the search has changed to AI and it's terrible. Even changing to classic, the same search will show your photo briefly, then change to 'Nothing found' or a huge list of random garbage. I cannot search anything. So sad. I have thousands of photos in storage. Google was my end all, be all.

author: jaz robinhawk
content: AI replacement got rid of the best editing features. the number one thing as an artist that I used was the perspective crop tool, followed by some of the color adjustments. they were quick at the fingertips and matched quality that you'd get from Photoshop. low and behold after an update these features no longer exist, making this app absolutely useless imo. I don't care about access through any Google platform, the editing tools were what made it. so disappointed in all the AI integration.

author: Yvonne Howard
content: I would very much appreciate it if the out of storage display (for backed up documents) would stop appearing. My photos are automatically backup without my say so. I'm not interested in having most of my docs backed up. I back them up myself. It would be nice if the user can decide what to have backed up. I'm not interested in paying for more backup storage. I would give five stars if I didn't have that problem. It can be very annoying.

author: Machaley Larder
content: It was great but in collections it only sometimes let's me merge faces with collections I already have, most of the time it won't pick up the collections I already have there so have to save lots of groupings of the same person in duplicate names. Edit: I mean that with some faces, when I try to merge, it's not picking up that there's already a grouping with their name on so I have many groupings named the same, although other faces it's fine and their name shows on the 'suggested' list.

author: Emily Lin
content: Used to love Google Photos, especially the Perspective tool that let me fix slanted angles and straighten lines. Now it's gone with the new update, and there's no substitute. Please bring it back. This was essential for editing architecture, scanned documents, and travel photos. Until then, 2 stars.

author: Mike Williams
content: Poor usability. Can't select a bunch of photos to move them to an album AND archive at same time. (Photos have to be reselected for subsequent actions.) App insists on labelling my dog as one that died 15 years ago despite them being different colours. Basic editing options such as cropping and straightening are not as quick to access as they should be. Search terms and results are biased towards North American norms.

author: Katie O
content: I like the photos app, but I really don't like the way Collections has a random Places folder that is the first one in the list. I'm not interested in the grouping of my photos by place or accessing them like this and I should be able to delete or move this collection down the list so the folders I want are near the top.

author: David S.
content: Within the past couple weeks, I'm unable to use search - all searches return no results. App no longer grabs search terms from the 'commenting' area where I label important photos or screenshots from the past. I've tried force stop, reboot, update, clear cache - no change. Concerned that clear data or uninstalling will cause photo losses. Can anyone please give me my next SAFE steps to resolve this? Thank you.

author: Devon Skinner
content: Ever since the last update, the app has run incredibly slow and has significantly slowed down my workflow. Additionally, the new editing updates don't give me an option to export to Adobe Photoshop Express (which it did before the update) and the cropping tool is now harder to see margins for cutting. Very disappointed.

author: Natalie Burns
content: I went into the app looking for something to send my sister only to discover that it's missing. Just before that I had asked the app to back up my photos to clear up space and it seems a handful had been erased entirely. I'm pretty irritated and now I'm wondering if this is a one time error or how often this happened previously and I never noticed before. I tried all the stuff the "help" section suggestions and nothing. Can't find those images or an explanation.

author: Guy Cooper
content: App is broken. It used to work fine until a recent update. When you attach an image to a text message about 60% of the image does not appear in the preview, which makes the preview completely worthless. You have to tap on the image to see it. Lots of other people complaining on Google message boards, but Google seems to be ignoring everyone. I'm looking for a new app.

author: Thomas Haeberlen
content: The latest version of the app doesn't seem to order pictures chronologically by default any more. Instead, a random recent picture that (I suppose) the Google AI considers somehow "most relevant" is placed on top. I don't like this and I would like to kindly ask for at least an config option to switch to a strictly chronological ordering of the pictures.

author: Carla Sheedy
content: I used to love this app. So many options to edit my photos. The Magic tool is amazing. But over the last year or so, more and more often I edit a photo, save it and it ends up with lines across it or half the picture is purple or other ways it's ruined. I've submitted these issues multiple times over the last 6+ months but no one has ever responded about them.

author: Charlotte Fox
content: I used to love Google photos but now thinking of moving to iOS thanks to the latest update that doesn't let you have a 4 across grid anymore. Instead the only options are 3 or 5 across and random photos are massive, disrupting the basic grid and making it difficult to select photos in a chronological order. Just a small change that renders the whole app really annoying to use.

author: Patrick James
content: The latest forced update has totally ruined the interface and usability. I pay for additional storage and have over 20,000 photos stored, and have always been able to set all thumbnails the same size which is essential to be able to scroll through lots of photos. Now every few rows there is a random photo 6 times the size of the rest. This change is pointless and makes it much harder to find the photo I want. I may need to find another app and pay for storage elsewhere

author: Gabrielis Damarackas
content: Honestly, Most of the updates were bearable, the save as copy for every edit sucked, and the rounding of the corners for the crop tool was a little finicky but bearable. now the most recent update, it's horrible, I much preferred the previous layout, where I could properly see what photos were taken when, but now the only indicator is the little bubble at the top saying when, and then the floating bubble to navigate collections and homepage also doesn't look great.

author: Colin Reid
content: Baffling UI choices continue. Want to easily find a photo from a certain date using easy visuals? Tough. It's now a homogeneous mess that just dumps all your photos together with no separation. It gives a vague date at the top, but you might have three photos in a row from two different days. Don't worry, that doesn't matter because now photos uses ✨AI✨ because of course it does.

author: Microwave Dave
content: Incredibly tedious, barely fit for purpose, frustratingly slow. • Often takes 30-60 seconds to change a photo's tag. • Can't manually add people or pets if Auto-tag fails. • Can't see long photo names. • Can't highlight multiple photos to re-tag, can only re-tag an entire album or one-by-one. • Can't auto-tag local media, only media uploaded to Google Photos. • Often returns to the main screen when backing out of a photo instead of album or group. Breaks workflow.

author: Lisa Ha
content: Ongoing issue for some time now. It fails to recognise pets in a lot of photos. If I type in search bar "dogs", those pet photos appear, however if I just go through People and Pets, photos do not appear despite turning on the pets function. It recognises some but not others... edit: face groups was turned on and still not working..

author: Anthony Daniels
content: Horrible layout now with odd photos extra large. I want them all thumbnail size. Looks horrible and delete is now messy as they aren't shown in time order properly now. The first "big" picture shown for the month isn't even the first picture of the month - it doesn't even arrange them chronological order now thanks to the developers idea of "design". A mess.

author: Zach W
content: Once again they've made another stupid change. Now my grid looks terrible. Most of the photos are in the usual square grid but then random ones will be blown up bigger. And it also seems totally random which photo gets blown up bigger. This completely messes with my flow when sorting through and editing. This is just another completely unnecessary change that they should get rid of as soon as possible

author: Gregory Bennett
content: UI updates make the app more confusing to navigate. I like Google photos, I pay for the storage and everything but sometimes I want my gallery app to just be a gallery app. At times it feels like I'm being forced into using the online workflows which is frustrating when all I want to do is share like 30 pictures I took today that are still on my phone. But photos can only actually share three of them at random and it just makes no sense.

author: Jessica Farquhar
content: I generally love the app and the memories that is pulls up however, I am reasonably upset that the compilations that the app puts together that play a song over the original audio of the video and there is no setting to remove it without having to jump through hoops for each and every video. Google, please fix it.

author: Piyush Shewale
content: Recently broken. Earlier it used to work seamlessly. Now when trying to create a highlight video, after selecting the persons, takes hell lot of time for loading(By the way I am using S24 Ultra and a 1GBPS Wifi), and then boom.....just goes back to template selection page. The reason I started using this app suddenly became useless.

author: Dion Swope
content: I'm not too excited about how it groups my pictures together. Then, I have a video of my two cats playing with a new toy and it no longer has a play availability and that was recorded a month before one of them died. And my albums keep getting archived and sometimes disappear. Way to mess with people's memories. 🥴

author: Megan
content: Stop deleting my photos without my permission!I checked my trash and archive and the photos im looking for aren't there and i'm not close to the storage limit. I pay $3 a month for extra storage so you can save my photos not delete them! also you need to fix your pet recognition especially black cats because I can't spend hours sorting through hundreds of photos of three different black cats. literally every single photo of my black cats is under the wrong profile!

author: Laura R
content: I'm not able to download any of my videos to my device, they all come through as unsupported media. photos are fine, but videos won't download. I've cleared 6gb of space in my phone, updated the phone, updated the app, disabled and re-enabled the app, still nothing.

author: Roland Hazoto (Hazoto Gaming)
content: this f***ing app keeps backing up albums even though I explicitly have backup turned off. and this is after it spent years asking me if I wanted to turn back up on every single time I opened it even though I said no every time. Now it stopped asking and just backs up newly created albums with no way to stop it. STOP SHOVING CLOUD BACKUP DOWN MY THROAT

author: Patrick Villacorta
content: Lowering my rating until my issue is fixed. Cannot create new faces or add photos to faces. Several months now with no feedback. Original review: Mostly happy with this app. Now that my whole life in pictures belongs to Google, I really hope that they live forever. Even now that they have started charging for extra storage, I see no better option. Though less of an issue than before, there are still times when Google photos overrides/undo what I do manually, ex. tagging faces, merging faces.

author: edwin grosmann
content: can't use it anymore with that creepy trace line around objects in the photo. also remove the very prominent 'backup now' button in every photo, reminding me that i've turned off backup is very anoying; respect my decision please. now using the stock samsung photo app as my dayly driver; suits me: WAAAY less bloated indeed. another example of how Google has ruined a perfectly good app.

author: Richard P
content: I don't like how the app constantly rearrange photos, making them very difficult to find. I also don't appreciate the app creating slide shows on its own. For example, the app took pictures of my mom not along after she passed. She was very ill and the pictures were her at her worst. I was shocked the app used the pictures and, without my permission, put together a slide show. It was painful to see. Perhaps there is a way to shut off this feature, but I can't find it. Not a fan of this app

author: David Silva (Davi_)
content: I no longer can edit videos longer than 1min, just keeps saying "unable to save" after trying for like 2 minutes. The quality option is a lie, you have to download the video to actually watch it with it's original quality. What's the point then? I really tried toc.ake tbis work because it's just annoying moving +200Gb of videos/photos but I guess Google photos is no longer an option.

author: M Caruso
content: Update: Its been a year. The portrait blur was fixed for a while but now its a guessing game again. Please address this, so I dont have to look for a replacement. Since the update, Portrait Blur does not work correctly,HDR is missing, UI has too much backlash to set precisely.

author: Mini Gamer Adib
content: Whenever I open the Videos section in Google Photos, the thumbnails are automatically zoomed in. This happens every time, forcing me to manually zoom out before I can comfortably browse my videos. It’s quite inconvenient.
