Please fix this issue so the Videos section opens at the normal/default zoom level or remembers the user's preferred zoom setting. Thank you!

author: speegler78
content: This year and certainly with the re-design, this app has gotten worse and is starting to make me think I need to migrate to a competitor for my photos. My least favorite big is that every photo I crop I get a duplicate (even after deleting the original, a day or two later I get a second copy of the edited version).

author: Igor Bugarinovic
content: Google removed the ability to zoom out to uniform tiny thumbnails in the last update for no reason, instead forcing a dynamic view where random photos/videos are taking up excessive grid space It is now much harder to quickly scan and find older photos, and I've had to roll back to an old version of Google Photos for this reason. On the other hand, thank you for finally allowing us to download multiple pictures to device with one click. This basic missing feature was a much needed change.

author: Farrell O'Gara
content: It's rubbish that when you've opted to backup WhatsApp photos automatically, Google Photos saves them in a separate album to the Camera folder by default, with no option of changing their default album location. The app backs them up again into the separate WhatsApp album, if you move batches from there to Camera! The option to save an edited photo or screenshot, but not to save it as a copy of the edited original, was removed some time ago too... Why?

author: Hagatha Crone
content: now what the heck happened again I left a review saying how the edit button was missing on the videos, 2 Days later the edit button was back on and I edited my post and give you guys a core stars and now all of a sudden I go on my phone today and the edit buttons gone again for the videos 🙄😠 what is going on end I can't even show you a screenshot of what I'm talking about

author: Zak Knight
content: Severely dislike the latest update. I don't want or need my phone in selfie mode every time I open it. Nor do I want or need AI to suggest edits and log every subject in my photos. Phone gets hot to the point of concern if the camera app is running for too long.

author: Kody Warden
content: I DID have this at 5 stars, but the newest update changed the way Google photos magic eraser works, my device (pixel 8 pro) is not handling it well. it's slow, and does NOT only change the things it highlights, it frequently goes far around the edge of the selection bubble and warps the image.

author: Greg Council
content: Like everything else Google makes, Photos is being ruined by AI. I'm especially tired of telling it to turn off the Quick Edit "feature" when sharing photos, only to have it turn itself back on. Why would I WANT friction added to the experience of sharing a photo? Make it make sense!

author: By Czy
content: Google photos used to be much better in past like 10 years ago in EU. It makes me really angry when I have my photos synchronized by default and Google keeps asking me to pay the money for a Google One instead of easily help me clean up the space. Even if I clean up the space i still have this reminder after a few weeks as I have 80% size taken by my Google apps, Mail, etc. Just like most free users I do not upgrade Google to Google one only for extra size

author: Joseph Herig
content: Photo to video editor's model Veo2 is way to strict. Blocks 90% of my appropriate photos. Google AI says the filter needs replaced, it's inconsistent and over cautious. GP needs customizable features like choosing main window lay out. Example: Choose to see only Albums, Folders or Collection. Minimal features. It works but hopefully more customizable options will be available soon. Its ok but don't use "photo to video, it's broken, inconsistent and over cautious. Recommended: Visionstoryai

author: Wolfie Wood
content: I used to love google photos and drive but now it is not working as I set it to! I keep turning the backup OFF and it magically turns itself back ON within a month. cluttering the photos I would actually like to save to google photos, like real photos, with the random screenshots and gifs I DO NOT WANT TO SAVE TO GOOGLE! Then when I try to delete the photos off of the google photos it deletes it from my device also, even with the auto sync OFF! LET US DELETE FROM GOOGLE ALONE NOT EVERYTHING!

author: Carly Szippl
content: I used to really enjoy the memories slideshows; there used to just be instrumental music. But now I'm watching slideshows of my kids when they were babies and toddlers... with background music with lyrics about getting naked and taking shots, breakups, lost loves? Today it played "Lady Marmalade" during a slideshow of my toddlers' Christmas photos. Inappropriate and not appreciated. Go back to instrumental or give me the option to change the music!

author: Mrs Arias
content: I tried to upload a picture on a webpage using photo picker and it would not pull up no matter what I did. I want complete freedom to share what I need to share! The feature/restriction is annoying!

author: Joshua M.
content: Not a big fan of the UI changes. It was perfectly fine before with around 4 pictures per row and showing the date etc but now it only does so when showing 3 per row and when you zoom out to 4 it completely removes individual dates and only sorts by month. Its just such a pointless decision to change and nobody asked for it.

author: Micah Corlew
content: Terrible update to library layout. Things used to be sorted chronologically left to right and top to bottom, as they should be. Now it's approximated to minimize negative space and can't be changed.

author: scott powell
content: Google, what could you possibly be thinking with the terrible background music on the photo memories??? It's got to be the absolute worst idea you've ever come up with. Even if the music was good it would still be a huge mistake, but the music is total garbage, and cannot be silenced without also muting the video memory being watched. What on earth were you thinking?? I thought smarter people than this worked for Google. This is not the work of talented minds

author: Kristi Heiderscheid
content: all though they've improved the "magic eraser" they now have the standard popup notification, after deleting a picture, blocking the row of editing options. it would be tolerable if it didn't stay in screen for so long. maybe they could give us the option as to where it shows up, (top or bottom) or the option for the length of duration it stays in my way. also the stacking similar pictures is a joke. simply changing the framing on a picture eliminates it from qualifying as a "similar" picture

author: Ryan Wang
content: Recent updates have introduced a bunch of bugs that make it really inconvenient to use daily. The grid view has random large or elongated photos making it hard to scan photos and follow their chronological order. The edit tools randomly switch order, making it take longer to find specific tools. Select and drag is completely bugged, making it tedious to select more than one photo. Really disappointing, as this was one of the most polished Google apps but is now buggy and a chore to use.

author: RJ Reed
content: technically I can review and edit photos yay. but the constant need to avoid either sending all my private images to the Google cloud which we know is being used to train AI, alongside the constant pressure to use AI tools, has me on the hunt for a new app. this default isn't worth it, it's just exploitative. also I do NOT trust it with my data.

author: Amber J
content: Specifically purchased the type of phone I have for this photos app. For years I have been thrilled. However, with AI (just like Gmail app now) I'm exhausted, frustrated, and disappointed. SO much time I wasted finding a simple photo (or not). I despise AI integrations in the apps. It used to be that I could bypass it. I appreciated that. CANNOT any longer. What good is the app (and especially AI) if I can't find photos I know exist (and used to be able to find) using basic search terms.

author: Billy James Fortner
content: This is supposed to be a functional product. Not a digital paperweight. After receiving my TCL 50 XE T614SP, Photos and most of its subfunctions worked pretty good. But now as I use a Samsung A17, I'm not confident at all of using it. It's broken at worst, most especially Magic Eraser. The latest update makes this app so spotty and broken, I don't even want to enable it at all until all the bugs are worked out, but I highly doubt that will make any smidge of difference. Big nope for me, Google.

author: Dean Caron
content: The people & pet grouping and then auto-updating albums are fantastic features, if they actually worked. Has not id'ed a person in months despite being on latest version and reaching out for support. Group similar faces option is on.

author: Hydonyx Design
content: organization difficulty. it's great having folders but I wish they'd disappear from the main folder or something once organized into one otherwise they can get sorted into multiple folders and it's a mess. also the search for any of my Pic is difficult when I'm trying to find a specific one but any of the key words don't make it pop up so I end up just having to scroll. it seems like a problem other users are having as I see very similar reviews. the app updates often but ive had this same issue

author: TayLanee Campbell
content: not easy to transfer, everything is to push you towards a subscription, takes forever to recognize that photos/vids were deleted and if you want to use an extended drive you cant just drag and drop.

author: Kris H
content: I used to love the app. That was, until Google got money hungry and created Google One storage. Between email, drive, and photos, I'm now barely hanging onto free storage. Google photos was once the best place to back up the gazillion photos I have taken over the last eight or so years, but now I have to pay for storage? I don't want to pay a ridiculous charge for space that was once free. Doesn't the Google franchise have enough money? EDIT: STILL THE SAME ISSUE THREE YEARS LATER.

author: Blessed Ahunanya
content: I'm rating 2 stars because of the magic eraser future, it's trash at this point if it's a bug check it, cause it barely works properly after I updated and downloaded it as Google photos requested, after that I can't use it to erase objects or anything and it keeps processing an erasure for more that 5 - 10s, it wasn't like this before fr.

author: Oleg T
content: Every time you move a photo to trash a LARGE UGLY BLACK BAR appears close to the middle of the screen, stating: "Moved to trash / Undo". It blocks the view of a next photo for ≈5-6 seconds. This feature is completely unnecessary, because: 1) you are already required to make 2 clicks to trash a photo – first click the trash icon and next click the confirmation dialogue; 2) photos moved to trash are not permanently deleted for at least 30 days and can be easily restored anytime.

author: Lee
content: Useless for a backup, don't waste your time! Absolute joke of a service. Any basic features and functions are basically non existent. Only want to download all my backup files (200gb) but can't. Have to do it through a PC (I don't have) and select 17,000 photos individually?? Shambles.

author: Zozo
content: "Google Photos needs to add a proper selective backup feature. Currently, it backs up everything automatically, including downloaded images, screenshots, and videos, without allowing users to choose only camera photos or exclude videos. Please give us separate toggles to control photo and video backups, as well as the ability to choose specific device folders."

author: Sharon Sayre
content: Puts row of creepy figures bottom of every screenshot so I have to take more screenshot of team stats and lists. Is not helpful! Now it's 8/24/26 and is big lagging delay before will take my screenprint, and still has line blocking new at bottom I cannot get rid of!

author: Ben Howes
content: still a horror show of usability for editing (no I'm not going to use Gemini to create AI slop) and the timeline doesn't show all photos even if they're tagged with location and timestamp (same on browser, so it's not just the app).

author: ByRoyalCommandV
content: Does at of the things you'd expect a photos app to do. Basic edits are easily done, back ups are quick and easy, and organising what photo goes where is simple. However, the latest update seems to arbitrarily choose a photo or video to enlarge compared to everything else in the grid layout of all backed up files, meaning that seeing what photos/videos are in order in next to impossible without prior knowledge. Very bad UI decision that makes the app annoying to use.

author: José Simões
content: Devs, can we stop cascading async third-party loads into the UI, *especially* in places where other important elements would be? I just clicked a button on a toast that I couldn't even read - because it appeared suddenly on top of the "edit" button in the toolbar. TLDR; decent app, but random stuff keeps showing up in important places. Use if you don't mind repetitive pop-ups and clicking mysterious buttons with no further context.

author: Gemma Bailey
content: frustrated by the app changing the layout. I like the app to open on the camera lbum but it's changed. also, the people and pets have such poor AI detection. i don't seem to have a folder for myself, but it lets me look at others. when I remove photos from others and say it's the wrong person it should ask who it is so it moves correctly. currently it just ignores you removing it and reappears when you refresh.

author: Jonathan Blair
content: Generally love Google, but the recent update of combining RAW/Jpeg as one image and then displaying the RAW by default is a horrible user experience. Also, when I used to make albums to share with people, it would include the RAWs and JPEGS...now it only adds the RAWs. if you want to add both, you have to click on an image, switch it to jpeg view, then add to album to share. So unbelievably frustrating having to do this 200 times just to share 200 jpeg photos instead of selecting a day.

author: Callum Newland
content: automatic backup is nice, although it is very annoying that there is no easy way to un-backup an image once uploaded. Random large images on the photos view is a terrible eyesore, it was fine before there was no need to make it worse. Collections tab is annoying: albums are too large and there is no way to choose which image is displayed for them, there is no way to order them, there is no way to remove the useless documents tab which nobody would ever use. Hiding places tab would be good too.

author: Vijay Khairnar
content: very bad navigation. whenever I have to send or share a photo I never find it in photos, because it never show recently downloaded photos on top. it uses some metadata which is useless. example if I have to send a photo to a person just downloaded from Gmail, it goes far below in choose photo list. I have to go to files application, then I see the photo on the top, then I click share button. but there are few applications like gmail, doesn't support files, in this case I take screenshot of file

author: Sophie Sweatman
content: Far too many changes behind the scenes. A while back my pictures were backed up from my phone and then available in Google Photos on my phone and laptop as well as Photoscan by Google. Now it is unclear what has been kept or lost. The tools keep changing around behind the scenes and we never get new signposts. The new search cannot be jigged. it shows people who are distinctly not me as photos of me are labelled me. It can't be told. Then keyword searched is replaced by chatty scatter-gun AI

author: Gabriel Eaton
content: App is good and works, but they recently changed it so it's no longer 4 photos across only 3 which makes the entire thing feel significantly more cramped. Now it's either very cramped 3 across or very small 5 across. If only there was something comfortable in between that everyone was also used to. No longer able to press and swipe to select multiple photos in my main reel, but I can do that in sub-folders. AI edits are pushed even with AI features disabled.

author: Akash kushwaha
content: I like how Google keeps adding updates every 2 weeks just to remind me in the gallery that "your app is up to date". So, I keep updating the app instead of checking my photo and video collections. They keep adding features that are not needed before. Also, they also add gemini pro features inside the app so that I can accidentally click on the payment button and get busy for 2 minutes to get out there whenever I want to make myself busy when others want to talk with me (yk for farming aura)

author: ARose
content: PLEASE FIX ASAP! WHERE DO THE EDITED PHOTOS GO? As soon as you finish editing and click SAVE it's GONE and you can only search for the original photo again! PLEASE FIX THIS! Also still need to make the editor LARGER and the buttons easier but overall the navigation menus and saving still need help! Search works ok but saved photos should be saved instantly to an easy to find location! edited and automatic edits and missed "memories" are also hard to find a calendar option and more folders too

author: Pogo Cole
content: This latest update to remove the months is awful. I can't find the pictures I want because they are all combined together and the 'months' floating on top does not help because I can't tell where one month ends and the other begins which is how I would find my pictures easily before. I pay for all the space I have, so should not have be subjected to this update. Worst update ever. And why do I have some photos made larger than all the others? What the heck? Updating without asking?

author: Scarlet Ross
content: The UI changed and it's just horrid. Instead of a simple navigation bar at the bottom, they thought it would be aesthetic to make it a tiny awkward sliver near the bottom of the screen. And the layout of my photos now is collage-shaped rather than in squares and it's a pain to look at. At this point, they're just changing random things. 🫩

author: Pomme Granny
content: Use to be a great app, but since the last update (I think I got it a week ago or something), RAW files are taking ages to be processed, and are displayed first by default in the gallery, which takes a very long time. Also, now, the RAW preview looks horrendous, this is probably due to the fact that we used to have specific filenames (COVER for the jpg and RAW for the... raw). This is basically unusable now when you shoot RAW. Very disappointed 😞

author: Alan Guy
content: latest update not good. ui was fine before now just looks like the iOS photos app. much preferred how it looked before and the lack of separation by date between photos makes it a lot harder to find things as they all just blend together. Switched from iOS to pixel as like prefer Google apps, hopefully not a sign of things to come.

author: Cheers Thanksalot
content: Google's latest update for my Google pixel 0hone broke basic stuff. Saving edited photos now often results in partial photos, or photos that look like jigsaw puzzles. The "dynamic" adjustment unnecessarily over-straightens images so they look completely wrong. And this is their so-called update. And that on their own phone.

author: Clément
content: It works but the UX is not great: - When I try to create an album nothing happens so I click several times and then it duplicates the album - I cannot see my favorites in the favorites view - I cannot create subsections within an album - I cannot order my albums within folders - When I try to add highlights to a 1k+ photo album it auto selects 100 and there is no other way than to deselect them manually by scrolling through all the photos It feels to me like the developers are not using the app

author: Swayom Kanti Ghosh
content: The app layout used to be so good...but now all the photos appear together... without the photos of one date being separated from another date. Please change back to the previous one. Edit: Another issue. Setting Locations for each photo has become a nightmare, what I want to search for doesn't come up, and existing locations can't be removed easily

author: Jesi
content: I love the editing options on this but I'm not a fan of actually ordering photos. all that the ups site says is that there is not certain date it will be delivered, and then says the 26th, it is not the 29th and still nothing. the last update to the package tracking was on the 26th. it should not take this long for a simple 5x7 photo.

author: Monica Evison
content: Why is there a shimmering white line around people? how do I get rid of it? extremely annoying. I'd like to uninstall updates, it used to be good. It got worse now it stacks my photos. I think I'll stop paying for it. I hate the highlights and memories.

author: Craig Crosby-Mckenna
content: Has a bug on Pixel phones that they've not fixed in an age. If you edit a photo then try to import that edited image into another app it will throw up an error message. The workaround is to remove all updates and prevent it from doing any further updates or do a screenshot of the edited image and add that which is obviously not great.

author: Jorge-Alberto Castro-Castaneda
content: The last update has a lot of bugs. We can't select multiple images at the same time by clicking and dragging. The interface looked better when you could see the picture being divided by the day it was taking / month. Needs to be fixed ASAP!

author: Tristin Gregorian
content: I'm not the biggest fan of folders being on a second page, separated from the first page which only shows camera roll photos. And for some reason, I can't delete photos anymore? It just pulls up an infinitely-looping circle of doom and does nothing. Strange stuff. Otherwise, the app has amazing features that I really enjoy. I love that I can order photos through the app. While I haven't used it yet, I certainly plan to! Altogether, I really just use the app became it came pre-installed.

author: Alicia Perez
content: I HATE the new organization of Collections. Now I have to click through multiple menus to find my folders, it takes longer and I don't want or need it. I also wish I could default to open on my Device folders which is what I use the most. I do not care about Memories. I hate the pop-ups that constantly ask me to back up my photos (which I do not want to do). This app gets worse and worse with every update. At least allow us to customize our default view! Please!!

author: Lee Anne Roque
content: this app worked great until recently. now anytime I crop or edit a picture in anyway, it no longer shows up on my camera, recent photos, or any other album in other apps to post. I thought it was a Facebook issue but as it turns out the photos no longer show up on fb, Lightroom, Vinted, eBay, etc. which is pretty inconvenient if you want to post something. none of the recent updates have fixed this issue. before it was a 5/5 now it's a 3/5 please fix this bug!

author: Jared
content: Why can I download some stuff and other stuff, no. It'll just say downloading when I click on it but nothing. Sometimes I'll get a notification like 30 minutes later saying unsuccessful but it's completely random. I don't know why, there's no clues. it's annoying as hell. It can be the same batch of videos from the same day of the same thing, same album. Let's say out of 10, only 7 will download. The others are in some weird download purgatory. At least on mobile.

author: Melley
content: I like Google photos but the mobile app is a bit of a cluster compared to the more straightforward, less clustered desktop/PC version. Also, is there a reliable way for duplicate images to be axed without having to manually check to make sure you're not deleting both? I'm talking for like 100s+ of pictures. Thanks! edit 8/28/26, why are my photos not showing up in the big main page? Only some are, the rest are on Recently Added. Having to go dig for my most recent screenshots is nuts

author: CJ Hannah
content: Fix Google Photos, PLZZZZ! It used to be my favorite, GO TO for photos until a few weeks ago. I'm an artist, photographer, and major ADHD - I have come to rely on GP so much it's almost 2nd skin, and saved me so much time & hassle.Now, I can't even find all of my photos, albums, etc. Most 🤬 is not being able to just pull up a photo and attach or insert anywhere. Just spent over 1 hr trying to find a photo I had taken of an order that the seller asked for me to upload a pic. (Still can't)

author: Jasmine Ivy
content: It's mostly good but some photos don't have my face highlighted or those of other ppl. There's no way to manually add a face so when I go to look up pictures of myself for sharing, etc. those photos aren't available and I have to scroll to find them if I don't know the date. Very inconvenient. Pleeeeeease add a manual face adding option.

author: Natural Nashuan
content: please stop the use of our photos for the pointless music videos. Everyone please Read the info that the app can read - we can't opt out of much of it. High resolution photos will lead to the app demanding that you pay for storage. The photo editing is poor now. It has a white haze if you crop the photo. It used to be better before Google tried to AI everything. IMaking albums for me show you can get too much info about from them and flaunt it.

author: Sora
content: Google Photos is and always has been a very great tool for managing your photo gallery and syncing it between devices. However, I'm not super fond of the AI stuff everywhere. I wish there was an opt-out toggle. If I want AI to edit my photos, I'll go to the Gemini app for that, not Google Photos, because AI doesn't belong there.

author: Kat Willoughby
content: Good for photo storage and searching, but it sends too many memories/themed notifications each day and there isn't an option to fine-tune this other than to disable them. I like the occasional one to look back on but the current rate is pestering. Similarly, there's a pop-up (I think about AI editing of something? I dismiss it because I want to 👏 look 👏 at 👏 my 👏 photos when I open the app) that holds up using the app for what it's for. it's gotten pretty irritating to use.

author: Sonya Shelley
content: The crop tool glitches if you use the auto crop and then try to adjust it. You can't crop from one side at a time, only from a corner. When you hold your finger to see the original, it shows you the pre-cropped version. You can't enhance and then see what was changed to adjust it. And you have to save a copy. These updates went the wrong direction. The only thing that's better is you can search for your albums as you're adding to them.

author: Diamond Dove
content: I like this app, but I can't change file names and I have been experiencing glitches with typed descriptions as a whole. Update 6/6/26- Some of my pictures haven't been showing up in my library, even though they are backed up and show up in my albums and other places in the app. This seems to happen when I have backup turned on, but when it's off, the pictures show up, like they normally should.

author: Ross Blank
content: Up and down, finally a bit more stable. Some things are great, but base functionality of a photo gallery can be buggy. A lot of new features, but at its core, I just want a place for my photos be live, be accessible, searchable, and stable. The other features are nice, when the base is covered. At least I can get my photo information again - a couple years ago they really borked this app.

author: L. Alchemy
content: This is normally one of my best apps. I've used it to edit countless pictures, some of which were my own AI-generated works that needed considerable corrections at times. Since the latest update, certain options in Photoshop are no longer there - Color Saturation, Skin Tone & Blue Tone were values I adjusted in just about every picture in my library.

author: Ruth A
content: It keeps saying I'm not connected to the internet when trying to download videos from Google Photos to share. It won't complete uploads at all. I've restarted my phone, cleared the cache multiple times and it's just awful. It continues to do this even though the app is updated. If it finally downloads a video compilation it ends up saying creating the video failed. It's pretty much useless for sharing.

author: Amy Phillips
content: Great app! I don't have to worry about my photos taking up all my storage, but I have them wherever I go! It recognizes your friends, but doesn't let you tag them in the photos it doesn't recognize them in, and it should let you tag pictures to help you search for them later. Also, I really hate that it saves all of my screenshots. Please update so this is not the case!

author: Miranda Martinez
content: Great app! Best place to store photos since Photobucket! The only cruddy part is if your account gets hacked, they have access to your old photos & videos. Also, since I forgot my password on a few accounts & don't have the same numbers anymore, I lost a lot of memories.): I wouldn't mind, but the pictures of my babies... Gone forever. I don't see how with all this ai technology, they can't just compare your photos and info to help you regain access. I make a new account with every new phone...

author: A Google user
content: does "photos" take photos or store/edit them? the camera takes good photos. The photos app stores them well (but it can be a little counterintuitive finding photos). what more can i say? whichever one it is, the editing tools are standard and a bit limited. i have no idea if i can buy more tools, but I have no intention of spending money on something that should be included.

author: Lisa Fuentes
content: The only thing I don't like about Google photos is when I need access to a photo and I can't search for any because it's "organizing your photos so you can find them faster, try again later." Please stop organizing my photos, leave them on the date they were taken, and if I want to organize them, I should be able to do that myself by creating folders. I'm still a big Google fan, just not a big fan of not being able to access my photos quickly when I need to.

author: Jeanne H
content: I normally have high praise for Google Photos, but I'm entering only a three star rating this time because the option, "add a description" is gone...why did Google Photos remove that from the menu? I used this option all the time for many reasons but especially for identifying my garden plants and their care instructions. That has been so helpful, but suddenly it's impossible to to do that. I am really disappointed with this change and extremely frustrated!

author: A Google user
content: Google photos has definitely improved in the last few years, but I cannot for the life of me, figure out why it says I have over 15,000 photos! I take a lot of pics, but I've noticed the photo count jumps significantly every so often. A theory I have is that it makes a copy of each photo whenever I switch phones, and then stores all the copies. Perhaps another possibility is that it double counts everything because of Google drive. Regardless of the reason, it is annoying to try to locate the 15,000+ photos that it claims I have. I haven't counted them, but from what I can see, I don't think it's anywhere close to this. But as long as it doesn't start costing money, I guess backing up multiple copies is better than losing pictures. Since the filters changed a couple years ago, i don't use it to edit pictures anymore. I do, however, enjoy the .gifs, a.k.a. "animations", it automatically creates when I take several photos in succession. The computer generated movies that the app creates are usually pretty ridiculous, but on the flip side, the movies are oftentimes quite amusing when they're extra ridiculous. Hahaha. The computer generated "stylized" photos it creates are kind of dumb. Usually only chooses already good shots, then edits them to look not as good. It would be much more helpful if it automatically improved my crappy photos. Anyway, congratulations for reading the longest review that has ever been penned. ♡

author: A Google user
content: Good app would be great with a few fixes. I like that my pictures are accessible from many devices but wish I had the option to choose which pictures are saved to the cloud. And I can't delete any picture without it being deleted everywhere. I take pictures of things that don't need to be available on every device (like reminders when shopping or trying on clothes). Google, please change this feature!! I want to have the option to say no BEFORE the pic uploads!! I'm sure I'm not alone here.

author: A Google user
content: I'm so disappointed! I absolutely love this app, it has quite literally changed my life! but I cant access it :( when I try to print off pictures, when I want to share the pictures on social media multiple at a time, through any of the outlets that I need to! and although my husband and I have linked our Google photos together, I'm not able to get certain random photos and videos that I really need. altogether still an amazing app, but desperately need these changes made.

author: A Google user
content: I am glad to have a place to store and access my photos & the tools for adjustments are good. However, if I adjust something from my phone it forces me to accept it as a copy - even if it is just a rotation! I wish it would pick up all the rotations and that the control panel for it wasn't so buried. Also I really don't appreciate that the wonderful features created keep getting changed to make them less functional and more a tool of big data - specifically movies and animations.

author: Crimson Tales
content: Love the auto save feature that allows me to easily get to and download/ retrieve my photos... Unlike other major phones with built in cloud apps. Edit - 8/17/2022: So Google loves to make stylized photos, which is great, but if you don't look at them right away it's really hard/impossible to find out where they are hidden. Also sorting is not a possibility and the oldest will always be on top, so it takes a while to get to the newer items. Blech.

author: Tony Gutierrez
content: This app used to be good but for a few months now it's been awful. Whenever I get a notification that photos were added to an album and I tap on it, all I get is an error: "Can't find link". Also, photos don't always indicate when they're part of an album. I'll try adding a photo and instead, I get a notification saying "1 photo added to 0 albums". I tap on the embedded View button and it turns out it was already added automatically.

author: Eyal Marcus
content: The new application (and I am using it for quite a while now) is a big downgrade from the previous one. The automatic creations are worse, and even when they created, nowhere to be found. , have to keep looking for the search, and the "x years ago today" functionality is not good as it doesn't do a collage of photos you can send people, a thing we used to do with a lot.

author: Melissa
content: Ehhhh... It would be really nice and 1000% useful if pictures were saved to albums in photos. So if you want to have prints made of several pictures but you cropped and enhanced but Photos puts "folder" pics all out of order if they aren't in your camera roll. It's lame and I would just assume use Onedrive and Amazon Photos cause they both have that very super technical, mega advanced, futuristic feature but Google doesn't. C'mon now!

author: mahoromaticfan15
content: The app is great for the most part. it organizes photos by the date it was taken, in decending order, which is great. The biggest issue I have, and the absolute most grating one, is that when you've used up all of your free backup storage, every time you open up the photos app to look at a photo, it will bring you to a screen that says you need more storage and you'll lose all of your photos. The only way you can navigate away from it is to buy storage or click a tiny button to continue. Hate it

author: A Google user
content: I'm pretty happy with the Service, but the App has some hangups. - The backup status often fails to update or be Accurate at all, falsely representing that you're fully backed up and not actually the reason nothing will load on anything. - When uploading it shuts down my entire home network because the app uses every bit of the upload bandwidth. - Even when fully synchronized, organizing photos (adding to albums, archiving) has a delay, and sometimes never processes, causing errors and aberrations. - I've requested a checkbox on the Add-to-Album screen to simultaneously archive the same media, so you don't have to find them twice.

author: A Google user
content: The app has potential but I'm rating at 3 stars because there are several cool filters that the app does randomly and automatically but you can't do them on your own. For example: animation from video and color pop. If youre lucky the pic you want to edit will pop up but isn't likely. Same with the animation. You can just do the edits yourself in the app.

author: Tapio Vahamaki
content: Mostly good, but wish better organizing. Features missing, such as After archiving pics from main bucket, to be able to share pics in albums, that were archived in main view bucket. Actually better, would be able to select pics & "move" them into an album, like Google Drive can do. Take them out of the main view, as I call the primary/main bucket. Very cluttered; can't remember which pics I've already put into albums.... very annoying 😒.

author: John Caddell
content: Took a star away because of the difficulty of getting the app to do what you want not what it wants to do with the photos. I don't want them in archives I want to delete them. The app keeps wanting to send them to archives. There is also another update to install. Again Works great for me. I would have given it 5 stars but when you update it on the 25th and have to re-update it on the 27th again it shows you evrything can be improved on.

author: Kate Kelly
content: The "Photos on device" screen with a list of device folders suddenly stopped showing any new files in a certain folder when viewed from within Photos. When the same folder is viewed from a file explorer app, the new files are seen. There doesn't seem to be a way to force a refresh in Google Photos. I'd like to keep that folder backed up but it's no longer able to see new pictures from beyond ~2 days ago. Other folders like Screenshots work fine.

author: A Google user
content: When browsing for pics from another app (SMS text, fb, IG, gmail, etc.), Photos doesn't organize my pics as albums. It displays the pics as a time indexed camera roll. I have to scroll through, potentially, years of photos to locate one taken in the past. To remedy this I would have to use the space and folder structure on my phone, which defeats to purpose of having unlimited space on Photos. Suggest to display album structure when browsing from other apps.

author: A Google user
content: Cool for everything else but sharpening. When I looked up why I got the stupidest answer in the world. The head of Google photos had the audacity to say that, "there won't be a sharpening tool anytime soon". There is literally no reason for this, please someone explain why Google will not add sharpening to the photo editing. Other than that everything else is good. The photo sharing is perfect, the time organization is great and the assistant is like having a kid make a drawing for you that you put up on the fridge.

author: A Google user
content: Bring back the "open with" feature! For some reason a recent update did away with the "open with" feature, which I used all the time. I liked to use it to be able to choose photos to edit in a different program (a Google program), but now I have to do it the long way :( I also don't like the way it opens up when you hit the menu button (three lines). Why'd you have to f up a good thing Google?

author: Journalist Cruz Jackson
content: After reading other reviews I see I'm not alone in some of my frustration with the app. For the most part I truly enjoy it but I'm waiting like patience on a monument over here for pictures I need that were snapped with my phone or tablet camera to upload. I'd like to be able to label or name my photos easier too. Why can't we organize gifs quicker & easier? Dates are good but names/labels would be easier. When I need a picture I need to know I can quickly & easily locate it and move on.

author: Servant OfTheLord
content: Except all the doubles. Put photos in folders. Get another copy per folder. And does not delete any doubles. Or triples. Or even notice them. Needs to have title and date prompt for easier reference. If I search cat I don't just get cats. I don't even get all the cat pictures. Editing should be much better, better than picsart. As good as adobe. All of the stats will vanish when I have to pay for this app. Google you're the favorite. However not anywhere near as good or even close to your compet

author: A Google user
content: This app is creepy, arrogant, and weird. Completely out of nowhere, I'll get a notification that Google photos has created a collage or done something to one or more of my photos without my permission. Apparently Google needs to look up the word "boundaries," as though it were a narcissistic sociopath frenemy. Um, I'm going to keep Amazon Prime just for my photos--it's so much better than Google, even though they're both evil corporations.

author: A Google user
content: The only thing keeping this from being the perfect gallery app are it's customization options. Things like downloading multiple files from the cloud to the device at once, video editing (more cropping/clipping options), and if possible even an option for manually changing a file's date (the library tends to shuffle your files) for some reason would all go long way.

author: Quincy “Mr. Quick” Poaches
content: For the most part. The app works well and is easy to use. However, one of my folders has disappeared and I am unable to access on any other device except the phone that created it. I cannot see the folder on the PC, Chrombook or my other two devices. Only the original device. I checked all settings. The pics themselves are still in archive, but the folder they're organized in does not show up on any other device. Also, it is hard to organize multiple pics at once.

author: A Google user
content: I was hoping that the Googles Photos App had some easy option to both preserve our memories in two ways. (Maybe I missed some kind of option when exploring the settings..idk...) ...but.. If i build up a few album's that'd have more than 800 photos in, also a few music files, video files, albums of saved gameplay...ect I like the storage. Itd be nice if we could choose how and what is being uploaded. -Upload Photo Quality- ·Original ·High ·Med ·Low Like that ☝

author: A Google user
content: I am enjoying the app; being able to back up my photos is fantastic and the advanced search feature is awesome. That said, the app is seriously lacking in organization features, allowing you to put your pictures in albums but not folders, which is particularly frustrating when they were in folders before I backed them up. The app also always shows all your pictures before you even begin a search, making it appear as cluttered and unorganized as it is. Will I still use it? Yes... for now.

author: A Google user
content: Used to be great. Needs to be improved now though. Love being able to backup phone photos, wish there was a better way to sync down to my desktop. Clunky web interface makes the task of organizing photos daunting. Used to love the assistant stitching panoramas. But 3rd party apps make much better quality, and most of the stylized photos are usually just over saturated versions, I end up dismissing 90% or them. The core is good, but most newer 'features' it tries to add fall short.

author: A Google user
content: Pictures take forever to move to different folders and even longer to refresh. Some pictures I moved are still in the folder but when I click on them it says it doesn't exist. No matter what I've updated it too it has this problem. I don't like that is shows the shared albums really big (I only have 2) then the rest of my folders are small and I have to scroll across and click see more to get to them. Samsung photos is faster and easier to use but I don't have a Samsung phone anymore.

author: Curtis Scafe
content: After some update it lost all my picture search matches. I have to go in and tell it yes that's me when before I went through maybe 10 pics and it recognized hundreds. Now it only matches the ones I've selected. Kind of annoying. Plus the last update changed the layout. Why do I have to go to another screen to search? They also messed up sharing. Used to be able to select multiple pictures and if they weren't on your phone it would download and then share. Now it's only sharable by link

author: Susan W
content: 2023 - I don't know whether I'm coming or going most times w/pboto app, BUT I found overall this photo app is better than most. I have to do a little more work trying to get the photos where I want them so I can find them with less hassle. When I do figure it out it works great until you change stuff. Just leave things alone (except where absolutely necessary) for awhile & give us a chance to do albums or whatever without another learning curve. Yet, I'm sticking with you for now!

author: A Google user
content: Don't like app. Too many repeated items taking up extra space. I want to create own folders & don't need all this pre-named catagories that get in the way of moving things around. I liked the way my older Moto was set up much better, but unfortunately was stolen, so had to buy new. Not as happy with this model. Don't need the memories past items either. It's too much duplication using up space. Same pic in too many catagories . I don't want my pictures sorted by dates, I sort by album.

author: Brittany Walker
content: I love this app, and would easily rate it 5 stars if it wasn't for the changes to storage you just announced for next year. I like knowing that I have a total of 15gb of storage for my documents, without worrying about it being eaten up super fast by pictures and videos. The fact that this change is being made just seems like an unnecessary money grab to force people to purchase more storage, and I am not happy about it. I hope enough people express their disappointment that you reconsider.

author: James Meola
content: I expect more from Google, but it's okay I guess. This app is good, but lacks features. The huge feature that's missing is the ability to hide/lock photos/albums. You can archive, but that only hides from the main album, it will still show up in other places and thumbnails. When in an album, you can't pinch to zoom in/out like you can in the main section, which makes it hard to find pictures. It's great how cloud storage works and how easy it is to access my photos from any device though.

author: A Google user
content: This was my absolute favorite app... I would take pictures and save screenshots and took notes. Then every month I would open my Google Drive and sort the pictures on my PC into folders for easy retrieval... But, they took that connection away, now I go through too many steps to sort my pictures anymore... So I stopped using my phone for that. I never realized how useful that was until it was taken away. Was a 5 star program for organizing my life, now it's just a 3 star photo sorting program.

author: Ted
content: I used to really like this app, as I could store all my photos off my phone and computer for free. I guess nothing last forever. $20 a year isn't bad, but if you don't want to pay it, your phone and email become useless. It seems like Google is holding our devices hostage more than anything. I get it... they have to make money. I am just going to have to get a new storage method before they raise their pricing to make more money.

author: A Google user
content: Very good and fast. Duplicate checking is incredible. But Flickr has more organizing features. 1)We have option to sort photos or videos in an Album but Please add option to sort Albums by name or any order that we can customize. 2)Please give us an option to search for photos that were never not added to an Album.3)Please add option to show the number of Photos and Videos in the Album like Flickr, right it just shows the total combined. 4)Please give us a "Where used"option for each photo/video, so that we know which Album it is used

author: I'm Sorry, You're Welcome
content: Explain it to me: Trying clear space, but you make it hard. Why do I have to refresh Chrome before trying to download another video from my storage? "Why don't you just select multiples?", you may ask. That's because when I do, Google decides it's going to take an hour to download 5 videos, instead of 2 minutes. Why? Also, I paid for extra storage to save as "original quality". Fun fact: won't be doing that anymore. Why does every video take up about 5% more space when upload it for storage?

author: A Google user
content: You never seem to expand on a feature. Instead of a single locked folder, how about just allow us to set albums as private and still make them available for image selection/sharing. I see my suggestion made it through to make albums available when selecting images to attach/import, but you always fall short. Could you sort albums either by name or last updated? Also, could you make archived images available when selecting images to attach/import?

author: Don Johnson
content: It took me a while to realize that Google photos has their own cloud, I thought whenever I would back up and store, meant that my photos were being saved in my Google one account, which actually makes saving photo much more simplified, and if you decide to delete older photos and store them in trash, it gives you 30 days to change your mind to decide that you want to keep them, just pull up the photos in your trash and they are in your app again. Very simple and easy to use.

author: A Google user
content: Not very customizable. I dislike that I can't turn dates off, I don't want to see my photos grouped by the date they were taken, I should have the ability to turn that off. Also I don't like how it always defaults to show all my pictures, I'd rather it default to album first and let me closer which album. A dark theme would also be a nice touch. would love the app so much more if they added customizability to it.

author: William Hall
content: I love this app but would love if it had a hidden mood or a way to lock folders so they can't be viewed with out a passcode. Would love to be able to hide photos and not just achieve them. Achieve photo still show up on the pic area of apps like messager and text. As well as other apps. Would also like to able to pic what order and where you wanted the pics at on the college. When you make one it cuts half the image out

author: Wynter Sheard
content: I've been using this since...hmm maybe 2015 and I've had my ups and downs with it. I keep coming back to this app because I can get a new phone anytime and be able to easily transfer/back up my four photos. However, there was a time where I had over 4,000 photos, I guess the app couldn't handle it because every year it secretly deleted my photos that were 2-4 years old. I didn't notice until this year when I wanted to delete unimportant photos. Customer service can't do anything about it

author: A Google user
content: Ok, but lacking some organization features. Inability to sort albums by name, or search when adding more photos to an existing album is a pain. In general searching for album is not good. Inability to grade photos, and sort this way; finding comments is a challenge as well. Space usage on the phone is horrible! No cache control! Other than that pretty good.

author: A Google user
content: i like the app except if all my pictures are there, and i want to quickly print one, there is no print option or Save option. Its too difficult once its in the google cloud. this definitely needs improvement because it is not intuitive. Also you should have the option to save ALL photos to your computer also if you want, instead of doing one photo at a time. Just ask before auto sync. This would give piece of mind to people who worry about their life of photos stored in the cloud.

author: Krishna Prasad
content: The best photo and backup app I have seen in both Android and iOS. Edit: I reduced 2 stars. The issue I have is... their backup sucks. Once you upload the photos (1000's of them), there is no way to backup your photos locally. Their Google takeout just doesn't work, called the support (as I have paid subscription) and they asked me to use the photo download feature! How can you download 24000 photos from photos interface!!!

author: A Google user
content: App is working better than before, however it still looses megapixels when saving any picture edited in its program. Also, its "Autofix" feature looks good on the screen of my cell but once saved, its true quality shows on the fomputer screen and rarely are photos salvageable once saved after edits. I need a high resolution editor that doesnt drop my photos megapixels in half (or more) after using and saving with it like this does.

author: Tracy Anderson
content: I do not like that u have been getting rid of my photos. I know u warned us it was going to happen but come on u decided to make these changes during a pandemic. no store allowing people to develop pictures at this time. I've recently lost many of my pics and from your email u intend to erase anything past 2 years. I have had photos stored in here since 2014. I will get them off. I just beg for some more time. I've got pics on here that can't be replaced. I always used this as photo album.

author: Laly M.
content: The sync doesn't make sense to me, sometimes what i delete on my phone's gallery gets deleted from my Google photos-what's the point of “back up” then? Won't let me move an entire album into another album(to quickly combine photos into just one album.) I wish i could delete pictures from my gallery, THROUGH my albums; My albums already have my pictures organized, deleting from there would be so much easier!

author: A Google user
content: I would give it a 5 rating if they just left it alone! The new update is not useful for me. Before I could just tap the 3 dots in upper right corner to edit. My biggest complaint is now I have to hit 'save to device' on every darn picture, even the ones that are taken by me, and, now I have to go back and do the 'save' again for pictures that were already saved and taken long before this update!! Not happy at all.

author: Victoria Phillips
content: Google photos is ok. However I do have complaints. The update that replaced library with "collections" groups everything. Library made albums easier to find. In the memories view most are automatic, and you can just add them and at the end of each month most but not all of the memories will end up next to the best of month highlights or in the photos view which is frustrating. But if you create a memory it will come out as an album. I don't like this. Also photos update to yesterday at 4am.

author: Queen of Nerds
content: I like the photo storage, and the ability to share pictures with people. The editing features could be better. It would be nice if it had a paste function, so you could put a picture in with another picture. That would make it like a real photo editor. Also, the markup feature needs more colors! I edit pictures all the time on my computer, and I can think of many other features that Google photos is lacking.

author: Alissa Vann
content: So I do fan edits for famous YouTubers and so I have a lot of pictures and folders. One day when I opened up my app to do edits, the pictures that were there were from either when I got my phone, or pictures that I took that week, so all of my photos were gone. I decided to just move on after trying to get them back and not succeeding. This just happened again, and I'm getting mad about it

author: Joseph Crickmore
content: It in (almost) every way is like the desktop version to the application and then some. I say almost because two things I want the app to do. Technically the desktop version, but I want the option to edit videos on desktop. The other is the slideshow feature on the app. It works PERFECTLY on desktop (especially with videos) but the app does no such thing. That's why I cannot give it any higher than 3 stars. I hope you see this Google as a reason to update the software.

author: Kathryn Bowman
content: My experience is now 4.5 stars, but it took me so long to get here. Would it be an impossible ask for Google to not move the photos around but leave them alone in the order they were taken? Every app I go through to access my photos goes in at various points of entry because no one knows were the damn photos are. Do less Google in order to do more . . .

author: A Google user
content: Overall, it's nice to have a backup in full resolution, but when it have to update content that you backed up anfd then you edit on the phone, like a slow motion video, Photo is the worse. It wont update and no matter what you do on the phone, if you try to download the video, it will be downloaded the entire video on slow motion, not the section you would want.

author: Sassy girl (Leslie)
content: All in all not a bad app BUT, and there's always a but 1. When I make a collage I'd like to pick from a few different templates to show off these photos. It's all the same even with different photos. I want to choose where to put them and how big each photo can/should be. After all they're my memories. 2. When I try to write on the pics in the editor part, you can't see the writing. What's the sense of having that option if it's absolutely useless. Once these are fixed I'll change my rating.

author: Jimmy Fleming
content: I'm SO thankful that you guys final allow us to sort our albums by title instead of last photo taken date. Ugh. Now PLEASE do a setting "delete from device and archive". At the very least bring back the ability to leave things "selected" until we unselected them, it use to be that way. Right now I have to "select photos" then "delete photos from device" then I have to go "select photos" again, then "archive". This process is even worse if I decide to do this before photos has backed up

author: Victoria Spies
content: I love the layout of this app. It's easy to find pictures, create albums, order prints, and the facial recognition is great. But there have been ongoing issues/bugs with the editing. So many photos can't be edited because a pop-up says I have poor connection. I don't understand why I need any connection just to edit. I HAVE good service/internet so it makes no sense. I also have cropped photos which can't be reverted back even though the app says they can. It is frustrating.

author: Brian Lusher
content: I generally try out most google products and deal with the bumps in the road if there are any. Was happy to finally have a product like Apple's photo backup but the settings on the app would not work, used an extra gig of data in a few days and was auto backing up to the storage that counts against my google drive. I will download again once these issues are fixed.

author: Dixie K
content: This has been my go-to app for photos for a long time, so I'm pretty invested in it. I'm always amused by the auto-generated stylized photos. But I really dislike the new Android updates (starting when - I don't know). I try to check out whatever notification and only ever get a photo scroll that I can't stop or start from the beginning. Super frustrating. Please get rid of the photo scroll. My personal photos are Not an instagram story. I will never want them to be.

author: Matthew Sechrist
content: UPDATE: dropping 2 full stars. Why can you still not select multiple pics and get a download option? Only option given is to Archive. This has been an issue for a while, but it's incredibly short-sighted and since the free storage ended, reeks of big-business making it unnecessarily hard to stop using even a single photo worth of service so you advance up their pay tiers and never down. Come on Google, I just want to share a handful of pics with friends directly without linking a whole service.

author: Angela D'Aguilar
content: Please add the feature to search for duplicate photos! I have a ton of duplicate photos taking up storage space, but it's very time consuming trying to locate duplicate photos because they are saved in various photo albums. I'd love to see more advanced tools & filters. Other than that, pretty good app for backing up and sharing photos and albums.

author: Laura P “laudpatty” Ruffino
content: When I opened my Photos editor today, I reacted with cursing I'd rather not put in this review. I got my bearings relatively quickly, but a lot of people won't. I thought I was in the beta for Photos. 🤔 Had that been so, I would've left feedback saying that people who don't jive with technology are going to hate these changes. Also, the new photo search is terrible, and my auto-sorted pet pictures are all mixed up! Classic search should always be optional in settings. Fix that now, please.

author: Mayank Raj
content: This app served us well, but it served google better. Now that the benefit of additional data is low for training image models... There is no free storage. The app has great AI, flashback, editing, etc features; but lacks common sense features like every thing is sorted timeline wise ALWAYS. Example issue: you edited a photo from 10 years ago and saved a copy... Now in order to find that pic, you have to scroll down till infinity again!

author: Eric
content: Very easy to use app with a few serious flaws. First, there's no way to tell it to cache an album on the device for offline viewing. Second, there's annoying popups on nearly every single photo offering to fix it in one way or another that get in the way of showing photos to others and can't be turned off, only temporarily hidden. Also be aware that you have zero privacy with Google photos. They scan every single photo you upload to train their AIs and to data mine to show you more ads.

author: Susan Wildeboer
content: Search feature is great. The reason for only 3 stars is there are NO FOLDERs to better organize Albums. I have 100s of albums and would like to organize them into folders such as Trips, Family, Christmas, Work etc. It would make it much easier to find the album I want to add photos to. Google please ! This is my big ask. Then I will happily rate GPhotos 5:stars.

author: LisaMarie Dujon-Lewis
content: Definitely lacking some very key features, such as duplicate files finder for all file types. Surprisingly, quite a few popular, common formatting file extension types that can't view can not be viewed in Photos. The other surprising setbacks are the inability to compress files, plus there is no easy way to change a file's format from a .jpg file to a .png file, for example. Thank you for your consideration.

author: Erin Birch
content: I like the app alright. It syncs fine to my phone, but I wish it was better at syncing when I'm on a computer. Also, why can't it be set up so we can create sub-albums? I HATE that I can only create single albums. I'd like to have them by year, and then smaller albums within each year. Especially paying for storage, you'd think you could make that a feature...

author: A Google user
content: Facial recognition and search options are awesome! Free storage WAS a big help, too... Now, it's a somewhat less valuable consumption of a limited resource intended to drive sales of another piece of the ecosystem into which so many have become a part. Unfortunately the Billions and Billions in profits are no longer enough. One of these days, I hope to see the value of the casual consumer return to prominence. I will not hold my breath, though...

author: Emily Blackstone
content: I've been very pleased, but something in the new version removes my zoom when I take a photo. I'll zoom in, hit the button, and then the picture isn't zoomed at all. If I do it twice usually the 2nd photo will come out like I want, but it's frustrating. Especially because the clarity of the photo isn't the same when I try and crop it compares to the clarity when I zoom in.

author: R Singh
content: Horrible app, especially if your phone uses it as the default gallery, in which case you're basically forced to pay the $0.99 fee for storage. Downloaded videos dont appear in the app, and It's ui is not user-friendly in the slightest. Samsung and Apple default galleries are way easier to work with. While google Photos offers options like backup, it usually causes more bad than good. Unless you have no other way to back up your photos and videos, I would not recommend it.

author: Johnny (Blaze)
content: Love Google Photos, I mean who doesn't? Great app with lots of functions, and it's relatively easy to use. Only complaint is the upcoming storage issue. I personally believe Google makes enough money to store our pics for free, even if one person uses 500T of storage. Google stop being cheap! Only 3 stars until you change the upcoming picture storage problem.

author: A Google user
content: Generally a good app, but it is lacking in some basic features in favor of complex and unnecessary ones. Really MUST have the ability to rename photos directly (needing to open the Files app just for that is ridiculous), suggest new names when copying (if same name, such as after an edit), save copies in different formats (like png), and to sort by filename. I only use this app to view and search my images. I have pretty much all extra features disabled, because they are irrelevant to me.

author: A Google user
content: If it's just me, loading slow, backup isn't working, I've changed settings, it just hangs on blank page with "choose folders" at the to. tried manual, got some things backed up, but takes an incredibly long time. I also don't see the search feature s I see others posting about. I'd really love to be ad wt25dle to fully use this :( THx

author: Mercedes G
content: Not sure if this "it". Storage is a great option, in fact, I found a number of photos I have been able to find, uploaded from a few phones back, awesome! However, ordering by date is less important to me, although it's good as a reminder of where I was or what I was doing. As a minimum, I would like to tag photos, or create categories where I can see an album of related image, as with Samsung Gallery, this is how I find what I like to revisit. Just now, it's just a massive stack of images.

author: Joe Smith
content: Easy to use. Easy to find pictures. Uploads fast. I love magic eraser and Snapseed. Ordering pictures and changing the aspect ratio is more difficult than needs to be. That should be a feature right within the order photo tab. Otherwise, have to go to Snapseed and use expand so that photos that are printed don't crop the people you're trying to get a picture of.

author: Amogh Simha
content: The issues below seem to have been resolved. Bumping my review up to 3 stars. Preserving my comments below in case some poor soul has the same issues and comes across it. Know that your pain was shared, lonely soldier... I can't see my old photos anymore. My uploads are not going through, I'm not able to add photos to albums. My videos keep buffering. They just won't play! I have ~7 years worth of photos and videos backed up here. I can't even pack up and move to a different app.

author: Christian
content: Good for organizing photos into albums and finding them by various methods. The biggest issue is that there is no way to find out if you forgot to place a photo in an album. If you did, it will get lost in your main feed and won't be able to find it later. Such a basic feature yet Google doesn't seem realize it's a problem for many. OK app if you have a small to medium collection, otherwise find something else where your photos won't get "lost" if you forget to put them in an album.

author: Kira D. Foltz
content: While the search features with Photos is excellent, I do not appreciate being backed into a corner of having to pay for storage space now for that access to continue. Also, biggest issue is when you initially take a photo, it pixelates and goes blurry. You have to swipe away or close out to see a good image. And the relationship with Facebook app is still not there so I can only upload from gallery rather than Photos.

author: A Google user
content: When I first found the video collage feature it was really cool! You could select several photos and videos and it would automatically assemble them into a short video clip with music in the background. But then it stopped allowing videos to be included. Later it stopped working all together. It would go through the entire process but then once it completed, the completed video is not there. I'm looking forward with hope that they'll get it working again.

author: Stefan Neamtu
content: The app itself is great, with nice auto organization features. Photos are easy to share and load relatively quick. The issue is there is no way to have an option for two way syncing. If you use the backup and sync tool on a PC to upload photos, there is no way to get photos downloaded on your PC. Google photos seems more like a photo dump because of this than actual photo service.

author: Steven Farnell
content: The feature list is amazing, but even with the latest Pixel phone, the app just keeps getting slower and slower. Searching typically takes so long I give up, it won't delete backed up photos, new photos take hours to show up, and I have switched to Gallery Go for viewing photos on my phone. I did a factory reset on my phone, and not even that helped. I am looking for an alternative.

author: Jehangir Athwal
content: Inconsistent interface. E.g., some contexts allow for larger photo thumbnails while others do not. So if there are multiple photos of the same scene, it is difficult to pick the best one because the thumbnail is too small. The album sharing feature is a poor effort. When trying to share, not all users presented by Photos can be invited and Photos does not offer an explanation.

author: Charles Carrigan
content: This has been my go to photo storage solution for nearly five years since it was released. I have to downgrade it from 5 to 3 stars, however, for two reasons. 1) the free photo storage option for compressed "high quality" photos is being removed, and this just about kills the usefulness of this app. 2) the improvement in features over the last five years has been really minimal. I really expected the app to be a lot further along by this point, tons of features missing.

author: Judy Hahn
content: Easy access to pics on phone and computer, easy to use, enjoy their stylized pics, and memories. Not great for labeling pics, which would make it easier to reference or find later. Also would prefer to have better options for making collage, putting the pics in the specific spot I want them in. It needs improved searching for specific pics. Would like option to make a movie/slide show in the sequence I put photos in an album. And with more than 50 photos.

author: Rita Wario
content: Pics are great, takes forever to make a custom movie. Movies don't allow you to pick which part of video you want, so usually adds an unwanted segment or cuts off the head. Editing video feature would be great. Now Google put a limit on storage, they want you to buy storage so they can be like Apple, so that sucks now, I'll have to move photos to Dropbox more, I guess. But overall app is pretty good.

author: LadyDee
content: I've never really had an issue with App until today. I finally decided to try and create an animation as well as a collage. Very disappointing!! The animation speed was crazy fast with no options to change it. No additional transition themes. Actually, no options for editing at all!! Unfortunately, same issue with the collage. No frames to choose from. No themes or colors. I couldn't even adjust the photos positioning in provided frame to fit correctly. I guess ya get what ya get.. 🤷🏼‍♀️

author: A Google user
content: Good app, but it could use some improvements comparing it to the iOS version. 1) it's very hard to know what pictures/videos are synced already. Please add an icon to the thumbnail to know if it's synched or not. Otherwise the app works great. The "ease of use" could improve. Arranging stuff seems very difficult, especially if you haven't arranged your Media in past uploads.

author: Destanee Nichols
content: I love this app, it has a lot of great features and has been storing my images for years. However I have had 1 consistent problem, albums. Whenever I make an album and put my photos there I don't want to see it on my main reel of photos anymore. I can never actually finish organizing all of them if the ones I've already categorized are still in the way. I even pay monthly for extra storage.

author: Khalid Walton
content: Would be great to have better video editing capabilities. The "create auto movie" feature doesn't work all the time. The photo editing features are much better than they used to be but still not as dynamic as they could be. The auto-enhance seems to just usd a Vivid filter without any real color/tone/contrast adjustments based on reading the image. This and the subpar auto crop feature is why I keep Photoshop Express (PE) installed. PE is so much more advanced at auto adjustments.

author: Aaron Wolf
content: There's a lot of good here, especially the editing features. But photo organization lags behind other options. You can't edit photos within an album: You need to find the photo in your main library instead. You also can't download photos from albums (same issue). I really like most of the app and would love to give it more, but the library organization capabilities really make it inconvenient at times.

author: A Google user
content: Just recently the multiple framing, sizing & color choices were eliminated for creating collages, (on my Android) Unless these functions were bundled into a different app that was the one of the only things I liked about Photos. Making an album is dull, boring, if you want to create fun, you have to purchase a Photo Book. This is really a greedy move, Google. (I will amend if I find out I'm incorrect about the blaise` collage thing)

author: Richard Brown
content: The new July 2020 Photos is a disappointment. The photo backup & web gallery continue to be great. However the 1-year-ago or 3-year-ago auto-collection presentation is terrible. The previous version was like looking thru a photo album. The current version is more like TV. The back/forward, slideshow & magnifier controls are limited -- you will see what the app wants to show you at its pace. I think I will turn off the notifications.

author: Christina Biagetti
content: Not a fan of having to save a copy of enhanced photos. I used to enhance nearly all my photos, and now if I do I'll end up with double the photos or having to go through to delete them all. Yet I can enhance photos in my web browser without having to save a copy. Horrible change. I do really like the magic eraser though. My pictures from touristy areas look much nicer without people.

author: Dave Miller
content: Very good app for safe keeping your pictures and getting space back on your phone. Has decent photo editing capabilities. One VERY bad item is that when it offers a suggestion to make a purchase of a picture, book, etc it is possible for the purchase to take place while it is in your pocket. I had it make a purchase of a canvas while I was riding my bike. By the time I completed my ride it was past the time to cancel the purchase. Otherwise I would give the app 5 stars.

author: A Google user
content: sneaky. you start using it, then it asks if you want to free up space on your phone. if you do so, your pics on the phone are removed.Also, the albums don't sync with my messaging app. if you are in a group text and want to send a pic, it is way harder to find it than it should be. quickpic was better but it isn't better any more. if I could find a better pic app for my android, I would leave google photos.

author: A Google user
content: As much as I'd love to to give 5 stars, I have to keep in mind that Google photos does not allow to manually adjust photos or edit as they do automatically in stylized photos, such as color pop. I enjoy editng photos and saving them all in one space, which Google photos has allowed me to do one of those only. Even though I am a subscription customer to larger storage, editing is limited. Other than that, I have been preaching the app so I can share my quality photos with everyone.

author: Mihavit
content: I really enjoy using this photos app. However, I find it strange that some useful function that isn't baked into the experience. For example, a option to hide certain photos from the public view. Achieve isn't a sufficient place to put particular photos u don't ppl to see. Something behind a security wall should be put into place to access certain photos and videos.

author: Ricky Ferrer
content: Needs improvement on Suggestion options. For Rotation suggestions, it only gives you the option to rotate the photo when you click on it. Provide an option to zoom in on the photo and also edit, rotate, or even delete the photo as well. For Archive suggestions, it only gives you the option to archive or not. Provide the same options as well (edit, delete, etc) when deciding to archive or not. Also, allow the Search to find pictures based on a specified GPS location (city, landmark, etc).

author: Justin Gandara
content: It was amazing, but I was kind of hoping for a cool idea, if we can use this app so we can watch our old videos offline, so that we don't have to wait for wifi or reception. In the edit part, they're should be a mirror adjustment so we can make our photos and videos backwards, and when there's a photo or video that's backwards, we flip flop it fowards. Also in fact, we love Google Photos when there's an unlimited storage, it's better than buying storage and wasting our money.

author: A Google user
content: It is an excellent way to back up all photos, although the free unlimited version reduces the file sizes. But the files saved definitely kept adequate resolution for viewing on any electronic device. My main complaint is how difficult it is to organize and search for albums. I really wish we can organize them in different ways, such as alphabetical order, sub-albums, etc. rather than only by the dates of last update, or whatever algorithm Google uses.

author: A Google user
content: Overall, I like it. The assistant makes some cool things. Some extra things I don't use. Like the movies are fun, but it generates so many, I don't even watch them anymore typically. The color pops needs some work (usually contains an error). The reason for the low rating is I told the app it could use data to back up my photos. It must have been constantly doing it (instead of in batches or at set intervals). It charged me just shy of a G in a day! Hopefully they will make this more efficient.

author: A Google user
