content: Latest update dropped the rating. I use this app to share photos with friends and family. I love the seperate albums and automatic adding of recognized faces. Dropped my rating because the latest update makes it more difficult to add photos directly to a shared album. It used to be in the sharing menu, so one could select several photos to add now you have to add them 1 at a time or go into the album, then select from there. Used to be much easier, why update to something more difficult?

author: A Google user
content: I don't find it an easy app to store photos in an organized way. It's definitely doable, I just find it too complicated and time consuming to organize the photos I upload. I also don't enjoy that it independently sends me stylized versions of the photos (and gifs for videos) nor the collages it makes on its own. It's a good place to back up photos, but I find other apps a lot easier and more pleasurable.

author: A Google user
content: I love Google Photos because I go through so many phones in accidents and I know as long as I sync, all of my photos are safe! But recently, I noticed all of the dates to some of my photos dating back to at least December of last year all have wrong dates on them! They say one date in the photos section, but when you select it and click the three dots, the date is entirely different. Very annoying, and when I scroll down to the very bottom of the photos tab, there are empty gray spaces..

author: A Google user
content: This app is great for storing photos from your camera, and online! My only complaint is that recently, whenever I want to download an image or save an image from a game, ect, it never shows up in any of the device generated folders, except for screenshots. For example, my downloads folder doesn't get new pictures added to it, no matter how many times I download the image. Don't know if its just my phone or the app itself, overall great app! I guess I'll just have to stick to screenshots.

author: A Google user
content: I rated it 4 stars 2 months ago. I didn't give it five stars because the program does not allow you to organize your photos and albums into subgroups (i.e. "personal, vacations, events," etc.). there's not even an option to organize the plethora of albums in any order. this is not a small issue. Same issue with putting the photos on Google Drive automatically. There's no option to put them in a folder of your choice. Now I have hundreds of folders with meaningless titles. Please work on this.

author: Ryan Maher
content: Had to downgrade from 4-star to 3 due to the app no longer having unlimited free space for 'high quality' upload. The app is great, could have some improvements but it usually is always being improved. What worries me is having enough space to store photos indefinitely. I have all my family's photos and memories here and as it gets filled over the years and decades at what point will I run out of space? Hopefully they lessen the price per gig as space becomes cheaper over the years.

author: Sandy Tabor-Levron
content: The app works well on some of my devices. But on my LG Tribute and Tribute HD phones, my photos don't automatically upload to Google. I have to physically open the app for Backup to begin backup. It isn't a BIG issue, but I thought devs should know.  My biggest concern with this app is actually the only problem I have with EVERY Google app- the massive size! I understand that in order to have the options and functions we have, the app size must be large, but what about releasing lite versions? Maybe cut out all the extras, and offer a basic function Google-Certified app that I can use on lower-end devices, like my daughters LG K3. It doesn't come with much internal storage, and we all know we can't move a Google app to an SD card. *insert eye roll here* Anyway, Thanks for all the hard work you guys put in for all the great apps!

author: A Google user
content: This app was the default photo app for my Pixel 3. It works well, integrates well with my online photo storage, and the assistant makes some fun suggestions for stylized photos and themed videos. My only real problem with the app is when i want to make a video from my photos. I can select all the photos I want, add music, edit the order and time for each photo. But i can't save it. When i click on save, it creates a video file. but if i try to play it, I just end up at the video editor again.

author: A Google user
content: I love my photos and I like having different albums, but some things really confuse me. Maybe it's just me. I would like to make sure anyways, so here are some things that bother me about Google Photos: I'm not always sure if the photo is saved, its really hard to find certain photos, and it doesn't give me the option to put my photos in categories immediately.

author: Jacob Jewell
content: This app does it's job & is easy to use, plus it's free. I have only two problems. 1. I can't organize photos in the order I want. They're always listed in the order they were taken/uploaded. 2. The app automatically creates folders for photos from Snapchat, Camera, Messages, and more. STOP. I don't need all those folders. Just one big list of photos is perfect. That way I don't have to hunt through several folders if I don't remember where the photo came from. I do like the album feature though

author: A Google user
content: google photos is great, but feels a little unfinished. It doesnt feel like a very "native" app. for example, screenshots you take on your phone are difficult (or impossible?) to access from the web version on a computer. not very intuitive organization of photos, but perhaps as I keep using it I'll come to love it. i really enjoy how it recommends photos from the past to you, and it will automatically edit great montages and beautiful photos for you.

author: A Google user
content: You cannot edit the photos themselves- no cropping, no coloring, no fine tuning of pictures. You have to download another app for that, then upload any of those pics that you want on to your Google photo drive phone app. You can't do anything on your phone... If you want quality photos, you need a different app to begin with.... Too many steps. However, the storage is amazing! And I love the organization.

author: EM
content: Overall a good app, but it's missing a very important feature that seems obvious especially now that free storage is going away. I want to turn OFF automatic backup for VIDEOS ONLY and continue to upload my photos. I'm probably going to buy storage monthly from them, but I don't want that small amount of storage filling up with random videos I take that I don't care about.

author: A Google user
content: Keep getting pegged to rate this app so here goes... 1) Camera shortcut missing for last year 2) album sort is not permanent. No matter which sort you choose, it reverts back 3) after 4 years you still can't find/filter photos that aren't in any album yet But hey... at least you were able to monetize this by selling printed albums... before actually fixing any of the above issues that have been requested multiple times over the years.

author: MDP
content: It's easy to use and very convenient. I would recommend improving the way the app creates memories of past photos. I've been using this app for many, many years (and I really like it), however, I do notice that the memories are repetitive. I keep getting the same pictures and the same memories over and over again. I have tons of photos but only a few handfuls come up in the memories, and they are always the same ones - for years. Please improve this. Thank you

author: A Google user
content: Exceptional. I would give it 5 stars if it had a better sort feature. I say adding features like sorting by date, name, file size would make this app even more phenomenal. I believe I have a lot of duplicates taking up valuable space, ad this would be easier to delete instead of skimming thru thousands of photos and video. Make it happen Google!

author: Samantha Grobbel Manier
content: The facial recognition really bothers me now. It always thinks my cat May is my cat Mari & it's impossible to tell the app otherwise. I have to click EVERY PHOTO and manually change the name. Not to mention, google photos has to recognize a face in order to tag a photo of someone. If it doesn't detect the face you can't add a person or pet. (This happens VERY often.) It's rediculous and makes it so my search results for a person I want to look up are very incomplete. So many little issues.

author: Klaus Bockholt
content: This app is great but something isn't working with the backup, albums and syncing across devices/platforms at the moment. I created an album on another device and the album didn't show up on this device. I modified photos through this app on another device and the changes didn't move across. I tried to share an album and I was told the picture, which I took last night still needed to be uploaded despite automatic backup on. They should have been uploaded over night ages ago.

author: Robert N Chase
content: Change is sometimes difficult. Finding specific photos varies between easy and challenging, depending on both Google's and your interpretation of search words. The latest changes have made it more difficult to find photos by people's names.. Those albums have disappeared from easy view; you have to figure out how to find them.

author: Mathew Boban

author: Mayeenul Islam Mayeen
content: Comparing to Flickr the upload and organization feature is better. Loved the mini AI tool - the Assistant of suggesting artifacts. Liked the app and love to have more better UX in next releases, though it's still a good one. +1 BTW, would love to have the feature: Local photo vs. Synced photo filter will let us easily distinguish the non-synced items, instead searching through all the mess.

author: Basya Sumner
content: good 👍 edit : I can't find the photo to video thing and I really liked it so If you can add it back I will definitely put more stars but for now only 2. edit: ok this is sooo much better

author: Tamika Dixon
content: App is easy to use. Cropping could be better. I don't like the glitches in the app when it comes to Google photos trying to make a you order photo albums and tries to cross photos with Google reviews and other social media apps.

author: Barbara Guest
content: Why is the backup of one screenshot now taking 5 minutes. And please give an opt out to stacking photos!

author: Charity Akufuna
content: it the best app ever keep it up 🥰

author: Kinesho Alesho
content: The app is good to use , easy to organise photos , easy to back up your data and some good features

author: whitewind
content: Norm, Produce nice photo memories.

author: Stuart
content: It just gets worse and worse. Google needs to turn off the deeply creepy scanning line that appears around some photos when viewing them. Whoever thought that was a good idea needs to be sacked immediately. It gives the impression that your photos are being scanned for some reason. Way to go to put people off your product. Remove whatever this feature is or tell users what it is and give them the ability to turn it off.

author: Neil Hillard
content: It does the job but I can't believe it doesn't support tags. Why can't I add tags to individual photos to tag my dog, my friends or family so that I can later find all photos that include them? Seems rather short-sighted. Downgrading score even more. Still no tag support and now photo collages insist on adding a watermark/stamp in the bottom left of the image which it never used to. 🤬 To make Photos even better, there's Quick Edit. However it used to work. It doesn't now, even though enabled!

author: Agi
content: Absolutely horrible to use especially on windows. No file names visible. The biggest problem is when downloading lots of photos and if you don't make a note of what you selected to download, once the download is finished you won't remember which photos you download and end up redownloading them. Been using it today and yesterday and it's highly frustrating. Very basic file system worse than those 30 years ago. You select X number of photos to delete you press delete and nothing happens.

author: Lauren Evetts
content: second edit - I used to love using Google photos but now it is rubbish. I've spent ten years collating albums but for the last six months or so, the app has been so slow and clunky. It takes an age to add images to albums and if you accidentally add an image more than once, you get multiple copies appearing in that album. It doesn't rectify this as it used to. I still have blank images where pictures used to be, no idea what happened to them! I'm so sad.

author: Nalen Atukorale
content: Cannot even open this app!! When I click on The Photos icon it opens for about a second and then reverts back to the home screen. Cannot view, edit or do anything else. Currently, I view my photos by going into Files. The whole phone storage is only at 30%, and I cleared the Cache for the app as well. Still unaccessible! So, it is useless at the moment. Update after your response: Do you actually read these reviews? That is exactly what I have said, so your solutions are not of any use!!

author: Bri Watkins
content: Randomly re-tagged most of my cat photos as the wrong cat mid August. The ability to accurately tag my cats is just gone now. Keeps tagging them as cats i had in 2007 or haven't photographed in 8 years. I understand facial recognition with pets is harder, but the previous method was much more reliable. Google photos is the only Google software keeping me from abandoning Google altogether, so they really need to revert this to what it was before.

author: Randhawa Jutt
content: Locked Folder is missing from my Google Photos app. I checked Collections, but there is no Locked Folder option at all. I also checked the settings, but I cannot find the Locked Folder or its backup option. This happened after the recent Google Photos update. Please help me restore access to my Locked Folder. I have important photos stored there and I do not want them to be deleted. 😭

author: Carson Tatum (Sincoura)
content: They removed the ability to see photo information. it used to be if you clicked the "about" button it would tell you the format of the photo for example. now it's been replaced with an AI slop search bar. I don't need AI to look at my damn photo I need to know if it's a JPEG or PNG. Just another thing in the long list of AI slop features that no one asked for to make your user experience "better" you're welcome!

author: Alex S
content: They've absolutely ruined the app bloating it with unwanted AI features that they constantly nag you about using. I've tried to ignore it for a long time but it's basically unusable at this point, the entire UI has been made worse just to try and get you to use AI features and the app is incredibly slow. I switched to a different photo gallery app that actually works and isn't user-hostile.

author: Morinosuke
content: A recent update broke the very useful "Select all for today" option. It no longer appears, making it much more tedious to move photos from a specific day into an album because I now have to select them one by one. The app also keeps pushing me to back up all my photos, quickly filling my storage and pressuring me to pay for more space. Please fix this bug and stop pushing backup so aggressively.

author: CsB SS
content: Hate it. I cant stand how it automatically stores my photos in Numerous different folders without asking me where I want them, it makes it SO much more difficult to easily find what I'm looking for when they're scattered in 12 different places that don't even make sense together.

author: Shailesh
content: Absurdity of this app is beyond imagination! I got a new phone, I tried to transfer pics, so I selected pics from photos app and started downloading them. for some reason, it stopped after downloading some pics. now before I start download my pics, this stupid app started uploading those very same pics and now I have two copies of them in my Google Photos, plus less storage!! insane.

author: Nanami Clouser
content: The new update has caused my photos to no longer appear in a grid of all the same size within the month they were taken. I have the photo view purposefully zoomed all the way out for the sole purpose of that consistent grid, and now the view looks like a bad slideshow made at 3 am by an unpaid intern. At least give us the option to go back.

author: B
content: Google photos will no longer let me share a single photo to a messaging app or any other app on my phone. I have done every Security check downloaded reloaded gone through my whole Android phone gone through my all my app settings and Google photos will not let me share a single photo to anything as far as apps on my phone messaging notes nothing

author: Rhyder Peterson
content: absolute nightmare. all I want to do is save SOME of my photos to the cloud but Google photos cant even see my folders so I guess the only option is to go through each individual picture? I have thousands of pictures. and its saved photos ive deleted off my phone and im confused because I do not have auto upload on so how did it get those pictures after I deleted them out of my phones trash bin? incredibly frustrating.

author: Leslie Sayre
content: Hate the update, no longer able to search without using Gemini, which I also hate. Have disabled Gemini, because I couldn't search anything, without it popping up several times, even though I had already said no, and closed it. *Editing to add, since there's no way to reply to your reply. Ask photos also requires Gemini, so that doesn't help at all. Thanks for nothing 👍🏻

author: Isaac G
content: The new layout for browsing images now expands images at random to take up the space of six or even nine images, even at the furthest zoom out. Makes it look really cluttered and unorganized. I get that they want to make it easier to look for a specific photo, but don't expand images when I've got them set to the smallest they can be on my screen. The new ai editing features will lower the quality of your image noticeably. I've also seen the app get slower upon turning Gemini features on.

author: Steven Lowry
content: The back up feature is a scam. Whenever the app backups, it backups ALL your photos & videos. Therefore, you will have doubles & triples of items. Next thing you know, you are out of storage & Google will want you to buy cloud storage! More monthly subscriptions! It should be illegal that you are FORCED to have ALL of your photos & videos uploaded to this app. You have no choice. Even if you install a gallery, there is no way to make that your default photo/video app.

author: S Mor
content: It's just a bizarre waste of time. Today I selected 28 images to back up so I could access them on my laptop, and for some idiotic reason, it started backing up 11,000. Why does it not just do what I ask it to? It's constantly backing up all my images, instead of just the new ones. People think AI is going to take over the world, but not if it's this useless.

author: Mark Cifone
content: photos disappear after editing them. there's no way to attach them to any message or chat unless you take a new screenshot or save it as a new copy. looks like this has been an issue for a long time and Google is ignoring it.

author: Richard Johnson
content: Bad. Nearing my storage limit so I decided to move large files such as videos elsewhere. However there is no simple way to do this. Web tutorials show an the option to click an item, then download it, but this option has gone. If I decide to bin an item it seems to think it has a right to delete it from my device (phone) internal storage too. So I'm having to move things from my device to a hard drive, before I delete from Photos. Might as well not use Photos for much anymore now! V frustrating

author: David Humphries
content: Great app although gradually being made worse with features no one asked for.... And my low rating reflects the fact that when you want to download your photos Google have made it nigh on impossible to do. Takeout is rubbish and often has many photos missing and Google strip all the metadata from the files and send it separately so you, the user, have to have a degree in computing and the patience of a saint to rebuild your own damn photos. Why, no one knows but it sucks.

author: Detroit Diva
content: I would like it if there were a lot more choices of frames for the collages. Also, the addition of picture frames for single pictures. I'd like a glossary that explains what each editing feature does and how to use it. It would be nice to have stickers, add ons, better text features, more choices of filters and the ability to change picture's backgrounds to other things and colours.

author: Theo
content: Since the latest app update, the cropping tool no longer works in a useful way – I can't flip an aspect ratio from portrait to landscape anymore without rotating the whole image, and even when I do that, it doesn't maintain the aspect ratio I try and resize the area I want to crop. Might seem a small thing, but this was the feature I used most by a long way when editing photos since I don't care for filters or more advanced editing. I will have to look for an alternative.

author: A Google user
content: It can be quite difficult (if u haven't checked the button to backup and sync, which I haven't) to see what is uploaded and what isn't simply from using the app. Also, worried now about using too much data and loss of storage space due to recent changes in policy. In addition, don't want to loose original images/videos and their metadata (time and place taken, etc), but shrinking them prior to upload would do so. In short, the recent changes have messed up a system that used to work well for me.

author: A Google user
content: This is just poor and i can't believe i thought this was the answer to my problems, far from it! Sync doesn't work, just hangs with the following messages: - getting photos OR - getting ready to backup Also, app doesn't find my photo folders half the time. tried everything from a reinstall to clear data/cache but nothing works. sharing? pointless if i can't get my photos in the cloud to begin with and seems like Google don't care from a lot of what I've read about others having similar issues.

author: Victoria R
content: Usually good, but every update breaks it more. After editing photos, either with the markup tool or by cropping them, I can't save the changes. The "done" button exists, but nothing happens when you press it. Can't uninstall/reinstall as it's a system app. Tried force stopping it and clearing the cache. Nope. I wish there was the option to install the previous version of the app.

author: A Google user
content: After using the app for a few months it's started to crash when editing a picture. It's now unusable as every other image crashes when saving an edited image. You have to close the app, force stop it and then retry just for it to happen again a couple of pictures later. I've come here to delete the app and have noticed an updated version so will give it a go. It's a shame as it's a nice and easy app that did the job perfectly.

author: Ian Y. Dass
content: Use to be one of the most useful tools by Google. Now the app is buggy and very slow to do simple things like load photos, delete items, etc. It's frustrating. Come on Google, do better... Update 2026: instead of getting better, the app is getting even more unusable. And coming from a large corporation like Google, this is crazy work... Disappointed to say the least

author: Brandon Codrington
content: *2nd Edit* Took the company several weeks to fix the app CONSISTENTLY crashing after adding 4-5 editing features to a single photo. It's a good app now but it's unacceptable for a multi-billion dollar company to not work out glitches before putting out a product. That's just lazy, money obsessive work. ALSO the company won't let you use certain features unless you give them unfettered access to all your photos by uploading them to cloud storage. Horrible company all together but app is 2 stars

author: Reinis Peterlevics
content: New layout update made the experience worse. If I want to keep photos neatly seperated by day as before, they can only be 3 per row, which makes it very uncomfortable to use, i want to have 4-5 photos per row so everything is more compact. Modern phone screens are huge, there is no reason to limit it to only 3 massive blocks per row.

author: Lykaroc I
content: I have always loved Google photos but now they are doing updates which makes it harder to use. I use it for work and at the end of the week you used to be able to touch one button and erase a whole days worth of photos for some reason they took that easy option out. like most updates they end up ruining the app

author: Ashley 57
content: I do not like this update. The lack of separation from date to date makes it difficult to find anything in my camera roll. Everything looks cluttered and personally, I find the rows on 4 to be a better separation. Picking between 3 and 5 makes everything appear jumbled together

author: Liz Koller
content: When I edit photos, it always saves it twice! What a waste of storage. When I put photos in albums they sometimes disappear again. Finding it all very frustrating. It used to be great for storing all my photos but now debating looking for an alternative option.

author: Brian DeVol
content: I don't like how, in the latest update, some photos are randomly larger than all the others, instead of being a uniform size. It's fine to have that as an option for people who want it, but there should be an option to go back to the old layout. Scrolling through a uniform list of images is so much more user friendly.

author: Carolina Coreas
content: The new storage policy sucks, most of my space is already gone after it was updated to the new policy. It doesn't make sense to include emails together with my photo storage. Also why cluster ALL of my pictures together on the home page ?! I liked that I could find my pictures sorted by month, why get rid of the most basic form of organization?

author: Dr. Mauser
content: The latest change to land makes it look like a wannabe for the iPhone. Suddenly all my photos were crammed together in little square tiles, cropped so they were harder to distinguish. At least I found the way to separate them by month. They I tried grabbing the scroller, and suddenly my phone was vibrating like mad. I don't want or need that. It's loud and obnoxious. But there is no way to turn it off. What idiot thought we needed that feature?

author: Ms. D
content: Stop changing stuff no one is complaining about. Went into my app only to see ALL my photos squished together bc the month disappeared. I really dislike what happens when you click edit now. The cropping is AWFUL. You can't edit and then edit again after saving bc it makes you edit the original. Please change it back. Also now, when you click share a whole edit window pops up, which has to be skipped first. Get rid of this, if we wanted to edit, we'd click edit first.

author: littlemiss 407
content: updated 2026 - google photos are getting greedy they have slowly over time made it impossible to have storage without paying a subscription and now they are adding more stuff that counts toward ur storage! ive used google photos storage for along as I can remember 19 years'ish they were amazing but they more they class that counts as storage ive not seen a great increase in free storage 2024 review - I absolutely love this app, I hope it never ever stops working,if it does I lose everything.

author: OG Famodu
content: Recently accepted update and the disappointment in this former great app continues. Suddenly collections and photos appear blank. App is crashing often during attempts to edit images. I used to love using this app and lately find it frustrating and problematic after the last few updates. I will need to start downloading all my images to make sure I have my own drive backups as my confidence in the security of my images is not as it was before with the recent issues I am seeing. 🤔

author: Shawn Hu
content: This app mostly works and does things as needed, but it has a few utterly retarded UI design choices. Pressing the clear up space button deletes all content from local storage, and cannot be cancelled even by closing the app, even though it takes like 10 minutes to execute. It also is not made clear whether pressing this button does that or brings you to a menu where you can manage local storage in some more granular but efficient way. (It appears there isn't any way of doing this.)

author: Jeremiah Price
content: Google is well on the way to destroying what used to be very good app with their censorship BS. NSFW photos are here to stay, and as long as editing and searching with Lens don't go outside of each person's account it is ludicrous to restrict them. It is very frustrating as a semi-professional photographer to have the AI editing restricted and Lens restricted and Nano Banana 2 restricted and leave out a large segment of users who have no thought of misusing it.

author: Jeff M
content: Default behavior, such as adding motion to still pictures, or now more features -this time it's AI; every release must be pampered & modified Everytime, nothing is simply left alone anymore. Disabled / No Used. and no, in not going somewhere else to post & troubleshoot. But thanks for response; you get what you pay for 😩

author: Abhishek Pradhan
content: The previous update showcased the pictures in the homepage more in a cleaner way. Whereas in this updates the it looks very clumsy and it's even not allowing to select multiple pictures just by long press in a single picture and sliding the finger, which was available on the previous update.

author: Julian
content: Over time, the app has steadily gotten worse. Consistently, features have been removed or just made worse. Now, the entire way photos are sorted has been changed, having them all as one giant block instead of separating them by date, which was a great way of sorting them and didn't need to be changed. The only reason this isn't a solid one star is because it still functions most of the time, just aggravatingly. I really hope they fix this.

author: James D
content: Not happy. Updates constantly change the way photos appear in the grid, which has limited personalisation options. App always pushes useless and invasive AI features eg. sticker creation. Editing photos always creates a copy, which then requires manual deletion of the original. I just want my default photos app to work for me :(

author: Vincent Bondy (None Hitwonder)
content: Editing is almost unusably buggy right now. Image won't even show up in the editing screen until you've rotated the image, so now I have to rotate an image just to see it so I can crop it. Other edits like saturation and brightness and stuff don't reflect changes, or sometimes they will after a long delay. tried this on the 2024 Moto RAZR and now on a Pixel 9a, and it's trash on both.

author: Epik duck Leader
content: app is good, perfect to keep a hold of pictures but the new update of the gallery just looks so off the date is on the top when ever I scroll and I try zooming in and out to see if I can put the date on the old section but nothing... I liked when the gallery showed what picture was shown in different dates on the side instead in the top :/

author: Savannah Stephens
content: used it for photo editing until the recent update. made the ui much harder to navigate and removed some features that I found useful (the ability to turn each slider from edited to unedited by pressing the icon), as well as changing the "hold to see original" function to also include cropping, both of which make it much harder to directly compare changes. genuinely considering looking into alternatives.

author: Larry Greenstein
content: Google Photos SEEMED to have improved but took a downward turn when, in back-up, it no longer includes screenshots as a folder to back up. The app says continuously "all folders backed-up" when they are NOT. The most current pictures shown have NOT included screenshots and I attempted several ways of doing so, but Google Photos seems to have ELIMINATED it.

author: Cats Blink
content: I have a Pixel 7 and for months now the editing when cropping a photo is not good as the photo goes tiny! I don't have the dexterity to make finer cropping adjustments. Please hurry up and roll out the fix.

author: Mark Raught
content: this is why my next phone will be a dumb flip phone. something that has been fine for a LONG time and they change the basic interface on an update. yes I can dig through settings and change it back but many cannot and get frustrated. why? changes like this are almost as bad as cramming "ai" garbage into everything.

author: Elizabeth Jackson-Helton
content: ever since I got the new update, no photo that I take will load and show up. it glitches out really bad. and there are things that I take pictures of for reference. please fix this. or I may have to uninstall the updates because I can't see the photos that I've taken.

author: Bernard Pletikosa
content: Foreground video processing in 2026, on hardware like Pixel 9 Pro??? Come on Google, why do I pay for all this hardware if it's not able to process a video in the background while I'm editing further. limit it to one or something, but for the love of everything I'm not gonna stare at a screen for 3 minutes while nothing is happening.

author: John Godsland
content: This app has had ups and downs. I remember complaining about a functionality change on Twitter many years ago, chatted to the product manager who implemented a neat twist to give folks like me what they wanted but kept the main feature intact. But now? I am sick of being constantly nagged to enable Gemini. No matter how many times I say no the same prompt appears again and again and again. Google no longer believes in consent. No means no Google! What a weird and creepy company it has become.

author: Gio Gonzales
content: Kinda disappointed that the backup feature does not work properly if I'm not on the app, even with unrestricted battery usage. The upload keeps on reloading. Just why should I stick to the app when I'm just UPLOADING photos and videos?! Stop trying to be like iPhone on everything!!

author: Hannah Parsons
content: Who ever allowed the changes to the magic eraser and video frame export to go into production should be fired! The eraser used to be awesome. It's now useless. And forget about exporting a photo from a video. It gives you the wrong frame.

author: Stephanie Mueller
content: I don't like the new update at all. why are some pictures bigger than others? its easier to view when they are all the same size especially for finding pictures. I miss pictures if I'm searching for a certain one when one photo is way bigger than other

author: NiKi Leon
content: Drag-select multiple photos stopped working on my phone. The same action (tap and hold on one photo, drag up/down) now selects one photo and then scrolls up/down. It does enable the multi-select (the checkboxes appear in the corner of all photos) but the drag doesn't work & I have to tap each photo individually.

author: amzuel420
content: I deleted a bunch of my photos and the photos icon on the screen of my phone disappeared. I found it when I swiped up for apps. I tried to move it back to the screen but there was no option to do that but said google was an option and now it's gone and I have to do a search to find photos. When I do get the photos folder open it tells me theres no photos while I'm looking at one. I have to click collections. I just quit using it. now I use Facebook Messenger and send pics to my computer

author: Lez Martin
content: Keeps saying 'Update' with no updates available 🤔, Forever Swapping things about, so have to go looking for things, and settings seem to change all on their own whilst all this is going on. It's getting frustrating having to spend time figuring out what has been moved where , So Make your mind up and STICK TO THAT LAY OUT And Stop with the "Try it out" pop up 😡

author: Rahul Rangari
content: I was expecting photos will get added automatically in People and Pet Section but it never happens. It sticks with older photos added initially and also there is no way to add or declare the new photo of same persons. My expectations is google should identify the face of persons over the time

author: Issam Shema
content: Worst part about this App! sometimes you will be spending your time editing at the end after editing you tap to save your work but unfortunately everything will disappear and you won't find your work again so you had to start again.

author: Jamie Pope
content: I am less happy with this app when more features and AI bloat are added. please just keep it as a way to access my photos on and off the cloud. Please stop forcing Photo's 'quick edit' turning back on every time there is a phone update. I hate it. I don't want to edit my photo when I'm sharing my watch to show I've safely got somewhere, but this add extra steps. I'm sick of it turning back on so often. I swear I've turned it off at least 3 times since February 2026. let me keep it 'off'!

author: Athar Hussain
content: this app is so frustrating, and I always struggle to find the feature I want. today I just wanted to switch between the 2 Google accounts so that I can try and create an album on my other account and I couldn't find the way to switch accounts. there is no profile picture anywhere. Aaarrrrgggghhhh! update: my profile photo has re-appeared again in top right corner. wasn't there at time of review. updating to 3 stars as still a frustrating UI.

author: Joanna Ridd
content: Update: your response did not deal with the issue I raised. Makes storing and organising photos so easy. I love the collages, videos and memories it creates too. One suggestion: when adding photos to an album, there should be an option to search for the album you want. I have a LOT of albums & finding the right one by scrolling through them all takes a long time, especially if it's one I've not used for a while, so it's way down the list.

author: R. Thew
content: Excellent, much easier to use than the play store thankfully. Features are easy enough to find without getting frustrated. Its great to back up your photos and organise them and those albums. However, for some unknown reason, the "all photos" timeline is for some reason all mixed, such as a trip in July is labeled October with some split to the day after and other trips in there too. Another hitch is you can't turn off the camera auto backup, as I want full control over what I want to keep!!!

author: David Clark-Bell
content: I love this app. It allows me to share photo but I'm also disappointed in it because I feel as though there is more that could be done to manage the photos and allows more choice as to what we want to backup it always feels like an all-or-nothing option rather than allowing us to group important photos based on our own filters I need to filters photos by doubles, blurred, overexposed, large photos, very small photos, this app doesn't make it easy for me to manage these requirements.

author: Steven McCourt
content: Could still do with work. Truly awful idea that you are not pre-warned about only being able to add 500 photos to an album at a time. Just spent (wasted) my time going through selecting a load of photos to add to an album and when I press add it tells me that there is a limit and DESLECTS all the photos I just selected. Where is the logic in that? At the very least, let me go back and amend my selection to remove some photos from my current selection; or warn the user beforehand that the limit is 500 photos at a time; or remove the limit - take your pick! Could also really do with being able to preview photos/videos whilst adding them to an album. It can be hard to tell what a photo/video was and if it is relevant to the album or not. Currently, you would have to add your current selection up to that point or leave the current selection, go back to photos and check photo/video to see if it is relevant, then go back to adding photos to album again.

author: Louise Ingleton
content: Great to be able to access my phone photos from any device. Update - 5 years on: I've now got 1000s of photos & upgraded to paid storage. The most frustrating thing is not being able to find what I need. I have a mixture of personal & business photos (so many cakes!) I would love to be able to tag the photos so I can easily find a specific cake - for example #coffee #cake #birthday #2x8". However the only way to add that info is in the description & that's useless as it isn't searchable 😣

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is an abomination, it's whole process is laid out in the most convoluted manner. Let's say I want to select images from the jumble of photos on my device to back up, move (not copy) them into their unique named folder for ease of future use, while simultaneously deleting them from my phone. But photos can't do that, no, you have to back them ALL up, then dig for the photos to keep. Also, why do I have to delete from device and cloud, I'd like to choose one or the other!

author: F. St.
content: Started in a recent version to create artificial albums to make into a photo book which I would have to pay for. This album included pictures of dead animals taken for veterinary purposes together with sunsets. There needs to be an agreement first for photos to suggest items to album-ize, delete, etc - an 'opt-in', not an 'opt out'. And as to its suggestions for rotation! Its algorithms are way out.

author: Scott Campbell
content: Mostly decent. Pretty basic though. Free uploads is the best part. Not having the ability to favourite or hide photos is a big omission though at this stage. Also, the aggressive software algorithm it uses to try to 'stabilize' videos after you try to edit them into a compliation and save them makes them unwatchable unfortunately. Needs the ability to turn this feature off as otherwise it's unusable.

author: Rhodri Hughes
content: This app is great. You can see all your photos and it is better than any default android gallery and it's really handy to back up your photos. The problem is that it is extremely hard to organise your photos. For example there is no way to delete a photo from the cloud without deleting it from your phone as well. WE NEED THIS FUNCTION GOOGLE! If this feature was added this would easily be 5 stars.

author: Adam “The Scriber” Rutter
content: Google Photos started off as an excellent app for backing up my photos. But in the last month, I have been experiencing issues with trying to backup my selected photos on to the cloud with no success. I pay £2.99 a month for extra storage, but GP still won't backup my photos. I have become very frustrated with the app, and so I have decided to reduce it from 5 stars, to 3 stars.

author: Megan Wren
content: Used to be a great app. Was a bit annoyed that google removed the automatic backup as an option a while ago, but usually remembered to open & back up every few days or so, but following the last update I have about 30 photos not backed up and it's stuck on 'Getting ready to back up' and saying I have nearly 4000 photos to back up? author: Samiron Paul
content: After the recent upgrades, I lost one editing feature that I used the most. Scanning a tilted document, by auto adjusting the corners. I cannot find any other alternatives for that. There are a lot of AI features now but I can't see any option that does that. The document scan option produces PDF, not an image. Please bring back a convenient way to scan documents that produce images. Till then it's a 3 star for me.

author: Drew Woods
content: Alright Google, it's a solid app. But here's the deal, we've become accustomed to this behaviour where my photos are backed up. Now that this will take up my limited amount of free space, I'm FORCED to pay OR not use the service. Well I'm not paying. Plain and simple. I have my own personal cloud storage device. I just happen to like your UI a bit better. Plus the AI is better. BUT, I pay for Amazon Prime. They offer free storage for my photos now. Sooooo, you're really losing access to ALL of my new photos, and not gaining anything from me. I'd highly recommend you reconsider this decision. In the very least, allow for a CERTAIN amount of space BEFORE it adds on to your storage. Like, allow 100 free full size photos a month. That's 3 photos a day roughly. That's fair. And wouldn't take up TOO much space. I'd be a bit more conscious about what I'm backing up and whatnot, but that's fine. I tend to just take a bunch of burst shots and save them all but I only really need the best one. Anyway, that's all. You are now just an archive of old photos. Unless there is a free storage option, I won't be uploading any photos to this. Thank you.

I don't want to have to label every rando who shows up in this or that meme...

author: Ariela C
content: They changed the user interface and it sucks! At least give us the option to change it back! Now it's sooo much harder to find the albums and pictures I'm looking for. Y'all were doing good with some of the updates, and even other features that I don't care for, but this time I had to say something. Please change it back or give us the option to change it back. This makes me want to find a new app and uninstall yours!

author: Mackenzie B
content: Absymal. Uninstalled the update that forced a white outline around figures in my photos because it gave me headaches when I wanted to look back at my photos. No option to even toggle it off. Google photos kept prompting me to update until the app became completely unusable without the update. Will be looking to migrate my photos elsewhere, the white outline "scanning" it does is horrendous for any user wanting to look at their photos I miss when users' experiences were taken into consideration

author: Trend Bender
content: ATTN DEVELOPERS! STOP TELLING ME I CAN FIND WHAT'S MISSING IN THE ACTIONS TAB! They are not there! Most things available in photo edit are no longer. Not able to order prints. Magic Eraser and Best Take and other editing options gone. Only basic filters and cropping remain. Pixel 10 Pro XL.😡 Why did I buy this phone again? 👎🏼These features do not appear in any of the places (or anywhere else) that you're suggesting. Fail. Trading my phone for an iPhone. Fed up with years of Pixel trash.

author: Lailesh M
content: I went to search today and was confused. I feel the previous search was a lot more accurate. This time it gave me a bunch of random photos that were not related to what I entered. Otherwise I love google photos. It keeps all of my photos in one place. I love the albums I share with my family. We all have an album that we share together, and it is great.

author: Keenan Radzak
content: every single time I open the app it pops up a "beautiful" ai image and a "try it out!" how many times should I have to say no before it realizes I don't want ai. no. layout also is a mess. Keeps pictures and screenshots in 2 completely different areas. Not sure why there isn't just a "on this device" home screen. I don't want to navigate for t minutes just to find my screenshots.

author: Razvan Birle
content: bloated with lots of "embellishments" for photo editing but Photoshop does a way better job. ask if ppl want collages (i really really don't wanna see collages with some troll selfies.. that's like taking something ironic seriously. I don't want collages and animations with selfies in general). would be cool if the search bar were a bit more accurate but i guess that takes more time. i would definitely swap filter effects with photo tagging options (or even auto-tagging. would sell a kidney for

author: Mohamed Zeglali
content: very Great photo app sybc but.... I hate that virtually every edit requires you to "save copy" now. I almost never want to do that and then have to delete the original. Ever when doing something as basic as rotating a photo it makes you noW save a copy. It really increases the workload of editing photos when you want to make a minor change and then have to save a copy, come back out, find the original, delete the original, navigate to the next photo and do it all again. Please let me just save

author: Matt W. Coleman
content: I have been using for over 10 years?! Anyway, this has been a saving grace in a world of continually expanding image quality and all the photos we have taken. The AI search is okay, but like most AI, give it some context and it can do a little better. Otherwise, editing tools, arranging, and more have been great.

author: Brett Thomas
content: The app makes it intentionally difficult to remove photos from the cloud storage without also removing them from the phone. In fact, the option isn't available at all in the app, instead one must switch off all backup services and then clear the photos from a web browser. It feels like a deliberate threat: Do not leave the Google ecosystem.

author: Christina DelliSante
content: I can no longer go to view the shots to edit photos but get a message of "trouble loading shots" with no useful help information anywhere on the web. I depend on this feature to find the best shot, but it no longer works. I think it's time to find something new for my photos.

author: Lester Petrycki
content: A very glitchy photo app. One moment the editing features work like a dream, then they don't. Saving photos is crazy, sometimes they're saved & sometimes not ... just gone. The automatic albums feature & the people/places groupings should be an option that can be turned off. You should have the option to open the app to your albums.

author: J Anderson
content: I have had problems loading photos. It drags and some photos won't show. This has been going on for quite a while but every time there's an update, I hope it will fix it but never does. I don't know how to make it stop dragging. I've cleared the cache constantly and removed photos that I don't need. It's not that my phone is overloaded because I'm only using 86g out of 256g. How can I speed it up and to get photos to show immediately? I'm so tired of this.

author: Thomas Shober
content: First of all, the main functions of the app are so great. I love the cloud storage, sharing capabilities, and search functions. BUT the new editor update is very buggy. Quick crop is nice, but the image size wigs out during other edits. The perspective edit is gone too! The rotation is too sensitive as well, it needs a dial. Also, we lost the ability to easily turn a single edit off and on, which was a huge plus before! It's a nice attempt but lots of bugs and the loss of some key features.

author: Erik Kruse
content: Cannot stop weeks-long "uploading 3 files" notification! This has gotten insane as I constantly have a notification that 3 photos are uploading but when I click on the notification it does nothing. Yet another reason I am distancing myself from Google products in general and paying for privacy with Proton. Will back up everything elsewhere and then delete this app so this notification will be gone for good. Google, you've gotten way too big and you just don't care anymore.

author: Sophie W (Animals and Minecraft)
content: this app is amazing for rewatching old - or new - videos, AND PHOTOS. I never really knew that I needed Google photos until I actually started using it for something properly useful😭. one thing, when I try to cut videos, it always kinda extends the bar and beings the cut line with it so that it's never cut where I wanted/needed it to be. thats all, byee😆😁

author: Rich Adams
content: Photo metadata now hidden by default and have to expand on every photo just to see things like size. The filename is also truncated now. Then we have the constant dark patterns trying to trick you into turning on backup. It's turned off on purpose, respect that decision. Or add a config option "Yes, I know backup is off, never ask me again".

author: Caleb Johns
content: Great app. I love the many video editing options. The only thing I would request (this is me being picky) Is a way to play music on the video a little after it starts. Like the music starts in the middle of the video or something. There is just no option for that right now. I love the editing though, keep on adding great features!

author: Vince M
content: well it appears you may have fixed the spastic crop tool also I haven't noticed the side pop out at menus in the editing room they certainly no belong there and are very problematic. You have added a sticker suite, Bravo!! I started testing it out today big plus. well if you added a real color palette with a color matching tool and an adjustment for opacity I wouldn't have to download other photo editing apps any more. only other suggestions I can think of is more personal freedom in deciding🤪

author: Will James
content: I do love this app, there are so many useful features which i do use with some regularity. I do however have an issue with the fact that I can not access the locked folder on my Chromebook. I either have to go the website or use my phone. This can be quite frustrating as all other features I use appears to be available. Please fix this Google

author: Ollie R
content: Stop pestering me to turn on backup - I don't want it. Editing date/time doesn't work most of the time and has been broken for years. You can't delete photos in albums only remove, clearly a dark pattern to keep your usage high. And please make it easier to upload pictures I've downloaded, it's not easy unless you took the photo yourself.

author: Don Archer
content: HEALING BRUSH! The new magic eraser is utterly impossible to use. In the previous version it was the perfect tool. It used to be fantastic for retouches like skin blemishes. Now it over selects and does a worse job. Major downgrade. At the very least include the healing brush from Snapspeed. UPDATE: Now the healing brush is available but requires a face in the photo. ugh. please just allow us to use the tool without face detection. It's not a feature!

author: Ryan Terry
content: "Make the app yours" banner trying to, as usual, shove Gemini down everyone's throat doesn't dismiss even after selecting "No thanks". Creating an album is now a nightmare, when it used to be easy and intuitive. Just try adding locations, which upon editing jump back to the top even after being dragged later in the album, which happens pretty much every time a location is added. Unreal, how consistently and severely Google breaks their own once-working products. Trash redesign.

author: ellaskye
content: I want to restore my photos back to it's original time and place but they became recent pictures instead. I have photos from years ago that I want to view on my gallery coz I could look at it without WIFI anytime I want. I would like my photos of that exact date it was taken. It is because for me pictures and videos are a proof that precious moment really did happen.🥺 I had cats and dogs of those bygone days. Pls I miss them so much.😭❤️

author: Kiki Chan
content: This app was so good. Until, recently I re-downloaded a few photos back on my device and when I checked a few days later they were automatically deleted from my device and I haven't even disabled the automatic backup settings. I've experienced that more than twice. It's very frustrating.

author: Francis Castro
content: Every update now breaks Google Photos and my app is consistently stuck on "Setting up your photo library" and does not show backed up photos once I've removed the local copies on my device. I have to now open Photos on the browser just to see all my photos, which defeats the entire purpose of the app. (Update: Still NOT fixed as of May 2, 2026)

author: Soms DRC

It is very distracting and makes me want to move to a different app.

author: Coma Dreams Film
content: I save video from text message and it's not in my camera roll. I go through some stupid steps to find it in my "internal storage" move it to a new folder and mark it as a favorite. it's not showing in any folders and it's extremely frustrating because it shows up if I wanted to send that same video as a text message. I'm very disappointed in this phone and this app is another annoying thing about it

author: John Wayne
content: I hate the changes it's made. I can no longer build files to store pictures together and most of my pictures are no longer searchable on apps, i.e if I'm on Facebook and want to upload a picture most of them no longer show up. I hate the changes, I want to be able to make files, not "albums" that don't show up on other apps.

author: Hate mi Loife

author: birdenand
content: It is virtually impossible to find any of your pictures. Oh, that picture you can't find in your camera album, it's been decided this is in your videos album (despite many videos being in the camera album). Looking for a screenshot? Could be in like 5 different folders. Want a picture from telegram? Oh, it's actually not in the Telegram folder, its in the Telegram Images folder. Or the second Telegram folder. JUST PUT ALL MY PICTURES IN ONE BIG THING AND SORT THEM CHRONOLOGICALLY.

author: sue wyllie
content: The last update broke it on my Kindle Fire. It launches, but then disappears into Recent apps. Selecting it there brings it *very* briefly to the front before returning to the background. Wish I could've replaced my broken Galaxy with another one—and stayed in the ecosystem—but money be tight. And up to now Photos worked flawlessly on the Fire.

author: Maximus Marshlovoski

I've tried force stopping it, clearing the cache, nothing's working.

author: K-oz Dragon
content: It seems impossible that an app could have LESS features each update, but Google has managed to do this. The location data now no longer syncs with photos from a camera. It use to. You also now have to click a second panel to open image data on EVERY PHOTO. I'm already looking at the details, show the exif data! Or keep the panel open when clicked!

author: Max M
content: Amazing app!! I downloaded this app thinking it would just be like a normal photo app, but no, it is way better! It can recognize peoples faces & and keeps photos in order by date. You can also do stuff like Photo to video, which is where you take a photo, than Google Photos makes a 4 Sec. video about the photo, and it sometimes includes music, and it does it all in less than a minute. I highly recommend you download this app, it is way better than you think. Well they removed photo to video😡

author: Louise Hamlin
content: I find it incredibly frustrating that I can't find a way to import just a few photos from a folder on my device to Google photos. I can only find a way to allow Google photos to import all photos from particular folders on my device. The only work arounds I've found are time consuming, very inefficient, and incredibly frustrating.

author: Marcus

Yeah, it's getting a bit tight on my phone but there's at least 12 free gigs. Regardless, I'll NEVER pay to store photos ESP at the ridiculous price not that Apple is any better. Ah how I miss those SD cards.

author: Abhinav Dubey

author: Alexandre G.
content: the fact that it keeps asking to backup over and over with dark UX pattern to make you enable it per image by mistake doesn't deserve to get graded higher. I get selling phones with no storage by today's standard to force the sale of cloud subscriptions, which oligopoly wouldn't, but you don't have to be annoying about it... Also the AI training as an excuse of a feature, when you can't even skew correct easily anymore, might be worse.

author: Zuber
content: Developer responded so I've edited my review slightly. I've also given it 2 stars now instead of 1. However, it would've been better if default was that deleting items in the backup didnt delete items on the phone. Part of previous review: if the measley 5gb of online storage runs out, your only option is to buy more storage space via monthly subscription, or you try and delete photos/videos from the backup to free space. But then it also deletes those same files on your phone itself.

author: Adam Bakowsky
content: It's unbelievable that default photo app from Google is lacking basic functionality. I want to see ALL my photos by default, and only when needed check groupings like Screenshots. No albums, no nothing. What a disgrace, that you have to go looking for a 3rd party app for something that should work out of the box.

author: Ashraful Sheikh
content: Google Photos is truly one of the most reliable and feature-rich apps for managing photos and videos. I have been using this app for a long time, and it continues to impress me with its performance and smart features. The automatic backup feature is incredibly helpful, ensuring that all my memories are safely stored in the cloud without any extra effort. The synchronization across devices works seamlessly, allowing me to access my photos anytime and from anywhere. All the best in everything.

author: Will
content: You can't archive stuff unless it's moved to your main folder which is a big design flaw. For example you download something or screenshot something and it's impossible to archive even after it's backed up. And file names now get truncated. So you can't see the last digits of filenames which usually shows you the date, time, rev# of a photo. Bad oversight which creates big headaches.

author: Ben
content: Used to be a good photo editing with an HDR option. I don't know if HDR become "tone" or if it is no longer available. The editing tools were laid out nicely, and have been updated to a confusing hot mess. More clicks to get to tools, to many categories, and a seemingly random access to the AI tool. 2026: HDR still not working on Samsung device nor Pixel Device. "Portrait lighting" also not working.

author: Mark Andrew Frey
content: They took away the edit button? Now I have to wait ten seconds for it to open to some stupid screen I don't want and still there's no ability to edit photos the way I have been for years. Don't push AI baloney on us. Always make it a choice. What are you thinking? This is totally unusable now. How do I downgrade? UPDATE: I found if you turn off Gemini In Photos under Photo Settings, it removes this BS and brings back the Edit button.

author: Patrick D
content: 3rd time it's asked me to create an AI cartoon of us and I've said no. WTH?! Prior: Good but everytime they update the app (which is like once a week) they pop up a prompt saying there's an update and then when I click it, it takes me to the app store where it says I've already updated. Bad UX! Get rid of these annoying redundant prompts please. Feedback shared, they ignored it.

author: Chris V
content: Visual glitches involving image storage and selection. What appears to be unloaded images when selecting will actually select another image or other images. Worst, if you ever had older images stored, it will still label them under a wrong date you have never customized it, specifically selecting [Month], and then it selects images that belong in another month. Uninstalling and then reinstalling doesn't work. There's now more of them.

author: K P
content: On Pixel 10, edited photos are not uploadable to websites and apps. Message is "Can't load some photos. Try again later". There are reddit threads going back 7+ months on this. How in the world is this not fixed yet? I see a lot of new little features being shipped here but no bug fix for an enormously frustrating defect? Great priorities.

author: Tabitha H
content: some really great new features are available now. A bunch of us have run into an issue where those features seem to disappear specifically AI enhance. And that's a great tool I kept looking for it here in this app and then I suddenly realized one day no AI enhanced option 'is in my camera not photos app so if you open your camera and look down at your last picture click it and edit then AI is there. I hope that helps anyone struggling with that.

author: Liam R
content: Genuinely the worst thing I've ever used, half way through editing a photo it'll just stop showing the edits I'm making and sometimes just resets the photo. What's more fun is when your cloud storage is full (something I don't want nor need) it doesn't leave you alone, I'm always bombarded with messages to upgrade my storage.

author: Kate Pelletier
content: This used to be a great app. Now, every time it updates, something else breaks or gets moved in a way that's less convenient. I haven't been able to trim videos in-app for months, and with the latest update, it takes forever to scroll through photos. Something stored natively on my device shouldn't have this much lag. It's now also incredibly inconvenient to navigate to folders to find photos.

author: Samuel Thomas
content: I just updated Google photos, what an epic mistake. there's a completely different layout and random photos are now larger than the standard grid, this makes it difficult and confusing to find the photos you want. how do we switch back to the old standard grid where all the pictures are the same size in the grid? why have you changed this? literally nobody asked for this. currently looking for a new gallery app because they've forced this change.

author: Montgomery Richmond

For the life of me, I can't figure out what to do. Needless to say, this is useless, because it only worked once.

author: Tin Der
content: Doesn't sync/cache big videos correctly, so it doesn't display in the app nor does it back them up. That's such a basic feature :l

author: Juan VALLDEZ-
content: Taking screenshots is far too critical. Too many things inadvertently obstructing the path for what should be an ez and seamless detail.

author: Kelly P

I get a constant pop-up saying that I need to update the app, but then it tells me it's not available. And that's just the tip of the iceberg. I pay for extra storage because I take thousands of photos. I never had to worry about my photos until now.

author: Steve

author: Leona Koch

author: Vikas Jain
content: This app is incredibly frustrating. It forces you to grant full access to your photos and videos just to function, which feels more like data extortion than a real requirement. ​Even worse, sync is tied to your Google account rather than the app itself. If you disable it to protect your media, your emails stop syncing too. It’s an intrusive, "all-or-nothing" approach that prioritizes data collection over user experience. Seems like extortion

author: Peter DeMarco
content: Google photos was less reliable and harder to control than the proprietary Samsung app built into my Galaxy A26. I couldn't even delete pictures on Google at times.

author: A Google user

Please change it back or give the option to be able to read the file descriptions like before and please add more video playback formats.

author: Luca Menegozzo
content: The edit feature has lost quality since some updates. author: Jenn

SO none of the photos are chronologically correct by original date. And for the love it all, and a remove duplicate option!

author: Ms. Anonymous

author: dinez

author: Veronica Rose

author: A P

author: Kate Walton

author: Vincent Brian

author: shlok Joshi

content: Update: all my photos in the "photos" doubled up, and the photos I just took never showed up until 2 hours later, very frustrating. After the updates, it's harder to access "screenshots", "shared albums", and my other albums on my device. They made it more inconvenient to use. Now they put a notification bell instead of the shared album icon on the top right corner, which is a pretty useless change. Please stop making unnecessary updates if you don't have any better ideas.

author: Janet “Joyfully Janet” Caen
content: From day one (what's it been, 10...20 years)this has been my photo storage preference. For the past couple of years or so, I've had to purchase a few products, attempting to find the great editing features that are no longer an option here. Now you put out another update? What BETTER benefits have you removed this time? Just SAY IT GOOGLE!!! You're sick of being in the "photo biz" and stop with the passive agressive downgrading updates.😒

author: A Google user
content: I really like this photo app but it doesn't have an option to gather all stickers into one album (Facebook messenger) and I find that ads from other apps are saved in my phone. It's annoying to have to go in every single day to delete video/picture ads from my gallery. Also I find it weird that some of my photos are saved under different folders and sometimes I have double folders. It makes me miss the old gallery from my previous moto g4 phone. Edit: I was scrolling back to show a friend some photos from summer only to find that some of them are broken. They show less than half the photo while the rest is grey. Now I'm wondering if I've lost these photos for good. I'm upset.

author: Cromulently Cromulent
content: I like the app and it works well with the Pixel 7 Pro features. I would rate the app better if it wasn't for the really annoying "unable to edit, check your connection" error that has been happening since January this year. I can edit while a picture is still in the camera folder but as soon as you move it to another folder you can no longer edit it.

author: R W
content: Are you serious? A photo app and backup app that does not let you actually download photos when you need them again? Are you trying to hold them hostage? You can only open and select and download one photo at a time?!!! And after two or three clicks to get there? What the hell are you thinking with an app that doesn't let you easily select and download multiple of my own files you want to edit and share? Insane! Now I have to switch back to OneDrive. uuuugh! Make good design decisions!

author: s dhn
content: App was great, but it no longer shows photos uploaded to your account via other devices/the Google photos site, a bug that hasn't been fixed. Sent feedback multiple times. Edit: in response, the photos are correctly in my account. When I log into Google photos on Chrome on this device, the photos are there. When I look at the app, the photos are not there. Edit: Finally, 2 days later and all the photos are appearing in the app as it is in browser.

author: A Google user
content: Idk if it's bad, or just overly complicated. The app automatically saves photos to folders it makes. You'd think there would be a main folder that holds every picture, but my photos folder is missing a lot. I try to make a new folder to consolidate things, but the new folder doesn't show up as an option when I click "move to folder". And if i start in one folder and use the "add pictures" the ones I want don't show up. It's tempting to delete all the sentimental pics, just to have a clean slate.

author: Jessica Fritzler
content: Only good for editing now. I can't back up my photos without clogging up my Gmail and Drive, and I'm sorry that I don't want to lose quality for freebie storage. 🙄 I get why Google changed things, but suddenly I'm having to constantly jump through hoops just to use the app. If I didn't like the editor so much, I'd just get rid of it.

author: Flaviane Kurak
content: Unable to save when editing photos. On my phone, when editing a picture I'm unable to save the changes, the button simply won't work, to be fair, neither the cancel button. All the other features work fine. As well, I don't understand why, after backing up pictures, the app mix up and put all in the same folders, including pictures we received from instant messaging apps.

author: A Google user
content: This would be a great app if it didn't delete photos from all devices when you delete a photo from the app. It's infuriating and what's worse is when someone sent me photos from their google photos acct randomly the app seems to have turned itself back on with a default to grab all photos from my phone. I'm not readily finding where to turn it back off.

author: A Google user
content: Taking photos is great. But after spending a painstaking amount of time cleaning up the photos, I'm still randomly getting duplicates. I also created a number of albums and am so frustrated that I can't access those albums via Instagram or other photo editing apps (instead I just get the entire photo gallery). I organized my photos for a reason. I would like easy access to them across platforms so that I can share them how I wish (ex. Doing a collage of my pregnancy photos). Honestly, the camera isnt worth this hassle and I wish I stuck with my iPhone. Lesson learned.

author: A Google user
content: It bothers me how the people and pets section is on top of the first page app is on when it opens. I am struggling figuring out how to archive photos of exes and now their faces r the first I see when I open the app which is upsetting for obvious reasons. I don't want to full on delete these memories but I don't need to be constantly reminded of them either.

author: Aaernia “Nia” Folkvarsdotter
content: I've hated this app for many a year now. Sure, it works, but I despise how it's organized and of course like everything else it changes over time, making it more steps for me to find and open what I want. Let's just bury downloads and screenshots! Oh? You added them to an album? Okay, now they can show up in the photos tab where typically only the photos you took are! And that's the only place you can tell they're albumed.

author: A Google user
content: Handy, misleading and intensely intrusive. No, you will not be able to summon your archived photos from the ether - unless you have round-the-clock WiFi access, of course. Neither are the editing tools anything to squeal from the rooftops. The solution? Get yourself a nice little hard drive with some decent cheap photo-editing software...and if, later, you choose to upload duplicates to your Google Drive or indeed your whatever: good for you.

author: Rachael Slade
content: The new update is terrible. I can't find any of my photos. For example, if I used to look up the word restaurant, it would show me all the photos of restaurants that I took along with any screenshots or paperwork with the word restaurant. I have purposely photos with words next to them so I could find them fast and the future. Now it's no longer works. I search for a very specific word and no longer do my items come up with that word. Comes up with a whole bunch of other stuff.

author: Marcus W
content: I like this app, it'll keep your photos secure forever and give you amazing memories to look back on. However, with my Android phone, it's the only Photos app I'm provided. While it's good for storing photos, it doesn't work properly as a photos app. I cannot access my photos that I have just taken until the phone decides it's time to back them up. This is a major issue, that should not exist. Photos apps have existed since the dawn of smartphones, and the most basic feature. It's intolerable

author: Furqan Iqbal
content: when I started using this application, it was great! many pictures were perfectly fine for storage. Now every time I open the application, it says, I don't have enough storage. It is such a headache connecting my mobile to my laptop and transferring all my pictures and videos. It seems as if your application is not working on backing up pictures on daily basis. There are so many complaints, shouldn't your developers take note and make this app better. There is no use for our feedback.

author: A Google user
content: Having problems with organising album using Android OS. I have to use my PC to ensure the uploaded photos are really added into my desired album. Is a double job. Can't select photo to be album cover, can't download photos from the app, all have to be done by PC version now. Heck, it never happened before! Please fix it. This was the best image storage app ever.

author: A Google user
content: It's a great app, but it just doesn't work fine. When I need to delete photos, sometimes I have to delete same photos for several times, just because there are some blank white spaces left, that after reboot turns back into photos I deleted. And at the end, when I have to delete a lot of photos from both my device and account, after few minutes of cleaning it just stops deleting and pressing delete button just doesn't change anything... Moreover, syncing between devices could be better, because every time I need to transfer video from my laptop and I use Google photos I just cannot download video, it just says try in few minutes, and sometimes it could take hours... I'm aware of syncing data between servers, but in that case don't just write try again in few minutes, write something more realistic... Furthermore, sometimes there are minor bugs, such as syncing photos between my devices, when I upload photo from pc, it just doesn't show up in the photos app on my phone, but everywhere else those photos are present, even in web interface in chrome... And in that cases I have to upload my photos several times, just so that they appear in app, but then finally they all appear and I have to delete duplicated ones... So please, Google, update your app, so that it wasn't that laggy, because for me, person, that use photos app many times a day, sometimes it just gets annoying to use it, and I simply think about switching to alternatives....

author: A Google user
content: Photo management is complete chaos. Cant control where they go, how to move, how to keep in a private area, move or copy independently of all devices, how to access albums... then photos show up in multiple folders, and if you archive something, guess you have just deleted it. Easy photo mgmt software has existed for decades, this ain't it. Took a simple thing and complicated beyond belief. It's a nightmare. I'm pissed. You suck Google photos.

author: A Google user
content: The "favorites" star randomly appears sometimes. When it does, I'm unable to move any photo to another folder. I like the star, because it allows me to flag a photo that I want to keep, and mass delete other ones I don't. But it would be nice to be able to have it around all the time and also be able to use the move to folder feature. Also there's a new error that says photos doesn't have access to my SD card to delete a photo.

author: Maya Shavzin
content: Sure the app displays my images, but additional features are clunky at best. There is no easy/convenient way to rotate images! NO WAY to rotate batches. IT'S SO ANNOYING and inefficient! When I take pictures of documents or artwork, they're usually saved in the wrong orientation, 270 degrees of how they were taken, and I don't know if that's the cameras fault, or Photos'. That's why I'd love a way to rotate batches! Deleting is super slow, too. DO BETTER.

author: Andy Leone
content: This app was so easy to use and create sharble abums. Now ever since updates it is not as user friendly and the MOST important thing is some of the album's have missing pictures. The other problem is if pictures are added to an album by others, even though you save them. If that person deletes them or changes phone numbers or email the pictures disappeared Even when you hit the save to library button. VERY unreliable. I am a paying Google customer and I tried to call tech support. NO HELP

author: A Google user
