content: Bad UX. Saved a modified version of a not-so-recent photo from an album? Good luck finding it ever again in the whole feed. Trying to export a photo to another folder so that it's easier to find in other apps? You can't. Upload dialog blocking UI waiting for network? Tough luck, now you can't use the app until you have network again or kill it. Can't add selection of photos to more than one album. Can't see what albums a photo is already part of.

author: A Google user
content: When I got my phone I disabled all of the pre-installed Google apps that I don't use, but recently a friend sent me some important pictures through this app so I re-enabled it. At first I liked that it was uploading all of my photos from my phone because I've been meaning to back them up somewhere, but ever since it started doing that my battery life has tanked. I took a look at the app settings and it has been using my data connection in the background and eating my battery doing it >:(

author: A Google user
content: I just used the option to free up space and now the app it's just a mess of unorganized photos sorted by date only. I'd like to have the option to at least create albums that automatically fill with pics from a certain device folder so I don't have to deal with this mess. I like my photos organized by decice folder but albums olny let me fill them automatically with photos of certain people or pets.

author: j baer
content: App is set up in a very frustrating way that makes it hard to find pictures. Samsung photos was so much better. And stop trying to force me to back up my photos! I don't want to, stop making me click multiple times every few days to stay that I still don't want to! Not to mention it's set up to get you to inadvertantly turn it on. Just stop! I will never turn on notifications or backup, and that is my choice and my right. Stop bombarding me to try and force me to or wear me down! NO MEANS NO!

author: A Google user
content: Getting better and better, I have been suggesting for years that you include a duplicate removal tool 🤔🤔🙄🙄 after linking Dropbox and other apps to Photos it has taken my 1300 photos and turned them into 13000, I now have 10 of each of my photos stored.... It would be so great to have an algorithm that would pick the best of them and delete the rest....... Please, please, please, that's why I lowered your rating from 5 to 3

author: Nicolas Canali
content: This app is not trustworthy. Failing to upload pictures and albums and a very messy gallery. Rarely the actual date of the picture is the same as the date on the gallery, finding myself looking around all the gallery for what I'm looking for. Years ago Google Photos was working properly and just lately (around one year) it got too much messy.

author: A Google user
content: It's a good app. But like all Google apps the size of the apps and updates is absurd. They seem to believe they are above all apps. Wanting updates constantly. Which doesn't make half of them even work after. They already consume 80% OS, then apps are always running and demand background data on. Also their apps eat up memory and RAM and can't stop them or report them. If you do it pops right back on. I hate using Google, we need a better system,they're too controlling.

author: Lorena Hamman
content: Because of the recent update, a bunch of my pictures changed. Some are blurry when they used to not be, some look pixelated, and the new way of storing multiple shots in one stack is so annoying to sift through. I hate how you it's not compatible with any app on my Pixel, and I hate how stupid the storage system is. If I download a photo, it takes ten minutes to find it. I wish they would stop making changes and just let my photos be.

author: Todor Stoyanov
content: Spend hours of my life trying to share albums in the past few months - it keeps returning error to try again later... Also any new album created on the one device will no apoear on another device and vice verse. At the same time the photos are syncing - the backed up photos from each device would appear on the other one. But the app isn't that useful without having the option to organize photos in albums that would sync across devices and that are shareable.

author: Kevin Tessner
content: Not sure why now I have to go back and re-edit the original photo when I just want to make one more small tweak to a photo I'd already spent a considerable amount of time editing. It's great to have that option, but for the only options to be Edit Original or Cancel (and make no further edits at all), that's just a terrible way to treat the user.

author: Supergirl Sophia
content: Overall it is a great app. Though, like other people, I have been experiencing problems. One, even though all my photos are backed up and synced, it doesn't show some of my important photos and videos. Next, my photos and videos are scattered, and not in order of how it was in order. I have a couple of other bugs, where it kicks me from the app, just shows a white screen, etc. I still like this app, though it can be better.

author: A Google user
content: Edited 14/06/22: I read the article and did what it suggested. It has made no difference. I removed a star because the suggestion to do all those things to an app that's been working fine annoyed me. Edit 13/06/2022: crashes every time I swipe up on a photo to add to an album. In recent updates, I have noticed a lot of bugs. I rely so heavily on Google Photos (I was previously a Picasa user), and would love this to be fixed asap. Does what is expected of it and is easy to use.

author: Becca Dutile
content: With this new update the editing option is way too complicated. It doesn't automatically keep the level of brightness, tone, and all of those other things you choose throughout the whole process. The eraser doesn't erase what I want it to and the cropping feature is now a thick line and curved in the corners so I can't see if I've cropped out what I want to crop out. I live editing my pictures and videos. With this update I've stopped taking pictures and videos. Don't fix what it's broken.

author: A Google user
content: I used to recommend Google photos to anyone. Especially if they had a pixel as you could get unlimited photo storage. But this has since been taken away and now I have to constantly clear "your storage is x% full." Notifications now. It's annoying and no longer worth recommending. I don't want another subscription for a service you used to offer for free.

author: alex mitsou
content: There is no option to delete a photo from the backup cloud instead of the device, I've been looking all around the internet and we have to play around with folders that we don't want backed up. I want a downloaded/ taken pic in on the default "camera" folder, but it gets backed up immediately, and it stays there even if the photo is moved to a non-backed up folder. Also, I believe there could easily be much more clarity of what we are doing, but the menus are bad instead. Make easier to control.

author: Joe McKenzie
content: Overall nice gallery and photo editor. However it nagged me to update to get the "latest features", and now I'm sorry I did. The only thing that seems to be added is more frequent nags that my photos are not backed up. I use a different system to backup my photos. PLEASE add a way to turn this off. Annoying the **** out of me is not going to make me decide to use your service. In fact I was considering switching over, but now I'm not.

author: Emma Chapman
content: I haven't used the app as much since they made changes last year. It's less intuitive, harder to scroll through memories, setting made less accessable, harder to find other features I used to like, like the gifs. It still automatically makes them, but they're more buried so I never look. And it's not that I'm not tech savvy. I recently got a degree having to do with computer databases. This app is just plain a less plesent experience then it used to be. Everytime I open the app I'm disappointed.

author: João Rodrigues
content: The new UI.. a hit and miss. It's more difficult (albeit inexistent) to see the auto generated creations, stylized photos etc, and specially movies and albuns: I miss the "for you" tab (you need to go to a PC). Good addition the map fixture... But still I can't edit date and geo tag my photos... Also I like the new edit features. for now it's more like a backup app with pay fixtures than a photo app.

author: A Google user
content: My main issue is that I'm constantly trying to find my photos after editing them. There is a feature that groups original photos with the edited ones, together in one "file"...which results in me having to scroll forever to get to the original to find the newly edited one. This is such a departure from how my gallery used to be, before Google Photos, which I really miss.

author: Kates “THEE OG Sexy Ninja” McDonald
content: it is unreliable and redundant. It also should connect and communicate more fluidly between photos an Drive. At times, I have no idea as to which ones are in drive or which ones still in photos. if photos and drive communicated w/ each other; for instance if I delete a photo in one app that should reflect that in the other app. That goes for any changes/ edits to that photo. it would make a huge difference to the Layman that usually utilizes these apps. Otherwise you're just burning up storage.

author: Jeremy Brumley
content: It's not something I do often but it's fun to go in Google photos and create a movie. The last few times I've sat and selected pictures and videos and actually spent time making a movie when I hit save it just goes back to the previous screen or either at the bottom it says couldn't save movie edits. I don't understand why it started doing that but it's really annoying. You could really spend a lot of time and make something really neat but it never saves and won't work.

author: A Google user
content: Was one of the best apps on the market, UI and responsiveness is still really good. However, it has been some time now that backups have been getting delayed for a few minutes, then hours and now days. Fresh install on a phone with just 4 pictures and stuck on "getting ready to back up" for 10 days. Lots of free RAM and storage, tried factory reset on phone and still the same. Same symptoms on three other phones.

author: Veronica Freitas
content: For photos of art, especially pencil artwork, Google Photos has steadily become more difficult and inefficient to use for editing. My phone's default photo editor is both faster and more capable than Photos now. It's annoyingly hard to get the precise level of effect you want, when say, editing contrast. The phone vibration when changing the slider doesn't help. Why do I want my phone to vibrate when I'm closely looking at a photo?? Photos used to be my favorite, but not anymore.

author: Pix Smith
content: Getting better, but still unclear when it comes to accessing different directories, It doesn't seem able to find images, even when you tell it where to look. Kind of laggy on pixel 3. new editing interface is difficult to use, and makes the picture so small that it's hard to see what changes might have happened. just once I would like an app to be designed by people who actually might use it at some time.

author: A Google user
content: Please put back "View Recent Activity". Was very helpful for shared albums. Also I was able to at one point have my photos backed up without having to always go into the Photos app. It no longer does that. It will only back up photos if we go into the app. Please put it back the setting where it will automatically back up photos if we do not go into the app. App is no longer syncing with my photos in Google photos on the desktop. There are photos shown there that aren't shown on my phone app.

author: Connor Dodd
content: When you back your slowmo videos into photos and delete it off of your device, it makes the whole video in slowmotion instead of just the part you edited. This has been a problem for years, and they still havent fixed it. The app is really easy to use, and the Assistant makes it easy to find photos from trips. It automatically makes slideshows. Also recently, when I back up videos, I can't view them

author: A Google user
content: Used to be a set and forget type of app that would upload photos taken to google photos, but this feature hasn't worked for me for a few weeks now. Instead, it displays a message that says it is 'getting ready to upload'. Despite the message, it never actually uploads anything. I've tried uninstalling and reinstalling app, and clearing cache, but nothing has worked so far.

author: A Google user
content: It deletes some of your downloaded/saved photos. Also, around 50 of my photos have just turned black, no matter what device I look from. I can't see what they are anymore. And now on my android, I can only view some of my photos in my library. The rest are gone completely. This all is good in viewing your photos from different devices (linked to your gmail), but it doesn't keep all of them. I don't know what's happening (this all happened within 1 day), but can you please fix it

author: KuletsBro
content: This app... Let's say that I had a lot of problems while using this app. Firstly, I couldn't edit pictures due to a certain error; secondly, whenever I moved my photos to my new album, it didn't show up as if the app didn't know that these images were in the said album; lastly, the compression after I trimmed the video was definitely unnecessary. With this in mind, I hope you guys will take action against these problems.

author: L F
content: There is no easy way to re-download images that may have been deleted back onto your phone. I didn't realize what the "clean up" feature was, and assumed it would be tool to clean up storage in the app. It's impossible to easily re-download those photos, there isn't a button or menu at all. Upsetting problem to deal with, as i do not use photos as my main photo manager.

author: A Google user
content: I used to like this app quite a bit and still like a lot of it's simple but effective edit capabilities. However, several months ago, it lost the ability to delete photos (keeps asking for permission even though permission has already been granted). It tells you to use Gallery to delete the pictures but when I do, they still show up in Photos! Big thumbs down because of yet another simple, widely reported bug that Google has done nothing to fix.

author: A Google user
content: The only good thing I got from this was accessing pictures from several years ago, other than that, it isnt good, when I delete a video from my phone after being backed up (I made sure it was using original size), it deletes the video from the app, I lost a video I made and I will never be able to access it ever again, had to install an app that is like the samsung trash can so I dont lose another thing again.

author: A Google user
content: UGH! The only reason I used this app was the sharing option. But for some reason, in the last few months, it won't let me see albums shared with me at all. It's full of bugs, searching is a nightmare, adding already uploaded photos to albums takes forever and I have to add a few at a time to make sure it doesn't miss any of my photos or videos. Super time consuming, frustrating and just an awful customer experience. Honestly, guys, you're freaking Google for crying out loud. Make an effort!!

author: A Google user
content: I keep finding more and more annoying bugs update (25/03/19) downgrading from 3 to 2*. Impossible to delete more than one photo without having to go back into the main library and reselecting the next photo. Also, why the hell would i want to edit a photo and save as copy and have 100000 copies of the same photo!? just want to edit the existing one, is it really that hard to achieve?

author: Angel Colon
content: Used to like Google photos. Was very organized. Now each time I try to enter a name for a face it keeps saying "error while labeling cluster" and now I can tag faces which made it easy for me to locate pictures. I updated my app and still nothing. Hopefully it gets fixed soon. Edit: Tried the article and went to the forum. Nothing worked. Just uninstalled it. Hopefully Im able to find another app.

author: E. Patton
content: When it works, it's great! However, most of the time I'm unable to save any edits. The app is responsive, not frozen -- I can keep making edits. But tapping "save a copy" or even "cancel" do nothing! It used to sometimes work if I force quit the app and then reopen, but that no longer helps. I have a Pixel 7 which I've owned less than a year, and I've pretty much had to give up on editing photos in the Photos app. If anything, it's gotten worse with subsequent updates.

author: J1
content: What happened to select all, I have to manually select hundreds of photos? And if I want to download a photo, it's a multi step process on top of that. I'm definitely ending my increased storage storage subscription, and finding a more versatile photo storage provider that lets me manage my files easily. Most recent updates address storage, of which I have more than sufficient space. What I don't have is time to waste organising all my images individually. Fix that.

author: A Google user
content: Great app but needs improvement. It takes forever for the newly uploaded pictures & albums to cross over platforms. I would upload some photos via the app then want to see those pics via PC but it would take a very long time for those pics to become accessible to the PC platform, visa versa. No matter how many times I refresh the page, new uploads take hours in order to view the pictures on a different platform

author: Lillian DiCarlo
content: Something I'd really really like to see changed is when you create a shared album having the option of sorting the pictures so that people can see the ones that were just added first. As it is, it shows the oldest pictures first, so if you have an album with 600 pictures, you have to scroll a ton to see the pictures that were recently added. While I don't mind too much, my technologically challenged parents and in-laws have a rough time of it. Another thing is allowing you to choose when you ge

author: A Google user
content: This app is way too "smart" and offers features that do not provide much value and make the general organizing of the photos a challenge to navigate. Currently, photos from the camera are organized chronologically requiring an endless scroll to the bottom just to get to photos snapped years in the past. There doesn't seem to be an option to change the photo layout format either. Weird...

author: Melissa Pepper
content: Very confusing app experience. It took a significant amount of time to set up my library (and it did not explain what process was taking place, so I wasn't sure what I was waiting for). I learned that adding something to Google Photos means that it deleting it from Photos will also delete it from your device, even if syncing is off. Adding photos to an album is also very confusing since you can't sort by phone folders. I hope the interface and instructions improve in the future.

author: A Google user
content: The dates of when the pictures were taken are not accurate. When you want to access to the photos through another app, you can't browse by album making it pretty hard to go through 100's of pictures till you get to the one you need when you could have just gone to the album you had already created and easily find what you are looking for. Other than that I like the somewhat accurate Memories feature!

author: A Google user
content: If there is anything good at all that I can say about this app, it's that it at least lets me keep all files in one place and it neatly segregates my files into folders according to how the filed were obtained - there is a screenshot folder, a camera folder and a folder for almost every editing app. That's great, however there are many things about this app that could be improved. First of all, why is it that I can't create folders simply how I want? Why can't this storage app be like the 'Computer' icon in Windows, where it actually allows you to create folders, rename folders, delete folders, make folders within folders and move files however and wherever you want? Also, there is an issue with deleting files - it takes something like 5 minutes to delete 60MB of data. Why, may I ask?

author: William
content: LET ME MASS DOWNLOAD ITEMS. You let me mass delete my photos by the thousand, let me download a whole album in 2 taps. Some elements don't match the material you color scheme. For instance, under Library>Utilities, the close and options buttons on cards are mismatched. Also, the menu which appears when selecting photos, and the "add to album" menu.

author: Maggie R
content: It would be much more user friendly if your phone's albums were actually imported. The app has great alternate organizational features, but none of them are as easy as just knowing what folder a picture has always been stored in and being able to quickly go there and find it. Even re-creating the albums through the app doesn't take them off the main page leaving so many pictures to sort through.

author: Riley Xu
content: The app generally tries to be "too smart" with a bunch of "helpful" features that really just get in the way of usability. For example you're bombarded with highlights and editing suggestions. The AI also randomly picks out some "interesting" photos and makes them really big in the library view, but it does a really bad job of choosing those photos. Many of these there is no option to turn off. There is also an annoying amount of advertising to get you to buy canvases of your photos.

author: A Google user
content: I like that it will backup my photos. But, it sucks that the photos are resized to a smaller format for free while the original size is limited to a fixed amount. It also only does the backup over wifi which I barely use. Why can't I backup photos over my 4g connection? I also hate the assistants. It's a useless feature which Google tried to force on everyone. You also can't mirror an image in the image editor.

author: A Google user
content: If you're photos/videos aren't backing up, go to your device settings and search "optimize battery" and switch it off for Photos. Google support won't tell you about this setting, so don't bother asking. They wasted hours of my time suggesting it was a defective device, unrelated to android OS. Also, they need a better way of organizing albums that match up with your device albums.

author: John Moos
content: Loved this app until some recent changes. Photos are always displayed as unedited even after editing/correcting them. I've tried editing them on my phone and online at Google photos, yet they only display as unedited. Also have noted many photos are not syncing. Please fix! *Latest issue - now it won't let me edit photos in my gallery. Keeps saying "Unable to Save". I've tried uninstalling and reinstalling the app. Clearing my cache and data. No luck. This a 5-star app otherwise.

author: Jill H
content: You can no longer make albums, which makes it impossible to find the pictures you want without scrolling for long periods of time. Google now charges you to edit certain aspects of photos, so now I need my Samsung gallery app to screenshot, edit and create/add to an album. It's ridiculous to charge for editing and not be able to separate pictures into albums to easily find the pics desired in a timely manner. I already pay Google for many apps. It's so frustrating. I use to love it now I don't!

author: Anthony Karlin
content: Love it, I highly recommend you get it if you don't have it already. - 5 stars 3/31/17 UPDATE 2 stars 8/24/21 can't believe they got rid of the unlimited storage, that was the biggest point they had going for them... keeping 2 stars because the search is still awesome with being able to put like "blue car" into the search and it knows what photos have blue cars in them, but plesse Google, at least give us more space, and not just 15GB, since that's a lot less than unlimited....

author: Fynn
content: Photo editing is really good for most people, but you'll have to download photos before editing them, even if the photos are still on your phone. The photo organization leaves a lot to be desired. If you only have a few photos, the organization doesn't matter, but when you get into the hundreds or thousands, only organizing by date is extremely frustrating. I wish you could still view locally stored photos in this app. Now you have to download another app to do that.

author: Mr. Folkes
content: It's a great reminder of where I've been and who's been with me asking the way! Set it, forget it, and remember! 4 Stars! --------------------- Things have definitely changed. All of a sudden, we were told that future pictures would no longer be saved unless we subscribe to more drive space at a cost. I strongly resent that change to say the least. I'll leave it at that. 🤨

author: A Google user
content: My favorite photo app until the last update removed the ability to share photos to album. This means that I can't do anymore the two thing below, which to me are essential. 1. I need to have a picture on my phone to add it to an album. Before I was able to add photos that other people have shared with me to an album without the need to downloaded them to my phone and than add them to an album defeating the purpose of having photos in the cloud 2. I can't search or look at my photos and simply select the one that I would like to add them to an album. Now that Google has removed the possibility to share photos to album, the only workaround that I have found is click on each single photo, click on the 3 dots on the top right, select add to album. This is not a sensible. The only way that I have to add more than one photo at a time to an album is to go to the album and click add photo, the problem with this approach is that it just show me all images on my phone in chronological order without the possibility to search or add photos that have been shared with me (it only access the photo on my phone). PLEASE BRING BACK THIS ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONALITY

author: E KS
content: Update is no good, it's very cumbersome. Getting to your albums or collages, etc takes so many clicks and the items are almost hidden & difficult to find. My albums on my previous phone not syncing to new phone(despite my previous albums being selected to sync) , rather it just dumped the photos into the big mix, so now I must hunt for them. Not sure if this is due to update or just a poor feature of the app.

author: Dylan Celius
content: For just generic backups it works great but if you want any sort of photo management, look somewhere else. You can only scroll by month in your main photos tab which is useless when you're trying to work through vacation photos, you can't download images from a shared library directly (you have to save them to your library, then find the photo, then download it), and it's just a pain to download and organize photos into albums. These are fairly basic features - do better Google. I expected more.

author: A Google user
content: It's really annoying to have to swap over to albums to see ALL of my photos because it's decidedly sorted everything based on where the image came from (ie: took a picture vs saved from the net). Needs to have an option that front page lists ALL photos from the start, not make me shift to find where it's decided to save it. Also being able to get rid of the albums it has that are just sitting there empty (movies/collages, etc) would be great too.

author: e bonnet
content: The app is great but i dont like the constant notifications. I dont need any suggestions. Im not interested in posting or getting cards or going public. Stop notifications. I have to change my rating Google made me rely on them for my photos. If I knew I had to pay, I would have never saved years of photos in Google. Now I gotta deal with storage issues. I'm going backwards. Since June 1st, I have LOST PHOTOS! Bait and Switch! Google ????? I changed 4 to 2.

author: Lisa Ricketts
content: They used to be really good but here lately not so much. The books & pictures look good but they're taking so long to print my photobook. I'm going to have to find another way for pictures to get printed. This is #6 photobook & the 2nd one I've had problems with. Gave them another chance but I'm going somewhere else. I ordered my photobook on December 15 and it's going on day 13 of printing. I've tried contacting them but nothing. Google photos has went down hill.

author: A Google user
content: an OK app, but can't do the simple, but very necessary things like renaming a file, what's that all about, no good adding supposedly great things, if it can't do the basics... After more than a years worth of updates, you still can't rename a file from inside the app, I can do that in the most basic of apps but you just can't do it in this one........ Rubbish.

author: michael dender
content: You will now have to pay for use. Use another app that isn't from a company hungry to make breathing a subscription service... Recent updates have made editing photos tedious. Before, you could adjust photo parameters with slider bars all available in one menu. Now you must select each setting (brightness, contrast, highlights etc...) to access the adjustment for each. This adds more clicks to achieve the same result and just wastes time. It's more frustrating than you may think.

author: Sky Surfer
content: Until the 15 August 2025 update this was the most useful photo editor. I'll now be looking for an alternative app. (Unless I can go back to the previous version but that doesn't look likely). You used to be able to crop by moving the 4 crop corners individually. This is useful when you've taken a photo of a reflective image (e.g. photo or screen) with the camera positioned off centre, to avoid getting reflections on the photo. This app used to allow the aspect ratio to be restored.

author: A Google user
content: Repeatedly unable to recognize duplicate photos. The search isnt that great. I searched for bugs and it couldn't show me a picture of a praying mantis I took. It's great for backing up photos for free, but that's about it. As a photos backup, its decent. As a photo gallery, its terrible. For viewing & organizing photos, its terrible. The app has not added any new or useful features in a long time either.

author: Kayla Amboro
content: So, I thought that I can choose the ones I save when it says "these files are taking up space" and it deleted all! I am really mad because there are some memories so yeah... And I'd like to have my photos back if that's possible. I didn't back up my photos soo that is really sad because I really want it back, please add a option where you can choose the one you wanna keep and not delete all...

author: A Google user
content: Let's just say that someone likes to play with editing features, but knows nothing about how that works. the colors are way off. You're using too much color concentration. I don't like that. so far, most of your features are just not up to par with my own ability to edit my own photos, so it's really just crowding my little device so that i must delete things that I'd rather keep. i hope you find a better photo editor.

author: Boaz Sadeh
content: Improved a lot but still does not allow to manage storage easily. It backs up everything but doesn't help you delete the un needed photos (no option to search for photos not in a folder or identify what was backed up and what was manually uploaded). As a result Google decided to remove the unlimited free high quality photo storage. Will have to find another platform soon.

author: A Google user
content: Backing up photos are great, but it bugs out too often! Everytime I move my photos to a different folder, the app will automatically create a duplicate in the original folder! And if I delete the duplicate, it deletes both pictures from the phone. It completely misses the point of "moving" photos. Sometimes the photos don't even load and are just gray squares. Makes everything look unorganized. I wish Pixels came with a regular gallery app.

author: A Google user
content: This app was good but some months ago idk what happened but It made it difficult to upload anything. And when I try to load the pictures on a different account it takes hours for them to load, I literally leave the app open over night and that's not enough to load them. And when I want to upload anything it never uploads, and when it does it doesn't show up on different devices. This app is broken

author: A Google user
content: since July 17, photos aren't syncronyzed in drive anymore. thee problem is that only in drive-One we can organize photos in directories and maintain some archive order... come one, we all know the "albums" aren't just anything useful to do that... I am really disappointed, I just dropped photos and bought gfolio, an app that sync my phone directly with drive.

author: Nic Niven
content: I use to love Google photos, and though I have my photos onto my SD card, Google keeps wanting me to buy space. And it won't let me delete any photos as before. You have to change the settings and then delete...but it's a waste of time to keep change settings back and forth. It use to be easy. And free. Now you must buy space even though my photos are on my SD card. ???😠

author: Tucker FitzGerald
content: I shoot photos of my family vacation on my Android. I go back through, find my favorites, crop them or adjust the lighting or whatever. Now I can only "save as a copy." So I have duplicates. But even worse, the newer, edited photo (i.e. the one I want) is saved to the time I edited it. So it's no longer grouped with those photos when I scroll through pictures.

author: Dash Wilson
content: Had no problems with this app until recently. They changed something about the way search works. Previously if I searched for a word or object, it would narrow it down to a small selection of photos and was extremely accurate, down to a single word on a piece of paper. Now, when I search, for "ID" for example, I get a list of seemingly random photos. It barely narrows down anything at all. Closest I can get is it finding "ID" is inside of other words like "Friday" which is extremely unhelpful.

author: Jim Smythe
content: Has limited photo editing features, missing basic ones like resize. The Lens button is missing on some phones. A few times when I've tried to create a shared album, got error: "Can't share album Try again in a few minutes" It then creates a non shared album with only some of the photos I selected. Has quite limited photo editing - the gallery app (Samsung) on my phone does a better job.

author: A Google user
content: Basic gallery app, connects to the Google drive, however, as soon as you try to start arranging your photos.. First things first, It took me awhile to find the photos not taken directly with the camera, it's device folders or something in the menu. Second, when moving photos from file to file, there's a huge bug. The photos will sometimes still appear to be there, even though they've been moved, and if you delete the old ones, both are gone. Works, but it's buggy and far too product focused.

author: Juliet Cordova
content: Love the convenience of auto-backup to cloud storage but I don't like the flaws. I appreciate that now I can see the details of the Memories photos shown. But I want to have control over ALL the folders that I want backed up. Functionality is minimal at the user end. Y'all ask for ratings but you don't seem to care what customers intuitively want from the app. What happened to being able to go to the photo location of the photos in Memories??? Why is that now unavailable??? Add, don't replace.

author: Danielle Garcia Johnson
content: Almost 3 years later & I think it's total B.S. that we're now limited on amount of storage for our photos, files, apps &emails etc. If you want more storage you have to buy it, either monthly or yearly, can't just use your SD card that has ton of extra storage. Why not? Google makes you buy their storage for things we can store on SD card freely, instead you buy from them at costs I can't afford! VERY FU**ED UP GOOGLE! VERY FU**ED UP!

author: Al Maier
content: It's nice to have backup storage but what sucks is that when I create an album I have to go back and re-"check" all those pictures to Archive them, so they'll be out of sight for creating another album. It's just major eye fatigue to have to look over those pictures again, pick them again and hope you got the right ones out of there for archiving. I was hoping they could create a command that moves them into an album and archives them on the same keystroke

author: Dairy Nebula
content: After all the hype, very disappointed. It's not very good at organising photos the way I want, it seems it has too be the google way. It hides albums on google drive when it should be syncing with my other devices, and will not let me transfer albums to a usb drive. I thought these things were supposed too make your life easier, disappointingly this seems to be the case. Will have to look elsewhere. It's all about buying photos.

author: Edyn Song
content: First, thanks for giving us the option to unstack the photos. But I really dislike how places are in a list now and don't have an option to put it in rows. It's already hard enough to look for places. Now it's like the death scroll. I have asked this before....please give us the option to put "places" in alphabetical orders so it's easier to locate photos by cities or national parks. The auto tag is tagging the wrong people,and there's no option to remove that tag and input the correct person.

author: A Google user
content: Why doesn't this app have the ability to Edit photos?? Like, let me mark on a screenshot a circle or something. I can only edit if I open another app. another thing- when I DOWNLOAD photos, instead of my photo being accessible from Google Photos, where it doesn't show up- I have to go to my Device Downloads folder and somehow move/save the photo in my Google Photos album. Takes too long and not always successful. Getting a screenshot is faster. I don't always want to do that

author: Tora Ayase
content: I'm leaving a low review because of the recent UI update. Immediate thoughts were about the cropping tool, the view when cropping (or editing in general) is much smaller, and I can't see what I'm doing well. The thick curved border also makes it incredibly difficult to tell how my picture will look after I save it. I hate the new super minimalist buttons, they all look the same. everything is in a different place now too. Some things are hidden behind another option. The app was better before.

author: A Google user
content: I like that I'm able to share pics but honestly it's very confusing to me how to add pics from one of my not shared albums to a shared one. Also, I don't see easily how can really manage my pics in "manage your pics" - all there is is a suggestion to remove pics and to back up device folders which I can do in other places too. Three stars less for being not intuitive enough for someone who's bad at organising pics. Like I said sharing function is awesome. Thank you for your time.

author: A Google user
content: I'm not liking the fact that it has to be running the minute I hit the power button on my device..Update ,still have to shut it down by hand still keeps running? If I disable it , it messes up the whole google platform. And other google apps start not working right? 11/23/18 I don't take photos, I don't share photos .. Why is this app always running? This will be the last time I update. Two or three time's in one month! I got better thing's to do... Just your support staff that has never given any feedback at all?????

author: A Google user
content: This app uploads the pictures from your phone by default and makes them only accessible with an internet connection in a much lower quality, because it doesn't find them on your device anymore. First I thought it had even deleted them. If you want to have photos from the cloud offline, you can only download them once at a time which takes hours... I strongly recommend deactivating the default backup feature.

author: A Google user
content: I have LOVED my Pixel image capabilities using this app, but after the newly installed updates I'm now unable to edit and save images! I can edit, but when trying to save, I get an error msg saying "error saving." I have been uninstalling updates in order to edit and save, but all the new capabilities are missing. Please find a fix quick!

author: Brena Patchen
content: PLEASE bring back the perspective crop tool!! As an artist who relies on it for accurate photo editing (as I'm sure many others out there do), this was the single tool I used the most often. It should never have been deleted. I'm now going to have to use a secondary editing tool to address this issue. I honestly could care less about the AI tool options - just please bring back the perspective crop option! Please and thank you!!

author: Don Holley
content: This one's reliable app that I trusted to keep my photos has gone downhill fast! For the last several weeks, it has without my permission, rearranged and relabeled my photos! So at least once a week I have to go back in fix everything! I already sent info 2 weeks ago and you never responded! You take the photos and you put them in a completely different album, that has nothing to do with the subject! Erase the name or remove edit faces,so I can't always fix them! A

author: Jessica Keukelaar
content: Quality changes when you edit photos or share them outside of the app. If I want to "unblur" a photo (which I pay extra to be able to do) it immediately darkens and changes the overall photo. If I share photos to an external app, the same thing happens. I want to see what my photos will look like accurately in the app, not something that looks okay until I want to do something with it. This app just keeps getting worse and worse, honestly.

author: Carlo Alberto Ferraris
content: The builtin editing tools should really be improved (the ones in Snapseed would be a good starting point...). Also, being unable to specify which pictures to stitch together to build panoramas or which pictures have specific people in them is maddening, as the automatic detection does not work reliably. Moreover 4K/60FPS video can't be edited (it hangs forever on the "saving video..." modal). Soon it will also not be a free service, so the value proposition of photos will decrease further.

author: Lukasz Tracewski
content: The UX deteriorated in recent years. The memories produced by the app are very good, but ruined by the fact that photos scroll automatically and there is no way to turn it off (except for individual images). Also, the photos zoom slightly when the memory is played, and I really don't want that. I understand the app is made for people with an attention span of a fruitfly, but please let others disable the automated movement / switching. Thanks!

author: Jonathan Fulton
content: This will make it really easy to backup ALL your photos, including the bad ones that you'd really rather delete. Then it will fill up your available free storage and will want to sell you more. All while making it ridiculously obtuse to find and remove them from storage. I felt railroaded into paying for more space, but eventually was able to clear up our accounts so that we could at least use email. I won't be using it for backup.

author: Juan B
content: Have enjoyed this app in the past. It's got great features but is still buggy. I am paying for storage on 2 separate accounts. However, when I upload photos using my PC it takes days, sometimes weeks to note that they have been uploaded before freeing up space on my phone. I have emailed support a number of times but no reply.

author: Logan Cook
content: So I spent 30 minutes to make a movie. Picking through pictures and videos. Just cause I wanted to make a better version of "they grow up so fast" of my son because Googles a.i picks the worst photos/videos. Well I hit create and it says "can only pick pictures and videos" and cancels everything. I spent so long going through my thousands of pictures and it didn't even attempt to make a draft?! It's not like I can save the selections I made either. Super frustrating.

author: A Google user
content: I'm really upset that multiple photos I have are being slowly destroyed and no matter what I try eventually the photo is completely blank and so is the back up and anywhere else I have it if it is connected to my account which is the only way to transfer them they have to come into contact with account data. It takes weeks/ months to completely eat the photo, too. plenty of time to mourn another baby photo I'll never have again. Some have a double exposure effect instead, though. still annoying!

author: A Google user
content: As a gallery, this app is pretty poor. For a start, the photos stream contains everything. We should be able to hide files as organised folders, not just dump everything into another stream called archive. You also cannot use commands like archive when viewing a device folder, nor can you organise the main photo stream by folder or any other criteria.

author: A Google user
content: For whatever reason, there is one photo that just will not get added into a Shared Album even though though I get a notification that it has. And when I select a photo to add, this one photo is not selected as being added to the album. This has been happening since Friday and it's just this one photo that I'm having a problem with and it's one that I took on my phone.

author: Jatin Kumar
content: I am experiencing a lot of loading issues and bugs. Bug 1 : it is counting screenshots and camera pictures in the same folder. Bug 2 : it won't delete the picture which is being backed up. The processing time is endless Bug 3 : loading time when delete/backup is in progress. After switching from previous mobile, I thought transition wont take much time. It's been a week now, Google photos hasn't improved a bit.

author: Jodi Bonner
content: The frequency with which the app removes photos from my phone makes it difficult to share my beloved photos. And when the photos don't disappear, older photos won't show up when I'm trying to share them. Overall, it a very poor photo storage app. It does nothing for me and I wish my phone allowed me to remove it so I could access my photos properly.

author: Facundo Castro
content: There's two big flaws in this app: 1) There's no way to see only your unsorted photos (i.e., photos that are not in any album). That makes the app pretty much useless for sorting photos, since I have several years worth of photos to organise and now way to check if they're already anywhere. 2) The migration to Google Drive (where I decided to sort my photos instead) is clunky - dragging and dropping doesn't work so I'm having to download my photos to move them.

author: Brooke Miller
content: Doesn't always seem to offer the same thing. I like consistency. The selection of photos vary and I've somehow got it looked to 3 email addresses.... I'm going to say with the help of Google's suggestions ..... My favorite thing is the color pop and I can't select the picture I want or do it when I want. Google photos decides.... Don't like it

author: Will Butler
content: Google photos used to be the best photos app hands down. I can still remember years ago when auto awesome used to make me auto movies out of my videos and pictures, sometimes multiple times a day. They were great and my friends always wanted to know what Google had made this time. But then something happened and no more auto awesome. I'm lucky to get 1 movie every six months now. Google has ruined this app one update at a time. What a shame!! Many other issues not enough space to mention.

author: Kitty Rose
content: The photo search format is HIDEOUS. I hate having the search bar floating in the middle of the screen, and I don't care if you can move it, I just don't see why it can't be a regular, stationary search bar. I have also done searches for photos/videos with zero previous deletions within the app, and now with this more recent version, the results are absolutely *gutted* compared to what I would get before. Sometimes, simple IS best, and you shouldn't try to fix what wasn't broken.

author: A Google user
content: There is something wrong with this app, although I have set it to upload original pic, sometimes it compress them and it happens very randomly. I have lots of extra space which i pay for it monthly. Except that everything is perfect, although I wish I could browse my photos according to where they are taken.

author: Amy Strickland
content: Every time I understand how to navigate this app they completely change everything. I can never find the photos I want whenever they change things. I have been searching for 20 minutes and I cannot find the people section where I can search by people I have spent time tagging and sorting into albums. Search doesn't pull up anything anymore. It's garbage. They need to stop changing everything dramatically every 5 minutes to justify their salaries.

author: palesa
content: Hi! I had an issue just a few minutes ago. I was using your app for backing up some of my pictures and I got a notification station that I could 'free up 3,0 G(its not the exact number) of space'. I clicked the button and it didnt give me any consent about what's its deleting. Photos deleted almost all of my camera pictures, some of my videos and my downloads. Does it normally do this or is this just a bug? If not, in your next update could you add a consent pop-up. Thanks Google Photos!

author: Russ T
content: Meh. I thought these guys were smart. You can't lock the app or mark certain albums private. You can't store photos separately from your phone and the back-up cloud. Backed-up photos must exist on your phone and on the Google photo desktop app. There is no way to "gallery" photos that you want to save but not be on your phone. One must download photos to another location. This is Google, their tools should be able to do more. Overall, a huge disappoint.

author: A Google user
content: I enjoy photography and I find elements of photos disappointing - especially for someone using multiple operating systems (2x windows desktops, macbook air and Android phone). photos (on phone) comes with excellent options for sharing, especially if you have the great value google drive for storage (100gb acct). The editing is basic but working with a chromecast and my Samsung TV to share albums is also easy and a definite bonus. the movie editing is easy but glitchy - not fixed since 2018!!!

author: Shaun Inguanzo
content: Tries to push paid/premium options such as run of the mill filters which I can use free of charge with Samsung Gallery. Photos also never quite seem to visually organise themselves well, and the weird 'suggestions' for photo effects that the app pushes add little to no value, only serving to infuriate the user. Apple's Photo app treats the photo experience as a complete and premium experience requiring no further purchase to enjoy basic features.

author: Jeff Love
content: Can't find photos to review for premium print. Searched help, no help. Still followed help and can't edit or find what pictures were automatically picked. So couldn't substitute any. Disappointed I couldn't figure this out. Update, same thing happened again , once again couldn't find or sub auto picked pictures through application. Fix this by cancelling Premium Prints. Did not find any articles in help or forums address this problem. No resolution, had to cancel.

author: A A
content: Why do things you do in the Google Photos app not show up on the desktop version? Why can i not see a lot of the photos i have uploaded to an album when using the app, yet can see them on my computer Google Photos? Why do album name changes not sync between desktop and app? Why when i upload a video to Google Docs on desktop, i cant find the video on the app? Would be great if it didnt have all of these problems. Remains unresolved issue since April 2019

author: Jordan Krumbach
content: I did not like this app for a while due to the fact I unfortunately have, on numerous occasions, lost all of my photos due to an improper backing up and/or were not loaded on my account correctly, when I'm for sure they were there. It wasnt until after i started being interested in phone settings etc until I learned how to ensure my photos were actually on my photos account and not just being shown to me (alike a gallery) via Google photos.

author: Dolores Cobb Phifer
content: I give this app a low number because I can rarely find photos to add to a post because of the way they show up. It seems to rotate by month rather than year & month. I just Bluetoothed a photo from my old phone and instead of being current, it is somewhere in Google Photo Land. This needs to reflect what you are working on and not some chaotic reason or the lack of reason. Or, do you enjoy screwing with people?

author: Cat
content: Two major problems with this app: If I try to add descriptions/captions for my photos, the app constantly deletes or rearranges them so that whatever I wrote is all mixed up and assigned to the wrong photo. It's a nightmare. On top of that, it often refuses to let me add photos to my albums. To fix both of these problems, I have to use the desktop site instead. So annoying.

author: Raymond Dunne
content: I don't like the backup persistence and the editor is pretty much useless to me. I set it to leave my photos alone but it insists on doing what it wants regardless of my settings and the editor has lots of frills for people who think they're unicorns but nothing that's useful to me. I can't adjust the size of the pen nor where the text is placed on a photo I want to edit. I don't use effects or any of that junk. I like to keep the photos real but add my own comments and mark ups.

author: A Google user
content: Two main grudges at present. With thousands of photos it is virtually impossible to organise them without extremely tedious efforts. No way to select photos that are NOT in any album, so you are left with lots of "orphans" - very frustrating. Secondly, and related, is the lack of a two or more tier structure to store albums. You end up with either countless smaller albums, or fewer albums with countless photos in each. Not good :-{ However, there are many great features overall, granted :-)

author: Tanya Doyle
content: Google photos is saying it is "setting up my photo library..." and it keeps throwing me out. This message also keeps appearing on my screen... "Photos" failed to start several times. Restore it by clearing its history? I pay for extra storage and have plenty of room left. I just updated the app but this started before that. I am horrified at the thought of losing my photos. Please help!!!

author: Y Primrose
content: This app used to be good, but like it seems like with Google apps, the updates being made are for a few, but are creating issues for the masses. Every update throughout this year causes pictures (entire folders) of them to disappear. I am so glad majority of my pictures are safe on my SD Card (never configured it to the phone). If I didn't do that everything would be gone. Once again this last update deleted a supposedly locked folder. I want be doing any updates because of the missing info.

author: Gail
content: Wish I hadn't installed the update. New editing feels like a step backwards. Some of my most-used tools are now gone, like the ability to freeform crop a photo that is a distorted rectangle. As an artist, I want to control my edits, not have AI decide for me. Google Photos editing features used to be a great tool for me but no longer. Very disappointing.

author: Azad Ahmed
content: Please try to understand what I'm gonna write, at first the archive folder was at left corner upside but now when u open the app you will see the folder just in front. It's really insecure, we have private photos we have to hide those. But if someone somehow open the app they are also gonna open archive folder. It's really risky.. please do something 🙏 at least provide a security password system to open the folder.

author: A Google user
content: There is currently no "move to album" button. I don't like any of the views daily or comfortable or otherwise. The default sharing of photos is through Google contacts not messaging and it has not been made clear if that's a changeable preference. I don't like feeling that all of my photos are always online instead of only on my device.

author: Martin Nygren
content: Many photos are grouped incorrectly, and you can not correct them. Either because it doesn't give you the option to change it, or because it's unable to save the changes ("unable to edit, check connection"). Applies to both app and browser. It auto-overwrites face tags which I have added myself, with incorrect ones. Not suggesting. No option to manually add undetected faces. No easy bulk tagging. Can't see what's done by AI/manually. Reply: Article is incorrect; not able to remove from group.

author: A Google user
content: The latest version of Photos has been disappointing. Changing the way you share photos with friends and family is not intuitive. It is really slow and unreliable. Before it was easy to see the new animated photos or automatically tweaked, now they are tucked away in a highlight reel. Please roll back to the former cards style

author: A Google user
content: I love Google photos, but my only big problem is album sharing. There's no "remove person from sharef album" feature, so if I share something with one person, the spread could be detrimental. I recommend adding that, and the ability to fully duplicate shared albums, instead of doing it 500 at a time.

author: Yair Assia
content: This app used to be great. I liked the organization and the ability to watch memories this it piles up for you. The last update is trash ! Suddenly photos are not in the dates I took them and it's really buggy. Another thing in mind is cloud. Although it's not expensive, I don't want to spend money to back up my photos. It keeps forcing me to back them up because I'm out of memory, and it really annoying. Overall just not good

author: Linda Arencibia
content: The app seems to store my photos arbitrarily and randomly.. This makes them hard to find on both my phone and those which have been sent here. And the fact that photos are stored randomly and automatically is a real nuisance. Again, is not easy to find my photos because of this. And every photo taken appears here. There should be better means for individuals to edit and catalogue what is here.

author: Durga Sindhuja
content: It is a good app to make collection of photos. But i hate it when it automatically log out from my google account and login. And i won't get half of my photos back. I have to switch off and on, and have to load for many times to get all my photos please see about it.🙁🙁. It automatically back-up but nearly half of my photos are getting missed. Why??? Please look into it.

author: Ilyas Mirobdalov
content: In the details of the photo this app doesn't display the albums that contain it, unlike the browser version, making managment much harder. When adding a photo to an album, albums are noy displayed alphabetically even if the option is checked on the browser version, thus you have to search for an album, among possibly many every time Adding to album as well takes a lot of time in waiting, seemingly at random, no matter how few or many photos you are adding at once.

author: Dr. Nugroho
content: 1. Why don't you put search button at the top of the screen, like all other Google apps?.Why make an exception. It's counter intuitive. 2. Sort the album. It's difficult to choose if you have a lot of albums. 3. Let people know which picture goes into what album. This info is available in browser, not in the app. Please add a simple photo organizer feature, i.e. to move the physical files in one album to other folder. This will help a lot for backup. Thanks 🙏 ...

author: Lou Weisenbacher
content: The latest update has RUINED Google Photos. You simplified it TOO MUCH. It used to be easy and simple to navigate and find albums, etc. Now it is more difficult since you "simplified" the app. Really bummed about this. It is one of my most used apps. I share albums with my family all of the time, now they are hard to find and use. Please DO NOT change the desktop version, it still works great!

author: Dylan Cag
content: Why can't I store albums in folders. It takes forever to find anything. Hate this! I have to scroll through endless albums. Takes forever. Totally not practical on the job. Major pain. As soon as I find a photo app that allows me to organize my photos into folders I am switching!!!! (Let me know if you have a suggestion!* TY)

author: HairFreek Barbers
content: This app is upsetting. For some reason I cannot view recent photos right away. I have to use my Samsung Galery to finish projects. The editing options are nice but good luck trying to save your changes. Out of five pictures I edited, only one actually saved. I tried to save one picture several times and eventually had to screen shot it and use Samsung Galery to finish my work since the screen shot won't load to Google Photos for several hours.

author: Mike Sudz
content: I use Google photos as a backup for the gallery pics on my phone. I like the animations and rediscovering pics from a year ago. Very cool app. Edit 10/24 -Google photos received a "revamp", and if the purpose was to take steps back, make it a lot more difficult to find pictures, they nailed it. Honestly, why screw with a product no one has a problem with. You Google people are too "smart" for your own good. It's a back up app now.

author: Isabella
content: It's a general photo app, so its fine, but I absolutely cannot stand not having all my photos (screenshots, saved images, actual photos, photos from other apps, etc) in the same place. You get a feed of pictures you've taken and you can access side albums for everything else, I just hate that lol personal peeve but please make an option available to have a combined front page

author: Matthew Smith
content: Used to be a great app. But it won't be a more because backing up your photos for free is being taken away. The editing software is great though. I wish it didn't take up so much space on my phone. The need to change it to where the thumbnails aren't ever saved on the phone. Or they need to make it so the cache automatically is deleted once the app is closed. I am also only giving them only two stars because they are getting rid of free storage.

author: Debbie H.
content: UPDATE: Found out you can Search "Recently Added" to find pics recently uploaded regardless of the date of the photo. But app is still AWFUL. The limited Sort "options" for the Albums is beyond frustrating, and the "disconnect" between Albums and Library. It doesn't allow you to delete a photo when looking through an Album. Can only "REMOVE FROM ALBUM"!! Then you have to go find the pic in Library and Delete it from there?!? One of the huge reasons why my storage is so full!

author: A Google user
content: So annoying. Backed up a bunch of pics, and 'removed pics older than' that were already backed up, but at a lower resolution without being very clear about it. Cant download images back onto device in batches easily, you have to manually select all. Then it complains that you cant download more than 500 at a time. I'd expect better from Google.

author: udayaditya barua
content: This app is good but it is dangerous to store private photos. Everything is searchable from everywhere. Archive doesn't mean anything other than not showing up in the home page otherwise it is searchable, categorised everything. Anybody who gets your phone, has access to every damn photo whether it's archived or what. While adding a photo to an album you might accidentally add it to another album because it shows the last used in the list. That optimization isn't necessary.

author: Ortwin Van der Stappen
content: If you wanna sync photos, it does the trick. Any photo management, search, or albums have severely lacking features. An example is not being able to see photos not in an album. The albums also don't carry over from your native gallery if you're an Android user. There are also no filtering options for photos in an album (video/ photo, multi albums...) Just not enough features for managing your precious memories.

author: Thallium
content: This is the default photo app on my Pixel phone, and I've hated it since the beginning. I feel like it keeps finding new ways to aggravate me. All I need to be able to do with it is organize, and occasionally edit photos - but that alone is somehow a struggle. It hides the 'folders' function, tries to sort my camera photos for me, and centers the entire experience around a dozen features I don't want to use. The way backup storage works makes it way too easy to accidentally delete photos, etc.

author: Eugene Vorontsov
content: The only reason to use it is unlimited space for backups for "free" (Google collects the photos for research and product development). Otherwise, the interface is garbage and operations (delete, add to album, etc.) are glacially slow (minutes to tens of minutes) when applied to many images at a time. Very, very buggy. Image order randomly changes while browsing. Can't add more than 500 photos to album at a time; must select the 500 manually, one by one. Shared albums visible to anyone with link.

author: Jason Elias Turner
content: stores pictures, some mine some not smh idk but hackers are able to easily get in this app along with other apps, they love the android face with blue background. I recommend check system apps before putting anything you don't want ppl seeing. not secure at all. they've even planted pictures in my photos. if it's not secure it shouldn't say it is. it's uncomfortable knowing that ppls getting into my personal apps and able to access settings, photos, and erase, and steal photos.

author: A Google user
content: This app was perfect when it had the option to only sync while charging. Whenever I'm reaching a Wi-Fi my phone battery will just die in minutes, as it struggles to upload. And switching the sync on and off everytime I'm low on battery seems inappropriate, given that the option was there in previous versions. Google Team, please take care of this somehow, otherwise my rating is going to stay on 2 stars only.

author: Aya Ravensong
content: Don't really understand why I'm not able to pick the order and placement for photos in collages and animations. Sort of defeats the purpose if they all go in there randomly and cropped terribly. You also can't adjust the size of the boxes when printing photo books. It's very frustrating. Other than that, it's not awful. But I don't understand how none of the developers has realized that this is stupid by now. You can do that with literally any rinky dink photo app on here. Why not Google photos?

author: Kim Hayes
content: I use Google photos to back up the photos on my phone. My new phone doesn't have an SD slot, so the internal storage filled up pretty quickly with the number of photos I had. I backed them up to Google Photos and then used the free up space utility, only to discover that Google Photos doesn't save them into the albums I had them sorted into. YEARS of photos, disorganized in a matter of minutes, with no way to undo it. Thanks a lot, Google.

author: Rebecca Swafford
content: Edit: The June 2020 update is terrible. The functionality is all over the place, all the buttons moved around. It makes no logical sense. User friendly, photo search is awesome, and the photo backup is reliable. Only thing-- I wish it was easier to make albums/move photos around/label dates after they're uploaded.

author: Faith Neff
content: To be honest, I had JUST purchased extended storage, having barely used it, and started getting CONTINUOUS notifications that I can "pay for more storage". Good grief, at least wait until I have used maybe 80% of my storage instead of 18% (this number is about a month later) before you try to push me to purchase more. The pushing began within a couple of hours of my purchase.

author: Jen M.
content: This app is good if you don't have a lot of photos. if you do have a lot of photos it will charge you quite a bit. every month it wants $9.99. that doesn't seem like a lot at first but it all adds up. for your own pictures... for an iCloud storage. where the pictures could just disappear? as many of mine have! so it's questionable... at best! they definitely need to make more adjustments and safeguard your photos better than what they do. it is something we pay for so it should be a good service

author: Steve Procter
content: I love the memories it creates, but please make it so we don't have to back up videos too, especially now we have to pay to back up our photos :( As it stands the App will back up every photo and Video, but the videos take up too much space and to be honest, it's mainly photos I think most people want to back up. It would be beneficial to users if we could select Images only in the back up options. I hope that makes it clearer? Thanks for listening :)

author: A Google user
content: Doesn't back up the album's you meticulously keep organized on your gallery, over many years, and when you go to archive to "save space on device" it loses all organization. it also seems to forget folders your previously set to back up and sync, and often can't see the folders which are in the same location as the other folders. Giving 2 stars because the search functionally beats gallery, but that's Google's job - searching.

author: Daniel Hubbell
content: Every update to Google photos reeks of feature creep. New add ons like a mandatory pop up to fix lighting on every picture, or automatic adjustments that often make low light pictures look worse come to mind. As does folder sorting among others. Can't say I'm a fan of the app. Or that I would use it if it wasn't impossible to remove.

author: A Google user
content: I love it in some ways but when it comes to easy access to photos through other applications, such as photobox or similar, to actually get at photos for prints etc. It is an absolute nightmare, simply awful. Whether this is from Google Photos end or the developers of the other sites and apps I do not know but it was horrendous for our wedding pictures which we purchased as a digital download choosing Google Photos to store.

author: Ivan Maduka
content: After research, I put a .nomedia file in my exclude folder and it worked for the Samsung Gallery app, but not the Photos app. Fair, but not what I wanted. Another issue is that other apps can't read the folder either. Album covers? Missing now. I wish there was a simple way to hide/exclude folders like you can hide albums on the Samsung Gallery app.

author: Anthony Huang
content: Something broke with the photo album syncing on the app out of the blue. Tried clearing the cache, data, reinstall, made sure it was the right account, had enough space, and all the troubleshooting steps. But still, the collection/albums (my own and those shared with me) are gone from the app. No problem on the web browser version.

author: A Google user
content: Sometimes it's hard to find some options. Freeing up space not always works, as sometimes the pictures get unsynchronized, so the app does not delete the picture from your mobile but if you delete the picture manually from your gallery, it gets deleted even from the cloud. Adding pictures to albums does not work sometimes (have to do it from browser), some of the albums with pictures were empty when seeing from browser. Choosing pictures to google maps contributuons often results in error.

author: A Google user
content: It is much more complicated to download photos and videos to my PC than the one on my last Nokia. I can't see the benefit of using a small screen to edit photos and I don't want a phone camera app modifying my photos willy nilly, Why can't you keep things simple rather than feeling the need to be innovative where it is not necessary? I want to have complete autonomy of how my photos are enhanced (or not enhanced).

author: A Google user
content: Im fine with this app but I wish that they had some more options even it came to the photos. I want to switch everything over to Google photos but I can't because my camera can do more things to my photos. But my camera takes up a lot of space. So if your a photographer or a person who likes nice photos with filters Google photos isnt for you. Plus they have 0 storage. And if you want more space you have to buy some. Which I think is really dumb.

author: Michelle
content: Anyone else having trouble with their storage on GP? Mine was getting full so I've been going through deleting ones I didn't want to keep...everytime after I do that my storage rate decreases a lot?? Seems like it increase. This morning when I went to work on deleting more my pictures are all out of order...not even on the right dates in the folders. Anyone else had issues like this? I even restarted my phone thinking it was a glitch. 🤷🏼‍♀️

author: A Google user
content: Again I had to reload the app to do updates just to discover that the last hours of updates have been erased, that the folders i had created had been deleted and that hundreds of photo are now duplicated (a vast majority of my pictures are now doubled). The app would be great even with less options if the options presented were working correctly. it's nice to have an app that tries to photoshop your pictures for you, a lot less if that means redoing all the work every few months!!

author: Dmitri Aletkine
content: No longer unlimited and has trouble following my instructions. I only wanted to sync camera, not random folders, so I made sure to uncheck the folders in settings. Photos followed my desires for most folders, but ignored my settings for screenshots folders, so it kept saving random things. Deleting them from photos forces deletion from phone too, so that's unacceptable. Also, when I changed setting to not sync device, it just kept syncing. Final nail in the coffin was becoming not unlimited.

author: Brad Harrell
content: I get really frustrated with the "People" section. It automatically tags a face and it will add some or even most photos with that person in it, but not all of them and there is no option to manually tag the pictures in question to add them to that person's "album." Also, if the app misidentifies a face and you don't know that you can "add a new person," and you simply remove them from results, that photo is apparently no longer available to be tagged. I have other issues as well.

author: A Google user
content: Pretty good but lacks some very basic features. For example collage does not allow user to reorder/place photos ourselves, the same is true for animations. they can only be made from photos in the order they exist in the gallery, cannot reorder or even adjust photo framing, crop or resize. Creates animations from videos for you... but does not allow you to choose which videos animations are made from 😒

author: twistyoz (twisty)
content: This was an awesome app before the latest UI update. I've reduced my rating from 5 to 2 as a result. Not only is it a little harder to find things, when you go into a gallery such as pictures grouped by people, if you view a photo, clicking back takes you to the main page again. The same problem occurs if you search for objects (e.g. mountains)-- If you look at one of the pictures, clicking back will take you to the main page rather than the search results page

author: A Google user
content: This app is not at all user friendly! I had over a thousand photos, painstakingly organized into Albums. My phone died and this new phone uses Google Photos. I transferred all my photos. Instantly it arranged them by date! Aaaaggghhh! Years worth of work lost! POS program! Now I can't find anything! Then that phone had an issue and when I redownload my pictures, they suddenly can't find my pictures! I have seven pictures now. I should NEVER have trusted them with my pictures.

author: Karla Romany
content: The last update has left me unable to scroll through my photos. The app keeps closing itself. I emptied ALL photos and videos from the app, in a bid to troubleshoot the issue. This has not worked. I took 6 photos as a test. I still cannot navigate through the app. I take a lot of photos for my business. I love Google photos but my goodness, please please I am begging you...FIX IT!! In the meantime I will be uninstalling all recent updates...let's see what happens Thanks in advance

author: A Google user
content: I love this app, it is the best app for images, and it does really good at backing up your photos. Enough positives. Why is it that everytime I download a photo from the computer it says "It can't download, device storage is full" It's not full obvi! And I try to share it, it says "We could not process your video/photo" Like, what?! So then I uninstall it, reinstall it, still isn't processed, click the edit button, still says it's full, do the same again, and it gets so annoying! Like, why?!

author: Lou
content: It helps in freeing up some space, although it'd be nice if it was still in the same folder placed in the phone. It'll be hard to find certain photos when they aren't in the folders I placed them in and It'll be nice if the folder and the pictures were backed up and not just the pictures, for organization purposes :)

author: Cheryl Wood
content: Since the update the editing tool is a problem. The magic eraser used to be a really handy tool but now it's nearly impossible to get it to work, constantly tells me to connect to the internet for better results when I already am. You circle or paint out an object and it doesn't hold and just reappears. Have started using another editing app. Don't fix it if it ain't broke as they say.

author: Nabaasa Elder
content: I used to love the app, but they keep changing it too much. It's more complicated now, in my opinion. I don't want to go through three menus to get where I need to be. Plus, it barely uploads my photos anymore. Just keeps giving me a loading bar and icon on pictures even after going in manually.

author: A Google user
content: I'm still not happy with how Google stores and organizes my photos. It's visually wrong and doesn't match anything else I store on Google. When I use gmail, drive or maps I feel like it's pretty intuituve and my information is THERE. I don't question it. When I try to use Google Photos I waste too much time going back & forth between accounts verifying that its really THERE.

author: Iz Zorro
content: Not a good photo manager app, it has a lot of problems 1. Uploading and back up takes a lot of time 2. Not easy to navigate through. 3. Hard to organize your photos. 4. It keeps crashing whenever I press the download photo button or viewing old photos. The good thing is its very spacious and you can open it on your computer.

author: Thiago Medeiros
