content: It has been a fantastic and vital product for over a decade, but backup inconsistencies are keeping me from depending on it. My library is pretty extensive, and since last year my device keeps hanging on "preparing to backup", and never syncs. It is a very well known bug, one can tell just by googling, and it just doesn't get fixed. I have a paid Google One 1tb subscription, plenty of cloud storage space, but it still won't backup. It's heartbreaking, but I may be moving to a different platform

author: Alena Perez
content: I have used Google photos for the longest time and loved it until recently. Photos are now difficult to locate, archived photos often pop back up in the main location, and other archived photos are missing. It's horribly messy now and sharing and organizing is no longer simple. That paired with the changes in payment plans, I've decided the best choice is to move off of Google photos as my main photo storage. It's a shame, but dealing with Google photos right now is quite frustrating.

author: A Google user
content: It'd be great if it didn't remove photos from my device for no discernable reason, to only be accessible from the (thankfully) in-app cloud storage. I have no idea how it's decided which photos go, but you don't get to choose and there's no way to undo en masse. You'd have to go through each individual photo to see where it's stored, and download it again. Ridiculous. I didn't download photos so I could be denied them when outside of wifi. Very frustrating "feature".

author: Keith David M. Opulencia
content: I've been experiencing a lot of issues with this app. First, adding photos to an already-existing album is so hard, since most of the time, it doesn't work; it just flat out don't add it. Second, creating a new album is also hard, since it doesn't load it—it keeps saying, "couldn't load album". I hope Google addresses these issues because this app is a godsend; it frees up a ton of space on your phone for free, and I hate seeing its potential be wasted with it being unconcerned of its issues ♡

author: Zoila Rodriguez
content: I love using the assistant to create interesting photos and collages. My only complaint with this app is the inability to edit collages like switch pictures around or move them inside the frame. It's also a little creepy at how well it finds pictures of people in all my photos. I can search for a contract and all the pictures with their face show up. It's scary good. Update 5/12/2021: downgrading app to 2 stars because it keeps crashing. The navigation is worse in the new update.

author: A Google user
content: Not sure why but my Snapseed folder seemingly has only one photo, despite the fact that I've been using the app for over a year and adding new photos to the folder almost every week. I still have the photos but they're scattered all over my gallery, sorted by chronological order, and there are so many photos I don't even know which ones I did edit with Snapseed and which ones I didn't, so I had to make a temporary folder for the photos I might have used Snapseed to edit, would be great if it returned to the way it was about a month or so ago instead of the absolute mess that is my gallery right now

author: Courtney Cooper
content: It's really frustrating that the app doesnt allow you to set a custom schedule for backup. If it did, i could go through the photos I've taken that day and delete the ones I dont want. at the moment, every photo I've taken is uploaded, before I've had a chance to see if its something worth keeping. its annoying have to directly delete from both my phone and Google photos itself. it's extra work that could be easily eliminated.

author: A Google user
content: The app was great and super useful but just now I was backing up some pictures and videos and after I used the "free up space" option, ALL of my videos and pics that I had just backed up got deleted! The videos said "video not found, I closed the app and when I opened it again everything was completely gone. Now I'm not sure I want to use this app anymore

author: Michael Gray
content: I have had some bugs where I can not free up space on my phone and there keeps showing records out of sync, then I have a bunch of large older video it will not let me upload from my Android. it just feels so buggy these days, I am considering switching to Amazon. I only use it for storage and hardly make albums, and the basic functionality is becoming frustrating. I am a product manager, so I know these are fixable, but I wish I could talk to someone about it. possible?

author: Lalit Vatsal
content: It deteriorates the video quality to the extent that they are not even usable. I relied on the compression and cleared my phone's memory but then realized it was a bad decision. That said, I like photos experience overall. Only one suggestion, please notify when video quality is getting deteriorated and let us keep those files on device.

author: — bruh.
content: I've had some problems with this app. Firstly, there are some out-of-sync photos, and my phone and laptop show completely different things, they aren't synchronized. Beside, even if I share my album to another account, I noticed tha not all of the pics were saved, but I can't check it, once my first account show all of the photos from my gallery, however, my laptop have only the photos I've saved. I don't know how to transfer my photos anymore.

author: Elizabeth Wig
content: On opening the app, I'm faced with pop-ups that are prompting me to delete photos to free up storage space, then to turn on backup (to fill up storage space?) and have to turn down both every time I want to use it. Then the albums that have been shared with me are in a hidden corner of the app. Then the album I was looking for, which appears under my account on my computer, where I have joined the shared album, is nowhere to be found on the app. So much hassle for an app that doesn't even work.

author: Tracy Green
content: I've loved this app/cloud for as long as I can remember, but now, during the past few days, anytime I try to look at the details of a specific photo, it says "An error occurred during the installation of Photos. Please uninstall the app and then install it again". I've done this. I've, also, rebooted my phone several times. I'm not able to redownload a photo to my device that was once saved to the Google Photos cloud. I can't view any of its details. I keep getting the error. Please help.

author: Pete St. Martin
content: Google did a great job of convincing their users that they didn't need to worry about storage over the last decade with Gmail, Drive, and Photos. They even removed the 100 free gb they gave me (different account) as a promotion from a few years back. I like this app. It's a good way to store and share photos. I occasionally make photobooks. The photobooks are very bare bones. I mostly continue to use this app out of convenience. I am not convinced that they won't end up screwing me later on.

author: Markus Mouse
content: The new set up for the collections feels unnecessary. There are so many extra folders added. It took me a week to find my screenshots. The folder for screenshots brought me to photos that weren't even my screenshots. I had to click another button labeled screenshots within the folder to find them. Also photos I save from anywhere like messages or screenshots go into my main photos. It is now unorganized and messy. Very disappointed in the update. Don't fix what's not broken. It was fine before.

author: A Google user
content: The app itself has lots of great features and is fairly intuitive to use. The problem is that it automatically deletes photos from my phone after it backs them up online. This removes them from any folders I've organized them into and prevents me from sending them to people. Tere seems to be no way to stop this feature. I have tried looking in app settings, in my phone settings, and turning off the 'backup and sync'. The app needs a simple option to not delete photos without explicit permission.

author: Katie H.
content: I'm glad to see I'm not the only one with a 'keep closing' situation on Chromebook. It's been like this for several months now. It works occasionally, then another update happens and it breaks again. I'm using the web version instead, which isn't ideal. Please fix this incompatability issue! I've reported the issue multiple times.

author: Danu Ureche
content: I don't have all my phtotos in one place, I have to go through a lot of folders to find them Even worse, I cannot edit my date and time locally, I have to back up the photos, why? These are my photos and it's my choice to upload them or not. Some settings are very unintuitive, and a lot of pop ups with memories folders etc etc, to make you more involved, but I don't want to, yes you can turn them off but the settings are the worst that I ever seen, almost every button opens a new tab in browser

author: Sandra Turner
content: I do not like the changes they are making. It has only complicated the app. Ok, today is 6/30/21, and I have been having nothing but trouble with this app. I have almost always really liked everything from google, but over theast week, week and a half maybe, every time I open google photos and try to do anything with my photos or my photos in my archive, the dang thing 'stops working', and closes down! Every time! I close it and then reopen it and try again, after about 3 tries, I give up.

author: Emily Tomaka
content: The latest update is very frustrating. I can no longer access photos I've shared with others or that they've shared with me, that aren't in an album (conversations). They've also made it a lot more difficult to access the shared albums. Also, please stop forcing people to backup photos if they don't want to. I'm working on a family collaborative project and sharing photos on an album and you would've thought I was asking some people to pull their own teeth due to updates that have been made.

author: tanya koehler
content: It's nice place to store photos. Use to have a great video maker, but they have down graded it. Can't choose the music or put a title on it like you use to be able to do. But now it deletes videos/slide shows that you try to create. So you definitely can't use it as and video editor! Very disappointed, expescially because I spent 30mins putting a video together, go to save it, It spins for 5mins and then they just deleted it!

author: Daniel J. Colby
content: I have lots of issues in apps adding photos that Google Photos have archived. Once a photo is archived I can't seem to add the photos back to things from my library. I try to send a picture I took a year before in Facebook Messenger or send a pic in a text and it looks like it will add it and then nothing. Usually I just give up. I also want a way to make the "buy photo books" less invasive. By the way, I will never buy copies of photos that I shoot as most are informational.

author: Charlotte Cowley
content: Edit 19/10/20: I have upgrade to the Pixel 5 with Android 11 and the app has gone awful! It crashes all the time and it cannot take multiple photos in quick succession. Unfortunately bthebrating has had to drop from 5* to 2*. Please read these comments and fix the glitches!! Photo quality is amazing! I love how it suggests edits, animations and albums. It recognises things which makes searches a bazillion times easier... It's just awesome!

author: A Google user
content: Everytime I move photos from the downloads folder to a new folder, the new folder disappears after a while. The photos don't go to the trash or back to downloads folder, they're just gone. I tried checking the option to back up the folder to see if that would keep it safe multiple times; didn't work. Checked online to try to find a solution and saw I'm not the only one and support didn't provide a solution. Please do something about it.

author: Allison Cappelli
content: Very buggy. I tried to "free up space" but the button just wouldn't do anything. After updating and restarting didn't fix it, I cleared all the app data. It took most of a day for it to reload everything, but finally the free up space worked. Unfortunately since then, the memories are not showing up. There is a large blank spot in the UI where they should be and when I click the notifications for new memories it just opens a blank screen and never loads. Not worth using without the free storage.

author: Susan Praseuth
content: It has some of the features that I need. What I would like is to be able to choose where photos are placed in the collages. I would also like to be able to choose my photos for panoramic shots rather than rely on the algorithm to pick them out. They usually miss it and then I end up with a bunch of useful photos. If those two functions could be correct, I would give the app five stars.

author: Miq Amera
content: Overall, good. But, the option of "free up space" simply deletes everything on the phone without options to review or select first. Does not even ask for reconfirmation before doing the action. One click and all the one backed up to the cloud gone from your device. Plus, all the backup photos are simply back up to one single place (and sorted by date) instead of within folders like your device usually has. Since I prefer looking into the folders as the pictures I saved are for specific purposes.

author: TALAT ABBAS
content: The markup option for editing photos is not nice. there are very less colours and size of the pen or highlighter cannot be changed. I cannot blur photos and there are very few filters and no stickers. Samsung's gallery is much better than this app. That app has all features. But, as this is a realme device so it is not having Samsung's gallery. So please add these things in this app.

author: Jed Abbott
content: The new design feels clunky when compared to the previous version. Auto-stylized photos and videos no longer show or can be easily accessed. I have to either go the website or use a previous version of the app on my other phone. I am also not a fan of the new location for the albums feature. I don't see the point of it being tucked away in the top left corner of the app. Overall, the new design feels like we are loosing capabilities instead of gaining simply for Aesthetics.

author: A Google user
content: Great App, but it just missing some key features, being able to see all non ablum photo so you can which ones you need to sort. This non-ablum should be a pre-generated ablum that allows you to see all of this. Plus when they did there unlinking with drive. I had some photos left in drive and don't know if they are in my Google photos area. Why didnt they just bring everything over, so I don't have to do the guessing game. Please fix this and be better about changes in the future.

author: Helenena
content: Even after years of using, it doesn't seem to get better or having bugs fixed. Goodle said my missing photos are apps problem (software) and so their guarantee is useless, even when it's the essential function of today's PHONES to take a photo and RETAIN it..and if it's called GOOGLE photos the Google should take the responsibility!.Does not want to share to anything from itself.. In general, communication with other apps is VERY POOR! no wonder people stay with apple, now I understand! Pixel 👎

author: Rayson Wiggill
content: If you do not have a SIM card in the phone then it will not save the photos so if you are traveling and something goes wrong with your SIM card you can not take photos.... Not a good time. An update - I found the photos it had just put the worng time and date stamp on the photos by about 2 months for some strange reason.

author: A Google user
content: Too Many Crashes. It has been only 4 days since I downloaded the app. While uploading photos, creating albums, adding photos to albums app crashes. I have to choose all photos from beginning. If I chose to upload photos in downloaded file, the app doesn't even start cuz of crashes. It needs to be fixed asap. Device: Samsung S9

author: A Google user
content: This is an incredible service for managing and sharing photos. My only issue is that the core task I'd want to do from phone, create albums for easy reference and sharing, does not work reliably. I never had any issues on iOS but it never works as expected on Android. I create an album and add photos and it appears all is well...and then the album disappears. Or I create a link to share and that's when the album disappears. Hence, a two star rating for the app even though I love the service.

author: Josh Foshee
content: Update 5/15/21. Please make the videos take more than 50 pictures. I always have to delete about 20. I would love to make a video long enough to add all the pictures I want and the length of the song I use...its changed recently and harder to navigate. The hidden section are more difficult for older people like my in laws. Very easy to use and very helpful when explaining the use of every tool.

author: Jadon Cochrane
content: Has worked great for years. Since last night the app has been growing in my phone continuously in storage size. I deleted all my photos in my phone and within 5 minutes my phone was almost unusable with full storage and the app had jumped to 15gb. I had to delete the app because something was continuously writing files onto my device storage in the app.

author: Phoebe Young
content: I have Google photos installed on my Fire tablet and it worked great! (at first) I wasnt a fan of the layout but it didn't matter that much. I liked that it saved the art I did and showed me the previews right in the app. HOWEVER Recently it has crashed every. single. time I open the app. I have uninstalled, updated, restarted, and no matter what it always crashes almost as soon as I open the app. I don't know if my device isn't supported anymore or what but it is severely disappointing.

author: A Google user
content: Still the option to edit the collage photos is not available and the collage pics are almost similar. I like the video feature which it automatically creates. I just have a suggestion while creating a collage we should have access to alter the arrangement of the photos in the collage. still waiting for the feature to edit pictures in collage .

author: Ivan Delgado
content: I really dislike the new Google Photos editing layout. What used to be simple and straightforward now takes way too many clicks. Before, all the editing tools were right there in one place, easy to access. Now everything is hidden behind categories, so instead of making quick adjustments, I have to dig through menus to find what I want. This update makes the whole process slower, less intuitive, and honestly frustrating. Editing photos should be quick and convenient, not a scavenger hunt.

author: Curtis Livers
content: It works, but does not have a lockable folder. Additionally, it is ofern hard to navigate to various folders such as the screenshots. The presentation is not consistent. Also, if you don't have signal you can be blocked from viewing the photos on your camera roll. Maybe there is an option to view resident photos, but I haven't found it. A major fail. I have to download a separate app to view photos that are stored in the memory of my phone. What the hell? Otherwise it has some nice features.

author: Ami Shumway
content: It drives me crazy that it often doesn't pick up all the people or pets in the photos and if it doesn't give you the option to manually add tags to the missing pet ls or people. You can only edit the tags of the faces it's already picked up. I also hate the updates to the Edit functions. I do like that it's easy to share the photos with other Google users and search by people, dates or places. I honestly only use it because storage is easy.

author: nicky reid
content: Most of the time this app is awesome but then sometimes it's impossible to find things, things don't save where you want them to, photos get moved to random albums. I have 5 albums titled "family and friends" that I did not create with photos of my cats randomly allocated among them. It's extremely frustrating to save an image inside Google photos, generated by Google photos, and still never be able to find the file again.

author: Robert Frazier
content: On the latest update of photos, Google made it very difficult to find and locate shared albums, especially for those that are not computer/software savvy like (great) grandparents. It is not very intuitive how to add a shared album to your library, especially for users that have iphones. A major feature of this app is for us to share photos and albums with loved ones who do not live nearby. Please update it again to make it easier for them to view these photos and albums.

author: A Google user
content: Good over all but why do you take an edited photo and place it into a separate album. It would be so much easier to place the edited photo right next to the original. You make it so that 1. It need to back up to the correct album then 2. The user needs to go find that album. I currently have about 4 "photo editor" albums. Just make those photos go into one concise folder please

author: Breanna Harrison
content: Since the new update, most of my older photos don't load in, like there's a blank space for them and i know that they're uploaded because i can see them on my computer but after all I've tried they still won't load. I've uninstalled, reinstalled, restarted the app and my phone to no result. Wifi or data. Also my photos haven't been backing up either while on the app or in the background. The new update is disappointing.

author: Joel Banks
content: The changes to the editing options have removed useful capabilities. Keystone correction is gone, and I used that very frequently. Even worse, it's no longer possible to make further edits/adjustments once a photo has been saved - it reverts to the original, and all prior work is lost. (And there used to be a message saying you can adjust edits later - gone now.) _Bad_ changes, and for no apparent reason. Undo these 'improvements'! Many others say the same thing, and more. Fix these problems!

author: A Google user
content: It'd be nice if there's a feature to hide photos and have them accessible via a password or fingerprint. Also, I don't like that it sorts or groups the photos by date, I hope there's a feature to disable that. The albums look very stylish and simple though which I love but I opted out of it eventually because of customization issues which other photo galleries have ease of access.

author: Daven Raphael Carberry
content: At first I actually thought that this was a pretty cool app but now I'm very disappointed... I haven't been able to gain access to a lot of my videos and photos which has sentimental value that cannot be replace! There must be something that can be done to get them all back especially as I have invested too much money, more than I really wanted for bulks of memory in the hope that my files will be safe and easily accessible.

author: Kay Pledger
content: I have been using this app to back up my media for years. I've been on the 200 GB plan for $2.99 since 2013. It's taken me almost 9 years to use 200 GB, and when I thought I could upgrade the storage to the next level, Google is only giving the option of 2TB for $9.99. Firstly, I don't need 2TB, and I don't want to jump from paying $2.99/month to $9.99/month! What makes matters worse, is that google is offering 500 GB for $5/month exclusively for T-Mobile customers! THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE!!!

author: O P
content: Half the time it has some kind of issue. Whether it be not being able to show all of the albums on the phone, or that Google wants to override personal settings. It also bugs out a lot, causing issues with the SD card. Because of this software having to be on Motorola phones ,for some unknown reason many customers cannot delete their photos from within the app, and have to go into internal storage. When I think of how bad it has become since 2017, it's actually quite sad.

author: Cobus F. Potgieter
content: They messed up an app that worked well with the last update. I don't think anyone actually test edited any photos. After reframing, you can't save and edit other properties later; it reverts to original! Framing handles snap all over the place and almost impossible to grip anywhere but on the corners, so you can't accurately adjust axes separately. Effects are laggy now. Such a pain to work with now.

author: A Google user
content: I think that this is very helpful but it's also very frustrating at the same time because there is many things that are capable of doing but then again they are very limited. Issues are : 1. Not capable of recognizing duplicate copies 2. can't really fully organize and separate types of Media (photos, video, animation, and others) 3. No longer have an automatic sync up to Google drive That's not really all as more time passes it's only becoming worse. I will appreciate some feedback on fixing

author: A Google user
content: it's good. good concept, but not user friendly. Some edits were overlooked in the way of sharing and sharing is out of sequence. And deleting.. that's a cluster. you work on multiple devices. Delete from one, thinking it was deleted from all only to log in later on the deleted device, you find out that the photos were put back because their also on another device. With some tweaking, it'll be number one. But until then, I give it a 2 stars. Feel free to contact me. You have my info.

author: Rachael Page
content: This app was amazing, and then they recently changed it and it no longer is intuitive. Getting rid of the Assistant tab was a huge mistake. Now I can't find my shared albums or the auto-generated collages and stuff. I don't know why everything always has to be messed with, when it already works. Fixing things until they're broken, all in the name of newness, is the new norm, and it's frustrating.

author: Heather Rabassa
content: Used to be great. The new update it horrible. My albums are all out of wack and it isn't adding photos in the correct order anymore. I have pictures that are staying at the bottom and anything I add gets put smack in the middle of the album. It's also incredibly hard to find anything I save to my camera roll through Snapchat. I had to upload the video to Photos TWICE for it to work and now it refuses to be added to my album. I had no complaints with the app before this update

author: Salvatore Spatafore
content: Google has taken away the ability to connect directly from apps (like facebook and messages, etc.) to Google Photos. I have a pixel. An actual Google phone. There's no reason I shouldn't be able to do this without having to go in and download the picture beforehand. It's absurd. I think I may be done with Pixel. I've had every generation, and the 4 has really been awful. Now they take away a crucial feature?? Garbage. 👎

author: martin almeraz
content: I lost so many pictures hoping I see them again. I have about 100 pictures that turned gray. When I click on them they just load and load never ending. I have tried to reboot phone, force stop app, sign off and sign back in to account, reboot again and nothing. I have pictures of my grandpa's last days that meant so much to me before he passed away to Covid. Now it seems that the pictures are lost. I still have not delete them hoping one day they magically possibly reaper.

author: Fanta Friend
content: While I am glad this app exists, I on the brink of installing a substitute. Unfortunately, it is not that easy to replace. The things that really piss me off every time I have a bigger set of photos to add, include: better control over sync (sync on demand without changing prefs, sync per album), cancellable uploads and better integration with in-device gallery.

author: R E
content: Perspective crop is back, which is good. I just wish the app hadn't gotten harder to use. It was much easier to change just about anything before now. Also, before you could turn on/off a change in ex. light to compare before and after, now we can only compare original to current change, not the individual changes. Another thing is markup, which has gotten incredibly bad, you can't change the size on the marker, it changes size depending on zoom level — awful.

author: A Google user
content: Not versatile at all. The only good thing in it are the automatic groupings, such as places, faces etc. I get mad when I want to create a new album and the only way to get the images is at the thousands of backed up photos. I should pick up photos from anywhere, shouldn't I? No I have just found out that I cannot sort files by size. 😡

author: Tan
content: Google, what have you done?!? It used to be my favourite photo editing app, but in the latest release the perspective warp has been removed and the cropping tool is no longer as precise as it used to. Also, once you have saved an edited photo, you can't edit it again and have to use the original photo again, i.e. incremental editing is no longer possible. Please bring back the previous tools, otherwise I have to look for another editing app.

author: Juan Carlos Pinillos
content: I love being able to share an album with many people. Unfortunately there are so many issues that occur and some weird features as well. So many times it's happened to me that I try to upload photos to an album and receive a notification that they were uploaded but in reality it didn't work. This will happen for days. The help says to uninstall and reinstall but when you do, it takes days for Photos to find all your photos and shared albums with no certainty that the original issue was fixed.

author: Inf-o Homebisnis
content: the basic concept of this all is good. But somehow starting from few months, sometimes a lot of pics r suddenly missing from my phone memory (some of the missing pics are backed up in Google photo (obviously with lower resolution/since I m a free user), yet some(a lot other pics) are somehow. missing vaporized without trace(and unable. to recover /undelete, in future Ggl photos Must Include PC recycle bin features). it seems that this app somehow perform some erroneous/unrecoverable actions.

author: Chris Brown
content: Getting better now. Editing tools are improved from before. However my gripes are: date change within GP doesn't actually affect the EXIF data, so when you download a photo, the date will still be wrong (and it WILL be wrong, because GP does some weird time zone allocations that are unpredictable unless you have GPS info tagged). My second gripe is preemptive - I have 30,000 photos on GP, but how long until they randomly decide to abandon this project, like they always do?

author: Yui Stay
content: Deleting anything on here deletes it in your gallery too and once it's synced you can't easily unsync it. (the warning message did not specify that, it only said it would delete across google platforms) and when I tried to restore everything it said I didn't have enough storage?? So I signed up for the free trial to get enough storage to get my photos back and delete the app, but even after that it was beyond complicated to find the cancel plan button.

author: A Google user
content: Changed rating as it's not so good now that they have unsynchronized between Drive and Photos so now having to go between the two to delete no longer wanted photos. Was a lot lot better when photos were auto-deleted between the two 👍👍. Actually made more sense and was more productive when this happened 🤔 So whoever thought it was a good idea not to do this must be pretty thick and stupid. Or both!! 🤣🤣

author: Angel Undead
content: I just wanna look at my pictures without things like "search inside screenshot" or "copy text from image" or "fix lighting" popping up. If I wanted to do those things, I'd edit the pictures. And speaking of editing, please add more options for that. I don't want to have to download a whole 'nother app for tools that should already be in the one I have. Would be much appreciated 🙏

author: Nikki Zantop
content: The last update took photos from a great experience to a real frustration. Removing a few spots from a photo used to be fast and easy.... now it's slow and hard to select a small area. Correcting the perspective of a photo to get documents aligned quickly used to be fast and easy.... now that functionality is gone altogether? I find myself using the app less frequently for editing because of these changes.

author: Sara T
content: I love the photo creations it makes!!! LOVE! ** I hardly get these creations anymore, unfortunately. And, now when I delete photos from my phone, the backed up photos erase from my Google photos. I just lost a bunch of videos, once I permanently deleted from my phone to gain more storage on my device. And finally, my phone has a section of pictures that aren't backed up. Are it's bc I upgraded and started paying for more storage space. Absolutely disappointed.

author: A Google user
content: This app has huge problems backing up photos on my Note 9. Having an SD card ruins the backup. The only way to make it backup photos that are in internal storage is to go into device folders, select a folder on the SD card, toggle the backup, toggle it again and then the photos will back up. Please fix this. There are a lot of phones with SD cards.

author: Matthew Cordaro
content: Updated... Used to be: How a photo app should be. Now it can't handle something as simple as printing. And no, it's not the printer service. Google crops the photos no matter if you're saving to PDF or printing to an HP or an Epson or anything else. You have to use a secondary app now. What a shame. Photos is what's been keeping me a Google customer. Everything of theirs has been slowly degrading. I'm about to leave next phone generation. Google is heading for death by a thousand cuts.

author: dallas wilson
content: Great photos quality and I love the integration with all of Google and my nest devices and Chrome cast. I love the idea. However organizing the photos into folders or sorting them, deleting unused photos except the ones you choose in folder is impossible. Organization is a nightmare with this app. And sharing a photo is just insulting a slap in the face. This app makes it frustrating to share photos. They force you to share a link that brings your friends to your google page.

author: Dianne Davis
content: App won't let me upload with any of my other apps. It was working two months ago but then it stopped working. If I want to upload pictures to Facebook, Facebook Messager, messaging, Offer Up or any of my other apps it won't show my photos. It shows gallery, dcim, camera, Facebook, screenshots but nothing with my photos. I check my storage and they are there, over 8100 + photos. I just can't get to them to upload any of them to any app.

author: Danielle Downing
content: Usually a great app to keep track of all my pictures but here lately I have been having problems. All my pictures are out of order and when I click on the photo it still shows the correct date but when I'm scrolling through my pictures they are off by days or even years. I have tried searching how to fix this, Uninstaller and reinstalled and cleared the cache and storage. Nothing works! They are still viewing correctly on the web version though. 5 stars if I can get this issue fixed.

author: A Google user
content: Used to a fantastic product. Then they decided that the best thing to do is to take away the most intuitive features. Edited: gets worse and worse. Used to be so easy to add highlights to a dedicated album. Now you cannot find recent highlights easily and have to add photos individually.

author: Alexey Sidorov
content: More glitches that ever! This used to be a great photo syncing and editing app but over the past few months it started to create troubles. I had to reinstall it 3 times for it work properly. It takes forever to sync, background sync doesn't work, but worst part - l lost a lot of my photos because it showed me as if everything was synced to the cloud and so I freed up space on my phone, but later I couldn't find them on Google photos cloud and there were gone from my phone.

author: D K
content: Backup works fine, but why is deleting a picture also delete copies of the picture in different folders? That's just stupid... and now the search through my photos doesn't work on my tablet for some reason. Keeps saying turn on back up. But I don't want to back up the tablet. And it should be able to search through the already backed up photos!

author: A Google user
content: I think overall this app is very good but I ran into a very annoying problem. Sometimes the app keep generating thumbnail in a low resolution, kept in a hidden folder, but include it in my photo stream, register in the day it was created. This makes the photo stream contain duplicate files but in very low resolution. It's very unpleasant to look at. I tried deleting all of those file and today I found out it makes a lot more of it. Please tell me how to fix this. Aside from this, everything's 5*

author: Kate Shearer
content: The latest update messed up cropping. Before, it just kept the photo’s aspect ratio and I could zoom in and move it in one go. Now I have to adjust the crop handles, then re-select the aspect ratio to fix it, and then adjust it again. It’s slower and more annoying. Plus, saving now overwrites the original by default, so I have to choose Save as copy every time. It makes a simple crop frustrating. Also, the HDR adjustment I liked to use to add a bit of depth and lightness is gone.

author: Brandon Smith
content: The latest update to Google Photos removed the "Lens" button from the bottom of the screen. I used to use this all the time. I could take a bunch of photos, then review them and hit the Lens button to have everything translated into my native language. They removed the Lens button though, moving it instead to a sub option of the extended options. So now it takes more clicks in order to try to quickly translate things I have pictures of. At the very least let ME decide where that button is.

author: A Google user
content: There's no way to delete photos directly from Albums, or move suggested Manage Library/Archive photos to a different folder, instead you need to go back to camera roll and scan through all photos you've ever taken to delete/move the few you want. This makes it not user friendly for folks who take a lot of pics for different projects and then need to easily find and edit those albums.

author: Alan Forrest
content: I want to like it but they make it awfully difficult to simply upload photos from a folder on your phone into an online album. I just want to highlight some photos, click on a button to upload to a new Google Photos Album. But no. Upload the photos. Then after that, select the ones you want from a sea of others that you've also had to upload. then copy to a new album. try and create a link, but then get told you cannot, because of updates. Updates that you cannot see happening, nor know of.

author: Adrienne Bourque
content: Where did my stylized pictures go? In a recent update, after I see a stylized picture once in memories, I can't find it anywhere again. You used to be able to return to it to decide to save it later. It's not even a memory if I just took the picture today or yesterday so no idea why it's grouped that way. This appears to be the case with the iPhone and Android apps, but I still see the normal "For you" section on a computer browser.

author: Amanda Gabriel
content: Great app! I've used it for years but recently had to uninstall it due to limited storage. I kept getting the notification that gmail will soon be out of storage and so unable to receive new emails. When I checked it out, majority of the space was being used up by photos with tonnes of pictures and videos that I would have preferred not to be backed up. Could an option be added for users to select what they want to be backed up or for pictures only to be backed up?

author: Kendra Williams
content: Can't find anything anymore. I used to be able to go to collections and it'd have everything laid out, but now some things are in categories and then subcategories, but some stuff is missing. I had a memory pop up with the option to save the collage, but I can't find it anywhere, even searching for it. Had to view the memory again and screenshot the collage.

author: Madison Gaddy
content: The change in how you edit photos is frustrating because it moves my edited photo all the way to the top.. I want it exactly where it was. Also most of my photos aren't showing up in other apps like Facebook, Messenger or messages, so I can't post or even send them. Photos is the most important part of my job and I can't even do it correctly because this app keeps messing things up.

author: A Google user
content: I used to think this was the best app ever but for the last few months it has been crashing, not backing up, not showing me comments on shares, and generally not working. It's frustrating and disappointing. I have disabled and reabled so many times, yet it is still stuck. I now have 1800 files not backed up. I have to find another storage method since this one no longer works.

author: cheryl suszczynski
content: I used to like it but with all the recent updates, it's quite annoying. This folder keeps popping up and random pictures are automatically placed there. If I move pictures from my download to another folder, it doesn't recognize what date the pic was taken so shows up out of order. I can no longer create new folders on my external drive to save cloud/phone space. That used to be super easy and now doesn't work at all. Just overall, it's very frustrating to maneuver now.

author: Anna (Zonarypython)
content: This app is useful at times and I regularly use it but it feels like I need to navigate more menus than I should to get somewhere. I hate how it shows picture of animals that are currently dead it makes me sad and some of my recent photos from a few years ago I dont look at intentionally or it would show a spotlight memory thing of a picture of a rash or gross injury I have sustained I also wish it was just trying to be a photo app. It's good if this is what you want but it's just so cluttered.

author: Mallory
content: One big pro for me is the feature to search for photos. But I absolutely hate the it doesn't move the picture when you create an album, it just creates a duplicate. I would organize my whole camera roll if it meant I could find the pictures after, but it's impossible to tell if a photo has been put into an album or not already. This makes everything very messy. I try to just use the photo feature on my phone (which I generally prefer) but then I change a device and stuck with Google photos again

author: A Google user
content: Honestly... great features like photo back up. But very cluttered and could be easier to use if it was ever improved in the 4 years I've used it. Editing stuff should be easier but it's not. Do you even have designers or just use interns? Lol Nice try on the automatic photo collages and videos but they're usually a disappointment and very hard to personalize or export.

author: Alan SZTERNBERG
content: Please Google. Stop adding feature to print photo. I don't want that. It's not ecological. I want a space to save and organize my photos. It's becoming harder to do because you want to make to app as simplest as possible. But it is not working. I need to have tools to manage, search, filter etc easily. Not buying a print.

author: TS Heritage
content: Most recent update moved stuff around and added useless Memories, Collections and Places tabs. If you're going to change the interface like that and impact how we manage our Library, at least give us the option to remove those new tabs. I'll never use them, so let me put basic library features back where they used to be on the first page. This update is annoying.

author: Jacqueline Elegeer
content: The new layout of the collection tab is bothersome. I cannot find what I am looking for because of the rearrangement. I also don't like having to backup photos to find them. The premade collections and sub-collections aren't great and for the most part, fail to contain items that would actually be under them. Because of this, I hate the layout. It's not efficient. It's inaccurate and makes it so much harder to find the photos you want. It has become non-user friendly. I'm disappointed.

author: Rhonda Waterhouse
content: It's so disappointing that I have had 2 previous Pixel phones, now I have the most expensive one and photos storage is no longer included. It's always telling me I'm almost out of storage. With the previous two phones, unlimited storage was free. I've only had this phone a couple of months and I'm out of room. Now there's no reason to buy another Pixel. It's too expensive, doesn't work as well, AND it doesn't include the free storage I had with the cheaper, better phones. Boo Google!!

author: Aelin Tog
content: The backup takes such a long time and only happens if the app is the only thing open on my phone so I can't even use my phone for other things while waiting for the back up. Furthermore, as soon as I downloaded the app it automatically put all of my photos not from this email address but another one so then I had to patiently wait for hours on end for all the photos to be backed up onto the right account. You also can't move many photos into the locked folder at once.

author: A Google user
content: After back up related changes, even when I have selected original quality with no change and turned off the back up, somehow the back up is still in action and I lost my data real quick. I don't know how it is doing back up even when my device photos were already backed up properly. This is one of the worst experience regarding Google photos. I am using it since long time and was really happy with it. This issue should be resolved.

author: A Google user
content: The thing I don't like is the UI. Please give us the freedom to separate offline photos and online photos. Like putting offline and online into separate album set. The app at this moment is hard to tell if a photo is uploaded or not and I have many photos on my phone. I also use my phone for business meaning I have many product photos that I don't want to upload to google photos.

author: G
content: You guys simply NEED to let us zoom in and out in albums. My library is extensive, and so are my albums, having all my photos crammed in with no option to zoom out makes it unbelievably inconvenient to find photos inside albums. And the absurd thing is, we can already do that in the library tab, or the favorites tab, why not in the albums which is the whole point of Google Photos? Also, adding a "select all" option would be nice for management.

author: Mette Mai Veelmaa
content: I tried this out because there's an option to share your gallery with another account. Now most of my photos have disappeared from my main gallery and been backed up but because I share my gallery with a friend, all of my photos and theirs are scattered thoughout the app. It's very difficult to find and sort mine. If only there was a way to only see my pictures or an easier way to sort them, but all in all I don't really recommend.

author: Marc Brown
content: I have multiple Google accounts on my phone. When I'm on the Photos tab, and go into the Updates feed, I see the history of comments, added photos, etc for all albums in the main account. When I go to one of my other accounts, that feed is inconsistent. Whenever there's an update to the app, I see the history in that updates section at first. If look at it later, let's say the next day, the updates page is empty. Yes, I can go into each individual album and see, but not ideal.

author: Jen H
content: Ever since the update, I have files missing, it does not work well with my Moto camera so now I can't scroll through images like I used to when I load the camera. Also when using the app it won't let me delete items I keep getting an " error faiedl to bin" . Maybe there's some bugs and glitches that need to be worked on? I am running on Android 11 .

author: Krisztián Fekete
content: Unable to download all photos at once from a shared album, it's only possible to download each photo one by one. I have to do it in the browser. Also, when stabilizing a 10-bit HDR video, Photos removes the HDR. This seems to be a known issue since March but still hasn't been fixed yet. Face tagging is also broken, very inaccurate (can't seem to tell people apart and detect faces where there are none, randomly tagging people in photos). Sad.

author: Mark van Renswoude
content: Only use it for shared albums and it's not bad at that. But it completely ignores the settings to not show memories and they take up too way much screen space, plus it shows a photo I'd rather not be reminded of all the time and I can't get rid of it. Edit: thanks for the response. Yes, I've read that article but the app still shows the memory despite blocking the date. And I still can't completely turn off memories altogether.

author: A Google user
content: I hate the fact that they take my pictures and rotate them,, hide my pictures by putting them into atomations, and other manipulations. I do not mind suggestions if they must. However, I have requested that they keep their filthy hands off of modifying my pictures, and they have not honored that. I want total control to do those things myself.

author: Shaun Fosberry
content: Hi. I prefer Google Photos above other similar apps for several reasons but @ the same time I have a hard time accessing any photos when I dont have data. As soon as any media has been uplaoded by google, its suddenly removed from my device and I cant view or use any of my photos with my Samsung's own gallery app unless I get data or connect to wi-fi and then download said photos from the cloud to my device (again). I also struggle to sort and navigate between different folders.

author: Alan Ambrose
content: Was five stars, until the new update. Unlimited high quality storage ends on 1st of June. All high quality pictures will count towards storage from then on. Let's get them really really used to it, then start charging them. Google must be pressed for cash, I suppose. I'll be going back to the good ole external hard drive, I suppose. No such thing as a free lunch, or storage.

author: Danielle Edwards
content: Google gave me a notification saying that I could free up more storage, so I clicked yes, only to realise it had removed all the photos from my gallery app and thrown them together. And after that, it still 'complained' that my storage was almost full and I have no idea what I'm even supposed to do now. I don't think there's any way to put them back in my gallery, because I have an SD card that would've taken care of my storage anyway. All in all, I cried about this for at least 3 hours.

author: Saundra Revere
content: I don't know wasn't able to get in .. let alone use it. I was forced to rate it first .. without being able to open it. So I gave a one star!!! Once it opens and I can use it, ill let you know! Still cant access!!! After several attempts were made. I dont care for this app.I dont understand why i cant get to my personal photos !?? I never would have stored them here had I known this would have happened. Very disturbing.

author: Amber Hunter
content: I've happily used this app for years and out of the blue it crashes seconds after I open it. Opens, two - three, crash. It hasn't been able to back up any of my photos for quite awhile. This constant crashing has rendered my once favorite photo app useless. I have uninstalled and reinstalled the app twice - to no avail. I've checked settings, permissions, updates. I've finally just permanently uninstalled it and are now looking for something else to take its place. I'm sad.

author: Karl Robin
content: please add the ability to group albums together!!!!! I have multiple albums that are similar but are different, and it bothers me to no end that they can't be organized well together. please add the option to sort items in the trash folder. it would be helpful to sort by date deleted (which is how it is now) but also the date the photo/video was taken!

author: Armil Biag
content: The AP has gotten much worse in the past few months. The app doesn't sort the photos correctly by month and year anymore. The app previously sorted the photos based on the photo timestamps, but I've seen some older photos mis-sorted by months...no rhyme or reason behind it. This was never a problem before. The other part is the very, very slow upload from my Samsung Note 10+ into Google Photos. My data speed is fast, too. I'm really considering to move my files to OneDrive or DropBox.

author: A Google user
content: When I try to send a photo by clicking the share button for messages it sends a link instead of the photo, that's idiotic! I'd just send it while usisng the messages app but finding an old picture is a pain because most of them don't show up in the same gallery folder for some stupid reason. Android pie, Google photos, and the way messenger works, are all cumbersome and not intuitive.

author: A Google user
content: Google Photos used to work very well, but as of recently it has been very bad. Somethings like screenshots and things like that don't save unless I keep them in my phone photo gallery for more than 2 days. Also, I uploaded many videos that were important to me in order so save room in my photo gallery. It said they had all fully uploaded, I went into Google Photos and poof! They were there and one by one, they disappeared. Now they are gone forever and will not come back.

author: b.
content: The big problem with this app is that once your photos are synced and backed up, if you delete them on your device then you can no longer see them in their original sorted albums from your device when in Google Photos. You can see them sorted this way on Google while they're still stored on your phone, but not once you delete the original, even with backup. They should stay sorted into your albums so it's easier to find them rather having to scroll and search by date. Too hard to find anything.

author: D cake lady S
content: App "needs" updated way too often (and then won't update when selected), makes too many folders on its own (taking up space?), and won't print my photos at least 50% of the time. It's very frustrating to not be able to print a photo when needed, or select a format how to save it. There's no reason it should not print. Just says my printer isn't available, which it is!

author: Deanna Hunter
content: I would love to be able to add a searchable description to my photos. Because your search function doesn't always pull up what I'm looking for . I tried tagging using #description , but the search function won't pull them up :( Dont like the new version of this app. I still hate that when you attach a photo to an email it's not a jpg. It makes it difficult to easily send and open photo attachments. I miss the old collage, videos etc that would show up every day

author: Jamie Basten
content: I'm not sure what's going on. Basically I had all my photos in specific folders with names in "library" now all of a sudden, there's only a couple of folders in there with only afew pictures in them. It's very annoying. I had them in certain folders to help me find pictures easier, now when I try and make a new folder to sort them out again, it's separate from the other folders... I'm so confused and annoyed

author: Tablet
content: For me, it isn't good. I only use it to back up photos as a last resort in case my phone dies or is stolen. But I hate so much I can't organize the photos into folders in a easy way. Why can't the backed up photos stay in the carpet? I don't like relying on the AI sorter, it doesn't work for me, I have too many photos that won't record properly. So, not for me, I hate it here, but I appreciate having a back up of my photos in case of an emergency. It's a mess, but I have them at least

author: Asry Andy
content: 1. I was previously able to view & edit faces under "people" section on photo details panel. Now the option is missing. 2. The problem is it recognizes all subfolders inside DCIM as "Camera" folder which is strictly selected as backed up folder by default. This includes Screenshots, saved Facebook images (mostly stolen memes) etc. There's no options to exclude any of those.

author: Dosh Man
content: It didn't have to be this hard making a photos app, but somehow I found myself getting more irritated the more I used it. Biggest problem for me is that it takes more than 2 minutes for a downloaded photo to even appear in your album folder. I had to keep closing and reopening to see if it had come through but some photos appear faster than others. It's frustrating. Too many issues to summarize but this is the biggest one for me. Sucks cause it's part of my phone.

author: Teddy Bear
content: Automatically deletes photos if they look too similar to each other, so if you want to take multiple pictures and get the right angle you have to use the burst feature. The app starts having more issues whenever an update is due, and as I'm writing this none of the videos I'm taking are showing up in my camera roll. Overall a rather frustrating app that I hope doesn't come pre-downloaded on the next phone I buy.

author: Daniela D
content: I have been using this photo Google app for years and I never had any problems.After recent updates I tried many days to edit videos, pictures. keep crashing, comes as error, I can't work on my files.I installed it 5 times, I deleted cache, I deleted Data, I reinstalled it again and still not working. Also I am paying membership and none of extra tools for editing pictures really works.I Today is Christmas and I am trying to do some nice videos and is just not working. Very disappointed 😞

author: Zach Rutledge
content: The photo editing tools are useful, but the rest of this app fails miserably at being a photo gallery. Want to hide directories? You can't. Want to rearrange albums, folders or anything at all? You can't. Want to resample a video to make it small in size? Ha, sorry. Make gifs from a video? Nope, can't do that either. Such simple things would make this app actually useful instead of hard coded non-options, but then that would be giving users control and I guess Google won't let that happen.

author: David Robinson
content: I really enjoyed the photo editing capabilities of this previously but one thing I can't seem to do anymore is to highlight an entire background to reimagine it. That was sometimes useful but now when I try to do that it highlights some and when I try to add to it it doesn't work, it shifts the highlighted area slightly instead of adding to it. unless I'm missing something the update has made it worse.

author: KT Burk
content: I agree with the other people who have left reviews. I can no longer use the magic eraser tool a few months ago when I would open a photo and it had telephone wires in it. they were already highlighted because the app had learned that. that is exactly what I wanted to remove from the photo. now if I take a picture of the Moon for instance and there are wires in the way. it not only removes the wires but the Moon as well. it is beyond frustrating.

author: SamUnderStars
content: It is very disappointing that in videos of my friends, Google can't recognize their faces and I am unable to group them to their album because of it. I've tried putting their name in the about section of the picture/video but if Google doesn't recognize it, it's just not allowed. What if a friend is off screen in a picture but I want to add them? What if the video is slightly dark? The app needs a way to manually add people to a picture/video.

author: Jack Bunce
content: The new interface is confusing and ruins the previous Photos experience. I used to love the way photos would present photos taken on the same day in previous years. Now it seems to be presented by weeks and there appears to be no ability to scroll through those photos. One can only wait for them to change automatically! I will certainly use Photos much less than I did before. I want to have control not Google. This is the same way they screwed up News, ie, took away my control.

author: Liber McKee
content: Removing unlimited compressed photos really killed this service. Now even if you pay you only have 100gb of storage and personally I'm already over that. Literally made the app unusable. It used to be the best out there for sharing photos with friends and making collaborative albums from trips. Guess I'll have to migrate to Amazon Prime photos which goes have unlimited original quality uploads with a prime membership

author: Arceus
content: my photos got rearranged randomly after my phone's system update. there's no way for me to bring them back to their original arrangement like before. it's big deal because if it's easy to find a particular photo if I know where it belongs. too bad there's no way to sort photos in this app. I just hope Google can add that option next update, to sort photos in each folder. manually drag and drop for sorting and arrangement will be better.

author: Zsolt Kaszas
content: Used to be good, but now it's more annoying then useful with the new notifications. Mixing up memories, no connection in between them (time, place, people, etc...), It's just a big mess. I feel like all the Google products going into the wrong direction. People complaining everywhere but no one is there to listen to them. Thank you

author: Scott Bush
content: I like the fact that this app gives you storage and makes it easy to back up photos. However be aware that it DOES NOT allow you to download photos from years ago in your memories. That way you "have to" by photo books and other items from there store. Other then that it's a nice easy app. PS ...the only thing I've been able to figure out is to screen shot those old photos I want to re load on to my phone. Maybe I'm wrong ...and if so , someone please tell what I'm missing or doing wrong

author: A Google user
content: They want you to use their machine learning to be able to sort and filter your images, but they don't let you help train it by manually tagging photos. Two of my tabby cat's have been mistakenly identified as the same cat, but I can't correct it. Yet more of Google's arrogance that they are doing nothing wrong, and not actually meeting the needs of their customers. It picks the worst photos to "enhance" and the enhancement always looks horrible with chromatic blue distortions.

author: Timothy Edgemon
content: I used to love this app. About 6 months ago there was a huge change that only negatively affected user experience. (See negative reviews below.) Please change it back. Also, stacked photos has disappeared? The option in settings is 'never allow', or 'always allow'. But when you forced it on people, it stacked their entire library. So it won't do it in the future anymore, but still there are a bunch in my camera roll from when it forced it on us. I can no longer unstack.

author: Aleksandra Dziubek
content: I'm lowering my rating until the app has been fixed. The recent update brought some new features, but at the cost of speed and stability. The app now constantly hangs and breaks. Plus you can no longer control the strength of filters - when you set one to e.g. 50, you get 100 after saving. I've been using them every day, so it's really frustrating.

author: A Google user
content: I don't care for the auto archive option. I'd like the option to change the pictures in the google-made movies. I do not like there being an older picture covering the new pictures I'm trying to look at. I'd like to stop pictures gping into an album after a certain time, instead of one album full of everyone I tag. I'm watching my kids grow up, so it would be great to have more efficient ways to organize my 10,000+ videos and pictures

author: Logan Kuhn
content: Google has been making a lot of changes to drive me out of their ecosystem lately. Finding photos is harder than it used to be/should be. All photo editing options are locked unless you opt in to backing it up online. If you do back up your photos online, now you can't delete it from your device without also deleting the backup. This app is still technically functional, but I would recommend using something else. Not everything needs to be AI, keep some of the manual markup and cropping tools.

author: A Google user
content: Needs hacker intrusion, tracking and image upload detection. what the hell is moon.PNG? i don't know. who names their photos anyway? photos are usually given a name automatically. Also an automatic camera repair would be nice. i can't use my camera. i can just take screen shots. because of a camera guard app by Protectstar which i had deleted without removing a setting 1st.

author: Oleg Demidenko
content: The only app we pay for to Google (storage space) and the worst UX we got from it. It is very hard to organize photos into albums (good luck quickly adding them to an existing album). Some photos somehow never appear in the album even after being added there. Setting sync options could have being more organized and intuitive It's highly confusing and disappointing

author: A Google user
content: Could you please make it so that the photos are no longer sorted by the date they were taken, and instead by the date they were uploaded or saved, so that we don't have to search for our photos that are taken years ago when we've just uploaded them to our phones. It is very frustrating! Who would ever even find that useful, it's extremely annoying having to search and search for a photo you just uploaded, just because it wasn't taken recently!

author: justice rising
content: Really needs a duplicate finder for not only one account but a duplicate finder amid multiple accounts. Very frustrating that with the 3 accounts I have it has been saving the same photo to all 3 accounts and now I am out of space and there is no easy way to get rid of duplicates! The automatic duplicate deletion does not work and never has.

author: Clare Donovan
content: Everything seemed ok until recently. First the app would completely freeze when moving photos to a different folder. I had to close the app and reopen, concerned about what had happened to my files. I noticed the times it had frozen it had copied the photos to the new folder (instead of moving), but then it seemed confused about what was where. I rolled back to an earlier version as suggested online, but now the photos aren't displaying on the right dates and it's all jumbled. Hate it.

author: Jennifer Hogan
content: The erase feature on the latest update is a downgrade. With the previous version, you could literally erase something the size of a pinprick, the updated version does not have the same capability. It is also hit & miss if it's going to work, often with a message advising to connect to the internet for better results, despite being connected to WiFi with full bars.

author: Gabriela-Madalina Baciu
content: "Storage management" app that is unclear with some of the high-impact functionalities like "free up space", which essentially erases everything from your phone. A problem that wouldn't be terrible if the user is provided with either an "undo" or a "download selected" option. I just wasted 2 days of my life downloading 7000 pictures ONE BY ONE and then re-adding metadata or custom photo edits (which are also deleted when uploading in the cloud). "Tedious" doesn't even begin to describe it.

author: Dr. Dark
content: Not a big fan of the new update for the editing tool. I really liked how simple it was before and now I have no idea how to even revert an edited picture back. For some reason it also always darkens/puts a filter on my pictures for no apparent reason too? Makes me wonder why the editing tool was changed, because I really preferred the previous version. Otherwise no complaints, been using it for several years and love using it for storage.

author: Noel Amaya Ortiz
content: The option where it says "Free up space" I accidentally clicked on it and deleted important photos and videos permanently. I feel so frustrated I can't recover my files. There should be a warning if someone accidentally clicks on Free up space like, "Are you sure you want to continue" that way people don't accidentally delete photos and videos they wanted to keep.

author: Psych its Ike
content: Ive always had Apple until recently and I much prefer Pixel then iPhone but some were better on iPhone, Google Photos being one. Google sorts the photos way too specifically and most of the time I have to look deep to find a photo. They sort photos by camera (only photos taken by the phone itself), downloads, apps (one folder for EACH app exported on), photos from my Nikon (which went into 15+ DIFFERENT folders) and more. I don't like that I can't view ALL my photos from one page sorted by date

author: A Google user
content: App needs A LOT of work. I. confused as to what the difference between stared and loved items. I couldnt find either anywhere! I had to go back and re-star things and even then everything kept disappearing. It was so frustrating. Also, I can only heart some images and star others. Never the two. It is a horrible system and should be fixed. I do love that it stores a lot of pictures and is a reliable place to keep pictures. just to be sure, I always store my pictures in two places.

author: A Google user
content: Don't really use the app much in terms of retreaval of photos as I back up on my own external hard drives. The app however is convenient for people who don't do that and rely on the cloud service. I found it average but for some it may be different. It does glitch and stop working sometimes though which is the reason I back up independently as I do not trust it 100%

author: A Google user
content: This app is not intuitive. Rather than an easy way to organize and search your photos by date, it pushes towards albums that are arbitrary date and subject-wise. Also it favors pushing photo products over a simple collection of on device photos. If you have a large SD memory card in your Android phone, there is no need for all the complicated cloud options this app pushes.

author: A Google user
content: Confusing, convoluted, intrusive... it forces user to change habits and to sort of depend only on it. One should not have to repeat the moves (cleaning, editing, sorting) it did within the device's gallery in the Google Photos gallery as well. The back up (Google Photos in this case) must follow the source (device's gallery) and one should not have to make the same moves twice. Maybe I don't get it, looks good, works smoothly but it's confusing.

author: A Google user
content: It's perfect in theory but every time I launch it I get an error android.process.media stopped working and it crashes. I have to relaunch the app like 10 times for it to actually work. The only temporary fix is to reset ALL app permissions which is super inconvenient but then the problem starts up again after a few days. PLEASE HELP. I'm on a Galaxy S8.

author: A Google user
content: I love this app, when it's working right. When I move a photo to another folder, it duplicates it instead if moving it and when I try and delete it, it deletes it from everywhere instead of just that folder. When I open the app, my pictures constantly "flash" like they are trying to update but can't and I have some photos that no longer show, just a file error. Please Google, fix these issues so I can give you 5 stars again. These issues didn't start until after the Android 10 install.

author: A Google user
content: Used to be the best photo storage service. Unfortunutely since writing my last review, Google have decided that they would like to keep my photos for themselves. There used to be a fantastic feature where in your Google Photos represented a folder in your Google Drive. Via this, you could set up your favourite syncing app to sync your photos to your local PC, or even other services, and as you snapped them in various devices, they would sort of concatinate in one location. This was then removed because people apparently found this incredibly simple concept confusing. This was then followed by a wave of people asking who the confused people were, not one of which turned up and said "oh good, that confusing thing is gone". Anyway, you can still get your photos back by downloading LITERALLY YOUR ENTIRE ACCOUNT via Takeaway, so that totally makes sense, I'm sure the people who found a folder confusing find that to be blissfully simple....

author: A.J.
content: Could be an excellent option if nested albums/folders were implemented. I have to organize hundreds of albums by category- for example, jewelry creations organized by type (food, animals, color). And this carries into other things that also needs further folder separation. Hair styles, makeup, etc. Too many to not have this feature.

author: Richard Kowalsky
content: I almost switched over to your photo app but it falls short of a basic feature that Samsung offers, a simple running count of total photos in each category. It is one of the reasons I have not activated my pro 7, but there are other reasons. From what I've seen from the preview of the new update it does not include the count of each category. Sometimes the little things mean a lot.

author: Ben Murray
content: I use this quite a lot for editing. Used to be pretty good. Recently got a major 10years UIUX "update". Now it's glitchy, requires more clicks to do things (who signed off on that), and is harder to use for detail. Cropping is broken as the image remains tiny with huge screen borders. Going to switch away to something else for editing now... I know these reviews make fa difference but come on Google, sort yourselves out.

author: jesse james johnson
content: This app, like all google products, lack the complexity in functionality. It's impossible to know what you've added to an album and what you haven't. Without some kind of indication of what's already in an album it's just too time consuming to organize photos. I'd also like a second way to add hastag or keywords to photos so you have a secondary way to sort/search photos in an album.

author: Sonja Sundell
content: Unfortunately google has such a monopoly especially on android devices, that this is the most "convenient" photo storage. Most of the times you need to have the app open for it to backup, which is super inconvenient. The only times I don't want it to backup, it does it without opening the app.... so every time you need to manually turn off the backup. Secondly, there is no convenient way to delete your photos, it will delete them on the device too!! Also no storage plan between 200GB and 2T??

author: vdroxana
content: From the getgo, it doesn't back up the photos in my gallery by folders... it just puts them ALL in the same pot, probably by date, but really scrambled: Camera with Whatsup and etc. It's a mess!! It also has no option to MOVE photos into folders, only copy them, so still the same mess, and the process itself takes long. I also want to move photos back to my gallery for better editing or sharing, but there isn't such an option. I stopped the app and will be looking for smth else.

author: Chad Jenkins
content: I'm using a phone where I'm forced to use this as my gallery, ultimately it's less functional and slower than a normal gallery app. I heavily dislike having to use it, while it has a few useful features it's also incredibly redundant. Overall I wish I didn't have to use this app for my gallery, it's less functional and slower for most things, not to mention they've also removed the unlimited storage which was one of the few good things about this app, however it's gone now.

author: Ebube Glory
content: It's nice but I do have a problem with it. About a month ago my device was low on storage so I decided to delete some pictures and the app gave me an option of saving space which I agreed with and did but the problem's I haven't been able to see let alone retrieve those pictures and videos. I keep searching but can find none of them. It's really a big issue to me because there are over 70 photos and videos missing. I would like if this issue is rectified as soon as possible.

author: SBG2022
content: Used to love this app, but since the update, I can't find anything. I used to often search for folders by name. Now, when I type the name of the folder into the search bar, the folder I typed comes up as a choice, but when I click on it, NOTHING HAPPENS. I have tried this repeatedly with many different folder names and the same thing happens. Please fix this.

author: Cristian Hidalgo
content: "Unable to edit, check your connection" I updated, tried changing wifi, using mobile data, and still couldn't edit photos (also have paid Google cloud). To anyone who gets the error, the solution I found is to find the app in the play store. It should show as installed and there is an option to uninstall to the left of the open button. Click on that and it will ask you are you sure and click yes. It doesn't uninstall the app, but the update. Always back up photos but it shouldn't affect them.

author: A Google user
content: Like this app when I could sync Google Photos to my PC. Now I have to use google takeout. That is not a solution. Switched to Amazon Photos that supports this. I can also organize my photos in albums. As a bonus my photos are displayed on my FireTV as a screen saver. This is exactly what my wife wanted. Too bad Google can't connect their devices and services together for a nice user experience.

author: Ivyclaw
content: This is becoming a pain to deal with! I can't turn off the "photo from _ years ago taken on this day" thing, and it's no longer letting me crop images! It just goes dim with a loading symbol! It does the same thing when I try to delete something too. Idk how to fix this!! Some images I have through screenshot don't even show up in the gallery! Please help!

author: SuperMonkeyCube 01
content: I just wanted to look for an old picture, but every time I scrolled to the right time frame, it kept loading more pictures and moving to up a couple of years ahead. I tried scrolling back down like 10 times, only to give up and use a web browser instead. Albums also fight with you when trying to edit them, undoing changes, and removing pictures I just added.

author: Luto Pastialis
content: While the editing options are very elaborate, which allow me to enhance already good picture quality even more, it sometimes fails to save the edited picture. Seems random and is super frustrating after spending 10min of adjusting the settings and then not being able to save! Tried restarting it and clearing the cache, nothing works. It's not a storage issue as I have over 100GB free space left. I have a Samsung galaxy A13..

author: MJ
content: I have collected quite the photo collection over the years with MANY of them being duplicates. I would love, like so many other users to be able to detect duplicates. Also, downloading photos when you have a large number to move is a tremendous hassle. You are limited in the number of photos you can move at one time and there is no way of knowing what has been downloaded and what's not.

author: Mike G
