content: This app has gotten worse over time. As it stands the only real reason to use it is that it automatically syncs with your Google Drive and sharing is "easy" from there. It's not that easy though because sometimes sharing just doesn't work, and accessing videos or motion images online sometimes just doesn't work, or there's often a major delay. Also it doesn't seem to let you browse by folder on your phone anymore. Basically any other viewer is better.

author: A Google user
content: This app is great for storing, but very difficult to personalize to your liking. The app stores everything randomly, and doesn't let you organize anything. You can't create folders, or edit them. And it NEVER backs up photos from my device camera, no matter if you turn your settings on for that, I always have to upload each file manually. I lost precious family photos when I thought the app was already doing that, then had to reset my phone to factory setting. By far, the worst google app.

author: A Google user
content: Google Photos works seamlessly in the background with my phones photo storage. Ive always been, still am, skeptical of the cloud concept. Butthis seems to work great! EDIT: years of use, in short, DO NOT USE THIS APP on any Mobile. Back up 100% IGNORES SD cards, only internal storage. The "how to" is outdated on most devices. Google Drive interaction was never ideal. New design 100% DOES NOT intentionally. Also "Sharing" is only to view, not given to own. More wrong but at review letter limit.

author: Filipe Governa
content: No support. New Backup and Sync Windows app doesn't sync pictures in OneDrive folder that old Google Photos Backup desktop uploader synced fine. No more access to pictures automatically edited by Google Photos, must use a PC to approve the edit so it shows up in the app. No more unlimited high quality Pixel uploads despite Pixel overpricing. Can't edit photos with the app, must use the website instead. No more unlimited free uploads even if you overpay for a Pixel. Keeps constantly asking me to sign when I'm already signed in. Says "storage is low" and tries to trick you into paying for more space when you still have ~5 GB of free space (seriously?). Otherwise good.

author: Christine Dorn
content: When I try to edit using the app on my Chromebook, it always crashes. I have uninstalled and reinstalled it 2 times and it still crashes. I have posted twice on the help forums, no replies. I have searched the forums and none of the suggestions work. It looks like a fairly common problem. It works on my phone and the tools are easy to use and do a pretty good job, but I would like to be able to edit photos on my laptop.

author: Chris Frazar
content: Recent update was a bit of a disaster. Photos no longer has any of my photos in it. They are still on my phone's sd card, but photos can no longer find and display them. Not a useful photo app without the photos. New photos go to the SD card and appear in the app, but none from the past. Pain in the butt to navigate through the file directory every time.

author: Victoria Deacon
content: Having massive issue with the app. It's stuck on "preparing to back up." I've tried all the suggested solutions I can find and nothing has worked. It even seems to have failed to back up some old photos from 2016, but only a selection (even though I've been using the app for years!). I've even paid for additional storage, so I definitely shouldn't be experiencing issue like this! Please sort it out Google! I'm relying on you to save some very precious memories!

author: A Google user
content: When I was first starting to use Google Photos, I gave it 5 stars and swore by it.. in the past few years I've grown to realize how unorganized it actually is and the limitations it has is ridiculous to say the least. And now, it isnt really even free anymore. Not for any real space worth having the app to waste it's own space on top of it. I'm disappointed in how much Google and its services are and have been changing. If it weren't for the worst it would be alright.

author: Carine Mai
content: Google photos cannot differentiate between my dog and my mother's dog. Although they both have long-haired coats, they're different sizes, colours, and have different markings. This is extremely frustrating, and frankly a little upsetting. I am unable to have children and my dog my love. Furthermore, I am an artist and it is necessary for me to organize my photos into albums for use as references for artwork. This issue makes it extremely hard to do so. Correcting the "name" seem impossible.

author: Will
content: I just want to view my albums (which I created on my PC). I don't want to give access to all the photos on my device, but the app doesn't work otherwise. I don't want to backup, yet get many pop-ups to do so. And if you do (e.g. by accident), then you run out of storage and are asked to pay for it. Then there's no way to undo the backup, you have to delete photos one by one, making sure they aren't part of your albums. You'd think a Google engineer could calculate space required in advance.

author: Simplistic
content: Any time I try to load a video, the app will buffer or freeze for the video with no way to fix consistently. This is common with screen recordings, but can happen with most videos. Photos will mix up the dates that photos and videos are downloaded, and say they've been taken at impossible times. There is no way to search for media unless the app itself has decided what's in the photo (which is wrong on many occasions.) There are other issues that I can't fit in here, but need to be fixed.

author: Mark Mills
content: The issue of storage is a little frustrating. I had been told by Google photos that my storage was getting full, so I went back through my albums and deleted literally hundreds upon hundreds of videos, photos and files in order to get a little more space. For some reason this didn't increase my available space by even 1%, and in fact my storage continued to increase, despite me continuing to delete far for videos and photos that I was taking.

author: minutes ago edited
content: I liked Google photos. I always had. Now it is seemingly getting a bit more asinine, lacking the intuitive flow of use it once had. I use well designed photo software for my photos now. Google photos is just a place to put photos that I should have already backed up elsewhere in a effectively organized manner with intuitive software.

author: A Google user
content: This app would be good, if it didn't keep taking my photos off my phone.Despite fiddling with all the settings I can find, Google photos keeps lifting my pics off of my phone's storage and putting them on the cloud. Once they're there, it's NEARLY IMPOSSIBLE TO PUT THEM BACK ON MY PHONE. I use a lot of visuals for my work. It's incredibly infuriating to have them constantly removed from my phone, and put in with all the unorganized, difficult to sift through photos that have been backed up 4evr.

author: Jeremy Beals
content: *Update: the problem was caused by freeing up space recommended by google photos. So your link isnt helpful. After "freeing up space" on my s20, I can find the backed up pictures in the gallery, but my other apps don't have access to them now, and I lost hours worth of video editing for my business because they can't find the originals. I should've remembered from the last time but it sucks that you can't access them like promised when backing them up

author: Jerry Thomas
content: The photo app was perfect until the last update. The new UI is completed, and a complete change from the previous version and old crop options are not available or are not easily accessible. There might be new features, but it feels like a drastic change from the old version, which makes it much more difficult to use. Please bring back the crop options where we can choose the edge and the photo crops and align itself.

author: Aurelia Wallace
content: it's a great app, but I really wish there wasn't a storage limit now. that's the only reason my rating is so low. I'm going to have to find a different place to back stuff up soon, because I'm at 99% full storage and keep having to delete my videos to make room for pictures I want to save. there should at least be some deal for a one time purchase of some sort, Google is such a big company I'm sure they could afford to do this or add a bit more free storage.

author: Weilah de las Montañas
content: unfortunately the quality of the app is decreasing with the time. There are too many bug, wrong dates showing in the preview list (even though the info of the photo shows the correct one). Saving a photo after editing takes ages. Copying or moving a picture within the app, does actually the same thing... and it's either coping it nor moving it... among other things and this all happens with a pixel phone..

author: A Google user
content: It displays all the pictures on the phone, including pictures of some apps, music album pictures, which are not expected to be displayed. Please design an option so we can decide which folders to include or exclude. And hope it could support: first double tap to zoom in to fit screen, second double tap to zoom in to 100%.

author: Victor Eze
content: Finding the exact video you want is actually hard, for example if I want to find a video with a certain subtitle it doesn't pop up at all. I just keep finding another way which is actually hard if you find a video where they wrote something like "This should work" as a subtitle, Google photos won't give it to you even though you've backed it up

author: Cheri
content: Google Photos Search used to provide swift accurate results, one photo or groups of photos of a person, topic, location, etc Unfortunately, photo search has become a cumbersome task. Plus figuring out how to word intuitive thought into what AI needs to find photos & still receive less accurate results. You can switch Classic and Gemini but, even Classic is affected to the point that it's less accurate. We pay for Google 1 Fam so this adds a layer of disappointment. I hope there's a fix soon.

author: Aayden Trammell
content: So much I have to say.... but biggest issue right now is that a "select all" feature ANYWHERE in the app would make stuff go so much quicker and easier. Or at very least you could allow the boxes to be checked faster as it scrolls down. It scrolls down only like 8 pictures per frame when selecting, which makes everything you want to do when selecting photos take an eternity... :’( Then to make matters worse, it's extremely easy to accidentally click something then suddenly you have to re-do ALL

author: Marko Griffin
content: This app has gone to hell tbh. Edited photos don't STAY EDITED. All my images are out of order and not under the right dates on the home screen. Photos "share to Drive" doesn't work and constantly says "synchronization error, please try again later" and stops the upload halfway and doesn't move!! Even after I followed the Google forum stating to uninstall, reinstall, update phone system, restart phone, force stop the apps, etc! What is going on Google??

author: A Google user
content: There are few things that I like about this app. Not "a few" ... "very few". First thing: I had the WORST time syncing things so that they would show up on my computer/desktop, from my phone. When I realised they weren't syncing, there were over 5000 photos to sync (I take a lot, and edit a lot). So then I try to sync them. For the life of me, I can't get them to sync over. So... I start searching. Seems like a few people (that I could find) had the same problem. The fix? I had to shut off my wi-fi, turn on the sync over data option, go back in, then it starts syncing, so I turn the wi-fi on again... it goes for about 250-350 photos... so I think... cool - it's working. NOPE. It goes back to the "preparing backup" spinning circle of death. So then I do the same thing. And it works again. Then it gets stuck again. So far I think I've done it about 12 or 15 times... and I still have over 2100 photos to do. So - THAT'S annoying. Second... I have to agree with someone else here, on their low review. WHY, when you delete a phone from Google Photos, does it delete on the stock photo app of the phone as well. Oh and I dislike the editing feature as well - it's very limited. But now maybe I'm just getting picky...

author: Lol Dot
content: Recently there was an update and the albums are kind of harder to find, and I feel like it's just not as functional. Bad update. also they should really consider putting in an option to arrange photos. Not just with the search feature or in an album but actually arrange the photos. In large uploads they tend to get scattered.

author: A Google user
content: Internal Storage Hog on Android Phone. Although this app allows me to move it to my sd card, it then proceeds to fill up my phone's internal storage with thumbnails of photos. It was taking up close to 2 gigs and only stopped because space ran out. There is no way to limit the cache size on an android. It's terrible. I had to stop using the app.

author: Lea Queener
content: The AI "Ask" is HORRIBLE - worst update EVER!!! Bring back the old "Search," PLEASE. I've used Google Photos frequently since the update in October, and not ONCE has it been able to find a very basic, simple keyword, like "gift" or "sign," and bring up anything close to the correct photo the way it used to. What is even the point of having this kind of search!?! It's basically faster for me to try and scroll through 10 years of photos instead.

author: Tanya Rana
content: I really dont like the new update. Photos used to be better before this. The archive and and trash columns were better when they used to come out only by a swipe. Archive needs to be hidden. Also things have changed a lot and it isnt convienient anymore. Please bring the older version back. Is there anyway to degrade to the previous version?

author: Nick Richards
content: edit: am using G's links to feedback. OP: Image editing is an infuriating process. Recent updates have made it painful. Now magic eraser is slower and does not erase 75% of what it used to erase. cropping ridiculous because you can't reliably move an edge, only corners, And when you do move a corner that resets the zoom, which on a cell phone reduces the size of your crop to the size of a postage stamp! Ridiculous. Browsing photos is fast. Searching photos is unreliable, out of order, and wrong.

author: Beverly Akhurst
content: Annoyed that I am being forced, basically to save photos the way Google wants me to rather than in a way that works simply for me. I appreciate all the tools, but there is a sense of control "creep" that wants to convince us all we need this and then need to pay for what we used to keep elsewhere. Trying to see this as balance of good and bad. I still seem to spend more time than I used to sending my photos where I actually wanted them

author: Sydne Johnson
content: I don't know what happened with this most recent update, but ever since my app updated a few days ago, I haven't been able to see ANY photos that are added to shared albums. I get plenty of notifications saying photos were added, but I can't see any of them when I click the notification or go into the app. It's pretty irritating how buggy it is, and since I use the shared album for work, I'm *really* hoping it gets fixed soon.

author: Michael Sheldrake
content: Took away the functionality of being able to move photos to any folder we want. Very annoying. Don't remove functionality. Specifically the add to folder function. Now it can be hard to share photos uploaded from a different device. EDIT: The photo editing system just got far worse. It was quick and easy to apply edits in the same way to many pictures before because you could see all the faders at the same time. Now it's convoluted and slow. Also liked the auto adjustment which I can't find now

author: Ben Gramkow
content: Does the job but it has started constantly bugging me about my online storage being almost full. My storage is currently down to 88% full but the photos app keeps bugging me that it is almost full. They are obviously trying to upsell me the extra storage which is an extra cost every month that I have absolutely no interest in. There's got to be a photos app out there that still shows me photos but doesn't bug me trying to sell me things. I'm willing to pay a one-time cost but not every month.

author: Alice B. (Alice in Paris)
content: Photos taken with the phone are not immediately available in Photos app. I do not use cloud backup, if that's relevant (it should not be but whatever). When I take a photo then go look for it in the Photos app it's not there, even several minutes later, closing / opening the app. I just tested this, and the photo took 5 minutes to be visible in the app. What is taking so long? Do I need to change some setting? This issue has been present for months, my app is up-to-date.

author: AbuJafar Choudhury
content: The app doesn't sync and isn't as reliable as it used to be. There's too many things going on in the background that slows down the functionality of the app. When I scroll to older pictures, it fails to load, and when I want to download them, it fails to download (even after uninstalling and installing the app). I'm afraid I'm losing my precious pictures that I synced with Photos all these years.

author: Jer Vib
content: Have been using this app more for ordering items but there are not enough options available for photo projects. Also it is not user friendly, too hard to navigate. It is my only area to save photos now and the option to order in store and pickup is a great savings not having to pay postage.

author: A Google user
content: At first this is the best one, but later it turn disaster for now. When opening the app, I often being reminded to do backup and re-organize photos. Then if I refuse, the app hid the current photos/videos, had to wait for 10 minutes or when I had good internet connection. I also accidentally press the login with google account, and now I cannot logged out and use the offline version! Please make it optional again to keep the offline version while still using data.

author: A Google user
content: If you take a lot of photos/videos then manually backup to computer because it takes a TON of effort to get things to backup each time you have new photos/videos and even when it actually works, it will do it at 6KB/sec despite my phone in the same location will have upload speed of over 5MB/sec (5,120KB/sec) for any other apps and there is no other data use on my phone. It was not like this before, so one recent update ruined it. I hope Google will fix the issue in the next update ASAP!

author: A Google user
content: It takes a lot of time to upload the pictures and move them from one folder to the other one. I've been probably trying to upload some pictures for days, forcing me to use another clouds. The stylized pictures are good, but the app is not useful if you want to updload and release space from your phone. Probably needs a lot of work. It'd be great to focus on simple features of the app rather than other more elaborated tools.

author: A Google user
content: While I love the automatic albums and the search by face, the inability to sync with my desktop computer and the CONSTANT deleting of photos from my device without my permission is driving my nuts. I'm probably going to have to switch over to OneDrive, it's just too annoying to constantly have to search online for photos I want to post and re-download them.

author: Sonam Dhage
content: Wow the syncing feature can be useful and super frustrating!! Firstly, since this app also syncs unnecessary folders like 'screenshots' & 'whatsapp' stuff, I went ahead and deleted these folders on G photos, only to find they got deleted off my phone as well! Now they're all gone without saving them.. Plus even if you choose the option to 'stop syncing' certain folders, it still syncs them! Would be helpful to at least provide a warning as to what you're deleting off the phone as well.

author: A Google user
content: Loaded the upgrade and used it to review photos I have taken over the last two weeks. I saw NOTHING new being offered by the upgrade. Therefore I have to ask: What is supposed to be different compared to the program operating on the device before and after? IF something was changed then I lost several photos I already had in Archive and see no suggestions on how to retrieve those photos.

author: William Harris
content: I literally got the Pixel 8 Pro for photos and editing. Literally as soon as I find a new filter for scenery and equipment shots that's perfect, the filter tab is suddenly, and entirely empty when attempting to edit any photo! What gives Google?! EDIT: I've tried everything suggested other than uninstalling the app. I have folders that aren't backed up and I'm not willing to lose them. There was a security update that did not automatically install, but there has been no change since updating.

author: A Google user
content: For the last year or more at least this has just been chewing up ever more on-device (not even the SD card!) memory as it insists on cacheing information about pretty much every photo or video I have on Google Photos, using, seemingly, unlimited amounts of storage until my phone starts to complain that it can't function as it's running out.   I need to go into the application manager and delete the data manually - then Google Photos loses the setting to backup my old photos, at which stage I need to re-enable that setting and the whole cycle starts again.

author: Adam Goodall
content: Whatever's happened in the most recent update has knackered the ability to add text to images in the editing features. I can get the words on the image but controlling the location and sizing has become a pain. Assuming this is investigated and fixed, it would be nice to see the text autofill the box size fully rather than just on height. Otherwise it's a decent photo storage app and I'm quite happy using it.

author: Kishaan Ramruthan
content: How do I prevent Photos from deleting files on my device? I want to clean up my cloud storage but keep my local images. And when I take away permissions, it doesn't allow me to see MY pictures? I also turned off backups. But just saw a notification that files were being uploaded. Very sneaky!!! It feels like I'm not in control of my content!!

author: A Google user
content: This app works fine until you try organizing your gallery in any kind of way. Folders randomly disappear all the time; the photos are still there, but somehow the entire folder is lost. Only some of the pictures show up in the area where you can separate them into folders or albums. There is also no eraser for markup but otherwise, editing pictures is fairly easy.

author: Sam Hello
content: miles behind Samsung and apple!.....this my first time using Google photos, I usually had a Samsung with their gallery or iPhone. now I have pixel. this one really lacks some simple features that I took for granted.....like big obvious one: when organising, let us have a folder containing multiple albums....I have far too many albums, organising on this is sub-par at best. I also can't seem to move files between the device albums and the albums already stored in drive

author: A Google user
content: Good idea, but backup feature is flawed. The app will automatically backup photos from my device folders. But makes no effort to keep them in the albums online. Then makes matters worse when it deletes old photos to save space, the photos are only available online but they could be anywhere in your gallery. Why can't this app simply make an online folder, gallery or even just tag the photos with the folder name??????? One more thing, when I save an album shared with me, the images are not longer

author: Tami Barrett
content: When Google got rid of Picasso for your Google photos they traded the best photo and editing program for one that is completely inadequate. They need to bring back Picasso or design an app similar to it. With Picasso it made organizing (and later retrieving your photos) a snap. Also editing and naming your photos was easier. And did I mention the ease of éditing. Also changing the order of your photos and albums was a breeze. Gone are the days of common sense and customer satisfaction.

author: Discursive Bind32
content: Google Photos is a game-changer when it comes to managing and organizing my photo library. Its intuitive interface and powerful features make it easy to store, organize, and share my photos and videos effortlessly. I appreciate the unlimited cloud storage for high-quality photos and videos, which ensures that I never run out of space on my device. The app's automatic backup feature is a lifesaver, ensuring that my precious memories are safely stored and accessible across all my devices.

author: Ammi Tante
content: I've been using this app for almost 6 years. There are so many memories I've created as an album. Before knowing this app it was quite hard to save any photos to the laptop or SD card, I ended up deleting so many photos just for the sake of space. Then I found this app which Saved my life from deleting any pics. Its just disappointing me that unlimited storage is going away. GOOGLE PLEASE KEEP THE UNLIMITED STORAGE PLEASE!!!!!

author: Sandi Dreer
content: I'm using a new phone and have had numerous times where my photos show up as "device only" & I'm unable to view or edit them. ETA - even after clearing my cache, etc, about 40-70% of my photos are unviewable. They're greyed out and when you attempt to open them, all you see is a constant spinning circle. They never open. But, they're recoverable as I have had to pay for Wondeshare Repairit. I should not have had to pay money to recover images. ETA 2 - I previously did all in the linked article

author: A Google user
content: Liking it less and less... Three big complaints 1) No longer syncs with Google Drive... Extremely disappointing! REALLY miss this! 2) Can't print from Google Photos (desktop version)... instead have to download each picture and then print... very frustrating extra steps! (Note, pictures in Google Drive can be printed straight from the drive... Again, miss syncing with G-Drive!) 3) can't add pics directly to an album... They first get dumped into G-Photos. It can then be hard to find them.

author: Amanda Z
content: App let's you spend time selecting photos (50) to create a movie, only to tell you there's an error once all done at the very end. It's "still processing" and you can't download or even edit so you can share it anywhere! Just spent 30 minutes creating a video and can't do anything with it!! Stupid!!a

author: MrEduard994
content: As a Gallery app, it lacks a ton of basic features. In contrast with other photo apps, it needs better options to choose what to see on the app, what you can do with that and filters (it doesn't even have a "Select all" function). You are shown all the photos on your phone by date at once (even with the "back up" toggle off), just some albums you have and to move pics in them is frustrating. If you want a Gallery app replacement or looking to organize your photos, this ain't it.

author: Vince Caibigan
content: Monthly payment for a storage plan is a big disappointment and simply a waste of money. Why not give it a one-fixed price for a year or a hell of a lifetime? Is being wealthy not enough from you guys? Give us that option and we're good. Also, 15GB is kind-of generous for free users to store photos but I remember the 30GB free storage. What happened? You halfed the free storage to force users to buy limited storing plan. That's sick business!

author: A Google user
content: Doesn't save your albums when switching devices. The pictures exists but not in their respective albums. If I want to see pictures in an album from 2 years ago I'll have to scroll down through all the pictures and look for the ones that belong to that album. Going back to your old device to add that album again? Congratulations, you just uploaded it all over again - duplicates the pictures and they're all recent now too.

author: Ray Saga
content: Google photos used to be amazing,but recently I don't know what's come up. I had this great feature that enabled me to sort photos into folders the very same way I placed them in the folder, nowadays sorting photos has sort of become a gamble. Like it doesn't follow any predated order or any pattern assigned. It varies with every single action I try to sort them into my own customized way. I really hope you could fix this;this app was one of my top 3 best...now,not so much.

author: Haakon Poulsen
content: Duplicates (IE, raw and those on drive) Can't filter, search by extension or file name Sorting is a nightmare, date only is not good design. App settings and ux constantly underwhelming. Can't retrieve photos shared with me by others. Searching every other day online for basic features that are unsupported or notes bugs with no resolution from Google. Google app auto backup changed to high res, when I switch back to original, google doesn't overwrite those already backed up.

author: SukiJane
content: Why does it take hours for me to share an album after adding 4 short videos? It keeps saying it is updating the album! Once it lasted over 24 hours! It should be available right away! Ridiculous!! REPLY: If you send a link why can't it be a link that I can click on instead of having to write it down and then type it in to the search field? I can't even copy it and paste it. This is the problem I'm having with messaging from Google. You can't even select or copy a portion of your text.

author: Vris Serket
content: Used to be really good for archiving all photos on my phone and laptop and being able to access files from my laptop on my phone. Lately the mobile app has completely stopped working though. I can't delete photos or videos, add anything to albums, or access anything uploaded from my laptop whatsoever. I can no longer edit or crop photos either. Photos is my phone's default gallery app so I don't have a lot of other options available to me, and It's making accessing my files extremely difficult.

author: Jen
content: *2nd UPDATE: It's unfortunate that pictures are duplicated still after no fix and paying $10/month fir the storage. Still really miss Picass over this, but I'm sure I'll stay with it bcuz everything thi SO DISAPPOINTED WITH THIS APP. I really wanted something better, but Google Photos is nothing like Picasa was ...and the editing options are almost non-existent, there's almost no point in using this in-app editor. I hope for better...and not too happy that it no longer syncs with drive.

author: amreen
content: I always had issues backing photos up. The photos were never backed up. I recently changed my phone and installed google photos again in the hope of getting all photos again but to my surprise I didnt get any photos back. I have already cleared data of my old phone and reset it. I seriously need my photos please help me get them back. I've already reported on the app but didn't hear back.

author: Liz Stjepanovic
content: You really need to come up with a more user friendly way of allocating photos to albums. It would be great if we could upload albums as they are from the phone to g-photos so we don't have to allocate them manually. It's so overwhelming when you have thousands of photos to organise! Each time you have a new photo you have to do it and it's just too much!

author: A Google user
content: I've had to change my review. Photos refuses to upload automatically - it'll work for a bit, then it'll just decide not to upload any more. Worse, it doesn't 'fail' which presumably would show an error, just shows as 'preparing' forever, so unless you check you'd never know which is just awful for a backup app. Yes, you can usually get it going through a mix of patience, swearing, clearing data and reinstalling, but seriously Google...

author: A Google user
content: Very slow upload. Mannnnnn! Works if you run some music so phone doesn't put the app to sleep. May be faster to use drop box etc for quick saving plans. (I'm trying to back up my phone to upgrade but way too slow, and not enough memory on my computer. A combination of using Samsung and this app together for a compounded problem.) 2 days and counting.....

author: Georgie Shevas
content: Great app for storing all my photos, but can no longer sync my photo albums from my phone gallery straight to the app anymore which makes backing photos up take much longer than before. Big let down. Update: only my camera roll shows on Google photos, not all the albums I've made on my phone. Makes it far more complicated to put albums onto Google.

author: A Google user
content: Bring back "backup while charging only" option! I'm curry on vacation taking a lot of photos, connecting to WiFi here and there. EVERYTIME I connect to the WiFi, the photos start backing up. I would rather save my battery for taking more photos and vacation related phone things. Google let's be smart and bring this basic and awesome feature back.

author: A Google user
content: No straight forward way to assess all your media, independently of origin, in one single folder. Also, the default setting allows photo app to send you messages and emails about new collages they've done with your stuff, which is super annoying. The default should always be less bothering people, not more.

author: A Google user
content: Sync/upload doesn't work properly. If an sd card is installed even if no photos or videos are present on the card the app will not proceed beyond getting ready to back up. Force stop/clear cache/restart will not resolve this issue. The sd card must be unmounted for syncing to proceed. This error has been reported in multiple forums for well over a year.

author: Kristina H.
content: So I LOVED this app. I used to move photos from my photos to an album and it removed them from the photos. But now it moves them but they still show in my photos. Because of this I am out of storage and forced now to buy more space. I'm frustrated because if it just moved them it would duplicate them. I refuse to buy additional storage when this was never a problem before. I am now seeking other photo apps because this is extremely frustrating.

author: John Conrad
content: Horrible. Very difficult to track where the photos are and too easy to accidentally delete them when you think you have save them to another album hard to tell which one are on the device and which ones are in the cloud. Also I dont want anyone to have access to all my albums but I could not figure out how to save photos to an album and then lock it from others. This flaw makes it difficult to store everything in google photos

author: A Google user
content: 😕I am new to google photos, so I expected syncing would save my photos to google. 😐However it only appears on google photos, once you deleted an image on your own device it is also deletes on the app. 😣I feel like I've messed up. There were some were photos luckily saved in google drive instead. As for the others, I can't recover them at all. 😧I sometimes don't like saving in google drive, because you'll have to upload it and move individually to a file you created.

author: TalisienTao
content: Still no changes for the better. Photo storage is what your concern is . Honestly I am sure most of us aren't worried about that . How many remember when you could do really nice editing with you phones photo app. Plenty of small options that arent being added and then changing certain features saying they are improving and as far as i am concerned i dont not see the improvements

author: A Google user
content: My photos won't delete correctly, they take minutes to delete at times or don't delete at all. And at times when they do delete, they don't delete from the storage, just on the app. Every time I have to either switch off and switch on my phone or exit the app and open it again, it also at times causes other apps to force stop and close. I've tried reinstalling, changing memory cards, but nothing works.

author: A Google user
content: Tried creating an album this morning on my phone. However most photos did not show up in the album when I opened Google photos in my computer. Now Google photos is telling me that album is deleted. I feel like there is a "sync" button I need to press but can't find it. It also sucks that if someone shares an album with me I have to download each photo to my phone to add photos to my album. Not intuitive to use

author: Keith Cavey
content: I miss non-destructive editing. Now, even simple changes like rotating or cropping a photo require me to "save as copy", which makes photos harder to manage and increases storage requirements. That was always the #1 killer feature for me - I guess it's time to start looking at 3rd party apps that provide better editing and library management tools.

author: Linda Kricher
content: Nothing mentioned in your list of updated features appeals to me. I'd like to be able to: 1) learn how to select a photo or screen shot, edit it and use it as a contact picture; 2) rearrange (to MY liking) the order of photos in a given album; 3) display my albums however I choose, but at least have an option to do it alphabetically, by name; 4) move pictures sent to me by text or email to an album, or use as in #1) above. IF ALREADY PART OF THE APP, THEN PLEASE MAKE INSTRUCTIONS EASIER 2 ACCESS

author: Mario Ritchie
content: Can be useful at times. But sometimes my pictures are saved (under the 'photos' tab on the app) but will appear under a different date than when I took the pic/screenshot. IE, if I took a photo and saved it on 5/27/23, then it'll appear under a different date, like a few days back, I uninstalled this app to see if the problem is fixed, but it hasn't. This problem is only happening under the 'photos' tab on the app, but it works fine under the other tabs.

author: Julie Garrettson
content: Used to be phenomenal but your techs feel a need to keep changing things around so instead of easy... things are ridiculous! Used to hit 1 button to make a collage but now I hit 3... now I can't even find a way to asend or decend my photos to readjust the chronological order when your app hasn't put pics in the correct order ... and now I have to hit 3 buttons to search a word ... etc. etc... not a happy camper for sure...

author: Nancy Broady
content: This is the worst experience that I have had in years. I CAN'T FIND my photos! Why in the world can't you make this a straight forward thing. I have no control over my own files & pictures. These devices are hooked to Google. Does Google have a stake in every company that makes phones and tablets? When the app takes and stores my photos, they should be stored in a folder that says "Photos" so I can just click on it. I shouldn't click on 1/2 dozen things to get to my photos! Change it!

author: Henry Hurley
content: I keep getting notifications I'm almost out of space. When I try to delete from the app to clear up space, it automatically deletes from my phone too. There's no option to stop this! I've got 1TB of space on my phone, I don't want to delete from my phone! I can turn off sync and delete from the app only, but once I turn it back on, it resaves all those pics again. Let us delete from just Photos! Don't hijack our phones! The photos in my phone are my personal property! Let me keep them!

author: Jose Vieira
content: I'm been generous with this rating, on top of the editing issues already posted I also have issues with the albums, I have my photos in separate folders "albums" as a photo management app it should convert the folders into albums or at least let me add a folder as a album, there's no way to do it. The app is designed just to upload to the Google cloud which I don't use. Hope Google will work on the usability of there apps.

author: Katie Fox
content: The latest update is not an upgrade. The memories are a rip off of some other apps but I cannot watch it all again or go back through the photos. Once I close out of the memories, I can't find it again within the app. The automatically created collages, videos, color pops, ect... Are not nearly as good as they used be and are almost all garbage that I never save, whereas I used to save those wonderful creations all the time. Looking forward to a better update soon, I hope.

author: josh flores
content: With the new update the for you folder is gone. This was a very appealing section, I enjoyed the automated creations. It seems like now when an automated creations is generated and you click on the notification it disappears instead of opening for you to look at. I'd like for them to bring that back.

author: William Rees
content: Excruciatingly slow, buggy & inconsistent. Used to work well but is now slow with pointless, confusing UI changes. Pretty much consistent with the rest of the current Google app lineup. Needs to have more options for organising & managing local and cloud photos as well. Memories, automatic backup and sync are good though. Would like option to automatically delete local copies of pictures once they're backed up.

author: Rachel D
content: Photos have disappeared from my albums. I edited a photo yesterday & saved it, now I can't find it or the original. This is disgraceful, precious memories gone. Surely there are some legal ramifications for deleting someones intellectual property? There is no option to search by size of file so I have to go through every item to check which large files to delete- my storage is full. Pics are randomly backing up in original quality instead of my chosen smaller size, using more storage space. why?

author: javeria malik
content: There are lot of inconveniences. I don't want all the photos to be moved from internal storage to google photos. The folders gets messed up. When sync is off, we can not access already backed up photos. To access them, we have to turn it on, and then again, all the photos gets backup to google. The collage feature is good though.

author: Erin Harker
content: It's great to keep my photos all in one place, but it's not intuitive. There's no option to download back to my phone, despite troubleshooting. Which is beyond irritating. Also, when you move a photo to a folder, it should delete it from the general section. That way it's safe to scroll regardless who you're showing them to.

author: Shayfer B
content: It's impossible to organize photos into separate galleries. ive only had this issue since switching from Samsung to Google Pixel and im really disappointed honestly. I've been making due with what I have for a while, but a bunch of photos r being corrupted because of album transfer and I can't access the photos to know what I've lost. Backup is great and all, but I'd like to have an organized gallery.

author: David Kenney
content: The App was great! The fact that we can no longer store pictures on Google Photos taken after June 2021 for free. Absolute greed! Google has so much money, that couldn't spend it all before he leaves this world. The plan to make more money that they DON'T NEED? Just take a service (app) that's been free for year's and charge people for a service that was free! You lack integrity and I'll be looking for another App and it won't be affiliated with Google! Storage fine & suddenly they charge $.

author: Donald Smith
content: it is not as flexible as my old iPhone. some photos and videos I have to save to clipboard and then can't find them. sometimes I want to post from my albums, but only the gallery is available. moving pictures or videos from albums is problematic. I have tried at least 6 times to download the update and it will not download. Just get the circling.

author: The Good Life Rentals
content: The latest updates are horrific. The editing screen alone and the size that it makes the photo you are editing are awful, as well as all the other changes. The magic eraser was so good. Now, it takes forever, and it is no longer as efficient at automatically erasing items. Just go back to what was not broken!

author: Christine Welcome
content: I really don't know what to say about this app. It's giving me the time of my life (and I don't mean in a good way) to view my backed up photos. I saved so much photos and was given the option to "free up space" from my device. Now the pics aren't even loading in the app. The pics are blank and only some are actually stored. This is terrible.

author: A Google user
content: This app has several cons, likely: 1) In edit photo options, basic features like highlighting certain portion of the photo is not possible unlikely as MS Paint. 2) No option available to mark photos as favourite or starred, so as to find those photos more quickly. 3) Major issue I have faced is, photos that are saved from FB, Twitter, WhatsApp are getting accumulated in the same album named camera and this makes finding photos captured by me with my camera even more difficult. Hope you guys will fix these deficiencies asap.

author: S s
content: Won't save edits to photos, only get "error loading media", takes up the MOST space of ANY app, keeps turning off 'upload only over wifi', keeps turning ON for default no matter how many times I turn it off, and now with the upcoming storage change it won't even be FREE for them to spy on us while they sell our data and learn from our photos what we're likely to buy.

author: Darcie Barr
content: It deletes my photos without permission!!!!!! I've had this app for many many years and I'm tired of it. You can't get all your photos at once off if it. It takes months for them to download and then you can't even save them to ur phone it's gotta be a computer and it constantly crashes. Stupid.

author: A Google user
content: the assistant stuff that it does is absolutely fantastic. the low rating is because sharing photos outside of the Google framework is a giant pain in the ass. downloading my photos to another device is impossible. as soon as I find something that allows easier sharing, I'll never come back, regardless of how cool the assistant features are.

author: Samantha
content: Unreasonable sometimes. Very limited editor. Pop up suggestions won't get out of the way when editing. Can't scrub through video with suggestions like "Export Top Shots" in front of timeline. No X to send it away. Can't find an option to edit video speed. My old Samsung's built in camera editor was better. Only reviewing because I'm at the end of my rope. Want to throw the Pixel 6 out a window.

author: Mo S.
content: The new update is not good. This was an alright app before, but now it has options that I don't need, such as putting your pictures into a collage or putting them on other items such as canvases, and I still have not been able to transfer the photos from my old phone to my new one. It also rather than show your actual photos in the photo section only shows photos that have been shared with you a.k.a., other people's faces and photos. For now, it's just not a good app.

author: Anne Bingham
content: Love the automatic features. I've had problems with the face recognition, though. After a certain number of people it doesn't remember names or profiles. I've gone through and spent hours identifying photos only to have it forget what I labeled or forget the person. Also, when I change the date of a photo it still comes up when searching the old date (which is usually the upload date, not the date the photo was taken). It would be nice too, if you could search photos by text in the description.

author: Tracie Harrison
content: In my experience of the iPhone 11 on up the camera on the apple products are so much better in the whole experience of using the camera process to the photo itself. Much clearer and vivid also in the fact that these cell phones have come a long way , and I don't realize it until you experience them all. Thank you

author: A Google user
content: There are a lot of awesome things about the app, but it takes up way too much storage space. Your job is only to sync the photos on my phone to the cloud, Google Photos. You have no business taking up 510 MB (110 MB app size + 400 MB user data) of my storage space. You can't really say "Never worry about running out of space on your phone again" on your product description when it's that big.

author: Adjoa Nkansah
content: When you go to look at your photos and click on one, you come to realize that the dates displayed in the main page view are not correctly displaying what time and year the photo is actually from. At first, I thought it was because of my old account with doesn't have any storage plan. But now it is happening with my other Google account which has a storage plan. This isn't acceptable when the app is this far into development and knowing how big Google is as a whole.

author: Justin McGrath
content: It doesn't need to do much, yet doesn't manage to do that well. It takes over the sharing menu for photos and there's no way to disable that. It also constantly nags you to update.' Regarding the developer's reply to uninstall the app, that is an incredibly odd reply. Why don't you change the app so that it uses the normal sharing menu, which includes Photos, rather than having a sharing menu that makes it hard to share using anything other than photos? But sure, I'll disable it - it's a system app and can't be removed.

author: A Google user
content: I have ordered books on two previous occassions and was very happy with them. The book I just ordered was a disappointment. On past albums there were alternating full page pics. On this one, The Mohonk Mountain House, there were no full page displays. This is 5-star resort and the pics were outstanding.....but not in the album. I will certainly look for a different vendor next time.

author: Joseph Esposito
content: Many problems with this version. I was not seeing photos added over the past couple of days. I tried all the recommended options force stop, clear cache, restart, etc. Now I see the photos but my albums are missing in the app. All still exist through the browser. The only album visible is the one I updated in the browser this morning.

author: Dakota (Koda)
content: not video friendly. When I switched to my new phone, it didn't have a good file folder, so I just decided to use my Google photos. absolutely impossible to slide the bar, as a "cut video" pops up. nowhere in the settings can you remove it, and it makes no sense as there's a video editor right under it. please fix this or at least allow double clicking on the sides to fast forward/rewind like every other app does now. will not be using besides to back up my phone.

author: A Google user
content: Its confusing and sometimes annoying too ....some of the albums tha i created had automatically vanished and the photos were not shown in any of the albums ...after searching a lot i found them but i had to save them in the device again ...... Also the backup is stopped in between since weeks and it is always shown 'waiting for wifi' although wifi is provided 24/7 to it .

author: A Google user
content: i love most of it, but it keeps deleting photos in a folder that's not marked to be synced and there's no way to turn it off. it also backs up all of your photos in one place, which is a horrible because i have separate folders for separate photos, i dont want to see them all in once place so im only able to back up pictures from my camera app. i want to backup memes and pictures i take with my friends in separate folders and see them in separate places, not all at once in the "photos" tab.

author: eevee Aspie_dextrous
content: Albums are not in alphabetical order which is ridiculous ! Some albums aren't even there (yet they are there when I use a different gallery app) the operating of this is really awkward especially the sharing to Facebook option . It's forever telling me that I can't do anything on my phone until I "clean" up,I think that is just a con to get me to buy more Google storage because half the time it has a problem moving photos to other albums

author: A Google user
content: On my tablet Google Photos is great, has all my photos in it,.  When I first turned on my laptop and Google Photos was there, it showed all the photos, and under Albums it listed all my albums from my tablet, that I had created.  Photos all there.  First day.     But after that they no longer all show.   Now some are missing from my laptop and under Albums none of my created Albums from tablet app show, are not there. None of my own divided up categories that showed the first day.   I am missing crucial photos.  It is not good enough, when you cannot trust the app to transfer everything into other devicesl!   I have to still send the crucial missing photos to myself and download into laptop,to save on an external drive to make sure I don't lose them if my tablet ever crashes!  How good is this?

author: Victoria Edwards
content: The layout is good to use and understand, however, when organising photos and moving them between folders I constantly get a "there was a problem while moving x items" message. This has not been fixed no matter how many times I've updated the app, restart the app, restart my phone and remove and re-insert my SD card. I've also checked my internal and external storage, and both have room to house the transferred files. I've had to resort to using an external files app to re-organise my photos.

author: Jessica Bastantes
content: This new photos app. Is basically just a degraded image of its former self, of course there's some emprovement. Price paid for that Improvement is not worth it one thing that I just loved was when you went to which settings you could choose a comfortable View which makes a big difference when you look at your pictures, also photos not only tend to disappear into nothingness. But it's literally done on a regular basis.

author: A Google user
content: I don't like that I cant personal (manually) click on someone's face & group it together to help the algorithm distinguish between the people in the picture. Especially for people of different nationalities. Sometimes it tries to group together four different people under the same "person" category. For a few months the algorithm wasnt working so it wont pick up any of my pictures from May to August. Why isn't the facial grouping helping anymore? Do I have to reupload pictures to get it to work?

author: A Google user
content: I had google photos. and honestly, it was annoying. Yeah, it does its job but you'll get to a point where you have to decide "Do I keep my original quality or do I just want lower quality and unlimited?" Amazon has way better pricing and actually lets you keep your original quality if you have prime. Either way, Amazon's pricing is much better.

author: Peter Grand
content: i've tested the top 19 Gallery apps, and this is the most clunkiest out all of them. You can't even hide/exclude folders in the Library tab. No dark mode setting, while it's nearly 2025... The "Photos" tab doesn't show anything, it's blank, while i have 80 pictures. With a high-end phone, the first startup took 2 hours (!) to "analyze" (with disabled backup, so it can't be that). No ability to tap the edge of a picture to instantly change to the next. The editor doesn't have a "redo" button...

author: Beckie Smith
content: Not sure what to do with this app. Pictures seem to disappear, can find no way to retrieve them. I also have to agree with Carrie Tohl finding my pictures has become such a chore. I delete duplicates & in a couple of days, they have magically , are back. Also im not seeing any new filters. Instead they pull one of the pictures throw a really Nice filter ,drag you in & never get direction on finding the right App!! SO YOUR SUGGESTION WOULD BE??!

author: MamaNancy23
content: I don't like how this app went into my Gallery and took photos from there and moved then here. Now I can't even find some of my photos. Not only that but this app has grouped them according to date, which may or may not be correct, when I have my photos according to subject and there's no way to change it. I want all of my photos put back where they were but that probably won't happen.

author: D Anderson
content: I find the app so awkward to use and navigate. Automatically saving photos into seperate files is fine but atleast have a "photo roll" option that all pictures go into so I can find what I'm looking for. I also find that, when posting photos on other apps (eg twitter), half the time the picture that I want to post doesn't show up (usually because it's in a different folder). I also don't find it easy to transfer the pictures from my phone to my pc. It just feels overthought..

author: Christos Kyriakopoulos
content: Most of the times I try to delete something, it needs permission to access my storage. Again and again. Often when I delete something it is just not deleted. The thumbnail turns gray, and when I scroll away and come back it is there again. And why can't I see the media from all folders in one place, regardless of whether they are backup up or not? Only the ones that are backed up are shown in the home page, the rest is shown only in separate folders. Search works well.

author: Vaikuntha Krishna
content: Very messy. From several years Google photos app gives me so much trouble. It fails to move images and files to my sd card, and it happens half of the time I try to move anything. Sometimes it whimsically resizes my photos and makes them fully blur. I lost many important photos this way. This week the option to transfer to the sd card completely disappeared! If one is working hard to make an app, why not just make it work properly. Go all the way or not at all!

author: A Google user
content: The search function within Google photos is unrivaled. Unlinking it from being synced with google drive makes absolutely no sense to me. Now I have to use twice the space if i want to have photos in both. No more automatic reflection of photos in google photos that are also in google drive. It was the best gallery app until this move. They said they did this to reduce confusion, but it only added more steps and increased confusion over what photos reside where...

author: Ashish Lirani
content: I spent a lot of time on this app. While I love this app for showing all the memories and creating different categories, it would stop syncing my pictures for days. It won't back up period. I have tried updating the app, clearing the cache, uninstalling,re install, double checking all my settings including back up in data enabled. It also consumes a lot of my battery. My phone gets hot.

author: Jane Alice Van Doren
content: I've been using Photos as my preferred back up and cloud storage for years, but despite paying monthly for extra space, and sending feedback multiple times about an issue I've been having since February of this year, and posting in the help forums about it— I've recieved absolutely no response or assistance. Clearly Google is too big and too busy to maintain the basic functionality of their many services, even the ones that people pay for. Find a better option for your photo library.

author: A Google user
content: I used to love this app, but after this latest update, no edits are saved. My photos aren't in order and I keep getting prompted to buy more storage so I did thinking that was the problem. Nope! Same problems. Cleared cache, etc. It's a Google major glitch. I'm looking for a more reliable app...

author: Nicholas Rice
content: To be honest I only really use the app because it is there and already on the device, saving me the hassle of having to find a new one. The experience is somewhat frustrating, I have been trying to upload a handful of pictures to Google photos across 3 devices and it has not worked. One device said the pictures were backed up but they never showed on my account. It's so frustrating that one has to deal with so many issues just to upload photos.

author: Masha
content: Extremely limited amount of editing functions. You can't even flip the photo, you can't change colors manually, there's no tone/color curves, you can only draw with existing colors and one size brush. I do the majority of editing in the Lightroom and in Snapseed, but it's inconvenient to switch between three different apps just to edit one simple photo

author: Maurizio Carcassona
content: It does its job, but very poorly on the download side. Most of the time, it just doesn't download and then it blocks my phone randomly, or makes it start executing tons of instructions at a time. Along with Play Store, this is the only app that shows this problem. Central memory is fine, storage memory has low usage, and my CPUZ gets extremely hot, despite more demanding apps don't give this problem.

author: sudheer kumar
content: While saving photos on Google is a good option. We don't have the option to download or delete all Google photos at a time to a device. Please update this. And moreover if we have a photo on phone and that was backed up to google, we don't need to be reminded to free up space in device. I just clicked the "free up space" option and lost all my photos from device. Even though they're backed up to google, I can't find pictures from my device so that i can upload directly to a website or some apps.

author: Ishika Bastakoti
content: It's good but can you not build the "free space" for all google pixel mobile or at least a minimum of 25 GB free stoeage?? It would be a good marketing approach in my opinion. Moreover, I don't like how the photos, as lower on the list the pictures go, it won't load without internet which is really annoying as well.

author: Dylan Gadwa
content: Disappointed that it's 2023 and there isn't a better way to organize our photos other than the date and adding them to an Album. No tags, no filters... I've got a lot of different interests and it's important to me to find data sets. Astonishing that this is still the case after so many years.

author: K. D. M. TOP COP 72 (Fruit Bat)
content: Google has made some great improvements over the years but at the same time has done some of the dumbest thing as well. One thing is when you get the suggestions or creative creations if you don't save them when you open the notification and exit, there's no easy way to find them to do whatever you want to do with them. They keep adding stuff and cluttering up the whole User Interface.

author: Sara jaffri
content: Used to be great but now the app has just become painfully slow. The backup and sync has so many bugs and a lot of the times just wouldn't bother backing up for weeks. Searching for something is a never ending struggle even with a lot of the photos and videos labeled and sorted. This app used to be a favorite but has now just become annoying.

author: Joody Looey
content: I miss the previous Google Photos editor. Favorite motion photo edit features no longer available: 1) Cannot export/navigate frames, 2) Cannot export to animated gif or video. This feature was extremely helpful when taking photos of active children. Current version is less integrated: Cannot choose external editor apps from Other menu. Editing features are less efficient.

author: DeJuan Patrick
content: Not a fan of the new layout out. My favorite feature of the app are the suggestions for collages, movies, and animations. Now you can only see the suggestions if you log into the computer. When I am not near my computer, I use the suggestions from the Samsung photo gallery to post on social media which is not nearly as robust as Google Photos, but it's all I have.

author: Omar M
content: This app doesn't work well. I am starting to move away from it. I can't move pictures to a folder easily. After I move a bunch of pictures, it tells me "0 pictures added". Sometimes it adds the pictures to a folder and then removes them later. If I create a folder out of lots of pictures (say 300 or 800), the folder doesn't open and keeps saying " loading photos". It also doesn't follow the way you organize your photoes on your mobile. And it deletes them unless you specifically disable it

author: Thomas L
content: They've made all the features much worse. Now if you edit the colour balance in a photo, and then go back and crop it, it will remove all your colour balancing. It feels like they sabotaged the user experience so they could tell shareholders it's running on AI. Can you edit a photo easily? No. Could you before? Yes. But maintaining a usable photo app doesn't make stock prices go up

author: Ole Jørgen Brønner
content: A mechanism for non-cloud transfer of locked folder is needed, but at least it's (practically) possible to get the photos from the device now. It's not possible to move photos to locked folder from within an album... No sorting on video length, no bulk delete from device of selected items. In general of ton of basic stuff needed to manage photos and videos is missing. The backup is really bad at running in the background. Would be less severe if the upload wasn't dog-slow.

author: Martin Aichberger
content: So 500 character reviews? Wonder who thought that was a good idea, cause you know, it isn't. Guess I have to keep myself brief. Don't modify my photos when I move them to another folder, because that makes sorting by the modified date meaningless, so thanks for making the best way to sort photos completely useless for almost all my photos and let me change the preview photo of my folders. Tell me when those changes have been made I'll change my review.

author: A Google user
content: So it used to work before but now that I updated it the whole application is broken. Archived photos are popping up in my camera roll and won't go away. Photos I put in an album are filling up my phone with so many duplicates. The app won't respond to any of my commands when I try to delete, edit, or sort my photos. It's essentially useless as of right now.

author: ocelot the great
content: I am tired of defects present in Photos: when i add a new text label on desktop, all text labels are messed up and mixed. There are more bugs. Please introduce removal of duplicates (even for rotated ones). Please introduce a feature when photo is removed from general pile of photos when added to album. I need to have a possibility to correctly sort my photos by putting them in albums, but this is not possible because when i add photos to album they still remain in the main pile of photos...

author: A Google user
content: Please!!!! bring back the old feature that had the main auto backup folder that emptied as you put the pictures in albums. That was the greatest feature in managing photos as it allowed me to stay organized and find duplicates and similar photos much easier to clean up my albums. 5 stars for sure if that was brought back!!!

author: Wiktor Piwowarczyk
content: I don't usually write reviews, but the last update ruined the core feature of the app for me. In family and group of friends, we make albums from events and share them with others. Before, I could choose which of these albums appear in my library. I could still see all of them in the sharing section, but only the ones important to me in the library. Now i would have to leave the album completely not not see it. Or I need to scroll through all albums to find the one I want to see. Horrible design

author: A Google user
content: I used to love this app. I could count on it to save all my photos and it gave me comfort knowing if something unexpected ever happened to my phone, I could always find my pictures again. But I upgraded to a new phone recently, and now this app is not working. It gets stuck when backing up my photos. It'll show me it has 44 photos to back up, and hours later, I go back to the app and it will still show the same 44 photos backing up. I'm very disappointed with this and I hope it gets fixed soon.

author: A Google user
content: App is useful to back up photos in case you lose your phone or need to factory reset, however it is not a pleasure to use. Screenshots are automatically backed up in the same folder as the camera photos and this is annoying because screenshot folders are usually just a bunch of random useless memes that you want to share with friends and then delete, not keep forever! There's no option to separate them and no way to disable backing up screenshots. Please fix!!!

author: Mrs. Sherri C
content: This is a great App. I just wished it didn't constantly run in the background. Plus, it's always using data, even when I choose to force stop all background processes and/or activity, this App stays active no matter what. In which I find to be incredibly annoying & extremely frustrating! Also this App is constantly draining my phone battery. I'm not happy! Can you please fix the battery draining issue at the very least. This is why I rated this App with only ⭐⭐ (2 Stars).

author: A Google user
content: Pretty good. I've had better and worse. I don't like that when I text a friend a pic they have to view it through the Google album book vs. seeing it in the text I just sent them. Wish there was more filters and options for creativity, Or that I can name my own picture folders.Sometimes the pics I marked up disappear or won't show up for me to text. It's like a scavenger hunt trying to find the pics I edited.

author: Nancy Tedford
content: I think it's too much. Hard for me to understand. I'm sure it has a lot to offer, just not sure what to do with all of it. I feel like it has more control over my photos than I do I've got to add this today. Google photo app is running my pictures crazy. I don't know if I need to uninstall the app or what. I know y'all know what you're doing, and y'all need to sell your product evidently, but were you thinking this was best for us? I need my very own assistant for my photos. Someone to come over

author: N P
content: I honestly really miss my old Samsung android photo app. This one makes it really difficult to send photos over other apps like Instagram and fb messenger. You have to really dig to find images not taken on this phone. And you can only send one at a time and then you have to dig again to find the rest. Makes sending multiple photos through other apps time consuming and frustrating.

author: A Google user
content: OnePlus 7 Pro. There are bugs to be worked out. Now when i try to set wallpaper for the new Android 10 on the 7 pro, i get distortion in the images. Vertical stretch, and horizontal compression, I've tried restarting and changing the way I saved the photo and different parts of the photo. I'm sure there are other bugs but i haven't found anything else yet.

author: Lucas
content: The new editing software is a horrible downgrade to what previously existed. I do not like it at all. I want the ability to edit my already edited photo. It's crazy that I can't do that anymore. Additionally, I want to be able to do the corner edit cropping that I could before, where I could drag the corners anywhere and it would skew the picture to fit. Why was this removed? Finally, I hate that there's no option to save as a copy anymore. W

author: Katie Silsby
content: Had this app for donkeys years. Loved it till the new update. Before the update it would show you what happened 1,2,3,4 etc years ago and I loved looking at photos I took all those years ago, especially on the kids birthdays when I could see how they've grown over the years but they got rid of this amazing feature and now it's 'remember this' or 'days at the beach' with the most random of photos from over the years. I miss looking at photos from the same day/ week. Please change it back Google.

author: Ira Chesley
content: A great photo backup app that gives an amazing amount of storage for free and does everything you'd want. as long as what you want is to let Google control everything. every update that they have pushed has moved the user farther and farther away from using local storage to store photos and made it more and more difficult to manage them being either backed up, only on device, or both. and for obvious reasons. the more you rely on Google the more you'll have to pay for storage. despicable.

author: Celeste
content: Updates change the saving of photos, creating copies of photos I just want to replace with my edits. Moving folders from one folder to another takes forever and usually doesn't work. Often I can't even edit my photos. It also has problems editing photos that are moved from different folders. Also, sometimes when I move photos from one folder to my main folder, it doesn't even show up in all my photos. Finally, the SD card permissions make me download a different app.

author: A Google user
content: I want to resize photos to attach to emails. But there is no way that I can see to do it. You would think Google could make things clear and intuitive. I think the people who write these apps are so introspective they have no idea of how a user perceives the app. I don't want to change my photo with 21 effects to Sunday. All I want to do is resize it!!

author: Liz F
content: Takes forever to back up files, especially videos. Really difficult to organize the files that do get uploaded since the app can't see most of the folders in my phone's gallery. There's almost never an option to Select All, and on the mobile app there's no way to move photos to trash when you're looking at them in an Album. There seems to be no rhyme or reason to this app. I'd love to switch to a different app, but I have too many years' worth of photos on there for it to be worth the hassle

author: Travis Be
content: I really liked this app, but I am taking stars away because I can't find the Google created creations from my photos. The animations and Then/now comparisons are so cool but I can only find them from the notification, never in the app. Sometimes I get two notifications and only get to see one creation and that makes me sad.

author: Sim Dhaliwal
content: Suggest that there should be an option to export all photos to phone w/o messing the timeline. Used sync before but never experienced all my photos being deleted from the device; accidentally pressed free up space. Had 3k photos now only have 200+ left. Sync was on, good that my photos were backed. However hate that I have to download them in device, once downloaded, they don't go by their "date taken" anymore. old photos are now below my gallery i have to scroll further to find recent photos.

author: A Google user
content: It gets the job done but I hate the glitches. -I tried to sync, upload, and transfer the folders in my Samsung phone and it just dumped all the images in without folders. -Also, when I'm moving photos around on mobile, when I create a album to add photos to sometimes it just doesn't create. And the photos don't always transfer -And sometimes the albums miscount the number of photos in them. -Not to mention, I really wish I could turn off the feature that just randomly creates and suggests random albums for you. Like, just give me a space to put my photos so I can move them from my phone to my pc by the album.

author: Pablo Gardella
content: Nice and efficient app with wonderful features like the autorecognition. However, so far it's not possible to do something as simple as to group several albums in one category. Not having any sort of hierarchy is frustrating when one wants to look for a particular album among many others. Another drawback I found is that shared albums are not the same as personal albums and many features get lost. For example geographical filter did not work for me on a shared album but it worked on a personal

author: Eve M
content: The editing interface changed completely: - the options are grouped into categories that make no sense. - trying to tilt a frame slightly became almost impossible as no matter how quickly I raise the finger it still adjusts my selection to a different value. - if I choose to save the photo (not saving a copy), and then try to edit it again, I receive an error message and my previous changes are lost. On the plus side, erase functionality works better, but the overall app performance is slower.

author: brenda flick
content: When doing a screenshot to send via text, I get an error message asking for access to my photos. Access has already been given, yet it won't sent directly from a screenshot as before. I have to select from photos to send. May seem silly to some, but it's frustrating as the other way was quicker.

author: smol bean
content: It's really clunky to use. I hope that you can delete pictures "collectively" and back up pictures in "albums" "specifically". when i try to back up photos, it backs up "ALL", I DONT NEED TO BACK UP ALL OF MY PHOTOS. ONLY A SELECT FEW. please let us choose them in albums, not one by one in pictures.

author: Andrew Draper
content: Google Photos keeps trying to turn on cloud storage for my photos even though I've repeatedly told it no. I believe that Google Photos has turned it on at least once without my consent. But the button for cloud storage often pops up on a slight delay directly over the menu at the bottom, so I've also pressed it accidentally more than once while trying to quickly navigate to folders. I like some of the other features, but stop making it so frustratingly difficult to opt out of cloud storage.

author: A Google user
content: I would give it five, because it does what needs to be done for the most part, but there's something happening with device folders and the fact that it isn't getting fixed is irritating. I've organized all of my photos multiple times now, and I'm about to just find one of these gallery apps and use that instead.

author: Doug Hooymans
content: It was perfectly fine before the last update. Now, in order to look at different photos on my device, I have to hunt through the "collections" menu for absolutely no reason. What possible logic could there be in making the user experience more complicated and obtuse. I used to think Google knew what they were doing. I guess they got rid of "be competent" when they got rid of "don't be evil".

author: Ahmad Zufar
content: This app used to be fine. All of sudden after several times I ignore the update notification, a lot of photos doesn't appear in google photos, then I tried to update it and return to normal. After that, something worse is happening. The app reback up the file that I already back up. What happened? I hope I can get a proper solution. Thank you.

author: A Google user
content: It's fine for taking photos/video out of your phone but its really hard to get them back (I wanted to use some to make a movie on my laptop and had to find a way of making the clips save to my laptop so I could select and use them. It makes silly animations of your pictures all the time as well. Wish I could upload from Google to a file on my computer more easily. Otherwise it's OK enough that I will keep it rather than delete it.

author: Felice Donatiello
content: When you have a hundred albums and you try to save photos in a particular album, it can take a while to search for it. IF ONLY there was an actually search by name to save it would be amazing. It's literally takes minutes sometimes just to find the right album to store a certain photo in. Is that a function where you could search for the particular album name it would be a lifesaver. Get on it Google.

author: Grant N
