content: App needs to take away features or something. It is very complicated to find where images are located. Some images save to messages, some to Snapchat, some to insta folders with almost no rhyme or reason. With that, it is very difficult to integrate photos with any other app because they can't dig into all of these random folders and locations on your phone so you can't find the picture you want to post on Instagram for example. Get rid of the printing and the collages like what...

author: Evans Burgess
content: New update is a game ruiner. The most useful edit feature was the keystone/perspective cropping tool. I used it regularly when taking a photo of a document or an old photo. That feature is totally gone! Instead there is an AI auto frame that actually adds made-up pseudo - letters/words. It also now replaces the original in the Photos stream, whereas it was a choice. It's like Google thinks we're babies and thinks it knows what is good for us.

author: A Google user
content: I loved the idea of it but when I try to create a video it wont let me actually save it or share it on social media. I've wasted half a day trying to get this to work but the video wont get out of processing after several hours. Reading up on this people are 10 months and still waiting. Sounds like it's best to find a other app. I was really happy with the video so I'm extremely disappointed I can't use it or have to wait hours or months to use it, if it loads up.

author: Jason T
content: I don't like the regular popups asking me to backup my photos. There needs to be a setting to disable this annoyance. I also don't like the automatic "collections" that it makes of my photos. It doesn't make sense. I can't tell if the collection is on my SD card or internal storage so I'm always mixing them up because the names are similar. Another unnecessary annoyance that should just be built into the app

author: Kayleigh Meek
content: Firstly, I used to love this app. And if the improvements were made I'd go back to 5*. Unfortunately over the last few weeks it's just not been working as it should . My data has gone through the roof & I haven't changed the number of photos. Also, uploads are taking days if not weeks to back up. This used to be such a reliable backup but now its not the case. I've troubleshooted, followed all to try and solved this but the new update seems to be the issue.

author: Marat Kudaibergenov
content: I am really disappointed that the ability to adjust corners when cropping pictures is gone. This was my most used feature when dealing with documents. The auto-frame doesn't seem to work with documents. Please bring it back. It's extremely inconvenient to have to use 3rd party apps to do something I used to be able to do in Photos.

author: A Google user
content: It is decent.. However I found a huge issue. When trying to organize on my phone or through USB via computer it is extremely difficult to sort files. I wish there was a function that made it to easier to differentiate my files. The most annoying thing is when you take pictures in portrait mode it creates ANOTHER picture that does not have a blurred bckgrnd THEN A FOLDER WITH JUST THOSE 2 PICTURES... FOR EACH PORTRAIT PICTURE. Why?!? Why is each folder individual instead of a folder for portrait?

author: be awesme
content: Editing is fairly easy but still a struggle. Creating own Folders and sub folders isn't allowed. So it's hard to find things when you need them. You can create picture groups to try and find things easier but use is so limited it's hard to use. Groups can share pictures easily but no subgroups are allowed within the group. This makes it hard to catagorize and we have to use other app options for that. It's storage options were great but now will be limited. So another negative for this app.

author: Darren Hanchar
content: Help! Just upgraded to the new s23 ultra. Made the switch over and went to open google photos. Only shows half of the pictures backed up. I went to the photos web page and they are all on there online but the app won't show them. I tried everything from reinstalling Photos app to deleting app data and cache. Trying to make it reset. Nothing is working! I just want my pictures back without having to go through an internet browser.

author: LNX
content: almost, not quite For some reason, it's impossible to control how pictures are accessed when the phone has external storage (microSD). Even when external storage is selected, the default picture options throughout Android default to the standard internal folders; meaning regular moving of pictures is needed as some apps don't allow folder access to other than standard folders. Facebook being one of them btw. As good as Google pictures is via desktop/browser, it's not quite there on mobile.

author: Jean Vilmenay
content: Still think you should add a delete option to the archive suggestion! Love the collage and canvas ideas. Something they are difficult to locate them again. A place to save these would be awesome. Just because we don't want to order them at that moment, doesn't mean we are not wanting to at a future date. So a save/save for later option is a win for us both!

author: A Google user
content: Make it so I have the option of putting my albums in alphabetical order and I'll give you a better rating. I've had to factory reset my phone and now when I resize and save my pictures, they revert back. The resize doesn't save! when I went to upload to fb, it did save but want showing in my pictures! So frustrating! This current update really messed things up. FIX THEM!

author: Avitra Angelica
content: While the app is overall good, the new UI is painful. The image is now very small on the screen, especially in cropping, which makes it very difficult to, say, crop to the edges of paper without cutting off parts of a drawing, or otherwise using the tools provided with any degree of precision. Fixable-ish by using the google photos site on a PC, but horrible in-app if not on a huge tablet.

author: A Google user
content: Wish when you put something in an album it took it off your front of. I have photos of an open wound that automatically pop up when I open my photos and I don't want them to. I want them closed in an album until I open it because if someone is beside me it grosses them out. Also app seems hard and confusing to me.

author: Chazie Antunes
content: Bad... Honestly, I preferred the good old stuff where you just had your photos on your smartphone, and when it was too much, you just placed them in your pc files, and nothing gets lost. Now, photos get lost, backup into my so-called Google account but I can't even find it, the app creates files I don't want, or categorising them by location or event type... Duuuuude, I just want a normal timeline photo app with no bling bling or whatsoever. And I (!!) want to decide if I open a folder or not.

author: Tiffany Longcor
content: it's fine. but I wish it would go back to organizing it by day and not by the full month. it's harder for me to organize everything. and I hate the "shots available" that shows up on every single video. I basically only take videos - I don't want to see the shots. I just want the videos and I can't scroll through the video as easy when I have to exit out the stupid "shots available" on every video.

author: J T (Exanime)
content: Terrible app. Finding old photos is basically impossible, search feature never returns a thing useful and if it gets close you can't do anything to help yourself (like jumping from a close result to the rest of the photos taken that day). "Select all"? Forget it, click on each photo like an idiot all day please The entire thing is a pastiche of "discoverable" design which simply sucks and it's not even similar enough to other Google apps to make it somewhat intuitive

author: Lilac Smile (Lav)
content: It was good at first and kept my storage neatly until this month were all of my folders that were made by apps to storage images,gifs, videos disappeared and I could only create albums which I'm having trouble with, and it's been a real haslet to deal with trying to find things from the past and share it, but the backing up was probably the only good thing about it.

author: A Google user
content: I don't find this very user friendly. It's confusing and difficult to organize my photos and it's got very limited options. I used to have a Huawei and I really liked the way the gallery worked on that phone. iPhone is also more user friendly than this. I wanna be able to have a list of albums and decide what order etc but everything backed onto the cloud always shows and it's just a ball ache

author: A Google user
content: The app has lots of problems with refreshing and syncing its state. I can't see shared albums, and starred photos are not syncing correctly even on fast connection. It feels the app feels does not follow the single source of truth principle from the user point of experience. The web version is much more reliable.

author: Casie Calm
content: The app is good in general. However, now that I have no more free space and wish to purchase more space, it is not allowing me to do so. 5 a result, I have to delete some of the very same photos I wish to save in order to save new important ones. I'm not begging for free space. I just want to purchase more space. For this reason, only I am upset about the whole Google experience.

author: Jess Thompson-Gray
content: The fact that I can't download more than one photo at a time from Google Photos to my phone storage is absolutely ridiculous, especially when I'm using a Google Pixel phone. I can click on a single photo and select 'Download' but once multiple images are selected that feature isn't available. More and more likely I'll be switching to iPhone next time I upgrade.

author: Peter Kut
content: This app was phenomenal for years! The latest update has taken away one of the editing features that I used constantly! I can no longer take pictures of a book on an angle, (to prevent flash glare), and then edit them, utilizing the feature that has been removed, to bring them forward in the picture. I'm not sure of the name of the feature that was removed, but I can't find it anywhere and I would love to have that feature back! Or at least figure out how to utilize it in the new update.

author: Jeremy Mukes
content: This opinion may be aimed moreso at the Android os than the photo app. I would prefer that when I take a picture and the save it,the picture would be in only one location unless directed to do so otherwise. I hate it that my storage gets cluttered with multiple versions of the same photo as if Everytime ive opened,edited or sent a picture with a different app, it's as if there's another copy saved. This is only speculation on my behalf. I find it quite annoying and dumb imo.

author: Matt Montero
content: The new video controls are terrible. They consume the entire screen, almost, and the play button is stuck over in the corner like a forgotten element, instead of the most important thing. Maybe it's because I've scaled up text, but even then, there's no excuse for such an awful change from the old video controls, which worked fine at my settings. Go back and fix it, Google.

author: Melinda Smith
content: Photos is my go-to storage solution but lately the bugs are crazy! Creating a shared album has been glitchy. I created an album yesterday afternoon and it didn't finalize or send the sharing invitations until just a few minutes ago. The Back-up option is updating items that were already backed up before the High Quality limit was imposed. Just now, the app closed and told me, "Photos closed because this app has a bug. Try updating the app after its developer provides a fix for this error."

author: ajax
content: The videos I favourite after a while keep disappearing from the favourites section and it turns grey and I can't play it but it's still there in the section. I've complained about this many times and nothing seems to be done about it. The favourites is useful since I usually save a lot of edits on my phone and it saves me from checking each folder I have for the best ones. Please fix this for crying out loud.

author: Rachael Deas
content: Where has Magic Eraser gone?! I just got my new Google Pixel 6 pro and was excited to try out the magic eraser but it's just not there! I've tried updating the app and restarting the phone, but not joy. Edit after Dev reply: The only options available under tools are blur and colour focus. My problem isn't that I can't use it, it's that it isn't there. So no, I'm afraid an article telling me how to use a tool that isn't in the app anymore doesn't help :(

author: Lori Wilson
content: At first I gave a 5 star because it was good. I just went on there to order some photos and the app is duplicating orders and it doesn't show up until later. I tried to cancel one of the orders and it won't let me. This need to be fixed because I am not paying for a duplicate order. Get it fixed Google. I have explained what the app is doing it is duplicating orders when you order prints and charging my card. I have tried several times to get in touch with support or to cancel this order.

author: Jesse B
content: Keeps photos safe for free UPDATE: free turned out to be an "introductory" price, although I believed it and recommended this for several people I now need to make sure understand that it will cost money soon - grrrr. It was too good to be true alas. It's still a functional app, I'll have to see how expensive it ends up being and what other options exist. We have a few months more of free first. Update 2: Switched to Amazon Photos for unlimited lossless backups of photos for prime members.

author: Tasha Marie
content: The dates have been so out of sync for the last few days. I've had to look through photos in a certain month that are actually dated from a month or so before. Today though, photos past a certain year just refuse to load, and when I try to scroll to the bottom it stops at March 2011 even though I have photos dated from 1986. This is on top of the ongoing issue I've had with the facial recognition which ignores my settings. I've had to correct & remove the same photos countless times.

author: A Google user
content: The new look layout feels like a step backwards. The awful highlights carousel at the top is not fun or enjoyable in any way. Why set a time limit to look at a photo? The 'For You' section was far far far better. I can still use it on the desktop. Where is it in the app? Really disappointing.

author: David Sempere
content: Do you want a gallery app that doesn't work well? One that, you'd hope, connected with the google photos service on your computer but doesn't? Do you want a app that you thought stored data in googled cloud services but instead basically just stores it directly on your phone? Yes, well i have the app just for you, a frustrating mess of an app that chugs when you want to do anything besides putting in photos and videos

author: A Google user
content: Great App for sorting and storing your pics BUT I recently updated the app on android and found out it had deleted 90% of my pics from my 'gallery' folder on my phone. Gutted. The only way I can retrieve them is to 'save to device' but there are hundreds. Lost without them. 😒😒 help!

author: A Google user
content: Google Photos used to be so good and so fast, but what I'm now seeing is that my photos no longer sync automatically and it has been at least 5 days since my photos were backed up. I can't get it to back-up despite using several methods, so I'm probably going to have to uninstall/reinstall.

author: Nathan Epps
content: At this point Google should already know that this app is officially unstable. Especially after the June Update for the Pixel 6. As you probably saw, the app is constantly crashing. But it's not just a soft crash, it requests you to literally uninstall the application. There's no way to access the app info to clear the cache or anything. It's absolutely unstable and only Google has the power to make this app usable again. 2 stars cause I can at least still scroll through my photos.

author: DW H
content: For the most part I really enjoy this app and will probably pay for more space when the time comes up. However with that said the most frustrating thing is the fact that it doesn't keep their folder structure from your local device. I'm sure a lot of people have their photos organized on their phone but when they upload to Google photos it's all lost.

author: Chris Bice
content: This app would appear to be a good way to keep a copy of photos safe but it lacks key functionality and I now wish I'd not used it. I was swapping phones and decided to back up my photos and videos from my old phone using this service. The issue is a lack of ability to perform a restore to my new phone. I can download one photo at a time but not all together or a selection. Pretty useless in my opinion.

author: Amanda Frye
content: Your choices for compilation are undesirable, I can't choose which picture to be each album cover, and I can't organize and group my pictures the way that I want. The locked folder feature isn't user-friendly. Also, I shouldn't have to backup and sync to every cloud on the www,but not be able to retrieve anything when I get a new device. I have lost irreplaceable memories to the cloud in this way, more than once! Also, the edit feature in the paid google1 app is poor!

author: Sam Amaya
content: Good and bad things, but unfortunately they bad outweigh the good. Google is great at a lot of things. But photos is not one, now the features are good, such as pic to text and cropping capabilities. But the cloud aspect is frustrating. I can back up my pictures, but when they are backed up, and I want them back, stored on my phone, I have to download, every one of my pictures manually. Please make a "download all pics to device" button. And make the app less reliant on internet connection.

author: Diane Robinson
content: I'm tired of the Google photos best shot and the constant suggestions when I view each picture. A message pops up on each picture, either saying, fix lighting, order photo, rotate screen, archive, etc. It's annoying. Also, I don't like the best shot feature. I'll edit my pictures if I want to. I don't need these constant annoying suggestions. Please fix this. Thank you.

author: Pinky Bishnoi
content: I've been using this app for many years now but the past year it's been doubling all of my photos and videos, doesn't let me choose folders i want to back up which i made, the double photos uses most of my space in the app, all the features are awesome but please fix these problems. I've years worth of memories in there. ***It's always backing up photos which are already backed up. It's always backing up 1000+photos of my albums.

author: Nicholas Wells
content: I teetered on 3 stars because the app can be confusing and Google has a better editor that would make it a more powerful app. But all and all its a decent app with great Android integration. 2020-11-23 UPDATE Keeps crashing whenever I try to get a share link for my album and then can't send feedback without okaying data collection permissions.

author: Alexis Dixon
content: I have been using this app for about 10 years now. At first I lovedddd it bc it automatically backed up my photos and that was it. Exactly what I needed. But now it just seems like spyware and really intrusive. For example why is every photo being grouped into a category (woods, food, swimming, playground)? I can't turn this feature off but I don't like it because it means all of my pictures are being looked at.. Even the private ones. I will be finding another cloud service as soon as possible.

author: Kevin Harrington
content: 1/21/23: Thanks developer for answer, however what works on albums doesn't work for folders. 1/16/23: App no longer files photos by date order in a folder. Sometimes the last photo put in a folder is the 1st shown, sometimes if a photo is edited it will be next to the original sometimes it is 1st. 5/18/20: App doesn't rename photos, must use "files" app. If you move a pic to another folder, it's date & file name changes so a pic from any date when moved becomes today's date.

author: A Google user
content: It's okay generally. However, I lost a lot of my holiday photos recently dispite being logged into my account. I checked that they were backed up on the Google photos app. They were all there. Deleted them from my phone. Went back to upload and print and they were all gone. Gutted. Still not back photos up now. I've gone back to the old fashioned way of saving on a hard drive.

author: A Google user
content: Having numerous photos over the years, they continually get jumbled around with no way to move them. Plus I don't enjoy binning copies of over 1000 pics when they seem to get copied, meaning I lose half my data space until I work my way through sending them to the bin. Also when I look at pics I find them being repeated in all different parts of my albums usually 3 or 4 times. Very nauseating.

author: Dan Paul
content: Does basic things adequately I suppose but lacks many features and the ones that it does have are clunky. For instance, rotating photos, a process that happens often with phone pictures, requires you to click edit, then crop(?), rotations then save. This slows you down considerably when editing. There's no option to flip on either axis and no filter to create a negative. I guess this is good enough for hasty pics on Facebook but if you want to do any real editing, then this app isn't much use.

author: Julie Firth
content: Twice now I've updated this and then took it off again. The reason being is when you update it, half of the things that are used to be able to do or changed or you have locked them. Honestly what do you get out of missing people about. I used to be able to make a collage and arrange the photos as I wanted now you just plunk anywhere and I can't do anything about it. Put it back as I originally found it

author: Tony Dávila
content: Can't believe you guys got rid of one of the most useful features of the app - the map. It was super easy to find a photo if you knew where it was taken, by looking at the map and picking it out from the location. Not surprising though, Google always kills off the most useful features. It's like you get pleasure from it. You guys were cool when you had the "Don't Be Evil" motto.

author: Josh Stewart
content: Google forces permission to view photos on your phone, so that you can view the photos youve uploaded. If you dont give this permission, it will not allow you to access the app, with only a grey screen and a prompt to 'go to settings'. For a big company like Google, youd think theyd know better than to force intrusion to view content on your phone in order to access features that have absolutely nothing to do with that. Absurd.

author: Kellyn Marie
content: Edited what response: so conversations went from a single button at the top to bring hidden five layers deep in the settings. Thank you for telling us how to get there, but please, please bring back the simple button at the top for conversations. I used to love Google photos, it was simple, straightforward, and easy to navigate. But now I can't find anything! Specifically albums, shared albums, and most importantly conversations through Photos on my phone. Why change it??

author: Joshua Baltaxe
content: Yup... since the June 2, 2020 update photos will not backup unless I have the app open and on screen (not in the background), and even then it takes forever. Additionally, forget adding any of those photos you're trying to upload to shared or existing albums. I pay for high resolution storage, and now have no use for it. Please fix!!! Could be a problem because I'm still a Note 8 user; however this is the first app that has glitched on me so far.

author: A Google user
content: while it's quite easy to use and share, what annoyed me the most is that photos and videos kept duplicating itself on the app and in the gallery. So when I share, I find low quality duplicate photos that I have to manually delete. So far I haven't seen a solution to this, nor a fix.

author: Joseph Ward
content: Where do I begin? First off 3outta 5 xs I can't send a photo to another app! I select the photo,and send it to the app but it never gets there! Who knows where they go,I sure don't!Would you mind sending my photos back, bc they're mine.But apparently not!! This happens with a strong wifi signal, it's frustrating to have your photos out in lala land, Photosville or wherever they go! Just send them back! Also why can't we put our photos in the order we want them to be,it would be so nice

author: Peg Torres
content: It's just a pain. If I take a screenshot of something important to me I don't need it made fancy. I enjoy editing my own photos. NEW REVIEW August 22, 2022: My previous review hasn't changed except my annoyance has increased. I'm always hypervigelant about the risk of others having access to my photos through FB. I'm going to find and use another photo app.

author: Enriqueta “Queta” Cansino
content: Not all functions function...ongoing problem. I take lots of photos and video of family, and they ask me to share all the time. I used to be able to, but I haven't been able to share ANY of my photos or albums, for a couple of months now. When I click on "share," a window pops up to "try later;" been "trying later" for weeks now. And support? Forget about it. Nonexistent or sporadic at best.

author: Jennifer Fournier
content: Missing simple tools that would really help organizing. If I select a bunch of images to add to an album that I want to then archive, there's no way to either "select all" or "archive" from within the album. But if I go back to the main photo list where I can select "archive", everything I had just selected must now he re-selected, again. This is horribly cumbersome if you're trying to clean up a lot of photos. The app also isn't currently maintaining my device folders. Hoping that's user error.

author: Tony Wallbank
content: This app is getting worse. It keeps trying to get me to turn backup on, and when I refuse it selects about 200 photos and asks me to backup these. The only way out if this is to close the app at that point. Its a real nuisance when I just want to open the app to show someone my pics. Instead I have to fiddle around stopping it uploading 200 photos, which one started can only be paused (by pausing the app) and is impossible to stop. Come on Google. You can do much better than this.

author: A Google user
content: Just another app that "ok" but still missing features and is over simplified. Can we please not Implement an easy way of starring or favoriting photos in a very quick manner? Maybe a left a right swipe like Tinder? we all create hundreds of photos and we need to dig through and get the ones that are really good.

author: Amanda Ravendes
content: Convoluted and frustrating. Photos were mass moved from my phone to Google Photos, so now I cannot access them through most apps for sharing or editing. But to redownload them to my phone one by one? It's ridiculous. YEARS worth of photos removed from my phone. Also does not keep photos organized by albums created on my phone. Will likely start utilizing OneDrive, Dropbox, or another service if I need to back up my photos/videos.

author: Nick Luchsinger
content: Ground-breaking search features and some other really cool stuff in a really sloppy app that is very inconsistent about saving changes to photos and albums, especially when viewed across multiple devices or with a poor internet connection. Some editing features are best used on a phone, and some are best on a browser. The experience is really inconsistent and it feels like the product has been partly abandoned in the last couple years. And I'm using it on a flagship phone (Pixel 7 Pro)...

author: Jacob Walker
content: Buggy and intrusive. If you only want some photos backed up, forget about it. Even with cloud backups disabled, Photos will still crawl through every folder on your phone to find photos, then back them up to the cloud without your permission. There is no way to disable this. For Google Home devices, photo frame capabilities are very problematic. Albums will refuse to update when more photos are added. Newer albums won't even show up as selectable.

author: Patti Jones
content: Hate the photo app. Half the time I can't bring up my photo albums where I put 90% of my stuff. And when I do find the albums it's only a few not all of them. Hey when I can't find my pictures. Would prefer when you put them in an album that they go off of the list of pictures. That way I don't have pictures in three places including the cloud.

author: John Healy
content: A labyrinth. What is the point of having this app and the Google Gallery app? They are so siloed it's an incredibly frustrating experience trying to simply locate a photo you've edited in Gallery to print in Photos. Want to download all the photos in an album? Well apparently that's too much to ask. You have to download them individually. It's a mess.

author: Dhiman Dutta
content: Everything is up to the mark as a gallery or photos app but as also like a cloud storage for photos and videos is not good as we can't even create a folder. Organising is very poor because of it. Which forces me to switch to a different cloud based service to pay and organize my every bit of memory not just like a large (unorganised) gallery By the way it's not about deleting I have mentioned about organising

author: Samantha Alcalá Subias
content: Very messy & Limited All the photos get ate merged in Camara folder, even if you create folders and move them. Settings has very limited options vs other apps, you really need to merge this with Gallery Go. If delete something of your device because it was backup before you will realise that here is no way to find it in the cloud. I was thinking about purchasing storage, but being limited and disorganised is very frustrating.

author: A Google user
content: I actually like the idea of this app & how it puts together creative pic stories among other features. However, when I went to customize one of the pic creations it came up with for the month of Dec for the first time I had a major problem. I was planning on making my 1st purchase from this app because I loved the pics and the formatting. After working on it well over 30min the stupid app decided to crash & lose all my work. When I left a message for support it went unanswered. Dont recommend.

author: A Google user
content: Photos view is not good. Automatic uploading feature is helpful but annoying at the same time because it uploads all the pictures of folder and captured by camera. It would be great if we can select photos and videos which needs to be uploaded. I have to disable this app just because it uses all of my data and speed in uploading unnecessary photos and videos.

author: Doug Shue
content: Please add an option to hide albums that are on the sd card. And an option to set a cover image for each album would be nice as well. This app came pre installed on my phone. So I don't see ads but I also don't get some options in the editing feature like "blur background". Many items in the editing feature are paid options if you upgrade the google storage.

author: A Google user
content: It needs basic improvements. (1) No 'Trash' button inside albums so it's impossible to delete photos from there. (2) Adding descriptions is annoying, the keyboard overlaps the text field. (3) You can't see if a photo is already included in an album (only available via web). (4) You can't edit the date of a photo (only on web). (5) Sometimes I get blank menu when tapping on the the hamburger button and photos are not loaded in albums. (6) It randomly duplicate photos.

author: Chris Eng
content: It's always doing that annoying thing where it gets the date groupings wrong on the main Photos page, even though the metadata on the individual photos is correct. Please fix that bug already, it's been happening for years. Also, the Memories feature is seriously broken. I have photos going back 10+ years yet for the past year or more it only shows me highlights from 1, 2, 3, and 4 years ago. I've tried all the solutions your bot suggests.

author: Dan Kennedy
content: Missing so much that others offer! I was hoping to wait and see good features added. Alas none have. Google bought Picassa and never moved over duplicate finder and the ability to select photos from many albums and post them or email them. You have to create an album and then share the album. Facial recognition is hit or miss. Even some photos with a face consuming 25% of the photo it won't see a face to tag and it's impossible to add a tag to a face. Side photos forget it. Not Happy!

author: Šimon Demočko
content: Locked folded is stupid. You painstakingly put stuff there, but the only way to do export or do something is pull them out of the lock and let it fall between all the other photos. Also they promised high quality to be forever free and then changed it to be counting against the space quota after a few years. That's really mean. They can store 60 minutes of YouTube videos every second, so to claim that some pictures are causing them problems with hard disk space that justifies monetizing it is :(

author: A Google user
content: Interesting: what once was the best photo app has suddenly become limited and strange. There is no link allowing photo to be edited externally. The photos taken by any camera that is not the default Android cam do not appear until the had been backed up to Google servers. Suddenly, I am again browsing for a decent gallery app. This usually happens when a the company behind the app promotes a new person to the position of development boss. Can you fire this person, Google?

author: A Google user
content: If i want to share a photo, i dont want to add a link, just let me post the photo. I'm also having trouble posting pictures to my feed on Instagram. I can DM someone, but yhe option to send it directly doesnt show up. if i try to share though the Instagram app, all of my pictures arent available. This is a horribly organized app. I will be seeking out an alternative.

author: Ibrahim Hamdan
content: I don't write reviews, I'm here to tell you STOP advertising "Google one" stuff, it's not working it's super annoying. I have so many subscriptions to things I need and use, if I ever need Google one I will subscribe, stop pushing it down our throats. I like your app that's why I'm writing and not just switching to another app. Thanks

author: A Google user
content: Very disappointed. I backed up all my photos in the app. I then deleted a few videos of my normal gallery and expected it to be saved onto Google Photos but it didn't save. I can never restore those videos again. I had faith and trusted this app but it let me down. What's the point of backing up your photos if you can't delete them on your normal gallery to free up some space? Once again I'm very disappointed in this app, I expected more from Google, way more🙄😒😒

author: Bolling Willse Sr
content: I have found much disappointment in the upgraded version. The cropping tool has become cludgy and will sometimes completely change the aspect ratio or orientation of my framing choices with an abrupt jump. The rounded corners block the true corners of the intended cropping. The removal of the lens correction tool is an abomination! It was the best in the industry, and now I must move a photo to an Apple device to correct an architectural photo. That is terrible! For me the AI integration sucks.

author: Team Aces
content: Only use if you are fine with Google handling your photos and videos. This app kept offering to back everything up online and I had to keep telling it no, since there's no clear way to get it to stop asking. It finally got through one day and clogged my Google account with gigabytes of photos, then promptly advertised buying more storage space. I had enough of these shenanigans and deleted the app.

author: A Google user
content: I like that it offers unlimited storage, but it's still messy. The first time I used it I made the mistake of allowing the backup of every folder and now when I try to delete "useless" pics that I only want in my phone but not there, I can't delete it only from the account? It should be easier to do and seeing the pics based on the date isn't always that helpful, I can't find anything.

author: Alexander Jeigalo
content: The app lags all the time: new photos after taking them may appear after half a minute, photo details (size, location, etc) may not load ever, deleting a photo requires you to wait 20 seconds with redundant intermediate dialogs. But the main concern is it heavily drains battery: 35+% of a charge is taken only by photos, spending hours in background to upload several dozens of pictures on fast wi-fi. And there's no option to upload only while charging.

author: Shayan Yadegari
content: I regret using this app so bad. I spent hours to keep my photos organized and each in specific album and here's google photos mixing every photo. Hell no! I'm not gonna make albums in google photos too. It should detect my albums and add them that way. And after it asks me to delete backed up photos it should send them to the trash of the phone's library not disappearing them all at one. I'm really pisses off. Also it doesn't show which photos are backed up! It really messed everything I did.

author: Ela Loyola
content: Been using this ever since. But I hope they can make a little bit of changes especially when it comes to back ups. Back ups are nice—can't deny it, but I hope it will have an update about it not being saved to another back up account when it's already saved to the main google account. It makes it so hard and it takes up so much space when I can still literally put other photos, videos, and files there... but instead it's already used from files that have been saved to a main google account tho.

author: D. Taylor
content: It would be really nice to be able to search and clear duplicates across devices. And if the files from more than 4 years ago are less and less likely to open. I miss having my stuff on an actual hard drive cause the cloud is not reliable in the least and in pretty nad about the lost meaningful files that were *supposed* to remain accessible and available to me are* forever* lost because now Google can't seem to recall them to me. What was invading for again??

author: A Google user
content: Not the experience I was expecting. Uploads take forever, trying to delete multiple images doesn't work well because you have "ghost" copies, it drained 71% of my battery uploading and downloading images, videos made by the assistant don't play, gifs take long to download, etc etc etc... On the bright side, the service works ok on PC

author: Rock & Peter Cats Dupler
content: Google Photos used to be very good, but now... It seems like it's just here taking up space. Auto upload is still nice but of less importance since storage is no longer unlimited. It used to send me notices of new panoramas, animations, collages, & colorized pics, but now rarely & when it does & I click the link I just see an album with my pictures. No Google Creations. For a while clicking Utilities would show some things but now it too just shows some things I can do & that's it.

author: Ashley
content: I really like that I can edit (crop) before sharing a photo in a text message, yet I DO NOT LIKE that I can no longer send a photo to other apps to do easy things like resizing it! I like Google products, yet I don't want to have to go through a bunch of extra work to use my other programs. PS as a general rule of thumb, even if there is a better way of doing something for brand new people, it is best to not make changes that make us have to relearn a program. energy consuming = frustrating

author: A Google user
content: If I had nickel for everytime I needed to force dtop this app today alone, I would have over a dollar. And that's today. I would trade all the photo animations and albums I didn't want for a single, functional app. instead I need to install a separate app to edit, and I can't even turn off notifications for this, an app that by the nickel owes me about ten bucks.

author: Anya Feuchtenberger
content: In the past would have five stars! now two I absolutely loved this app and the unlimited photo storage! I am absolutely heartbroken to learn now they're going to charge a fee when there are other ways they can make money, people do store other things besides photos. as I'm one of those however I cannot afford to upgrade due to new photos that goes against the quota. In the end it all seems about money instead of keeping something good this proves the loyal people don't matter to them!

author: wilted ash
content: Pretty good, but the new "Ask AI" feature makes finding specific images a nightmare. Please please please go back to normal search and have your app actually recognize words, colors, characters, people, and things appropriately. I don't know why you even NEED AI in a PICTURE BACKUP APP. Seriously, what are we doing here? This AI stuff is getting out of hand. We don't need AI in everything, Google and Alphabet. Edit for response: I know that but classic search should be the ONLY search option.

author: A Google user
content: not good but i had no choice with an andriod phone. Allows virtually no control over file names and contents. It also tries to automatically organize your photos, does a bad job

author: Brittney Lemoine
content: The new format is not user friendly at all. It's been updated for months, maybe over a year, and I still don't get around the app well - as far as finding albums or options like collage. I continue to use it because all of my pictures are here (and I do like the search option), but I am considering switching to something else.

author: S. R.
content: I strongly dislike the new update. It removed some of the useful options. It is now considerably more difficult and time-consuming to edit photos, cropping is cumbersome, magic eraser is now practically useless, and saving any changes is now slow and unreliable. Photos, screenshots, and other images are now jumbled together instead of being separated into folders. The old version allowed for more precise editing, it had more options, and it was quicker. PLEASE bring back the old version!

author: A Google user
content: When photos backup from Google photos or any other third-party gallery app the folders you set up in them do not show in the cloud. Only these groupings from AI like pets and vacations. I'd like my pictures to back up in the folders that I have created. I've tried every setting for hours and can't figure out a way. I hope I'm missing something that you can suggest.

author: Brian Hardy
content: Have Android phone Samsung Galaxy S9+ with a thousand photos all neatly organised into Albums in my Gallery. Several dozen Albums such as Family, House Contents, Workshop, Pets, Medical, Screenshots, Work, Vacations etc etc. A lot of work went into organising my photos into Albums. Uploaded to Google Photos BUT no Albums!! Just a thousand photos in date order. Yes I can create new Albums in Google Photos but I shouldn't have to do all my work again. Time waster in my humble opinion.

author: lostand found
content: Loved checking in daily to see previous years memories of the day and sharing them with family. Now having updated the feature is a bloated mess showing random unconnected days through the year. "Revisit this moment, Featured Friday, Remember this day".... Etc. All designed to keep me using the app for longer, but in reality actually turned me off using the feature altogether. It's an unnecessary addition. Going to try revert to an older version, if not I'll just give up.

author: A Google user
content: Good for storing photos BUT the album feature keeps on changing no matter what I did, it kept on removing photos from albums over and over again, and no getting the right amount of photos listed for the album. This was very annoying as the albums I made were constantly removing photos when I shared them.

author: drone_ranger1 Ward
content: used to think 4.5 stars but lately when trying to generate a link for sharing the app crashes on 2 different mobile devices with the latest version. Using it on my laptop to generate a link has been equally aggravating to say the very least. Many people rely on me for pictures from events. This app has been my go to but I'm thinking about looking for something else to use. To top that all off upload speed seems to of greatly diminished. I have a paid subscription.... what the heck???

author: Pedro J. Gonzalez
content: The most recent update of the App crashes. When you swipe up a photo to see its properties the new version of the App now allows you to apply filters and edit the photo without having to click on the editor. I think that function has a bug and the App crashes and requests the user to uninstall and reinstall. We'll have to wait until it's fixed. In the meantime don't swipe up!!

author: Keith Caffray
content: Used to be good, now not so good. Main bugbear is its insistence on putting suggestions on each photo when I know that the picture is exactly how I want it to look. It's very annoying to keep having to click out of these suggestions every time I load an image. At least give us the option to turn this feature off, then I will give you a higher rating

author: Shannon Wilson
content: I hate the new memories format so much. Before it showed memories "on this day 2 years ago, 3 years ago" etc and I really liked it because it felt fun and organised. Now it just randomly shows you memories from a random period of time. For example, showing a photo from July 4 years ago when it's October. Plus the photos have no context and they just ominously zoom at you. I don't even understand what I'm looking at half the time.

author: Cheryl Schwartz
content: I have been using Google Photos for years. All of a sudden, the dates changed on hundreds of my photos. In addition, there are hundreds of blocks containing empty squares. The earlist date now only goes to 2007 but I have photos dating way back. I have 2T of storage but I'm only using 9% of it. I am paying for space that I can't use and that's not fair! How can I fix it?

author: A Google user
content: Don't like this app. It doesn't work properly. I add photographs to an album but it loads only some of them. Photographs appear twice sometimes. The automated sorting is not good. If only I could sort things manually and the app did as it was told. Photographs which should be on my phone get whisked away and then have to be downloaded again. Really don't like this app.

author: Inshirah Bint Sami Aman Khalifah

Before I used to be able to take a picture and use it how I see fit not parasidic to the internet because my snap, fac/ve, insta, so forth is accesible. Nosy much???

author: A Google user
content: I don't like that Google photos saves literally every photo I take, regardless of if it's with a camera or in another app. I don't. Red every Instagram story, ever saved into its own folder. I've search settings and preferences and there's no way to make this stop? Just have all of the photos in one place and let the user choose how to organize them.

author: Meggie Rock
content: I appreciate Google photos being generally integrated and easy to use, but I hate the new layout. It's so cumbersome to edit your photos. I think some of the light settings are too narrowly clamped, I'd like to have more control and the option to save unique filter settings.

author: jakamo suliman

Good job!

author: A Google user

I keep updating it but it never fixes itself. When it worked, it was the best photo app in the world.

author: Carol Morehead

author: Casey Rowlings

I have cleared the cache and uninstall the app multiple times and they will sometimes show but it appears to be random. Furthermore screenshots are now saved automatically from android without choice.

author: B Koenen / CCRx

author: Daryl Davirro

Because of this, it's harder to organize and to know which photos were put into a certain album. seems like the organization abilities went down with the newest version. please fix this.

author: Rebecca
content: Extremely Dissatisfied! I have loved highly Google Photos for Years. Now.... ohh. Google lens!!! Very difficult to use. Too many extra steps and it not a photo search. It's search for the words in picture. If I wanted to do that I will just go to search and type in what I was looking for.... Difficult to edit a photo. 👎👎👎

author: Lexus Raven Sykes
content: Memories get lost when photos do, The app were doing perfectly well already. It used to be excellent. Now people who relied on it are being let down, they can't get their photos back if it's been in the bin too long even if they had a lot in there, too many to attempt to restore. I got space now but no photos they are all gone. The app isn't trustworthy like it started out to be.

author: Robert Francis IV
content: I think photos was a great app in and of itself, but the decision to take away unlimited storage(using lower quality) is ridiculous. And if that wasn't bad enough you're going to make it so we have to choose what memories to keep and which to delete (forever) if we get too close to "storage quotas". You're basically saying, "Give us your money or else say goodbye to your memories of loved ones"

content: With photography as a new passion, this app provides A LOT of features. I hardly ever use snapseed. And now there's the unblur deature that just saved so many photos from a wedding. Only up from here. (Five stars) Edit: There's a recent update that's changed the entire UI of the app, and it has since been a very buggy app. Photos disappear when adjusting skin tone (as an example) and 'save as copy' does not always save the changes made. (2 starts)

author: A Google user
content: Excellent app overall, but since the last update, it has been not uploading any of my photos or syncing them. It is constantly in an "uploading phase", and it has gotten to the point where over 700 of my photos from the past week have not been automatically backed up. A bit frustrated.

author: Xander
content: I would like to rate it higher but after uploading all my photos to google photos to save space if I wanted to download a large chunk of them I'd have to do it on a computer so I'm told, and none of my folders or organisation was kept when uploading all my photos so now I just have a huge mess of photos to sort through again. Also I don't really like the way it shows locations of photos I prefer it to be more precise than the area colour thing Google does but other than that I like the app ahaha

author: A Google user
content: The app is riddled with bugs. Downloading photos from the internet get arbitrary date labels that group them in the most nonsensical ways possible. Manual album sorting is an excruiating process of attempting to move photos into the order you want it, all while hoping the app doesn't just flat out reset your order. For a google app, the flaws are glaringly stark.

author: Prabhanjan S.M
content: Back up and sync with the cloud does not work. I hadn't updated the app in a long time. Since a month, back up isn't working. I manually tried to backup. A spinner widget keep spinning at the top of the app with a message "getting your photos". It does not and is killing the battery. I updated the app. Also uninstalled and reinstalled. Doesn't fix the problem. Googling the issue suggested to clear the cache and clear the data. Doing that stopped it from detecting the camera folder. Please help.

author: A Google user
content: I really like the fact that your photos are backed up automatically. And in case of loss or theft you will have all your pictures online. But one thing I got upset over is that I purchased a new memory card. And when I transferred my photos from my phone to the card. The app believes these are brand new photos. Now if I have doubles in my account with all my pictures date forcibly being today. Now I know this is a free app. But just wanted to share my experience. File names should be checked.

author: mercy ebere
content: Thid photo app is nice, but the issue I have with it is that I can't edit my photos, when I click on the edit and try to crop or do anything, the picture becomes invisible, it just goes blank and I won't be able do effect the changes that I want, because I can't see the picture am working with, it's very frustrating and quite annoying

author: Derrick McDaniel
content: The redesign is not good. At first I thought it was just a matter of getting used to it but being on holiday for a month now and using it regularly I still find navigation of the new layout tedious. I really hate the way they changed the remember this day from a card to an insta stories type layout. And why would they stick the stylized photos in with that. Hope the next update is less garbage

author: Note
content: Too confusing UI, I have been using a lot of complex software for a looong time but the UI in Photos is pretty bad, it's hard to manage file or identify storage usage. I nearly permanently removed photos and videos of my cat who doesnt have much time left because the app recommend me some option about cleaning up files and didnt give much detail what would happen,cant remember exactly what it said but it looked safe enough for me at first glance, in the end it deleted most file in one of my acc

author: A Google user
content: I really dont like how the photos are sorted. I can never find my downloaded photos easily. I switched from an iPhone to a Google Pixel and the photo storage is the biggest change I've yet to get used to. I also miss being able to connect my phone via USB cable to upload my photos directly to my PC.

author: Antonio Catta
content: I always relied on Google photo as backup. But since a couple of days it's a nightmare. All photos in wrong order, wrong date and I'm not even sure if some is missing. I'm not the only one with this issue (my wife too although she has a different account). No way to have them back as before. The engineers are"flying around the airport"and giving evasive and, mostly, useless solutions.I'm seriously thinking to change cloud.The quickest way to spoil a business is this one. Low quality, high price

author: Eric C
content: If only it was more user friendly. Option to edit videos is awesome. But it really needs an option to sort files by date, name, etc. I backed up my photos to my computer, and then they were all out of order, with no way to rearrange or sort them. (Gave 1 star, but ultimately, it's a decent default. Thus the 2 stars).

author: A Guy
content: just after I left a 5 star review for how amazing the app is, I found that in the main "Photos" tab, that some of my photos were not being shown! I have to go all the way through Collections, On this Device, and Camera to see all my photos.... edit: the Gallery app is much more of what I actually want to see.. Photos is a complete mess.

author: D. Vandall
content: Really disappointed with the latest update. Not sure why you would want to screw up something that worked perfectly fine the way it was. Missing the "suggestions" feature that would show animations, collages, color pop, movies, panorama, etc.

author: A Google user
content: This used to be the perfect app. Now with recent changes there are some frustrating hiccups including the fact that once you edit a photo, you can no longer pick up where you left off with those edits--you have to start over from the original image. Also the cropping feature has lost all of the detail at the cropping edge that used to make it a powerful cropping tool. It is now blunt instead of precise.

author: Rhoda H
content: I love the face recognition feature on photos, but sometimes it is incorrect.I've named all of my photos and Google has mis-grouped a whole bunch of them and I am unable to change them.. I am super frustrated. I don't know what happened to the option to remove a picture from the search results but it's not there anymore.

author: Francesca Fornoni
content: I can't seem to be able to use a shared album anymore, I receive notifications when others add to it but when I go look in the app I can only see my contributions to the album. I'm only able to see some from others when logging into my account from a browser, but even there it's not up to date. Used to work great before the last couple of updates.

author: Kira Liz
content: I have errors with deleting photos, so they're forever stuck on my phone, even after switching phones, because they were synced at one time. I'm also not able to transfer photos from my phones internal storage to my sd card without getting an error. Because they too were synced at one point. I'm also not able to find out how to get to my synced pictures via desktop while logged into my Google account there. And there's no troubleshooting, or helpful FAQ for it.

author: Gina Marie
content: I have two Google accounts and I'm uploading all photos to one, yet some photos still upload to the other.. it's creating confusion and all photos are being divided up and getting lost and now I'm unsure whether there are pictures missing or not. I'm scared to free up space because there's so much confusion as to what photos are going where. If there's a better place to upload & save your photos, id recommend elsewhere. One positive I'd like to note is the ability to share & add to shared albums

author: Vicki F.
content: I have really liked this app for a long time... But now I find that I can't retrieve ANY of my photos beyond five years ago. And as the calendar of 2021 marches on, I lose access to more and more photos. So frustrating. I even purchased more storage!

author: A Google user
content: It seems to be getting worse all the time. No longer gives the option to remove duplicates, no longer have the option to add on YouTube, all controls for editing except rotate have dissappeareds udderly, and as of yesterday if I'm reviewing a video and try to open options the entire app shuts down. Believe I'm gonna add Dropbox to my Android.

author: Brian F
content: Just began using this and my Pixel instead of my iPhone for product photography.. within a month they've removed vital features (perspective changing being the main one) which I saw as nothing short of a game changer.. now it's been removed and the best in could do is hit the AI button, hope it does something useful... One week.. one whole week I managed to escape the iPhone. Very disappointing.

author: Chetana Rao
content: I had previously given it 5 starts but changed it to 2 now. Did not like the new update. It was easier to navigate the app previously. Also when you click on the memories shown on top and select view all photos from this day, it doesn't do anything! The videos that are backed up and no longer on your device take way too long to buffer and play

author: Willow White
content: There are seriously not enough simple functions. The scroll bar is ridiculous and takes me to places I don't want to go, and one simple misstap on my mouse button lost me the photos I was trying to collect in an album for over an HOUR. More than once. The 2 stars are straight up for the app being free, otherwise it's driving me crazy!

author: Vinuth Panchal
content: issue is Can't adjust pics in collage and also pls add an option where we can share the burst shots in albums, to select the required pics and add it all at a time... sometimes it keeps showing uploading/backing up pics, and it goes on for days, never ending..I have to uninstall the updates and re install it to recover from this problem..like every single time.. Very frustrating..pls fix it..

author: Dan Clark
content: I really, really dislike the new Android iOS photo editing tools. As a professional photographer, I was quite happy with the amount of control and the organization of the previous toolset. The recent update is WAY too complicated for most people, IMHO, plus it took away the very useful 4-corner Crop tool, which I used all the time. Other tools may also have been changed, but I didn't bother to explore them. I just immediately did an uninstall to get back to the previous toolset.

author: Adam killingback
content: Great app. Although it has a major flaw it will only back up photos when you open the app! And if the screen is on! So if you take lots of pictures and dont open the app and lose your phone the pictures will be lost! Extremely annoying! I dont see why it doesn't back the pictures up automatically in the background when you have wifi😡

author: A Google user
content: Furious that the connection between Photos and Drive has been severed and no option in the Dive Drive app to allow a manual sync. apparently this is coming in a few weeks. a word of advice, don't make fundemental changes without having a manual override in place. Photos has just become a worse product due to this, way worse.

author: QC Jess
content: My ONLY issue is technical and happens intermittently. When sending a photo with the app to a contact via the stock messages app, the other party is unable to download the pics or unable to view it completely. If unable to view completely, they are sent a link to view the photo regardless of the share photo option NEVER being used by original sender. I'm unsure if it's the android software itself or a Google Photos issue but I'm 100% sure it IS a PAIN in the rear for myself & others!

author: Katarzyna Wiśniewska
content: When I try deleting things from Google photos, they also get deleted from the synced devices and there's no other option?? The point of having Google photos was to move part of the photos to the cloud and leave part on the phone, but everything got backed up automatically and now I can't touch them from the clouf bcs they will get deleted everywhere.

author: Angela Berardinelli
content: Originally rated this app 5 stars back in 2015 but I have to edit my rating. It still gets 2 stars for the excellent photo editing features... IF you can find what you're looking for. I cannot find my device folders easily anymore. They completely changed the labels for the different "tabs" at the bottom of the app, and none of them correspond to my device folders. This includes making it harder to find screenshots taken on my phone. Terrible experience over here w the new UI.

author: Peter Kline
content: It seems like I'm unable to add photos to a shared album without backing up every photo on my phone, which I don't want to do. I've deselected every folder from backing up and yet it just ... uploads things I didn't want backed up to the cloud without my consent. I assume this is because Google has decided that everything in my phone belongs on the cloud so they can charge me for storage (MORE storage, since I already pay for it). A frustrating finish to an otherwise good product...

author: A Google user
content: I just wish you guys would fix the duplicate picture problem . It's really annoying and time-consuming having to go one by one to delete the duplicates . There's been times when I've had 20 copies of one picture . And for someone like me that likes to store up pictures could take Days to erase all my duplicate . It's a great app and I love to use it but if it have something to delete duplicate pictures would be awesome then truly it would be an awesome app .

author: Richard Gilbert
content: Why change the photo editing software, which was easy to use, including ease of cropping a picture! The latest version is definitely NOT an improvement - how can I go back to the earlier software version? It's very frustrating when the earlier editing version did the job efficiently. I suppose I'll have to find another photo editor! 😕

author: derek charles
content: Exceedingly disappointing! Since upgrading my Motorola G7 to Android 10, Google requires printing by their associated companies. Previously random selection of photos could be printed simply on any available iSnaps terminal. Now forced to group subjects into books for printing by e.g.Freeprints. Need to select individual ones from any book to print. There is also a problem with stopping photo videos continuously playing. Loop off works on one but another plays on & vice versa.

author: A Google user
content: This photo app is not user friendly, and it makes me miss my iPhone. I can never find pictures I download. It's not clear which folder or album they are saved to. Also I'll take a picture and it may take up to 10 minutes for it to show in the photo album. That's such a huge lag between the camera and the software. The search feature is pointless; it never brings up what I'm looking for so I still have to scroll. Impossible to search by date when the photo was taken. This app is trash.

author: Joshua Kinzer
content: Its primary function of quickly viewing photos is really good, but thats undermined by the bad visual organization of the albums/photos as of recently, and even further undermined by the thinly veiled ad it gives you every time you open it, asking you to backup so it can charge you for storage. Looking for a different app because I'm sick of getting an ad in a basic core phone app every time I open it.

author: Mr. Jesse
content: When this app has all features available, it's unbelievable. Unfortunately, all the features are rarely available. It selects which features you can use with a photo (such as colour filter, it selects which colour to filter for you.. If the option is available at all). Not sure why they'd make such a powerful app and then restrict the options that are available. It's frustrating. Edit: the generic response that Google posted was the least helpful thing they could've done. Like why even reply?

author: Kr
content: Bring back the geomap of the photos, stop trying to push it out of the app and hide it. Work on ability to search well, sort, and re-arrange photos, that's what I need from a photo app that I can't even replace with anything else. No one needs your engagement features like moments or "a year ago on this day", or "change the colour of the sky on this photo" prompts, or "buy a photo album".

author: A Google user
content: I love all the new automation, albums, styled, etc. The UI is lacking to say the least. Switching pics between devices is a pain. Doesn't seem to be any other way to combine albums than to manually search thru all photos to find the ones you want and add from there. A frustrating task when you have as many photos as I do. Not too worried. I think within in the next or two they'll have the features that I'm looking for. When they fix these issues I'll gladly comeback to revise

author: Jeff Ryan
content: GP came loaded as the default photo gallery on my new Moto One. I use my phone as a camera for work daily (lots), and I'm really disappointed with Google Photos. Gallery was the default on my previous Samsung phone, worked much better for what I use it for. Can't scroll through photos until completely unzooming, and if you pinch unzoom past 100% it exits photos and goes back to the camera. Zoom is capped arbitrarily. It's slow. I'm going to end up paying for a gallery app, this is bonkers.

author: Dan Wrench
content: Really slow to search for something. Perhaps I've to many photos. Perhaps because I've only got a Pixel 2 and they are deliberately putting in bugs to force an upgrade. Can't edit movies so it often uses the wrong photos. Biggest complaint is inability to search for an album I might be adding to using old photos. To add a new photo to the album you have to scroll through all your albums chronologically. I have 75000 photos going back to 1910 so that can take a while

author: Shari Gollnitz
content: I used to love Google Photos but within the last year it has become pretty useless. The app constantly crashes when editing photos. In order to edit a photo I have to take a screenshot and then edit the screenshot. I don't have time for this nonsense! Also, when I delete photos it shows blank boxes in my photo collection, which is annoying. Time to look for a new photo app!

author: A Google user
content: Works efficiently- ALL photos stay in photos even if you put them into albums? Dumb, I don't want thousands of pictures in my photos that should be for new photos and ones that weren't put into an album! What is the point in putting a picture in an album and still having it in your photo section? 300 pictures I want them out of my hair put them in the album they're still in my photos 🤦🤦🤦 No other app that I use for pictures does this but Google! It's dumb it just junks up my current photos!

author: A Google user
content: problematic and oddly limited. Can't rename photos in bulk, backup doesn't function properly despite a lot of troubleshooting steps, after going through backup steps and checking to see if I can delete a photo from the device it tells me that the photo is not backed up. I would give this less Stars except that it lets me send links to photos rather than the full files

author: denise
content: It was good until I used backup and sync. I can't get my pictures back to my gallery. I wasn't informed of this and now I have to open Google photos just to see them. I have a lot of pictures, and my storage is full on the app so I should buy the 100gb. Google photos cant be opened that quickly without wifi or data. I think I lost all my memories now

author: A Google user
content: I like this app for the editing and storing of course but be careful when syncing it to your computer. I synced it to my pc and then transferred the photos to my pc as a backup and then deleted the photos from Google Photos thinking they were backed up. They didn't fully transfer over to my pc and you can't recover your deleted pictures if you empty the trash. So now i've lost a years worth of photos and memories. A long as you don't make my mistake it's a good app.

author: Carnanya
content: I cannot express just how infuriating this app is. It doesn't accurately recognize the seperate albums on my phone, causing all sorts of photos that I don't want backed up to be backed up, and once the photos are backed up, I can't seem to remove them from the photos service? The result is an absolute mess of photos, not properly organized. I can't even do anything about it! I can't find any tools to help me properly organize things how I want.

author: Mathias M
content: Auto night mode makes this app barely usable. I often want to make a quick shot, only to have blurry mess, because the app decided that it needs night mode, even though the pics are fine if I turn it off manually. Which is the worst part. You have to turn it off every single time you start the app, and you can only do it if the tiny symbol appears. What a major step backwards.

author: A Google user
content: I'm not sure what has happened in the last month but if someone could fix after you edit a photo it would be nice to have the option to just save it, I don't need to save a copy of it. I also am tired of having the error message to check my connection. Up until the last month I have had absolutely no problems. Please undo whatever update you last did.

author: Aliasgar Hamid
content: Please sort this problem out: Photos uploaded from my gallary should be kept in the respected folders as they were in the gallary. The problem after uploading is that my photos are not classified like they are in gallary-taken from camera, screenshots, edited in lightroom, WhatsApp photos,etc. So finding one photo needed takes way too much time. Please sort it out for me, i really love this app for storage.

author: Miguel Sanchez
content: This app has a significant issue that keeps me from rating it higher. When moving a photo to another folder, which I do often to keep things organized, the photo's date changes to the current date. This causes photos to not be organized properly in the folder I've just moved them to. A quick Google search reveals that this is an ongoing issue encountered by many users. Something as simple as correctly keeping a photo's date shouldn't be that difficult.

author: Philip Brazina
content: This is a great app to keep a backup of your pictures. What I don't like this when it backs it up from my phone it takes the picture from my phone and puts it in the general repository on the Google Cloud, not maintaining the folder from which is was backed up on my phone. In addition to that, I can't file photos into folders within Google photos, but there is no way to see what is still left in the repository that hasn't been filed as a repository just exists as a whole.

author: Alice Thornburgh
content: EDIT: The links you have provided do not work. This continues to be a problem. I have over 3 days of footage in a Google Photos album. I am unable to download it because some videos are still processing or otherwise unavailable despite many of them having been uploaded a year ago+. I'm a musician, and this album contains almost all the work I've done over the last few years, over 800 recordings. I can't download them from my library either.

author: A
content: normally this app is great! stores lots of photos, editing is fine, album and folder system perfectly nice. until i started noticing that random pictures would begin deleting themselves from my device? they would be saved in the cloud, but every time i redownloaded the images to my device they would disappear again if i closed the photos app. they also seem to be chosen completely at random! i have photos from a year ago disappearing as well as every single one of my recent ones. fix this!!!!!

author: A Google user
content: Overall, mostly okay app. I wish the app let you restore photos from within an album, instead of having to scroll through and search for the pictures. I just want to save all of the photos in an album to my phone, but the only option I get is to remove those photos from the album.

author: Aaron Boke
content: Miserable to watch videos on because it doesn't have basic navigation features like "skip ahead x seconds". You can only navigate a video by CLICKING the *tiny* bar at the bottom, it misbehaves if you try to click and drag. Also you can't change the thumbnail for video or sort within an album by any criteria other than the name of the file (which is not displayed). Also there is no way to hide things other than the SINGLE "locked folder", which will not back up.

author: M S
content: Please update so that labels matter not just the recognition system. I have multiple cats (family has 8 total) it can't distinguish a 2 year old Tortie from a 17 year old Calico and we have 3 that are semi similar. Memories of "name" are always just a bunch of random cats not the one specified. The app outside the "memories of" function is fine. I haven't used other photo apps to compare, if it didn't annoy me with its inability to read tags I would give it 5 stars.

author: A Google user
content: I hate the automated albums and edited pictures and silly movies. Stop that nonsense. Just store my pictures please. Five stores for the storage, the smooth interface, the neat tools... minus three stars for taking my photos and manipulating and organizing them without asking me if I want any of that done.

author: Manon Moulin
content: I used to love Google photos, but not sure what is happening right now. When I save an edited photo I cannot continue editing, even just to crop the edited image. I also put work into editing pictures and it end up saving an entire different result. very frustrating. do not now what happened with this app. Oh and lots not forget the newly improved AI functions that NEVER work.

author: Tim Raybould
content: I like the memories feature but there needs to be an option to turn off the music. It's especially irritating when the memory being shown has audio/music which is then covered up with the auto generated music from the app. I wouldn't normally put something like this in a review but it's been like this for months now. I love the app on a whole with this one exception.

author: R. Jones
content: 2 ⭐⭐'s! Not compared to an ideal app even, just compared to the previous version. the perspective cropping tool has been removed, and some editing can now only be done if you currently have Internet access. At least give us an easy way to go back to the old version, you don't even have to fix anything, it is already much better.

author: Sadie
content: It's a great app, honestly. But there needs to be some small window to recover permanently deleted files, I know that sounds useless, but I was clearing files and, by mistake deleted all of the photos I took. All of them. Even though they were backed up, there's no way to get them back.

author: J Read
content: Frustratingly messy, unadaptable UI. I really want to make this work but i cannot organize my photos in this app and I don't enjoy looking at it. I don't want AI or automation, I just need a reasonable level of control to file things in a way that makes sense to me! Also, every random gallery I install from the Play Store displays albums transferred onto my new device that Photos seems to deny the existence of. I wish this app was better. Two stars for free storage and not crashing.

author: Sabela
content: I don't like the last update. It's difficult to find the memories, i liked the collage that used to be automatically created to remind you that day. Also, automatic creations are messed with this thing called "Recent highlights" which, I don't know why, also includes recent photos (I can already see this in my camera roll folder...)

author: JC Johnstone
content: So many things wrong w this app I'm not even sure where to begin. I can rarely find what I'm looking for using albums, search etc After the recent update the erase tool no longer works. I tried to remove some overhead wires from a house photo and no matter what I tried, it wouldn't work. Simple edits are no longer possible and organizing hiding etc is terrible. Do better. 2 stars

author: Joshua I.O. Adenaike
content: Yesterday, I uploaded some pictures. Today I checked for those pictures. They were sorted by faces. After adding their respective names and saved them, they all suddenly disappeared. I couldn't find them any longer. What the problem is, I don't know but please fix it.

author: Sherry Stone
content: I've used this app only for my photos all these years. I think I'm going to find another photo app because everyt ime I edit a photo even in an album , it disappears and I can't find it and I use my photos every day. I'm so disappointed that this was an update. I Uninstalled the update and it still does this. Any fixing this huge problem soon?

author: Nancy McMillan
content: This app was working fine until recently. I can no longer upload photos to my Dropbox app or attach them to an email. When I try to add them to Dropbox I receive the message: Storage full or not available. I have plenty of space in my Dropbox account. When I try to attach to an email, I get a message: Couldn't attach file. Did the recent upgrade affect this capability? I am able to attach photos to texts.

author: Mahmoud Hussain
content: The app is great for storage, but the organizational structure needs improvement.
