It would be much better if the automatic upload preserved the original folder hierarchy (Camera, WhatsApp, Facebook, etc.). While sorting by people and places is a nice feature, it feels cluttered for users who prefer manual albums for specific events and vacations. Please consider adding an option to sync based on local device folders.

author: naureen auma
content: Google photos is good though at times you add new items it shows that you've added them. Then go back to clear the storage in your gallery but when you come back to check your added photos... The whole space is empty...n all your photos are all gone so sad. Can't accord 5 stars for this app..coz im kinda disappointed coz I've lost lots of photos...

author: Philip Berube
content: My photos are not backing up and can't be found on other devices like my tablet,I've tried clearing my cache that didn't work and the back up under the icon on the right top hand corner is selected and on.better fix it cause the phone I have them saved on won't be around forever and they can't be found on other devices and your suggestion does not work,fix your app

author: A Google user
content: I like that I'm able to store my photos somewhere and retrieve them again when need be, but for some reason my albums always glitch when I'm trying to open them on the app? I always get the 'can't load album' notice and the photos are greyed out and don't show after I tap on them. Please fix this!!!

author: A Google user
content: There is a bug in the dates for the device folders. The dates are all wrong and it shows photos taken at a later date as if they are from an earlier date. For example photos taken in September 2018 appear under May 2018. And photos taken in February 2019 appear like they are taken in January 2019. This issue makes it difficult for me to organize my photos and delete photos in bulk by selecting the date! I noticed this bug many months ago but only reporting it now. PLEASE fix this issue soon!!!

author: A Google user
content: Dude like what the hell? Bad enough how limited the editing features are but now it's saying I need to have a connection in order to edit a picture? That's in my phone's memory? So wait does that mean Everytime I wanna edit a picture it has to be sent to a server to do it? Like how much of my data is this damn app wasting

author: Matthew
content: Google - Please get rid of the print store advertisements at the top—the ad covers 30% of the screen—it's excessive and incredibly annoying. Promote your backend products in a menu or something, or at the very least give people the option to hide/collapse them. In the unlikely event I decide to order such products, I think I can manage the process without having it shoved down my throat. The newer photos app is already irritating enough. Miss the old one.

author: Cailyn Whitney
content: As others have already noted, the new update is awful. There is no longer any functionality in the intensity adjustment for filters, no matter what intensity it is set to, it will save the edited photo with full filter application. The "magic eraser" function no longer allows for selecting small details. The app automatically selects an object in the image (usually the full in focus image) and will exclusively apply the erasure to that, which is...worthless. No more space for add. info.

author: A Google user
content: Need to put reverse order view back in. Over all the app is cumbersome and not intuitive, it lacks user options and controls. In order to view shared photos from another user you have to allow Google access to all your private photos which it then sorts, stores and displays with little or no user control. Downloading photos is a real pain as is sharing outside established lists through Google. Too bad, it could be a useful app.

author: Donald Green
content: I was use to love my pixel and it's photo capabilities. but they have been progressively getting worse. Things that should be simple. Recently when I crop photos I can't make anymore additional edits. I get a message saying if I want to do further edits I need to revert to the original picture. Since I have gotten the pixel 10 pro, I can't save photo blurring. for example I take a photo and want to blur the background, it says it saves but it never does it just reverts to the original photo.

author: Amber Fabre
content: Cluttered. Needs to be simplified. I was expecting to see something similar to my gallery...just my pictures organized neatly into folders. Instead its a "Do anything and everything possible pertaining to a picture" situation... EXCEPT actually be able to back up ALL of the folders in your gallery! Not an option for that in the settings 🤔 So pick 4 folders & we'll just throw the rest in randomly... all together I expected better from Google

author: Sarah Brittan
content: Can't edit photos from inside an album, I could before this update. I rely on this heavily as I group photos of different topics across a wide range of dates, even years, & then edit & share from my google photos albums as needed. Having to now go look up each photo individually is beyond frustrating. Please fix this!!! The app's search has also got significantly slower lately. It is very very noticeably slower to respond and load search results.

author: Ashley Villandry
content: Very disappointed! Keeps wanting me to update but tells me I don't have enough space available to update. I keep going through my apps and photos and videos to delete stuff I can go without yet I still don't have enough space for the update apparently. Also half the time I try to take a pic I'm told there's not enough space available, I'll delete up to 14pics then try again and STILL get the "not enough space" 😑 I hate dealing with it.

author: Jalena Lee
content: I initially downloaded this app because my phone was running out of storage for my photos.I decided to give this app a try and after I downloaded the app everything went fine until I noticed it deleted all my photos off of my gallery. I am trying to find solutions from Google,Yt etc. On how to put my photos back into my camera roll but so far there is no solution. If there is a way to get the photos back into my gallery someone please let me know cuz I am very annoyed please and thank you

author: Regina Miller
content: I use to like the goole photo app. My favorite app to edit my photo's. I really liked that I could use the pen to type words on it and highlight some of it also, but the pen and the highlighting tools are gone. I went to the help link and it says I can use those tooks in the help link, but the tools are not showing up in the app to use them. Makes me not like the app so much, anymore.

author: King King
content: I paid twice of $1.99 .I asked to refund one of the $1.99.they refunded me the wrong $1.99 from another account! And will not fix the problem to put back what they removed.and told me to getvahold of the other account to pit back what was never supposed to been mess with in the first place! AND when I paid my first $1.99 did did not save alot of my videos that is stored in my phone!.

author: Murthy Gorty
content: Reducing from 5* to 2* primarily because it is not improving at all, at least I am not able to see, as a user persona. - no way to search for b&w photos - in adding to albums, can't search the list - love the ability to search for pets/people, but several photos are not being identified properly. - etc.

author: Glenn Gannon
content: Really complete app. Great simple editing features, and easy to create albums. It just let the app do it for you. After recent updates, I take back what I said. The photo editing has become unusable. The deskew tool has been removed and the crop tool resizes the image as you try to adjust the crop so it's impossible to precisely crop a photo. This app has lost its way

author: Laurion Schmidt
content: I used to love this app...but I hate the new update! What happened to the "for you" section with suggested edits and gifs to easily create? Even now, they show the suggestion of automatic creations like cute gif creations and you can save it.... but where does it go??? I can't download it to my phone to share on social media.... What's the damn point if none of these features are *actually usable*?? Severely disappointed.

author: Indu Sankaràn
content: We need not register for anything and every thing.take care of overall security and log is ok. All other ordinary usage should be simple. Too much cut throt comption is disgusting. Make a simple pack(essentials) for senior citizens group. Some provision to delete not used app. Others should affected. List essentials. Remove and restore procedures. Present system is complicated.suggestions should be listed in serial nos.no storey

author: Jesse Lopez
content: Constantly stuck on "uploading # photos" . My fix was to "use without account" , restart the phone then switch back to account. All that does now is get stuck on "getting ready to back up". It's a hassle constantly monitoring if your photos uploaded. You can tell they aren't when the phone gets hot trying to process whatever Google photos is trying and failing at. Paying for the extra storage is not worth it.

author: Stavros
content: When are Google going to provide a folder/file view within the Photos app which is user editable? This would make it far easier & quicker for me to find certain photographs in the future. Then if we have these folders, I want to be able to view them first, with one copy of a photo file only(in relevant folder) and not in a seemingly endless list of photos dating back 10 years!! Come on Google, fix this please????

author: amber vanbilliard
content: I love that is links memories from different phones. However, once they started charging for storage it has said mine is full ever since. No matter how many pictures I delete. I thought a few years back it was free and unlimited? Everything's about money now. I'll just buy an SD card and move them over I guess.

author: A Google user
content: Lost all my folders when I decided to free up space and ended up with a single gallery with all my images. Doesn't support batch actions, quick selection of multiple images by swiping (need to tap every single image), rearrangement of Folders by name and many other features a basic gallery app should include. Edit: Face tagging needs some time to work, but its good. Search function is fantastic. Suggested animations, movies, books etc. also really good.

author: Maria Marchione-Novoa
content: I'm changing my rating from 5 stars of the photo storage app I thought I would love until my dying days because of ITS GREED! The new policy that forces you to buy storage is very unfair and unapologetically a robbery! The world needed a free storage app and Google was definitely in the position to provide it. Profit over everything else. Business as usual.

author: Derek Elphick
content: This app only selects images from certain locations on your device. Not ideal. Plus where is the support? The email address supplied is no longer monitored.....come on Google wake up. My storage is at 50% yet I can't view anything. Where is this so called storage? Archive shows nothing. The vault needs the ability to be made visible if need be. Moving stuff out to share and back in is cumbersome and time consuming.

author: Sara
content: Why can't my pictures load on this app? They're my pictures. I took them! They shouldn't be pixelated when I open them. The quality of my internet connection shouldn't depend on whether or not I can view my photos. I'm disappointed in Android and Google for making this app. I miss older tech when the app was just called 'Gallery' and you could look at images clearly as you please with or without internet. Sad

author: Andrew Rosati
content: Used to be a lot better. But now I can't edit the description of the photo anymore. And more importantly, which is important to my job, I can no longer screenshot my photos and scroll down to include the location information. Came in real handy now I can't do it. Causing a lot of aggravation. Very disappointed with the updates.

author: Sam Derry
content: I really don't get you! I have photos already on here which I'm wanting to put in Albums. However.... it keeps saying i need more storage. I'm not trying to add more photos, just trying to organise the ones already stored here!!! I think it's just a way of getting money out of folk 🤔

author: A Google user
content: Dude, never sign in with an account. It's annoying, the layout changes, it's always trying to change your photos, and I can't make it stop. (As disconnecting an account doesn't work.) I have to download a sperate gallery app just so I can manage my art in peace.

author: Plasmonic Cell
content: If there is an option to hide what is effectively a banner ad for the print store, I'd love to know where it's at. With the option to print presented on each pic I view(!!!), It is increasingly difficult to forget that I could do it.

author: A Google user
content: There are too many problems!! I added the photos from my sd card and now its made its own new camera folder, so I have to keep combining them whenever I take a photo which is a pain. I absolutely despise the organization method by date, there should be a way to turn that off. There should also be a way to turn off the "people, places, things" folders that auto-generate. Looked online for a solution and the google support worker literally just said to "ignore it" ....thanks.

author: Monique Irwin
content: Deleted and backed up photo's for the first time so will see how well I'll be able to retrieve when I want to use them. That worked well but now it keeps saying storage full. I haven't taken many more pictures since purchasing an extra 100 gigs of extra storage. So why is my storage almost full again 😑

author: Nick Rambo
content: I really don't like how this app aggressively removes photos from my phone. I live in the country and often I will go to show someone a recent photo only to find Photos has aggressively removed photos from my device. I get it, this is purely a cloud photo app but at least give me a damn option to download an album instead of manually having to download *every single picture in the darn album one by one*! Edit: did you guys really send me a guide on how to use the app? Wow.

author: adrien
content: google photos has been fine for years and this recent update deleted my albums and the are no where to be found inside the app. My significant other has an album I have shared with her and she can see it just fine but the ones that were shared are gone for me and still only she can see the shared album. Something similar happened to her more than a year ago after an update. It's like the algorithm saw that it hasn't been opened in so long that it decided to get rid of it for you. 😁😁 So happy.

author: A Google user
content: Just what I needed. I forgot to read the techspeake of what is in here. I dont mind the extra storage space, but about the rest about ALL my photos being 'integrated' sounds like it gets done whether I want it so or not. Just like the food we eat, things added to an update should say EXACTLY what is being added. I went to uninstall latest update and all it offers is for ALL updates to be uninstalled.

author: Tina Lindsey
content: I bought several of my pictures through the App, and Most of them were RUINED! I'll NEVER Order my pictures through the App Again!!!! That being said... as for the Rest of the App, I love it. Stop messing up people's Precious Memories, and I'll give it a 5✨️ rating/ With a 👍🏻👍🏻!!! Until then... you only get 2**.

author: Psyop guy
content: Google worked hard in the recent years to prevent the user from being able to manage his storage. You can't realy see or filter for deletion photos from device that were not backed up. You have to use a one button that they provide. UI does not indicate where the photo is. The user is only left with the possibility to store everything and buy more google cloud storage. Its a money trap.

author: Alexandria Nichandros
content: good for linking your phone to backup stoarge, and the search feature is good. very annoying for sorting and organizing and DOING things with your photos, unless you only want to change one photo at a time. if you want to do anything to batches of photos, it's totally annoying. also it crashes on my chromebook pretty often, but never on my phone

author: David DeVane
content: This app is good for storing my photos in cloud and accessing them across devices. My biggest gripe is i wish there was a way to make it only store my photos and not do anything else. I dont want it sorting them for me. I dont want anything grouped. One folder with all ny pics. Thata all i want. No suggestions. No "helps". Leave me alone and store the pics period.

author: A Google user
content: Unwieldy & annoying, it keeps randomly creating albums & moving images there, but then it won't let me share images on Facebook anymore. It comes up with 'suggestions to "Manage my library" ', except it dosen't make any suggestions, it just says "caught up with everything Check back later for more suggestions", lord only knows what it has done this time. Here's a suggestion, let me edit my own library!

author: Knife Life
content: It ok, but they taking away the unlimited storage. They get rid of all the good stuff. Thing is people still support it. I dont get why they have to mess things up. Use to be a music app that stored the downloaded music to the app and not your phone also. And could play offline!!! Best ever and what ya know. They got rid of that also.🙄

author: Keith Charsley
content: Good for reviewing photos as they are but incredibly slow moving photos to an SD card. Far quicker to move from the camera to a temporary computer file and from there to the SD card. I tried moving a large number of photos from the camera to an SD card using the app which crashed in the process and I lost half the photos. Now I only transfer them via a computer.

author: A Google user
content: Photos get deleted when backing up sometimes. Some photos become grayed out and non-accessible. Also, a major thing is that when pressing save to device, it hardly ever downloads the photo from the cloud. When I disconnect from wifi to cellular, once in a while it works, but that's like playing lottery. All the sudden minutes or like 10 minutes later all the photos start downloading. I pay for this service and it's garbage.

author: William Kratky
content: Don't really care for this app as I expected a lot more functionality from the geniuses at Google. For example, the algorithm that picks out photos and suggests archiving is great, but it ends there. I can't zoom into the photos in the archive suggestion view to confirm what I'm archiving. Or, often times its a great suggestion, but I want to delete instead of archiving. Nope, no way to do that aside from exiting the view and finding the photos manually.

author: Ionut Ciuta
content: I'm very disappointed in this app. For a few months now I've been unable to upload my photos. I select the them, I see the upload progress bar and that's all. Can't really see them on the web app and can't free up my device storage because the photos are stuck in limbo. The album creation is also faulty. I only randomly manage to successfully create a album due to the same reasons. The photos are not being uploaded. This is so frustrating. I even paid for a GDrive subscription.

author: P S Bose
content: My downloaded images get lost or completely mixed up, creating confusion. I download it today, and next day when I want to see the WhatsApp pictures, I don't find the pictures. After a lot of searching the pictures show up some 15 days or 20 days prior. All the pictures get mixed up completely and tracing the pictures is extremely difficult. Very annoying. Finding pictures is tedious. No improvement with the updates.

author: Julie Barrett
content: Aggravating, very aggravating. When I upload the photos, they disappear into oblivion. They are never to be seen again. Sometimes this app makes extra copies of a lot of my photos I have to sort through them and it's very time consuming and as soon as I get it done, it happens all over again. Just very freaking irritating. Google can do a lot better than this. Get a different photo app. There are way better ones than this one.

author: F H
content: They broke it, I can't add people to shared albums, if I go to more and select any it says invitation sent but no one is getting them. They don't show up as invited, tried over and over. But my wife's iPhone version works fine. Can't find albums you own without using search so you need the name, seems like not all are showing, wife had same issue with one i shared with her after this update. I don't think Google employees actually use their own products. Maybe they know better than us.

author: Alex Nowis
content: Having played with the new layout for a few weeks, I am not a fan. Why has the option to download selected photos or photos from an album back onto a device disappeared?! I spent fifteen minutes ticking photos I wanted to redownload, yet there was no download option. So frustrating! Everything was fine the way it was, I dislike how some albums have now moved & you have to search for them manually if they don't appear in the album's list. Please add a download button & make the UI simpler.

author: Oluwatosin Joseph
content: I've been having issues with launching the app for about three months now. It started when I updated it. Whenever I click on it to launch, it bounces right back to my home page and I'd have to click over and over and over again before it eventually launches. I've tried restoring to the device version and that issue stopped, but then I updated again and it does the same thing. It's so frustrating! How can I fix the problem, please?

author: 7Moons
content: I have a google pixel, so I'm practically forced to use this app but I don't mind using it. The layout has a nice use to it. But this app is not at all consistent. Hence why I'm using another gallery app from google that acts much better. It becomes frustrating whenever I delete an photo from google photos it gets off my device, but when I delete a photo from my gallery that's more prone to not being removed from both platforms and only one. It's not consistent, especially when coming back.

author: A Google user
content: Confusing UI- Never sure which all media is on the device and what's on the server. Difficult to manage. Some functions don't work many a times e.g. Movie: 1. Sometime it allows you to download on device sometimes it doesn't. Confusing. 2. Can see pics downloaded through WhatsApp 3. I deleted some old movies but keep appearing again and again. 4. Old pics take a lot of time to open as it uses data to get downloaded first. It the internet is fast enough, you struggle. Not a fan.

author: Jonathan Andrew Hume
content: What happened to SAVE ALL in Shared Albums? There used to be a SAVE button at the top of the Shared Album page when someone added to it. Since the last update, this had disappeared! Was this accidental or intentional??? It makes no sense to individually open and save each photo/video - especially when I've just had someone add 500+ to it! - Help please!

author: B H
content: Horrible! You can no longer download more than one pic at a time. Each picture or video needs to be downloaded individually. I had a photo album on my phone of pics & videos that need to stay on my phone. I backed up all of my other pics & even though this particular album was not set up to backup, Google photos backed it up anyways & deleted the photo album off of my phone. I now have to download over 100 images 1 by 1 & re organize them. Please stop with with updates. You are ruining the app!!

author: Hayley Gunston
content: I've just downloaded my Google photo app into a new phone having backed up the album's. But on my new phone it doesn't show the album's thumbnails in the library. I can only find the album through a physical search using the search box. This is no good to me when I can't walkways remember the name of the album! I want to see all album thumbnails like on my other phone?

author: Stuart Rally
content: Good app for short term. However, for long term uses, it automatically deleted some photos and videos you had. Not only that, some that aren't deleted, when you tap on one to get a bigger resolution, it skips to a different one. Backup is an issue that also deletes some photos too. Overall an unstable photo app.

author: Jennifer Maynard
content: Please add the option to add a name to a face instead of waiting for facial recognition to figure it out! Absolutely love this app. I do wish there were more sorting options and that there was a button to add a name to a face. I have so many photos of my kids and family members but the app doesn't recognize that there are actual faces. I should be able to tap ANY face (even if it isn't recognized as a face) on ANY photo and have the option to "add name".

author: A Google user
content: Doesn't do anything any other cheap/free photo editing app will do. Considering it's advantage of being able to strip away every bit of privacy, by being part of the operating system and by it's uncanny ability to make itself the storage space for photos, videos and photos that you don't want to be turned into videos and videos that you don't want to have every last bit of realism stripped away from, it should be able to do a far better job. And one last comment - I'd (oops too many characters.)

author: A Google user
content: So I'm not sure what happened, but I updated the app and I can't organize my photos, add photos, or create an album. The photos will move back to their original placement, the photos will delete themselves from the album, and the new albums will delete themselves. I shouldn't have updated the app I guess.

author: A Google user
content: Half of the time google photos corrects my pictures or suggests wonderfully stylized photos and I'm very happy with them. The other half of the time it shows me the filter I've selected but wont save the edited picture correctly. When i try again, it loads the version I've selected, but wont save it. I'm about ready to give up.

author: WW C
content: Since my prior review in Feb. ( below) there have been several updates , NONE of which have fixed the problem. Kinda sucks. Recently, can't recover photos from trash, even the same day they were deleted. Just gone! And now, after an update two weeks ago, can't even delete ("no access to sd card") And there has always been a problem in that photos cannot be renamed without going through a Rube Goldberg process. But it actually does have some good, built in editing features.

author: pratigyaaa
content: This app does not let you save the created movies. So, frustrating totally spoiled my day on a stupid issue. Wasted my time and efforts. I also went thru the steps of forcing stop and clearing the cache but nothing at all has improved!! My movie is still not showing up as a VIDEO and the DOWNLOAD VIDEO option will not appear. It take hours and days for the video to finally show, if your lucky! this is soooo annoying. 🥴😠😠😠😤

author: Michelle Bernard
content: Since there is a trash bin, I don't understand why you need to confirm each delete. It's so cumbersome and makes cleaning your gallery way too slow. More importantly, why is it so complicated to delete photos and have it reliably synced across Google photos AS WELL AS our own galleries (eg Android/Samsung) even though these have been selected as synced folders. It seems like it should be easy, but I find all sources of help even more confusing.The automated replies are useless and patronizing.

author: Arseni Nimera
content: New internet features in image editor make it far less useable than before. I do understand the desire to sell Google One to us, but denying me the simple image cropping ability because I've lost my internet connection is silly at best. I think you can just as well cache the "paid functons" and only check them when internet is available and not every time you are on "image editor" activity. For me this is pretty major, thus only 2 stars.

author: Vibrations Om
content: Having unlimited storage is great but the fact that you cannot tag, sort, organize or label photos makes it less of a photo management software and more of a mere cloud backup drive. Google's Picasa from 10 years ago was more advanced in every way with its ability to label photos, and batch edit photos. What a big downgrade this has been.

author: Alastair Hull
content: Was a 5 star app but recent big update not only makes it unusable but I've had to uninstall it. I started to notice my phone getting really hot and my battery suddenly going from a comfortable 1.5 days to half a day at most. Looking on battery usage it's Photos? No uploading, no clue what it's doing. Tried reinstalling. No change, so I've had to uninstall and now my phone is back to normal... Not really what you expect from a Google App on Google's own OS.

author: Austin
content: Maybe it's a bug with an AI shift or something, but my Photos will lately be labeled with the correct time/date... they'll just be organized under different times/dates. No way to fix it so far. Example: a group of photos will each individually say they were saved in the afternoon of June 22nd, but the library sorts them into June 1st, 2nd, and 3rd.

author: A Google user
content: I find theres too much going on in this app & it's missed the point of its basic function. I just want to quickly view my photos (like I could with my old photos app) but this app is very very slow. Loading recently taken photos or deleting photos take several minutes which is very annoying. You are not sure whether it's your photos are saved or deleting or not. After 1st activation of cloud backup, I was flooding with alerts every 5 minutes for 3 days with "remember this day.."

author: Kevin Dufendach
content: I am extremely upset Google will be charging for a service that had once promised free unlimited storage. Classic bait and switch. I used to recommend Google Photos to everyone, but no longer. So disappointed in you, Google. Previous review: great for storing, sharing, and searching photos. My wife and I each have our photos shared with each other automatically, so I get to see the fun adventures from the day. I also love its integration with my Google Nest Hub.

author: Michelle Waddick
content: purchased photo prints, just received them. They are so dark. The pictures with people of colour shows almost no facial features, lawns in the photos look like a deep hunter green, the contrast is terrible. I purchased a photo book a couple Xmas's ago, and it turned out quite nice, guess I expected the same quality. Won't do that again.

author: oxyharmonic
content: Why, when I preview photos, do you show me squares, when the photos aren't squares? It makes it really hard to select which are the good shots. And what have you done with the photo editing in photos?? You went from intuitive sliders to a long hidden menu, that vibrates my phone everytime I change anything. Big step in the wrong direction.

author: Darrick W. Bachelor
content: Well what I can say is when I can't access my photos because of a lack of wi fi really hurts my opinion of your app! Just because I can't update the stinking thing I have no access to photos I've had for a very long time! And ahh yes I think of them as mine! No something for the app to hold out like a carrot no hit the button sucker! 😒 I guess you could say Americans don't like being forced or manipulated in to doin somethin 🤔a certain way!

author: Matt S
content: I don't like when something keeps messing up by trying to do something for me. I need to be able to turn off whatever mechanic makes the edges "snap" into place while cropping a photo. Or at least make it so that it stops snapping into place the fourth time I try to move it away. I know where I want it cropped and I've never had an issue. all of a sudden, you decide I must have help and you are snapping me to points I don't want. why break a not broken thing?

author: RC Brooks
content: Clunky is the best word I can use to describe this. Google manages to ruin everything they acquire. So much better when it was Picasa. But that's not helpful to improve. Simply make the app lighter. No need to mine all our info. I'd be willing to pay for a simple app that allows me to embed from the server but I don't think that functionality exists anymore.

author: A Google user
content: A complete folder of my photos are missing automatically from my Google Photos App. Day before yesterday was the last time that I saw those pics in that particular folder(Google Photos). But, today i don't find it anymore anywhere. It's not that I've deleted that folder mistakenly. Assuming even if I had then it should've been under the trash section. But it's missing even there!!! My memoirs are all Ruined. All the pics from my latest trip are gone now. Disappointed a lot.

author: Nigel H
content: Too many issues, restrictions, and not enough options to make this usable as a photo browser. One of the main problems is that the app wants to identify & display every single image file that exists on my device and doesn't appear to allow the user any control of which folders to access and which ones not to. Does not recognise hidden folders. F-Stop provides this and many other useful features (showing filenames, size, etc in browsed lists) I would consider basic in a photos app.

author: A Google user
content: I am providing a real pain point of almost all users for the product manager of google photos, basic thing this app should do is save the folders on cloud according to their folder name in gallery. What this app does is just throws all the photos in an open folder which can contain thousands of other photos. If a user needs to look at some older photo, he needs to search through those thousands of photos. Main reason this app is not doing well is this. Pls add this feature in next release.

author: Darren O'Brien
content: Since recently, I have been able to sort pictures by date. I like most recent photos on top, but whenever I choose the options, the app states OPERATION FAILED. I have cleared cache and data, uninstalled and reinstalled, and rebooted the phone. Still, it doesn't work. Otherwise, the apps seem fine. Will change to 5 stars if this can be fixed.

author: Auguste Maillot (Eaugustative)
content: It would be much more convenient to have both options for albums and folders we have on our device, and consider either a folder or an album. The difference is really confusing in the app, and it makes the management awful. Overhal, not really easy to use app in the way that things are managed really strangely, not only for albums and folders

author: madi
content: I accidently clicked "move photos to archive" under "organize your library" under "utilities" now most of my photos are gone from my gallery and I don't know how to get them back. I'm also very frustrated that when I delete a photo from my gallery, it stays on Google photos. this makes a big unorganized mess of random screenshots so I have to go through all my photos and delete specific ones by hand. please help I just want my photos back 😭 there are also no photos in archive.

author: Jeanette
content: It incorrectly groups all my screenshots, my camera photos, my pins and downloaded videos together... Into one "Camera" folder.I'd like all of them to be in a seperate folder but I've found no solution. Please make a function to view all our photos in one folder. But the most problematic part is when we have to move devices. Now, the dates are wrong and some of the photos aren't moved despite being backed up!!

author: Michael Pursell
content: The app and auto backup features are very nice, but the lack of a manual exclude folder option makes the app unusable for me. Photos auto detects album art from my music folders, and makes thousands of new photo albums for each music albums art, making it impossible to find actual photo albums. The ".nomedia" does not work in this situation, as the music would then go undetected. Many other gallery apps support manually excluded folders, I would love to see it implemented here.

author: Kirsty Morris
content: Update ruined it, I loved the old version of the app, I hate the new one. Its difficult to use, it's hard to find photos, all the collages and animations I saved, I cant find now. Only halfway decent part is the showing the photos from years past. Not an app I would recommend to anyone, I'm very disappointed.

author: Equuology X
content: Way too invasive. The app tries too hard to organize/recognize things that it just feels very invasive. Also, it sucks when I'm trying to show a family member a picture and the app keeps asking me to confirm what's included in a NSFW image (which ends up sparking an awkward conversation in itself). It's a good app, but it just feels so invasive and too excited to do things you aren't ready to do. (I actually disabled Google Photos and use a simplified gallery app for these reasons.)

author: Debbie Couch
content: Used to be my favorite app and it had the best search to find photos but the updates this summer have made it harder to find photos, sucks up a ton of space and seems to store duplicate photos from my phone without a quick way to find duplicates. I pay 1.99/mo now and app keeps recommending I buy more storage at 19.99/mo. Crazy! Don't fix what isn't broken, please!

author: A Google user
content: This is the second time I'm reviewing this app and in both situations its because I'm not happy with the app. Just a few days ago I couldn't view both photos and videos in the camera folder and everyone knows that's the main folder of the app. Everything has gone black for reasons I have no clue to. I can't post to any of the social media for this cause. I wish I could upload a screenshot of the problem so everyone could see. I have updated the app to the latest version but its still not working.

author: Beth Budwig
content: This app just keeps getting better and better! Love it! Update - latest version has a bug where I can't press the bottom buttons, like you know, "save". It's terrible. I spend time editing my photos and I never know when I'll not be able to save them and have to discard all my changes.

author: Keith Hanley
content: Google photos has recently introduced auto-framing, a feature which is not only unnecessary in my opinion, but makes cropping photos more difficult. I don't need the photo to be moving around (tilting, rotating, etc) while I'm trying to crop it. Perhaps some people may find this feature useful, but I am not one of them.

author: A Google user
content: It's a good app, but it's lacking some basic functions and I can't understand why Google will not add them. Examples: sorting options (by filename, date added, date taken, size, etc). Album order (date, name, amount of photos, etc). The option to overwrite already backed up photos in good quality, with a version in original quality if you change the backup quality setting.

author: Dave Green
content: Search option doesn't find partial photo titles and despite having all notifications off it pesters the user with annoying 'suggestion cards' that can not be turned off. Useful for photo backup, but really the least they can do when you have to buy an expensive new Pixel phone every few years. This app is getting more difficult to use with every update. Revised November 10, 2023.

author: michael enochs
content: I don't like this app. I don't like how unorganized the app is. All I want is to be able to select a folder to begin with i.e. Internal Memory Card or SD Card and be able to have folders inside to make that organized. The app called ES File Explorer is everything I wished Google Photos was. I don't even know which photos are in the cloud and what's on my phone. This should be a very simple concept that is incredibly harder than it needs to be. You only need 3 tabs: Cloud, Internal, SD.

author: Jennifer Muir
content: I don't understand why ALL photos aren't stored in the same place. For instance, I find I can't access photos I want to access, while on Facebook. It appears photos are kept in two, different places. This is BEYOND ANNOYING. Pictures are pictures. Store them all in the same place. DIFFERENT FOLDERS would be IDEAL, so things are easy to find. I don't like the "date way" to file things. SO, I need to WRITE DOWN the website? I can't seem to highlight it, and copy it. Why ask us to rate the app?

author: A Google user
content: I'm sorry but I don't like what Google photos does to the pictures I take. I have trouble finding them after I've taken them. I move them to folders and then the folder is missing. I can't understand the symbols when I need to crop a photo. There is a lot of technology available in the app that makes it just too complicated. Wish there was a simpler way to manage my photos. Can you tell I'm a senior?!

author: Ilja Korolevich
content: missing a lot of simple basic functionality! Just mentioning a few: (1) no option to upload videos, only photos; (2) constantly offering the syncing of photos, which can easily mislead the user. (3) no structure and system in searching photos in case willing to find "Memories" photos stored on Google. (4) no simple navigation in selecting files for upload. this time I decided to stop resisting all the inconvenience and search for smarter alternative, which can be found on mobile app market.

author: Lynn Kel.
content: Horrible. Moved downloaded photos from one folder to another and find out later that they completely dissappeared. No sign they ever existed, except I used them for profile photos, etc, so I definetly had them. Not in trash. Just gone. And previously trashed photos from same night are in the trash. Photos moved to a different folder are in-tact, thank god. But this is ridiculous.

author: A Google user
content: I really can't stand the fact that photos cannot actually be "moved" into seperate folders. Sure, they can be organized into different folders but they all still stay in the same main folder which makes it hard to keep everything organized and clean. I was used to this with Samsung and LG phones, so it's a huge inconvenience with this being Google's gallery app. I've given up on organizing photos on my Google phone because of this. Will probably switch back to Samsung if it stays like this...

author: A Google user
content: Using a new device, Photos was automatically set to sync and backup my pictures. Didn't realize deleting them from cloud deleted them from my phone. Lost at least an hour of work sorting through the ones I had deleted on purpose and the ones Google deleted for me. I turned it off, but that doesn't make it a bit less annoying that it happened. Quite angry.

author: Stacy Maddux
content: Making albums, editing from albums, or uploading or backing up doesn't allow to do it from albums you made on your phone. Makes it quite a hassle. I can move photos but when I go to edit them or delete them I have to go back to the camera roll..... When you upload that it's just a big old upload, not by the album that you already made. I want to organize my own photos not have Google do it for me as a primary and basically only organizer.

author: Morgan Maclellan
content: They recently made an extensive update. Disappointed to see that when you search and then select a photo and then go back your search is no longer there and you are on the main screen. Let's say I want to look at all my Disney photos, I don't want to re-search "Disney" every time I go backwards from a photo selected in the search

author: A Google user
content: Organizing abilities are very poor. Main annoyances: 1. No way to filter and see only photos which do not belong to any album. 2. No way to delete a photo straight from an album (have to remove from the album and then find it again among the photos on the main "pile of everything" view).

author: Alex Evans
content: The app hasn't been backing up my photos for weeks (just eternally "Getting ready to back up"), it can't seem to load anything in my library before 2019, AND NOW after years of ensuring they were the most viable free cloud service out there, they announce they'll start charging for storage of reduced quality photos next year. Just a disaster.. What's going on here?

author: Bob S
content: My camera photos are stored to my sd card and now I can't delete any with this app. It asked for permissions and to locate the sd card, goes through the motions of deleting but photos come straight back again. I've had to roll back to an older version of the app to cure this. A plus point of doing this - edited photos now don't save the the PhotoEditor folder, which was a pain!

author: Raymond Chenon
content: Really awesome product. Except for 2 small features : 1 the default SIM's data plan is used to upload photos. Whenever you change SIM card, it resets . It costed me 20€ in one day. 2 Photo folders cannot put in a folder. In 2018, google photos doesn't allow to create sub folders. You have the tech & talent just prioritize those 2 features. I hope a product person reads this.

author: Rick S
content: Was pretty good, but with every change, I like it less. The info button is gone with the latest update; I checked the support forums and I did click on the 3 dots- info option is not there. I spent 2 hours reinstalling, moving photos off my phone, and restarting my phone; option still isn't there. It is silly that every time there is an update something else breaks. Also, I feel like it's silly that there is no feature to flip a selfie photo and it needs another app to do that.

author: Roger Chappell
content: One major flaw: people don't want to keep every photo they take, that's not how people use cameras these days. A lot of the time we take photos of things to show friends or partners things over chat, not because we want photos of those things to keep forever. Also, why would we want to keep screen captures?? So I think this app should have a setting to only back up what is in your camera folder, images that are an hour old, or just overnight or similar, not immediately after taking them.

author: Paul Jensen
content: When I save screen shots, instead of saving to the area they are supposed to go, they go to some different section, and this I can't save them to the photo album s I want to save them too. Also,I keep my photos backed up daily. I've had times where I have needed to switch to a new phone. I'd re-backup to a new phone, then returned my old cell phone to the manufacturer! Then I discover that only abt half of my photos were transfered!!! And I'm now missing photos that I can never replace!!!

author: Thread Bomb
content: Sure, you can easily upload all your photos, but downloading them is practically impossible - the process is obscure and fiddly, and you have to do this for every single picture. There is no bulk download option! Also, the app will keep starting up and using data, unless you disable it.

author: Yoav Moran
content: For a main working tool with images - this is one buggy service. Edited images are saved without edits and seen bad in the web. Edits in the web cause duplicate photos to appear in app. Comments in images keep mixing between images, and sometimes disappear. I've tried to scan an old album, and 50% of my time was spent on trying to overcome these issues.

author: Yane Alfonso
content: I like the app but more than once lost bunch of photos. Don't trust the backup system. Once I click on "backup your photos and save storage in your phone" photos went to the moon bye bye. And recently my phone got broken. If you have all your phone folders with the "backup switch ON" is not enough. I've lost everything again!

author: Stas Ivanov
content: Terrible update for video editing After the most recent update trimming longer videos became a nightmare! Previously, long press on the "border" for video trimming was taking you to a slowly moving video start / end while "zooming" into the timeline - so you had a good precision when moving video start / end. Now the same mode doesn't allow you to slide farther into direction of the editing "frame", so you only adjust the length within a few seconds, and then you need to "zoom out" again.

author: casey soper
content: I used to use the animation feature all the time. With the new update it's been ruined. With a sequence of photos it used to offer me the option of turning it into an animation. Now I can only choose a single photo from a sequence and it's not offered as an option on the actual photo library page. It's gone from being a simple process to a long-winded feature that doesn't work.

author: A Google user
content: Hey Google! I have had recent problems regarding the photos tab display. The photos seem to be scattered among different dates even though they're all taken on the same day. Checking the "Info" on each image, however, shows the actual date it was taken, so the bug is mainly on how the images are displayed in the photos tab. Please fix :((

author: A Google user
content: When editing, Photos used to automatically keep a copy of your original photo. You're unable to search for albums when adding photos to albums.. Lack of privacy is main concern. ANYONE who has link to your album can view the photos. In other words, it's not private at all. (Google+ had options to keep albums private, ie only persons you explicitly shared with could view photos and they could not forward the link to anyone else. Photos should have this functionality, but currently does not.)

author: A Google user
content: While I appreciate the ease of uploading and having my photos accessible on my phone. I pay for a large storage amount and often deal with glitches. My photos are hard to access on my other devices, share links don't often work, editing formats keep changing, and I've had to delete and reload the app multiple times.

author: Sarah Munford
content: Great app for backing up and organising photographs. Just one thing frustrates me - the face labels / name tags. These are automatically assigned and there is no way to manually add them when they are missed. It also frequently mis-labels people, or groups people together meaning the correct tags / labels are lost! Hoping this feature will be added in a future update, then I'd give it 5 stars.

author: A Google user
content: The app keeps getting unnecessary changes. I just want something simple. Now there's no option to see all of my photos at once. I don't care for folders, timestamps, or backup. I have fewer than 5 photos, and I can't even find them all. It's very frustrating.

author: Xylene Graves
content: I usually love it most of the times, but I dropped my rating from 4 stars down to 2 stars. Because the new format is constantly pressuring me to buy more simply because I'm at 66.7% capacity, which took me 5 yrs to use. Yet, EVERYDAY, I'm told I need to monthly data plan. 4Star Post: One thing, when creating finalizing projects, I feel software commands could be more intuitive or obvious. I can't remember where to start bc it was disjointed in my head. Then, it takes me forever to get started.

author: A Google user
content: Photos gets backed up for sure, but sometimes, rarely, some photos may get backed up and some portion of it is greyed out, Or like crashed or corrupted. And also, they are very poor at responding to your complaints, I've complained 5 times, but never got any response.

author: Janice Trigg
content: I don't like that it scrolls through memories, etc. I'd like to do that myself. I want to be able to have option to delete a collage, enhanced photo, etc. The only option is to save and if it scrolls past before I see it I don't know how to get back to it. It's not user friendly like previous version.

author: Helen Timmins
content: I HATE this app. If Google updates this app, please PLEASE change how users can organize their photos. If I create an album, I don't want to just copy the photos from my camera roll, I want the pics in that album only. I also want to set my default view to albums, and not scroll through hundreds of pictures to find something. Also the ability to hide/unhide albums. Please.

author: Leo Stache
content: Uninstalling the update until the Library tab gets fixed. My issues with it are described below: This is a gallery app. I don't like the way the app likes to "organize." A lot of people probably like it, but I don't. More taps to reach the same destination. Consolidating all the albums into categories adds more clicks to do what used to be 1. Why make something 3 taps when 1 tap do good? This is following the Windows style of changing things.

author: A Google user
content: Solid app in most ways, but when I attempted to email the email address listed to report a potential bug, I received an auto reply that says the inbox is no longer monitored. If Google can't provide a working email address, they are setting a poor precedent for their platform as a whole.

author: Claudia Odette Barrios Muralles
content: I truly hate that the users cannot choose to NOT back up camera folder. I don't want every single photo and (specially) video to backed up in the cloud. I would infinitely prefer to create a personal back up folder and automatically upload only the media in that. Oh, and add a "delete from cloud" option, so I can keep my media in my devices if I so choose.

author: David Fawcett
content: This app is getting pushy with turning on backup and a lot of other stuff. it won't stop asking me. I said no when I setup the app years ago. In the last few months it's now asking me about ever week or less. If I said no I mean no. It's like it's waiting for me to hit yes my mistake one day when it pops up... Also with all the Google app icons almost looking the same I keep opening the wrong apps from time to time.

author: Xeng Vang
content: New updates are screwing up how I want to open up the pictures and videos. Keep them all in one place. Stop putting them in different categories where I have to keep looking for the specific folders and categories. It makes it so difficult to find them. Just reverse it back to the old pictures settings. Sharing and making prints aren't important to me. I'll prioritize my own pictures and videos. Stop throwing them around different places, then I can't look it up because it's no longer there.

author: Lil Landy
content: I changed my rating because I can't seem to find a way to delete duplicate photos. Most of my photos have saved twice for some reason. I've looked everywhere trying to find a way to filter duplicate photos, with the ability to filter between the original and copy so I can delete them. I've tried online and with the app and no results. There's also no way to select all for the comments and delete them.

author: A Google user
content: Beyond frustrated with this app! I need to be able to sort and organize my photos and albums so I can find what I need quickly. Scrolling through the 16k photos that where in my app when I updated my phone is extremely inefficient. It seems like a pretty simple feature, moving and sorting photos. Every other photo app from previous phones have had these features. I hope Google can make these changes soon. In the mean time, looking for an alternative app... any suggestions?!?

author: Cherise Simpson
content: I hadn't even done the latest update before my pictures disappeared! I honestly rely on the search function in this app and the one that groups faces together. Since the update became available that feature just permanently says "we are organising your photos come back soon". So I decided that I'll do the update as this must be the cause of the fault, however no joy. Im not sure that uninstalling and reinstalling will put my pictures back or get rid of even more!

author: A Google user
content: The camera is good but it only has picture and video NO slow motion Which to me is annoying because then I have to use another phone to do slow motion. It is also annoying that the photos always does updates with your pictures without you knowing. Also if you decide to delete a video it doesn't delete it you can watch the video if you are on internet but if you aren't on internet then you can't watch that video.

author: Jenna Dodd
content: The storage/sorting on this app is the worst I've seen. It stores photos to your Google Account but only photos you physically take. The rest (from Messages, Snapchat, browsers, etc.) are stored separately. It really limits the otherwise cool features of the app (collages, easy printing tools, etc.). You can manually move them, but why isn't there an option to have them saved there without the tedium?

author: Russell Sheppard
content: There is no button to manually sync up my photos. I have been waiting years upon years but it has still not been added. When I do open the app and leave it open, it will sometimes sync quickly but most of the time it just sits there saying that it is getting ready to sync. I love the app but I'm sick of Google not even bothering to add a simple button that would let is manually start the sync process. I pay for 5GB's a month of storage space and I would like to use it more easily.

author: Seth Moore
content: The new user experience is pretty bad. No standard menus, removal of features like "For you", and the rising prominence of the "Feed", maybe some people like it but for the number of pictures I have is way too many pictures for that feature to be useful. All movies are now only in portrait mode, so no more casting family find to tv.

author: Stephen Liu
content: It has some major annoyances. Photos are automatically sorted by date taken, if you download an image, it'll usually be hidden deep in the gallery bc metadata. No sorting options. Pen size when drawing on photos isn't adjustable. Little control over which photos are filed under which people and pets. Sometimes when I archive something it doesn't move and I have to tap archive again. Sometimes photos won't load and a gray square shows up instead. Very little has changed between each update.

author: Radina P
content: Once I archive photos in Google photos I am no longer able to save to device anymore. I am really unhappy about this. Why was this feature taken away??? Also, all my pictures turn sideways. I have to edit every single one. I thought might be my phone but, I have a new phone and it still does it. It never used to but after an update months ago, maybe even February 2022, it started doibg it. A fix would be appreciated or a setting I can change.

author: Jordan Parchment
content: With every update released, this app becomes less usable & reliable. In the past, this was my go-to app and my gallery app by default. But lately, it has not been saving videos that were edited or even backing up any of the specific videos I've tried to upload to the cloud. The app has also been force closing when trying to create a link to send to someone else. I hope this app is fixed soon because it was my favorite app.

author: W Dawn
content: Like most things you do, it's a great idea but you made a mess of it. Why do you have to make EVERYTHING so difficult to interact with? Yes, I would love to keep everything in one place, but sometimes I need to import/export things to/from Google photos. I have to jump through 6 hoops to get it done. Need something in a specific ratio? Nope. Google won't do that one! Gotta spend 30 minutes getting it somewhere else that will and then another 30 minutes getting it back into photos.

author: Kristi Pace
content: I am trying to give Google Photos a fair Chace, but I have had nothing but problems. On my LG, I have avoided Google Photos because it made the entire prices more difficult, not easier. I now have A Pixel, a gift which I will be replacing soon, and all my photos automatically go to Google Photos. I am in the pieces of figuring out how to change the set up until I order a sufferer phone. I will avoid this app at all costs in the future. Very disappointed.

author: Nicholas Villano
content: It doesn't show everything in your system. Only certain categories like screenshots, photos (camera), selfies, and some downloads. All the other phones I have with a built in photo app had all your pics in different albums, and it was incredibly simple. The reason I gave this app two stars is because I do like the backup and some other features, but the fact that some of my pics are not showing up, even though I just downloaded them 3 times, keeps me from giving a better rating.

author: A Google user
content: Used to be five stars, but downgrading to a very marginal two, and considering uninstalling because *every time* I try to look at the current photos (ie, the ones not yet archived) I get a little banner across the photo, blocking part of the photo, and asking "move to archive?" I then have to click either yes or no before I can see my entire photo, for *each* photo. Do you have *any* idea how distracting this is? I think the developers who did this need to think about changing careers.

author: dauntless74
content: Despite updates virtually every week (?!) this app is horrible to use. It's a mess and so difficult to navigate. Folders and albums everywhere with some unaccessible when you try to post a photo from different apps so you have to move photos from one folder to another just so you can use that photo. The collages are a waste of time, day you choose to use two photos for some reason you can't choose which photo goes top. I wish i didn't have to use this mess of an app.

author: Robin Homa
content: It has been deleting my photos by itself at least once a week and I wasn't even aware of why my important pictures kept disappearing until I checked my 'should-have-been-empty trash" , and there were about 28 of the missing items. I've apparently already permanently lost the others. Back up anything important immediately and it will be a fair app, but if I could get rid of it for a plain camera pictures app, I would.

author: Anonymous Sloth
content: Photos are HUGE no matter what setting they are on. My pics on my Samsung are coming out (and stored) as 5.5 megabytes.... sometimes I get lucky and they are around 1.8 so yeah my pics range from about 1 MB to 7MB. Therefore, it makes it impossible yo send them. Also if you aren't sending iPhone to iPhone or Android to Android. The quality is horrible, no matter what setting you have it on again! This is becoming such an issue that people are now using Samsungs gallery. horrible app now....

author: Cynthia Farris
content: People who like albums like creating not having it done for them. This app makes its own copies of your photos without permission and saves them as albums or new stylized photos to your device. So now you have triplets of the same photo and you have to waste time going through every form of file you have in every app deleting the excess. Who needs triplets of every frickin photo with out permission. Please make this stop. If this app didn't automatic everything it really would be the best.

author: Nicola Palmer
content: Since the latest update. Sporadically needing to take a photograph, it tells me it's unable to open camera, as the Google photos app didn't download correctly ?? Not great when you want to catch an instant pic of something. Have uninstalled and reinstalled twice, AND updated. Not impressed with this latest update. What have you done Google ?? Smh.

author: Constantin Sandu
content: Something really bad happened, some of my albums are "doubled" (i.e. I see 2 albums with the same name, but not with the same number of photos) and I am sure that some albums are lost. I always thought that this is the most reliable way to keep your photos, but apparently not anymore. Very dissapointed!

author: A Google user
content: As described by other users, it takes FOREVER to upload pics and the notification in the app is TOTALLY STUCK saying uploading and the numbers never change. Tried restarting reinstalling everything - nothing works. Used to be MUCH better once upon a time especially earlier versions and Picasa. Unless Google fixes this slowness and performance issue in batch uploading of photos, this is extremely frustrating. Users will start moving on to other apps. PLEASE FIX THIS ISSUE.

author: A Google user
content: I just got to say it's so frustrating navigating my photos when they're stored on Google. The thumbnails are huge and there's no way to reduce the size. also what happened to all my folders now? they're just all in one folder or with Google's pre suggested folders like faces or places which is completely useless.

author: Becca P
content: Every update feels like it gets worse, more cluttered and harder to use. I have all my photos so randomly organized. Give an option of how we want the photos sorted, either by date or name or size even. The library sorts them in folders by date of when they are created. Which for some weird reason certain images have really wacky dates! Let the user select which photos to import or which folders, I hate having useless tiny images from my downloads folder since I use it to store files on the go.

author: Ahmedul Haque Abid
content: Changing my rating. The app has no proper privacy settings. Even after putting photos in archive to hide, It still shows in from "Photos in Devices" section. Sorry but your new update super sucks. Make possible ways so that I can properly hide photos and maybe password locked section. Also do not F-ing show hidden photos, no matter what, even if i switch account.

author: Netriosilver
content: Slows me down, lacks customization. When editing photos, you sit through FORCED loading screens while editing just for it to "look for suggestions" and find none, having wasted ten seconds of your time for no reason when it should've only taken you ten seconds to even make the edit. This app also does not allow you to view all photos unsorted, and I downloaded a different app to use by default so that I can see the images I didn't take with my camera without pressing five buttons and searching.

author: Kel
content: If this app can delete photos directly from the device folders, it should be able to restore directly to the device folders. The app attempted to backup all of my device photos and ran out of space. From the app, I deleted everything but a few key images I wanted to keep. However, I later found all of the images had also been deleted FROM MY DEVICE, even though I was using the app. I couldn't restore the images because the app didn't have the space for them. This seems like an oversight.

author: Cortnee Beauvais
content: I have a very positive review until the update took place. I feel I have to re-learn the whole application now. The new version isn't as good in my opinion and is said to be easier. Unfortunately I had enable auto update selected and if I only knew then what I know now! It may not matter to new users but for the rest of us it seems most are not pleased. I have the old version on my old phone which is not convient but at least it allows me to find something a lot faster and easier.

author: A Google user
content: Review Update Jan 2020: On a Note 10+. When I edit videos, I get "Unable to save" and I'm just left stuck. Google Photos Help has a long thread on this with other people experiencing the same problem (various phones), but no solutions from Google. Also, you can't edit videos through the Photos web interface on a computer. So basically no options at all to edit videos from Google. This kind of crazy.

author: Yolanda Gober
content: It would be *GREAT* if once you add the pictures to an album, they are not kept in photos. Sometimes I move so many that it's hard to remember which one's I moved. F R U S T R A T I N G AND TIME CONSUMING 🤪 *UPDATE* Now when I delete pictures from photos because I already moved them to an album, they disappear from the album and vice versa!!! How can I go back to the previous version???

author: Faith “Fern” Shrestha
content: This app is so insanely bloated with random features when, really, I just need it to be a photo managing app first and foremost before anything else. Why is the first tab not my library? Why is the option to buy your photos a significant button? At least let us customize the order of tabs and change it so "Move to folder" isn't behind 3 dots.

author: ― Bʟossoᴍ ୭ु ̖́- 『Iɴғᴀмoᴜѕ Sмᴀʀтγ』
content: i'm a little pissed off. up until now i've had good experiences with the app but now i'm going to have to pay to store photos on my phone? i don't have another photo app and can't afford to use the new update that will make me pay for storage. what the hell was the point of charging us to use a photos app, a basic function of a cell phone is taking and storing images. very frustrated with this new money scheme of theirs.

author: Wendy Mulherin
content: Even if you manually disable the app from using background data in the device settings, somehow, it still sucks away Gigs worth in a couple days with only around 500 pics stored. The app keeps creating new collages, animations, etc from those and backing those up without asking... Not good if you're on a limited data plan!

author: Brandon W
content: Following up with my previous review, I also extremely dislike the fact that I cant change the amount of pictures that appear within one scroll of my phone. Some are landscape that the whole page and others can fit 6. I know the picture was taken with the phone horizontally, but I would like the option to be able to see more pictures and actuay customize that option

author: Ahmed ElBayyae
content: Good app but needs a lot of improvement 1. The photos take sometimes too much to load I don't know why this issue didn't happen on my old devices ( Samsung and Apple) 2. I can't change the album's main cover or choose which picture I want as a thumbnail and that's sad it's always the newest pic some time I don't want from anyone to see what's in there and this is a issue 3. I can't organise the albums the way I want also very annoying Actually I very disappointed

author: A Google user
content: I loved Google Photos! I am disappointed with the quality of the photo books since Google changed its printer from Oregon USA to South Carolina USA. Once the photo books were shipped inside a plastic sleeve that preserved the books - now it's encased in a thin bubble wrap & is not reusable once opened. The layouts look haphazard with full page bleeding cutting off a sizeable portion of the original layout.

author: Nunaya Bidnez
content: I guess you cant edit a screenshot once uploaded to Google photos. I don't understand why. If you can, then why is it so difficult to figure out how? Google often makes things much more difficult than they need to be. (Ever try to make a Google ad? Forget about it!) Also I uploaded a 75 MB video and tried to make a link to it to share with my friends. For some reason I spent an hour trying to do this and nothing I did would work. I got the link and it kept saying error. I am fed up with this app

author: Josephine
content: It's been a good app so far, never had problems with it and was all around pretty satisfied, but since 2 or 3 weeks ago I can't edit any of my pictures. Every time I try, I see the picture for a short time while editing and then it's black. I can't edit a picture I can't even see. This really bothers me and I have no idea what's wrong, I already tried deleting all Updates und then updating the app again but ist still somehow won't work.🤷🏻‍♀️

author: Family First
