author: Richard Whitcombe
content: New RAW file handling is infuriating and nearly unusable. Previously RAW went to a separate folder, you could choose not to back it up and easily delete them whilst keeping the jpg. The newest dumps them in the usual folder, no ability to stop them backing up but worst of all, no ability to bulk delete RAW whilst keeping the connected JPG -you need to go through each photo in turn and do it manually. With 100s of photos this is infuriating and slow. Terrible, terrible change.

author: Jennifer Rice Solomon (Jen)
content: Don't like it cuz I don't like the fact that you can't change the look of the collage, can't figure out how to change them to my format, I don't want to have to sync my photos w someone to send random photos, n I hate that it's constantly pushing you to buy the albums. Plus some photos I would like to keep 100% private. Don't like Google don't like messenger or Facebook but to keep in contact w family have to have it.

author: J L
content: The app seems ok at first glance, but is unnecessarily tedious. Search function is a joke. Updates make the app complicated and Harder to use. It constantly saves images in new random locations and creates duplicate folders. There's no way to remove a watermark after picture is taken with one by mistake. There doesn't seem to be Any efficient way to transfer photos to an external drive (Yes I tried G. Exports). Especially not one that lets you delete from your cloud in an efficient process 🤬

author: TongarevaPrincez
content: Frustrated, I'm unable to get rid of a tab that says backing up one photo.. And it's been back up since yesterday (13/02/22) like I can't turn the notification off or I can't swipe to at least ignore it.. It's frustrating because it ends up interfering with the other tabs that pop up on my phone.. Like come on a swipe to the left or turn of notifications will do.. It won't even show the photo that is being bcked up. The tabs annoy the hell out of me and this just won't go away..

author: Michael Goldstein
content: Used to be a great app, but ever since the last few updates I have not been able to view saved photos from a shared album, editing is extremely slow, searching takes forever, and videos frequently take an extended amount of time to play despite excellent internet connectivity. I hope this gets fixed.

author: James Rodriguez
content: The app basically has a stroke whenever I try to move pictures between folders. Sometimes they all get moved immediately, but more often than not some or all of the images I select stay put for multiple minutes at a time and I can't do anything with them until the app eventually catches up, even if I restart the app and clear its cache. Using any run-of-the-mill file explorer lets me do it without issue, so I don't get why the Google-developed app for my Google-powered phone has such issues.

author: A Google user
content: i don't know what's wrong with GPhotos, but it's always the same problem and you guys really don't care to fix it. Everytime the app keeps saying "waiting for Wi-Fi" for to upload, the problem is that my setting was for to upload with cellular data, but everytime this setting switches by itself from cellular data to Wi-Fi, and the problem is that when i go back in the setting there's no way for to change it again from Wi-Fi to cellular data, so? How long it'll still keep for to fix that?

author: A Google user
content: Normally, pretty good at everything, but somewhere around July 13th my photos stopped syncing from my phone. I've tried all the online suggestions to no avail. Resetting, reinstalling, clearing cache, removing updates, checking settings, checking permissions, etc. Many times over... Manual upload also just sticks. Not sure what the issue is, but as long as it continues like this I can't recommend it.

author: Martienne
content: Wow so i just found the faces photo frame widget and tried to add it to my desktop but it gave me an error that I don't have enough faces marked to be able to. I found this very odd since I spent literal days a couple of months ago going through albums to make sure all the faces were tagged as the right person (I have 6 kids and they all resemble one another, so I had to fix a lot). I went in both the app and desktop site and now there are zero faces saved in my albums. What?!

author: Vijay Chandramouli Suresh
content: The Google photos app is one of the best options out there to store your photos, but off-late the automatic photos uploading into an album based on faces are not working. I had to manually add them. I urge the technical team at Google to please have a look and solve this issue asap.

author: John Chaney
content: The militant and overengineered attempt to abstract away your photos from their folders in the device filesystem is not appreciated. The option to get to them has been pushed around to like 3 different places in the UI the past couple years and it seems like google's deliberately trying to prevent you from just using a directory/file-based approach with each update.

author: Angi Kinsey
content: I don't know what's going on with this new update but it has screwed everything up, and the layout is completely different. I keep trying to erase things in my picture and it's just selecting whatever it feels like it's not working correctly anymore I can't edit my photos the way I want to. it's gone to straight trash. is there any way to undo this last update because it's awful!

author: S M
content: It's fine, but what I don't like it that it dosen't recognize the folders it's pulling from. I have some carefully curated folders, and this just lumps them all together. Search function is not useful in this case. I end up backing my photos to a hard drive just to keep the folders intact. Also would be nice if it had a feature to detect duplicates.

author: Mikhail
content: I have been using this app since 2013, and it really helps me to look back to the gold old days. Thanks Edit: On June 2021, there will be no more free unlimited storage for high quality photos. That sucks ngl, because for those people who take a photos and videos a lot, the storage will be very limited and it's only 15gb. Sad. Might as well try to find new apps for back up.

author: David Bartlett
content: Awful. You're never really sure what folders you're looking at. For example, I have created yearly folders on the phone of photos that I removed from the Google photos cloud as space there was running out. However, when I select CAMERA from the library it displays these folders as well so giving the impression that they are synced to the cloud. It's all very confusing.

author: Ádám Mészáros
content: Missing basic functions like selecting multiple fotos with a swipe, moving folders into folders, selection of every photo in a folder, incredible slow when I move more stuff from one folder to an other to the point where it just stops doing so with some files. Also it has more and more paid features wich you can't hide, if you don't update it will show a message every time you open it... Im deleting this app

author: A Google user
content: I don't want all photos in the 'camera' folder to upload. Ridiculous. Should be able to choose. Out of 50 photos I choose to keep maybe 5 good ones. Don't want the rest. AND 'free up device storage'. What is it freeing up? No info on what is being removed from my device. I do not use 'free up device storage'. Google, stop trying to control users like Apple does.

author: Curt Raymond
content: Google photos seems to have a mind of its own. Sometimes it keeps all my photos backed up, no problem. Sometimes it misses a photo or 20 but when I prompt it it'll go ahead and save 'em. Some photos it just absolutely will not upload for love or money, no how no way, no error message. I wouldn't mind so much if it'd tell me why....

author: Stanly Rodriguez
content: The app was amazing but Google, after using its users to train their AI's to identify faces in pictures, announced they will remove free high quality picture upload because it's using too much space in their servers... Yeah, right, of course, they didn't think about that in the first place, that was "unpredictable". Without free storage, I don't see any point to have the app. Thanks Google again for using us.

author: Erin Kriss
content: I thought when I tapped the button to clear space and archive photos I would be clearing space in the Google photos. Unfortunately it removed nearly all of my photos from Gallery on my phone and moved them to Google photos. I cannot get them back into Gallery. I think it did not clearly indicate what would occur and it could not be indone.

author: Drelan Crear
content: It's a good storage app, and I love the memories that pop up, but I don't like how the photos storage is tied to my G-mail storage. I tried to delete some recent photos from Google photos, but it deletes them from my phone as well. I then tried removing the storage permission from the app so that I could delete them from just the app, but the app locks me out saying allow access. If there is a way to delete photos from Google photos without deleting them from my phone, I will raise my review.

author: Douglas Bashford
content: I've been using this for a little over a year and find it to be pretty useless. But it is good if you can get it to work, to quickly swipe right or swipe left to view a large number of photos in a hurry. But you have no control over your photos or where they go or where you keep them. All of its most useful functions are unpredictabe, and are also awkward and slow to use, such as rename, move or edit. This seems intentional. They don't want us to do that. Often a renamed pic will disappear.

author: L. Seward
content: My 5 🌟 just went to 2 🌟 after this last update. The magic eraser is horrible. Before I could just swipe what I want to erase and it would work. I tried it 10 times and it would not work. The Unblur doesn't look as clear as it used to as well as some of the other features. I pay 4 Google one and edit ALOT of pictures which is very time consuming and now it's taking me more time. Is there anyway to get the new update removed? Because if not I'm going to have to find another editing service!

author: Auto Intake
content: I love the fact that all my old pictures from phones I had years ago are still safe but the limit on storage space and the lack of an easy download to device and delete feature means this app is now really frustrating. I now haven't received emails in over a month because there's not enough storage space. The fact that it's designed to do this to make you buy more space makes it even more awful, they still get to see my private info I just have to pay to give them more of it 🤦🏽‍♂️

author: Jessica Calderon
content: When viewing images in Google Photos app on my android phone, I starting having a weird mirror image watermark of the photo. It seems to be on new images sent from an iPhone. There's also no way to effectively report this through the app, because I cannot get a good screenshot since it takes one of the help menu instead. There is also no way to choose a better screenshot from my library.

author: Vincent Russo
content: Absolutely HATE how it forces me to give full access to reading/writing my images. I get it, it's to constantly back up my photos, but that's almost exactly why my Google Drive is now filled with mostly images from older devices. And if you deny permissions? You just can't use the app. Maybe if they let us view/download only without granting permissions, then I'll reinstall Photos.

author: Code
content: The only reason I give this two stars is because you can do some cool things with Google photos. None awe inspiring however. My biggest complaints includ the fact I have to share everything that's in photos with the rest of the world, navigation through the UI, as well as the plain weird behaviors its been made to have. I had a list prepared but I only have 500 characters. In conclusion, Not impressed. More confusing than helpful. Wish I could remove it and use a different service all together.

author: Brandon Beesley
content: Absolutely horrible lack of features that should be "no-brainers", such as a count of the photos/items or ways to search devices for photos not already listed, etc. The backup/archive functions are nice, but without basic organizational features, the archive very quickly becomes an absolute nightmare to wade through the mess

author: Jamie Bensusan
content: It is starting to get annoying, my photos and videos are not on the correct day when taken. They keep being backed on and under the wrong date category so it's hard to go back to pictures when you don't know what day they will be under. I do hope this issue is sorted soon as it is really annoying.

author: Terence Hampson
content: Recently this app has been pushing hard to backup photos. To the point where it seems like they are hoping you accidentally press yes. It seems like at least once a week when I go to open the app that give an prompt that is not dismissible with a toggle already set to back up with a button that says continue. you need more intentional button presses to explicitly say that you do not want to backup photos. I don't want to upload photo automatic to Google, I have my own backup solution.

author: Karees Mathers
content: I had to drop my opinion of this app for inconsistencies. I have this on my Samsung phone and Samsung tablet. On the phone, the operation is still functional. However, it will not function properly on my tablet. It opens for about 4 seconds and then closes. If I open it again, again it closes at about the 4 second mark. At that point I get a message that the program is not working correctly. I notice this beginning on 31 January 2022.

author: rick boylan
content: I used to be able to take a picture and draw lines on the picture using the markup editor tool. I'd use this for marking off item on my grocery list and it worked good even when the phone went into sleep mode. Recently I believe you made changes with an update and the markup feature now doesn't work the same. When I'm using it and the phone goes into sleep mode the app loses the edits and/or has problems and makes the function non useable.

author: A Google user
content: Used to be really good on android. After a recent update it locks, freezes, crashes and the "select" check boxes for selecting and deleting, archiving, or adding multiple pictures at one time to an album is gone. Please bring back the previous features that worked fine before the update. I'm super frustrated with the new version.

author: Dean Ziyone
content: It takes over control grabs all photos and throws them to the clowd. Left with a reference position. So you want to look at an older photo you have to be online. Now that you took my photos i had to ask for them back and are now compacted . ii i still don,t now where they are expect using your program. You had no write removing my originals without asking. And archiving doesn't mean cloud storage only. How come your coments on reviews are not copy/paste and not even hyperlinks. Unpresuable

author: A Google user
content: The update ia terrible, your pictures do not show up in the app, even though in file manager you can see that they are still on your memory card. There is no way to bring them back in to the Google Photo App so if you dont mind some of your pics randomly disappearing, i suppose get the update.

author: Richard Wainwright
content: I love Google photos and use it to back up all my photos creating albums to sort them. I browse my photos primarily using the albums section. The latest redesign is awful, moving the albums options under collections is a convoluted way to access them. I think Google should allow you to customise the shortcuts at the bottom so the user can customise their own experience. However the current design is simply terrible!

author: Alastair Stevens
content: Ridiculously broken in recent weeks. Photos keep reappearing from the dead, even when expunged from the bin. Storage warnings abound because of this. Hundreds of pics deleted weeks ago suddenly reappear, and hey presto, storage at 96% full. But you can't easily download them either, as the bulk download functionality is also completely broken. Absolute pain!

author: Aarushi
content: The photos and videos don't all get saved in their respective folders. For example, all the videos I edited on INSHOT and it was saved on the INSHOT folder on my phone, it all doesn't get saved on the INSHOT folder on Google photos, out of 53 videos, only 6 are on the folder, I've tried to add the videos on the folder but that isn't happening I've also waited more than 2 weeks since I thought this might be a glitch but it isn't.

author: John Ball (Jak)
content: Editing photos moves the saved photo to another folder and you got to go looking for them. When you use Photo Edit, Crop, Rotate, the edit saves to PhotosEditor folder. Then you have to select the edited photo and move it back to the original folder you started in. Even after this move , you can sometimes not find it. I would much prefer it save to the folder you are in after edit, A choice, Save or Save as Copy in same folder.

author: RoseSpacesingOut
content: I can't find images saved from my browser (Google Chrome). Is there something I'm missing? I've checked every folder and can't find them. UI isn't very user friendly and I wish I could just use a stock gallery app but this is all that came on my new phone. Also, total BS that you have to buy more storage to store your pictures.

author: Seth Wilson
content: This app worked fine, but keeps asking me to update it. When I finally did, it stopped saving my photos. I've lost some amazing photos and video of my 2 year old daughter, because it looks like they save, and then they vanish. Might be a problem with the camera app, but something is causing me not to trust the app.... Which makes it pointless. (And I can't uninstall them because they're pre-loaded.

author: Donald Gomez Erving
content: It stores photos okay, but they are stored in this washed out, sepia tone like setting, and I've tried everything I could to have them stored in their original color, because I enjoy scrolling through them and not so much individually, but nothing works. It's such a drag. I mainly now use Gallery, and stay away from Google Photos for this reason.

author: Lingrah PC
content: I'm not one to hate app updates. I work in IT and I'm all for improvements, and usually love learning new UIs if it means a better experience. The changes Google photos has been making over the past year and a half are the opposite of user friendly. Making simple things difficult to do, forcing unwanted things upon you, and most importantly, removing options for how YOU want to manage your photos, only how they want you to. I'd sooner recommend the default file browser app.

author: A Google user
content: Since I've upgrade to galaxy note 9, this application doesn't work like it suppose to do. I noticed that this app dont sync automatically when there is a wi-fi connection, even when I'm trying to to this. It still stuck in getting photos for uploading and freeze there. I've tried reset phone, reset application, uninstall application, another account.... unfortunately nothing works.... On my old galaxy note 5 everything were ok..... I don't know exactly where is the problem and how can i solve.

author: Davis P
content: Can't add people to conversation! I'm trying share photos with family members, after adding 4 names to the conversation, it won't allow me to add anymore. And Yes they have Google photo and they have Gmail email addresses... When I click invite and type their name their email comes up and then hit send. Their email doesn't add to the list.

author: A Google user
content: Used to be great, but now it is just confusing. Pre-fills some very strange search words, but doesn't actually use them. Constantly pops-up dialogs about assistant, albums, etc. when you're just trying to get something done. Maybe google could buy Clippy from Microsoft? Geesh.

author: Kaylee Dunwoody
content: There's a bug that won't even let me report the bug. Only certain photos show up when trying to share/use them in other apps. Which I assumed may be a privacy thing so I clicked on the 3 dots in the right corner and selected "options" then the app will close out, then it gives me the option to "send feedback" then that closes out too.

author: J. Black
content: I do not like the UI used to set photos home screen, or lock screen pics. It's too narrow, and didn't allow you to customize the width of your photos adequately. It's very annoying. Secondly, I don't like the ads at all. I generally get rid of any app that spams me ads because I'm not interested in them at all. It's*ukking annoying on any app, and you will never get any revenue from spamming me with ads. I'll probably get rid of any app that I can that brings me ads.

author: Thomas Holmes
content: Used since 2016. Worthwhile editing features (free in other apps) require paid subscription. Used Google Opinion Rewards to pay in years past. Since Rewards is phasing out, I won't be renewing my paid subscription by paying out of pocket when other editing & storage apps can integrate for free. Thanks for a good run, Goggle.

author: Ashley Johenning
content: Frustrated. When you attempt to upload images from your device to any app, it shows them in chronological order based on the most recent image saved to your phone. Google photos NEEDS an option to see ALL items from ALL folders in chronological order in the same section. For example, If I took a few photos on Snapchat, a few on my camera and also downloaded a few my friend sends me on WhatsApp, then I shouldn't have to go to 3 separate folders in Google photos to see the pictures i saved

author: Odion Mercy
content: I felt comfortable saving my photos here cos I can always see them even when the photos are no longer in my phone gallery. I discovered that the Google photo app in my phone show spaces for saved pictures and videos but they are not visible; I have to know how I can restore the photos but it has not been possible. I'm unhappy because I have happy memories saved there but I can no longer access them. Please how can those pictures and videos be restored?

author: Ana Pineda
content: I sent feedbacks & screenshots by email; waiting for answer. 06/17/2023 I will contact you by email expecting your help and a solution to this problem.(06/15/2023).. Now Google photos is modifying my captured images!! This is not acceptable, any AI is capable of doing what I know how to do. I DO NOT NEED THIS!!! Your AI is not capable of doing a good job. I see how my beautiful picture is transformed into an ugly photo shot. You should give the option to accept or not any changes to my images .

author: Travis Seagroves
content: This app is one of the most frustrating apps I have used. I have problems getting the uploads to work and will say upload pending and will refuse to do anything, I have tried clearing my cache, app data, switching accounts, logging out, force stopping and restarting my phone and nothing has worked. Can you guys please make your app work properly I never had this problem before now it just keeps doing it, I'm paying for 2 tb storage and u guys can't even make the app work right.

author: Michael Odunayo
content: I DON'T WANT BACKUP FOR EVERYTHING!!! This app is fantastic in my opinion but it does way too much. There are folders i don't want or need to backup for ever!, like my SCREENSHOTS and some other folder i created, it annoys me how i can't just switch off backup manually.. I hate that there is so much junks backed up on my photos, please fix!

author: Mary Bozzelli
content: While I love some of the features this app offers and I subscribe monthly to storage, I have been unable to back up and clear photos from my phone for awhile now. It's stuck at 75 gb of photos on my phone that are unable to be removed for storage space! I've tried everything - removing and reloading the app, clicking the prompt when it comes up as well as going into the app and trying it there. I've tried troubleshooting from forums online. No luck.

author: BrutalNightmares
content: The app is nice to have for piece of mind but it is not very user-friendly. It does not upload your photos into the folders/albums you have them in, so if you need to find anything, you have to manually make folder for photos that you already have in folders. There is no intuitive way to force a photo sync so I don't know if some photos will be saved if I clear them off my device without manually checking each an every photo.

author: Alex F
content: UI / UX of sharing multiple photos is terrible now. Please kick out the employee who did this. In fact there is no way I can share selected photos, (only of I share one to another Google photos account, I can then proceed and share more after by adding new photos to the chat like interface) but for some reason I have totally unusable magnification button that does like 20% zoom. Worst update ever. What works incorrectly: When in photos tab, and selected multiple photos, there is no way to share

author: A Google user
content: Poor app makes albums and collage without asking which is taking my storage. When I require any thing done I would like to be the one to instruct my device to do so. Kindly remove the albums you have made as well as the collages. Do not repeat the process without my instructions to do so. Thank you.

author: • chippy82577 •
content: No longer having free unlimited storage is so evil, but now the editing feature feels so convoluted when it used to be easier to navigate before. Also rounding the corner of the image the user wants cropped is bad. The images have sharp corners and will do so after editing, so it makes no sense. ALSO I'm now unable to edit those images in my screenshot editor without having to screenshot the image when I used to be able to do so freely w/ an option in this app. Changing that was a mistake.

author: Julie Bolt
content: I kind of hate this app. It archives or does something to my photos so they can't be accessed by third party apps unless they're "restored" or "redownloaded". I've contacted google and they had me reinstall the whole app which worked until it hit whatever arbitrary time limit that's set and started archiving them again. It's really unclear how to fix this and is causing me a lot of frustration.

author: A Google user
content: This is an awkward piece of garbage for the most part I do like the ability of my Android to take photos but manipulating them is tricky. Either the Android or the app has refused to allow me to set up an album. I'm not particularly happy. It has also arbitrarily set up albums for me when I had no intention of doing so.

author: Matthew Correia
content: Generally good, but the value proposition reduced significantly over the years, and it's missing major features to actually MANAGE all the photos it collects... eg: no way to easily bulk convert motion photos to stills; no way to filter by stacks (and if that would be possible, also no way to flatten stacks in bulk to just the top photo for each). Management in this app needs way more attention. I wish it would use AI to highlight standout photos among the many i take, for easier favoriting.

author: Iris Croatica
content: Nokia 7.2. - deleting photos does not function. It deletes a photo or two when it feels like it. It doesn't work when multiple photos are selected nor when I want to delete a picture I have curentlly opened. The photos are stored on the same memory card I had on a prevoius phone where it worked normally. This has been going on ever since the update to Android 10.

author: A Google user
content: While with other platforms take a photo and have a copy on our laptops or PC's immediately, with this one we have to take a photo, go to a web browser, download photo, move to folder....  And if want to "sync" multiple photos, you have to select and download a ZIP.  So, I guess the "sync" word shall not be used to describe this app.

author: RAEchel Running
content: it frustrating to move and share to FB. Why is it so difficult to rotate images? You have to rotate 3 times or open the adjust. Very time vonsuming. I find it not intuitive to organize or see as a contact sheet - wish I could access via my computer desktop. I wish it was more photo- media friendly. Wish I could say I love it but I don't.

author: Oliver Vernon
content: The movie making feature is just terrible. There's annoying things like it automatically adding music and not showing the entire clips you imported, and now it just keeps crashing as I'm trying to simply put together four 15 second clips. It just generally does not work well and isn't user friendly, and it's been this way for ages! You'd think a company like Google should be able to figure these things out...

author: Kat McKinney
content: Awful update. My upside down photos don't flip automatically any more. Landscape photos need flipping. EACH AND EVERY TIME they need saving as a copy, which is the most stupid update they could have come up with. I thought something was wrong with my phone, but no, just idiotic decision making by the product team at Google.

author: Chris Wallwork
content: Great, seamlessly easy, but the fact theres no way to rid my library of duplicates is a game changer that some other apps support. Really wish it was a feature. Edit: Just installed the new update and it still has no utility built-in to identify duplicates like Picasa had, like iphotos has. Lowered the rating by a star, tell me why Google photos does not have this feature. Only reason I could imagine is that it forces you to store more photos than intended, increasing your need for storage.

author: wayne artz
content: The photos do not appear as an option to select pictures from in most apps. Could be made simpler to rearrange the pictures in the different albums and combined albums. When sorted by the date, it should be the date the picture had been taken not the last time you sent it. After I put pictures in an album, should be able to delete all other copies without it deleting the last album copy.

author: Aesthetic Garden
content: Over all this is a cool app to store all my videos and screen shots and photos but when I took my screen shots out if the screen shots album and pressed the plus sign to put it in my personal albums then I deleted the ones in screen shots because I THOUGHT it was in my alblums now. Then after I already PERMANENTLY DELETED them it wasn't in the alblums. I had so many stuff I just put in the trash and now it's gone. FOREVER. I don't like this app.

author: Sophia Rowe Nadezhda Cruz
content: i’ll rate it two stars since sometimes i experience some glitches or bugs that i don’t know why it happen often. when i save a picture from facebook or from other apps, the picture would appear late. to appear in the album, i would have to restart the app again so i can see the picture. this is pretty annoying. sometimes, when i edit a photo, then click “save,” it would say “unable to save changes” like what? – i didn’t do anything wrong, i just edited a photo. please fix so i can rate 5 stars.

author: A Google user
content: I've been messing with this from a week but now I just found and fixed it. Its a bug inside the app that if you put anything in trash and them somehow the containing folder gets deleted and you hence its not in sync with the Photos anymore, you won't be able to recover that back. To do so you need to create the same folder at the same path again to restore it else it would keep on saying that its been restored but you won't see that in your storage or photos.

author: Linda Urban
content: Since the last update end of July, I have several "missing photo " experiences. one minute I see them there, next minute they are gone. Frustrating! Cannot find them anywhere even if I follow the instructions in this app. Not happy. A couple were from an important family event.

author: Westin DeGough
content: The new photo editor is severely worse than before. The appearance is peak but the functionality is trash. The thing I miss about the old editor was the ability to just go through each adjustment instead of having to navigate a ton of different sub-menus. I like the idea but it just doesn't click.

author: talatu ibrahim
content: I have a bit of problem with how the backup works. After i backup all my photos and want to recover them, it doesn't rearrange all my album like how they were before i backed up. It just put all the videos and pictures in the same one place and it's frustrating to have to place them in the album they were before.

author: Stuart Buck
content: It doesn't have a natural interface and the clean up option tries to archive most document photos saying they are clutter. I don't like the 2 way sync feature so if you delete an image in either then it's not long before it's gone on device or google photos, there does not seem any way to control this. I do like the timely reminders as they spark conversations, you know, when people used to talk 🤔😉.

author: Jester
content: This app thinks for me and I despise that. I don't want you to create panorama's for me 2 months later. If I wanted a panorama I would have created it myself. I'm not able to upload my pictures to other people well, but it sure can auto sync every picture I take every time I take it. I have had to reset account options multiple times. I have had enough of Google apps being too intrusive.

author: Lynn Scheid
content: I never had any problems w/this app before it updated recently and now it's like a jigsaw puzzle with lots of missing pieces. I am hearing impared and can't hear at all. Bc of thar I have to use email, texting and Gallery for contacting people and they do the same if need to contact me. Seems that every othr week or so my Gallery has a mind of it's own. I am tired of always getting into settings to fix this. We should be able to chose the way we want our phones to work.

author: Migz Solarez
content: The worst of them all. you can't see your device folders on this app, just the individual files. It only backs up what the app wants to and not what you want. you can't tell if the files are back up or not. you just have to trust the app did back it. Microsoft can do all of it but I need the extra 1TB storage Google offers

author: Liam I
content: Was great, lower rater for removal of "for you" tab. I know use photos through chrome as the app is a little too much of a copy of Instagram. Please reinstate the "for you" option rather than having to go through all the recent highlights. Not great at all.

author: Laura
content: I'm gonna try to explain my problem. On Google files it told me to remove backed up media, telling me that I could still see it after that. But after backing up, I can view my media, but not in a folder, and I cannot put the pictures in an album. I really want to have a my photos organised, especially my camera media.

author: Diane Floyd
content: I want more control/understanding of what's going where and clear, simple spaces. This version is cluttered and more difficult to navigate than earlier versions. Sharing is far from obvious. Leave out suggestions for albums, books, animations, etc. etc. etc. More isn't necessarily better.

author: A Google user
content: Super disappointed that facial recognition isn't available. Crazy that I can't just mark friends and family to easily find other photos. I like the collage function but silly that can't amend collage once created and no way of marking which photo should be the main one or in which arrangement to show a grid of photos (by order chosen or any other means). Also can't seem to locate Google photos albums with many other apps (including canva) so have to try find by scrolling through thousands.

author: Sabra Schirm
content: Sadly, a very mediocre photo editor. It came built into my new phone, and I was unpleasantly surprised to find it had less than a quarter of the capabilities of the default gallery editor in my 8-10yr old Samsung phone. Aside from the warmth slider, there's nothing it can really do that that 10 yr old gallery editor couldn't, and a lot it CAN'T do that the old one can. You're better off downloading a secondary app.

author: Wunder Flurries
content: It was great and intuitive before but I finally got annoyed with it constantly telling me it will be better if I updated so I did and now when I want to edit a photo, the 3 slider bars that the edit button looks like are gone and in their place is 400 options I will never use. Editing photos used to be simple and quick and now it's horrible. HOW DO I ROLL BACK UPDATES???

author: Mei
content: The UI is horrible. Is difficult to distinguish between what is in the cloud and what is only on my phone. Yes, there is a little icon in saved photos - but when you have lots of photos, it becomes difficult to organize it efficiently in the cloud. Yet, the app doesn't allow us to use it only as a cloud service instead of a gallery app.

author: A Google user
content: I'm so fugging mad! I spent weeks tagging people to their rightful faces because the app cannot seem to differentiate among asian men but for some reason, many of the faces I've tagged was removed. I love the app, okay. It is very convenient at times, but it's annoying when you remove the tags I worked so hard to organize. Please do something about this. It keeps happening and I keep retagging the pictures.

author: Andrew Mierzwiak
content: Google photos makes it extremely difficult to view and download albums on the computer. Backup from phone is fine -- but it is nearly impossible to download full albums off the cloud. It times out 100% of the time on googles end. Have gone through dozens of steps with support and the only option they provided was chunking up the downloads into about 100 photos/videos at a time... For tens of thousands of media items.

author: Ron Lai
content: While I like that the developer is trying to keep the app fresh and more organized, sometimes LESS IS MORE. This applies here. Instead, all these UI changes have done nothing but confuse me; and I'm a technologist! Also, I need to be able to flip through hoards of photos quickly looking through EXIF data, and that capability is there but only an afterthought. Now it is near impossible to access my photos in my existing albums. It is either bugged or designed this way!!!

author: Xiaoqiu QIU
content: Unfortunately, the new overhaul removed some functions of the previous version. One can no longer adjust distortions in crop mode, and adjusting "pop" or using "enhance" requires "save copy" now. For the previously edited and saved pics, one also cannot incrementally do further edits but has to start from the original pic.

author: A Google user
content: Encumbered tech is BAD tech. The fact that my auto backup stopped working on Feb-1 is criminal. I followed ALL steps of the "troubleshooting" (except I refuse to have to reformat my phone for ONE apps deficiencies) and it still didn't backup, even when trying to force a single image at a time. I've kept trying for months and then when I created an album, it mysteriously started to backup again. Then it stopped after only completing around 600 images out of the 4500 still on my phone that it had stalled on back in Feb. I'm paying for this (and Drive) for 2TB. Why though? For Drive functionality, it seems. Photos as a backup tool is not reliable. And right now, as I type this review, Photos is currently failing again, just by selecting 96 images to load into a shared album. A progress wheel has been spinning and spinning with no end. Time to force quit. It's 2020. You should be able to make your tech work at this point.

author: Suzi H
content: The latest update has ruined the app. I'm a tattooist so rely heavily on my phone for taking pics but with the new update the photos keep self brightening or going really dull when scrolling through so I can never tell what the photo ACTUALLY looks like. I've had to delete all the updates on the app and it works like it used to again. Shared albums are now a tiny tab at the top and for some bizarre reason photos are arranged oldest first so you have to scroll to the bottom to see new pics 🫠

author: Meagan Petroni
content: I wish movies were easier to make and they had more categories for the ones you can make automatically. I also wish it was easier to find music to put with your videos and that they made it easier to label faces when they get it wrong or the person is wearing sunglasses. Overall this app feels like a total after thought and for those of us that value our photos it's kind of a disappointment.

author: C Courtney
content: The recent upgrade is plain awful 😔 My phone will not allow me to access and move my photos into SD storage. I cannot move photos period. Please, can I just revert back to the previous version??? Also this version takes up much more space on my phone!!! I used to be able to transfer photos to my SD card, but the upgrade doesn't allow that anymore on my phone. While I thoroughly enjoyed this app in the past I now find it extremely frustrating.

author: Coq Suqer
content: I'm giving 3 stars because, while it's a decent app for what it is, it's an app I never asked for, therefore never use. Except when it's filled up my cloud storage, by backing up photos I never asked it to backup. And then when I delete the photos in the app to free up cloud storage space, the photos get deleted from my phone and I lose them forever. Edit: Typical automated response from a company that doesn't care. Drops to 2 stars.

author: Kayla Smith
content: Not a fan personally, I've lost so many photos after removing old phones off my profile. I had no idea it would delete the the files too. Not even a warning saying I need to back up my files or they'll be lost. All my daughters 1 year old photos gone. On a positive note this app does have nice features. I just wish it alert you before it automatically deletes files. 💔

author: Robert Walczyk
content: It's been 5 stars since 2016 but the app was gradually going down. It got to the point it's so slow I had to switch to alternatives (on Galaxy S22). It takes seconds for a picture to show up after it was taken, I can't rely on it to browse latest pictures any more. This is the most basic feature for such application and it's been broken over time 😢 I still use it for browsing historical pictures hence 2 stars. PLEASE FIX, I WANT TO COME BACK

author: John Hodgson
content: Updated version worse for cropping. Perspective cropping has simply disappeared. Used it all the time to correct distorted photos of texts and posters etc. Poor solution on my phone, is to go to Settings > Apps > Photos > App details > Uninstall.... which gives you "Do you want to uninstall all updates?" > Uninstall.... Reverts me to older version. Perpective crop there until the app autoupdates to latest version then con again. Infuriating! Bring it back please!

author: D Gomez
content: Sooo buggy. I could love using this app to organize my photos, but I think it would be really helpful to have a 'search for album' function when adding new images to an existing album. It can be very difficult to find the album that the selected photo belongs in, esp because there is no sort by ABC order, date or search! I think this is an extreme oversight on an otherwise great app. Maybe the app developers could consider adding a feature to sort albums by abc, date and a SEARCH(cmon Google🙄)

author: Vicki Haaland
content: I liked the app for taking pictures. But when I was told I had to much storage used with pictures. I deleted over 100 picture. Same message. Then went to storage to delete and did in my phone storage. Still message. Couldn't find another way. Tried looking on line for help. Unsuccessful. Sent hours. I finally deleted app. Will try again because I hope not to lose pictures altogether.

author: Antonella Coiro
content: Recently, I decided to move synced files from my phones internal memory to a larger sized external sd card to free up space on my phone and upon resyncing those external sd card folders, google photos has resynced every one of the photos in those folders AGAIN, taking up double the space! Yes, my Android phone does change the creation date of these photos when I move them for some silly reason, but can't google photos just see my photos' NAMES and realise there's no need to re-sync duplicates?!!

author: Jeroným Komanec
content: This app doesn't work properly with the new file management in Android. Anything in your DCIM folder on the SD card is automatically backed up, which includes all albums created from the photos app on the device, without being able to choose which ones to back up. To circumvent this, you need to create folders OUTSIDE of DCIM, then you can manage which ones to back up and which ones not.

author: Donna Daubert
content: Like getting the memories. But can usually only see one pic. Too many clicks to get to other pics. Can't see to save the memory pic. This is very discouraging as some of them are friends, family, and pets that have passed. And can't find these specific pics, videos in history. Also haven't found how to save pics to albums.

author: Doug Kippen
content: Perhaps a single user's issue, but... One irritation is the use of the term "Archive" in Google products, without any explanation of what exactly it means (a web search turned up no answers). Does the Archive function delete the file permanently, or does it move it to another storage location for later use (and where is that, and how do you retrieve previously-archived files?)?

author: A Google user
content: It's really annoying sometimes and there are not a lot of editing options. I can't mirror pictures or do near as much editing as I would like. I also dislike how it suggests deleting pictures and how many notifications I get. I just want a place to store and edit my photos.

author: Joyful K9 Services
content: Always pushing me to pay more for more space...i would prefer lower price options, and I would prefer push notifications for duplicates, old photos etc. I would also like help with organizing into files (animals, work, nature etc) Too expensive for the space I need....

author: Lisa Rose
content: You can't put photos that you already had like if you put photos from another phone on to a new phone it want let you make a folder but it'll let you make a album. I'd rather have the option to make a folder and not a album. Just for that reason I would NOT recommend this app for your pictures. Also it wants to archive half of your photos just because they just sit there or they've been on your phone for a while.

author: Billy
content: Doesn't work right since the update was applied 2 days ago! After clicking on the "edit" icon it takes a very long to to open editing, and then the copy function for copying text in a photo isn't working properly. It did finally open and work once yesterday, but every time other than that one I got an error message advising me to try again, but noayter how many times I would try I would always end up back at the error message

author: A Google user
content: For the past couple of weeks, Google photos been acting weird and lagging and not backing up my pictures and videos. Even though my photos size is normal and I bought storage too. Please explain what's going on. I am afraid of losing my already uploaded pictures on Google photos too. Also face recognition is not working very well since some faces are not recognised

author: Kyra Shepherd
content: Please implement a 'restore photos to device' function. Upon losing the data on my device, there is no way to restore the thousands of photos I had backed up here without individually downloading them one by one. Additionally, the app backs up all my photos from various albums, but without the organizational structure of the albums. So I can't even re-save the photos systematically by album.

author: Maaria Juva
content: For videos it should be optional if they autoplay in the thumbnails. Also the first screen should be the thumbnail. Now they just play automatically (in the app) and show a random screen (e.g. when choosing photos and videos in WhatsApp), making it challenging for privacy when someone is looking over your shoulder and you're scrolling through photos. I imagine it's bad for the battery too, as well as distracting.

author: Stef_Hipari
content: No need for a long post. Please read all the one star reviews as they are for the most part, pretty spot on. I'm baffled by how subpar the sorting algorithm is... And on a Google product of all things. Like, it actually makes no sense. To add a second layer of corny to this app, I am also using the terrible Google pixel 6 which at its MOST administrative performance, is Fisher Price at best.. Cannot wait for my next device so I can get back to a conventional OS' gallery.

author: Richie Bansraj
content: As a pixel owner it is supposed to be the best on this phone. It has some good object and facial recognition software embedded in the app itself which makes identiying things so much easier. However, the app is too cluttered and made somewhat more complicated than it should be. Also, storing photos won't be free for anyone who doesn't own a pixel. I would not recommend using this app because of the storage issue and the overall clutter issues.

author: Bojan Macura
content: Sorting the photos within the album is totally broken. And has been for a long time. Setting the album cover also doesn't work most of the time. I understand Google's objective here is collecting data, and UX has never been their main focus, but this app has a very basic UI options and even these basic options are broken. I have been using Google's ecosystem from the beginning and I'm heavily invested in it both privately and professionally but now I am looking for an alternative photos app.

author: Jade Lazaris
content: It's incredibly confusing, especially with a Google phone. I don't like that I have folders upon folders that were created by Google photos sorted in an order of it's choosing, and then a completely separate list of Google drive shared albums that can't see each other. Maybe I'm doing this wrong? Send help, and chocolate.

author: Jusjef
content: Like that it has unlimited storage. Update: ONE+ 8T5G No longer has unlimited storage for one, and for two, only allows you to download only one picture at a time to store on your device! What's up with that?!? Interface is still clunky and unintuitive as it always has been.

author: A Google user
content: When i stabilize a video, the progress bar of the stabilization on goes to half and then stopped and threw me out of the progress bar screen. I tried to stabilize multiple time, but nothing happened. My screen was fine and had nothing to do with this issue. I can't stabilize any video only rotate and cut the Video. Google, i hope u respond and fix this issue Sincerely, daonlydood

author: Kerry Ann
content: The search function is now absolutely horrendous. What have they done to it? I used to be able to search for a specific month, looking for photos from a past holiday for example, and that month and year would come up in order of the dates I took the photos. It now brings up hundreds of totally irrelevant photos, some from years ago, along with memes, WhatsApp GIFs and anything else it feels like throwing in!! I pay for my storage with Google but will be looking elsewhere now.

author: George HTz
content: I can't keep a backup of my photos and then unlink my account. The photos are deleted. This is stupid as I have a little brother who likes to view family photos but I don't want to trust him messing with other apps and services by accident, so I made a separate profile for him but I still have to have my account "linked" and with it the emails and everything. Also not nice to have the compressed backup photos count in the data plan. I'll be moving to onedrive since I use office.

author: Huwge XB
content: Needs a security option to allow biometrics required to open. I use my camera for work, for private, for all kinds of things and I don't want just anyone to have access to the main gallery. To not even have the option to lock the gallery is bizarre, in today's world. It's a lot of effort to manage photos security manually.

author: ezra (Ezra)
content: Kind of outrageous that i have to have an app this big just to see my photos. Occasionally pictures just disappear. Some features aren't available if you don't upload your pics to their cloud - i have no desire to have all my personal photos on Google's servers when i can just back them up the old fashioned way at home

author: Kevin Wood
content: Good news! The UI just got redesigned seemingly for no reason. Nothing is improved, just moved, and a new super annoying "highlights" was added which only seems to be in the way. Of course, none of the things I have hoped to see for years have been added or fixed. Were you imagining organizing your photos with the use of tags? Think again! Google Photos seems to try as hard as it can to prevent you from using albums as tags. This app is phenomenal at making you want something else.

author: A Google user
content: Not as customizable or intuitive as you would think. If i didn't know any better i would have thought this was an apple product. I can't create an album and then remove the pictures from their original folder/album so I'm just duplicating work. I also can't create private folders like I could with a Samsung. This app is very cloud heavy, which is part of the selling point but if you're in an area with bad service, you're SOL if you've already archived a photo. Overall needs more user control.

author: Logan Cote
content: Sure, it can backup your photos fine, but it has features I dont want but can't disable (the memories feature is useless to me i dont want it), and other features, like deleting photos from before a certain date are missing, replaced by a basic childish option to remove all photos from your phones storage. And once you do figure out how to remove an album from your device, a painful process, the album disappears from the albums tab. Please make this easier to use for more than just backing up.

author: AYAN BASU
content: So many old pictures of my good memories are lost automatically without any action by my side. All are in the list but only showing like dark spots. I tried to open those pictures and then it's showing a dark file only. It's really unexpected and really sad to lose those pictures.

author: I Rahul I
content: Photos is my best gallery app, thanks! But one suggestion (& in need of it very much):- WHY DOES IT NOT HAS AN OPTION OF "SORTING IMAGES/VIDEOS BY NAME❓" bcz. in an album, when you want your many images to be in sequence, then it becomes impossible (due to incorrect date order or exif data error, which may have occurred during cut-copy-paste, or due to other problem) In photos feedback forum MANY MANY USERS ARE FACING THE SAME PROBLEM. PLEASE UP-VOTE & E-MAIL THEM for their dull-attention.

author: Jolene Cowles
content: I love that all my photos get saved innone spot. Only problem is, At the moment i cant get into my account that I had for at lease 20 years. I have gone the route suggested, still nothing. I know you all are supes busy.. could someone please look into me getting access somehow to all the saved data in my Drive/Cloud.. i have reached out through email*work*. Thanks again for all the hard work.

author: Teri McDaniel (Mrs. Scott Field)
content: Bring back the old editing controls, the newer ones are horrible and I can't tell what I'm doing. I installed a different editing app just to get away from Goggle Photos editor...it's that bad. Plus, I'm having to uninstall/reinstall to be able to delete anything... otherwise, it just spin into oblivion without deleting anything.

author: edward
content: First of all it backed up and deleted my whole camera roll without me promoting it to after I downloaded the app, then it didn't give me the option to save it all to my phone unless I go through each photo individually and lately it's been bugging a lot since the update, showing grey squares instead of photos and displaying wrong dates with photos moving across months and years. It's making the process of manually saving all of my photos a colossal pain in the butt.

author: Eduard Georgiev
content: Organising photos can be difficult with this app, as moving items can create huge conflicts and duplicates. Albums have very limited functionality, even tho the app is based on them. To illustrate how unfinished this product is: There is NO way to list all photos that are not allocated to albums. People have been complaining for years but still nothing. Another possibly worse issue is that the app will actively delete photos from your local storage after they have been uploaded, no way to stop.

author: Uh Delynia
content: Hello. Since the new update everything is going awful. The photos aren't backing up from my gallery, it keeps deleting stuffs that I didn't deleted, also it doesn't delete stuffs that I wanted to get deleted! It keeps crashing on me and kicking me out. I can't even go on the app to see some photos.

author: Mary Borgaily
content: I liked Google photos until they started making multiple changes with their updates. App rearranged my photos, grouped them into different albums than what I had placed them in, & added music. I do not like any of these changes. Do not rearrange my photos, add music, date them, or move them around.

author: Tom Watts
content: Google Photos seems capable on the surface. However, files within different folders act as if they are linked often. For example, if I download an item and then move it to a folder, it still appears in both. Worse, deleting it from either folder deletes it from both. Forced to use a file manager to delete it from undesired location. Google photos also seems to have trouble moving items frequently. Similar workaround required. It also loses PC copied items. It's the dumbest smart app I use... 🙄

author: David Swinstead
content: Always loved Google photos and have recommended it to many but after the last update, the UI changes have removed all of the useful stuff (or at least hidden it so well I can't find it) I can no longer find the auto generated albums, the animations, the montages, or anything else that used to be in the "for you" section. They're still present on the Web version thankfully but this means I can't see myself ever opening this app again, it's now only useful as a background synchronisation tool.

author: Onyema Chiamaka
content: 2022 pictures on Google photo wasn't restored after, I reset my phone, As if that wasn't enough, if I open my google photo, I will see a popped up comment "backup paused", I've tried to see if, I can un-pause it or remove the pause but I can't, What do I do to recover my pictures and remove these paused so that the current ones can automatically saved . Thanks

author: Lady Kayla Ackley
content: Usually would give 5 stars, but lately every time I try to open the app, it always goes back to home and I get the error message that it is not responding. Ive restarted my phone several times and still no luck. If it wasn't for the other photo app that came on my phone, I would not be able to access any of my photos. I still get notifications, but the apo itself does not want to work.

author: Sara Kay
content: There needs to be an easier, better way to cleanup my library and organize it. I'd love to have a better working clean management feature, like removing duplicates, screenshots, auto add to albums by using tag labels, etc. Google is too smart of a company to not have figured out how to improve cleaning utility of the Photos app by now. Also needs better in app photo editing capabilities, add resizing and rename photos

author: A Google user
content: The app is very limited. The photos and videos categories like any normal camera gallery is not an option, the editing is limited, the backup is not perfect (the videos can be backed up on a different day). There is no option to mute the notifications on a shared album but still have the access on it and the list can continue. Whatever happened to our beloved Google apps? They all are going backwards. I understand the "safe to fail" concept and being agile and try new things but this?

author: Daniel Kuck
content: When I add photos to an album, it appears to succeed, but often the photos disappear soon afterward. The count will go up from 83 to 84. But a few minutes later it's back at 83. And it doesn't provide an error message. It happens with my JPEGs older than 2015. To fix it, I have to edit and re-save the photos using a separate app (because the Photos app just refuses to edit them). Then I can add them to my album. I would delete this app, but it's the only way to set Chromecast photos

author: A Google user
content: This is stupid, when I tried to get all my photos back and yes I did but when I go on images on anything message related it won't show my photos that I'd like to send and it mixed up the photos in different orders. It's gets annoying, but overall it's okay keeping your photos.

author: A Google user
content: I've been using this app for years and it always pissed me off on and off it's like as soon as one problem starts getting fixed 10 other start reason why I'm only reading it to Stars even though it does give you unlimited storage is because there'll be times it'll say everything is backed up and we'll end up deleting everything and then the photos are gone and the fact that they say you can tell the app how to organize the photos for your main list of everything but it doesn't let you

author: Peter Hodgetts
content: Unfortunately, depending on how many photos you have, Photos wil still chew up your local storage. Its taking 800MB on my device, which is too much for what is a 16GB phone. I've had to disable the app. Happy to re-enable it when a manual limit can be introduced.

author: Jonathan K
content: I keep my pics on my SD and backup to my computer or portable HD. I edit with different apps depending on need. With the limited free storage space, the app has had less use to me. Never bothered to review before now because prior to the change it was perfect and didn't need reviewing. Now that I hardly use it unless someone sends me a share... Anyway, I really don't use it very much so when I was manually updating some other apps and ended up here...

author: A Google user
content: Thanks for fixing the issue with app crash. Now I am seeing different issue. When I edit photos, they are appearing in photos. I don't have any clue of where they are going. Also after taking multiple photos, only the recent photo is showing when I open app. Plese look into this immediately.

author: Natalie Pace (NAP)
content: Social media platforms and other applications have real compatability issues with Google Photos. They don't tend to recognize the images as available unless I download them to my device. I also have a relatively medium amount of photos and am already being warned I will have to subscribe due to the quantity in the coming years.

author: Rgnld Media
content: When a new notification is received and opened you cannot go straight to it doesn't show up in my sharing folder until I go back into my photos then go forward through two steps again!!! And then sometimes the new message or photo still isn't there!!! I have a brand new smartphone and still having the same problem. Very frustrating. Please fix. 09/08/20 9 Months later.. all my Google photos notifications are turned on only when I open the app does it tell me I have new photos.. Hello Google....

author: A Google user
content: It thinks the miniature Bison, gazelles etc are dogs, plus a photo of my husband stretched back laughing is a dog. It registers the creepy baby dolls I use for Halloween displays as people (and it scares me to look at them!) I wasn't thinking how I'd have to look at my recently deceased parents all the time but at least they were human! I chose the large files and have 4+giggies left for free. Constant interruptions to tell me to buy storage. I don't need your backup

author: Kris
content: Auto stylise functions need much improvement. No option to search for photos by a specific location (maps allows this feature but only for a specific date not collections of photos for that location). No crop or filter option for videos. Pretty good at recognising the faces you add and grouping images by person or pet. Adding text doesn't work most of the time. The clumsily arranged menus make it difficult to find device folders or to add them to the backup.

author: Louise Bentley
content: What's with the Ultra HDR?? It shouldn't be the default but an option. What I'm seeing and everyone else I share my pics with are different images. Pixel cameras have always been excellent but this isn't working well for so many of us. Editing has become a time consuming nightmare. I've disabled the ultra HDR in advanced settings but it's still brightening etc in editing.

author: A Google user
content: Very nice app. Only things that really bother me is the fact that People and Pets isn't updating everytime I upload a new photo, and that we don't have the option to manually add people / pets to their folder. Sometimes it mixes up my cat and dog, which is fine, but when I remove them from the folder they don't belong to they don't reappear in their own folder.

author: Kyle Harrison
content: Where has the shared with you button gone? Every time the UI gets updated this app gets more confusing to use. I can no longer find the photos that have been shared with me. Edit for the response: I'm not looking for shared albums, I'm looking for photos that a person has shared to me (not album, not family sharing). It is visible on the website and used to be available in the app.

author: Jennifer McClain
content: Not a fan of recent changes to the photos app. It seems less streamlined now that they have taken the share, add to album, trash, etc buttons from the top of the screen and expanded them into the bottom. I don't need to see previews for who I can send to or previews of my most recently used albums. And now the feedback feature acts more like Google assistant when it comes up. It no longer includes system logs or the ability to check to have Google email you for more information.

author: McKay Cheatham
content: It technically works, but apparently 50% storage remaining is the point where Google feels it's appropriate to start sending "Your storage is low Photos & videos will stop backing up if you run out of storage" push notifications with a handy little button to "Start 100gb trial". I get that I'm using these services for free, but the 2.4 trillion dollar company that I've already sold my soul to apparently doesn't understand that these kinds of irritations make me less likely to want to pay them.

author: A Google user
content: I create albums so i can easily find certain photos....This app changes those albums to location grouping which is irrelevant. I also seem to be missing a certain amount of photos from when i first began using this app. Pls just let users store and label items in a way that we prefer. Shame coz otherwise pretty good.

author: Melisa Hoang
content: Creations suck for automated videos leaves half cropped photos or zooms in on nothing for slideshows. Not worth editing in app if I need to fix so much from the get go. author: Jim Pallas
