content: I love the app. It's generally easy to use and has good features. However, ot would be great if there is a way to filter the pictures in the all photos tab. For example to be able to see only photos that are not in any album which can make it much easier to delete the extra photos we don't need. Also, the video creator has so many glitches. For example, when inserting a video in it, sometimes it doesn't play it properly. It often takes so long time for the video to be finalized.

author: Brandon Sunkel
content: Generally it's been great. A few weeks ago there was update which allowed us to change the people in the photo by clicking on the 3 dots on the Pic of the person. And then remove or change them. That's now gone?? That was a fantastic update. As I have lots of photos that the AI has Incorrectly put a person in that is not the right person. So now I can't remove them and add the right person. Please bring that back.

author: Phillip Dashkevich
content: There are several issues I've experienced thus far: 1) The screenshot pop-up does not allow you to choose to delete directly after its taken - in the event it was taken by mistake. The only option is to "edit" it - you have to manually go back into your gallery to delete it. 2) The video functionality is very basic. You can't choose to change the video speed, for example - which is fairly standard across other similar apps. 3) Inability to take an image frame capture from a video.

author: Stephen Routley
content: Recent cosmetic changes seem pointless, and hardly attractive. It's useful to have different tools a bit more separate, but now the whole suite of tools has become too fragmented, making for a lot of annoying jumping back-and-forth. The Devs have also got rid of the perspective tool that was available in Crop mode. I didn't use it much but when I did it was because it was absolutely vital, and it was an incredibly useful tool, but for some reason it's gone. Bring it back!

author: Stephen Wilson (Teraquad)
content: I like how the app can show you all the photos and videos you have on your phone. However, navigating the folders can be a bit of a pain in order to find a specific photo. Another quirk is that by using Google's own Files app, when you shift photos from the phone to SD, it does not show the photos when they were taken, but when they were "added" to photos. I think it even changed that modified part of the file. Thank goodness the file names are intact or I wouldn't know when I took the photos!

author: A Google user
content: Great app, but certain quirks can be fixed. For instance, be clear when I delete off the Photo app that I am also deleting off phone storage. imagine my surprise when I find I'm missing multiple files and photos i simply wanted not to sync. Yes there is a trash bin but some 4k files were too big and google required i permanently delete those. I assumed that those files would still remain in the folder I moved them to. So only fix for now is to turn off sync (which defeats the purpose of app)

author: A Google user
content: I think it cool that I can look back on all my old pictures from years ago. It's really nostalgic to go down memory lane and but there is the issue of saving the pictures to whichever device your on. You guys have updated this application several times but fail to feature an option where you can select several photos and save them to your device. It's time consuming and unfair to have to go through photos one by one in order to save them. Please fix this issue

author: A Google user
content: PLEASE give us an option to draw on our photos and/or add text!!! I feel like I shouldn't have to download another app for such a simple task! Also.. the assistant gives the option to "archive" groups of photos that are either irrelevant or of documents. Could you also add an option to "delete" those photos instead, and recognize when there's multiple copies of the same picture (or multiple pictures of the same object) and offer to delete those too? If yoy add these options I will give 5 stars!

author: Stijn Zaalberg
content: I like it, but it could be very messy! I'm a guy who creates albums for everything. And after a while want to dive into the album and delete pictures. However when you are in an album, you are only able to remove it from the album, but then the image would still exist. When removed it's almost impossible to find.. For me this is extremely annoying. Furthermore I do indeed like the app! But some things (like this) is just a classic UX problem which could be solved easily. Thanks for the app!

author: Marcelo Monaretto
content: App is really good for the basic functionalities. Having the feature of putting photos in folders and being able to decide which ones get backed up or not is VERY useful for sorting and managing. Locked folder is a bless as well. However, I really don't understand why you can't keep the folders on the cloud storage. What's the porpouse of having multiple folders if it doesn't matter when they get backed up?? Also, not having a filter for device-only photos makes things hard sometimes.

author: Joshua Ojeda
content: The Layout of the app is great, it's neat and easy to manage. However, one thing that is grinding away at my gears is the transfer of files. It takes ludicrous amounts of time to transfer any amount of photos from internal storage to external storage, but when it's the other way around, it doesn't take nearly as much time. On top of some files not even showing up when I move the files over directly from the source, the whole process is tedious overall. Please fix this.

author: ANU GOPAL V
content: Scenario: We take a picture and preview it from the small square box. Then, when we swipe down to close the camera app, the closing animation becomes very jittery and laggy. I think this could be optimized. For example, when we swipe down, the animation should return smoothly to the square preview box itself, similar to how it works on Samsung phones. Currently, when we swipe down, the picture moves outside the box in a flattened way, which seems to cause the lag.

author: Peggy Wickham
content: I have a LOT of photos on my phone. This app is helpful for accessing them but it is so, so frustrating that there is no option to access the individual folders (albums) on my phone, but must go through them chronologically. This is not so bad if you know the date a particular photo was taken. Although this is a pain in the neck, it is doable. However, for photos that have been altered multiple times, it's near impossible. Please fix it so that albums on phones can be accessed!

author: A Google user
content: The App itself is very, very useful and the organization system through folders and tags is extremely helpful and convenient. My biggest complaints are that Google Photos shouldn't automatically make special folders for you based off of themes such as skies, food, dogs, cats, cars etc. Most of these folders are themes that I don't really care about (like planes) and even though the app can be accurate in finding the right photos, It ususally ends up producing some unfitting combinations.

author: Simeon Chavel
content: App used to be great. Important things broke. App is organized intuitively. Makes it easy to keep track and access pics from anywhere on the phone. Editing tool is great too. I get tons of pics on WhatsApp, put them into Photos albums directly. At some point, App albums can't show pics from WhatsApp correctly. Pics are in the wrong chronological order, or repeating themselves like a warhol. Also, can't edit them in the album anymore, must find them in the complete set.

author: Shawn Bates
content: I knew Google was going to start charging for storage so not a surprise but still not happy about it as that was really the reason I used it... I take so many photos and it was handy to have them all saved in one place for free.. I can go back to saving on computer but liked being able to get them on any device.. oh well... All good things come to an end

author: Joseph Smith
content: Backing up files!!!! Backing up photos is so stressful. I switched phones and wanted to back up all my large files to the cloud before switching over and it took me almost a week to figure out why it was stuck in an endless loop of backing up my data but never completing. Apparently you MUST have the app open and on the screen in order for anything to upload. I had to sit with my phone and babysit the uploads and keep the screen on!! Ridiculously annoying! It didn't used to be like this!

author: Mauricio Galvan
content: Google Photos is good, but needs more features, such as better editing tools. Also, interestingly enough the more storage I get, the quicker it fills - almost forcing me to buy more. Seems like a scam. I've tried downloading my photos and videos to make room, but the process is so over-complicated that it's just ridiculous! Why can't it be a simple "Save To" process? Nope that would be too easy for customers. C'mon, Google! Have a care for your customer more than making a buck!

author: Jerome Zaccone
content: I loved the movie function but it no longer works on my new phone. I'd like to see more effects and manual adjustments but it's always a great surprise to see what the computer comes up with when you let it create the movie. I made a number of movies using my own photos and music but they removed the customized features and now it's dumb.

author: Big Foot
content: When photos are backed-up from the device's storage, the albums are distorted and are never there in Google Photos. I think it should create albums with the same title as in the device's storage, and then back-up. One more thing. When you share an album with other Google Photos users, i.e. family, you cannot turn off the function of downloading. So, they can view the album, and also download to their device.

author: Karl Patschureck Jr
content: I have loved this app till mow. It tells me I am out of space buy more or remove some. I have removed way over a thousand pics and videos yet Google photos still tells me i have no room and has stopped backing up my recent photos. What the hecks up with that! Seems they are only interested in selling me more memory than I will ever us for more money than I am willing to spend. $2.99 per month for 100 gigs of memory.

author: Simone Davis
content: My photos I want to post on Marketplace are not available in in my "photos" app. I have to go find them in lala land, redownload individually so they are back on my phone. Ridiculous. It wasn't like this until some months ago and I tried to find a picture in my photos app.....nowhere to be found. Very tedious sometimes to get photos back on your actual phone for easy access.

author: A Google user
content: great app but I need be able to sort my albums in alphabetical order and not just chronological order which makes no sense. I also dont want to see the "places", "things" and other premade albums at the very top of the app which I never use. Sub-albums would also be very nice. Just adding these basic file management options would make this the best gallery app.

author: A Google user
content: Organized yet not. Maybe to organized. There is an automatic album made for every way you save a photo. It's very organized but nothing is in the same spot. Quite difficult to find a photo you saved when later you don't know where you saved it from. An album or photo roll with all photos combined would be nice. Not getting rid of the album's made but maybe an additional one where they are all colocated.

author: Joel Faulkner
content: Edit first: Looks like the unlimited storage for life for owning Google Nexus and Pixel phones is going away. This was a huge selling feature for me and others and apparently was a ploy to get you into their ecosystem so they could charge you later. This is now on par with every other photo app and therefore deserves only an average rating. More than I ever expected that a photo app could be. They hit the mark and then some. Thank you for this app.

author: Tara Brookover
content: Can't find the collages, stylized photos, animations, etc...even when I get a notification that Google created something like this for me automatically, I click that notification & it takes me to the app not the creation. I look everywhere but can never find what I'm looking for. Seems like the only thing I can find is the highlight reels from previous years 🤔 seems like the 1st version I had was way better than any updates I've downloaded! This app should be top notch! Hey Google get with it!

author: A Google user
content: Overall a good app, everything is set out clear. The only problem I have is the "stylized" photos which are done automatically always look far better. You cannot easily achieve the same level of editing manullay which is annoying... The "Auto" filter just makes your pictures brighter when in reality I want a photo that looks similar the automatic and random "stylized" photos google does for you.

author: Josephthe4th
content: This app does some things I don't like. I wanted to copy some photos to another folder but leave them intact in the original folder. It changed the date and moved them out of order. Very frustrating and disappointing. I don't mind having duplicates. I just wanted to organize them in a separate folder. I hate this app. I hate that it changes the date when you move photos to another folder.

author: Ash Howell
content: (Was) great for keeping photos safe and easily accessible. love it. Edit:Such a shame about the change of policy. My storage is almost full already and it's only just begun, signed up because of the unlimited photo storage that is now limited. 2 stars removed. Now I'm forced to pay. I have years of photos backed up there. Where will it end. 100gig gets full before you know it you'll be paying $100s a year to keep your photo's there. Might have to go back to floppy disc's in a case as my back up.

author: A Google user
content: The camera import (mtp) function works well but there doesn't seem to be a way to make it store importer photos anywhere else than the internal storage (like an sd card). This makes the feature pretty useless for backing up and syncing images on the go since there's no way any reasonable amount of images will fit on the puny internal storage of modern phones.

author: Angelica S
content: Love that all of my pictures are in one place, and there are awesome tools (movie creator, gif creator, etc). BUT I would REALLY love a way to delete duplicates. It takes absolute HOURS to go through and delete one by one since Google Photos uploads everything constantly (yes, I know I can edit settings but I enjoy not worrying about losing pics).

author: Gomez Ojeda
content: It has interesting features, I just wish it was easier to navigate through folders, 'cause it's a mess really! Collections are shown in no order at all, no matter if you previously organized your files into folders, subfolders and stuff, so it's not that easy to find the photo you're looking for. I wish it was more like navigating through the "storage" option on your phone. Saving a copy every time you edit a pic is also a little bit frustrating. Other than that, it's a pretty decent app.

author: Bryanna Stults
content: It says that it needs to be updated or else I have to continue without an acount. I have tryed updating it SEVERAL times. It say pending and keeps saying that for hours straight. I mean hours. 3,4,5, even 6 hours. All it says is pending. I tryed canceling it and trying again. It just does the same thing. What do I do?

author: A Google user
content: There's everything available on this app that one could dream of EXCEPT the most needed piece!!! *The "simple" ability to clear up a pic! I must download an additional appt for this! Hey guys!!!!!! If u want me to like yours, how about giving this simple addition! A place to click with ability to "manually clear" the fuzzies as best possible. Preferably, within the 3 bar lines underneath pic. May be all that's needed. Simple is more. No interest in app's automatic suggestions. Thanks

author: A Google user
content: I always got the " Getting ready to backup", and the blue circle is spinning and spinning forever, there are dozens even hundreds of photos left to backup. Clear cache or Clear data does not work, I have to uninstall and reinstall the App, but after a few days or weeks, this problem happens again…… quit annoying!

author: Marianne Baker
content: Great except for the fact you can't export multiple eg to Facebook. Edit: years later... Camera crashes are now well reported and I've experienced my fair share of them too. Have also had problems with the app failing when internal storage has a few gigs of photos in it and no wifi is present (like when you're on a trip taking photos!) and most recently the VIDEO failing somehow and recoding something other than I'm seeing on screen?? The panorama changes are also bad, it's temperamental at best

author: Peter Christo
content: Most infuriating, not being able to establish at a glance, which files are on the web and which down loaded. Also, a hide feature would be a great add on . Update: yes now got an archive feature, so photos can be hidden from the main stream. BUT, STILL NO WAY, of seeing AT A GLANCE, which photos are saved in the cloud and which on the phone, Now two copies keep showing of some of my photos on the app?

author: Shaden Masri
content: My previous rating was 5 stars. Dropped because storage is no longer free. Recommendations: - Increase free storage / make storage free again. - Backup device folders into set folders in the cloud, instead of having to organize them by hand once uploaded. - Removing pictures from the cloud should have an option to not delete the picture from device.

author: Iancu Ghita
content: Overall it's a good app. Especially before, when you had unlimited storage space for the photos in the cloud. What i don't like about this app is that if you start to upload a file, there's no way to cancel the upload; unless you force stop the application and delete the data and cache from the app, but then you have to download all the thumbnails from zero, which is time and data consuming, which for me is a problem. Not to mention that it is very annoying also.

author: A Google user
content: EDIT: I have removed another star after sharing functionality has been changed. Everyone I know is confused with how to share with multiple users. These "share groups" are not intuitive at all. The app picked up wrong dates for imported camera photos, although exif info and file creation dates were correct. I ended up with a ton of photos scattered at random dates. It's not possible to change the dates at this moment. Other than these two issues the app is great.

author: M
content: Simple edit feature: all I want is a mirror flip option - horizontal and vertical. As it stands, we can rotate the photo round and round, clockwise and counterclockwise but can't flip it. I'm not sure how she does it, but wife takes photos on her phone that appear in my account via "Parter sharing" (my favourite app feature!) and sometimes lettering is backwards on a shirt or sign. I would love to edit the photo by horizontally mirror flipping it. Thank you

author: Tom A.
content: Today's date: May 22, 2024 I have a Pixel 7a that uses Android. The "change cover photo" option under the 3 dots no longer exists. Instead, when I click on the photo and click on the 3 dots, it only gives the options " move to folder, copy to folder, print, and delete photo from device". The option to set photo as cover for album no longer exists under the 3 dots. None of my albums are shared or business either. All my albums are for myself. The option did exist at the beginning of this year.

author: Annabeth
content: It used to have unlimited storage space for photos. Pictures build up over the years 15GB is not enough, you can't put a limit on memories. And charging to buy more storage is just a greedy way of saying that they want money. Don't change something that is supposed to be unlimited to having a limit. Please fix this Major Problem immediately, thank you. P.s- I'm not doing this update.

author: A Google user
content: I have been used this app for more than three years. It was a very good app. But I was find some photos were missing in camera. I have make sure I took the photos and can't find it back eventhough from cloud. Also I can't find some sets of photos were took two years ago was uploaded to cloud. I have very upset & disappointed. Could you please fixing it. Thanks.

author: Nathalie Antonov
content: I've been using the app for several years now, and I do like it, but for one- the grouping of photos including the raw and any edited version of a JPEG makes it really hard to batch delete, or select numerous RAW photos to delete, without having to go into each foot separately. it used to also be there was a raw folder, that was helpful too. Secondly, I've been trying to get in touch with support because the app editing process has been glitching for weeks, and I'm getting nowhere.

author: K McDivitt
content: Used to be good, but giving us less size control options and instead changing the app to the permanent settings they think are good for all, just make it more restricted. I bought the pixel because of it's great photo taking.... and I used to control the size. Now it's only 2 size options in the camera and no real options in photos. The reason you say you changed is more free storage on backup, which we'll be paying for anyway.

author: Cody Hoskisson
content: It has some very nice features, really, it does. But it has some really annoying features, too. For example, I want to use the app to look at pictures other people are sharing with me. I do not want it to upload the photos that I take because all that does is fill up my google storage (which is another grievance I have since storage used to be unlimited for free, but I understand that that isn't going to change). However, the app will not let me use it unless I give it access to my photos.

author: A Google user
content: This is a nice way to store photos and not worry about losing pictures if you lose your phone, but ... My pics keep scattering & duplicating, and I now have a separate folder for 'thumbnails'. What's most annoying is the fact that the camera pictires are no longer arranged chronologically, month after month. with old pics reappearing three times where recent pics should be. Too scattered for comfort!

author: Eru
content: Overall a good app. However I have recently encountered a problem in which the app sorts my photos with the incorrect date. Eg, it displays photos taken yesterday as being taken a week ago. This is only happens on the 'photos' page of google photos, and it only on the mobile version. I have checked the time and date for each photo, and it is logged correctly. Yet, the images are still displayed as having been taken on the wrong dates. Also, I can only view photos taken with my current device.

author: Bonnie
content: I lowered my rating... Lately the editing feature has been terrible. It takes forever just to do small tasks and forget about editing a video. Trying to forward a video or photos has been slow. Also, after editing, I have to search for the updated photo and it doesn't come up with the group when doing a search.

author: Eesha
content: It's not the greatest, it deleted a bunch of my photos and they were all backed up, I can't seem to access them anywhere either. They just kinda disappeared out of thin air. It's pretty straight forward other than that though. Also after the first time I used the free up storage thing, on the 'photos' page, it messed up all the original dates and they're all out of order.

author: A Google user
content: I can live with this app, gotten used to it. However I was trying out the Movie function using Assistant and it seems like I have to upload my video (to where?!?) before it lets me so anything to it. I thought this is supposed to be a native function, no uploads required. On top of that, it doesn't even upload my videos. It just says Uploading and the progress bar doesn't even move.

author: A Google user
content: giving it a 3/5 1. photos I download don't immediatly back up and i have to manually back each individual photo up. 2. sometimes when zooming in, a photo quality drops. 3. just a minor gripe, but as a person who draws frequently, i usually use references for things I'm having trouble with and I think it would be more helpful to be able to display multiple pictures at a time like you can on a computer, as it's a hassles constantly cycling through photos when i need a specific references.

author: Adam Osborne-Smith
content: It is honestly a good app in a lot of ways - editing, folder management, very friendly for inexperienced photographers. The fact that you can easily send photos to other people, but not save it on your own device, or easily move a folder to your own computer is such a laughable point of friction. Don't get me wrong, it's clearly made by smarter people than me. People so smart they're sometimes very dumb.

author: A Google user
content: Works great for photos that I take it received in messages or emails. However, whenever I save photos from websites and move them move or view them within the app, they disappear from my phone the next day. Like the app is deleting photos that I save every night at midnight... Not cool. Updating my stars to "neutral".

author: Frog Froggington
content: It's fine, but I wish it was more customizable. The app has indexed my music folder, and created a new album for each of the album covers in my music folder. I do not want it to do this, but there is no way to point the app to specific folders; it indexes your entire drive. I also wish I could turn off the "auto creation" of certain albums like "documents."

author: A Google user
content: After using the Google photo app for a year, it's still confusing. I like that I can sort photos by album, but the albums aren't visible to all your accounts. This means if I want to do cross posting on multiple accounts or platforms, I can't access all the folders. Another really stupid thing is, if I want to give access to another one of my email accounts, they treat it like you're sharing info with a total stranger. AND you can only share with ONE account. Please make it easier for posting!

author: barbara t
content: Thanks for making it possible to find collections again when searching photos. It's now visible in the oval. Unfortunately the edit functions on photographs are much harder to find. I am sure I am not alone in not wanting AI or automatic editing and prefer edit photos by myself. You've hidden the stuff at this point. Please make edit options (crop, brightness etc) more accessible

author: Jaxy Tommy
content: Very cool but honestly feels built for simple things than what I thought would be basic. I want to select what album it loops through on the widgets—or to select a singular photo without looping. This is very crucial when you're trying to build a theme for your phone and don't want to download another app. Id also like better editing. When editing text if you misalign it there's no snapping for it to be straight. I dont have enough space to talk about the rest; but these are most important tome

author: Lesli Homrighausen
content: Typical, simple photo app. Very easy to acclimate to. The only issue is it being a Google app, once you're out of space, it's unusable.. unless you clean out a substantial amount of data, or you pay monthly for more space. There are other apps that you never have to pay for.. and you won't be forced to delete and forego backups.

author: A Google user
content: Pretty good but still rather have a SD card. The photos that are older end up having really bad quality because they get archived or something happens to them that when I go back to look at older pictures their quality is sub par so they don't look like the way I took them. Other than that, I really like the a lot of the other features and sorting with albums , stylized , looking back on this day, collages, videos that put a bunch of pictures to music. There's a lot of good and a lot of bad

author: A Google user
content: Although I love it's potential you gotta hate the bugs. I am trying to download some photos back on the phone and there is no Download photos option. At one time I almost lost quarter of my photos when Google photos just decided that I have put those in the bin. Good thing tgat I checked my albums and saw that something was amiss.

author: A Google user
content: I will give this appthe full 5 stars when such features as advanced security controls are available, I can't believe you can share an album with people but can't prevent them from sharing it again with someone else, or restrict their access in a more advanced setting than the one available, it is quite light and it actually surprises me from Google, given they bought Picasa and it had way better options to manage shared content. Also, still some work to be done on the collage, movies, photo book

author: Mary Word
content: I am used to this app uploading almost immediately from my phone, and count on that. But for the last few days, possibly since a recent update, it is not working. The app says it has 77 items left and it is 'Getting ready to back up', but the little blue circle circles, then changes to an up arrow, then circles again, and nothing uploads. I can individually click the upload icon on a single picture, and it will upload. But the automated backup has been broken for a few days now. I have tried clearing the cache, restarting the phone, etc., but it just no longer works.

author: Stacey Lowe
content: I used to love Google photos. Now you have to pay for space. And there's never enough of course. And somehow it started turning every one of my pictures into moving photos. I cannot stand it and I cannot figure out how to turn it off. But it has unmatched searching ability and library organization but the editing tools are not as user friendly as Photoshop. But since the update all my favorite Photoshop edits require a premium subscription. The storage changes are awful.

author: MzFinnchik Finnegan
content: Went to look at photos in pictures folder, everything I had on SD card folder GONE and Google photos icon was not the same and when tapped said app not installed. I don't know how this happened but luckily after reinstalling (which I wasn't sure how to do) I was able to recover only some photos Updated review This isn't the same app that I was familiar with. It doen't allow you to save only archive. What's the point of that? It is just like most apps that update things that should be left alone

author: A Google user
content: I was bit disappointed with this. I trusted this app for years, and I thought each album will back up automatically. So all this time, I'm deleting pictures in my gallery thinking its already backed up. I've checked the app searching for photos, but saw nothing. A lot of photos were not there, specially the photos of my grandma who passed away recently. My travel photos and lot more. I'm sorry, I know it was all my fault, but I am mad.

author: A Google user
content: Easy to use, great add-ons, and assistant is helpful. But it crashes a little too often for my liking. Also when trying to archive large numbers of photos it just wouldn't do it. Originally I thought I was hitting an archive limit but it didn't seem to matter how many I archived. App can be a bit buggy for me, enough for me to notice and get frustrated.

author: Kedesha Bolt
content: I just don't get it! The free stories space worked well for as long as I've had it. I backup my photos when I wanted easy. I NEEDED MORE SPACE And decided to purchase the premium. Soon after purchase it started uploading slower and slower. I'll try one photo at a time and overtime they piled up showing "UPLOADING 56 items .......USING WIFI". It is very frustrating because I do have a lot of photos and need to manually backup regularly. I've paid for 1 yr.

author: A Google user
content: This app does everything right except one very irritating problem. Importing photos directly from your phone works, but it DOES NOT import the photos by album. Photos are all chronologically in order, which is good. Nonetheless still a complete mess when you want to find specific photos in all in one album that you have created before the import. Very inconvenient. Had to scroll more than 2 thousand photos in order to create the albums before the import. Just very annoying.

author: Izu Chidi
content: This app is really great, but my only problem here is that I couldn't cancel my monthly subscription. I've looked for a way to unsubscribe from 100GB space monthly subscription. Sometimes I see partialities in the method of deduction because more is deducted than I subscribed. Please I need this unplanned subscription to be cancelled, I don't need it again.

author: Amber Young Majesty
content: Oh, yeah, GP is the best - they (it?) even suggested downsizing pix (so they take up less space!) whereas Gallery is almost always a jumbled mess, making up albums (or "stories") then prompting me to print them (which is probably taking up more space instead of less thru no fault of mine) - but why can't I find my photos from last Christmas?

author: A Google user
content: Stuck in the mud. Still a good resource, innovation has stalled. For instance, still no Android widgets. How is it possible that pretty much every other Google App has widgets and Google Photos does not. A good widget example would be to have an Album widget for mood elevators, etc. that would just cycle through the photos in the album with the option of adding background music from Google Play Music.

author: John Lindemeier
content: Like many apps, it is easy to set up but hard to undo. Been trying to stop doing automatic phone back ups, but they just want you to pay for more storage. Finally found the setting after looking for several days. Also, Google Photos doesn't keep the photo "albums" that you set up on your phone. Frustrating to create those grouping to have them all undone in Google Photos.

author: urthling carm
content: I don't know what happened to this app. It use to be so good and organized. But now things are super glitchy and its hard to get anything organized. I've seen that many people have had the same problems as me. For example, I'll try to move a photo from my Screenshots folder to another folder, but when I do, it does move the image but in the Screenshots folder it leaves an annoying blank space. + Backing up photos doesnt work as proposed and if you delete them from your phone they are just gone.

author: LynnP.
content: upon pressing, save copy, in the app, that's where I'm taken when selecting additional edits trying to print pictures from my linked CVS account- pop up message: the app isn't responding, then closes the Google photos app before I make selection; to stay or close.

author: Jad Wooz
content: Mixed emotions with this. I love organising all my stuff that needs be. but I hate it when I put specific photos on a folder/album but right after doing so, it still stays on the photo menu. this can give confusion to users with a lot of photos to manage. im currently enrolled to a plan to check if this 'might' be a good cloud... but if things aren't gonna be simple, what would be the point.

author: MaryBeth Ely (Show Me)
content: Loved this app, but changed from 5 stars to 3, because hate the updates and the change auto creations and loss of the old movie maker, boo. Now, if you get rid of unlimited high quality photo saves like you just said, I will find a new photo saving service. You make tons of money off our data, the least you can do is give us photo space like you always have.

author: Eric Blair
content: Stop hitting people who choose not to back their photos up with a prompt on a regular basis which toggles the backup option "on" and forces them to toggle it off. It's underhanded—but you guys knew that already. Besides being a factory app, it's not like there are a lot of reasons for users to not choose a different one, so stop pushing your luck

author: A Google user
content: The thing I hate about this app is not being able to create folders to organize. Yes, it will make albums for you but you can't correct them when they think your dog is your cat or it puts someone in the wrong album. Can't drag n drop into albums. So really it's useless because it takes forever to find any specific photo unless you make folders for yourself all the time. I'm surprised Google hasn't improved the functionality of this app over the years I have used it.

author: A Google user
content: Impressive set of tools to adjust and correct photos. App fails to automatically add new faces to be labeled for future search. There is no manual method to fill in for the automation failure! Would be great if it utilizes the names with photos from contacts!! Doing away with the option to automatically saving to Google drive is another negative. After experiencing the apple photo app, feels like the Google app is few steps behind!

author: A Google user
content: Lately when I edit photos which are stored on my SD card, the edited version is stored in my internal memory. I hate that. But I have tons of SD card space and not a ton of internal memory. The latest update seemed like it might fix that: "This release brings bug fixes to improve saving and storing of edited photos and videos on SD cards"....but no, it didn't. It still saves a copy.

author: A Google user
content: Fantastic app apart from one glitch. I scanned in all my family photos and edited them and all the dates have swapped and they are all out of place and have lost their original dates. If you try and rectify, they move somewhere else. Flagged it up with Google and got ignored as did countless other people. I think it is still broken. I have given up. For all other photos, editing, sharing, uploading is all amazing...I love it... simple to use and edit.

author: Geomer Bagsic
content: Hi Google photos. Your application is good but I'm confused because my photos in my album(application of my cellphone) are gone after I sync and back up all my photos and videos. And I really don't know what to do now. I'm really bothered to lose every moment I cherish to all that photos. Thank you. I hope that my concern reach you. More Power!

author: Courtney Susoeff
content: Another dangling carrot, thanks. I used to adore this app, because I thought it was a fantastic way to keep up with all my daughter's photos, and I get that they over promised storage, eventually space will run out, nothing is endless, my main gripe however is that they mislead about the quality of the uploads, and many of my daughter's photos as she's grown are not the best quality, also navigation is absurdly tedious as well as selecting multiple photos to delete or move. 3 stars at best ...

author: A Google user
content: I want more than anything to be able to organize the HUGE list of photos. I know I can make albums but I want to be able to organize them like I can on my phone, not just copy them as well to an album. Seeing that huge massive list is overwhelming...and being able to completely move them from one Google account to another would be amazing.

author: krasznai saci
content: overall does what it needs to do, but i really hate that my artistic photographs are marked "blurry" and "fix the lighting" by the app and it wants them deleted. photography is one of my hobbies and i believe i can create art and an AI cannot, so please let me decide what i think is worthy to have on my phone. i also don't enjoy the reminders to buy copies of my photos from google, i will choose a local printshop to make prints if i want them.

author: Andrew Lancaster
content: Don't like the promise of unlimited storage of photos at original quality, only to have it taken away. Which bucket items are stored in can become confusing--- especially when editing a photo from long ago--- it disappears into a hard to find place. Photo editing software has fewer options (e.g. I used to be able to move the light focus for fading but now it's set as a concentric circles from the edges)

author: Alan Robert
content: It's great that this app saves all my photo. But it is almost impossible to sort through images. I spent nearly an hour and a half deleting over 3000 images that I don't need, only to find afterwards that they are all still there! At the same time Google has informed me that it will automatically delete photos that haven't been opened for two years?! Makes going back to cellulite sound attractive.

author: Evelyn Marshall Blake
content: Magic eraser, will at times not remove the selection you've chosen and will replace it with letters that make no sense. When it works as it's supposed to it's great but there are times.

author: Aaron Quitta
content: They recently changed the way you edit and crop photos to a system that doesn't allow the for the same level of precision as the previous one, which is disappointing, especially as this used to be my absolute favorite app for editing photos. Probably the biggest loss is it is no longer possible to crop and photo that was taken wrong from a slightly so that it looks like it was taken head-on/squarely.

author: A Google user
content: Pros: lots of storage (love Google One), automated backups, fast uploads, easy to send files elsewhere too. Cons: No organization, albums are useless unless sharing, can't separate what's on device and what's online, searching is terrible: it brings up stuff online, stuff on phone, including ads and cache from every random app you've got. Ugh. I've switched to Dropbox except for sharing family albums. After a few weeks of auto backups, there's tons to delete too, and no fast way to get rid of it.

author: Jared Crimmins
content: The Google Photos Android app can be buggy, slow, and lacks feature parity with its web counterpart. As an example of a reoccurring bug, Google Photos has a fixation on one particular photo in a large shared album that I am a member of. If I load the shared album and click on a photo too quickly (within ~5 seconds), this one particular photo will appear instead. It's a bizarre bug and occurs even after reinstallation and on different devices.

author: A Google user
content: Google suggested to remove photos that have already been backed up, unfortunately I can no longer access these photos. Plus they're gone from my device. Plus I can't 'download' multiple back to my device either, when I think I've found them. Super annoying. Super sad. Other than that it's alright.

author: A Google user
content: It was nice before. Now it does not automatically sync my photos at all! Unless you open the app, it does not even start backing up. And in case you minimize the app or the screen gets locked in the middle up back up, the process stops. In other words, you need to open the app and keep staring at it until the back up is complete.

author: A Google user
content: I used to like this app but I have multiple accounts for different photos. It will let me add the accounts but won't show their photos even when I'm in that account. I've deactivated all accounts, uninstalled and reinstalled the app, reactivated one account... and it still only shows photos from the first account I ever added (even though this is now deactivated)!!!!! Very frustrating. I just want access to my photos!

author: Nick L
content: Very good, but you need to allow automated albums with ONLY a specific amount of people. For example, if I want Google to automatically add only photos with myself and my wife to an album called 'Only Us' I can't do that. It will put pics of me with my friends at a baseball game into that album because I'm in the picture. There's no options to create filter rules for this type of automated album.

author: A Google user
content: **UPDATE: As I have stated below, google photos WAS great. However, due to the new update, I feel that the intuitive and easy to navigate design has completely went away. The previous version is much better! I LOVE Google photos, it is easy to use, and you can make cool things like little movies, GIFs, and you can edit pictures and videos easily. There is also this things called the google assistant, and it is So Cool! It makes movies for you, collages, and so many other things!

author: Brian M
content: Update. Thanks for the reply. The link doesn't work. Ok, the slow uploading situation has been fixed. Thanks. One thing that would be extremely useful would be the ability to download multiple photos back to the mobile phone for editing and video creation using alternative tools to Google options. Downloading a group of photos one at a time is time consuming and unnecessary. Maybe there's a way to do this that I'm unaware of? If not, it should be available.

author: Diana Min (MamaD79)
content: I would give 5 stars if you would FIX it so that it STOPS duplicating photos, Google drive does this too. I know you have to make money, but to not make it so everything is not duplicated is ridiculous! You do this so that people run out of room fast, then expect them to "buy" more storage. I refuse to buy any more when I know I don't use even HALF of the 15gb! As it is, we have to go in, one by one and delete the duplicates, that takes too much time and is a waste of time.

author: A Google user
content: Good with serious issues. Generally the best photo storage. However there is no way to know which photos/videos are using space. For example pictures taken with older pixel phones and original quality converted to "high quality" don't use space. But there is no way to know which ones are which. Makes storage management impossible. Please fix

author: M S Puskas
content: Limiting space for photos is unacceptable. Trying to get me to pay only makes me want to ditch Google. Not sure it's possible. But iPhones are looking better to me.

author: Alex N
content: Has worked well for a long time but the video editor doesn't work right currently. It gets stuck on the first frame, so I can't trim from the beginning or the end.

author: mich c
content: They couldn't make creating a shared album more difficult. Create it and add photos, but you can't get the link. All the photos upload, but you can't find the album anywhere so you can't the the link or the album. And there's no progress indicator that it's working on the album. EDIT: in regard to google's response, the problem isn't how I'm using their app. The problem is their app is poorly designed. This is not unlike how poorly Google is maintaining many of their apps.

author: Patrick O'Callaghan
content: Using this to share a large number of old photos among family members. It's good as far as it goes but really needs a better way of organising albums. The fact that there is no hierarchy is a serious limitation. Also, when offered a set of photos to be archived, most of the time I just want to delete them. There should be the option to do this directly without having to hunting for them.

author: A Google user
content: I can't sort the album as recently added for some reason and the oldest first sorting means the oldest photos or images that took or uploaded to web (i don't know if it's common but it's the first time for me). And also there is no rotate gesture. It's ok to rotate one or two photos using edit image > rotate > save, but if there's a lot of that? It can be pain

author: John Powers
content: Happier now that 'perspective' edit is restored but it's not easy to find, having been moved one level down inside the crop tool. Nifty that AI suggests the adjustment for you, and it's mostly correct. Still not a fan of the look and feel of the new version, much preferring the older version (could be restored as Photos Lite?) and confirm other comments about the result image being too small to see.

author: Zee Aslam
content: The removal of useful features like tap-and-hold for motion pictures, the perspective tool, the ability to adjust grid size in albums, etc. has made this much less useful. My old review was noting useful additions, and my updated review is going over the removal of features that made the app more accessible for folks like me. I wouldn't be upset if they allowed toggling the behavior, but that's not a Google thing anymore even for paying customers. Current subscribers are not the target audience

author: Pravin
content: Perfect tool or app to store your pics on cloud. Good editing options. Just need to have one feature, I can select one pic to change the date and time of pic. Bit if I want to change date and time of group of photos then I can't do it. And need to edit each pic with their own date and time. Kindly allow a feature to select multiple pics to change their date and time.

author: Klo S.
content: It deleted so many of my photos and I cannot find a way to get them back. I got some of them back after a long, long, very tiring hunt. I had to switch through multiple accounts, go to help, and bla bla. I upped to 3 because I was angry and I didn't give a "fair" review. This is fair. I suppose. This is a good app other than the few, major, errors. I have resolved my problem somewhat, but I wish you could reverse, cancel, or disable the "free up space" option.

author: Brian Michael Napoletano
content: The application is very nice and easy to use. I love the animations, albums, etc. that the assistant makes! Update 2021: Changes to the interface have rendered it less functional. I can no longer access many of the neat animations and collages that the assistant renders. It also seems to generate fewer such items, and put less effort into them.

author: L Fe0
content: Blurring the background not working anymore, it shows the effect when applied, but the saved copy is the same as the original. please fix this!

author: Stefania Bello
content: First of all, it has a caching problem; it makes it hard to download a picture on your device, as I always have to clear cache and/or close the app randomly in hopes of making the download start. Secondly, why do my pictures and videos have to be displayed in an irregular grid? It's pretty annoying... Third things third, the sync is not ideal, at all. I mean, you're Google, not newbies... You can do better.

author: Anna Wilson
content: I'm using it. But...Need to be able to reverse alphabetize the album names. Finding photos is a royal pain. There needs to be an easy way to see in photos which albums the same photo is included in. And an easy way to find photos that are not in any album would be useful. I dislike that I can't add captions to multiple photos at the same time. Nor correct spellings or punctuation in one step. In short, I need access to the database behind the phot storage. Differs on 3 different platforms

author: Janelle Calvin
content: I have been using Google Photos for many years and have loved being able to share photos and vidoes with loved ones. One of the latest updates, however, has been awful. Why did we take away the easy access to Shared Albums? I have to search for them now and can't even tell which albums have new photos or videos to view. It's not convenient at all and definitely has made it more difficult for my grandma (who is not tech savvy). Please change this!

author: Carmine Tenaglia
content: UPDATE: I moved to pixel for the unlimited storage, now I am wondering with the decline in all of Google's offers, how much longer I will keep using them. First it was the Music app, then the pay app, now this.... Things are looking bleak at Google. NOV 2015: Love the app. Works great and appreciate the automatic backups of my photos. Moves from phone to phone without any hassle.

author: Jenn Luke
content: Would be so much better if: 1. It had a duplicate scanner, trying to sort out 5000+ photos is quite impossible and you would think this would be more important then editing photos. 2. Had an option to show all photos stored on Google photos, along with the option to view device photos (instead of only having device photos shown).

author: Thomas Hatfield
content: It's a handy app to sync photos between phone and desktop. Combined with Google Photos on the web, it's essentially a complete package. The problem I have is that the app in no way imitates the web site or desktop app (in this case, Google Drive), and for its flaws, the site appears to have no understanding of the folder structure on my phone. So, navigating between the two is a real hassle. If you can figure it out and put up with the quirks, it's a great way to organize and browse your photos

author: A Google user
content: Fine but some UI elements are silly such as ... 1. displaying loading circle over low res preview photo while high res photo loads in the background...whats the point of loading the hd photo in the background if you put a circle over the preview?? 2. fix lighting prompt. no, i don't want to fix lighting on every. single. photo. let me switch this stupid thing off please. Otherwise quite good but why do Google products in general get worse? Take me back to the Golden age...

author: A Google user
content: I don't want ALL photos saved in a cloud somewhere. When I discovered that some things were stored without my knowledge, I couldn't delete those files without deleting them on my sd card as well. Update: Just started using again but it appears that my device's photos are uploading automatically to my business account feed (again, without my prior knowledge). Auto sync and backup are OFF. ???

author: Fatima Thakur
content: this is an amazing app but the only problem is when I try to set the wallpaper i use a lenovo m9 tablet before updating the photos app it would put the wallpaper as it is without cropping the image smaller it doesn't let me put the wallpaper without cropping I'm so tired of this please fix this

author: A Google user
content: It's okay, but there should really be an option to turn off syncing your camera folder. I take a lot of pictures but don't want hardly any of them backed up. I only want the pictures in my other folders backed up. Syncing my camera folder uses a lot of space and I ran out immediately. Until you can turn this option off this isn't a good choice for me. Looking for other options.

author: Melissa King
content: Editing to 3 stars because of 1. Annoying irrelevant memory notifications. Annual anniversaries were cute, last thursday not so much. There needs to be done easy customization Edit: yes I've seen how to hide days. But it doesnt allow for fewer overall memories for just anniversaries or such. I dont have any blockout dates or people. Just want something meaningful when its available not 10 things to fill a quota each day 2. No longer data free.

author: A Google user
content: It's pretty nice. I just wish it had a few more customizable features. For instance, if I edit a picture give me the option of saving the original instead of overwriting it. If I make a collage allow me to choose the order they are arranged . Let me stylize my own pictures since the app has the capability. Etc.

author: A Google user
content: It'd be a little better if it was easier to navigate, create, and find things. There's always a "hoop" to jump through in order to find something. For example: When I share photos with my mom, all the photos I've ever shared with her should all be in spot (similar to how the camera photos are all in on spot). I mainly share photos with her when we're on vacation, but I'm only able to find the most recent photos I've shared with her & not the ones from the past. photos should be in one spot.

author: Lori Aldrich
content: This app used to be amazing! Now in spring of 2026, the updated version is awful. I am no longer able to search photos as seamlessly as the older version. I use this function multiple times a day. Now I just about given up on it.

author: Michael Tarbard
content: Great facial recognition and grouping features (pets, landscapes, etc...) the unlimited storage is amazing too Edit:3/6/2021 Still a great photo app. The creations and memories are great. Annoyed at what seems like a bait and switch in regards to unlimited storage though. I will still use it as I have put over a decade worth of photos into this app, but the lowered star rating is for being so invested in something that will suddenly cost money when it has always been included

author: Dennis Lowry Jr
content: I have always loved this app, but ever since all these updates it has been not syncing correctly I cannot confirm people's faces it is being ridiculous. ever since these updates keep coming everything has gotten messed up.

author: Malvin Marful
content: The app doesn't always recognize similar faces and group them. I have photos and videos of particular people whose pictures are not under their names There should be a option to delete duplicate videos or pictures under the manage storage section

author: Joaquin Valdez
content: the app is fine, I wish what ever was uploaded was put in individual folders so we arent having to dig through photos that are all fully mixed/merged together. Im not a fan of looking through individual dates.

author: Collins Nderitu
content: great up in general but can you please fix the face recognition feature in people and pets, it keep on missing some pictures. or give us a way to add the pictures manually, just a humble request

author: Anna Cooke
content: okay I'm getting really pissed off. Google photos is refusing to download my artwork I made onto ten gallery. it will download to my files and I'll ask it to download it to Google but Google automatically deletes it! I've tried every setting but can't fix it!

author: Mishi R
content: Hey, My suddenly my SD card got corrupted so I wanted to restore my all.data through Google photos , whenever I open the app it closed after 2,3 seconds. what is the problem I wanted to restore my data. please reply this

author: Ameera Habib
content: always liked using this app especially when searching for photos of people in my gallery, but that feature does not seem to be available any longer.

author: Gajendra Singh Solanki
content: I really like the app but recently for a few days the app isn't supporting the magic eraser feature that was in my phone . I didn't know why but it has stop working and is coming as a obstacle for my editing .

author: Rose Marie Mora
content: I don't like that fotos are automatically put in my gallery when I sent it in a communication like Facebook or WhatsApp. I don't need screenshot to be in my gallery. I only send certain screenshot for my own needs, not to be put in my gallery, which raises the amount of photos that I do want in my gallery.

author: Kevin Bigwood
content: was great when I purchased the Pixel 9 instead of an iPhone, but I'm gutted they've recently retired the Reimagine function in Photos. I used it a lot. 😫

author: SAMUEL HIGHEST
content: I really like the Google photos but we keep getting updates for this app almost every week but it's got no much to offer *no ai editing *not even changes in the UI

author: menziwa xolo
content: I hope it gets even more better with time. something are still confusing. but it's a great storage system.

author: Makayla Scull
content: Some of the new updates are really annoying. Whenever I crop an old photo, even from years ago, it'll show up at the very top instead of where the original photo was. I don't want old photos mixed in with new ones. I also can't upload photos in the background anymore, which makes the process much slower and therefore impossible to back up all the photos I want to.

author: Marney Freeman
content: I love most of the app. Photos can be nicely organized and saved in albums. It syncs with your phone's gallery. The one thing I've discovered to watch for is that if you delete an album in the shared section it will delete that album entirely. I lost 3 extremely valuable and sentimental albums full of pics that weren't saved anyplace other than Google photos. So just be careful, it's easy to do and there aren't any warnings.

author: A Google user
content: I got my first smart phone & tablet in the last 6 MTHS ( bit of a late-adopter !) . I wasn't taking many photos til I got this - it showed me what could be done with them & got me organised. Invaluable ! UPDATE: I've been loyal to Google Photos BUT The new charges for storage ( I'm now a photo editor with a LOT of images ! ) and the fact that, after I updated recently, I now get "interference-type" lines on the image when I use "Mark-up" , means I may now look elsewhere.

author: A Google user
content: I really like google photos other than the albums. When making an album, it doesn't tell you how many pictures you can add at once and won't add any of the pictures if you go over this imaginary limit. Also, the albums' direction is from oldest to newest, so everytime I want to check if the photos are actually in there I have to scroll all the way down. I would give better stars if the problems with the albums were fixed. I am very satisfied with the sharing part, though, and really like it.

author: John H
content: The photos app itself is fine but the way it interacts with Chromecast seems to have been broken literally for years. I've asked my Chromecast to show my own photos and created several albums. These used to show but now I just see random photos from Google by other photographers and not my own. From reports online I know I'm far from alone in this and wish Google would fix it.

author: Nosakhare Edokpayi
content: Great photo app, but I don't get why the photos don't get sorted by their original dates. The moment I move a batch of photos from one folder to another, the datetime updates to the time of the move and it totally statters everything in a really annoying way. It also Makes it so difficult search for a photo based on the date I know it was created. Having feature in the menu where photos can be sorted by recently added or modified or something, would have explained it. I don't understand.

author: A Google user
content: I used to be able to put photos in a fb album when sharing to fb, but this doesn't work anymore (on BB Keyone); it will only put them in "mobile uploads" , even though it appears to be giving me the option of creating and adding them to an album. I don't know if this is a fb app issue (posted it to a review for that too), or a google photos issue, but it's a problem when travelling to have to rely on a desktop pc to manage the photos I upload with my phone.

author: Mobereola Falola
content: This app would be way better if it arranged my pictures based on how they end up on the phone e.g Camera, Snapchat, Video, Screenshot, instead of arranging them based on date. Sometimes, I don't recall the date I installed a video or took a picture and I look through those categories on my phone's gallery, but with this app I can't do that and the entire arrangement is a mess. This wouldn't be a problem if all my pictures weren't forcefully removed from my device after buying that storage plan.

author: Lesly Rae
content: It's sort of like the designers don't actually use their products. Adding pics to albums is incredibly cumbersome. I should be able to click on several recent pics and add to a pre-existing album, but I can't. I'd also appreciate more options as to where I want those albums stored. Editing capabilities needs an upgrade. I'm a Pixel user over to Samsung now that is seriously considering other options as fluidity, ease of use and offerings aren't super impressive.

author: A Google user
content: They got rid of back up when charging option. So now it backs up pics immediately, so if take ten pics and decide to keep the best one after reviewing Google already up loaded them so I have to erase them in two places, not to mention it chews up battery power to transfer the files. Simple feature that they had before but took away. Bring back "sync when on charger" option.

author: A Google user
content: It's a pretty cool place to put all of your content you don't want in your gallery but for some reason out of the blue my videos started vanishing out of nowhere and they won't sync so if i don't have them in my gallery it'll say "can't play video" and its a tad bit frustrating considering i have them there because i don't want them in my gallery.

author: S Edwards
content: Grew on me. This app has gotten much better through the years. I really like the changes and updates. I've started using the app more in 2020. Finding your photos isn't as easy as it should be. I would rather have all my pictures in one place instead of having them grouped in ways the app thinks is best. It's a slight annoyance looking for photos and screenshots. Let me group them, I'm smart enough to do it.

author: James M.
content: Great for storage. It's more than a bit creepy that it clearly analyses all your pictures for content and context. Also it makes it more difficult than it should be to access your photos for printing. Also sorting into albums doesn't move them into the album it just adds them to the album tag

author: Pam Noble
content: A necessary evil. The 1st star: it's very easy to store, edit, & share photos. The 2nd star: can take a picture w/my phone & it's immediately on my laptop The 3rd star: huge amount of storage. Paid storage is worth every penny. I hate that I can't tag/label/organize photos like you can in Flickr. But I despise this app because albums are sorted by most recent photo. CAN'T ALPHABETIZE. Why, Google? When adding or sharing a photo, finding the album is IMPOSSIBLE. Need a better photo app.

author: Johnny
content: I really wish we could move pics into folders and get them out of view, so we don't have to scroll through all of them. But, it's still alright. Also wish we could draw on it and do a few more things, but that's life. Love the collage feature. It's awesome for putting pics together of the granddaughter

author: Samantha Hill
content: I do like the app. However, it doesn't give you nearly enough free storage. It also costs a wee to much for more. I had 97% full.. went through and deleted all the random screenshots and videos I had downloaded. Now I have 44% full and it's still telling me I'm "almost full" that it's "time to buy more storage" 97 to 44 and its almost full? Makes no sense guys!

author: Rachel M Morris
content: I love all things Google... But this app is my favorite. It helps back up my photos, clears storage space on my device, and suggests cool edits and animations of my photos, all without me lifting a finger. Free, easy, unlimited, Love it. UPDATE, you now have to pay a subscription for 100 GB storage if you need more than 15 GB. Which will eventually not be enough, I just feel like this was a bait a switch. Looks like I'll be using amazon photos and my hardrive. I'm sad.

author: Benjamin Charlton
content: It's ok, but I would expect more from Google. It is not helpful at curating photos and removing duplicates. Especially if you feed in photographs from WhatsApp and other apps, you can quickly end up with lots of duplicates, as well as near-duplicates at different resolutions. I think Google could easily use AI to resolve this, but chooses not to because they prefer to charge people money for storage space.

author: Scott Finch
content: Was fine until the last update. Now I have to look at the "Back up now" on every photo. I don't want to back up the photos, and definitely don't need to see a splash screen item running across the scenery or faces of people I photograph. Please remove the banner. author: Alison T
content: Although I appreciate that the app allows for albums to be sorted by faces, and is free, one key feature that many online and I feel is missing is the ability to create subalbums within an album. This feature is available on other Google products, so it feels like there's no reason why it shouldn't exist on Google photos. It would make the experience of the app so much better, because right now I have to share too many albums with friends and family and we often lose track of everything.

author: Max Simpson
content: Great amount of features, photo quality and offers more than other OSs in terms of reflecting on photos. However, the way it divides up screenshots, photos saved from messages etc away from your main photo gallery is a bit frustrating. Also when making an Instagram post, created albums don't appear (which can be very useful in organising what you want to post). In summary great for flicking through, infuriating when trying to find stuff

author: Mark E
content: It's ok. Was better. Recently it won't take me straight to my photos. I am only interested in photos I have taken. This app includes all the rubbish from social media, and no way toexclude folders, which results in a lot of clutter. Can't use .nomedia files because I want to exclude media from other apps, without preventing those apps from working.

author: A Google user

Suddenly after the update last night my battery drained and after 1 hour it only had 1%. I left it charging overnight and after 7 hours it was at 93%. One was Google Docs the other was this one Google photos. It would be great if you had a rollback option rather than waiting for a fix bug update. Thanks! author: TwinCities4Life

author: A Google user

author: A Google user

author: CasalsFan

author: Katie Hu
content: It's great for storing/organizing your own photos and videos on your own device/account. However, photo and video editing are often buggy. Shared albums are missing basic auto-sorting features and adding videos to them can result in them being stuck in the processing phase in perpetuity. The files aren't corrupted; the software just isn't working as it should and there are no steps to troubleshoot or easily refresh/restart the upload process.

author: Morteza nokhodian esfahani
content: I love it, I immediately replaced dropbox with this. Photo collages and animations are really awesome as well. Obviously the intent of google is to commercialize whatever sees in our pictures and videos but anyhow since its free&cool, it doesn't matter. Update: since it's not free anymore i'd day this pricing scheme even though it's cheap it makes you pay your entire life. I would pay specific amount of money even higher for permanent storage but in this scheme i go for alternatives.

author: A Google user
content: There are many good things about Photos, but something that is long overdue is adding the ability to throttle uploads.  Google Photos for desktop has it.  I live in a rural area, and have slow broadband.  DSL slow.  If I have backups enabled, taking a video with my phone results in a backup process that kills my internet for potentially hours.  Seriously, I am a software developer, I know how easy it is to add speed throttling to a data connection.  The app used to at least have a 'only back up when charging' option, but they took that away, so I can't even set it to kill my internet connection while I'm asleep - they have to have it be inconsiderate and use 100% of my 5 meg (less than 1 meg upload) connection.

author: Jean Sadler

The next day it will only let you share to Feed. Sometimes it gives you a drop down menu (which AMAZING) and that's what I want ALL the time!

author: A Google user

author: A Google user

They copy fine, but on the receiving end, they get stuck. Also, trying to delete photos from the main screen that you want to keep, but don't want them displayed all the time. So, I'll give it a middle of the road 3 stars at this point.

author: A Google user

author: Attila Gasparetz

author: Kel M.

It also would be nice to have an option to move photos to an album rather than just adding a copy of it to the album, similar to the way you can move emails to different folders and eventually obtain an empty inbox and categorized emails that are easy to sort through.

author: A Google user
