content: REALLY wish that deleting photos from the cloud didn't delete the same pictures from my device, especially if they're not being backed up. I have certain albums from my gallery that aren't being backed up for a reason, yet somehow they show up in Photos. As a result, they get grouped into things that I'd like to delete, and then it gives me a warning that it'll be deleted off of my device too. Please fix this.

author: Vladimir Radovic
content: Couldn't live without it. Very well integrated into android and the unlimited space is very much appreciated... But... The app is greatly lacking in organisation! A simple feature where I could choose to back up a folder and those photos not clogging up my main photos from my camera, but being backed up into a separate album would make this app perfect!

author: Christina
content: All the photos have the correct date when you click on them but when you search for a date they are all under the wrong. When I search for Christmas photos from last year, those showing as 25th December are actually from the 18th November and you can only see this by clicking on each photo. What I can do in editing seems to vary by picture and I recently had an issue with double of every photo which resolved itself after a day or two.

author: Eunice Noche
content: I'd like to give it a 5 star, but I believe that it can still use an update where we can automatically back up an album and remain an album. Also, it'd be useful if I can select things just by gliding my fingers on the photos and don't have to manualy select it. Edit: So, I was deleting videos on my phone because it's already full and then I checked if it was still on the google photos and saw that it was. I tried playing it but it displayed "Can't be played" and now I can't retrieve it.

author: William G
content: Makes viewing my phone photos on my laptop very easy after they have backed themselves up to Google photos. A useful safety net to keep my photos safe. I even managed to include photos that were not taken on a phone. Sharing can be tricky but downloading and uploading bypasses that problem. I wouldn't be without it. Unfortunately the free storage allowance has dropped considerably making it less useful.

author: Jonathan Hamarneh
content: Great app but it's so complicated to get access to your pictures. Theirs Google gallery and google photo. They don't even talk to each other. You have to put Google drive in between them to talk. You can't move files from your Google photos in a simple way. Plus dating system sucks. Theirs photo of me when I was a kid placed in 2022 because it was uploaded in 2022! You can change it but have to do it individually and it really sucks

author: A Google user
content: I like the idea that my photos are backed up to the cloud. Lose the phone? No problem, you have lost nothing if it is backed up to a cloud. Having said that, I have had photos that I add to albums Ive made get moved randomly to other albums. At one point it was happening so frequently that I could actually sit back and watch from the app page that shows albums and the pics would jump from album to album! Then whenever I was searching for a photo filed into an album I would no longer be able to locate it. And I have LOTS of pics so this turned into a labor intensive mission just to locate one damn pic that I had already filed away once. The only other annoyance that comes to mind is that damn "would you like to archive this pic" pop up......that gets on my damn nervessss....other than this it is an okay app.

author: Silicone Speaks
content: Generally, the app is good. I love how I can search for related photos (eg. Cooking). Just two things that annoy me, 1. I can't download my media. I try, it says "could not be downloaded". No ideas why. This is a recurring problem. 2. It uploads to all accounts instead of the one I have designated for backups. So I constantly have to be going through my other accounts to delete stuff. If those two problems could be fixed, definite 5 star.

author: Tim Lenz
content: Nice but missing key features. The inability to add people tags for faces the A misses is infuriating. Sunglasses on? You have a 50/50 chance of being able to tag. Also, adding locations for photos that don't have GPS info embedded is very limited. Probably not a big deal if all your photos are from a GPS enabled device, but if, like me, you have many scanned photos, out of luck.

author: P&M FieryFlakes
content: This was a very useful app to save photos to cloud storage and conserve mobile storages and prevent loss of photos. Until they've announced to change policies for their app, it's very disappointing that they'll have you to pay every month starting June to keep their services up. I'll have to give this a 3 star rating, even if they gave you a chance to save as many photos until the beginning of their policy change I don't think it will be the same anymore.

author: Marty Wojick
content: I put most of my photos in files before I sent them to the app. However, when I go to retrieve my photos, they all come up together. Yes, I can get them back into albums, but why can't they just come up in file order without having going through so many steps to retrieve them? I have looked in settings to see if I could arrange to have them come up albums first. Either I'm missing the setting or there isn't one.

author: Ruffian
content: Satisfactory, not superb. Ever since i switched to google photos on my phone, they take forever to send in a text, if they send at all. It will typically tell me not sent and ill have to resend 2 or 3 times before it will finally go. Also very annoyed with how it wont save changes when i edit or crop or rotate a photo. I have to go into the pics settings to save it. Could be better. Biggest issue is not sending in texts.

author: A Google user
content: I like that it saves all your photos & such, however; the fact that you can only save your photos in an album, but they still all show up under photos, I don't like. Then you have no idea which pictures have gone where. I wouldn't mind if they were in photos if deleted from an album, but all of them is too much. Once I place them in an album that should release them from being under photos. At this point I just archive them after adding to an album.

author: Mehul Bhavsar (mez)
content: Edit. The new layout isn't as intuitive and as friendly as the previous. The "burger menu" is in the top left for nearly everything and now yo get to my library and my device folders I have to go elsewhere. It's an inconvenience and more clicks. You had it good previously - improve what you have don't just keep changing for the sake of change.

author: Nanalee Gage
content: 2020 UPDATE, the new set up is crazy , ever heard the phrase "if it ain't broke don't fix it", new logo, new set up, It is so confusing, & important features are gone, it used to be user friendly, no longer, truly sad...😣😞 2016-7-8 I love it, except for I would like to be able to organize my albums in a specific order, or at least have them Alphabetical, and that is an unavailable feature, it is a chore just to find the albums I need.

author: Roland Denzel
content: It's fine. You'll never lose a picture, but you'll also never find it again. You'll just know it's IN Google Photos ;) For a company that indexes everything so well, it's surprising that you can't search based on what folder or app the picture came from, like Instagram or Facebook. That would really help find pictures, wouldn't it? It would also be great to be able to quickly tag multiple photos with categories or keywords. Also, they removed the one click rotate of images, so now you have to edit the image, click rotate, rotate it, click done, then save. Before all you had to do was click the rotate button right there under the image. Progress.

author: mizuki
content: ive had great experiences with google photos in the past, but the mobile app is what always got me annoyed. i tried deleting the backups of photos since i have them in my phone, but it deleted the actual photo from my phone and didnt give me the option to delete just the backup. now i have to go through the website just to get my photos back. could be a lot better, google photos is great, just not the app.

author: Kristi Miller
content: I like that I can look for photos by the people in them. I should be able to manually tag or remove a tag from any photo or video but some you can't. App still mixes up my sons even after tons of manual tag correction and they do not look much alike. The newer way of displaying memories like a story/slideshow is confusing when I want to pause or go back to a previous photo.

author: C. Thompson & V. Medley
content: Getting rid of unlimited storage is ridiculous. Probably the biggest reason I came to a Google phone when they first came out after my Samsung note was recalled. I've gotta 3 of them and if it actually changes, I'll probably go to iphone which would be terrible. Also, it'd be nice to a have fast forward and rewind feature when watching and editing videos. Crazy something so simple has never been available.

author: A Google user
content: *** really good app, I can't imagine anyone in the android ecosystem not using it. But recently I am having trouble editing picture within the application. l think it is only shared pictures that are effected but im not quite sure. please look into this bug Google as this is a solid app that I and many others use every day and I think we should be able to use the photo editing portion of thr app. 😉 BTW, let me know it's a problem on my end, and if so what i can do to correct it. cheers.

author: Will S
content: Lower to 3 as new update hides the Google creations so they are not as easy to see or review. Not sure why this was done. Suggestion to developers. When making videos from multiple clips it would be great to turn down the background music and use the music from the video clip. This could either be auto or even better just two sliders (one for background music and the other for the sound from the clip). This would make editing videos even better.

author: A Google user
content: It's a good app for storing my photos. However, I resent 'remember the day' where images of an ex boyfriend pop up in a collage, when you're trying to forget them! Don't do this Google, it's really unpleasant and intrusive. Also annoying for me are the stylised photos, which are pretty poor. I like to stylised my own (I'm quite good at it actually).

author: Andi White
content: The ability to move photos from place to place is a nightmare of a system... Move it out of photos into Google and try and move it back again and type screwed... The options offered when selecting a photo are frequently insufficient - deeply frustrating app for actually managing photos.. Edit 04/2023: Much better functionality now.. Stars upgraded.. Still could be easier to locate, search and categorise photos but drastically better than before..

author: A Google user
content: Havent really had the chance to go threw the app and look around, mainly it's a placr to keep photos and make sure their saved, I go threw my albums delete what I don't want then move on...I do need to make a pic collage of some sort for my fiance who is away till maybe June. I'll prolly change my rating if I can add and remove certain thing to photos or do a collage, and add funny sayings, quotes, pics, ECT..

author: A Google user
content: Great way to back up photos and videos but I think it would be better to navigate if backed up files were grouped with the names of the albums I selected to be uploaded rather than just by date taken. That way I could search for an album name i previously had on my phone then get whatever photo/video I want from there.

author: Tanya Heu (TANYAALLUPONYA)
content: The only complaint I have is the app is glitchy. I was adding a bunch of photos to a photobook I was gonna have printed and it didn't save it all... only up to page 13 and I had so many more that I spent so much time on. Soooo disappointing! All the tools and options are so nice and convenient til it doesn't want to work. The app crashes a lot.

author: A Google user
content: Pros: unlimited storage, 1 photo (w/o copying) can be in multiple albums unlike folders on a desktop Cons: The collage function is useless as it chops off heads; when I downloaded pictures from an SD card it randomly changed the date on some pictures to 1-1-1980, really?!?! that was a pain!; I couldn't figure a quick and easy way to send pictures back to my phone so I could use my phone's collage function. (I had to email, opn, dwnld, find so I could make a collage that the heads weren't cut

author: Muhammad Fairuz
content: Why doesn't this app have some basic photo/gallery features? I can't sort my album photos in alphabetical order. If I back up two folders at once, it merges them because it automatically sorts by date and time. So, if I want to create a separate album, I have to do it manually?! Really? Edit: It's not the album, it's the photos that I want to order alphabetically. I have hundreds of photos with unique suffixes and prefixes that I want to back up, but they're all messed up now!

author: Totustuus3
content: Edit: Used to be THE best storage option out there. Was so pleased. But now? Finally bit the bullet, downloaded the update, WHAT A MISTAKE. Everything has been rearranged, dates all mixed up. Disorganised & disappointing. Old: So much fun to watch how this video program arranges a small # of our photos, sets to nice music to create glimpses into moments we thought special enough to photograph. Im sure one can edit it to +/- photos that dont go together, but it's a very good start. :-) Thanks.

author: Ehsan Baloch
content: I would love to give this app 5 stars until i realised there is no option for removing duplicate files like receving the same picture or a video from WhatsApp and they be getting backed up twice and those duplicate stuff often takes quite a storage in this and this make my photos look quite unorganized as well. Today, i just had to remove more than 1000 duplicate pictures, and they were only from this year (I have been using Google Photos for 7 years or so). Google Files have that option, tho!

author: A Google user
content: Sometimes photos are easy to find. Sometimes they're not. Sometimes when I open the app all my photos show. Sometimes it opens weird highlights thing. Did I say I wanted these certain photos to be highlighted? No. Why when opening the app does it not open in the same way? Doesn't happen with my other photo apps. Why does app store photos and take them phone? Constant selling frames and such. Confusing & mercenary. Can't easily find photo by date also.

author: Pade Liah
content: Used to be a great app, unfortunately it turned out to be the least reliable app. Reason(s): it automatically deletes pictures without you knowing. What I mean is, whem you clean the phone, and go check if all the backed up files are there, you'll now find a lot of pictures deleted, but it did use to do that all those past years😭. Management, change your app features. Thank you.

author: A Google user
content: Great app, just wish there was a way to stylize any photos you want via assistant. Assistant did it with one of my photos and I LOVED IT, it hasn't done that for any of my photos since then. Google photos Assistant has stylized more photos but I wish I could choose photos myself that I want stylized, please make this possible. I don't like app now, you're unable to select multiple photos to delete anymore and it's a HUGE INCONVENIENCE for me

author: A Google user
content: really hate when apps that are great become tools for corporations to sell stuff to you. this app provides unlimited photo back up and helpful photo storing, sorting and searching features. there's no folder structure just tags and albums that dont remove photos from the timeline. this may be good or bad for you but i find it frustrating that i cant sort photos out of my timeline. recently Google has changed the first item in their menu to be effectively an ad for their photo books. not a fan

author: Average Bird
content: I need to use the pen under 'mark up' frequenctly but it never seems to work right. For some reason it always draws above where my finger is? I can't just put my finger lower than it needs be because it's so off I just can't tell. I also can't scribble with the photo full size because then the pen becomes huge and that's really annoying. If I can already fix these things I'd love to know how if not please do something about it.

author: A Google user
content: The automatic feature of editing photos is nice, but is there a way to do that yourself? Such as customize the layout of a collage, and pick which pictures get the stylist feature. there is just one picture that was created automatically with a black and white background and the colored foreground. I want to choose which pictures have that happen.

author: Julia Corcoran
content: UPDATE: Found an obscure menu that let me delete a photo that was "stuck" in upload (for weeks on end without a prompt to fix it). Once I did that, all of my problems resolved. Wish there had been a more helpful error message. The app was "uploading" the same photo for over 2 months, and syncing with shared albums and my cloud storage wasn't working as expected.

author: Zoltan Koszta
content: How on earth can I change the order of the photos in the app, so that the most recent ones will be shown as I scroll down at the bottom, or scroll right when I am looking at the photos? Pictures were displayed that way on my old Nokia phone, it's much more intuitive, and I simply can't find a setting to change it in this app, if it even exists. If that worked this would be a 5 star app.

author: Chloe Noland
content: This app is great, I've never had problems... Until now. Whenever I delete a photo from my gallery, it makes one from a day forward go back into the day I just deleted one from, so if I deleted one picture from February 1st, a photo from February 2nd would go down one, under the label of February 1st. It's really annoying and idk how to stop this or fix it. Please help me!! Edit: I don't know if this is helpful, but on Google Files, my photos are all in order of date, so it's fine there.

author: A Google user
content: I wish I could give 5stars: Here R ideas for improvement: Make easier 2 print my photos 2 remote printer like the drug store, or even a googleplex service. Also, I'd love a simple way 2 mark photos w keywords to make Albums more easily. It could rapidly improve the Intelligence of your image processing algorithms! Lastly, plz bring back the ability to add faces from several different pix into the best image. Solves the problem of not everyone smiling in group shots! Thanks!

author: A Google user
content: God if this App only had the ability to arrange albums into alphabetical order it would be the best photo album and organizer on the planet. Visually it's the most modern and fresh looking organiser on the market and sycronizing with other tablets and pc is amazing but LACKS the most basic functions. So sad especially from somebody as good as Google .  Having seen hundred of requests since the above review was written and google doing absolutely NOTHING "Yes that's Right NOTHING" About sorting the App to allow people to sort Albums Alphabetical one would assume google neither has the time or capability to sort or care about its customers.

author: Karishma Dahia
content: On the new google phone unfortunately you can only 'Save copy' of an edited photo, even if it's just simply rotated (rather than replace the original photo). Creating so many double ups that you have to go back and manually delete. Additionally, the google photo album features are also incredibly glitchy. With photos often not uploaded after selection and the option of 'add text' is usually accompanied by a pop up 'couldn't add text to album'

author: BARNABAS JOHN
content: It's good 👍 and easy to use. But sometimes it shows some pictures blank. When I check my media photos the pictures will be there, but coming to check them on Google photos, it shows them blank and still retain space other than deleting them and create space for another ones. In summary, it doesn't show all the espected photos, but it save photos once uploaded.

author: Prashanta Dhakal
content: Had to reduce my rating for the entirely dumb decision to put the option to rotate an image under the "crop" menu. If you know English, rotation is different than cropping. And rotations to images are done more frequently than any other edits to an image. Gah! Make it easy to rotate an image and don't put it under the "crop" menu. Don't try to change the meanings of existing words in the English language.

author: Isha Blight
content: Search feature lacks so many responses that the default gallery app can easily detect. I double check if that particular item is backed up to google photos, and it is. The search feature just fails to recognise so many results I'm looking for which makes me not want to back it up anymore if it'll be a hassle looking for things when I need it in the future. I have the 100gb subscription but google photos needs big improvements especially w convenience if they want to beat the regular photos app.

author: Jason C
content: Why would you release a new update to add an option to back up all folders on the device at once and have it ON by default? Now it's forced me to sort through all the folders I don't want synced, which was a massive headache. Please have the option turned OFF when releasing an update next time, or at least notify the user. I also don't like that the photos and videos are separated now.

author: Andrian Wijaya
content: The editor used to be so simple (doesn't need to import, you can just edit directly in your gallery), yet the result is already good. It's good enough that make me rarely used any other photo editor apps. But I certainly DON'T LIKE the NEW INTERFACE. Please bring back the editor paramater that stacked in row, from top to bottom. It's much easier to edit when you can see several parameter at once than when you need to swipe left or right just to see other parameter.

author: Hedi Hemin
content: Overall Google Photos is a great app, but you need to make a big update to the UI of the app, plus add options to organize folders (albums) better, and another one big problem: why can't we see the photos count!? Please add the ability to see the number of photos per album, it's very basic feature like why GPhotos don't have that until now!?

author: A Google user
content: My only issue is that the android app treats fujifilm images as burst shots, so if I want to add any photos to a shared album, i first have to wait for the photos to finish uploading to the cloud and then go onto my laptop to share the photos on the shared album. Would be really useful if I could do it all from the app!

author: Kimberly Vest
content: I would of gave it a 5 star. I've been trying to get help with finding the missing photos & videos that were backed up to my account from 3 long years ago. All my memories of my kiddos are gone it also had Photos of family members that have recently passed away. It would mean the world to me if I could see them pics or videos. Which im able to see the last few years of photos & videos. But Besides that it's a awesome app that I would recommend to download. 😥

author: Jodie B
content: Meh... It recently changed (on phone) so each thumbnail in "photos" is huge and I can't see pics in the grid nearly as easily as before. I don't have time for research project to figure out if that setting can be changed--I'm just going to "Files" instead, where I can browse thumbnails in a grid. It doesn't have any/intuitive options for organizing photos into folders. Not great photo or vid editing, also running out of space tho always deleting stuff & just way too busy to solve all above

author: A Google user
content: I would love the app if it allows me to hide content and lock it from. Next, please make the albums organisable, in example, the albums can be rearranged however i want to. Another one would be, please let me add any photos to favourites, right now it only allows me to add photos from "camera" to favourites, photos from any other folders doesn't have the option. Please make some changes, because these features were available on my previous iPhone but not on my pixel so it is a major turn off

author: A Google user
content: Never a fan of utilizing Google photos unless I'm doing something which requires the most recent photos taken, downloaded or saved to my phone, b/c they mesh everything together so the most recent is at the top of the huge mass of photos (for those of you who are like me & save TONS of photos). Also appreciate when using it from certain apps, you're able to click & select multiple photos, opposed to gallery which only allows 1 at a time.

author: A Google user
content: Seriously lacking in features. All of the photos are thrown out into a massive pile of saved photos, instead of having continuous folders, like say "Downloads"—after backing all of my saved pictures from there, they're now all mixed up with every single other picture I saved. Real messy. Also don't like how there's no option to automatically delete saved photos from my device after a certain amount of time. One last thing, the raccoon in the trash is missing which is a MAJOR disappointment.

author: Mickal Selim
content: Not bad. Works ok and no ads, can't complain :) updates not doing much change. Still looks, feels and works the same way. Good to have it but there are a lot better apps out there for photo viewing and editing than this one. Especially when they insist on freezing it with it's current theme and functionality. If you view or edit photos a lot, it will eventually become painfully boring.

author: Pete Townsend
content: Getting better, but the UI is incredibly frustrating and non-intuitive at times. I especially hate that I can't zoom in to see if I'm selecting the correct photo if I've already selected another photo. Also, I can't select just one photo from a group of burst photos. Have tried many times to remove music album artwork (on SD card) from Photos albums but no luck. Then I have to scroll through hundreds of unwanted artwork "albums." Don't get me started on the de-intgration from Google Drive.

author: A Google user
content: for awhile I was impressed with the simplicity, until I found some annoying problems : 1. you cannot download multiple images to your device. why do I want to download images to my device? because.. 2. you cannot share multiple images on Instagram otherwise! 3. when syncing images from other device, google photos didnt recognize the albums and it's a mess! These problems have been spotted and reported and responded under supports for over a year now but no attempt of fixing them!

author: Mary Tipton
content: It's okay, the features like Animations are cool but slow, it's annoying to create and sort albums and folders. For some reason I can't create any new folders like I want but can only make albums. My phone won't sort and show albums, only folders when I'm looking through files. It would be helpful if it would let me make my own folders. It's all just meh.

author: A Google user
content: I have been using the app for years, but I'm not fond of the new changes. Especially I miss the assistant icon where I would see Googles designs of my photos. I find the new version awkward and difficult to find photos and videos. I've taken off 2 stars. Personally, I don't get why the changes were made. Maybe don't mess with a design that was very user friendly, and make it cumbersome.

author: A Google user
content: Update. What does it take to get a response from someone. 2 emails several reviews and several feedback reports and still no response from anyone. Im a month in of still not being able to access my photos. Im ready to figure out a way to move my photo to another storage utility and be done with Google photos app complete. Can i please get someone to fix this issue.

author: Arnas Zoluba
content: Been using it for almost 8 years now and the app is overall great but I do hate the fact that once the media is backed up to Google Photos on your phone, there is no option to delete the photo from Google Photos cloud and keep the local file. Otherwise flawless. Edit: photo grouping which I used a lot stopped working 6 months ago with no solution given from Google's side other than "it's working on our side". Very annoying but there's really nothing I can do.

author: Ed Saffle
content: It does a good job of being a picture viewer. It's not very customizable though. No way to disable showing the highlights or month headings in the picture list. Has some predefined collections that cannot be disabled or hidden. This adds clutter and is extra problematic since I have a couple of collections of my own that use the same names. You need to use another application if you want just a list of pictures to scroll through, or the ability to sort by any particular criteria.

author: Stephanie Mandeville
content: Downloaded images are too hard to find now! There was a big update a few months ago that changed the layout of the app. It added a bunch of folders to the "On this device" section, and now it is so impossible to find images I've downloaded. It doesn't matter if I'm downloading them from Facebook, Gmail or messages; it seems like they sometimes show up in the download folder, and sometimes they're nowhere to be found. It's so frustrating!!

author: ISIA DIAMOND (INKAQUEEN)
content: I'm really not crazy about any of it,,but it comes with the Google family so I only use it for storage. It really doesn't make sense because Google has been my go-to company since day one of my whole smartphone experience. It's like they outsourced the photos app development and design to MARS!...I use my phone's Gallery and Photo Studio for everything I have to do with photos and artwork.

author: A Google user
content: It is not very user friendly. Sharing albums or pictures with other Gmail users is a great idea, but the actual process to go through is somewhat clumsy. Also the folder sync is in need of a major revamp. It does not give you the option to delete a photo from google photos without deleting it from your device. And the work around is incredibly tedious. Also once a photo is added to a folder on your device, google photos will permanently remember it in that folder. So you cannot organize it later.

author: Jessica Kusiak Peters
content: I take a lot of photos of book covers and posters for the book fair at my daughter's school. I used the auto crop function to focus on the images and make minor adjustments at each corner. I loved that it would straighten out angles without cropping huge swaths of the image the way standard square crops always do. The auto option zooms out, adds more of the background I'm trying to cut, and keeps off angles. Gone are the corner adjustments too. Very unhappy with this update.

author: Diane Esbeck-Nichols
content: My photos went to the cloud which is good so I don't lose them but when I want to bring them down to look at them it's a hole rigmarole . I do like the albums I'm not quite sure what a collage or animation is these should be explained I'm going to try the update I hope it works really well if you haven't done it star your pictures it makes them easier to save.

author: L ER
content: I loved the Google photos app before when it surprised us with auto created animations, collages, and the movies (especially the "they grow so fast" movies with the music). Now it's so much harder to find the different albums, really unclear where to make your own projects. I find this version not as user friendly or intuitive as previous versions. I really want the old version back. It made sense. Just keep updating that version!

author: Oscar R
content: Easily the best gallery out there! Finding pictures is so fast with the best search ai, plus I curate an album for each major adventure I go on. So easy to organise, and share with friends. Highly recommend. BUT, when I use the "free up space" feature, which is awesome, it also removes all the files from export folders such as inshot and lightroom. The exports are till in my gallery, but not organised in my folders. So annoying PLEASE FIX!

author: George Arango
content: Good, but needs a lot of work, specifically in managing and correctly categorizing backed-up photos. For example, some photos taken a month ago are labeled as having been taken in 1979. Also, the fact that albums in your phone's gallery cannot be automatically copied to keep your backed-up photos organized is mind-boggling; instead, we are left with a disorganized pile of photos that you essentially have to scroll through to find your desired photo... Lesser apps have this feature already.

author: Israel Valencia
content: I thought updates are supposed to make thing better and easier not worse, or maybe I understood wrong. It says we can no longer save high quality pictures and videos??? That is going to count as storage memory on our Google account??? Seriously??? Also it seemes like unless you pay for a bunch of more memory, you really can't use your email for much long term, what's worse is that every thing wants your email for every little thing you do. If the people wanna buy anything you need an email...

author: Stuart Roskelley
content: The storage and editing is great, but the management for storage, transferring, and takeout is horrendous. It is impossible to transfer photos to another account without completely downloading and reuploading them, losing all album history, comments, etc. The meta data provided by takeout is only usable if you write some script to translate it. When you pair this with the fact that Google One only allows one person to share their plan storage in a family, it limits real fast.

author: A Google user
content: Its nice to know my photos are backed up, but, when using this, my phone battery drains and overheats in 5 minutes, I cannot delete any photos from it even after following instructions on how to do it, and even though Ive got all folders to be backed up turned off, its backing up photos I do not want. Also there is no option to not backup every camera picture. Sometimes I take a photo of very small print so I can read it, but, it is nothing I need to keep. Cant make slideshows anymore.

author: A Google user
content: I like the app and the concept, but I'm still angry because of the killing off of Picasa, without covering the use cases of non smartphone photography. Also it is a shame that Google does not search among keywords in the photo header. The desktop sync has improved, but it still mixes the Picasa originals with the edited pictures, so everything looks doubled. Come on Google, you can do it better. Please cover the basic use cases instead of focusing on the magic features.

author: David Adams
content: Great app, kind of... The app works great for photo storage, organization, and simple editing, but their policy on unlimited photo storage is ending in June '21. It drops down to a 15GB storage limit for "high quality" pics/video. I think there will still be free storage for lower quality stuff but no one purposely wants to lower the quality of their memories.

author: John Rizos
content: Pretty good app to organize an view photos you took with a camera. It has nice editing and backup options and an excellent sharing feature to share albums with friends. There is an automatic memory creation feature and there is no option to turn it off. I don't want my gallery app to be creating stories on its own, those also take up space in the interface if you don't remove them manually. Finally for some reason you can't sort the album view by name or any other type of sort except from date.

author: A Google user
content: For some reason, if i download an image (from Xbox app in this case), the app will not let me view or edit the new file, instead replacing it with an older version of the image that has been deleted from my device. It has become very frustrating to start from scratch trying to edit these images when it turns them into files that should no longer exist. It even tells me that i downloaded the file at the same time as the old, deleted file. Any fixes or input is appreciated!

author: Aria Z
content: It's good, but there's a few things I think that could be improved. Like adjusting your collages so that they actually show the part of the image you want, it would be really helpful to have a little folder that puts all of your starred images or videos. And it would also be really nice if there was an option to scan through the app and bring up any duplicates for images.

author: Kiah Pierre
content: Google Photos is an OCD person's nightmare!! It allows you to put pictures in an album, but won't get rid of them in the main file after you file them into an album...so you don't ever know what has been added to an album or not. It also has tools like Utilities, where it offers suggestions of photos to archive, but it won't let you choose which of those suggestions to archive. You either archive all or nothing. It is incredibly frustrating and disorganized. I have more complaints but no charact

author: A Google user
content: Good app to store and share pictures but I expect more from Google. Why can't I tell you what folders I want to backup (manually, without autodetect) and why don't you preserve when a picture was taken as opposed to when it was saved (and why can't I manually edit it)? Google, please answer. We need more control on the program. Automation is great until it's stupid (see automatic faucets at the airport)

author: Jason Greene
content: A good app, and I like the backup function. The option of deleting photos when the app suggests backing up would be fantastic! Update: One less star since they're isn't an option to delete the daily highlights when they are being shown. I don't know why the interface is so clunky, I assume they want to sell more storage instead of having a fantastic product.

author: Kenny Conurn
content: It's been ok fot the most part however some time photos do not load and I have a hard time finding out where I place what photos because there's so many different options too many options become a distraction and then you're left with things that a normal user wouldn't use if there was a way that you could edit the options menu to where you didn't even see certain things it'll be much more beneficial t

author: Darren Williams
content: For the most part it's quite good, but the storage issues are a big problem. Even if you delete hundreds of photos (and then empty the bin), the available storage space doesn't change. Probably just a pkoy to make you buy storage space... which makes me more determined to use a third party storage solution instead being forced to buy more space from Google.

author: Dave K
content: The latest update as of November 10th, 2021 has broken my ability to add text via the markup tool. Whenever I try and go to type on the image it just flips between the highlight and the drawing tool because it can't bring up the on-screen keyboard. Not sure if this is a Google photos or gboard problem. It's seems to be related to the latest update to the Photos app. I uninistalled the most recent update and that allowed me to add text again. But when I install the latest version of Photos, the problem reappears. I've sent feedback via the Google photos app. I posted to the Google Photos Community forum and I also opened a ticket with Google One as they offer support to subscribers.

author: Alexander Auger
content: I really like the flexibility of the storage options. Personally I find it nice to have 10TB because I love overkill. However I am trying to switch over from IOS but it's hard. Google Photos has no folders, nor nested folders, only albums, which makes organizing annoying, additionally I'm not a fan of the UI, Samsung's gallery is much better and it has folders. I just really hope more customization options become available.

author: joseph o'brien
content: The editing with the older app was much better. Amazing. This new update has basic editing features that don't work as well. Bring back the editing features of the old app. I do like this new version although it now appears to crash a lot. 'unfortunately, photos has stopped'. Oh dear. Come on Google Update: things more stable. Nice to get reminders too. Image editing needs bit more ooomph. And so does the ability to organise albums. It's very inefficient to to-date a selection of photos.

author: Andrew Wilson
content: So much mixed. I really, REALLY need: (1) a "select all" or other more powerful multi-select within an album. (2) The ability to change the order displayed of both albums and photos. (3) The ability to view the photos as files, which they are, with file names, sizes, dates modified/created, etc. Also, the auto-sync sometimes does VERY strange things while managing albums on my phone. But I couldn't be without it, and I don't know of an alternative.

author: Ramona Lione
content: If a photo is moved to a folder, it should only be found in that folder. Some sort of image recognition software would be nice because it takes so freaking long to find the picture you want. There should be an easier way to search by what it's an image of, e g., people, horses, dogs, plants, etc. Finding a specific saved image shouldn't be such a huge time sink.

author: MASONN (the alpha)
content: Its a good app, but my photos wont show up when i try to send them to people. I see them in the app, but not on anything else. Its annoying, because it randomly happened a few months ago. And if i would want to actually see them, and send them i would have to manually download, over 7000 photos. Only like 100 photos show up, and their only the ones that i recently saved. And i can't just download them all at once, its really frustrating. I would hope you would fix this issue.

author: Afonso Roncete
content: App is really good for the basic functionalities. Having the feature of putting photos in folders and being able to decide which ones get backed up or not is VERY useful for sorting and managing. Locked folder is a bless as well. However, I really don't understand why you can't keep the folders on the cloud storage. What's the porpouse of having multiple folders if it doesn't matter when they get backed up?? Also, not having a filter for device-only photos makes things hard sometimes

author: Taylor Larson
content: There's two major flaws with Google Photos in my opinion - the fact that your photos are automatically sorted into albums/there's no way to browse all photos, and the Save Copy function instead of having the choice to overwrite the original photo. These two small details really bring down the user experience for me and I'd love to see Google offer a more streamlined app!

author: Marystella Mosha
content: So all of a sudden ALL my photos of documents, handwritten notes just disappeared. Now I'm looking for a really important picture with some really important details and I notice that the only photos left in my account are pictures of people,venues and food. I am beyond upset as I have done all I can think of and haven't been successful in locating them

author: Brandy C
content: When I started using Google photos it said "free unlimited storage" now it wants me to pay for storage. If I would have known I would have looked for other storage options long before I started using Google. There are priceless photos on here from my loved ones that are no longer with us so I can't just stop using them. Also, there are very limited free options for editing, cropping and fixing your photos. It shows you what you want but you have to upgrade to paid.

author: A Google user
content: It's nice to have the Assistant conjur up animations and throw together collages but, on the whole, there just aren't enough options for managing a large collection of photos efficiently. The Google Photos experience would benefit hugely from tiered levels of complexity and customisation in both feature set and user interface. I think there's a good chance there'd be a customer base for a modest subscription fee.

author: Diana McKinney
content: I have been grateful to Google Photos in the past when I had a defective storage card and lost my photos. I was able to recover from my account. However I came to realize I dont have control of what is saved thus what contributes to my allowed amount of storage. Google Photos saves everything not what you determine to be saved. An example is screenshots...I don't want them saved and counted in my storage amount. If there is a way to fix this I wish I knew. I could give a better rating.

author: A Google user
content: I like that my photos goes straight into google storage from my phone. that bit is fantastic. What is super annoying though is the styling of the photos and the animation done without being asked for. it is,a lot of clutter until I delete it, which I always do, because they are so badly done. if I want to apply a style, give me the option to do it myself. please just keep my photos safe.That is all this app needs to do.

author: A Google user
content: The app puts together great "movies" with well-timed photos that match background music, but only allows me to make "movies" with very quick changes from pic to pic and no option for background music. FreeUpSpace feature deletes from device AND leaves a blank media in GooglePhotos. Heard that might be corrected soon though.

author: A Google user
content: Awesome but frustrating. It organizes all your photos intelligently, but that organization structure is absolutely invisible when searching photos from other apps which makes 95% of this app's potential completely unrealized. You need to be able to physically separate albums into different folders so you can find them in other apps otherwise this app just serves to further push you away from using Google products in search of something better.

author: M Rey
content: Mostly works as intended, but has a serious issue of making an annoying pop-up every week/two, at random, to harass me for not have cloud back-up on; to the point I've accidently selected it a few times and had to scramble to cancel, as it automatically starts downloading everything. I store anything worth keeping on an external drive. I don't want my confidential or family photos stored on some random cloud server, where Lord knows who could technically access it or be potentially hacked.

author: Stacee Stephens
content: I enjoy having all of my photos stored in one place. I love the ability to edit them. Better fonts and texting, writing, coloring tools would be great. What i do not like when i store my photos either in archive or create albums. All of the photos stay in the main storage place. I have over 3000 photos. And apparently when i delete them from that main storing place it deletes them from the device. If i move my photos, i would like for them to actually move to the album or archive. Thank u

author: Queen of Hearts
content: User friendly app that stores all your photos in one place, freeing up valuable storage space. I like the assistant feature which auto-generates collages, albums, memories & gifs you can save or delete. "Unlimited storage" is a no more, and a docked 2 stars for that. For media saved at original size the limit is 15GB - after that they'll ask you to purchase more. To avoid this make sure you're backing up using the HD setting. No longer unlimited. 😕

author: Josie Hunter
content: Love that I can backup all my video and pictures in one place. I've got it setup to automatically back them up from my phone which makes it even easier. UPDATE 2022 I would love to see something that could help erase duplicate pictures. I wish there was a set amount you could pay for storage once and not monthly/yearly.

author: Shawn Muir
content: The app gets better and better. The search function great and can find people or specific animals in your pics. The editing filters are easy to use, and the yearly reviews are fun. Wish you could pick the photos that go in callage like you can edit the video.. Everything else works great. Update 2025. It's getting worse and worse. Changing my review. You can't find shared photos, they keep changing everything around. All of googles free stuff is changing to get worse unless you pay.

author: Tanvir Mahmud
content: This is a good example that an "Update" is not always "Better". I don't want my RAW files backed up in the cloud! And now with the new update i can't choose not to backup my raw files! I only want my jpegs stored in the cloud. Please set the raw files back to the pictures folder. Apparently i can't choose my raw files folder location anymore either. PLEASE, set the raw files folder to its previous location. Thats all that i want. I hope you'll understand my frustration. Thank You.

author: A Google user
content: I really like it and would rate it higher except that it is ridiculous that I can not fix mistakes made in facial grouping or that you can but it is ridiculous complicated and I have to spend this much time trying to figure it out rather than having a simple "tag face" or fix option or literally anything. I love being able to search by the persons face but it consistently mixes faces up or leaves out multiple people and there is no easy way to fix it.

author: Ulrich Schmiedel
content: I am using Google Photos from day one. I am quite happy, but recently Google Photos Android App takes hours for a new album to show up. Searches are also slow, sometimes. I have solved this problem using Google Photos on the web. This problem is not limited to my phone, but can be replicated on my Chromebook.

author: Em L
content: It's a nice app, but I wish there were more features. It is so hard to manage the photos and albums. I wish you could store albums within groups. I also wish the albums were in alphabetical order when you need to move a photo to an album. It would also be nice of you could turn on "auto archive" if desired, so that after you move a photo to an album, you don't have to reselect the photos to move to archive again.

author: Harry Callaghan
content: This is the app I use to store and sort all my photos and videos. Recently I've found that if I edit photos from the folder that my photos are automatically sorted in and then move them across to another folder, chaos ensues. I suddenly can't move any items, the dates seem to change on photos, and I have to delete the edited ones as they'll always bug

author: G Evans (gevans416)
content: I would take or download pictures and they won't be available when I go browsing through the app to share or edit them. That was a deal breaker so I had to download another photo viewing app. Also there's no way to control what folders show up and in what order when you are browsing the pics it can access. Good start but there are many apps that do much better...

author: Lewis Foia
content: The interface follows google's UI/UX standards I guess, butbit's wack. Overall the app is slow, it doesn't make clear which photos are backed up, doesn't allow you to see shared albums the same way the web app does, you can't change file names except by using your native gallery app, it takes too long to download a few pictures (even two small-sized pics).

author: Hieu Tran
content: Awesome! Updated: 2021-12-08 Changed my rate from 5 to 3 stars. New taken photos appearance were delayed in the app (Pixel 5, Android 12). The photo information was loaded really slowly (unacceptably slow). The app often takes a lot of battery due to the long time background running (3-4 hours), and I have to "force stop" the app. Actually the most battery consumption in my phone is Photos (all due to the background running)!!! What happened to the previous fast, smooth and awesome app?

author: Toney Webb
content: Lots of room for improvement. I hate the automatic folders google makes. Need to be able to download photos to device a view them while offline completely. I can download them but if I get to a spot with no signal, after I scroll a bit they blur. I'll continue to use it because it syncs to my devices. But google should really put some time into this app. It's not terrible but could be much better.

author: A Google user
content: I like that I dont have to fill my phone with pics . Everything is uploaded to unlimited storage (High Quality). I keep only a few collages on my phone for when I'm offline. Steep learning curve both for me to learn the nuances of the app and for the program to recognize people & things. Overall happy with it.

author: A Google user
content: Average -- pretty good. Appreciate the auto backup of images but I worry that Google has access to all my images (esp. since it happened without directly getting permission). No, of course, Google would never be evil LOL! I don't like the notifications I get, too often. And, i don't give a wit about stylized pics.

author: A Google user
content: I like it a lot, im so thaankful to have my photos backed up for free. I just wish it were more clear that my photos ARE backed up before i delete them. I open the app and i dont really have any reassurance that they won't be gone forever when I delete them from my phone, until I take the plunge and delete them. Its scary not knowing. I thought there used to be an icon in the corner that said, "backup complete", but sadly, it's not there anymore.

author: Hope Foley
content: I used to love Google photos--I used it as all-in-one permanent photo storage. (2013 to present) Now it's just temporary storage to get from phone to computer. It seems much more limited than previous iterations. I find I'm downloading back off of Google photos on to my computer to give room for EMAILS often. While downloading I suddenly have duplicates of photos I *know* I deleted to give space in the past. It feels like an exercise in futility to get you to buy more space for $1.99 a month.

author: Bella B
content: I don't like how I can't find certain photos from my camera, when I'm trying to select a picture, through another app. for some reason, it only shows a fraction of the photos, and I have to go into G-Photos, and mark them or newly save them, in order for it to show up in another app. it's something that would deter me from getting another Google phone next time.

author: A Google user
content: It's been a flawless experience until a few weeks ago. Somehow, on my S9, with full performance mode on, it's not backing up. At all. It's stuck on "preparing backup" forever, and I only have pictures from up to November saved. I reinstalled, cleared the cache, and it still does nothing. Please fix this :/

author: A Fakhouri
content: I don't like not being able to rearrange my folders how I like, my alphabetical order for example. If there is a setting for it it's not very clear how to do it. Needs more easily accessible customisation for organising folders etc. Also being able to select a folder as favourite would be nice but to my knowledge you can only select individual photos

author: Mohamed El Sherif
content: Please allow me to remove pictures from the drive without deleting them from my device, not being able to do so is really annoying. Thank you for the response, but this wasn't helpful, not all photos I take with my camera are that important to me to backup, same with my screenshots, an option to permanently remove from drive while not deleting from device would be great to solve this option, the tips in the link is good only if backup is cancelled and not turned on again!

author: Jennifer Hilton
content: I like that Google backs my photos and at a low monthly cost, and I enjoy the edit feature, could we possibly add a function to delete duplicate photos? Also, I took a lot of time to make folders of events and vacations and such which Google just removed and placed all the photos separately into dates. Can you please make it possible to keep my photos in the original folders so I don't have to search through each day/date?! It was very heartbreaking to see all my pictures removed and scattered.

author: Terrell Bacchus
content: I don't leave reviews but felt compelled in this situation. The app has been flawless up until a couple of months ago. Back up sometimes gets hung up and I have to restart. The sharing fuction has become a mess and is my biggest issue- when you try to save a photo (not download to phone) it gets stuck, comments aren't intuitive and often don't go through or come in late. I've tried the fixes in the articles linked but nothing has helped. Please help a pixel super fan.

author: A Google user
content: Uploads difficult to manage or pause for later. Or even know which photos have been done or not. Just get a progress bar Need to be able to stop it when WiFi load is minimal. Toggling off backup sync not effective. Re sync - option to choose which folders to sync from camera instead of everything trying to go at once.. Otherwise good to know photos are accessible.

author: Jay Dacorey
content: If only if there where more options. There is no undo option for backing up/freeing up. It's frustrating to see all your photos gone in the Gallery too, even though it's on Google Photos, implying that we should use Google Photos primarily. Plus, it backs up photos on accounts I don't want it to back up on. When disable it, it disables backing up for every single connected account. Give me a break!

author: A Google user
content: Google makes you think they can be trusted with your photos. I want to have faith in their abilities but as an android user, switching directly to Google photos (from gallery) was a very confusing change. I'm glad I can store my photos on this cloud but it takes up a ton of space. I'd like more explanations from Google when Google suggests actions for me.

author: Sherry Watson
content: I switched from Goggle Pixel 3 to a Samsung Galaxy but still a major Goggle follower in everything app. Not happy that to edit my photos in detail, I have to pay 1.99 a month or $17.99 a year. I left apple because of the charges, .99 a month for storage, app & song fees. Here we are now with Google. And it doesn't come with anything special, not even "unblur", guessing that's just on phone. Gonna stick w/ Samsungs options, their great.

author: Jason Terrible
content: Not enough customization. EDIT: Sure. The app does not scan the default Pictures folder, where a lot of apps default save to. So to see a pic, I have to cut the file and paste it into DCIM. No ability to add a photo from your device, or settings to customize scanned folders. You cannot even edit the filename of a photo! Add more folder view options, like details, different icon sizes, previews, etc. You could have an incredible app by just adding some real basic functions. Set a home screen.

author: Christopher Spudic
content: Nuisance but Necessary I got 14 notifications today. 14! I turned off notifications for this app because there is no reason to be notified and they're still coming. If I want to use the app, I'll use it. I'm a busy person and these notifications are driving me crazy! And when i get a notification on my phone i have to check it. Please make the notifications stop, again I've disabled them on my end, but they're still coming. Otherwise good.

author: Християна Ставрева
content: Hello there, I love google photos an have been using it for years, I've been having only 1 problem with it though. The audio on AVCHD video format seems to NOT be working. Other thing is would be nice if the video didn't start as soon as you click on the screen but rather to click on a "play" button, that way screenshots would be way easier. Thank you in advance.

author: A Google user
content: Just learning this app and so far its confusing. It keeps making stylized photos I don't want and sending me push notifications about them. Also, it took two days to back up all 200 photos from my vacation when I got back. It is nice though because it does back them up to my computer, which my other photo app doesnt do.

author: Jason Wood
content: For the most part good but the intrusive "turn on backup" pop up is ruining my experience. I have back up disabled for a reason, that hasn't changed the last 500 times you've asked me. There needs to be a don't ask me again button. It's a bit scummy too how the pop up has "turn on backup" as the default response with one button press while "continue with back up off" has toggle off and then confirm, so two button presses. Very easy for someone to close the pop up unknowingly turning it on.

author: A Google user
content: I'm glad for the auto backup feature, as I had an entire SD card disappear with a phone of mine, and many of the photos from it remain in my library! Update: the resolution is automatically reduced in backed up photos, so it's a pain to have to hand select which can be backed up and which should be moved to my computer for safe-keeping at full resolution.

author: Jacqueline “MONKEY” Meares
content: It would be nice if Google would quit changing the formats on all of their apps and then they decide to eliminate them for a newer app that doesn't work nearly as well, like Google Gallery, it sucks. But this app needs fixing still. If I am placing a photo into Archive folder why does it still appear with the other photos? There is no need for a photo to appear in multiple folders, if I put it into a specific folder, it shouldn't be in any other folder it's a waste of space.

author: A Google user
content: I love the app only thing i HATE is when i want to delete a photo from my phone it deletes it from google as well. Very frustrating. I should be able to delete off my phone and the photo stay on google. I really need to figure out how to go around this or they need to make an option to only delete off phone n not google! Also years ago the editing options were awesome they had so many to choose from now it sucks you can only change the color very disappointing. Bring back those editing options!

author: A Google user
content: My photos app is great when it does work...but after a cold hike did not save a series of 30+ photos I took of time in a cabin in the woods with family. Huge bummer! On the hike however, photos performed great and the camera was amazing. Not sure if this is a bug with the Google photos app or with Android software but either way hugely disappointed.

author: chociiru
content: Give people the option to choose if they want to delete something off the cloud only or on the device as well. It's extremely annoying that if something gets accidentally backed up for some weird reason(even after putting off back up and sync) i cant JUST delete it off the cloud. Im extremely annoyed. Please fix that. A locked folder shouldnt be necessary to do just that.

author: Benjamin Pieplow-Rohner
content: Being able to search photos' content is extremely helpful, as is having the option to compress or save originals. The backup (arguably the core feature) does not run reliably and ignores Android's "sync" setting. So, overnight connected to AC and WiFi the app will lie dormant, then on the train the next morning will try to upload 200 photos as I try to find a bus schedule, using battery power and making the connection unusable, with no way to stop the sync short of disabling it entirely.

author: A Google user
content: The service is great. The app needs work. Photo editor is absolute garbage. Filters are worthless. Needs histogram, needs HSL sliders. Google owns Snapseed, why are those tools not integrated into Photos? At least the basics. Albums page is designed for children. I need to be able to zoom way out and get an overview of my albums and sort them differently, view folders on device and know if single photos are backed up or not, and need to be able to pinch and zoom in and way out within albums.

author: C
content: I love the movies and collages that google makes, that's really cool. But it sucks that it takes so long to back up photos and the editing features for pics have been taken off....really sucks. I don't like that the amount of storage given is shared across all of the google apps rather then each app having its own storage amount. Just had to purchase more storage due to my photos.

author: ARYSS BRUCE-GALLASHAW
content: I love using google photos a lot. I can make new albums for my photos, save old photos that I thought I never had and some much more. My only problem is that recently I haven't been able to share my photos with anyone recently and it really annoys me because all of my good pictures are in there and if I want to show someone something I can't. It sucks but other than that the app is wonderful.I just hope that they fix it so that I am able to share photos again.

author: A Google user
content: Rather awkward for anything but very basic stuff. If you need to save or view a couple of pictures it's fine, and the backup functions are convenient, but the moment you are dealing with more than that, it becomes ridiculously clumsy. There is no way to tell which pictures come from where (is this mine or did I import it from a friend's library?), which ones are taking up space in your storage, no easy way to bulk select and archive groups of pictures... Needs much love.

author: A Google user
content: Does a great job monitoring your photos and places you've been... if you could choose to turn it off, it would be even better. I've looked repeatedly for some kind of setting where I could choose to turn it off or on, but if it's available they do not make it very obvious. Now I just keep getting random repeated notifications that I've got another Montage or collage ready to view and I don't even want it.

author: Timmi
content: Good features, easy to use, but privacy intrusions are very unsettling, and getting worse with each new update; I quote: "Your photos are now searchable by the people, places and things in them — no tagging required." I don't understand why they are needing to even snoop through our photos and analyse them. Why is there no option to disable that, and why aren't backups encrypted? Can't trust you. I'm definitely not installing latest update, and need to be careful with the occasional prompts.

author: Jeremy Moore
content: It stores your photos just fine. Some decent organization as well. Automatic face identification is nice, when it works. If there is a way to select pictures to direct it to identify faces, I have no idea how. That's the biggest issue with this app. So many widgets and suggestions but absolutely no explanation on what it actually does. I can archive photos, but I have no idea where they go or how to get them back. The special stuff only seems to unlock when it wants but then you can't find it...

author: Elianna Guerrero
content: Tbh, the interface itself is laid out nicely - except all the parts where it's not, lol. Too many things in here are not user friendly, are confusing, or have too similar of a function to other Google apps that came preinstalled on my devices. Also, while on my tablet, I realized there's no way to upload, since it lacks a "upload over Wi-Fi" toggle switch (probably since it doesn't have cellular data, but still)—yet for some reason is asking me to allow uploads w/out giving me a way to do so.

author: A Google user
content: It's ok but i would rather just have Gallery i really don't need 2 and 3 photo apps. What a waste of space! My Android comes pre-installed w Gallery, GooglePhotos and Drive - u can't get rid of any of them. And what's the point? Of all 3, Gallery is the better editor - and no matter if i reset my phone or get a new one - with Google all my photos are always saved and come back to me with the reset or new phone - so having all 3 editors definitely seems useless. Talk about Overkill!

author: A Google user
content: Back up and sharing are great. Unlimited cloud storage for hi quality images. This us probably the leading photo app. But the app is very basic - sorting tagging and labelling is practically non existent. You can't even do a slideshow with captions. This is very much a cloud based app with some offline capability. If you need to do something off line, then test it first. For example search does not work off line.

author: Colin
content: CAN'T DOWNLOAD PHOTOS TO GALLERY - As of the last update, there's no longer an option to download photos/videos to my device. I can edit, share it, save it to an album, but not download it. I used to be able to hit the 3-dot button, and had the option to download it (as long as it wasn't already on my device). Not anymore. Now you have to go to the Google Photos website, which is just slow and clunky. Such a waste of time 🤦‍♂️

author: Magnolia Joshua
content: Convenient for auto-backups, but kind of a nightmare for keeping things organised. Edited selections from an album and had to seek support to locate the edits, which were under explore>recently added. I manually added them to the album I wanted them in but still had a few missing. I'm on the 3rd round of gathering and double-checking and I just know there's a better way to do this.

author: Compassion Speaks
content: The app is good overall since it has never been compromised u still have all of my photos since 2012 and although there is a fee for storage now its not costly at all. Yes a bit deceiving as we the notion was this would be free but not extreme. I do wish you could save albums the way you want or edit the albums they make for you to remove or add certain pictures but I have not been able to do so as of yet.

author: Oscar Moxon
content: It's okay. Good enough to get me to use it instead of the built-in gallery app, but lacks: 1) Lots of useful features I see elsewhere, including downloading any photo! Mostly I have to share to email, send them to myself and THEN download, that's a joke! 2) Face recognition is limited and infruiating. Only around 50% accurate for me, often limits my manual editing capabilities. Doesn't pick up on enough faces for me to use it reliably.

author: Wowee Haha
content: I'm not sure what to think about this, its a good app and all but...when I want to make a new folder, I want the pictures to be in the order I put them in!! Its annoying trying to find a comic that I put in there correct page by page (1, 2, 3, etc.) Instead of trying to find them in order! Please make it so I can read my comic correctly!!

author: Sue Kurvits
content: The app was better before, but some things still need improvement. Pop-ups to add cloud storage are annoying. I can no longer share multiple photos at a time. Often photo captions are already filled in with texts from other photos. The magic eraser is unpredictable, portrait blur does not blur all of background and camouflage isn't worth using. There is no yellow, only warm or skin color in adjust. Apparently, Google does not take suggestions from reviews, rather sends people to a different site

author: Derek Casari
content: I have updated my review because unlike the program Gallery, Google photos does not allow you to create folders on your phone into which you can place photos and then back that up to the cloud. Google photos saves all your images but if you want to keep things organized by folders on your phone it would be nice if Google photos preserved that structure in the cloud.

author: Bri Weeks
content: I adore this app, but can we not add a simple locking feature with a passcode? I understand you can archive, but if someone has my phone they are 90% likely to find what they need just by using the search feature. I hate having to download other apps to lock photos when this app is so much better for organization. Just my two cents! Thanks you!!

author: C E
content: Faulty. I don't know what happened during the update but highlighting something or circling something has become a hassle. I often have to highlight or circle something for my elderly parents to see in a photo and every time I try to click the done button I can't. I constantly have to close out and go back in over and over until I finally can press done. It's annoying

author: A Google user
content: Eh... I like it, but there are so many small oversights. Like not being able to delete photos just from photos and not devices, many assistant feautes missing from desktop, things deselcting after i hit download (if i download 30pics so i can delete, i have to remember exactly which 30 I selected and go back and select them again to delete)....

author: Bulolo Wilber Innocent
content: It's a really good app with so many features, love that. But the new M3E update removed the colour pop feature, and this bug still exists where even if you set back up to WiFi only, even go ahead to turn off back up, it still backs up your photos using your mobile data anyway, doesn't care for your settings, it backs up the photos whether you like it or not. I suggest to those experiencing the same issue to turn off mobile data background usage in the settings, works for me

author: Janette Omanga
content: This app used to be great when it had unlimited storage. Suddenly, out of the blue, you introduce limited storage space, and that too a very small one! Honestly, what can you store in a 15gb space?- not even my smallest finger! And now you want us to buy more space should we need more storage space. For heaven's sake, isn't that robbery?!

author: Mbalenhle Vuma
content: All around a great app. I've loved it for years! My only issue is that the blur background option has disappeared for all photos, whether portrait or not. That was a great way to remove unwanted appearances on a photo. Please bring back the option. Ive tried everything and even googled to see if the option has been moved, all results say the option is there but im using an android 13 A32, updated google photos numerous times and the option still doesn't appear. Thanks for the great app!

author: Jessica Buchite
content: I like it; sharing is good. BUT I wish Google allowed more storage. You can fill 15GB pretty fast. I also wish Photos didn't keep trying to "back up" EVERYTHING from my phone! I want photos on my phone's SD card kept separate from the few I manually upload to Photos. Worse, if you use Photos to delete a photo on the phone, it doesn't go into (restorable) phone trash but a weird Photos deleted folder. And DON'T hit the "eject SD card" button in Photos! Just use a homescreen shortcut not the app.

author: Erin Hudson
content: I'm bringing this review down 2 stars, since the last update I can not edit photos like I used to be able to. Some of the options are gone. Plus it is very hard to find things, I had to look up how to find the automatic creations. I was just trying to make sure a new baby was recognized as who they were, and I can not find where the album's for that is. They are not in the regular album's that I was able to see. This update does not seem user friendly.

author: A Google user
content: A Great App but with sone major flaws. It forces all photos to be cataloged by date thus offering little flexibility in making albums. I have had to change the dates on hundreds of photos to get them where I want them. There is also no way to 'collapse' timelines or albums, or create sub-catagories (like the email folders in gmail) therefore forcing you to scroll through hundreds of albums and thousands of pictures. It would be nice to have the location name on the photos much like Apple does.

author: A Google user
content: It's a good app overall, but there's a bug when you screenshot an archived photo, it gets unarchived. This also raises some security concerns, my photos on Google Photos show up in Chrome when I search up "Google Photos" with or without any specific thing after it. I'll give 5 stars if you guys fix the bug and add an option to have it NOT show up.

author: Belinda Knoblock
content: I am really frustrated with all of the recent changes to this app. it seems like the AI feature that allows you to remove objects has become less accurate . There was also a feature I used to straighten and then crop photos of photographs and my artwork. It made them appear to have been photographed on a scanner. Why is that gone? And what is "unblur" supposed to do?

author: Kids Rodabaugh

So that made s why I it only gets three out of five, over all though I think it has been pretty much all good and I like it, other than those two things it has been great. 🙂😁

author: [Redacted]

Instead of getting rid of a photo with the same label to use the new one, it should register as a double or just not be deleted in general. I've found this app useful but when I discovered this massive problem, I felt like photos failed to do it's job; Storage.

author: Carl Perkins

It seems we have to wait and hope it happens. I feel giving to the tech employed in Lens alone that there ought to be significantly more tools on hand. I do enjoy the phot editing element. I'm a complete layman and have found success easily enough. I'm confident it can improve.

author: Eric B
content: It's been ok. Would love to see better and easier duplicate picture removal tools. Would like better control of where it pulls photos from and then where they are stored. Not happy that locked folders do not move contents automatically when you buy a new phone, lost a bunch of pictures then. Lost a ton of pictures when Drive and photos divorced and went their own ways. Would be nice to have a higher level of photo editing built into the app. Recent edits/photos folder can miss pics.

When I'm organizing photos, it seems like my existing albums are listed in a random order so it's hard to find them. I'd really like an option to sort my albums alphabetically while adding photos to albums.

Because that's the problem LITERALLY EVERYTHING is sa

author: Brian Gers
content: Can be frustrating at times when "memories" are suggested. The program makes up a group of pics which is nice but isn't always user friendly when trying to backtrack if you accidentally swipe to the next. It's near impossible to pinpoint where everything is. I don't like that! I can improve my own organization to prevent issues like that. Keep it simple!

author: Giuseppe Durante
content: Was going fine until the changes of storage data. I think that you are forcing people to buy extra storage with your free 15GB storage plan. I just don't understand why I need to pay extra money to keep my photos and videos when at first it was unlimited. Can't tell the opposite for the app, it does what it's supposed to do.

I hope they fix it and uploaded photos also stays in the folder to find photos easier rather than scrolling hundred times.

author: Steve Sorenson
content: New UI isn't an improvement. Don't know why you moved everything around. For example, the "Library" is gone, replaced by "Collections" and no longer on the front page.
