"cake" for example - we had our anniversary last Friday, the photos of the cake ARE there, but search does nothing and returns no results.

author: A Google user
content: Great for syncing your cellphone pictures with your Google Photos account and using high quality setting with free unlimited storage. Set it and forget it, and it's nice I can share large batches. However, sucks you won't be able to sort by individual or folder name. Many folks posted on the Google Photo help forum requesting and asking for this simple feature for a while, maybe it will get addressed here with a low rating. I'd be glad to bump the stars ratung to 5 if it gets added. Thank you.

Given my phone is constantly telling me to make room on my phone and I need to delete photos to do that, this is particularly annoying.

But then i have to delete them one at a time, a time consuming process. I wouldn't even use it at all except it was forced installed on my phone when i bought it.

author: A Google user
content: This is one of the best apps and concepts on the market, but it just seems to have a few flaws. 1. My phone is connected to WiFi and yet Google Photos refuses to backup my photos saying that it is waiting for a WiFi network. 2. Once I do get everything updated I can't use the "Free up storage" fuction. If those two things worked the way the were supposed to this would be a 5 star app for sure! It truly is amazing.

author: Molly Wiggins
content: The photo app itself is great, easy to find pictures and uploads to the cloud seamlessly. HOWEVER, their picture printing service is absolute garbage. The quality is not even as good as basic Walgreens, the pictures came all out of order, and inexplicably, there was a blank piece of what looked like torn scratch paper in the midst of the pack. Will not purchase through Google again.

author: A Google user
content: I would rate the app higher if the so called "assistant " really was an assistant that I could ask to do things such as create a panoramic picture or add special effects. It does create very good images but there are others that I want to use and there is no option for me to initiate the process.

author: Teresa Z
content: This app is just a little too friendly, like an aunt who is has made a scrapbook by snooping your social media. It interrupts my daily life with suggestions and highlights, when I primarily use my camera for field work, documentation, et c. It also suggests I archive photos without an option to just delete them - if it's going to be so helpful, at least give me some options.

author: paula miller

Will now use Google files app to view photos. edit: randomly stopped darkening photos. now its hit and miss as some photos will darken while most stay as taken/uploaded.

author: Dan Bonise

I've also had pictures been falsely identified as someone else. As far as I can see, there is no way to manually assign a picture to a face. Still having the same issues and of course Google is slow to fix them.

author: A Google user

Google photos, once you've used about 10 gigs of the 15 gigs they give you, stops working properly. It doesn't process the movies I make for my friends n family anymore. Then, if you try to get a hold of customer service, they let you type out your issue while talking to a computer. Then the computer assistant says they understand the issue and will direct the call to a

author: Stefan Baeurle

The new photo editing process with automatic cropping and rotation and prolonged AI screen effects are not helping. I also don't like the default Ultra HDR look I can't turn off when viewing photos. It makes brighter areas (for example a sky) way too bright.

author: A Google user

It makes no sense only to have chronological sorting, that's just not how I organize my photos. I see that people have been asking for other options for a long time now, and apparently Google doesn't care . They must have better things to than spend a few days getting together an update that will facilitate those changes.

author: A Google user
content: I like it better than Flickr as you can search for pics in your collection by using random keywords like "dog" or "wine". Only thing is deleting pics also deletes the original from your phones photo album on the sd card. Assistant would be improved if you could select which features you would like it to do. IFor instance, I like animation and colour fixing but I don't want it to make movies. I don't have the ability to do this. Get these things fixed and Google Photos will be brilliant!

author: Anna McKinney
content: Wish the print store was a smaller button... it makes the interface ugly to look at. Also wish there was a way to hide the subscription options in edit, so I have to scroll less. Another annoyance, is that there's no way to switch a photo's folder location from an album. I have to go find the photo in its original folder and for older images that takes forever. Even worse when I want to move multiple from different folders. Otherwise decent, no major standouts. No bugs found.

author: Ivan Krolo
content: I wish Google would stop copying Instagram's awful navigation style to your other applications. We've all been trained for years to pinch zoom, to click and see a scrollbar during videos, etc. What's happening now with Photos and even YouTube stories is completely confusing to navigate as portions of the application behave differently.

author: Tanjer Miah

Now because it's gotten rid of them off my phone, I can't find any picture that I need to look for. I'll have to search endlessly. Don't know what Google were thinking.

author: María Mercedes Alvarez Vellaz

author: Angela Foster
content: Backs up my photos, I use it daily for that. Unfortunately new app design makes it harder to search for, edit or do anything with those photos anymore. Used to be so simple to search for any photo you had taken in the last few years with a couple of clicks. Now takes much longer, much less intuitive

Being able to download a photo and then easily find it in the downloads is useful for uploading photos to a different app.

author: rmp5s

author: Luis Jarquin
content: It's not bad, it's just that it's really irritating to have them always wanting to buy more storage, they offer any option that will make you pay, and that's a true pain in the 🍑. Then, there's the fact that sometimes, I would like to simply be able to rotate the image without having to edit it. I would also like a better UI, it's hard to navigate through this app, when I finally get used to the new and confusing interface, they change, they LOVE changing the app, switching key elements.notcool

author: A Google user
content: Assistant doesn't work right in many situations. App hangs up while creating movie, WiFi repeatedly disconnects, can't select photos or movies from shared albums. Spend 90+ minutes and it still didn't create the video. 2 hours later, finally after selecting only still shots, it worked to create the movie. It used to work great!

author: A Google user
content: What is up with the ai that automatically catagorizes photos? If it did that but also kept a copy of my original camera album thatd be fine, but now only the unsorted leftovers are in my phone gallery. Worst bit is I cant manually move them back over? My camera folder is pretty useless now. It also keeps grouping my face with jjba faces and thats bullying However if youre stubborn like me (and willing to resort)- great storage. Very easy to keep my desktop and phone updated with the same photos.

author: Cheryl Gallagher
content: I used to be able to select many photos at a time in Photos for albums but now I have to go to Utilities & select each photo individually which takes a lot of time. Then I have to do it all over again to archive them. Please go back to the more efficient method or correct this combersome feature. Thanks.

author: A Google user
content: This could be such a great app if the functionality offered in the US was available here in the UK. Everyone I go to 'Albums' I see a brief vanishing 'People' folder reminding me that I can't tag my family over here. The live albums with this on the new Home Hub sounded really good though unfortunately it looks like this is another of Google's many features/services that won't make it to the UK. Depressing.

author: Mrs. Monestime
content: I love the platform and all of it's features I just wish they'd allow you more options to categorize and edit photos yourself. Like if I create a collage I want to be able to arrange the photos or center them better than the auto generated collage that will not allow me to reposiston the photo. The facial recognition only allows the system to pick faces but will not allow you to identify a person in a photo so that it will show in that individuals folder. But other than that I think it's 👍🏽.

author: mausdeer
content: I loved Google Photos, and actually still do since I have a Pixel 4a and unlimited free storage. However, when I have to replace my 4a I'll have to stop using Google Photos, too, because 15GB of free storage is nothing (I take lots of photos) and the paid options are too expensive for me. Plus there isn't even an unlimited option available, which I would need. So, I'll enjoy Photos as long as possible with my 4a. I know I'm going to be very sad when I have to quit using it; it's really great!

author: Catherine
content: The new update is terrible IMO. I used to love it. But as of last week: Editing photos is no longer intuitive, some edits don't work at all, the changes you make don't end up on the photos, now most edits are 'saved as copy' and you can't just tweak a photo.... Have looked up how to revert back to the last version, everything I've found has not led me to a solution. I'll check back here hopefully Google will advise me?!

author: Fatima Zahra Tillah
content: Note to developer: No, it does not want to resize smaller. Of course I already tried that. I wouldn't be writing here if I didn't already try that. // I removed my previous 2x1 People and Pets widget because I wanted to display pics of other cats aside from my own. But when I went and placed the widget again, it didn't want to take up a 2x1 tile, only a 2x2 tile at most. It looks weird because the vertical margins are too big and don't fit snugly as it previously did...

author: A Google user
content: The biggest fault is in security. I would like to be able to hand my phone over to a friend or relative without concern for my photos album being so accessible, even to those who stole and unlocked my phone. The app itself should have a lock of its own so we don't have to rely on third party software. There should be layers of security for stuff like that. Literally have to use a dummy account simply for those albums.

author: A Google user
content: Since the upgrade i can no longer share photos on Facebook rhe way i used to. Before i would select photos, hit share Facebook, say something and post. Now I select and photos are in an album. Only friends with the app can see them. Hope this gets put back to the way it was soon. Otherwise great.

author: Tudor Leriu
content: This application seems to me to have peaked and actively decided to get worse. The search has gotten so AI enhanced, it will recognize your face in the dark but it's incapable of searching for a file by name which is essential for my workflow. I also really wish I could tag things myself. I'm happy to teach Google if they just let me. My big goal for next year will be to find an alternative photo service to move to and fully transition away from Google and I suggest others do the same.

author: Mary B
content: Really weird quirks. On a brand new LG phone, it refuses to do markup. And when I take screenshots and download pictures I can't trust the metadata: it often sets the time of capture an hour back for no apparent reason. Also the facial recognition isn't 100% accurate and sometimes when it "sees" a certain face I can't make it "unsee" it to label it properly.

author: Cody Blue
content: A great app but missing one useful feature: Would love to just be able to see every single photo on my device (Pixel 8 Pro) without having to click on individual albums. Currently you have to click on the albums like "downloads" or "screenshots" to see those photos. I like being able to browse all photos at once.

author: Slate Fistcrunch
content: App is generally fine. Annoying things like no option to permanently disable prompts to use Google's backups. And new version now makes quick sharing of collages or edits obnoxious opportunities for them to advertise, adding "Check out my creation. Make your own with Google Photos" to every share I then need to delete.

author: Tudor V.
content: For a while now the app has had a problem where if I tap to delete a photo, it asks me for permission (allow/deny). And even though I tap Deny, the photo dissappears from Google Photos! It's very frustrating! Also, the portrait blur tool doesn't work. Like, it does its thing while editing, but when you finish and save the copy, it saves it without the blur, like you never used it. Please fix these as soon as possible!!

author: Jamie Gray
content: Great backup app for the most part. My biggest issue is that it backs up screen shots as camera photos with no easy fix. So my photos are full of temporary snippets of headlines, articles or whatever I've taken across a week/month/year. I appreciate samsung store screenshots in a subfolder in the DCIM folder but they're shown as a separate album in the native gallery? And it's not like Samsung is an uncommon brand. Big messy problem that should have a fix as it means the app is largely unusable

author: Dylan Desautels
content: I don't know why but every time I modify or delete an image it forces me to confirm with "Allow" or "deny". It never did that before and it's annoying. If I press the delete button of course I want to delete it. If I go to the trouble of modifying an image of course I want it modified. Why do I have to press "allow" Avery single time? Also it keeps messing with my built in gallery and doesn't sync automatically as it used to. Please fix.

author: Tarek Salem.
content: Unfortunately it was a good service, but i can't believe how hard it is to download all my photos to my laptop. The download keeps failing , and i can only download 500 photos a time, and i can't just choose all, i have to go and choose each day separately. It is hectic , and nothing shows what was downloaded and what was not. Why don't you make it just a little bit easier. I'll delete google photos as soon as i backup my photos to my pc. Thank you very much google, i trusted you.

author: A Google user
content: Great app. Although with the Mate 20 Pro, it would say all items backed up which they are, but the "Free Up Space" option wouldn't be available due to "backing up" and then you would have to manually remove the items. Also is there any chance of an option to create folders in Google Photos. It would contribute to a more organized layout.

author: Karlo Kamiński
content: I mainly use this app to back up photos, and there's quite a big problem with that. It does not back up photos by itself, I have to choose manually, and then it has to use my mobile data because apparently there's no WIFI. It's not the wifi, I use multiple WIFI's that work smoothly, and I don't want it to use my mobile data, especially if it needs 2GB for a 3 minute video. Please fix this problem, it's wasting my money. It worked perfectly fine until a few weeks ago. :/

author: Jared Walker (JWalkTheRunner)
content: Love and hate it. Love the app itself but does not work well with other apps. Hard to share to Instagram and other apps don't recognize that you've sorted them including the physical location. Can be very frustrating Edit for goodle: it's not a downloading issue. The pictures are already in my phone. It also doesn't allow me to "allow access" to apps like messenger or texting even though I've checked 1000x to make sure Google photos has access.

author: Robert Bowen
content: The app backs up all the pictures that I took or pictures downloaded. It also sends me movies every once in a while. It's nice to see old pictures of my kids or into a slide show! The reason for 3 stars though is that if you want to free up space in the cloud, you must delete the picture on your phone as well.

author: Andreas L
content: Many good capabilities. Just read the description to find all the good stuff. Unfortunately it eats up your storage with a hidden cache that can not be cleaned without reinstalling the app. If they add limit cache size it would be a 5star. Now I can barely give it a three since it generates so many issues for me and my family.

author: A Google user
content: look i like the app but small things about it really piss me off. im on a pixle so this app is my default gallary app. My biggest issue that it fails at the simple function of letting me share my photos. when i go on and select photos to shear on twitter or Instagram or even to texting to others, it never actually lets me. it just gives the option to shear the google photos link on those plat forms and thats it. This is extremely frustrating and waste of time, PLEASE FIX THIS.

author: Leticia Rodriguez
content: I only wish it had an option to label or tag photos to find my photos faster. I have lots of photos and it's hard to find the pictures I'm looking for. The automatic organization is good but not very effective. I even tried a link that was given to me as a reply in a review I did with another account but the link didn't work. Other than that, everything else about this app is great.

author: Ben Sallien
content: It is a serviceable app. I have no idea why I have to pay a subscription for more storage, that is the stupidest thing ever. I also should not need an internet connection to look at photos, as well as the fact that all the videos and photos I download that were taken a certain date are ordered by when they were taken, not when they were downloaded. I love my Google phone but not having the option of other first party gallery apps is quite annoying when this one is so effort inducing.

author: A Google user
content: Its a good app bit it takes up way to much time. I tried to sync se photos and it took a little over a day to finish it all. (Granted, it was about 500 pictures.) Also, whenever I use the app, it takes up all my data so I have to use wifi. But it requires so much that it slows the proccess evem further.

author: A Google user
content: Google Photos used to be great. However, I noticed that new features added in the past one or two years tend to be buggy. For example, the small iconic preview of the videos does not work properly on my phone: it often flashes, and thumbnails of one video appear on top of another. Uploading videos is also a pain: the videos are usually not ready for download on PC after uploaded from my phone. It always says the video is being processed. I had to wait for tens of minutes or hours sometimes. I don't know what Google is doing with the video upon uploaded, maybe running ML algorithms for annotations, but why prevents users from downloading it since it is already uploaded? The same issue happens if I upload a video to Google Drive. A more recent feature is showing groups of photos 1-3 years ago. When I click on one group, it automatically goes to slideshow, which is fine. However, I don't like the full screen: I keep clicking on the lower-left corner of my phone to exit it, but the "back" button is not there and the screen simply goes to the next picture. I don't know about others, but it is anti-intuitive to me.

author: Shuney Wooten
content: If there is a way to put your albums in alphabetical order why isn't it easier to figure out and if there isn't a way to put your albums in alphabetical order then why not? Insane... And why do you have to have the app opened to backup your photos? My cleaner says the app is usually always running in the background but it never uploads photos unless you open the app.... other than those issues I find the app pretty good.

author: VOX FERRORUM
content: I haven't updated this app in many years, and after reading the reviews I will continue to NOT update it. All these updates for apps when everything works just fine is unnecessary. IMO it's just Big Tek wanting to collect more and more personal information. The constant pop-up to update is annoying and unwarranted. If it ain't broke don't fix it. So FO google!!

author: Stephen Schulze (SteveDS)
content: Not the only but most annoying problem I'm still having that I used to have with photos is that some of the files end up only partially uploaded so that only a portion of the picture will be there and the rest of it is squiggly lines and broken up data basically noise so the image is totally destroyed and if it's been removed from my device as well which photos also can do to free up device space this leaves you with no copy of the original even when you have it set not to

author: David J. Huntley
content: For the most part it works fine. However, one big miss is the inability to change the stroke weight in the markup feature. The stroke weight is too heavy to write fine text. The crazy thing is that you can change the stroke weight in other apps but not this one. If they fix this it would go a long way towards it being used for more business purposes.

author: Little Fish
content: it's okay but lately I have an issue. albums in the device itself displayed through photos are not showing up in other apps and favorites are not showing up in the favorites. it's showing completely different things I haven't had in years.

author: A Google user
content: Just recently the app started having issues with cropping and rotating images. I'll click save after doing one of these two and it will just load and load for literally 15 minutes. And there's an issue with saving any videos longer than like a minute. They don't show up immediately but then suddenly appear after a half hour or so. It used to only do it with videos that were like 10+ minutes. I started noticing this all when the two new options on the far right were added when editing a picture.

author: Princess Acacia Newton
content: Frustrated because I no longer have the option to simply remove the photo from my device. When I click the three buttons in the top right corner that used to give me the option to simply remove from device it now only says something about removing clutter. I am trying to download some photos from Google photos to use for a slideshow and it keeps telling me there isn't enough room on my device, but when I click "free up space" it tells me there isn't anything to free up. So beyond frustrated!!!

author: Jennifer Thomas
content: I do like the app and I have had it for a long time. It keeps everything organized for me so I can find things easier. I don't like that it now deletes my photos from my phones gallery when I delete from the Google app. Never did that before. I also don't like that they want to charge for cloud space when it use to be free. I know it's a small fee but there is still a charge. That's what made the app good. They stood out from the others because of this. Sad they are just like the others now.

author: Amarpreet Singh
content: Updated review Changing my review from 5 to 3 stars now. Google never indicated that photos storage will be limited. Other things were (drive, Gmail etc). And we learned to live with it. We also learned to live with the fact that photos storage is unaccounted for. Made us addicted. Then suddenly dropped the bomb. Review from 3 yrs back (below) Everything is so good about Google. Unlimited storage, animations, past memories. These are just few of many that makes my photos collection complete.

author: Corrie Wagner
content: Longtime Google Photos user and advocate. However, this recent update has essentially hidden shared albums, unless you know the name and are able to articulate it in the search bar. I'm all for simplifying, but then default to showing all albums in library! I'm not even sure how many albums just disappeared into thin air on me :(

author: Jason “JayMastaJay” Lehrbaum
content: Simply do not understand how when you edit a photo, it takes it completely out of order of all the other photos. The fact that you do not have the ability to save, only save as, is ridiculous. Give me the choice to override the existing photo with the new one and have it appear in the same order it already was in. Whenever I try to create a Facebook album after editing a bunch of photos I have to remember what order they came in because you guys take them out of order.

author: Jewels Sylva
content: After the 🐝s is my 2015 why I wasn't getting any updates. Today, 7/2022, I am getting the current app update we'll see🐝🐝🐝🐝🐝I'm afraid to get the update ... People tell me that they lost photos (like old vacation pics). Someone mentioned that they can't find their screen shots. A lot of folks say that the update has limited editing tools. What the heck?

author: Kate N
content: probably ok for people who like taking photos and never sort them (never look at them afterwards either). because while storing feature is good, organizing is almost non-existing: no tags, no nested albums, no any kind of categories. you are supposed to create separate albums for everything - that is, dozens and dozens of them, and them there is no way to organize the albums. just scroll through the chaos. (not to mention the untidy look of each album and no option for square tiles)

author: Rick Lesser
content: update July 24. I'm having issues with my s23 samsung photo app. Photos seem to disappear sometimes reappear. It's quite annoying, a lot of time the photos are work-related. Even organized. Yesterday I realized i'm missing about 175 pics. I thought I could count on google photos for my backup. Apparently the google app and the samsung app are in cahoots together! There are. More photos in Google than in Samsung. But come on, this is getting to be ridiculous.

author: Adrian Monge
content: I have been using Google Photos since the first time i bought my phone (Samsung A10), and it has been working great. However, with the new update where you can store your photos in a Locked Folder (which i think is a good idea), when I try to move a photo or video it loads for a little bit and then it closes the app. I dont understand why it does this and I would really want this to be fixed Thanks!

author: A Google user
content: It used to work great, but as of the last few months it doesn't edit photos in any way well. It looks like it will,until I try to save the photo with the edited changes,and then it just keeps spinning and doesn't show the change for over a half an hour, sometimes I have to restart or completely turn off my phone and then turn it back on in order to view the updated version of the picture with the completed edit.

author: Shannon Bailey
content: It's very convenient having your photos backed up to a cloud....when it works that is. I don't like the fact that Google is grouping older photos together not based on the time they were taken, so I'm having to sort thru 10,000 photos searching for one I took in December 2015. But when you lose your phone or important pics it's nice finding them safely in the cloud. Or maddening when you don't. It's odd that all my pics get uploaded except the very one I'm looking for. Very odd.

author: Randy Batista Rodriguez
content: The app is not as fast in syncing as the iOS Google Photos app. When photos uploading there is no way to know which pic is being uploaded at that same time (iOS app does). There is no widget on Android, the widget on the iOS Google Photos app is amazing with your stories changing. Please can we have those features on Android as well. Thanks.

author: Alan Jarzynka
content: not happy with the constant updates ! cause you think it's an improvement , doesn't mean I like it or need it or have to use it ! can't get rid of 'collections', which i don't want or need ! you send my photos to the cloud , again , didn't ask for it , don't want it ! glad you think you're so smart and think you know what I want ! ! this Samsung A15 sucks. I just want a basic phone , basic usable apps ! !

author: Steve Moddelmog
content: Really, really wish this app would quit telling me to "complete setup" by turning on notifications. I am not an idiot - I know how to turn on notifications if I want them. I don't want notifications from the app. I guess I will be pestered the rest of my life to turn on notifications.

author: Jaime Suárez
content: Edit: Please enable an option to turn off HDR viewing. It makes watching photos in dark environments uncomfortable and makes the dark spots in my photos look even darker with less detail. The best solution yet to store, backup, manage, edit and share your whole photo library.

author: Rosie Bubbles
content: Works okay for a backup, I wish I could download multiple images at once to my new phone, it sucks having to do one at a time. Also wish I could search for images better, the labels are usually useless. Overall it works okay as a backup, not my favorite in general for a photo app but it's better than nothing and works with my laptop. 🤷🏻‍♀️

author: A Google user
content: There's one thing about how sharing is handled annoys me. When I share one  photo (initiated within the Photo app, via SMS), it immediately creates an  album. I end up with countless albums with only a single photo in them. Update Feb 18, 2019 Why has movie making become so difficult? First, the ability to add title to the movie is gone. Second, the ability to add filter to the movie is gone.

author: Eric P
content: July 11 update changed where you can pause a video. Used to be in the center of a video (anywhere) but now you have to tap exactly in the lower left corner just above the video timeline. This is inconsistent with how youtube works. Also don't like how cropping photos changed. It used to be that the app would zoom in somewhat and you could crop from a side. Now you have to crop from a corner. Everything else about the app works as expected in terms of backup and under what conditions to backup.

author: Alex Laut
content: Google photos ai is pretty amazing and it's convenient how it can efficiently clean up you device once photos are backed up, but there doesn't seem to be an option for offline except I guess by offlining the Google photos folder in Google drive but then you lose the organization of albums and so forth. It's a pretty big shortfall.

author: Lori-Anne Fay
content: It's a CRIME they messed with the super easy go to sliders, for editing your photos! Now if I want to edit in an app, I default straight to Tool Wiz. And NO I don't want your AI to creatively think for me! I'll enhance my own personal Photos Thank you very little. If you wanted to change it try adding a new secondary option, rather than ignoring the adage "if it ain't broke, don't fix it. The rest of the app is okay still.

author: Juan Céspedes
content: This has always been one of the best pictures app ever. However, it is *very* slow in Android 11, and some times it gets stuck, waiting forever just to show the pictures I have just taken, or in "Setting up your photo library" or "Preparing for back-up". None of the usual "fixes" (clearing data, restarting, etc) work to fix this.

author: Bianca
content: I use Photos on a daily basis, having the Library be replaced by "Collections" was one of the worst changes so far. Not only it's an extra unnecessary tap, but we don't even get to have a rail to scroll, like before. It's a nightmare when you have plenty of albums. Is there really no way to roll back to the old UI?

author: Julie Konkol
content: Do not ship photos. I have been using this app for many years and love it, I have also sent pictured to local stores to be printed and it went perfect. However, this time I decided to ship to home. Wow, what a mistake. I have been waiting and waiting. They have been scanned in 8 days and when I tried to reach out to Google to get more info I was told it would be a while.

author: A Google user
content: I like the automated features like generated a video album of your journey or birthday. Does the job and does it well. Update 2 years later. Ive dropped a star because getting support for this app is impossible. I've also hit problems where photos aren't backing up and are stuck 'uploading'. Restarting my phone doesn't help, neither does clearing the application cache, nor can i uninstall the app as it came as part of the Google Pixel 2 (so i can't uninstall & reinstall to see if that helps).

author: A Google user
content: Very nice app works well. I preferred when their was a choice to upload photos only when phone was charging. It gave a chance to delete all the bad pictures before the upload. The new update does not allow photos to be deleted from my phone SD card, this is a pain in the ass and needs to be remedied.

author: A Google user
content: Used to be great. There used to be an option to only back up on wifi amd/or when plugged in. It appears one of the more recent updates has changed that though, because it is draining my battery like crazy trying to sync ohotos from a redent trip and when i explored the settings to try and pause it, that option is no longer there. One of the recent updates also changed how photos are edited so that a new image is created and saved in an additional folder & when browsing both copies show up. -.-

author: Steven Ward
content: The only reason for the missing fifth star is the automatic delete from the phone. If I take a picture, I do not want it to be saved in Google photos for work or something. I do want to have to try, and immediately move it to a non-synced folder so it won't upload to Google photo. I should be able to have separate photos on my phone and memories. please give us an option for this?

author: A Google user
content: Feature is good but sometime standard photo quality gets worse. Also color pop n some other suggestion are not working fully. I got many suggestion for color pop but many times color are still visible and half photo is done grayscale. Also auto suggestion is working only when you upload mass photo of single place or same person in one style. For random photos it is not able to suggest various auto edited features like color pop, stylised photo. Need more improvement in AI feature.

author: A Google user
content: Needs to mature. Cons: Places album doesn't work. Sort is supposed to be by date taken but the App order photos in its own unknown way. Little to none customizable. Pros: Big free space. Powerful edit capabilities. It's not necessary to waste the precious phone space, like iCloud or OneDrive. Intuitive like in "photo App for dummies" Update: after 1 week at least, places gather enough info to show some photos.

author: S Ranjan Patnaik
content: The best available app on play store.. the only issue that I have is, free up space does not always clear the photos from the gallery. It leaves some photos. At times it's really confusing whether they are backed-up or not. I have experienced this with many phones. Please work on this and rectify. Thank you

author: Ralph Mendoza
content: Great back up for cell phone and for Google plus photos. Enjoy the memories as well Update: the app has become hard to navigate. I got a notification of a memory and can't find a way to access it. They've layered menu options on top of each other and forgot about the user

author: A Google user
content: I think Google Photos does a great job in backuping your photos. I just had a one bad experience with this. One time I lost all of my photos both here in google photos and my mobile device when it recommended me to free up space. I am not sure why it deleted the photos. But overall it is great for backup and on the go. I recommend it if you have limited space since it is working just becareful with the option free up some space... it might cause you your photos. Also you can share library with o

author: Dawn Hughes
content: I recently went to a Google Pixel from a Samsung and man, the Gallery on the Samsung beats Google photos in organization hands down! My pictures are a hot mess of frustration! The editing features are great, except I miss being able to make gifs, otherwise it's good. I wish I could add photos to albums and have them stay in alphabetical order as I'm adding them and not have them be in random freaking order every time. It's literally the only reason I rate this so low.

author: A.P.Dr. Siriyakornrat Siri
content: To be honest, we use Google Photo to store personal photos that are not as accurate as the situation, haha. We understand that some images have issues loading full of portraits and profiles. I don't want to make a reservation. it has no storage Service fee, we understand. Keep improving. Thank you.

author: Ellie Martinson
content: EDIT: I can now see all my photos in 1 place, but still can't prevent albums from being created against my will. Not enough autonomy. I'd like to be able to organize my photos on my own terms, but Google photos does not allow me to do so. Photos are automatically sorted into screenshots, messages, camera, etc. and there is no way around it.

author: A Google user
content: I like and hate the app. I like that it auto downloads all my stuff and gives me suggestions and stuff. I hate that it seems impossible to organize my photos and that I cant detect duplicates on it. I've been trying to organize my photos but I have over 10000 and if I cant move photos between albums or I wont know if I accidentally forgot to select a photo. I LOVE Google! but I hope they make some helpful upgrades to this app.

author: Linda Richards
content: I wish they'd STOP updated how things are laid out in the app ALL the time, every update. I mean at least every couple months, I turn around, and can't find anything. What used to take 1-2 clicks, now take 4-5. Nothing is arranged the way I had it, it just sucks. IF IT AIN'T BROKE, STOP FIXING IT!!!

author: A Google user
content: I use Google Photos a lot in everyday use. I do wish they would create an option for reviewing duplicate photos. I have a LOT of older photos and don't always remember what day they were taken on. It would be nice to upload them and Google Photos scan the others to make sure I am not readding them. This takes up way to much room and is a time consuming task when I have time to go through them. I would greatly appreciate a duplicate photos option. If there is one added, I would change me review.

author: Jacque Miller (JayQ)
content: Can we please get some more control of facial tags for both photos and videos? Seems like a huge drop of the ball to have this feature but not allow us to correct it when it tags the wrong people or doesn't have a tag at all, especially when a face is clearly shown. Again, this goes for both photos and videos.

author: Eathan D.
content: There are to many additional storage files for the entirety of my photos. Such as Trash, Archive, camera roll, individual albums, and having several accounts that I use frequently causes some to be backed up and some not. Ultimately the interface is just to cluttered to use on a cellular device comfortably. For myself anyway.

author: A Google user
content: Works fairly well. The Auto backup should work more automatically. author: lynn

I suggest the devs to focus more on optimising its core functionality rather than extras like automatic photo collages or animations (which is not why people download this app for).

author: A Google user
content: The collage options are fairly limited. Not like the digital photo book creation programs which offer stylish options for creating an album before having it printed into book form. Also, I truly hate the lack of organising the photos like you can do in the computer, in the form of folders. It should be easy for Google to scan all the folders, and still offer all the options it has now to offer for bulk overview, and auto organising, recognition of faces and items, auto collage and auto animation etc. But at least, we should be able to organise our photos in folders and not only in the form of albums. For this reason, it will never become my favourite. Countless people complain about this missing option to organise, but still, the developers seem to refuse to include this simple option. Why? Why they want to force everybody to like their idea? People who don't like to organise, will never use folders and simply upload everything in a bulk folder. But those that make countless photos or use photos in a professional manner, like to organise them. Look more at Adobe Lightroom for editing, tagging and countless ways of organising them, or making collections and collages. Don't try to reinvent the wheel in a market or business, which you have no professional clue about. You had a product that was much better. Picasa was an obvious clone / copy of Lightroom, but for some strange reason have you discontinued it. Also, I think you should offer way more digital editing options. If there can be online Photoshop and Lightroom, or variants than resemble them very closely, then you can do much better in what you offer now. Google Photos is nice, but it can be MUCH MUCH better than it is now. It still has a long way to go before it is really the perfect online backup and editing tool and will become everyone's preferred choice. Who knows they are listening and reading the comments and will try to become exactly that.

author: Scott Schlimmer

The memories tab is now chucked away in the meaningless collections section. It used to be much better. Face recognition sucks too.

author: Robyn
content: There was a time where I would have given this app 10 ⭐'s or more. However, it seems with the recent updates, it no longer saves all of my pictures like it used to. It's seems like it picks and chooses which ones it should keep. I thought it was perfect the it was, I used to recommend it to EVERYONE, even set it up on several of my friend's phones. I won't be pushing it as much as before.

author: A Google user
content: The functionality of this app is terrible. nothing stays in albums and finding functions like archiving are near impossible unless you know where to look. you can search for backed up photos but not by their album name, which kinda makes that feature impossible.. this app is more for photo books and collages than organization which sucks cause its the only one that links well with google drive.

author: A Google user
content: It's just confusing and scattered. I feel like my pictures are in so many places and I'd love to organize them into folders on my phone but instead they just go into albums but still stay in one long endless roll of pictures. Needs better organization.

author: Saad Sheikh
content: 1: An editing feature, that can be used to add black bars to a picture, so the picture can be shaped as a square is needed (I have to use Snapseed just for this). 2: The highlights feature is annoying and unnecessary. We should be able yo disbale it. 3: There is no way to download multiple photos or videos. You have to download each photo or video separately.

author: Diego del Yerro
content: It is a good tool but it has some things to tweak, like free up space not working, using mobile data even when you tick "no" or not having smart filters of what types of photos to backup. It is probably the best there is for android but could be better. Searching does work really well and that makes the app worth it.

author: Lata Tiwari
content: Well everything else is fine and more than good. Categorising, organizing, editing. Don't mind Google reading metadata of photo but reading a whole image is a different level. I don't want Google to read my images pixel by pixel. Feature might be nice, you can differentiate a meme from a document but that kinda not secure and a breach to privacy. You are a hoarder Google.

author: Colleen S
content: I used to love Google photos, but every time I do something , I always have to upgrade storage from $2.00 to $21.30/month now. I let it go, of course. And when I delete photos from my phone, I have to go to storage & delete them like 5xs over. It's so annoying & sad that they want to charge that much. But do love the print option & I will do that.

author: Flora Worley
content: Google Lens absolutely ruins the experience of using this app, and there seems to no longer be any way to remove it. It's also totally unclear how one could remove individual or groups of photos (not the entire library) from device storage without also deleting backups in the cloud. Seems...basic? Finally, the filters in the editor are junk and I no longer see the 'blur background" option.

author: A Google user
content: I love how it has "suggested" items like an animation video out of one of my videos, but don't like how I can't do that myself and edit which part of the video is looped or whatever else. Also the collages are cool and all but can't edit that either. Or change it in any way. Also seen a "suggested" photo where everything was black&white besides one item. I can't figure out how to do any of these neat things to my pictures or videos only the ones that Google Photo randomly pick. Please fix!!

author: Nick Noyce
content: Functionality seems to be going backwards.. I have to use the Web browser to see auto creations now, if i edit a photo i want to just save the edits not have to save a copy to have to delete the original, would be really helpful to be able to edit direct from an album, i usually add all the best photos and then would be great to be able to edit them direct from the selection I have made to auto adjust lighting etc...

author: Phil Ward
content: After roughly 15 years of development on the app, it still has no idea how to properly orient a photo. Especially with Text. Lens can OCR the $#!* out of text from an image but figuring out how to orient from a top down? Forget it. Also, zero effort put into the Text Markup. It could be an amazing tool but gimmick "AI" filters are more important.

author: Raito
content: It's an okay app. Not bad, not good, just in the middle. You guys should probably add a way to see the percentage in number of you uploading every each single and overall photos to the back up. It will be very useful since as I don't know what percentage at it is when uploading my photo, whether it's actually uploading or not uploading. I hope you guys actually add it. Cheers

author: A Google user
content: Lack of default/user created category options and a basic navigation are a big flaw. I would like the app to open either to a default pictures taken by camera page or a navigational screen that allows me to chose what I want to see next or maybe a simple setup that allows me to choose what is initially visible each time I open the app. I may not want all my photos or videos visible as soon as I open the app and I would like to determine what is initially seen upon opening the app.

author: Nicholas Indoril
content: Used to be free storage unlimited and that was enough for me but that was in.... old times now we pay.... restricted a lot. Now crashing a lot, and many photos of mine have wrong dates.... I have lost my archive this way.... thought I could keep my media organized...but the get wrong dates.... why??? Looking for alternative.... I think I pay for nothing....

author: Joy Rodriguez
content: I was okay with the app. It did a decent job at first of backing up all my photos. I deleted my Facebook and needed somewhere to store all of my memories. My biggest mistake was fully trusting this app and not saving my photos anywhere else. Some photos from my daughter's birth just randomly disappeared as well as other important photos. 80% of my photos are still all there but I am pretty sad that the rest are just gone now. Probably should have just kept my Facebook.

author: A Google user
content: Really needs some work by Google to bugfix. Sometimes it stops working and refuses to upload files. Sometimes adding files to an album doesn't work. Sometimes deleting files doesn't work and the app retains duplicates. I'm having to reinstall the app every week to make it behave.

author: Nikolay Matusov
content: Showing all photos older than a year under the wrong date. Update: After going to Contact Developer I've got email response - "You have emailed to an address that is no longer being monitored." And this is the app that is getting updated regularly! 🤔 Update 2: After few hours the application started showing proper dates, without any updates or changes. Not sure what was it, but the whole ordeal with inability to submit issue and a bunch of wasted time makes me very uncomfortable with Google. ☹

author: David Lobsien
content: Its fine for photos. But everytime I try to send more than 3 photos, the app crashes. Then it says I need to make up space and delete photos. Are you seriously trying to tell me that the same app thats BEGGING me to relieve space, when I only used up 66% of my 15GB storage, is the same app that can't fathom the idea of numbers after 3?????

author: Sara Gates
content: I loved the previous version of this app. Loved, past tense, but 5 stars worth. Now I have difficulty finding things in the new version and no time to commit to finding the things I'm looking for as kids and real life are more important than investigating an app that was previously easy to navigate. I could have kept the old version but would have had to tolerate the harassing reminder to update every. single. time. I opened the app. 3 stars with the hope that next version is better 😄

author: Wanda Maximoff
content: Very good app for photos but when i try to open some important school work, my screen hangs and the photo doe not open. Same with the screenshots, when i try to open them my screen hangs and they do not open. If this problem would not have been there, I would give this a five star rating. And also, google services, when i am trying to update this app it is telling " could not update the app. If the problem still continues send a feedback in the app". So please if you can fix this, pleas fix it.

author: Richard May
content: The old Gallery is easier to use than this. Things like when I take a picture with my phone horizontal but it stayed in vertical? I go to rotate the picture but there's no button to rotate it. Other times when that happens it pops up with a suggestion if I want to rotate it. Then I use the pictures for a grocery list and as I put the items in my cart I delete the picture. This app won't let me do that. I have to go back to where the picture was first and delete it there. Old app you could sel

author: Dalai Dolly
content: No better or worse than the .multitude of platforms out there. I just suspect Google is more adept at collecting, syncing , selling and using me to the advantage of everyone but me. Free convenience at a price we cant e an guess. Pretty sick of it....in case you couldn't tell.

author: Sultan Mia
content: The previous editing menu was far better than this one in the updated version. In the previous editing menu you could access all the tools as a bunch that made editing time saving. For example under light menu we could access all the sub tools at a time. But in the updated menu you need to access tools one by one that's really annoying and time killing. I hope Google will reconsider it.

author: A Google user
content: I have concern regarding the improvement of this app. 1. Kindly have an option which to delete and not to delete photos in my mobile device when I click back-up or free up some space. 2. Kindly add more options in mobile app when inside the album while marking multiple item. Helpful options are add to other album, move to trash, etc. These are available in desktop website but not android application 3. Almost the same as number 2. Add more options in multiple marked items when inside the shared

author: Gary
content: The most recent update made it harder, not easier, to edit. Change it back to having one edge move at a time when to crop. And take away the rounded corners for cropping. That makes no sense. You can't tell where the edges are. And, place ALL the adjustments back into the same section. There's no need to divide them into lighting, actions, and color. It just makes it confusing to know which adjustment is where.

author: A Google user
content: Latest updates rendered the common task of cropping non-intuitive to unusable. The cropping tool has been buried deeply as an "extension" that must be added--and the only one apparently available. The cropping is only of each corner independently. Aligned vertical or horizontal cropping does not appear to be available. This is a deal breaker for the built in photo capabilities of the pixel.

author: swati kadvadkar
content: The app is good but only the thing I noticed is that I have saved all my photos and when I changed my phone I saw that many of my photos were deleted automatically. Inspite of saving photos in Google if it is getting deleted then what is the use of using it. Rest I don't have any issues. Please look into it.

author: A Google user
content: The animations are jittery. I wish I could swipe down to close a picture even when zoomed in. It's weird that some photos aren't showing up but when I visit the web version it's there, same goes for the iPhone app. I wish there's a thumbnail panel at the bottom like f-stop I wish I could create nested albums

author: A Google user
content: Don't need to worry about losing photos anymore. Still lacks a lot of essential filing/organizing features. A clear indicator whether you have backed up the 'Original' or 'High-res' (which could be lower-res than original!) would also be useful.

author: Si Doots
content: It used to be really good, then something changed and it's a bit naff, the assistant that would stylise and make collages and animations doesn't do it as often and when it does they disappear, also the navigation is not as good all the interesting stuff is hidden, when you open Google photos it doesn't offer anything that I don't already get in my phones stock gallery app, so there's no additional value in using Google photos

author: Joshua S
content: Photos pairs really well with the Pixel 7 and the features are really cool. However, as someone who likes to take pictures and to have freedom with the pictures I take, Google makes that a rather significant challenge, especially compared to the competition. The device's camera is pretty much the only consideration I make when purchasing a phone. I don't care for Googles storage, which can be turned off, but Pixel 7 is so in-your-face about unwanted storage, it's maddening.

author: November Star
content: I love this app! Hate the -forced- organization. Prefer my own folders/categories & to be able to save to without permanently losing pic if I delete the root pic. The ridgid pre-structure is frustrating, an old school choose "drive" & create folder method would be more appreciated. Current is overwhelming with over population and losses when reorganizing & dont remember which is root pic 🙄🙄🙄🙄 Better pic editing/altering would be nice too.. I loved my Note 5 for editing over any photoshope 🥰

author: Abdul Shakoor
content: Edit: Ok, it's no longer free so one star off. Another star off because you can't sort your videos in order of file size or video length, which is a ridiculously basic feature that simply must be an option. Is it a way to make me pay more for my subscription because deleting junk videos that automatically get backed up is impossible? Quite likely. Original review: Possibly the best App / service ever provided. Free unlimited photo storage...are you kidding me?

author: A Google user
content: Decent but could do better. The limited editing abilities are enough unless you need more than the basics. Where the app lacks is in its poor sorting options, only alowing to sort by time. This can result in very unweildly photo albums of endless scrolling through lines with only 1 photo on each.

author: Melisa Nichols
content: I have enjoyed using the app, but now it won't save my videos after I stabilize them. It says there is a bug. This is the message I get: "Something went wrong with Photos Photos closed because this app has a bug. Try updating this app after its developer provides a fix for this error." My samsung phone also just suggested that I put Google photos in deep sleep because of frequent crashes. Is there a fix?

author: Jonathan Bates
content: I've been a fan & 5 star reviewer of Google Photos since it was named Picasa. But after more than a year of neglect from Google & unfixed bugs that only multiply, 3 stars is too generous. Google photos is unstable, crashes constantly on Mac/iOS, and if you sync photos from more than one source, rampant duplicate photo imports clog the library: it's useless. Google always replies "duplicates are detected & never reimported". My dupe-ridden library shows otherwise. Shut it down, or fix it. Now.

author: Danielle Turner
content: Alright.... I really wanted to give the app 5 stars but some things have to stop and be added. First off I really wish there was a choose all button that would be extremely helpful especially if you could do it by date. And if there was the option to download if you choosem ore that 1 picture it's such a hassle to click every photo I want, put them in an album and then scroll through, swipe up on each one and press the download button. And what's even worse is that I have to wait for it to downl

author: Pierre Swartenbroekx
content: Hi, I have been using Google Photos since years to my satisfaction. I now have to update it, but I cannot and the system keeps repeating: "error on our side, sorry!" For info, I have a Samsung A2 Core, but I cannot specify it to the system. For info also I am paying my due share every month, and I would appreciate that this issue get fixed ASAP!

author: Hadiya Naz
content: There are many features for finding the pictures you are looking for, except when you want to identify blurred pictures that are synced by mistake. I wish we could search for it aswell and delete it to make more space on the drive. But I guess that's their tactic in making people buy more space

author: Agang Kanyane
content: Well for me everything is fine, but the problem comes to the editing part. When select a photo and hit the edit button, the photo is viewed for only few seconds and disappears. This makes it impossible for me edit a photo, since it can't be seen. I hope there's a solution for this.

author: Ben Arneault
content: It's meh. I only use this when editing photos on my Pixel 5 and why I give it 3 stars instead of 2 or 1. (Seriously, the editing with portraits is almost magic) But as a main gallery app it's terrible. Looking for pictures and videos on different folders is a nightmare. Definitely needs work. I prefer using Simple Gallery when looking at photos and videos.

author: Vladimir Stepanov
content: July 2025: changed the UI, and it's awful. Cropping next to impossible. Easy filters that I've been so used to are now gone. EDIT Oct 2025: * Filters somewhat got back, although i can only save a copy after applying them, so useless * Cropping — still unusable: can't do it precisely, and even if somehow i do — can't move it without breaking the frame * Some of the photos stacked together despite the fact it's prohibited in settings — AND now i can't unstack them!!

author: A Google user
content: Used to be a 5-stars perfect app. Now barely a 3-stars app after the redesign update. The Search page which has some the old 'For You' functionality is way cluttered now. Google basically condensed too many things into one tab, all to save a tab. Really now? Who thought that was a good idea? Also I don't find the redesign 'cute' in any way. It looks like it is designed for kids to use.

author: Everything's 19 (The Shepherd)
content: You know, this app was working wonderfully up until the recent update. I love editing and touching up my photos and videos, I now have a Good phone! with a macro cam, the app was awesome and I was lovin it. But lately creating links to videos has been horribly slow and I've had to just exit out of the app because it won't let me cancel. This has happened a few times now, also, after taking pics the app/camera froze, wouldn't let me back out so I keep exiting out and the pics don't show up...!?!

author: Ali Ducharme
content: Consistently for past several months, there's been 23 photo items needing to be backed up, yet never do! This used to backup in the background, but now it doesn't & hasn't for quite some time, not even when in task manager! Please fix this, as it's become quite the hassle! When you do, this will return to 5*

author: Allan lisowski
content: I approached Google to make for less updates and changes this app. Have lost approx 1/3 of my photos because of this. The reply was I had to jump thru a bunch of hoops to disable updating. Why aren't we just given an option in the app to do so as I am done feeding Google info as they capture more than enough on the sly of it as it is. I guess the most realistic option is to drop some or all of Google apps. I am fed up with constant changes that for the most part just create more inconveniences.

author: Tom W. H. IV James
content: Maybe this is a way to make sure that they collect all of the money they can. Those of us who have been & still are should be given free upgrades. That proves that Time spent helps everyone. With the older phones that I had. Beautiful. However, as the phones upgraded the services you got did not. How are we going to give the grade of excellent when options that would keep everything connected & in SYNC would help with the needs that are needed open to us? Do this to show what you're all about.

author: Leonardo Crespim
content: Like it in general but it takes all your storage. It is web based and it is using 4GB+ of my phone storage. Clearing cache will not solve. There is no way to limit this usage of my phone storage like in iOS. I upload the photos so I can reduce the amount of storage in my device still accessing them, but this app does not solve this problem. This is a long time issue not solved yet.

author: Dominique Joly
content: Some great tools/options, but missing other essential stuff. As an example, I sort all my pictures on my phone in different folders (some are automatic like "screenshots" and "downloads", others I create myself), as I don't backup *all* my images. BUT stupid Google photos doesn't backup the folders, only bunches everything together, so I then have to go in and re-create all my folders and categories as "albums". Ok fine, the face recognition is fun to use, but I'd trade it for folder synching.

author: Ben
content: It gets the job done and integrates seamlessly with the web version of Google Photo. However, they recently replaced "Library" with "Collections" which makes it hard to find things. With Library you'd everything in one place. but now with "Collections" it's all hidden down another layer inside "On this device". I guess they want to strongly delineate between what is backed up and not. I prefered the old "Library" flattened structure with the ❌☁️ icon indicating what's not backed up.

author: A Google user
content: All good except one thing! You can't tell the app to exclude certain folders from the "device folders" list (I'm specifically talking about the folders being visible within the app, and NOT the backup & sync option). Consequently, if you have album art in your music folders, they unnecessarily clutter up the "device folders" list. Please fix this!

author: KM
content: Wow, the movie editing is painful! :/ I ascertained that most video programs on Play weren't awesome and, don't get me wrong, I'm appreciative that there is a movie editor but trying to sync the audio was just No. I'd try to slide the time bar but that's too similar to the motion for selecting the entire section. So I'd just spend a few minutes tapping fruitlessly until the Editing Gods smiled upon me. Needs some work. But gets the job done eventually. Not everyone has the patience though.

author: Yep
content: I don't know any other storage app so I can't compare. But this app+website has one problem that's vital; you can't sort photos into folders and archive them at same time. That is absurd in 2023, managing my 100gb of pictures here is literally impossible. If you mark a hundred pictures that are not in perfect order and add to folder, I then have to find the same 100 and add to archive.. It can so easily be added with some coding, how is this still not a function?

author: A Google user
content: Backing up unlimited photos, having a history of all photos on cloud, with reminder of tossing already stored photos to save space locally on drive, and sharing with a partner is great. however having annoying repetitive bugs and slow processing of the automated backup search. ("getting photos ready for backup") goes on forever sometimes. its a bug when you have images on your SD card that have the same folder name as your default stored photo foldername. as well unknown reasons.

author: Nihal Mahay
content: Overall this is a really good app. The only problem I have is that when I put a name on people in collections, people who look nothing like that person go on that person's section. This is really frustrating looking back at the pictures in memories and the random people that aren't the person I named keep showing up.

author: A Google user
content: While uploading pics to gdrive (via mobile data) from this app, even after upload completes, it continues to show as "Uploading" in the notifications pannel. There is no way to stop it. Also, while uploading multiple images, there is no way to stop the upload in case u dont want to upload.

author: Sue
content: I've loved using this app for many years now, & rarely had many problems with it on all my devices. However I appose the changes with the storage on photos & vids. I agree with another commenter ( Joseph Lee) continue to offer free unlimited storage with photos at a reduced/ compressed quality format. Makes sense to me Google!.

author: Melissa Caton
content: This app is amazing! I love all the free features!❣️ I recommend using this for means of a Baby book! It keeps track of everything for you and has amazing animation features! Plus I don't have to buy more space in my phone, I have the Google cloud! Best App ever! Edit*** After using for a couple years, the terms keep changing, what used to be free is no longer, and no one is "grandfathered". Sadly I may be looking for a new app❣️

author: Wray Smallwood
content: An annoying bug found recently. Info in shared photos is not updated when you swipe through them. If you go back to the overall view, then back to the photo, it is updated. This occurs on both the web view and viewing them within the app. Result: info does not match the photo you are looking at.

author: Juan Pedro Mariano
content: After forcibly logging me out due to an out of date app, the settings seem to have been reset. I had to manually turn on backup on each of my device's albums all over again. I just hope that doesn't inadvertently eat up more space now that the unlimited storage option has been taken out. The archive option also glitches since the pics I just archived shows up again. Not great Google

author: Frank Top
content: Gonna have to adjust my review score downwards. I seem to remember there being a download button in the top right corner when selecting multiple images. No such thing now. So if you want to save multiple images you have to individually select "save to device" on each of them. Bad design!

author: Dawn White
content: Don't always know where things are. When I go to photos from another app they are not in the album's I put them in or not all albums are visible. I don't like that Google has changed their unlimited to being limited because now I miss shots due to needing to delete photos. Loved my Google before this limit, not sure I'll stay loyal, we have 5 pixels on our account!

author: Alex AD
content: I'm only using this app because my phone transfer went awry. Absolutely HATE it. The interface is overwhelming yet basic. Should have more "view options" to change how the photos appear. I had them in albums on my old phone and now it's just thrown together separated only by date and what the Google AI thinks is the subject matter. Some of us like functionality but with a bit more...fluffiness.

author: Kenneth Walters
content: Missing critical integration and functionality I love that this app can manage all photos I have saved to cloud. But falls short when other apps need to access a photo from my library and only provide locally saved photos. On another note, it allows you to edit slow motion video, but doesn't seem to actually save any of that to the video. Any time i take a slow motion video then try to share it, the entire video is slow motion, rather than the section I saved

author: A Google user
content: This app used to work great. However backup of videos is terrible now and taking forever, doesn't matter if the phone is on data only or wifi & data. Took some large file videos of fireworks at beginning of July, they were backed up almost simultaneously, now still waiting to back up a video from yesterday from phone to see on tablet.

author: A Google user
content: The pictures are organized well enough but I download/watch a lot of videos and the video player is a little below mediocre. The player doesn't have the 5/10 second skip function and if I use the bar to skip or rewind it sometimes make the video go completely black leaving only the audio.

author: Joshua
content: Photos has great automatic features and a clean UI. After uploading all of my photos to the cloud, it went ahead and deleted them all from my device. This would be totally fine, if not for the fact that I would have loved to keep them on that phone. (I must have missed the setting to disallow this) Now I have to go through and indivually press "Download" on each and every one (close to 1,000 pictures/videos) because there is no "Download All" button to retrieve them from the cloud to my phone.

author: Melissa Peters
content: This latest update has my photos shutting down while I'm editing my them. It closes out in the middle. It keeps telling me there's a bug. I've cleared my cache, and it's still doing it. I would love to delete this latest update. I love Google photos. I just wish it would allow me to share my photos on Facebook. The photos stored in Google don't show up when I'm uploading photos to Facebook. I pay for extra storage because I take a lot of photos.

author: Cian
content: It would be better but it's annoying that I can't pick what photo albums automatically get uploaded and which don't, my screenshots automatically get uploaded and take up memory and if I delete it from Google photos it gets deleted from my gallery, also the free up space button would be better if you could choose what backed up photos are removed from the gallery instead of all of them going, otherwise it's fine

author: M Harris
content: Super upset with the new "update" it's more complicated to navigate, I can't find the suggestions or how to make collages. The update only gave one to e to review the changes and it of course was not a good moment . Never had a chance after that. This is terrible. It went from a great app to I'm only using it until I can find something better. Very disappointed.

author: Phil “Mileage712” Carpenter
content: Price is too high per gigabyte. It's a bit much to pay for over the long term. Many people would be better off buying an external drive that is internet enabled. The slide show and other features are ok but nothing inspiring. If will use it until my paid storage renewal time and have downloaded all my photos to my external drive instead. I bought a NAS and will install the phone client and make that my goto space for mobile upload and sharing photos to family.

author: Dan Levy
content: Loved this app. Recommended it to people all the time until Google announced they were no longer allowing unlimited high quality uploads after encouraging people like me to use this app as their primary photo/video backup spot. Still a pretty great app but a lot of what made it exceptional & remarkable is now gone which makes me sad. Also now I continually see pop-up ads as "suggestions" to order hard copies of my photos as well as pushing me to order photo albums of my photos.

author: Muhsin
content: Order versions are much better. Why documents, places and pets and people in collection instead of search. Also the device folder there and only two folder in one row. It takes so much time to find a folder. Too much time is taken. Older ones are more easier and efficient to use. Much appreciate if organising files like older version . Also time taken to do anything with a few photoes/videos take is crazy. The move, upload, bin, copy with a few items takes like forever.

author: A Google user
content: love that the app backups all your photos and videos from the device. The movie feature is so terrible though! It used to be amazing and you could easily edit your videos but when the feature updated it went downhill. the videos wont let you edit it without the video crashing.

author: Thushni de Silva
content: I have found this to be a great way to back up my pictures but as of a few months ago, I have to manually go to the app and keep it open for the pictures to back up and things were going out of sync, having to back up videos from years ago. I am hoping the new update helps that. If not it would defeat the main purposes of using it.

author: D K Lal
content: Something has happened to this app. Uploading photos through the phone results in the photos being visible on the browser but not on the app. Even after many days, the situation remains the same. Combined with the upcoming change in the storage policy, it makes one wonder whether using this app is worth it. Seems to me like Google is about to face its own WhatsApp moment.

author: Teacup Appleblood
content: It would be be a 5-Star app but it does have some stuff missing. Like I can't flip photos horizontally so I have to go to my phone's gallery and flip it there. Disappointing, but I don't mind that much. Also, when you crop the size of a video the quality decreases so much, it's very disappointing, I dislike that.

author: Meenakshi Goel
content: It's pretty nice, I'm using it since past 11 years or maybe less but the problem is that again and again a when we open the app a message comes to update the app, whenever I try to do so it says we can't update it bla bla bla bla ....... Then if they can't update it then why are they showing the message.... Uhhh 😒 it's irritating😡

author: Sadie Gilson
content: The newest update changed things that in my opinion never needed changing. The old version was much more easier to navigate, and now everything is so much harder to find. author: Anu Naveen
content: Updated review: The new version fixes the album sorting problem and I'm absolutely loving it. Thank you Google! Another function I wish they had was the ability to delete photos within an album, instead of deleting it from the pile. Previous review: The app is good except for the absence of a basic functionality of album sorting. My photos are all over the place. It's frustrating. I wish I could sort by name or by album rather than the default setting of sort by date. Hope Google fixes this.

author: G33K5G
content: The newly updated interface is much better than what it was before — particularly the Collections area. Albums should be labeled as 'On the cloud'. Allow us to customize the view in Collections. I'd rather have Documents & Places in the list below as well as Trash. For Photos area, allow us to view by either date or last added. Every time I dump photos taken from years ago, they don't all show as most recent. Many are placed by date which can be impossible to find if you wanted to categorize.

author: A Google user
content: Great app, but has a few caveats: 1 - There are too many notifications. Probably at least one every day. I don't want to turn them off - but it would be nice to be able to dial it down a bit. 2 - Inability to create gifs manually. Assistant does it for you and notifies you later. This also applies to the web app accessed via a web browser on a laptop/desktop.

author: JUWOLS
content: Awesome, long time user. The only issue I have is that, because I've used this app for such a long time, I have A LOT OF ALBUMS, which is a headache when orgaizing pics. For some reason, in the app, when adding a pic to an album, it lists the albums in a weird algorithmic order which makes it really hard to find what youre lookin for. Only the last 3 you've modified show up on top of the list. Hoping to see that fixed!

author: A Google user
content: Fantastic app for storing your photo library! Especially on a Google Pixel with the unlimited photo uploads. Sharing photos and videos with friends and family couldn't be easier with the shared album feature, and I absolutely love how you can easily clear out my phone's storage with a tap of a button rather than guessing whether or not it is still using storage. My only issue is that you cannot change specific photos/videos to "high quality" from "original quality". It's either all or nothing.

author: A Google user
content: Super convenient app. It backs up all photos photos, plus folders you select to “Drive” automatically. Never fear a damaged device again. It will also prompt you to archive photos regularly, thereby keeping open space for you to take more 😀. There are some ads for features that it offers, which is why it only gets 4 stars. Sorry, I don't use any of the other features, so I'm not able to evaluate them.

author: Krista
content: I wish there was a way to save some photos in their original quality and back-up the rest for free. Google photos has gotten progressively better and better. I love how easy it is to clear my phone memory (after photos are backed up) now. I like how organized it is. It's fairly easy to use and find the photos I want. The photo assistant (where it puts my photos/videos into collages, movies, and stories) is unnecessary, but it does make some fun animations!

author: Ruby Mora
content: It is very easy to crop, enhance or add a finish. Sort of a pain to create slide shows or movies. Wish there were more options for editing . but all in all, very goody app. Update: I take a lot of pics. And i have my business photos all on my phone. There should be a better/easier way to find them. I have to scroll for hours sometimes. Still use this as my primary galary, just wish things were better for searching tons of photos. Update: Love that you can search for identifying objects in photos

author: CJ K
content: I love most of the features, but I have 3 suggestions: 1. Allow the user to change pictures in the auto-created collages. Sometimes the collage just has one bad picture, but there is no option to change it. 2. The user should be able to order a photo book from an album they created. Instead, I have to use a 3rd party to order my photo books. 3. Get rid of the music on memories. Yes, I can click to turn it off, but then it also turns off the audio for videos.

author: Mike Crews
