content: The best way to keep and organize photos. Plenty of user options and controls to customize your albums. Time stamps,location, and more. Gives you the control to go between internal drive,external,and linked drives and includes backup. If you have a lot of photos that cover a wide range of subjects/details. Then look no further. Look forward to future add ons from everything google!

author: Joseph Benitez
content: Google is all over the place doin everything and im a big fan of Google photos. So easy to use and great filters for editing. However, I feel it would be even better if it also offered an easier way to organize my photos and movies and even better would be if I was able to use Google photos to search for all my duplicates and delete them. Ive got lots of duplicates but don't have the time go thru my entire library. Just a suggestion.

author: A Google user
content: This app is great for sharing photos and viewing them. Editing is also good and its quite easy to crop or rotate pictures. Plus, the ability to upload my pictures to the cloud and thus not taking any space on my phone is awesome! However, there have been many instances in which photos were only showed as a gray screen instead of the actual photo. I'm not sure if thats because the photo never really existed or if the app is just glitching but it's very annoying and bothersome. please fix this!!!!

author: Chris Uhalt
content: I dropped my review to four stars, still a really good app but I'm going through a divorce and I'm literally bombarded with pictures of my wife. "Member this day" and it shows a picture of the divorce papers. I think a simple solution would be that the owner of the account chooses the pictures google shows you with the press of a "favorite" button instead of the algorithm. Social media gets your "highlight" pictures, that's why "memories" works for them. They don't have access to everything.

author: A Google user
content: Not as many editing options available as could be. They keep it simple but little things like, text & art on photosI wish I could control the placement of my photos in colleges and what about a dark theme by now. This app should by now be much more dynamic and cutting edge. For some reason google doesn't like its customers customizing. Some kind of deceptove monopoly thing? What's wrong with organizing a college.

author: A Google user
content: Pros: intuitive, direct and free storage within Google network, face label, albums, photo scanning, stylized cool pics, grouped memory collages Cons: not enough photo editing capabilities, wish it was easier to tag a person in a photo, need more photo editing from within app. between the pixel 3xl and the Google photos we should be able to do it all, but especially blemishes, smiles, red eyes, scenery, let's make it easy to show what this camera can do in fogg or in the rain.

author: Emiliya Stefanova
content: It would be nice if you add the option to tag people and animals manually. Sometimes the app doesn't recognize them. The storage is no longer free unlimited but it does the job. I appreciate that they didn't count everything uploaded thus far towards the storage count. I still haven't reached the limit. I guess when I do I will consider paying more for storage or not.

author: Diane Talmage
content: I really like the automatic backup and unlimited photo storage. It has been great switching from iPhone to Android a few times over the past few years. My only beef, is that often when I try to upload photos to an album it will not save or keep the album with all of the images in it. I've tried updating the app, changing around certain settings and nothing seems to work, so that aspect of the albums is a hit or miss and can be somewhat frustrating at times.

author: A Google user
content: I love the app and almost everything from Google. Two things that would make it better are more photo editing tools with a huge variety of options like a lot of the other photo editor apps. Also, the ability to lock certain albums with a passcode and a generic cover photo, just in case someone gets access to your phone or tablet etc and there is certain pictures youd rather them not see. Add those two things please!

author: MrsH
content: Easy to use, and I love how it brings up your memories. My original review is from 2016 which tells you I've been using it for a long time. Over the years of course they've tried to improve the app which has been a hit or miss. Sometimes it will automatically upload folders from your device that you have not selected to be uploaded which makes it frustrating because it removes it from your app once it uploads to the storage. Overall I still heavily use this app and still recommend it

author: Kelly Miller
content: Google photos is great. The reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because of some of the smaller things I found, but overall I love it. The fact that you can search keywords, or faces, or landmarks makes it really convenient when trying to look for a specific photo. The only downside (and reason for the 4 stars) is because sometimes it can get really picky and not find something that's obviously in the photo. But I typically will think of another keyword for it. I highly do recommend using!

author: A Google user
content: I really enjoyed everything about this. I have a Pixel XL 2 so I'm enjoying the wonderful photos as well. I wish there was a way to create a private folder to put photos that you dont want anyone to see in there, and hide it like some Samsung devices give you. Also, once I did a back up of all my photos it removed them from the device and now I can't use them with Shutterfly app. All the other features are just great!!!!

author: Baphomet
content: Google photos is the default photo app for my new phone, and for the most part since I've adjusted, it's been great. However, one major issue I'm having is with the facial grouping. Many of my pets aren't able to be added, as the app doesn't recognize a face in the image. I think it would be helpful if you could add a square to mark where a face is in an image even though the app hasn't marked it already, and add it to a pet or person folder from there.

author: Michael Branan
content: Ok, so a private gallery has finally been added, +1 star, and that's a good start. Now let me organize items in it. Much like Archive, everything is lumped together making images hard to find. I love the backup, editing, and every other aspect of this app... But Gallery organization is awful. I can create albums all day long and stick pictures in them, but what's the point when all it really amounts to is putting a tag on the picture. They're not actually organized in any way shape or form.

author: Joyce R.
content: Easy to share with others. The "memories" feature brings back pictures based on the date from the past - which are beautiful reminders of where you've been. "Archive" is a great feature as well, except it doesn't provide the option to delete instead of archive. Typically a bunch of archival photos are ones I'd like to delete. It's annoying that I do have to individually delete them, when the app already did the work of recognizing they were photos I probably didn't need.

author: J'aime O'Neill
content: The app has made improvements over time and become really useful and way more technical, which I like. Folders, geolocarions, facial recognition is amazing, etc. The only thing I would ask is that multiple photos can be selected from across folders. For example, if I want to post pics to Facebook from my Camera, VZN Media, and Snapchat folders, I can select them, back out of the folder, open another folder, and keep selecting from there. That would literally be the best thing. Lol

author: Tria D
content: It's wonderful being able to access your photos on different devices and knowing they are backed up even if you lose your phone. I love the albums that go back in time to what you were doing this same week 2 and 3 years ago. The search features and suggested photo albums are helpful, too. The tools for correcting photos can be a bit difficult to use.

author: A Google user
content: The Google Photos app is pretty handy for the most part. At this time there is not much in the way of editing tools, so do not expect to use the app if you need to do more than crop or adjust lighting. Occasionally Assistant will present you with auto-adjusted photos or videos made from your photos. If you snap a quick series of photos assistant may present you with a gif.

author: Jagger French
content: I've been very happy to see photos that I thought were long gone show up on here, made me very happy to see memories pop back up as well. Wonderful app just wish it was a little easier to change and find the different people to name so that it could separate photos better. Also wish that it was able to tag certain animals and people in photos that it doesn't seem to pick up or recognize as either.

author: Peter Forshtay
content: It's pretty good. Google banks on money spent for photo storage, so there is no incentive for them to do so, but a duplicate finder for past photos would be immensely helpful. Without it, I'm stuck combing through thousands of photos to delete the duplicates and triplicates I can find. Also, not sure what has glitched in their system recently, but many of the facial tags got mixed up in my account. Irritating and time consuming to fix. Otherwise, pretty good.

author: Mai-Lan Dunlop
content: Great for backing up and sharing. I appreciate the updates to the app over the years. The backup feature has been reliable and I love the ability to back up photos across multiple devices to one account. I really like the sharing features and have been able to share photos to loved ones during this past year of COVID-19 lockdown. One feature I wish we could have is the ability to export the entire album (sort order, comments and inline album text) and not just the photos.

author: Kyra Amos
content: I don't usually leave reviews but this app I truly love using. It saved all my photos from my past phones and I saw old memories even I forgot about! I would highly recommend. If I had to complain about one thing is I wish the date on the photos were more accurate than they are at times. Sometimes they are spot on, others they aren't. Other than that, it's a good app.

author: ERIC ROGNLIEN
content: Photos in albums are put there to organize and reduce clutter, yet duplicates are still there in the main pool which still leaves the main pool cluttered and confusing. Photos in albums shouldn't be displayed in the main pool because you can find them in their respective album. Photos in albums should retain their date and place shot of course.

author: A Google user
content: 4.5 stars. Great app, the search feature is scary good, and the backup works without a hitch most of the time. Overall the best photo management app on the play store, but not perfect: - If you decide to upload your photos at non origonal resolution, there is no easy way to change your mind about it afterwards. You have to delete your entire library and start all over. - The suggested photo edits and collages by the Assistant are never any good. - Very rudimentary controls for your local files.

author: A Google user
content: I really enjoy the photo features with collages, etc. My only complaint would be that when trying to update (for months now), the app seems to freeze in the download pending phase. And everytime that I pull up photos, I am faced with the update now or not now that I have to choose. It's just frustrating.

author: Jeff Hudson
content: I have loved this app, having used it for about 7 years now. I have saved literally thousands of photos, and organized them into albums. I also like being able to edit (to some degree) within this app, without having to do it with a separate program. The only negative about it is that when I changed my email address, thousands of photos and all of my albums disappeared. I later found them, after finding how to go into the app under my old email address. Would be great if you could merge the two

author: Abigail Fox
content: I used to love this app. I want to still love it. But for several months now, if someone shares photos with me via Google Photos, I cannot see them using the app. It looks like they never sent them. If I use the browser instead of the app, the photos show up. Similarly, if I "save" photos shared from others, they do not show up in my Google Photos gallery like they used to. No idea why.

author: A Google user
content: I love that this app saves all the photographs I take, so I never accidentally lose a cherished moment I captured "on film." Digital film, I guess. But I hate how it saves bagillions of the same photo. Maybe it's my settings, but still, no excuse for a company like Google.  Surely they see all the details of each photo/video. We should be given the option to duplicate or overwrite... That's my suggestion anyway.

author: Kaff Leen
content: It's pretty basic. I do like the tools and filters available for free as well as the ones you have to pay for. The price is low, however it irritates me that Google (being the billionaires that they are) decided to charge their loyal customers for certain features within the photos app. I find it to be unnecessary as they make PLENTY of money already thru so many other things, they could have just let it all be free. Other than that, the app can be confusing when you're trying to organize pics.

author: Born of Love
content: It really is the best out there. I've tried other photo/gallery apps and they just don't compare. The ease and the flexibility of capturing, backing up, modifying and reaccessing just can't be beat. My only glitch is I'm not a fan of having things out in some 'cloud.' When I find something that can outperform Google photos and regain my full privacy I'm gone.

author: James Barton
content: Great program, I'd give it a 5 if there were better instructions or tutorials. I spent allot of time organizing albums, then archived all the photos, which wiped everything out of the albums, I called and was informed that archived photos still show in albums, which they do not. I had to rebuild the albums. I use this program as a resource to access my thousands of photos in Lightroom by viewing the date in Google photos and then accessing originals which are very large. Great once understood

author: Kelly Fouse
content: I'm a picture fiend. And this helps save the most precious moments!!! Update: as of the new update, my sharing partner And I have been receiving notifications of nxes photos, except when we open the notification, it say "sorry this link is not available, either you lost connection or url expired" ... I have connection, nothing I know of is due to expire and neither of us and shared anything within a few days; frustrating .

author: Rachel Novick
content: I'm a long-time Picasa user, so I was upset to hear that Google would no longer be updating that program, but Photos is a suitable replacement. It's easy to use and I can access my photos from anywhere, instantly. One thing I think they should change is allowing the search feature within albums. Currently, you can only do a search from your main photo library. Also, you can scroll through your main photo library by date, but this is not the case in your albums. Please add these features!

author: Becky Watkins (Captain Becks)
content: Lost a star from previous review because generates less creations than when it was attached to G+, and didn't gain anything when it separated. I love the integration of old Picasa features. I just wish I could retroactively upgrade my photos that I previously uploaded lo-res to the new higher-res 12mp. Also to update my tags that I added on my computer. I wish it were more like Picasa, especially with syncing. I don't like that it can't recognize duplicates.

author: Mary Clayton Liles
content: Haha, not surprisingly this app has improved a lot over the last seven years. It's the only thing I use to edit and organize my photos. We have a smart TV and no longer use Chromecast, but I still wish there were an easier way to view high quality versions of your photos and videos on TV. I can do "tap to view" because I have Samsung stuff which is cool. An app for the TV would be cooler though.

author: A Google user
content: I no longer fear losing my phone with photo backup, which is worth this app just for that. I love pretty much everything about this app, and my criticisms are mostly nits. First, I wish I had options to sort my albums (by name, by date, last modified, created, etc). Second, a huge improvement would be around editing photos: being able to save as copy or keep the changes in history, easier one click rotation, especially for photos that are not on the phone's physical storage.

author: Hell Cat
content: Always a great app to save all photos to.. especially after switching devices. I can go all the way back to 2014 ( 5 phones ago ) and find all my pics in one place. The only thing is the editing options could be way better. And I would like to be able to move photos from all photos to a specific folder and the photo not be in the general layout. I prefer to separate into designated folders without having to see them as soon as I open app

author: Michael Gentile
content: Edit : Google has reneged on their commitment to provide unlimited free storage. Amazon still offers this, so you probably want to go there instead. All I have to do is snap a picture and it automatically uploads, gets polished and fixed up, animated and put into collages. You can even search for a person's face to see all of the photos with them in it.

author: W Cundiff
content: I wish when you go through your photos and place them to the different albums that that's the only place you would see them. It's impossible to sort all of my pics because I don't know where I left off. I'll have to start over again and again. It's too much work.... Other than that, its got pretty good features like facial recognition and putting each person in their own album etc. I will try to update after I see how this current update works. I need to spend every minute sorting all of my pic

author: A Google user
content: This app has a great foundation and only continues to add useful features and refinements. The backup is simple, clearing photos to free space is a breeze, and it's ability to automatically categorize photos makes finding what you need easy. By far the best and most polished photo gallery app for those not trying to keep secrets ;). That said, there is an archiving function now. If only you could password/pin protect photos...

author: Alejandro Ponce-Cruz
content: Please add a way to hide photos into different albums. You can only archive into 1 place so far, but I have work photos that I do not want to see every time Im looking through my memories, and I have other photos I want to hide, that I dont want to see when I'm going through my work photos. Still a pixel feature to lock albums? 😑 Hooked us in with the unlimited huh 😑 Amazon is doing that now though, if this doesn't add value soon, whats the point of staying.

author: PsYcHo
content: Overall, not a bad app. Everything is neatly organized, easy to find and easy to share! I love how I can create shared albums with my husband and we can both add to and view each other's photos. Works wonderful for pix of our beautiful Angel.... -⭐ for the editor... Lacks many vital functions. I don't like having to use up more space for a separate editor, but it's not the worst thing that could happen...

author: Joed Lopez
content: Update: Pretty solid these days. 4/5 because can't really mass export. Original: Back up / free up space only works when it feels like it. And when someone tries sharing an album w me it just shows that it is about to load and nothing shows up. Ive reinstalled 2x and still does it. Another example of google app on google platform not working right.

author: A Google user
content: I like the way pictures are organised, how easy pictures upload to Google from my phone, being able to free up space, and that it's easy to scroll through them and create albums to share. I only wish there was a good way to tag pictures with names, not necessarily the people, but their names and also a way to name pictures to easily search for them later.

author: Salvador Gonzalez
content: While you can't save unlimted photos at full resolution, the compression quailty is not noticeable in cell phone pictures. The assistant that creates movies, gif animations, and collages works great once you uploade the files. Update: I removed one star because there is not a way to sort files that are being counted as using disk space, and files that are unlimited high res. This makes it difficult to try and delete files when you dont know which if which.

author: Miz Eyedentify
content: I love the app. However, I would like to see some changes when it comes to using the photo features. The app should return back to the specific place within the original album upon clicking add to album. Also it would be great to have the ability to move or center the images on a collage or even choose a template. Also the uploading and sharing of videos could use some work. I have spent hours trying to upload a video only to find out it would freeze or fail to upload. Thank you

author: Marietha Conrado
content: Overall, I've never had any issues with Photos. I actually really enjoy it's grouping of similar faces, pets, places, etc. This review is more reflective of the most current, and really only issue, I've ever had. I can't delete any pictures from the app nor is it syncing across devices. Everytime I try to delete a picture the app closes. I've deleted pictures on the web and via other devices but it's not reflective in my Android app version of Photos. So, that's kind of annoying.

author: Andrew Labrecque
content: I really like this app, it helps me enjoy my photos years after they were originally taken and gives me access to my entire photo library so easily. I do wish that the highlights/stories feature would remember which photos I looked at the previous day when I come back after new photos are added to them. It would be better if it picked up where I left off.

author: A Google user
content: Me and my husband use this to share our baby's pictures with our family. But i think it can be improved a lot more. Like for example you can't create a group with the contacts you always share the pictures, you have to add them all the time to a different shared album. Also, they comment in the pictures and sometimes I would like to reply to a comment but it doesn't show it like a tree so that's kind of annoying.

author: Todd A. Blanchard
content: I really like the variety of editing options. They provide everything that I need. The perspective tool is back in the latest version! Thanks Google devs! One thing I'd like to see are the true versions of the images as captured by the camera. When viewing photos, they are automatically adjusted in the viewer. When sharing the same photos, they do not appear to match in terms of color, lighting balance, etc., even on the same phone. If that issue were fixed, I would give five stars.

author: A Google user
content: The app and google photos online always have a different number of photos. Duplicate photos on web browser. But they are not duplicate if u delete one both of the photos go to trash. It would be nice if there were more editing options or just more to do on the app. I love my pictures being able to organize better like easier to sort how u want instead of having to go in and change the date for them to fall into the order you want. I just think google can do soo much more with this app.

author: Darja Otten
content: Love. Especially the organization. Hate adding text to photos, collaging, & anything passed a very simple, basic edit. It's great to store photos but make sure you do any editing before saving it in this app. Limited fonts, colors & difficult to resize. I found it easier to use another app for advanced edits, collages & adding text to photos.

author: A Google user
content: Good app. Wish i could post selections from albums to facebook, though, instead of having to scroll down individuals photos to find what i want. Also, would love to be able to add a note or name or label to each photo & also be able to search for it with that label when posting to other sites like Facebook. Also to just be able to search for photos that way when i am in the Photos app.

author: Britt
content: Google photos is a must. It helps clear up space on your phone, back up all your pics/videos and let's you edit/filter. Would be amazing if the video editor had more options like splicing clips from the middle, fade option, basic audio editing & replacement, and ability to put multiple clips in a sequence. The one thing that annoys me is having to export clips to make a simple edit. Photos is always progressing, so here's to hoping these features are available soon!

author: Andrew Fisher
content: This is a great app for my photos, and much I prefer it over Microsoft's photos app with overall, the layout and design of the app being simple and easy to access, but there are two things that don't like. When you open a photo, it will sometimes have a pop-up saying "Fix lighting", but most of the time it makes the picture worse and the white balance is cranked quite high. The second thing that I dislike is when in the main menu, it will have some confusing pop-up on the bottom of the screen.

author: A Google user
content: Love the app & unlimited storage. But every now and then it will all of a sudden eat up large chunks of storage on my phone all at once, and I don' t even have to be on the phone at the time. It's happened overnight. i'll go to bed and when i wake up photos will have gone from taking up 500mb to 625! worst case was it added 500mb overnight! and sometimes it will add data strorage in consecutive chunks, like adding 50 to 70 mb 2 or 3 tiimes in a row.

author: A Google user
content: Pretty good, stores photos in weird places that can make them hard to find sometimes. For instance, downloading an image, gif , video etc. From the internet and trying to post on FB or text to a friend and then it doesn't show up through the afore mentioned apps but when you go to G Photo app it's there, just not in the other apps... Kind of annoying

author: Jonathan Schermer
content: I upgraded to Galaxy Note 20 Ultra last year and the only issue I have is that sometimes when I'm using mobile data I can't access albums or photos in the cloud, they show up as invisible. It happens immidiatley after I update the app and lasts for about 3 to 5 days then it fixes itself. Wifi works perfect and since I'm often around wifi it's not a big deal for me personally, but if anyone has the same phone just be aware it doesn't matter if I have full bars, nor does it matter if I'm on 4g/5g.

author: A Google user
content: I really do love this app and the security of knowing my photos are backed up and accessible from everywhere. Although it frequently gets it wrong or makes weird things, the auto suggested collages, animations, videos, etc are frequently fun. I do wish that the collage maker allowed for a little bit more control (photo cropping, placement, order, etc) like the old Picassa app used to have. And it is still very cumbersome to correct misidentified faces. But aside from that, it's a great app!

author: A Google user
content: The 3 problems I have are when the photo of someone's face is in the wrong face id folder, you can't move them to another one or create a new one. Second is if you take burst photo, you should be able to make an animation out of it, if you can do that than my phone just won't let me. I miss being able to correct red eyes in my phone's own editor rather than having to download some 3rd party thing that puts a watermark. If these 3 issues were addressed then 5 stars, otherwise I love the app.

author: Jarod Platt
content: Pretty good app, but it doesn't always line up with the changes I make on my computer, which is where I do the majority of work on my photos. Usually it fixes the problem if I uninstall the app and then reinstall it, but it takes time. Also the facial recognition has a few bugs and sometimes misses stuff, but otherwise it is really great!

author: Zandi Cotner
content: lots of cool features. some easier to use than others. my favorite feature is being able to order any photos you want in app for . 18 cents each for regular sized prints and the more you get the less you pay in shipping until u reach free shipping for 20 + photos I think. you get them fast. they have special offers for first time orders and periodically promotions. my one complaint is all the duplicates it allows Everytime it backs up ur photos. if the name changes on them it misses doubles.

author: Robert Rael
content: Please please bring back the sorting of albums to add photos to such that the albums with the most recent photos in them come up first! I have a daily time lapse folder I use, and now, on my phone, it's nowhere to be found in my millions of albums. Used to be near the top, because I add to it daily. If there's a way I can fix this, please point me in the right direction!

author: A Google user
content: Love that all my photos and videos are in one place, and especially love how it puts videos, pic collages, and pop up memories together for You! Only thing I wish was different is make it easier to put photo books, calendars, or just prints together from other suppliers other than Google. I hate that I have to download the photos I want before I can use them. Takes to much time and waste of computer space.

author: Joshua Ohmer
content: The auto-upload photo storage is wonderful. The AI adds a lot of searchability but can be inconsistent about faces. Most troublesome is that if Google fails to see a face where one is, there is no option to highlight and name the person. Also, when I say that a face is not who they think it is, I'd like to be prompted to give the correct name, rather than it just untagging the face.

author: A Google user
content: I love this app. My phone doesn't have a regular photo gallery, so I didn't have much of a choice, but I was pleasantly surprised. I do, however wish they had more editing options for my photos & videos. The unlimited storage is wonderful & allows me take all the photos & videos I like, without fear of running out of space to keep them. The assistant is a nice feature that most other apps lack & it's pretty helpful too. Plus, it allows me to easily share pics & videos with my family & friends.

author: A Google user
content: Almost a five star app, I mostly don't even mind the notifications. Trading on nostalgia is a bit of a low blow for us parents and grandparents, but the fact is, I like looking at "anniversary " photos, so usually, I enjoy them in spite of myself. The option to create your own book is amazingly cool, and the results are not half bad. At my age, it's unlikely that I'll ever use a tenth of the alternatives available, but what I have used is easy and the results are very nice.

author: A Google user
content: Great place to store all my photos and memories. Easily separate personal photos from saved memes or sayings off the net. I have had a hard time as of late getting it to recognize new faces. The faces it does know has incomplete lists of photos and albums. I also see no way to revoke shared album privileges more or less control who can see it to just those invited. I would say it is a good work in progress but is without many much needed features.

author: A Google user
content: Love the automation in it! Just wish there was a way to have it happen more often or to focus on certain people and scenes. Like if I could say primarily pick photos of me and my partner along with landscapes, burst animations, and my dog, that would make it so much more useful! It does a pretty good job already. But that personalization would take it over the top!

author: Dvine Lovin
content: Not happy at all about discontinuing unlimited storage. I may have to find an alternative. Also, being able to change the orientation of all photos at once instead of sporadically when Google photos notices it works be great. I like that I can label and create folders, find pics by faces, month, year, event, and location. Creating a link to share many videos and photos and awesome and fast. I like the memories, and collages and videos it creates too.

author: A Google user
content: Best option I've seen for photo organization on Android. I wish it was possible to sort based on file size and if a photo is original size or optimized. Easier sorting would also be nice for those of us who have thousands of photos but still need them in a chronological order. The scroll speed should allow more control. As it is I start scrolling through days and suddenly I'm skipping years. It's also a shame Snapseed controls aren't built-in to Google Photos (perhaps as an advanced option). This also needs to show patch notes so we know what changed on each release.

author: Tamara Kane
content: Update Jan 21, 2025: Increasing my rating as Google listened and added a pet face feature! Still want to tag my cat in more pics, but it's getting better. They also made it easier to rename or at least describe photos and that's important for search. I still don't like the "feature" where you only have 1 copy of a pic. For an artist, I need to have slightly different versions of the same photo in multiple places and delete from a folder, but not all devices. Bad:Timestamps can cause lost photos.

author: Kelly Duncan
content: I love this app. I do wish however that you had an option to see the photos not in albums. As well as... *****this is the most frustrating part of Google Photos for me.....***** A DUPLICATE PHOTO FINDER. I have over the years managed to accumulate multiple copies of the same photos and I have yet to find a way to erase the extra copies and leave the original. Other than that, this app is awesome.

author: A Google user
content: I love the free storage and the quality of saved files, however, I hate the way that it uploads and organizes everything. My auto sync only works about 60% of the time and when it does work it stuffs new photos into a variety of useless sub folders. It's a huge pain in the ass to access my latest photos. I've changed settings several times and it continues to do so.

author: Heather L
content: Works great. Keeps photos mostly organized... It identifies and organizes people as they age which is nice when you want to sort per person... groups well, just haven't figured out how to auto add in the right album... but it is auto added, lol probably lack of sorting on my part, takes time to group, add each group of photos which I'm not so great at... it is unlimited storage, at least until June 2021... then they count against your quota...15GB a person. I'm currently using the free version!

author: Naked Shot
content: Photos is an astonishing app that allows you to save pictures and videos throughout your life from the comfort of your hand-held device a.k.a. smart phone. It also enables you to get your pictures printed as easy as a click of a button!! Plus it offers other potions like canvas photos!! The most amazing thing is that you can go back one two three years from now and see your pictures. Sadly Google Photos doesn't have a "private " option as to keep some pics private. Therefore only 4 stars...

author: A Google user
content: Best for organizing/finding photos. Editing, collage tools, etc. are too limited to make this my only photo app, but its strengths are noteworthy. I'm befuddled when I show someone a pic from ten years ago and they ask how I have so many photos on my phone. Well, I don't... But gPhotos helps me find and share in a snap. What's missing? PLEASE make it so I can ARCHIVE OR DELETE suggested images. Too often I see pics I'd rather delete mixed in suggested archives, but there's no easy way to do so.

author: A Google user
content: It would ould be nice to integrate Google calendars with Google photos. say that I can click on a date on Google calendars and it can give me an option to show photos that I taken that day. This app is still a little slow but I'm sure it depends on what type of device I am using, Android 7.0. I know my phone is slightly outdated but it's a lot better than my old Android 5.0 which Google photos was very slow on. Maybe an option to automatically upload facebook pics with our permission.

author: Cammie Hartley
content: The backup feature is amazing, and makes it easy to access photos from different devices. However, it's a bummer that even if you pay for high quality photo storage, any use of the editor will crush the quality of a photo to the size of the free version. I thought I would be able to upload DSLR pics from my laptop and leisurely sort them and tweak lighting on my phone, or even from the website on pc. Nope! Not unless I want to defeat the purpose of using a real camera.

author: Dr Bernard B Heller
content: Easy way to archive photos, edit, crop, etc., and even experiment with colorization, and if you make a mistake, you simply revert back to the original photo. Fascinating! I just wish all of the features available through membership were available to everyone. One last thing: Who was the "genius" that thought it was a good idea to rate everything, no matter how innocuous, AND, as if that's insufficient fodder, have to tell you how we feel about it? Mind-boggling, and a HUGE waste of time!

author: Jase M. Voorhees
content: It is a good thing to have, I just wish I could have more room for putting a title on my pictures, and I wish I could look up pictures better, such as looking up things, like animals, places and food, not just people and events. Also, I wish that I could put things in folders myself, then I can organize and re-arrange them however I wanted.

author: Leighton Briar
content: I literally have no idea what I would do without this app! I use it in everyday for everything. I use every tool. Lens, edit share and so much more. Only thing is that I have been using this app for many years and now they want to charge me for some of the best editing features! My loyalty to Google and Google photos seems to be taken for granted, its kind of maddening but I'll deal.

author: Lovely Libra
content: The app is useful for clearing storage and protecting my pictures. My only complaint is that sometimes photos will be placed in an album that isn't the person it belongs to, or just not in an album at all leaving me to search for the pic & manually add to their album. I could understand if they looked alike or were in the photo together then yes they should be in BOTH not just ONE yet when it happens no resemblance no shared photos, have NEVER been in photos together.

author: A Google user
content: Overall the app functions fine, but I find that I have trouble with organization. Editing is a breeze and even fun, though I really need to edit with the awesome pixel camera. I need an option to select (and delete or move) ALL photos from a certain location, or say, find all photos with dogs in them. I know how to search, but results are hit or miss. With over 300K photos, organization is a nightmare. Don't want to buy storage. Please increase organization and mass location select.

author: Sentient Aspic
content: I like Google Photos a lot, I've used it for several years. The cloud backup and partner sharing are pretty seamlessly integrated, and the app as a whole is quite simple to use. The in app editing features could use a total overhaul, they're boring, unimpressive, and not very well executed, but that's the lowest point as far as I'm concerned. It is great for photo storage, sharing, and making albums easily, but in app editing isn't noteworthy at all. Definitely get a separate app for that.

author: A Google user
content: Just awesome! The automatic stories are great (the dates might be a little off if you are on a different time zone) the ability to find old photos by date, or people (as long as you tag them) and places (as long as your GPS indicator is turned on in your camera). And the ability to edit photos and share them with your friend for them to download, without having to create a bunch of emails is great!

author: A Google user
content: This app does a great job storing pictures and has many other cool features (collages, animating, etc.). Unfortunately, due to limited space on my phone and the massive amount of photos I take, I had to part ways with this app. It was taking over 2.5 GB on my storage card and I just couldn't handle my phone giving me warnings about running out of room. I did everything I could to make room but to no avail. It would also run hard on my battery if I took a lot of photos, so the cons outweigh pros.

author: A G
content: this is my main photo and video keeper. Can't edit photos after current update (happens a lot to me for unknown reasons). With my pictures that I lost i tried to recover so many times but it has a different number on it (did save current number, did try everything but lost everything.) Would be nice to watch videos and view pictures without connection. There are times that videos that don't want to play ( says can't play ), just annoys me.

author: Jamie Barrington
content: If it had not been for Google Photos, I would have lost so many photos to the ether. The facial recognition technology is crazy accurate! However, app is a little slow, even on the fastest internet connection. It's also not very user-friendly. While this one doesn't exactly apply to myself, less tech savvy people may have trouble navigating. Otherwise, it's a great app & I love that I don't have to worry about losing my pics...and I do have a lot of them!

author: Anthony Rindone
content: I love the ease of use, and how I don't need to concern myself about back ups of my photos collection. Worrying about hyper-organizing my pictures is no longer on my radar. I'd love to see more investment into the Assistant feature, though, as I feel like their suggestions are becoming more rare - even though I tend to save each one and look forward to some new cool creation that Google has imagined with my photos.

author: Cedrianna Hairston
content: Update: I use this as my primary photo storage. It does what it needs to, I just wish I could download photos easier than 1 at a time on my phone. Also apparently the storage settings are changing so I guess I gotta pull out the hard drive and slowly start moving my pictures. I don't want to pay monthly for extra storage. If it was a one and done payment option, I might do it.

author: Lin Johnson
content: I love a lot about it. It's easy to organize photos, share, and the memory reminders great! The things that bother me is not being able to search within an album and not being able to automatically add photos to an album only if 2 people I choose are in it together. Please add the options. Another odd thing is the photo it auto selected to be the main photo of a person is terrible. It used to be one of me with my eyes half closed and now it's a really bad photo of me from 20 years ago.

author: Alissa C
content: Great for backing up & sharing photos easily with people, but editing + album management is not polished. I should be able to batch rotate multiple photos simultaneously to save me the manual effort. Editing albums with location & text is awful on phone app and desktop, along with having to drag and drop to reorder things. Poor UX for albums with lots of photos. But, aside from that, it's a solid app with the convenience of the Google ecosystem.

author: A Google user
content: Good layout and great options within the app. BUT, after spending a good time organizing my folders, a "free up space" option came up. "Save up to 20 gb, these pics are already backed up", I said sweet! So I used it, MISTAKE! Now all my organized folders are gone and, although pics are available in the photos folder, there's no way to move them back to the original folders. So all the practicality of having them divided by folders is gone!

author: A Google user
content: Hi, I'm filling out this review to hopefully be of some help to y'all. I love the concept of the Google Photos App, however there are some 'Major' issues that just need a little tweaking so it's alot easier to use. I have the app because it came on my phone, I started using it and decided to take advantage of the 'Share Album' option with my relative who I sent a link to which shows only the new pictures that were just added, not the entire body of the album. I also allowed them to be able to add photos, comment & ect on the options list, but with just the link I sent she couldn't do it so in turn she downloaded the Google Photos App. And although I knew it took me awhile to get the hang of how to use it, I was quite dismayed wen she told me "Ok, I have got it DL, as soon as I figure out how to use it I will start adding photos too". The trouble is with the way you have formatted the options menu, there are No Clear, easy to understand options except for the Trash & Empty Trash options. It's really hard to know if you have actually Backed up successfully the photos chosen because the main screen doesn't just show those, it shows all of them together. Also, for a 'Lay-person I have no clue what the differences in the options are, wat the sizes mean to me if I decide to print a pic. Another confusing thing is the 'Archive' option. I don't know why it is that when I Archive a photo it seems to disappear from my album. Then I'm trying to figure out if the photo I just Archived can still be seen in my 'Shared Album' or not. I don't think it can be viewed by the person who I am sharing the album with. Well, I sure hope this helps all you fine people at Google. I do really like the app, but its just sorta confounding to Beginners like me,Thank you.

author: Nathalia Parra
content: Very useful. Never have to worry about limited storage for photos, plus I can access them on any device. *Edit* I took off a star because of the last update where it took away the search option of finding individual people the app recognized and separated. It was pretty helpful pinpointing pictures I wanted to find but since it took it away, it's been a huge inconvenience. Hoping they put it back soon 🙏

author: A Google user
content: I love 99% of Google Photos. However, using this app on my Pixel 4XL on Android 10 has surfaced some issues. First, no ability to save multiple photos to your device from the app. Instead, I have to open photos in a web browser, or share them to Drive and then download them from there. Second, frustrating integration with the share sheet for most other apps. I shouldn't need to click four or five times just to share a photo in Messages. Otherwise this is virtually a perfect app.

author: A Google user
content: I love Google photos! However definitely would like to see the option to only backup when charging. I take several photos throughout the day and don't want them always backed up. I would like to be able to delete from phone before they automatically show up in my Google photos. I'd also like to be able to turn off photos from messages showing as a folder.

author: A Google user
content: Google has come a long way in regards to managing photos. Shared albums is a great addition. However, there isn't a way to organize (sort or group) your albums. The ability to nest albums inside each other would be great too! I know some is that can be done within Google Drive, but I want to keep my photos in a single Google product. Keep up the great work Google!

author: Bob Roggio
content: The app, the site, they just work. Upload your 1300+ photos you've saved and (ta-da!) The magic happens. Unfortunately if you want to send the photo to Snapfish to print, it's not going to happen. The "high quality" photo is not high quality enough. :( Otherwise, this is a great app that makes it easy to share photos and movies.

author: Alex W
content: Love the idea of locked folders. However can we have the option to add existing folders/albums or photos inside existing album to the locked folder. Only being able to add to the locked folder from the locked folder is not intuitive or easy. Especially with a very large number of photos to scroll through and select. Also could it still be an option to back it up still? I really just don't want some items in search or the photo grid.

author: Bryan Denski
content: They finally added a map view and it works great. My only gripe now is that they don't have a way to create smart albums. In apple photos desktop app, I can create smart albums with dynamic filters. Like, make me an album of photos that begin with a certain filename, taken with this camera, in this date range. My main goal here would be to see which photos I've exported and backed up versus photos I've taken on my phone and uploaded without backing up yet.

author: Tanya P
content: It seems fairly handy. I don't totally understand how it works. I do know that all my fave photos from last 5 yrs are nicely displayed all the way down the scrolled page, nice & safe, they're not taking up space in my gallery. It has come in handy to find old photos that I thought I lost. Just don't start deleting, cause images will vanish from your gallery! Yikes! But handy lil 'Restore' option in Apps Trash saved the day. Haven't found much use for app features, overall great backup storage.

author: Carolyn Quigley
content: Collages are unprintable! I love all the features on this app, but after spending a while adjusting collages to my liking, thinking they would make nice prints on canvas or in a photo book, I discovered they are too tall and narrow for any print sizes available. Furthermore, there is no option to just add additional background to the sides, so the pictures at the top and bottom of the collage are just cut off, either completely, or leaving the subjects headless. Could you please fix this?

author: Mark Brown
content: Very good app for viewing, organizing, and sharing photos. It runs smoothly and the user interface is nice once you get used to it. They also have picture and album recommendations that make it easy to highlight and display your photos. However, the photo editing is very lackluster and bland compared to other apps. Cropping is easy, but drawing and adding text is a pain.

author: A Google user
content: I think this app is very helpful, you can search for a specific picture and find it faster than if it we're just on your phone. It also makes some edits and suggestions that save a lot of time, along with sometimes making collages. It also save a lot of space on your phone when you can back up picture to this app. I am a little unsure of if/ how you can transfer the pictures back to the phone storage. Also when you don't have data or wifi connection you can't look at them. This is annoying.

author: A Google user
content: Love it, though it would be great if it automatically separated videos from photos so I could more easily sort, view, and delete them. Also, the way the photos are sent in an album is weird, the recipient has to go, sign in, and open it, which they usually don't. However sending from the texting program only allows tiny images so it's hard to see what I'm sending.

author: A Google user
content: Liked the app. Very useful. Unlimited storage is the biggest highlight. In my opinion, deleting photos from a album should remove photos from the library too. It is very hard to remove a particular photo from the library once the library is stacked with lot of photos. Also, noticed the photo syncing having some issues at several occasions. Overall a wonderful app to manage all your photos.

author: A Google user
content: The app is great, but i would like some modifications. For archive suggestions, there should be a way to select some to archive and some to delete. Right now it is all or nothing. When adding photos to an album, it would be better of we could search specific albums by typing rather than always scrolling through all the albums. On this app at least i cam sort alphabetically. I don't see that option so it is really annoying to add photos to albums. I'd like to move photos to other albums.

author: Jason Smith
content: 9/15/05- It's a work in progress, I like what I see so far. Easy to see all my pics on multiple devices. 10/26/21- it's come a long way... And lost it's most valuable feature, unlimited uploads at full quality or any quality. I used to get pixels for that. I guess it was too good to last. They get you hooked and you're stuck.

author: Steven G. D'Ambra
content: It's great other than the fact it doesn't sync with other apps well. When your on a different app and you want to upload a picture from.yout Google photos or album in, it doesn't even show up. Some apps I try and upload a picture from.hoogle photos but it's like if the photo isn't downloaded onto your phone you can't upload it making a whole other process.

author: Michael N
content: Getting better with other vendor integration... Would be great if there were an organizing, naming, filing, cropping, rotating... Workspace... Sole purpose being the actual organization and Standardized handling. **I think making G Photos a local cameraroll and simple auto-albums etc. But create something bigger and badder for distributed storage. User ownership and labeling tools, something like...... Lightroom

author: mAkAkA Chaput
content: This is a great app, though it'd be better if you could edit "people and pets" yourself. Like being able to delete certain groupings of faces or being able to add pictures to one person. A bit reason is because sometimes it reconises one person as two different people, and you'll have two groups for the same person. Sometimes it doesn't recognize someone altogether and it's annoying.

author: A Google user
content: Im no inventor and a far cry from a software engineer but I do know that this app is always so much more than what I ever could have hoped it would be. The only thing I can think of that I would change is that when you put pics in albums they would disappear from the main photos screen. Or at least a prompt should appear asking if you want them hidden from the main library. Something along those lines. Otherwise, I love everything about this app.

author: Turok “Dre” 2002!
content: BEST...APP.....EVER!... That was something I once said. But now this app's getting on my nerves. The option to customise organization to your photos is out of whack. Every time I try to organize my photos in a specific order, they suddenly fall to the bottom of the list. Besides that glaring issue, this app is still okay.

author: Janet Totora
content: I have been using the app for a few years. I love how it organizes your pictures by several different ways and the fun albums and videos it creates. I also enjoy how easy it is to create albums or movies of your own and how easy they are to share. However, I am a preschool teacher and I take ALOT of photos. So the limited storage is killing me now!!! Please go back to unlimited!!!!

author: A Google user
content: google photos is great. It allows you to clear up space on your phone by storing your pictures for you elsewhere. Accessing your photos is made easy with Google Photos (even across multiple devices). The only thing that has kept me from rating it 5 stars would have to do with loading. it seems like it can take a while to load all of my images when I go try to access them.

author: James Johnson
content: UPDATE AGAIN: I was happy to see old photos I had forgotten about. Being a Samsung user, I wish I could use this app as my default photo manager instead of the gallery. Being able to delete local photos when they are safe and sound on the cloud is nice. I still wish it was easier to download and self manage your library instead of going through the tedious task of downloading them one by one.

author: Taylor Shantell
content: I'm glad to see the option of moving items to trash within an album has been added. A big plus. I would use the app even more if I were able to have an option to directly download memories . When I see my memories, all I can do is share them but not download them. Also, if I were able to multi select photos/videos and download them. Rather then having two individually go to each video or photo and download them that way. Also there isn't an option to SELECT ALL when adding/moving photos.

author: A Google user
content: I've been using this app for years! It is by far the easiest way to share photos among groups of friends, co-workers, or families, and the ways it integrates with Google Home products are making it more useful by the day. Perhaps the best thing about the app after the amazing automatic creations the Photos Assistant churns out after big picture taking days. The .gifs in particular always impress me, and I get accolades from friends and family for the special memories. Lo & behold, it was Google!

author: James Metzger
content: So far I'm finding Google Photos useful... With one BIG flaw... I used to be able to write on a photo in edit mode, but it is no longer there. With all the freaking updates, it seems to have gotten lost in the shuffle! Also, there should be an option to time/date stamp a photo, but as far as I can tell it isn't an option. Plus, in my storage, I would like to be able to name photos. These options would get you 5⭐ instead of 4!

author: Adele Look
content: First of all: 15GB of free storage is amazing. I can easily backup my entire gallary. Depending on how often you take pictures, it does fill up eventually, but at that point it's only reasonable to start paying for more. I wouldn't recommend using it as your only storage for super important photos/videos, as it definitely isn't immune to viruses and glitches (I've lost huge chunks of data twice in the past 5 years). That is the only reason I don't give this app 5 stars.

author: Skye Bjorklund
content: I love how photos creates panoramic photos automatically! I have gotten some great shots, and the app is easy to navigate for those unfamiliar with a screen or working difficult photo editing apps. Photos is great at recommending old photos to look back on as memories. The only thing i don't like is there's a lot of menus to click through in order to access albums.

author: A Google user
content: I like this app. Used it for years. Have thousands of photos on it. Back up is great: quick and easy so space is not taken up on my phone. The only thing I wish they would change is in the album aspect. I sort alot of my photos into many categories for tasks and it is such a frustration to scroll through 20+ albums when they seem to be in no type of order. If you could select how you wanted them to display (by name etc and some recent at the top) that would be GREAT 😉😁😉 Thank you Google!

author: DeLora Lee Wilson
content: I like the photos app. It would be nice to have an easier way to delete photos that pop up in memories, archive suggestions, rotation suggestions, etc. The app shows me the pictures and then I have to figure out where the picture is stored and then find the picture(s) in order to delete them, which I hardly ever do, so I keep getting messages to add more storage or manage storage.

author: Jellyfish Are Awesome (Karina)
content: I like this for my photos because of the easy cloud access and pretty good editing and organization system, which I like better than a lot of other programs. However, I dislike the limited space that also includes your other Google drive stuff, and the only way you can get more space is by paying. You also have to pay through a subscription, causing me to lean towards finding other programs, considering eventually I will run out of room, no matter what I do.

author: A Google user
content: 06-14+2019, Still pretty much the same. When archiving and backing up of photos, there should be an option to just keep them in the cloud, or on your drive, to actually save space on a device. (06/04/2017 Updated). Wish there were better control and more options. (07/01/2018 updated) Options are still very confusing. Just makes it more difficult to create files/folders/archives, etc. for photos. Just makes it difficult and cumbersome to organize your photos.

author: Amethyst Castle
content: It's very functional and easy to use, the only thing I wish would be improved on is the editing area. While it is easy to find what you want, the quality of the tools aren't the best. Cropping is difficult and choppy, and unless you want to spend 10 minutes finding the perfect fit, you have to settle for a little uneveness in the crop. The draw option is difficult to use as it has preselected colors that do not blend nicely, and the sizes are difficult to manage. Other than the tools, it's good!

author: Elf Spencer
content: Wish it were easier to help teach the algorithm the visual difference between a cat and a chihuahua, but there we are. The automatic animations are pretty fun. And I like that the app will show an album from a year ago to-date; fun to see how things have changed, and what has stayed the same. I do wish I could go back and go through folders of an old phone, after switching to a new one. That was why I automatically synced everything, to begin with. Ah well.

author: A Google user
content: I love Google Photos, how well organized the entire layout is, "the remember this day" feature is a nice reminder of past experiences, sometimes it brings a flood of nostalgic memories. I wish it would be a bit more consistent at times, Also it has a "color pop"which produces amazing photos but this feature in the assistant panel isnt a filter that you can apply to selected photos and just feels like a random selection at times

author: Chance The one
content: I really enjoy using Google photos. It is a great place to store photos that I've taken over the years and with the simplicity of it, the entire Google photos experience has now become my go to place for storing my most memorable photos. Navigating this application is so easy and I would definitely recommend it to anyone digitally storing photographs, videos, and or files. My obsessive compulsive disorder disagrees with odd numbers (5) so 4 out of 4 stars that's for sure.....!!! (=

author: Edward Miller
content: I use Google Photos to store my photos and videos. The interface is very user-friendly, and search works great. Uploading is automatic across devices. Free storage is 15 GB. My only gripe is the name “Photos,” which sounds like it’s only for pictures, even though videos are included. Still, it’s very convenient for managing and viewing media.

author: J.E. Highley
content: Functionally it works well, but it does not take your time into consideration. No option to turn off auto-generated albums; Placing those right at the top means we have to scroll past unwanted interface nonsense to get to the our own photos every time the app is accessed. No option to turn off. From a photo viewing app, I want quick access to my pictures, my way, not your way. At least offer a choice.

author: W N Chandler
content: UPDATED: I have improved my rating to 4 stars because of many improvements including auto cropping. However there is still no group editing, and other editing functions are still difficult, tedious or buried deep. It is still too difficult to categorize photos and organize them in a folder structure. It is unreasonably difficult (impossible?) to send photos (not links) to others by email or text.

author: A Google user
content: Nice app with a a couple things to made it great. Being able to fully edit photos on cell would be perfect. Also, it would be nice to delete from cell and it would delete from cloud. I am not a fan of more social media because I feel, me, not anyone else, I feel we need more face to face in person get togethers. I am old fashioned I guess.

author: Rick M
content: This is an excellent app to store and archive photos & videos. I only have one noteworthy complaint. It does weird things with slow-motion, even when you don't want slow-motion. When storing high-resolution, high-frame-rate videos the app will automatically use a slow-motion function which you can't remove, you can only adjust it. After an unknown amount of time your control over slow-motion disappears and that setting is not readily available in the settings. This is very annoying!

author: Kendra Clark
content: Overall this is a great app. I'm lucky to have extra storage through Google one. If I didn't, I would probably have to buy additional storage which in my opinion should be free. Also would love to see more editing options to keep up with other free apps available. I love that I can have all my Google apps connected and synced on all my devices.

author: A Google user
content: Love it! Very good search-by-people algorithm, that will find your face as a baby based on pictures now 😯. I'm a photographer, and I can confirm that the photo compression is good enough for any non-raw photos. If you know what RAW is and you want to keep photos at that quality, Google Photos isn't your solution. Video compression is pretty terrible. If you want to be able to view your videos at more than about 480p, don't use Google photos as your main storage option.

author: A Google user
content: I love this app. It saves all of my photos, they are easy to share, and they are organized by date or person. I also enjoy when the assistant makes movies and other things with my photos. The only down side is I can't upload the photos to any other app that will let me make prints of my photos. The .25 option on the app is too expensive. Other places you can get 4x6 for only .09.

author: nolan turner
content: I love the app because it immediately backs up your photos ensuring you don't lose them. Like the collages they put together for you. The search ability is very astute for the most part. The editing skills is the only reason I did not rate 5 stars. It's basic so therefore it lacks quite a bit for my needs.

author: Eleanor Barsic
content: I enjoy this app and love its a cloud. The improvements I would like to see are 1) when I add a photo to an album there would be a way to type in which album instead of scroll trough the numerous project albums I have. 2) that I could delete photos inside my albums that I no longer need. Instead, I can "remove from album", which cleans up my album, but then I have to fi d that photo, however old, in my main photo box in order to delete it. =( both would save huge amounts of time.

author: A Google user
content: Super useful, theres a lot of cool features and you never have to worry about losing your photos. The face ID is not great and you can't manually add a face. Other than that fun an useful and you can make albums and order photo books and all that jazz so im a fan. Edit: you can finally manually add a face to a category, it's buggy but it's alright

author: Jacob Kendrick
content: Perfect app for taking photos. Any photo that Google Photos might detect as 'too dark', 'too bright', 'not saturated professionally', or any other corrections that it could attempt to "fix", it will stylize your photos or videos. Google Photos also makes small 'movies' as to the photos and videos that were recently taken at the time of the movie's release, but I once accidentally swiped on one of my assistant's 'stylized photos', and the card dismissed after i missed the chance to 'undo' it.

author: Mostafa Mo
content: It's awesome I love the Google photos app. 2021 update: The storage isn't free anymore and the Google One subscription isn't worth it. Paying monthly or annually for something that will eventually run out means I have to constantly upgrade and pay more and more and more. I can imagine the day when phone camera qualities are much higher and we'll have to pay $500 a month just for storage on google one. I swear.

author: Michael Rork
content: I love everything about this app and service and highly recommend it as something everyone should use. - Dropped a star because it's no longer unlimited storage and there has not yet been an option to subscribe to that. - (Personally I feel Google One should included unlimited Photos storage, and that the storage levels you pay would apply to everything else, like Gmail and all your Drive files, etc.)

author: Coach Adam
content: It's a really good app for storage and basic editing. (I mean BASIC) You can make colleges but limited to the way the app arranges it and the number of photos in the collage. For editing there are way better apps out there. You can create picture books and other stuff, but you have to pay. If all you want is storage, it's as good as any other app.

author: A Google user
content: To be honest this app has it's good points and it's bad points. I love that all my photos are stored and backed up automatically for me so I don't have to worry about losing them, but some of the features are hard to use and a little confusing to me. For example, when I am trying to share my photos with someone else and I try to seen them via text it wants them to sign in or something and I still haven't figured out how to use the sharing thing on the app. If it was a little more user friendly for those of us that aren't as tech and computer savvy it would be a great app.

author: rutto noise
content: I've been using Google photos for so long that it has become irreplaceable for me. It's a good program, weirdly missing super basic features like "jump to date", or "see other photos from this day"

author: Tamir Moore
content: Google Photos is a great app! However, I recently logged out of the app and logged back in! As a result, I lost some of my photos and the app isn't recognizing some of the faces now.

author: Kent-Inge Skjønsberg
content: I like the automatic generated gifs and videos. Overall a good app, but I see a lot of comments about your high resolution DSLR photos get compressed and loose the quality if you use Google Photos to edit them. Even if you have paid for more space. Google: Fix that ☝️

author: Mark Webber
content: Still working on the figuring out part, but looking to dump all photos etc at once with one click while being able to go through and editing only the ones I want to keep, instead of the daily way!

author: Regan McCullough
content: Slow. Error messages are unhelpful. Trying to save a photo edit, but keep receiving an unable to save photo error that's not recoverable. This app also used an unnecessary amount of background data.

author: sam
content: 1. Nobody asked for AI help. 2. The perspective editing tool was the coolest feature in the app. What was the point in removing it? 3. I'm looking for any way to crop my photos OTHER than with this app. The cropping function used to be great; now it's inaccurate and unresponsive. PLEASE STOP RUINING GOOD APPS. EDIT: They readded the perspective feature! Yay :) Accurate cropping is still a bit annoying but I'm much happier with this app now. The AI continues to irritate but I can ignore it

author: Janan Dean
content: Has become difficult to work with. No VPN, complicated to work with, difficult to update. My current browser is more efficient. 4.11.2026 - Easier now I had to learn 3 different OS, including Samsung and iOS. Apple is real different bc you have to use a camera roll Apple only. Just have to switch gears from one to another.

author: Eric James Lenhardt
content: I love having all of my pictures in one place, and this app is great for that. I do have a question about the Remix buttons though, I have been having trouble with my favorite one which turns you into a Pixar type character hasn't been working for a while and I tried again to get rid of all of the updates and then update again, but after doing it I only have the first 4-5 Remix buttons and the ones I have been using aren't showing up now? anyway to get those back and actually make them all work

author: CautiousAdventurer TINTENT
content: I'm a recent convert, and I'm really impressed by the ways I can search for photos, great use of AI. But I have two big gripes. only space for 1 here: I have loadsa albums, and when I want to add new photos to an album, there is no way to order them, they seem to be in random order. Worse, I also can't search for the name of the album, at the time I'm trying to add the photos. It makes for a long and very frustrating process....

author: Jean Valjean
content: Maybe the best for photo backup. The search is also really useful! It would be even better if you could find an album alphabetically when you add photos. It would save time when you have many albums..! I sometimes have problems with shared albums. So I use Airdrop with my family and Airbum with my friends and colleagues. But for storage, Google is still the best!

author: Mis Jane
content: I really like Google Photos, but I wish there was a way to view or recover my pictures based on the original folders they were saved in on my phone. Right now, all the photos are mixed together, and it’s hard to find things if I had them organized into folders before. Please add an option to keep or view photos by folder – it would make things so much easier for organizing and finding old pictures! thank you!

author: Dan Grainger
content: The editing features on Google photos was the main reason that I used it. Now you can do hardly anything! Plus, when you do edit a picture, it saves a copy of the photo at the end of the album; entirely pointless. Aside from a few shiny new features, this is a massive step backwards. I will have to look for another way of organising and editing my photos if this is not fixed! Just realised that you now can't cast from the app either! What an absolute shocker of an update!

author: Guilherme C.
content: There's an incompatibility with Samsung phones that recognizes both screenshots and camera as the same folder. It's a bit annoying to delete everything. Also, we need better services in Brazil, specially now that it's going to be a paid service. Such as the Photo Book. I'm really looking forward to ordering one of those. Actually, it would work as a storage buffer: we could print some pictures and then delete from the cloud to save space in some cases

author: A Google user
content: Love Google Photos. The new version has some amazing search and catalogue features. I really can't understand why all but the most basic photo editing features were taken out? One step forward, two steps back.. EDIT: Some editing tools have been restored over the last few updates but still not everything that used to be in G+ version. Until then it's still just a photo repository rather than a one-stop 'Photos' app. Good, but could be even better.

author: A Google user
content: Fantastic app! Great Fun, User Friendly For Sure. The only downside is not being able to group photos without creating a album, once in the album you cannot sort them into your own order of preference. Also! I found that should you select a number of images to download in bulk, photos doesn't give you the option, you can only download to your device one at a time.

author: Vanessa Waterhouse
content: Nice editing features and the sync across devices is good but the search functionality could be vastly improved. It's difficult to find anything when all photos titles are numbers and you have photos going back to 2007 and earlier. I do like the way it groups photos into genres. I would very much like the option to download/save photos via the slideshows. Once they're gone, they're in the ether and almost impossible to find again.

author: Megan Vos
content: I love this app because I can keep all my photos and videos in one spot, and make seperate folders. There's also seperate folders, the app separates people by their face using racial recognition. You can archive or delete photos, it's really nice to be able to use the photo editor on the app as well. There are many things you can do with them. I can share photos, print photos, and I get memories sent to me and other cool things the app does with some photos. No issues so far at all!

author: Lily Dawn
content: Good app! I just have to suggestions: 1. PLEASE, make it so that you can put things in the trash from an album, it is extremely annoying to have to find a photo in an album that you want to discrad, look at the date, search for that date and then trash it. 2. It would be amazing if there was a view where you could see only photos that were not in albums, that way it is easier to organize. Please take these into consideration especially the first one.

author: Kassie G.
content: It's a really amazing app making videos appear with the repetition like tiktok. Although I had some saved videos a while ago and all of a sudden they disappeared from my home page, but if I were to log into my account on a pc they would show. Don't know why that was so...but I would like for it to be checked. All in all it's wonderful. Thanks Google!

author: Eliot Grigg
content: Overall, excellent. Organises all photos by date and location, and creates videos, albums, and stylised photos for you. Also cleverly gives you the option of fixing lighting on some photos. I do wish, though, that ALL automatic creations were available to view on the app assistant page, not just the most recent ones. Also, be warned: despite what it says, you seemingly CANNOT undo changes after they have been made, and once you've chosen to not make suggested changes, the option won't reappear.

author: A Google user
content: I love using gphotos. I am not an advanced user... just someone who has a phone with very little storage, so the ability to automatically store in the cloud is critical. The only feature I'd like to see added is the ability to organize items in the same way that other Google services do... with tags/labels. I've tried to use albums for this purpose, but it's not meant for that and gets too difficult to manage as the number of albums increases.

author: A Google user
content: Would be good if I could manually label photos the AI hasn't recognized. Like photos of people or pets that haven't been labeled. "Unlimited" storage is misleading, although it's still a great deal. You can only upload a limited amount of photos in their original quality, though I think the unlimited quality is plentifully high for most people.

author: Maddy
content: I'm a longtime user of this app and I've always found it incredibly useful with a decent amount of tools for basic photo editing. It has a very easy to use interface too. I would like to see the ability to mirror flip images, to share photos directly in other apps without needing to manually download them first (they should get temporarily downloaded to send across and then cleaned up), and to allow the user to choose photos to stack together, not just limiting it to the AI to sort.

author: All Sorts of Lots of Things (Nessy)
content: I want to be able to do the things I did in my i-phone, prior to switching to Android. I could briefly check my photos on a daily basis on my phone and quickly move them to various photo albums. It was then much easier to quickly find what I wanted to share with friends or family at a moment's notice. Photo sharing issues between my Mac, iPad and Android phone are extremely frustrating and annoying as I can't sync them with my phone any more so have two separate and different photo libraries.
