author: Ashwin Sundar
content: A true gallery! Much more than just a place dumped with all your photos. Few Improvements: 1. While adding photos to existing album, there's no way to search for the album. Have to scroll through the entire list of albums to find out the one I'm looking for. 2. Would be great if "Hide People" option really hides ALL the photos they're present in. 3. App displays all the info about a photo (date taken, people, location, etc) - would be great if it also shows the album(s) it belongs to.

author: A Google user
content: I LOVE that come what may, my photos are automatically backed up. I also love that I can search photos by content, like "food" "beach" etc and its actually very accurate. For some reason it seems won't upload random pictures sometimes. Its rare, but i wish I knew why. Please (!) get a duplicate photo deletion feature. Sometimes photos end up both on my phone and computer, or may have the file name changed, and gets uploaded twice. With thousands of photos, its a pain to comb through deleting

author: Richard James
content: Personally downloaded it for the back up feature which I think should be brought to Gallery Go. My issue is that folders in the app should be given the option to arrange them via: 1. Alphabetically 2. Date modified.....just like Gallery Go. It is VERY difficult searching for pictures amongst tens/hundreds of picture folders like me. I don't need to add them to an album for a good arrangement. Secondly, when I select a photo to TRASH, it keeps prompting me to allow photos move to trash. Fix 🙏

author: Horváth Ferenc (MrDoctor)
content: It's pretty good app for what it is. I like how it recognizes everyone's face that I took photos of and puts them in a seperate collection. Although it's missing a basic function: video speed. It's kinda annoying that I have to download another app just to play a video a tiny bit slower. Also I haven't been getting any of those memory collections that I used to get everyday even though the option is on. I liked those but now I only get like one every 6 months.

author: Andreas Fehrm
content: Too many frequent pop-up prompts about everything from "Do you want to buy a print of this picture?" to "Do you want to crop/edit this picture?" etc. Even though I have dismissed them hundreds of times, they just keep on coming back like an ex-girlfriend that just won't let go. Google needs to chill out on this front. Otherwise a great gallery app that syncs to the cloud, just a few minor bugs here and there — nothing too serious or cumbersome though.

author: HaSan AkAy
content: Nice app. Good way to back up your photos. I like the album feature. They are always there when you need them. The edit feature is nice. I like the Chromecast slide show feature but the algorithm is bad because it keeps showing the same pictures over and over again when there are hundreds that are never shown. Also if I delete a photo from Photos it should not delete it from my phone. Certain filles are supposed to be kept separate.

author: Alex Marshall
content: This app is usually pretty good, but recent updates have hidden a lot of my favourite features away without a way to access them. For example, there used to be an entire section for "suggested for you" which kept the automatically created collages, animations, and stylised photos in one spot that was easy to access. Now, if I dismiss a notification for an automatic creation, I'll probably never find it again.

author: Simon Zax
content: Pros: Almost everything. Cons: 1: While uploading photos it consumes quite a chunk of our batteries. 2: Since last update, Search bar and Library tab became more of an issue then solving matters. For older folks, it is really uncomfortable way of hard to find photos from different sources then Camera. Suggestion: Make a very hidden setting (as you usually do) where you can revent to old view.

author: Mario G Ishikawa
content: Unlimited storage is really awesome but it's uploading videos and pictures all the time over 3g even if settings are different. Also I don't understand how the settings are different all the time and blocked for me to change. The settings for backup show different on Google plus. Really weird. It's also draining my battery and I can never be sure if it's uploading or not.

author: Anand Ganesh
content: Photos have suddenly gone missing from the photos tab on pixel 7 pro after the last update. Update: No longer an issue as it turns out that I was logged into a different account. But I am giving a 4 star review still as I still see some pics only in one of the accounts, although the backup is turned off completely on all the accounts. Also pls give an option to save edits on the same pic (with an option to rollback the edits), instead of always having to save changes into a separate pic.

author: Garrett Aitken
content: It's a pain to alter files. Rename a file? Good luck. Taking a photo of a receipt, and you want to crop it, rotate it, rename it, and send it? Those options are sometimes presented to you as a blue pop-up offering those types of options, other times not offered. Sometimes when you save your adjusted image, it seems to overwrite the file, sometimes it saves a copy in a mystery location in another folder elsewhere. Its really inconsistent.

author: A Google user
content: This app is pretty good. Definitely, recommend it to friends and family. However, I do have a few gripes about it.   Why oh why, can we not download Albums for offline viewing on mobile devices? Its silly that Google can pick out my dogs face out of thousands of pictures, but can't save an album to the device for offline viewing.  Speaking of picking my dog out of my pictures, I have had this app for years, and an account as well, and the People and Pets section is still only People. Please fix!  So far those are the only issues I can say about it.  So many good things though. Removing photos from the device after confirming they are on the cloud, in order to free up space on the device. Picking my dog out of thousands of photo's is very impressive, even if I have to search for animals instead my dogs name. And last but not least, the assistant, puts together nice collages, memory videos, and automatic albums based on location and time periods.  Well made, with many convenient features. However still lacking a few important ones.

author: Tricia Williams
content: Great app for storing your many pictures. It is great at organising your pictures. It also gives you a history of photos you took on a significant date years ago which is very nostalgic. It's a great app to use and you will enjoy having your photos stored here. If you lose your device all you have to do is remember your Google account and password and you'll have access to your pictures again.

author: Roy Powell
content: Very Good Application. No matter what device I'm using I can always access my photos and videos without the use of a memory card. The downside is that in order to access some files on photos I would have to be connected to the internet. Another issue is not all files are automatically backed up and if you do not manually backup those files you run the risk of losing those files.

author: Claudiu Blajan
content: There are 2 issues: 1) when you delete a photo permanently from trash sometimes it comes back 2) when you free up space some of the photos can still be found locally, somehow it fails to delete them; however, I noticed that they are saved in cloud... I hope at least... Other than that, the app works pretty well now. Much better than it used to.

author: Ilias Voridis
content: I am really enjoying the app and I like the back up system. Fast and easy. I was able to save so many memories and be able to access them from any device. I am a little bit sad, since unlimited backup stopped and it's unnecessarily expensive. I would like to suggest that maybe you could give 15GB every year for free instead of unlimited. Either way I want to thank you for the app

author: Saimo Terranova
content: It is good and fast. . But I don't like the editing after the last update. The old editing was more intuitive and easy, please bring it back. . Another problem is that when creating a collage you can't arrange the photos the way you want, and I can't see why. . A suggestion: ad the option to add text to picture, so we don't need other editing apps.

author: A Google user
content: Great photo storage, managing, editing, viewing and sharing app. Only one thing could make it better... the ability to show only photos that you haven't added to your albums - so you can see which ones still don't have a 'home' - either as a fixed feature, or one that can be toggled on or off. This way, you'll know which photos have not been 'categorised'.

author: A Google user
content: It"s brilliant. The more you find out about it, the better it gets. Except for the lack of ability to sort Albums by anything other than date. Why on earth can't each photo be moved up or down the list, so you can arrange them exactly how you want them. This facility exists widely in other applications, why not in Google photos. Marking down a star because of this.

author: Christian Disch
content: Generally a good app to edit and organize your photos. Would have given it five stars, if it wasn't for the occasional freeze/crash every now and then. Observed this behavior acrose at least three different phones (pixel 4, 5 and 8 pro). On the plus side it's completely ad-free and there's only a single version that includes all the features, although some of the more advanced stuff seems to be available only on the latest Google Pixel phones for a while (eg magic eraser).

author: Kim Kaspersen
content: Quietly backing up photos while charging phone. I like it. Edit: New version is much more complicated and less intuitive. I used to enjoy getting memories from years ago and being able to share. Now they're useless. Albums are gone. I will never use the slideshow. My family can no longer take part. I want my easily sharable collages please!

author: Martin Fowler
content: Wrote my first review for Photos a long time ago, it's changed a lot since then, generally getting better and cleverer. I like the search, I'd expect Google to be good at that. I do see some comments I add getting confused and added to other photos, and manually editing face/names is sometimes hit and miss. Overall I think my photos are well looked after and easy to access.

author: Jorge Antonio Ramírez Padilla
content: Simple to use, with some areas of improvement. When streaming on Chrome cast, mainly with video, after a couple of minutes it disconnects. It might be a thing from the device's side, but still it shouldn't happen. Also, I don't like that it defaults to DCME, backing up Screenshots. I only want to backup camera pictures, not screen shots. Other than that, it automatically backs up pics, so one doesn't have to worry, and the free-up space feature is great.

author: Patrick Sedgwick
content: It's great for storing, viewing, and editing photos (adjusting balance and cropping and so on). But text annotation features, like "Add description" to a photo, or adding text boxes to an album, are much too buggy and by no means up to Google's usual standards. After adding a description to a photo, the description often disappears within a few seconds. Adding a text box in an album frequently causes the app to crash, with the loss of your text. Summary: good, but not good enough in some ways.

author: A Google user
content: This is more than just a way to view your photos. It will organise them for you as well, which sometimes is a bit OTT. But, having said that it has some nice features, like it will identify the people in your photo so you can ask it to show you photos with that person in..... Getting a bit 'Minority Report'?! Or photos of one particular place.

author: Sid White
content: Very good app for storing and organising photos. However, the face recognition thing is a bit hit and miss. Also, it would be nice to be able to group albums together in collections, and the ability to rearrange albums into an order of my own choosing would be nice. Maybe the ability to add a discription to the album would also be nice. But there are some great features, such as the auto animations and movies.

author: A Google user
content: its pretty okay. My biggest concern is when I try to arrange photos in my albums in the order I want them, it only works sometimes. This is very frustrating! please fix this. I would also like to arrange the albums themselves my own way. EDIT: I noticed you can alphabetize the albums, not sure if this is new, or I missed it before, but I like this.

author: Holly Burling
content: Perfect. Still have pictures from when I was a kid, and the only issue I've had is with the backup; you have to go on the app for it to back up, rather than it doing it in the background but thats just a nitpick. The image search works really well, too. You also have to pay monthly for storage and in their defense it isnt much, but id still just rather buy it as a one-time payment. As a result, I've never bought any extra storage. That's what gets it 4 stars. Otherwise, perfect

author: Vincent McCullough
content: This app is very useful, as it not only stores your photos (as you would expect) but it also allows you to categorise for certain things (eg. ducks) and to filter for certain places (eg. taken in Dublin). It also prompts you if you have photos that are taking up space that aren't very good, e.g. blurry photos, or screenshots of videogames. Also, there are of course no ads or in-app purchases. However, there is one problem with the UI, in that it shows photos at different sizes on the screen.

author: A Google user
content: Has great features (like face detection, sync, sharing, among others) but I think it could be better. The way it shows the folders isn't that easy to navigate and as it opens, the main tab "photos" only shows the camera's photo when in fact I'd really like to go directly to the folders, eg: downloads, WhatsApp photos, videos, VSCO, whatever.

author: Erika Andirkó
content: I like the app, but I have a problem. The descriptions of the photos are not good all the time. They used to get mix up. When I scroll down each picture to make a description and I directly go to the next picture because of the same to do, after some descriptions they do not fit exactly when I finished. If I check the descriptions one by one, I see a lot of troubles. So I need to use this method to avoid mistakes: after one description I am going back to album and I choose another picture.

author: Petya Trifonova
content: I very much dislike the new mobile view in Photos, the Libraries tab I find not useful, I cannot see the highlights there, when i receive a notification for new highlight the tap is fine to go to the next picture,but it's hard to rewind, to go back. Usually I will find myself in a prevoius year. You say is's simplified, but for me it is not. I usually do not write reviews, but since this is my favourite app, and most used in my family i thought I'd share.

author: A Google user
content: Nice app, but it keeps filling the valuable phone memory with data. My mobile pics are on SD card, but apparently Google Photos creates duplicates of them in internal memory. Have already disabled backup and sync, but after a while about 1GB of data are again used by this app. Had to delete the app from my phone. - Update: got another phone with 128 GB memory, app works now well. Needs lots of memory, do only install it when memory is large. Works well, with excellent functionality.

author: Jon Speirs-Davies
content: (Edit: I've increased rate from 1 to 4 - realised my settings were blocking background uploads. Even though videos are uploading now, it would be useful to be able to choose what to upload and get an estimate of how long it will take.) Fine for organising and finding photos but backup is terrible! It won't backup videos unless the screen is on and the app is selected. There's no way of backing up 1 video at a time so before I can share 1 video I have to backup them all. Horribly inflexible!

author: Merian Fay Salameda
content: the app is really great. it has been a huge help in maximizing my storage space as i have thousands of photos saved as memories. one thing i would like to suggest is for the albums to retain once it's backed up. i always sort out my photos into albums but once it's uploaded, it wouldn't be the same and i have a hard time finding the photos. all in all, the app is good but i really hope for those improvements.

author: A Google user
content: This is a staple I think everyone should always use to make sure their photos are not lost. I wish I had it years ago when my daughters baby photos were lost along with my device, I will never make that mistake again. I wish there were more assistant photos made as well as more ways to play with photo appearance. A big problem is when I make a collage it often focuses on parts of the images that are quite useless, i need the capability to edit the positioning of each image within the collage

author: Rhett Fraser
content: Good app but my problem is the organization. When you search for something (for example Halloween) It used to separate the photos by dates. The stuff that showed up based on your search were CLEARLY seperated by the date: Feb 14 2000 etc. or Today, Monday etc. for things this week just like in the normal gallery. now it just shows all the stuff related to your search with the date in the far left corner on top, not even showing what's from what date so you have to open the photo to see it's date

author: A Google user
content: Fantastic in terms of storage, albums and face detection. Two gripes: First, it is still missing access to seach when adding an image from other apps, so its useless if you have thousands of photos, and second, guests to an album have access to the sharing link of that album (even if you just invited then through photos), so that they can share YOUR album with whoever they want without you knowing. it doesn't make a lot of sense, if you invited through the app, avoiding sharing the link. thanku

author: Jasmine KM
content: I love Google photos, I have been using this app since forever! It's so much easier to search for pictures, have a backup and not worry about losing a photos, and share them via the app but kinda upset with the new changes that will happen after June! Which means I won't be able to have unlimited back ups and see my old memories without having to save them on my phone, which kinda sucks!😔

author: Joanne Barr
content: Overall a pretty good app, stores my photos and I can't really complain about that an awful lot. 2 little nitpicks for me: a) I'd love to be able to copy a picture from my library onto my clipboard, super useful for when a photo you need is finicky to find! b) the ability to choose between camera photos and all device photos to be shown in the photos section Other than that, it's a standard gallery and does the job for me

author: Sandeep Aggarwal
content: links in your reply are not clickable or even selectable to copy and paste. please make links clickable. also allow to select person or thing in a photo and name it. based on my personal and my children's childhood photos , twice my Google account was discontinued and I lost more than 200,000 photos. I was messaged it is company policy. thank god this last time only the photos which were objectionable were deleted and I was told not to save them again.

author: A Google user
content: I've used Google Photos loyally for the past few years. As much as I love it for its free high-quality storage, I can't give it a 5-star rating while it has the current sorting system. Instead of folders, you can only create albums (without sub-albums). Outside of albums, all of the photos are displayed in one 'main' gallery. This often causes the gallery to get cluttered and confusing. The search function often helps in this mess.

author: Linda Gail Lamb
content: I like the unlimited storage. It would be nice if there was a bit more photo editing options,; but there are editing and photoshopping apps I could download - I'd just need to choose. No real problems so far. Edit June 2022: uh oh !! 15 free is running low, guess now I'll have to pay for more soon. Maybe finally decide what to keep or trash... but I still like Google photos. Nothing is free forever, and 100 gigs won't cost too much on the yearly plan.

author: Tara Baker
content: its helpful to have tge search option is tge best feature far as functionality to me can type in for example miss me I looking for a pic of this old passage I have sometimes it pulls many sometimes just a few all depending on how much you have om there & what you asked it to look 4 facial recognition is nice works well ect

author: Iain McPhee
content: Great and easy way to back-up your photos and videos. Also, the automatic creation.s, collages, videos etc etc are a great little touch. My only suggestion would be to make downloading and/or deleting uploaded photos easier. It's currently quite a long winded process, and I still haven't figured out how to delete large quantities of photos at once.... maybe people just buy more storage rather than try to delete things

author: Steven Ercolani
content: I really love how this app allows me to integrate my photos on Google supported devices. I would ask for two improvements. First. searching using the description I put in. I enter what the subject is, so I should be able to easily find that picture again, but no such luck. Second, in editing to just allow a little more control in the editing process. I can get much better results from other editors like Luminar.

author: Chris Nlewadim
content: Awesome app! I totally love it! It would be great if you could add an option for batch or multiple downloads from Google Photos. That would save time and make it more user-friendly than the current style where you have to download multiple files one at a time. It is time-wasting. Could you guys add an option to checkmate duplicate file upload? And a search option in the locked folder so one can search for files by name or time?

author: A Google user
content: The peace of mind that my photos are backed up trumps everything else. Although it would be great if there were folders like a gallery, that help distinguish the various categories of pictures. Also the stylized pics are always over the top. I am on a Pixel 3 so was hoping the experience keeps improving, but the latest update has really messed the app. Highlights are only in story format, have to go back you just date to see those pics. It would be great @google to revert to the precious verson

author: SE
content: Good stuff, this app. At first I didn't see the point as I already have a Gallery but now I see! It's good to know that all your pictures and videos are safe there, stored. I still use my Gallery the most but Google Photos has a lot of things that the Gallery doesn't. Lots of cool things you can do with or to your photos and albums you can create! It's a fun app. Only thing I'm not fond of is this 'Clear the Clutter' thingy. Apart from that, all good things!

author: Paul Murphy
content: Edit 2021: I had a sneaky suspicion in 2015 that the storage wouldn't stay unlimited forever. Looks amazing, does a great job. Unlimited storage, why not!! Thank you Google. Could do with more control over photo editing, currently fairly limited. Still has a few bugs that need to be dug out. Crashes if opening app straight after taking a few snaps. Somtimes crashes when trying to share to another app such as whatsapp or viber. Overall I'm very impressed though.

author: Ouchtor
content: I really wish there was a way to redownload backed up photos and videos in bulk. There are many gallery-cleaning apps that allow you to go through your camera roll and swipe to delete/keep items, which is something I really need because I'm running out of storage, but they can only access local files and the majority of my images are stored in the cloud instead of my device. Alternatively, if the app had a built-in sorting feature. Except for that, it's great!

author: Francis Obioha
content: Great App. But since about last 3 months it doesn't recognize people and group them to their similar face folder properly, especially photos and videos taken using Snapchat. These photos and videos are just plain photos without any filter but still it doesn't recognize and group the faces and that's a problem that should be fixed. I've updated the app several times and still getting the same results. This makes looking for my photos really difficult!.

author: Ashley McKenzie
content: One of the best app. When you think you lost all your photos you actually haven't - edit: I dont like the update to the search. It's unnecessary complicated and weird.

author: Dennis Ndare
content: it's a great app but please, separate camera roll from screenshots on the main😭. It's really messing my back up storage yet i don't wanna delete my screenshots(just not backed up). Atleast add an alternate option on this, this is such an unspoken inconvenience you overlook through the updates.

author: Aquin K
content: Latest versions stable on my samsung. What I really hate is the amount of storage space, increasing permanently and significantly with every update. 862 Mb at the moment. That's just OMG! Just overhaul the app. Switch to extensions that can be added. If data storage continues increasing as in the past, I will just uninstall/disable whatever possible, rather than buying a new mobile after a year. That counts for a handful of other apps as well, just by the way.

author: A Google user
content: Great app, but could br a bit better in terms of adding old photos to the library. For example, if I add a single photo (that has a date) from a folder that is not in sync, then it goes with the date of today. This is very frustrating... Gets worst because the only way to fix that is by using the app on the PC.. But overall, it is a great app

author: A Google user
content: Google photos on a desktop allows you to edit information such as the date and time a photo was taken, it would be nice to see this option available to do with the app. I often get sent photos on a day seperate to when the photo was actually taken meaning when it saves it saves under the wrong day which really bugs me; I'd like to be able to change the day to the day the photo was actually taken.

author: Isaac Osaretin
content: I wanted to switch from my SAMSUNG gallery to google photos because my phone doesn't have Galaxy AI features. It is a nice app, actually. But it has a lot of issues. Whenever I try to use some photo editing tools, it closes by itself, I cleared the app cache at first, and there was no positive result, I have cleared the data now and still no positive result.

author: Simie Mandla
content: Great app. 4 ⭐s. Only because It just takes way too long for the pictures to backup. If i have a 1000 pictures to backup that day, it's hours before it's done and I can remove the pictures from my device. All the other features and automatic formating is awesome. Been using the app for years now. Helped me save memories that otherwise would have been lost through the loss of various devices at one time or another.

author: Marcos Bernardi
content: The general functionalities are really good (compressing, uploading, syncing, etc.). However, the album's have a limit of 2000 photos each, which is quite annoying, and the sharing of multiple pictures (e.g. all of a specific person) is really time consuming and not practical. Once Google improves those two points I will give the app 5 stars.

author: A Google user
content: It is quite good but it lacks some simple things that can be used in photo editing. eg to be able to pain in colour like you could before. Or to actually change forward pictures color and those in the back scenes another color. These little things would really help. Except for that this is not a bad app Also with a slideshow or making a movie before you had the app so the picture could be kept in a square photo with a fuzzy background with now just a photo nothing more.

author: A Google user
content: Truly a great app with great storage. Photo's are automatically added to the cloud when taken. Photo's can be tagged with a location for easy reference. Create albums to share. Archive photos or documents that you don't need to see on a regular basis. Very easy to use, with access to it from anywhere as long as you have an internet connection.

author: Abraxis Silverblood
content: so, its a great app, but genuinely, i wish i could see my duplicate photos instead of them being hidden, how am i supposed to delete duplicates when i downloaded something twice and and stuck with seeing double when sending pictures to others?

author: Cory Strohan
content: This has gotten better and better over the years. Especially loved the creations Google has offered in recent years, with enhancement suggestions to make some of my best pictures even better, though that feature seems to have all but disappeared with recent updates. Also sad to hear unlimited photo storage is soon to end. Still, really has become almost the perfect photo app!

author: Nick Collins
content: I am frustrated to find the photos I delete in Photos, which has superior photo processing apps, don't seem to be deleted in Gallery when I go there to make albums. I'd prefer to do all my album work in Photos, so I wouldn't have to change apps for that, but I haven't found Photos inviting for that. Gallery seems written for album making. So now I'm stuck with having to make all those careful decisions about deletions twice. HELP!

author: Mary Victoria Basham
content: This new version for April 1, 2026 mentions a lot of things this version can do. like "mess up" my calendar and send messages to people I may not want them to know. And a lot of other things. I feel like it's "taking over my phone" I Don't Agree Or Like That.

author: A Google user
content: In the past, google photos used to make pretty nice compositions and animations out of my pictures. I had a burst of photos taken in the same place while an airplane was landing. Later, google photos made a composite picture with the same background and multiple instances of the airplane approaching. That was very cool. I can't find that option to make such pictures anymore. Can someone help?

author: A Google user
content: Very good app. I use it for all my photos. Amazing for sharing and good for organizing albums. I recently got problems though, because some photos in albums are sorted incorrectly (but only on the phone and in the browser it's correct) and some albums are not fully synced in the app, means that I added photos, but online they do not appear in the album and the number of photos listed to the album is incorrect.

author: Siru “Kiisu” Kissankulta
content: It's great, though I feel like I'm not utilizing its full potential at all. From what I've actually seen, it seems like a great gallery app with (no longer!) unlimited online storage and a somewhat gimmicky, yet very entertaining and sometimes actually very cool assistant that does random things to copies of your photos and videos. -1 star for the biggest change over the years being a - however very understandably so- negative one.

author: A Google user
content: Simply having my phone synced with my Chromebook and PC is keeping my memories and experiences safe. Many people have lost everything to theft or accident but continue storing on vulnerable media. I hate to say "i told you so" but i do anyway. I hope Photos and other Chrome apps and extensions continue to develop and educate, especially for us older ones.

author: KikiKitteh Sim
content: 'FREE UP SPACE' - not working... Please Help!! ((leaving stars as is for now - hoping this issue gets resolved quickly)) only updated the other day & I have 81GB to free up... press button to begin & it goes grey & doesn't go any further than that! I even bought more storage a few months ago just so I could remove all photos from my phone - absolute waste of money though if I can't actually free up my device... thanks in advance!

author: A Google user
content: The only thing i don't like about Google photos are their options when creating an animation... There are none. I want to create an animation but can't do so in my own order, it chooses itself based on the date and times of the photos, which in my case, are inaccurate and so the animation winds up looking awful. If Google could change this, that'd be fantastic!

author: ElizaSavedbyGRACE Abellanosa
content: Thumbs 🆙👍 I've been using Google Photos since 2016, and it's amazing that I can still browse my photos. Just lately, they have asked for payment for the app, and I think it's fair to pay a storing fee :)

author: A Google user
content: This is the most excellent photo app I've ever come across. There was this important documents that were mistakenly wiped out of my device storage, and once I tapped into this awesome app, though not all but a fraction of the documents could still be found. So I would like you add more functions to this app, like if you are not on WiFi or data network, this app should be able to collect all the images if not videos, so that when you're back online, it'll be able to back them up.! Good job 👍

author: A Google user
content: I'm so angry. Don't tell me my photos and videos are saved to the app, then delete them from my device only to tell me after that they were not saved successfully. Thus making it impossible for me to access my videos and photos again. Make it easier for me to save my photos to my device gallery and I will be happier. author: Jebat Isaac
content: I love the app but there's bug.Im using it on chromebook.Everytimes i open the app,the app show black screen. please fix this. but totally your app was usefull bc i was playing game and want to change profile but it only work twice.I Hope dev see this message

author: Cassandra Sunshyne
content: I love this photo app and use it every day but I feel there could be some features added to it to make it even better. First I wish there was a way to add a person to the photo without the app recognizing that it's someone. I find it happens a lot, it might be a side pic and it doesn't know it's me. Also tags would be a great feature! Like the people tag but you can create them, like "Cars", "Tattoos", "Food" for example. I feel it would make finding photos easier if you can group them yourself.

author: Rohitakshya Sahoo
content: nice it's organised and editing with it is easy but if it was a bit more efficient for slower devices then it would it good as mine is a android tablet from byjus 2 to 3 gb of ram so I think try to make it a bit effective for slower thanks!

author: A Google user
content: Since its inception, never have I used any other app for photos on my app. It's a wonderful app, with automatic backup. However, it could be much easier to use, if they had an option to organize the uploaded photos according to ther folder. I mean at the moment, I often struggle to find my snapseed folder once I remove them from the device.

author: Johannes Neukamm
content: Update : I previously called this "everything I want out of a digital photo management solution", but I think as my usage has increased, I've come to see some flaws. The main one being that it's hard to manage photos coming into your archive from different sources. I have a quite extensive pre-mobile photi archive that's rather well organized - on a hard drive in file folders. It's quite a chore trying to import these with something resembling the same organization.

author: Therese Elizabeth Ries
content: every single time you guys update this it makes it more difficult for me to even access my own photos and albums. ever heard the saying " if it ain't broke, don't try to fix it" !? How about you just maintain what was already fantastic, the average person does not need ai or want it .

author: Andrew Doye
content: I use the App a lot. Images for it come from many Sources these days. I find the technology remarkable & flexible! I enjoy the Albums and Memory Collections that are quite regularly created for Me!

author: A Google user
content: Awesome. It's awesome but it sometimes deletes the pictures that are on my phone too, (I think it's something to do with the settings), and another problem I'm having is that the pictures won't load without internet connection. Overall awesome way to save some space for people who have way too many photos and also helps in making collages and other stuff.

author: David Graieg
content: Good app, handy features. It would be better if they kept the free storage increasing or added like 1gb free each year. Works on Android 17.

author: A Google user
content: It works very well. Organized and classifies the pictures quite well. The only problem is to know what's in the device and what's in the cloud. Also, Google could do something about duplicates (for example, the re-sent images through Whatsapp, which are backuped twice, or three or as many times as groups you shared with). Also, it'd be great to teach Google what's each pic ("that's a dog, not a cat"), if I understand correctly that'd will give a huge database to play with its neural learning algorithms.

author: Pennie McIntyre
content: The app is significantly better than the standard android photos, however there are some improvements required. It would be amazing if you could instantly share photos based on faces to more than one account, and if you could include animals. The constant reminders about backup storage is also infuriating, as your storage options are insanely expensive, and I couldn't afford to extend if I tried, so constantly throwing up the reminder is getting incredibly irritating.

author: Jenny Struble
content: I really like it but it lately keeps crashing when I remove a bunch or even just one photo from an album which is really annoying and frustrating when I'm trying to organize but otherwise the app is fine hope this gets fixed tho

author: Darren Frelick
content: I don't always enjoy the colourised pics, but the panaramics are incredible. I had to update this review. I can no longer delete photos through the app. I have not changed permissions, so i don't know what happened. That's a big issue as now i have to use another program or my computer to delete a picture. Not good. A fresh update. The app works well now.

author: Hanna Rotkus
content: Backing up and search features are great! Only few things bother me: 1) Would be useful to see also with the app if the pic is already in some folder like it does on the browser. 2) When adding to folder there to should be option to search the existing album or order alphabetically. 3) Moving photos from device folder to another causes the dates to be modified and files show on wrong order, I'd prefer that to work like a normal file transfer, or even give some warning what it is about to do.

author: Aliyah Violet Decolongon

author: Doe
content: EDIT: Support has been helpful, but the warnings are insufficient for non tech literate folks. Hope to see improvements. Original: Predatory app. Led me confused and caused me to lose my photos before I even had a chance to back things up due to non existent warnings. Never trusting Google ever.

author: A Google user
content: Generally love the app, great for freeing up storage on your phone, and deleting admin pictures like old bus timetables. But would be great to see the assistant improved for example I never use the collage but I'm always surgested them. And easy ways to cut down your own videos. Maybe a function to help delete accidental videos or all black photos would be great too. But love the stylised pictures. Just think the assistant could be more personalised, even if you have to answer a short questionnaire

author: Mihacappy
content: Good app as always with stuff prepackaged on a phone, but has a few issues. Sometimes crashes unprompted, and regularly asks me to upload everything to the cloud even though I always deny it.

author: A Google user
content: The app does a great job at storing and backing up pictures and videos. It has helped me recover many pictures I thought I had lost. I really like it. My only regret is that there is no way to arrange the main gallery into folders and locked their view. When you open the app and first thing you see is a bunch of pictures dumped into the main gallery isn't nice.

author: pattan imran
content: I strongly recommend that Google Photos introduce a dedicated security lock for the app, separate from the phone’s unlock method. Currently, anyone who has access to an unlocked phone can easily open Google Photos and view all personal images, which raises serious privacy concerns. There should be an option to set a different PIN, password lock specifically for Google Photos. I find it so annoying that whenever I want to share something from the locked folder, I have to go there on the app, move it out of the folder, go back to the app I want to share it on, scroll down to the date the picture was taken, send it, and go back to photos, scroll down to the picture again, and move it back to the locked folder. At least let us access the folder directly from other apps by providing credentials!

author: A Google user
content: It's a good looking basic app trying go add a little bit more to the table. There is one thing I wish Google would work on, which is making is easier to organise pictures into categories and albums. I've noted that they have been working on this but there is still options I wish I would see. If I could enter an album or category and then I would have the option to take a picture and that picture would automatically stay in that category/álbum. Using the AI technology that can now-a-days be found in some of the flag ship phones to categorise and separate pictures would be awesome. Do you know how crowded a phone can get with pictures? Make it easier to manage, and you'll have it all.

author: A Google user
content: Works very well with the lowest paid Google storage option, enabling original photo size backups, although it should be used in conjunction with a local backup. Extras such as a moving picture setting called Cinematic Photos and the automated panoramic photo stitching options are excellent, although you can't manually select photos for panoramic composites. Filters, photo adjustment options, cropping, & intelligent & manual photo rotation, are also very good. The free option fills up too quickly

author: Rajae Taylor
content: I honestly do enjoy using Google Photos because it's where all my photos and videos are backed up to so that way I don't have to keep anything on my phone itself. With that said however, I wish they updated the album settings where you can "select all" within an album instead of having to tap on each picture individually. Do that and you definitely will have my 5 stars.

author: Fumnanya Okeleke-Kooper
content: Hello guys great app but there's just one flaw for me. It is impossible to access the albums I create whenever I want to select a picture from that album. I'll need to go through the long process of trying to remember which I saved the picture and that's not good for me. If there is a way you can allow albums saved on web to integrate with device folders that would be a huge plus. Think about it. Thank you.

author: Victoria Bennett Kane
content: I absolutely loved the previous iteration editing functions, but this version feels counter-intuitive. I feel like I've lost control and it's all about AI, too clever. I like my own photo style, I've worked on it for years, I don't want my photos to look too perfect when I edit. I really miss the corner adjust function and would love it back Google, PLEASE! However, I still love the way it manages my photos and I especially love the collages, suggestions, 'remember when' reels.

author: Tobechukwu Emeka-Ukah
content: There has been a lot of improvement since the last time I reviewed this app. But there is still some work to do, especially in the naming of photos that were exported or syned from another device, these photos should always carry the original name as it was originally like when naming a photo with the date it was snapped and other info, these info should not be altered when the photos are imported into Google photos.

author: Nigel Docherty
content: Great app but there are a few things annoy the heck out of me. Lots of updates come out for it but there is never a changelog here so you never know what changes have been made, it is still referring to the clean up tool and has been for ages. Second thing is that when you reply to comments here, on many occasions you include a link to give feedback or find help. Problem is you cannot click the link to go to page nor can you long press to copy and paste the link. Would be handy if link worked.

author: A Google user
content: On the whole, this app is extremely useful and I would definitely recommend it to anyone who has heaps of photos and videos taking up space on their device. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because it doesn't sort photos and videos by their local source. For example, if a photo was in my local 'screenshots' folder, it gets mixed up with everything else in Google Photos. This makes it more difficult to clear up clutter.

author: Hazel Yau
content: great! the option to auto back photos up is good, the function to send files to others is good too. It does ruin the quality of videos a little which isn't great but not a huge deal. you do also have to go into the app for any photos/videos to actually back up to other devices which is also a bit frustrating from my experience, but in general not bad. the free storage is limited but manageable and not an issue if you have somewhere to transfer any photos/videos onto

author: Ashley Murungi
content: It's nice to see that the app creates albums of different people In ur lyf it's a very great way of organization. It's also easy to move the photos when u change phones with use of Google account. Despite the fact that some photos that might have been taken over a while don't usually load or use a lot of data to load it's still a reliable app. Also when a video or photo is edited it comes out blurry or pixelized. It wud be great if that was fixed

author: J.D. Curyer
content: Great concept and handy when operating while in transit and/or across multiple devices. but I still prefere to keep 'offline digital hard copy' (ext. Hard drive, laptop or simply stored on p.c.) as the idea of anything ie: Google, having ultimate control potentially of me accessing my own stuff or not, makes me rather uncomfortable about the whole thing. For example, what if suddenly it becomes mandatory for ALL storage and access to be paid for as opposed to currently just extra storage space.

author: Sara Al Alia
content: I suddenly am unable to restore/download the photos that I have backed up. Usually, once I back up the photos in my gallery, I delete them. I used to have no problems re-downloading some specific photos. Recently, I can't seem to download any pictures. Most of them just don't download at all, or they download, but the photo is always damaged. How can I fix this? I reinstalled this app after deleting it in hopes of fixing the problem, but there seems to be no change in my problem.

author: A Google user
content: Hi! I have an issue regarding saved videos after using the stabilization feature. The new video becomes slightly greenish after saving it. my unit is OnePlus5T. Im hoping you can do something about this. The app is great, it's just that, the stabilized video becomes unusable because of the green tint and its hard to color correct in mobile. Thanks!

author: Li Nal
content: I think 🤔 it's being reminded of old photo brings memories back, especially if you had forgotten of them many good photos stored over years. Always lifts up spirit on a bad day.. ✅. With new phone I see a shot of my photos,then it blanks go settings, done that but no much to for finish, to view my pics. Wasting time and energy to see nothinggg!!! . Should be simple photo,update,finish and view. No science. !!

author: Fever
content: An excellent gallery backup. It's my saviour. I hope there would be a backup option where the files are put in an identical separate folder as it was in my internal storage, instead of everything being all clumped up together so I no longer have to manually organize all my files once it's in the app again to increase convenience. Other than that, very well done.

author: Emilie Tateham
content: Id give it 5 stars because honestly this app is amazing, but since we're getting a gig limit this summe, which I'll definately pass, I have to give it 4 stars. Other than that, i love love the app. Great storage across devices and everything is easy to access with a search bar, folders, and you can even decide what album gets uploaded or not. Love it.

author: Shubham Singh
content: I'm using google photos for almost 3 years. Google is very good with machine learning so it has great optimisations. And recently there are several features added in the app. If there is a possibility to add the option to save device folder in directory based options then it'll be more convenient because I don't think that anyone is going to like to see screenshots in photos section.

author: faradvian
content: I've been using Google Photos for 6+ years and it's my favourite photo app. In the past 2 years, I've had minor issues like: • Video rendering: Videos record well, but will be choppy & almost ×2 speed in the app with no sound. Not a frequent issue though. • Markup: I wish there was an option to change the size of the pen/highlighter, (even if it was just a 3-size option). • Photo syncing: Adequate storage & connection, but won't sync (rare). Other than that, I love Google Photos!

author: A Google user
content: Cannot search the one info field you can add tags to photos?! Doesn't save the file paths and filenames. So very hard to catagorise photos, the main downside with this application. Too much effort to regroup them later in the app into folders. For everything else unlimited storage across devices its a must have. Amazed by its good points but has seriously silly drawback for a search company!

author: A Google user
content: A great app for automatically backing up my photos and videos. The prompt suggestions for enhanced photos, videos, and animations is a big plus. It would've been better if Google added a prompt for photo or video duplicate so that it would be easier for users to organize their library and created albums.

author: Jess Abbott
content: I don't even use my stock photos/gallery apps anymore! Google photos organises for me and is so easy to share with family and friends. Id give it 5 but have a couple of suggestions. 1. It would be fantastic if I could label faces that weren't detected in photos 2. ID like to be able to scan all of my albums and have it pick up duplicate photos and give me the option to delete those.

author: Robert Mandache
content: Any chance we can get rid of the Delete confirmation messages on non-Pixel phones? Running Android 12 on Samsung and it's very annoying to get that message on every photo edit / delete. Other than this it's a very good gallery / album management app. The setup of cloud backup it's very easy, I also set it up on other family members's phones for extra piece of mind.

author: Keith Hammond
content: Photos do not upload. Photos are labelled "Device only". Numerous individuals have asked for help, however none of the suggestions appear to have resolved this problem. From further web search the issue appears to be using SD Card as Internal Storage. Having cleared my mobile data, I reformatted the SD Card as Portable Storage. This gave me the option to store my photos on the SD Card. I have thus far not had any further problems with photos not uploading.

author: Angel Montefalco
content: I edit my review in this app since the photos are bufferring or mixing with other pictures (it is hard to explain since english isn't my mother tongue). For example, if you view your photos into grids, you can see what are those and when you click it, it will show your other photo but not the one you saw earlier (smth like that) :<< I used to love google photos before since it helps me a lot to save some storage for free but then 😭😭 I hope the programmers of this app will fix that problem :<

author: Josh L
content: Unlimited storage, an absolutely amazing search function, cool auto-effects and suggestions. This is one of my favourite apps that I consider a must have for anyone who takes a lot of photos and videos! Edit 2021 - took a star off due to the upcoming removal of the unlimited storage for high quality photos. I understand this is a free service but it's a shame the data allocation is still set to 15gb after all these years.

author: Somkene Nwafor-Ezelue
content: It's a wonderful app, you won't see many better, I recommend, please it'd look a lot nicer if you sorted all the pictures in the photos column, nobody wants to be seeing their screenshots all muddled up with photos taken by camera, or you can add an option to separate all pictures into categories (people, scanned papers, screenshots, scenes) in the photos column, so we can focus on What really matters

author: Suiluj Aznargen
content: I love that it saves a lot of phone storage with regards to saving photos and videos. The backup is reliable enough. But, one thing's bothering me. Everytime I backup my iphone it always leaves some photos in it, and when I try to clear everything up, those same photos remained in my phone's storage despite providing the necessary authorizations needed by the application.

author: Lidela
content: Google Photos is a great app! However I would like to make one suggestion regarding the sync option. It's very nice that photos and videos sync across various devices, my suggestion would be for folders to sync up as well. Having the exact same folders with the same photos and videos across different devices would be amazing. This can be done in a toggle maner, this way, users that don't like this change can just switch the toggle off. Thank you for reading and best regards.

author: A Google user
content: Although the experience is fair good, some demerits entice me to use other apps. First, you cannot put password for your gallery. In this way, anyone has access to ur phone, can see your pictures. Second, the automatic upload somehow has bugs. It needs to be uploaded manually even though I checked the AUTOMATIC upload.

author: shooky shook
content: The app is pretty good, it helps save storage and stuff like that. I never use it unless I need to save storage or organise some photos or whatever, but recently there's been a few "bugs". Sometimes when I put photos or videos in albums, it duplicates and the duplicated photos start flashing??? Hopefully you fix that but other than that, the app is totally worth it.

author: Mark Livsey
content: Had to do a factory reset on my phone, backing up my photo's to pc went terribly wrong somehow but they were all there on Google Photos. Only trouble is i only seem to be able to go back as far as 2012. I still say its much more convenient to store pics on memory card like "the old days" and for safety's sake be able to store them on the cloud too, annual storage plans are too expensive Google.

author: A Google user
content: This is indeed the best and most reliable photo app. Things that need to be added in the app:- 1. Feature to rotate photos with two fingers rotation gesture. It will be very convinient. 2. Whenever I select some photos then click send but I had to click delete (or any other options), then if I go back all photos are deselected so I had to do it all over again. 3. Photos can't be zoomed enough. I use my phone for education purposes mostly, whatsapp photos can't be zoomed to touch the inside edges.

author: A Google user
content: Great app for storing & sharing your photos, gives you lots of cloud space. This way your photos are securely stored away in case your phone breaks or gets lost, stolen; I recently lost my phone, once I bought me a new one, I was able to log into the same Google Photos account and all my photos were there. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5, is because they don't have an option to find and erase duplicate photos, this is a must have option for any photo app!

author: Shweta Agrawal
content: This app helps me organise literally my life (through all my photos over the last decade and more!). But it has become super slow specially when i have a huge volume of photos. Also, the functionalities to do anything with the photos like collage or video are very basic and do not allow for customisation. Would love to see improvements on this front.

author: A Google user
content: Fun app, but a little too automatic. Wish it had a semi automatic mode, where it might prompt you to which photos you want used or you could select from the ones you have. Total automatic nature more rarely creates a product that one likes, however you can go back and do some major readjustments you might get something cool

author: Harsha Vardhan Valaboju
content: Update: There's a hyperlink something like more info. I clicked that, it navigated to a help Google aricle on how to turn backup on or off. I've selected 'do not backup' and the prompt was gone. Old: I don't know if it's only for me, but for the past 2 days, every time I open the app, it prompts me to backup the photos and if I choose to not backup the prompt never lets me use the app. It keeps loading forever. Same again even if I close and reopen. It's frustrating and I can't use the app.

author: Stu
content: Has to be one of the best photo storage apps out there! One thing that's missing I feel is the ability to select all photos in a folder (especially for the archive folder) so that they could all be deleted or moved in one go rather than having to select them individually on the phone app, which is a real pain.

author: Marvia Laurence
content: Sept 9 2020 Now, after the update, I can't share content to my other apps! Last time there was an update, my videos stopped playing. Don't be like other apps that go behind when there's an update. Its a good app. I like it a lot. Makes good compilations of my videos and pictures. No trouble when using it. Only sometimes it takes long to open, guess it depends on how many pictures and videos you have. :) My videos aren't playing anymore since the update. Please help

author: Beana King13
content: Since posting my comment photos had updated to add some great features and plenty of new options to organize, find and share precious memories. Thanks Google, you do actually listen to the consumer. Good but takes some time to download large amounts at once. Better to do a couple at a time. could use some more edition get features to be more creative

author: A Google user
content: It could show a folder or something like that with recently added pictures. Because the app automatically adds photos by the time they were taken. So, if you wanna find an specific recently added picture, it's impossible. Or you're gonna find one picture in one date and the other one in another. This could be improved. It's a search mechanism to be added.

author: A Google user
content: It would be nice if it had the option to select and download all photos from an album. Another good option would be to be able to select all photos from a shared album and add them to a personal album (the web app allows this). Nonetheless, it's a wonderful and beautiful app that saves valuable disk space when it's running low!

author: A Google user
content: Amazing unlimited storage but it doesn't back up everything automatically. And I wish that whatever folder the pictures were in, they would still be in that folder when it's backed up because that's the point of having multiple folders in your devices, too keep them organized. It would be a big help in saving time and effort for not having to reorganize all that content again

author: Robert Dickinson
content: Great for backing up all the photos. Easy to upload from devices and from web too. Great editing features for photos taken on phone. Recent updates have annoyed me as you now can't download the raw versions on desktop without having to click in every photo. Time consuming as it downloads one at a time to a separate zip file. Still great for back ups.

author: A Google user
content: Useful but not effective to limit storage. You'll love to have all your pictures sync between your devices, but your phone will suffer problems in the storage: Even the app has an option to delete backed up photos and clean storage, it will keep a cache copy for all the images browsed (on my device it caught up to 8 GB of catched miniatures). You may move the app to external SD, but catched files will remain in device's internal storage.

author: Planet Sedge (SaZ-C)
content: An addictive app for 'ediT' freaks like me, with many gReaT features - syncing works well, creating albums is easy (& you can choose yr cover pics - shown on shared links!) Reason for 4 not 5 stars: (a) 'Description' option under Album's title was removed, so aLL your info about an album must go in the title; (b) Adding a description under a photo is no guarantee it'll stay (& no 'save' button) OR that the same description won't repeat under other (unrelated) pix! A LiL frustrating..

author: Atıl İlerialkan
content: Great app, great suggestions. Although, it has some sync issues when uploading pics on mobile. In a shared album, when you try to upload media, it shows as uploaded but no one else gets those until some time. Upload indicator notification is also not consistent, both in the website and on mobile.

author: A Google user
content: It's a smart app. Backs up all the photos. Unlimited storage at high resolution is a plus too. I called it smart because it automatically created edited images and stories from our photos. I would love to have following features 1) duplicate photos finder 2) Identify full resolution images 3) Sort images by when taken. I am not sure if that's possible for down loaded images from any social media / messenger..

author: Kingsley Gift
content: Great apps, some how I can use the Google one feature free. My issue is with cropping and editing an image, when you crop, it going back to the newest. Why can't cropping be alongside the one from where it was cropped?... Going through a 1k+ photos, you crop and you are back to the beginning having to find where you were b4 you cropped. That is why I usually by pass the app when I want to clean up my storage.

author: A Google user
content: The app is easy to use and organizes everything very well, the big problem is that if you don't have a WiFi connection, this app consumes a lot of data just to see your pictures. I hope that Google fix this problem, I don't even have activated the back up option and still consumes data, As I say before... Just for see your pictures.

author: A Google user
content: Can you please add a feature to display pictures and videos by folders from which they are added and to display those in albums automatically, or should say, to create an automatic copy of a device folder and to save it there, so I don't have to do it personally, it would make it so much more convenient for a lot of people with a bunch of photos. Over all this is a great app, but if you add these changes I think it would be used by a lot more people as the stock galery app.

author: A Google user
content: This app is a game changer, it's free, it saves all the pictures you want, it has great editing features BUT there are many downsides: sometimes it will randomly "forget" to save a bunch of pictures and leave them out, so you have to check carefully that everything is really in there before deleting them forever! And biggest pain point is photo quality: the quality of images saved is really reduced a lot from original quality that's a shame...

author: A Google user
content: a very intuitive app, you can edit your photos or it can do it for you, offcourse the photo backup option is great, and the other best thing is it works on your laptop as well, you can just drag any photo you want to add to your album and drop it here. The only issue I have is that creating and managing folders is a bit complicated for me.

author: A Google user
content: It is a great app but I do hope that you would give us an option of arranging the contents like by date, by name, or by size. Because from time to time I can't find the image that I needed and sometimes I really want to arrange the image by name so I can easily find it rather than typing it.

author: Rachel White
content: this app is pretty cool, I like the gif animations it makes for you occasionally, some are pretty funny, it was just now showing me a photo collage of many photos of a kitten I just sold. It made him look too adorable and now I want him back :D lol. Luckily when I tried to pause it, it went to the need to update screen and woke me up from my stupidity.

author: Abhishek M'c deepak
content: Beautiful app. It help me backup it photo only which I want. I would like to say that if organizing the the photo in the album can be a bit more less complex because in the album identifying photo with respect to a person (i.e. facial recognition), two set of album is created for the same person even if i delete it after some days the same thing happens. And I do love the stylized photos generated by the software...

author: A Google user
content: This is very good app in case of storage. It don't have some required functions as 1. We can not add filter for search by date, month 2. We cannot make folders for some albums to organise our important documents. 3. We can't select whole album for archeving as we need to select images one by one. Please add some more features to take google ahead of its competitors like flickr, Dropbox, Amazon etc.

author: Paul Clements
content: Very clever photo editing getting better now loving the unltd storage, for those wondering why you can't share to social media after you have pressed " Free up Space" that's because they are longer on the phone they are on Google photos cloud servers. So you have to look at Google photos pick then one want and Re download after you told it " Share too" (you now pick reciepiant service or person)

author: Balaji Doraiswami
content: Good app. Free from the annoyances of ads intruding often like the other equivalent apps. One glitch is that while browsing by sliding the pages, the order of appearance follows file size. Even when you sort by name (a-z), while browsing by sliding each page, the appearance or the browsing do not follow a-z by name. The browsing happens only by file size - smaller to larger. This must be corrected so that we can choose how the image order changes while browsing. So 4 stars only

author: Chantal Collins
content: For the past 3 yrs since i had this app. There are some photos and videos (especially albums) that got deleted by mistake in my gallery and i did not know how to restore or get them back. But this app made my day when i found all my deleted photos and videos (but not all) and i really loved that app since that day. That is if this is the reason you want to download this app, it works great!!!

author: Guy H. Martin
content: Many people will hearted tell me reasons why I shouldn't use Google Photoes. They can have their other apps that do so much more. I get it! I also like it because of its ease of use. Google provide good apps to their market. I am on a disability pension which leaves no room for purchasing software. I use as well cause I get it free.

author: Janis Bertrands
content: Alright, I am glad to say that I can improve my previous critical review, because it looks like Google has spent some time improving the app. 360 panoramas look better. Editing interface feels better and offers some interesting tools (like changing the background look on portrait photos of your device supports that). I, for one, enjoy the updated interface. And finally the search is insane... Basically finding anything without any tags it such. It's almost creepy.

author: Tshepo Eric
content: The app is quite good and reliable. Its user friendly, makes it easier to share your media to other relative sources. And i love how it reminds you about your past memories those that i personally forgot about. If there are any changes to be done, i would recommend the theme to be changed, and for privacy sake keep the recycling bin hidden in options rather than exposed for retrieving information.

author: A Google user
content: It's a good app. But there are some limitations. E.g I can't hide all photos of one person from all sections of google photos. The assistant creates albums from the same holiday in separate albums and I can't merge the two albums. I have to add all the photos from one into the other then delete the first album.

author: J
content: Since the latest update my albums have been very glitchy. Can't open certain photos, and when I can there's another one in the background or when I hit back it goes to a random spot I wasn't at in the album. Please fix. Edit: posted this last year and still nothing has been done. Edit 2: everything has been fixed and it now works well.

author: Morgan Parkinson
content: Great functionality and regular updates. Edit: last update took away "for you". I haven't been able to navigate to auto collages etc anymore. Much less intuitive for me. The main reason I open the app is now gone and the notifications are just there to remind me that I can't navigate it anymore.

author: Ser Aelon
content: This is a great app. I love almost everything there except the fact that I can't make a movie and share the file independently. Each time I make one, I have to share the link for my friends to see what I have done, which is kind of annoying. The second thing is "Pictures Collage", I can't chose more than 4 pictures, not even the position of the pictures. Everything is done automatically and no changes thereafter. So, 4 stars. 😌

author: A Google user
content: I would have given a complete 5 stars if there was a way of customising the download locations of photos from apps like facebook or pinterest. Furthermore, the stabilization and video editing features are not working for some reason (cannot save changes). I am using a oneplus 7 pro and have tried uninstalling and reinstalling the app, clearing cache and storage. Also I have all the updates installed. Google, I don't know if you will read this, but please try to fix these bugs.

author: A Google user
content: So far not too bad. Only thing I don't like is that photos that go to cloud get compressed and all those albums disappear once they go to cloud. In the 'photos' tab, I'm forced to scrolllllllll long way to find one photo. I don't get to just jump back into my album the way it was prior to cloud transfer. Change the photo compression please. Make it the SAME as when the photo is taken on the phone. Keep albums as they are, just make the cloud storage a: 'copy to cloud'

author: Curtis Miller
content: Love it for so many reasons. My only critique is having to use device folders for albums, because other wise, you don't have access to photos on the cloud for uploading etc unless you just want one continues device folder called "Camera". I just want all of my photos to be in albums that are stored as albums - google photos doesn't store your divide folders as albums, you instead have to recreate a new album in the library (or cloud) part of google photos. Very inconvenient and not streamlined.

author: HUBEDY BUBEDY
content: Does almost everything you need, with a simple interface and fair pricing. However, if you upload photos and delete them from your device, you will have to download them ONE BY ONE to get them back. There appears to be no option to select multiple photos for download. The browser version of Google photos has this option, I don't know why it hasn't been added to the app as well.

author: A Google user
content: I find the synchronization problematic. Especialy when it comes to deleting pictures. Once a new picture is uploaded to Google cloud then you have to delete it as many times as many devices you have connected to the cloud, or so. Never figured out the always working pattern of deletion. On the other hand I find the assistant/story generator amazing. It gave me lot of fun.

author: A Google user
content: I really love Google Photos & all Google products. And that's the reason I'm now a proud owner of a Pixel device. But there are few things which needs to be improved. 1. Add option for editing timestamp on Google Photos on Android devices. 2. Option to manually tag a person if it is not recognised by Google Photos. As in many of my photos the other person is not even recognised & not shown under info of the photo. Then I'll surely give it a 5 star rating.

author: A Google user
content: This app is great in backing up my photos/videos and offering good features. I came across it by accident and thought that I was going to lose my photos when it started backing them up at first. I got scared for a while not knowing exactly what I did to start the backup but once I spent more time with it I realized my photos would be okay being saved on google. The only thing is the quality of my photos and videos are not the same once they were backed up? They look too dark. Why is that Google?

author: Tomislav Hren
content: Google Photos is the best thing ever BUT 4 stars because under some circumstances it's just bad. For example, when I has Samsung S21 Ultra, uploading 10 photo took ages. Literally more than a week. Now, when I have Pixel 7 Pro, it works great. Another thing, sometimes, and I don't know under what conditions, I see duplicate photos in my library. I'm not 100% sure but it occurred to me that it might be due to adding those photos to the shared library.

author: António Rodrigues
content: Changing my review, as it seems everything is back to normal 👌 It used to be a fantastic app. Last updates have ruin it. Loads of bugs (just read users comments). I wiped all cache, reinstalled, and I am still waiting for the "getting your photos" to finish. For 3 days. App currently is useless. Photos takes ages to upload, when uploads. New folders are not auto-uploading new photos (just... why?! How hard can it be to make it an option in settings?). And Google is silent about it?

author: Jaikrishnan K
content: Very good, unless it decides to behave like a spoilt kid. Anyway it teaches you a lot of patience. Once it does that being spoilt, it can create a lot of problems like not at all updating photos using any type of data. Sometimes it latches on this wanting to use only mobile data, else it will always wait for WiFi even if you're connected to WiFi. Or it will just keep telling you that it is getting ready for backup. author: Hanan Alsham
