author: Milano
content: I love this app, however there is a flaw according to me. The reason I didn't give 5 star is because of its editing feature. I use Pixel 7 Pro. When I open a photo from the 'Photos' menu down below, it gives me option of 'Edit', however when I open the same photo from going to the folder I created in my library, the edit option disappears. This is frustrating. I have thousands of photos and it difficult to find a photo from All Photos displayed.

author: A Google user
content: it's pretty useful. especially in those moments when I need to free up some space on different devices, but don't want to actually lose my memories and moments. I only wish it uploaded larger files amd file amounts faster...but I assume Google is already working on that. otherwise I have no complaints...at least not any that come ro mind.

author: Bryan Cronquist
content: Love the app! All except for the fact I know I made 2 videos. And they disappeared... Completely and utterly. They weren't in a single backup I have 4 different ones, so yeah. Not in a garbage file, or a "vault", not on my Google 1, Google Drive, One Drive, or Acronis backups. But besides the Low picture edit options, still believe the camera is equal to the plus 8's, slightly different quality. But I can take pics in the dark, zoom in and still read contract fine print. Not with the Plus8.

author: Rose Grijalva
content: Google Photos keeps changing my face label cover photos. It keeps randomly changing these cover photos on its own. I changed them back and a few hours later they changed them to the lowest quality photos again. Now they are placing photos under the wrong person who's not even in the photos and I can't even put them under the right person again. I've never had this problem before I've been using this app for about 10 years now Hopefully, you can fix this bug.

author: A Google user
content: "star"ring photos (marking as favorite) doesn't always take, & I often have 2 do this several times b4 it does; photos/albums r sometimes slow 2 back up, even on strong Wi-Fi w/little or no traffic. + photos & albums r slow 2 load on devices that they r not "native" 2 (already on). otherwise, a gr8 picture app 4 managing photos/albums on multiple devices.

author: Brian Squires
content: It's okay as a default app but it's quite limited. One thing I find anoying is when I add photos to an Album I can't change the order of appearance. Update: tried the suggestions made by the developer and they worked! Observations I'd like to offer are that it would be easier if a "move photos within album" tab was included within the "Edit" feature. Only the original owner of the album can make these changes, the recipient can't edit but any changes to the album will automatically be updated.

author: Kathy Clark
content: I love that I don't have to worry about losing my photos. People are often complimenting the photo quality. It's great that the app often suggests better versions of my original photo. I like that I can organize my photos into folders and then reference those folders to show in my Google hub as a slideshow. I wish there was an easy way to add them to Google Drive in a folder structure rather than keeping them on my phone (Pixel 4a).

author: Ghausan Riana
content: Me: *Accidentally deletes an important image from my teacher in my gallery, and tries to find it in Google Photos Google Photos: Gone. Gone forever... Me: *Accidentally takes a screenshot, spent hours deleting them in my gallery, then goes to Google Photos Google Photos: Here are all 47 of your accidental screenshots you've done in last couple of hours Great app, a little tricky to use and it's quite annoying how we need wifi in order to see pictures, but it's good.

author: A Google user
content: Fine app. Good for downloading, everything else. Just wish there was one add to it, deleting a whole folder. Say there's multiple albums full of photos and gifs that you just want to get rid of, so, instead of going in and deleting every photo, just delete the whole folder like that.

author: A Google user
content: I would given it 5 stars but navigation in album is hard. Say your album has 500 pics and you want to go to last pic to edit. There is no way except to scroll & scroll down the 500 pics until you get to the last pic. A pinch to zoom out would be very nice to navigate within album faster. Also allow reorder of pics in album (oldest first, newest first etc).

author: A Google user
content: Love seeing the little surprises that the app comes up with in the way of animations and collages. Of course not all of them are worth saving but they definitely give you ideas on how to better organize your pictures. I would rate it a 5 if those same suggestions were easier to edit and fine-tune them to something that I would want to save. update 3/2019 still waiting for more editing features but LOVE IT ANYWAY! unlimited storage, automatic backup, face recognition, and Easy to use.

author: A Google user
content: Easy backup for all photos and videos. Gives peace of mind. Took away 1 star because: 1) I am certain that some of my photos disappear. 2) after creating the heavy reliance on a great offering, without preamble I suddenly received the notification that I needed to buy more storage. Not the best customer experience.

author: A Google user
content: I find the automatic back up a great help. My previous phone corrupted and I was very scared & sad, expecting I am not able to see stored photos there. But I was surprised that those were automatic uploaded & it made me happy. Thank you so much. The only thing I could criticize is the limitation of storage of google photo, and it offers users to pay for larger storage.

author: A Google user
content: It is nice to have all my photos accessable on any device. Fun feature of making videos from whole time periods or vacations. Groups pictures and videos together for a personal touch you can shar with friends. down side is i have lost many photos from switching phonea and the automatic back up isn't backing up my content.

author: A Google user
content: I love this app, esp for backing up photo and they're all in one place One thing I would love, is if it recognised duplicate photos and gave the option to delete them instead of me sifting through my gallery to do it. Like it automatically backs up and syns my pics but if I've been sent multiple photos it's quite tiresome to look through them all.

author: gems
content: Google Photos has always worked for me, but there's one thing that bugs me. This app needs to not only back up the device's photos, but also register which apps they came from so that they remain organized in their designated folders. After you back up photos and delete them off your device, they all get grouped up into one place in Google Photos - the main page. Unless you manually make albums for each folder BEFORE you delete from device, it gets a LOT harder to search for specific pictures.

author: Christopher Nieman
content: Awesome! Love this app and quite pleasantly surprised by it from time to time by different features. It does and suggests things to make my photos better. I just had it automatically take a bunch of photographs I took at the same time and stitched them together to make a big panoramic photo. Just super easy to use and couldn't be happier.

author: Sarah Worley
content: I wish I could see which of my photos are not categorized and sort them like I can besides people or animals, Give them tags. So that it's easier to find and upload photos through apps like foap, who make you download one photo at a time. We need more tags other than people or animals. Like sunsets, documents, and food, or plants. Thanks for making the access to Google photos possible via other apps. It's pretty great having free storage space for all my photos and videos all in one place!😍😃👍

author: Patty B
content: Far from perfect, but it's the best way I know of now to back up photos without much effort. It'd be so much better if you could manage albums and photos by different criteria, sort by name, sort & display all albums alphabetically, drag& drop pix from one album to another. I wish they'd not retired Picassa.

author: Kim G
content: It's a great tool for people like me, who has tons of pictures, and wants to great creative with them. I love the collages and animations that Google makes with my pictures. And they also give great choices for background music to help you mix and match 'til your heart's content. The only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is because nothing or no one is perfect, lol😊💙😊

author: James Russ
content: It's fairly easy to use and is a great option to help save storage space on your actual device. My biggest complaint is that you cant just directly download a large file from Google photos to your device. I recommend saving larger files (that you want to keep in your device's storage) to a separate folder. Then check your settings in Google Drive to make sure that you don't have that folder set to automatically backup.

author: A Google user
content: I like how it makes collages, movies, side by sides of pics of the past with pics of the present, and animations; all on its own. Then it allows you to review these and save and /or share them. I wish it was better at choosing the pics it uses since sometimes it doesnt use pictures that are focused.

author: Manish Kaneria
content: Great app. However you should give better search functionality esp to search photo on the basis of Metadata or EXIF parameters. it will be very helpful for professional photographers. They would be able to search photo by their camera used or by lenses used etc. Also the info on photo should display these details. If you give these features many pros will subscribe to Google Photos.

author: Deborah Murphy
content: As long as I worked within the windows platform, I was quite satisfied. But I now use almost entirely an Apple device for almost everything except a Samsung tablet that my recently deceased husband gave me. It seems to take forever to sync between my iPhone and my tablet. It is a constant source of frustration because I have a need to see the images on a larger screen. The screen on my MacBook cracked in a moment of carelessness during the pandemic lockdown so repair was drastically delayed.

author: Gerize Kleynhans
content: I have always loved everything about this app and over the years it just became more and more...intelligent However I have uploaded alot of very old photos and manually fixed the dates. But they are never included in the daily highlights and memories. I would really like to see all the photos included....especially these ones

author: Lia T
content: I rely on Google photos for a lot of my photographic records, from capturing phone photos from travels and day to day outings and shopping, to receipts and shopping comparisons of products before purchasing. I like that I can add captions and descriptions and organize images and also archive them. Searching is intuitive. It is easy to add photos to Google maps and keep the timeline record of places visited alive with images taken on those days. Accessibility is convenient.

author: monolie
content: I've been using Google Photos for years now, and I like it but there's one problem: I can't revert cropped photos back to the original anymore. I definitely do think it's cause of the updates that I installed a few months back. I've tried to click all the buttons when editing to see if it'll let me, but it's no use. Please bring back the revert option because it was really useful.

author: jorge luis valero flores
content: This google tool is great in almost every aspect. But I wish that you could have more options when using the "freeing up space" software, so that you can chose how much space to free from your device. For someone in a third world country like me that doesn't always have access to the internet, it comes in really handy to have all your documents offline... If you could tweak that into the next update it would be awsome.

author: A Google user
content: Very nice app! The app itself has many nice features, including, but not limited to, facial recognition (so it can sort the people into groups) and clearing clutter (and it doesn't delete the photos)! It *does* work offline but not as well. After about a month of photos, you have to wait for the pictures to show (if they do at all). Other then that, I have had a great experience with Google Photos, and I would recommend it to other users.

author: A Google user
content: I love how the app is set up and that it backs up everything. Useful when you get a new phone. I put 4 stars since you can't add any photo to the favorite section which some I would love to save there but can't. Also I love the face recognition to help you find pictures of people that use your feedback to improve. But it's sometimes slow. Right before I got a new phone it found old pictures with people from over a year before and isn't the best at updating on finding them.decent job though

author: Laura S.
content: Finally my years of photos on multiple devices are searchable and organized! I only wish there was a faster rotate function rather than having to go into edit then crop then rotate. It would also be helpful to have the option of categorizing photos into multiple libraries instead of just albums, since half of my photos are personal and half are for work. Would be nice if there was a side by side compare to more easily decide between duplicates.

author: Ameen Ali
content: Google Photos should increase its storage capacity beyond 15 GB; 15 GB is far too little.

author: A Google user
content: Super intuitive, and easy to use. My only complaint is that there are options in the Assistant mode that I can't figure out how to create myself-- color pop, for example. every so often Assistant will create a "color pop" photo (everything is black & white except for one item/area), but I don't think the option is available in the Google photos Edit mode.

author: A Google user
content: All in one all purpose light-duty photo storage and simple editing in an account based cloud, i really like that I'll be can store as many photos as I want without impacting my storage quota. I would recommend this app to anyone with a Google account that is signed in on more than one device. The ability to share whole album and specific photos is convenient even on a mobile device and downloading files is a quick click away.

author: Robert Coleman
content: Love the fact that I can trust this app to truly have my special memories saved especially when I run into problems like once having to factory reset my phone I had no worries knowing my photos were most important really to me and to loose them after so many years would have been such a bummer but thanks to photos everything was there perfectly. probs- space in general - I kno how to fix now knowing to save at lower quality & still have wonderful prints. Worst issue-hacking have had big probs

author: Aman Sharma
content: I think one more feature is needed here, to particularly adding any pic in the people section because it does not always show every picture in the people and sometimes it merges to people in one album. So strongly recommend I feature to manually removing and adding any picture in any people group. And self creating a people group and adding pictures in it.

author: Quintin Padilla Jr
content: Both logos are good. But I do like this one more. Even tho, I don't have much to say about it. But it is a good app. I download a bunch of stuff and the images go really clear and clean. The only problem is the album. When you show a link and to it again without copying the link it makes another album of the video you're shearing. Wish album is better. But nether less. It's a good app.

author: Cally Adele
content: It is nice having the comfort of knowing that even if my phone gets lost or I lose my computer; my memories will still be accessible and safe. I wish the initial amount of space offered was higher, and that the larger storage space you can purchase would be less expensive. Another downside to me is how sometimes I would end up with a lot of duplicate pictures saved and using up space.

author: Chevaune “Storm” Harrison
content: The ability to automatically backup photos is brilliant and having almost instantaneous access without having to worry about storage is GREAT. Keep the great features coming. My one major problem with this app is the inability to automatically find and delete duplicate photos is extremely frustrating especially now that the unlimited storage has finished.

author: Soni Bonesz
content: mostly positive. i like that it keeps my photos on the cloud and that i can use google apps to switch info from phone to phone. but my pixel 3 had an issue with this app where it restarted randomly as i was backing a LOT of stuff up to the cloud and about a 3rd of the photos were corrupted when it started back up again, even on the cloud, even on my phone. also, it says in the description of the app that you can upload unlimited photos and videos for free but you really only get 15 gb

author: 4 psw
content: It's OK. I really don't like defaulting users into sharing images by web link, in part because the feature seems excessive as well as a bit subversive. I also don't like photo printing services features, and immediately disabled as much of them as allowed. Printing photos is essentially passe for far more than most customers, so it seems quite odd to be so heavily marketed.

author: Ger K.
content: Extremely good photo backup app from Google (plenty of space given) but I have found that photos are not automatically backed up from time to time. I ave gone into the app on more than 1 occasion and found photos pending. I have unlimited mobile data and have this enabled. I'm not sure if its to do with the fact that I use 2 mobile phones and at least 2 tablets all signed into my Google account. I've had to disable and re-enable photos app to get it automatically working again. Have tried search

author: Sahiel Qader
content: So when I open the Google Photos app on my phone, the profile picture in the top right hand corner, does not update to the latest profile picture I have on at any given moment, which is really anoing for me. *Update, it did update the profile to the one I'm using now and all and all the app itself it's not bad maybe slow at times but not a bad choice for a photos app.

author: A Google user
content: The app works great, it gives you collages of the albums you've made, it actually has unlimited storage but it lowers down the quality of the pictures a little bit, it's not that big of a deal anyway, the only problem is that you can't store anything from your phone because if you want to delete something to make some space it just deletes the photos from the app as well, you have to upload them manually on a different album, but aside from that everything is fine

author: Katherine Leimeister
content: Thus is a good app. It saves EVERYTHING though, which is good sometimes, but if you take a screenshot and just want it for a minute to share, it keeps it here. You have to remember to delete it or you get a lot of junk. Editor is good. I have Google One so I get an enhanced editor. Overall, I like the fact that I can do what I want on my device and not worry about whether I'm deleting the picture forever.

author: troy3danto
content: Organized well, easy to be use. Tho I don't like that on my phone, when I edit a photo and click save, it automatically saves a copy of the photo. My iphone would allow me to save an edited photo as the original (which would replace the original, if I wanted). Seems like an easy enough feature to include (says the guy who writes no code).

author: A Google user
content: almost perfect, keeping things organized, sharing with people without mess. but needs more features like select all in the search results so i can search "paper" and archive everything in the results. ability to search for all of the pictures which doesn't have the location data so i can add locations to them. ability to add pin point location data.

author: christopher osadebe
content: I like the smartness of this app. it can help you to recover your long lost pictures and videos. I am in love with this app honestly.

author: something something
content: Update for Gemini, which is not ready for prime time. I needed an older photo for work. it took four different searches to get what I wanted because Gemini failed to locate the photo. The old search still works great! Works great now. Love the photo sharing with me wife. No need to send each other pictures of our kids - they are already there! I do wish the video editor and collage maker had more options.

author: Natasha Kearney
content: Usually love Google photos app, but I've given it one less star because since recent updates I have been unable to save edits within the app. To save edits, even just a photo crop, I have to save a copy which then puts the photo in a photos editor folder. This is cumbersome if the photo has been shared, and I then have to remove the original from the shared album and insert the new cropped photo. It used to work beautifully before. Please fix.

author: A Google user
content: The color pop in which the background becomes black and white while the objective in the picture is in colour ; the edges are not so clear. At some places/edges the objective is also in black-white while it should be coloured. These are the small things developers should work on else till now interface is good and suggestions are also OK.

author: Aryaraj Biswas
content: This a very good app. I can store all my memories in it. Editing options are brilliant. It also has a plenty of space, even albums can be created. Now here is the reason why I did not give it full 5 stars. Some days before, when I used to edit a picture, SAVE and SAVE AS COPY options were there. But after updating THE 'SAVE' OPTION WAS GONE. IT WAS NOT THERE. ONLY THE SAVE AS COPY OPTION WAS THERE AND THEN I'LL HAVE TO DELETE THE ORIGINAL PICTURE TO LET THE ORIGINAL ONE ONLY REMAIN. Can you fix?

author: Mr Villain Khan
content: Great App, But Free Storage Is Less ( Only 15gb ), They Must Expand The Storage In Further Updates.

author: A Google user
content: ATTENTION DEVELOPERS... Please add a setting to backup on a schedule or only at certain times! It's frustrating... I'll capture a temporary screenshot just to send it to someone then immediately delete it from my phone, yet the app still backs it up! Or, when I edit, crop & touch-up photos, the app will backup the pic at each step of the edit... Thus unnecessarily uploading 4-5 temporary pics vs only backing up the 1 final pic. It would be MUCH better if it were to only backup the photos I want to keep! Please consider adding this option.

author: Periyarnesan (Doc Hudson Hornet)
content: Good app, but we can only see photos online, so that is a problem. I hope Google will let you fix this in an update.

author: A Google user
content: The service the provide to backup all your photos and videos at no cost is just awesome. But the app is a little buggy. I tried leaving my phone to backup all night only to realize it didn't do anything. Also once I thought clearing app data was the solution to an issue that I couldn't get the app to backup some files, and then it just got the app to crash itself a while after opening each time, forcing me to go through my gallery and delete some media somewhat corrupted until app didn't crash.

author: RICHARD COZZETTE
content: Still really good but charges you for anything over 100 GB. Try and get 250 gigs it makes you buy a whole Terabyte! $10-20 a Month!

author: Cody2 Lee
content: only issue I have is sometimes I'm connected to other people's photos and I don't understand how to block that

author: Shankarnarayanan Tr
content: good, but i also want to restore my file manager documents, files photos videos etc which got deleted by mistake

author: Amitabh Rajat
content: Make feature of faces ..manually drag and arrange faces into a custom order like folders. Face should be arranged as user. Existing order is not understood and irrelevant

author: Kolorob
content: If possible, add the color pop option. Because it was an important part of the photos.

author: matthew leimbach
content: Great app, not much to complain about except I wish they offered a way to change the pin to my locked folder from my phones pin... like if someone breaks into my phone all of my sensitive photos and documents are available. Also considering we have to pay for storage I would hope more options for editing would be available but over all pretty cherry app.

author: Cas
content: I know many people have said that the interface is easy to use but I find it difficult to distinguish between photos/videos that have been automatically saved and those that haven't. Apparently any photo/video that I take with my Android is automatically saved but screenshots and downloads have to be saved manually. That's perfectly fine, I just wish it had been specified during the introduction. Otherwise, I truly appreciate the service of being able to save and archive my favorite photos.:)

author: Brannon Eatmon
content: I think everything works great. I just wish you could make certain photos or albums password access only. They should also make it where if you add a photo to an album, It removes it from the album it was in or at least ask if you want to keep or delete the original location stored for the photos.

author: Janet Atkins
content: I feel like I can protect my photos better. Now I just hope I get it installed right so I don't lose my pictures .

author: mahender pratap singh rathore
content: this is good but does not have storage for pics but it saves our beautiful memories that are so cute !

author: SUPRIYO PATRA
content: I like this app very much but there is no in build app lock option. please add an app lock option on the Google photos app.

author: A Google user
content: I have been using photos for nearly 3 years now and I'm more than satisfied. The features like back up and many more are awesome. The only feature I miss here is when backed up pictures are deleted from device for freeing storage can only be found in images and not in folders which is headache while searching for any old images which used to be in folders. So if you can do something that backed up and deleted images can be found in proper folders. It will enhance it's user experience for sure.

author: v i
content: Overall great app but it's lacking some important features. I was hoping to finally have a solution to separate my personal photos from my work photos. Unfortunately, it will just show all the photos from you phone's gallery, even if those are not on Google photos. No feature to identify/remove duplicates. No way to download multiple photos at once. No way to move photos between accounts.

author: Jason Kelly
content: Would like a flip photo option to flip reverse selfies. Have to use Photoshop app. update: they now have it. thanks 👍

author: Stephanie Clark
content: I love that this app automatically backs up all my photos. I do wish when I deleted a photo from my phone it would give me the option of deleting it from this app as well. The photo editing stuff is versatile and easy to use. I also love that it builds stories and makes animations from my photos. Definitely worth the download!

author: Hoyt A
content: No privacy! I love Google but this app is not conducive to privacy. You can "archive" photos so they are out of your main feed but other than that there is no easy way to hide photos from your main album. There is also no way to seperate your photos unless you make a separate album for everything, everything ends up on the main stream and without the ability to hide photos, its worthless for privacy. The nicest part about this app is that you can obtain them across all of your devices.

author: Shashank Mishra
content: overall ok it doesn't some features all though. I like the way they change the look of the photos application

author: Chandraprabha
content: I have a suggestion: you should add a feature to delete duplicate photos in the app. This will help to manage storage.

author: Melissa Collier-Smith
content: The only thing I don't like is that certain preferences sometimes revert and have to be selected again

author: Blue_light Øg
content: If I say that this app is not de best then I must be laying trus me if I say that this app is de best... And the sweetest thing about the app is you can update it and it more faster that way I can not do wet out this app

author: A Google user
content: I cant compare to other photo apps, but must say, I enjoy Google Photos... My big gripe, these modern days, is that now everybody can take & put out photos from their swell cell cameras, so my former skills no longer stand out... and the world is swamped, and diluted with captivating (and NOT) images... Oh well..Im over it...Sooo convenient!

author: A Google user
content: I love it! this has been a lifesaver since losing my photos on my phone on 2 different occasions. I love the automatic backup, and like the photo creation options in the assistant. the only thing I don't like is when I choose photos to animate, the animation is a lot slower than when assistant does it automatically. I would like to see the user created animation speed be the same speed as automatic/assistant animations.

author: Avery G
content: I want to specify the storage place for downloaded photos. Like when I download photos from Instagram, it's automatically create a new folder called Instagram. And screen shot are stored separately. I would prefer I can choose to have only one folder for all them. I can only edit the time in the camera folder, but I can move every photos to that folder, it doesn't make sense to me. It would be helpful if it store the time of the photo created, instead of the time I downloaded it.

author: Matteo Dalla (Sgnap)
content: Good, space really becomes an issue soon, because the app itself works well

author: Iaine Stell (Leafshade)
content: I love how this app has so many options, and how it syncs across my devices without even using Bluetooth. My only complaint is not having more options for editing photos of the sky. It's difficult tweaking the values and everything to make the sky look better without making it look terrible if I change too much of the values. Other than that, good job Google!

author: Mark
content: Its fine, however often I cannot select a photo for to send to whoever because the pics are blacked out.

author: Abraham • (Wìseåb.)
content: ...a highly functional app for media viewing, editing, curating,sharing & auto-upload to the cloud. It can be better, keep improving all features..👍🏽

author: Jenny's Animations
content: Works fine enough. But I really don't like the new library update, I used to just press "Library" and have all my folders there but now I have to click all this extra stuff just to get to my pics. Also if I edit/crop a video, the quality drops significantly. Half the time my camera folder doesn't open either, it just keeps loading

author: Ivan Augustine
content: Anyone experience a green line when zooming a photo? im using a Samsung and have green line on Googe photos but not on Samsung gallery.

author: Alan Locklear
content: love the "create" feature. wish there were more options for remixing photos.

author: Kitty Cat
content: Google Photos allows me to store my photos and videos, I just wish they would bring back the free unlimited storage

author: Sylvester
content: Everything is gud but pls quit asking me if i want to backup all my photos every time i open the app. I don't want to backup all my phone's photo.

author: Tommy Chase
content: I mean it's okay. It's just that sometimes I can't I mean I wish sometimes I could do picture and picture on my phone. Other than that it's keul.

author: Mandy Amoeferie
content: Very handfull to use this app but one problem is that google one is not available in my country. so please help us to make it eligible so I can use more space thank you

author: Samad Khan
content: I had much better experience of using photos its a highly recommended App to secure and save data either its your private data or Not

author: Moses Abiodun
content: Very good app The AI integration really takes it to the next level, the ability to search for picture using natural language is amazing

author: Jacob Dycus
content: excellent easy to navigate many organized categories and sorting options easily share with social media

author: Agnello Guarracino
content: Has it's moment, but far from perfect. Extra functionality that having a Google one account provides is great, if only it didn't appear so randomly. For example I could take 10 photographs in identical light conditions but it might only offer to fix lighting in 3 or 4 of those. I have a photograph of a delightful cafe in Dartmoor I would like to erase the telephone lines from the image, but the magic eraser button has disappeared for that image but it's available others. It's infuriating.

author: Alan Klosinski
content: Photos is great because it keep all of your photos in one place, and backs up screenshots and photos from other apps. I would have given a 5 star except for the recent announcement that they are going to stop offering free unlimited storage. This was very helpful and I cannot afford a subscription just to keep all of my pictures, so it will be back to the old-school hard drives unfortunately. Google makes enough money that I think this is a back stab to all of the people using their services.

author: Carly West
content: For the most part this is a pretty good app. there are some very minor little things that I might change.

author: Yayaati Pandey
content: Photo searching is cumbersome, and there should be a feature of making album folders to put all kinds of albums in one

author: A Google user
content: efficient and clean app. thank u. Would be awesome if we could save folders within folders (albums) and when adding to an album, it would be really helpful to be able to look at the albums in alphabetical order. Only thing I don't like is when I want to send a video via text or messenger, and it makes me alter video, maybe make smaller, i don't know I'm not that photo app literate. That part is dumb to me.

author: Abraham Nkansah
content: I love each upgrade for this app. It's so easy to use and in fact, very great! I love it. It's sometimes too slow to load pics and videos. I use Samsung A32 and Samsung Gallery loads pics and videos as soon as you open the app but this one takes longer to load. I hope it's not from the app and it's my phone instead but if it's the app, please fix it. Thanks...

author: Sunshine VanScoy
content: meh. I mostly find it frustrating and NOT user friendly. its great for storage but not as a gallery app, which is what im stuck using for now. EDIT: ok the app is MUCH BETTER since I did original review. I use it multiple times every day. Couple suggestions, the filters are very lackluster and I wish when you edit a picture there was a way to just save it as it is and not save as a copy. If there's a way to do that I haven't found it yet.

author: Antoine Jackson
content: The app is free, convenient and powerful. You can create folders and organize your photos and videos. You can set the app up so that it backs all your pictures and videos up, instantaneously. You can share your videos and photos several ways. It's also a good way to bypass the size limit restrictions in Gmail. It's really a great app!

author: Allison Van Kooy
content: I love almost everything about this app except for the tagging AI. They have made great improvements to the feature, but you still can't submit a tag if the algorithm doesn't pick up a face. If someone is turned around in a picture, the algorithm can't pick it up, but I can't tag the person unless I label the picture. I don't mind labeling, but I would like the label to merge with the tagged photos of that person so I don't have to search it manually. Otherwise the app is wonderful!

author: A Google user
content: A life saver app. Helps store all the amazing memories on the cloud. Have been using it since a few years now. However, im rating it a 4 star because the back-up keeps stopping as soon as you leave the app. This never used to happen earlier. Now as soon as you leave the app the back-up stops. Developers Please Note: The feature to start backup as soon as phone is plugged in to the charger needs to definitely come back!!

author: Ja C
content: I find this app really easy to use and to back up photos with. I wish there was an option to back up a photo but not have it go to all my devices. Some pictures I don't necessarily want synced to my child's device so I can't back them up. I also can't figure out how to get all of my folders backed up. It will only back up certain ones and don't give me the option to back up others because they aren't listed.

author: A Google user
content: Great app! 👌👌 'Bulk Actions' could do with improvement; Search & Select based on OCR etc. Also inconsistent Backup & Sync - Bug ... if (say) you select one month's worth of pictures, and say one (or a few) of the pictures have not been backed-up (due to above inconsistency/ bug), the app does not show which picture(s) have not yet been backed-up, and you have to go through a thousand or more pix to manually to identify which one (s) haven't yet been uploaded Keep up the good work 👌👍

author: Josh F.
content: This app used to have an occasional automatic feature that would identify and group identical photos so you could delete the excess. I haven't seen it in a while. And my account is becoming frustratingly full. I would be very disappointed to find out that this is deliberate in order to force people into feeling as though they are in need of buying more storage. Those of us with thousands and thousands of pictures may not even notice it's happening.

author: John Scott
content: It was maddening tryin to get photos took on phone to appear on my chromebook. Then as soon as I posted the inital review I found out the problem. In order for sync across all devices you either have to be in wi-fi mode or allow it to happen through your plan minutes. Once that was worked out things went a lot better

author: A Google user
content: Will you care to organise the backed up features in the same folder as my phone!! It will make navigation much smoother! It's really a pain to navigate by dates when i am just looking for a great pic of mine. Yes,face based albums are available but you can't use them when you're trying to export a picture, like setting a profile picture gives me goosebumps! Please stay organized!

author: Dave Walsh
content: I have used this app for a number of years now and my photo album collection has grown to a stage that they are beginning to get unruly. The thing that I would like to see is the adoption of folders (eg by year) and the ability to sort photo albums alphabetically by title. I have been scanning old photo albums and putting them in Google Photos. Unfortunately, although I date them by title and year, they show up in Google Photos by uploaded date which is not how I would like them to be sorted.

author: Felix Gonzales
content: really great app, one of the few that constantly improves and rarely seems to take steps back. BUT I think it would be cool to 1. have some sort of collage option where we can edit photos how we want instead of it being made for us 2. having the option to save an original photo as the newly cropped one. so instead of "save as new" we just save the original one to the newly cropped specs.

author: Diana Yin
content: I think the app and the backup and the library are all awesome. But it still backs up my photos even when I turn off back up. And when the photos back up, I can't find them on my device anymore. So I have to go back and download every single one I want to keep on my device. I do wish there was a mass download option with selection.

author: Blaine Ericson
content: I love the app and the way it saves all my photos into my Google account even ones that I had several phones ago from a different carrier more than 8 years ago. the only negative thing I can think of is that the photos app is not available to select from when adding a new contact. if it were readily available to all the apps I would like to access photos from I would rate it 5 stars.

author: Sayli Walve
content: It's not only the photo gallery, it creates albums by date, by category. Also recognises faces, place and activities and differentiate them together. All the photos are backed up and frees up the space. It shows memories of the past days. Collage, animation, movie are few of the best utilities.

author: Skylar Marine (Skyfox)
content: Maybe it's just me nitpicking (the app does a decent job at editing jpgs, though Samsung Gallery does certain things better), but I wish there was a way to improve, using AI, the resolution of Gifs the same way Samsung Gallery does with jpgs. Also needs features for editing RAW photos; but otherwise, it's not half bad.

author: Serenity Patterson
content: I love this app it saves all my photos and videos! Another Reason I enjoy this app is because if you go on Pinterest you can download an image and it will save to photos!! Only 2 problems. 1st when you want to delete more then 1 photo there should be something to select and delete multiple because I am lazy lol. 2nd there should be a way to delete photos but not delete from device! That's all I have to say. Overall I enjoy this app! I highly recommend it!! Have a wonderful day/night and be safe!

author: David Katzenbach
content: Has great options for a default editor. Would be PERFECT 5 star ⭐ review BEST PHOTO APP if it offered 1) color fill option for quick corrections. So much more accurate and hastle free to simply pick the desired hue already in the photo (or even picking from chart) and dropping it where needed. and 2) selective editing - ex: my skin is always dark which makes my wife sometimes appear pasty. I hear her groan when trying to correct her skin tone without making mine even darker.

author: R
content: Much improved since my last post. No longer glitchy. I usually never have probs and find this app very well designed. Recently though it's been opening on its own during other functions telling me it's not working. It asks to send report, I do. Still no improvement. It keeps shutting down when I open to access too. Help please!

author: A Google user
content: Nice little apps, keeps my phtots automatically tagged, organised and available. Nice to be able to create custom albums and movies and share it with your friends. I would give 5 star, if it allows me to save the photos in original quality for free. This option is either reduce your quota or requires you to get a paid subscription.

author: Regina Glenzinski
content: It has some great editing features but could use a few more. But I like how you can save everything into one area. And you can also save a copy so you can save the original plus what you edited into the photo that you thought would be best so that if you want to print it you can do future edits on the original if you don't like what you did on your phone. So overall I think once with an update with more features that allow some more editing features on there I think it'll be a spectacular app.

author: A Google user
content: Feature request: make it possible to automatically import photos from certain device folders into an album. For example, the Instagram photos folder on device, should automatically go into an Instagram album in my Google photos account. The reason being, is that if I just set the Instagram device folder to be backed up, when you free up space, these photos get deleted from the device, and it is almost impossible to find 2 years worth of Instagram photos now, because they re jumbled in main album

author: A Google user
content: This has come a loooong way since my last post! PLATFORM: So much easier to utilize, integrate & access. OPTIONS: All the bells & whistles that I need and much more. LINKING, SHARING & BACKING UP: Phew! Able to synchronize with Drive, Devices & Other "non-google" apps is like, a lifesaver. Losing 2yrs of all my photography work on a device that crashed (literally seconds away from uploading to cloud, backing up) was a freakin' travesty. Makes me want to cry just thinking about it!

author: Chimaobi Irechukwu
content: Great app,one of the best I've used if not the best,but I had a problem with the locked folder of the app.I moved my pictures into the folder and everything was gone,I couldn't find it anywhere on the app.I don't know what to do,its like everything got erased from my phone's memory similar to my other phone. Edit-Problem has been resolved,thank you guys

author: A Google user
content: Good app overall. But just when showing the back up process on the top right corner, show the photos/videos which are getting backed up when we click it. Just a preview is not enough I think. I have asked this because there are few items which are just showing "Backing Up". Even when switched to Mobile Data and turning the "Videos" toggle in Mobile Data option.

author: A Google user
content: I absolutely love the app, the way it organizes photos by date rocks & with the auto backup feature (wifi only or cellular) pretty much guarantees you wont lose your pictures. That is a stress relief for sure especially if you dont have a backup of any kind and have all your pictures on your phone that risky. Sharing albums with other google photos users or anyone, & you can see when they viewed them. only issue is moving photos folder to folder takes forever i use another app for that.

author: Kevin N Thompson
content: All my photos are organized into albums on my phone. Everything backed up to cloud with google photos. When I needed to factory reset my phone I mistakenly assumed they would remain in their respective folders. Since I'm a photographer I now have to re-sort an incredible number of photos... Google, would it have been that hard to keep their album designations? Now I have to find a better cloud backup service. Also, you really need to make watermarks possible. You want to be professional!!!

author: Jessica DeVries
content: I can take my photos anywhere I go and on any device...I love this app!!! This app is the only reason I have pics from 8 years ago off my babies and me together... Otherwise they would've been lost! Thank goodness for this app. It does have done issues with backing up pics and then I go in and find that they're not backed up anymore... And backing them up to my drive doesn't mean they're saved to my drive, sometimes either, but other than that, I love this app.

author: Derya Kosucuoglu
content: I think the app is good but it is sometimes difficult for me to understand if photos uploaded or not a small icon next to photos would make it more understandable. Also I wish there was an option for to make a collection of Albums. I want to keep a collection for my familiy, relatives, business, information and if I would be able to keep albums under some headers/collections it would be much neater.

author: D. Marcia Samuels.
content: Google photos are top notch. What I find however, is the inability for photos to be removed from the front, when they are placed in albums. A term called 'desk top'. More space is available then. Moving photos to locked folders serves a useful purpose; the photos cannot be seen. This is ok. I need to tidy and clear the 'desk top' when photos are moved TO albums and storage. Also, photos can be backed up when moved to locked folders. This happens now. TKU!

author: A Google user
content: For an app that has access to all you upload, I've never/not yet, had a problem with privacy. The link share function has worked flawlessly. Kudos for that alone. As far as cloud storage, ...and access from anywhere (with proper credentials) Again: flawless. Keep doing what you're doing. And, keep your noses, out of our business. Four stars: rarely do I give a five.

author: Stephanie Jarrell
content: I liked it better before all the changes. I cannot access all photos on my phone since the update. It doesn't seem to offer new movies /edited photos anymore. I wish you were able to change the size of the collages you can create, for example, to be able to make an 8x10 photo collage would be useful.

author: Stuart McDonald
content: Up date. My phone bit the dust after a love affair with gravity several times in one day. Anyhow the upshot is now I'm back to using a Moto phone and all is well. App works well. All I can say is that somewhere my other phone was just not allowing photos to work as intended. Funny as apart from photos everything else worked ok, apart from when it broke after its terrible fall.

author: Mon IsPrepared
content: You know, I like this app. It's simple, I can find and backup photos and even free up space on my phone thanks to it. However, after the update, whenever I want to download a photo, it just doesn't download at all and I need to restart the whole up, which is pretty much annoying to be honest.

author: A Google user
content: Good app with very limited options and not at all customizable. No sort option, cannot make an animation or movie within the folder or album. I don't understand why the photos added to a album or folder are still visible in photos album.in things folder you cannot choose what to show and what not.and more, Overall a nice app with many flaws.

author: A Google user
content: I really like Google Photos. I have used it to create photo books. My one gripe is they rely on AI a lot and it does a pretty good job of identifying people correctly, but when it is wrong I can figure out how to manually correct it. I have searched the Google support forum and all suggestions don't work.

author: A Google user
content: Loving the new Photo Frame feature. Smart and useful search. Editing features are quick and fast for basic enhancements, not all-inclusive but enough for practical purposes. Recent updates appear to have dropped a hold-drag to select multiple picture/videos instead of clicking one by one. Lost 🌟 here, please bring it back or share a tip on how to do it.

author: Anthony Ramirez
content: Amazon Prime members can get free unlimited photo storage. Google no longer gives you free unlimited storage but they do give you a lot of free space. Additional space is currently cheap but a monthly fee. It's automatic backing up everything so it's one of the most valuable apps for anyone who doesn't want to lose their photos. Melt sure to go into your device settings and uncheck the box that says your phone will turn off this app if it's unused for a long period of time for backups.

author: Ralph S
content: Having a frustrating problem with this app. Normally after I share a photo with someone, the next time I share a photo they will show up as a suggested conversation. But there is one recipient I'm sending to who never shows up there, so I have to go through multiple steps to send to her each time. I can't figure out why I'm not seeing her under "Send in Google Photos" (to the right of "New group".

author: Jaimie Sorgh
content: Super Better app!!! I'm giving it four stars just because I'm expecting more exciting improvement and Additions, if not, this app is more than the five star!!! Well done Google! You've really help me to retrieve my photos on my missing phone! I wish there is an option to be able to upload recordings!

author: Gagan Josan
content: Best gallery ever. Just a suggestion: When we edit an image from an album there must be an option to automatically add that image to same album. I have thousands of images and sometimes I edit a picture. The picture is saved as a copy and than I have to scroll back and find that particular picture and manually add it to album. UPDATE: I don't know why we can't just override the original image while saving instead of aaving as copy? Every time I edit a picture it save as a copy. Let user choose..

author: A Google user
content: Works fine. Needs better date selector so we can easily jump to specific date in the timeline. Scrolling just doesn't cut it when there are several years. Also it would be really cool to be able to use search when using Google Photos as file opener (i.e. when you need to open a photo in some other app and choose "open from Google Photos").

author: Harvey Tilleman
content: This is a top quality reliable app. It allowed me to put together and sort years and years of picture backups from many different devices and finally get rid of all the duplicates. I can take pictures on my phone and view them on my computer or my tablet with ease. The only reason I do not give it five stars is because the 15 gigs free amount of storage is not enough and has not kept up with the times.

author: Christina Martin
content: I love being able to access my photos through Google. Anytime I take a picture or have one sent to me I make sure I save them in my Google photos. If my phone is lost, broken, or stolen I have a peace of mind knowing my pictures will be saved in my Google account. I rated the app 4 stars because in my opinion with all the technology Google has, the editing features could be a little better such as variety of filters and other things. But overall its a great app.

author: Ameena
content: This is my primary app for backing up photos into my storage. I like the new features (the photo editings), and generally, the entire app. Although, one thing I've been constantly noticing is that sometimes, when I try to edit or download an image, it tells me "Unable to edit, check your connection." It's really frustrating because I have 0 issues with my connection expect for on Google Photos.

author: Aparna Sista
content: Its not backing up videos on my device any longer. Its a real flaw the app has shown now. Its strange that I can't open it's settings too. App itself can't be opened. Earlier, all files could be opened and backed up. Even backed up files are lost. Can you please look into the situation people at Google photos? Its been very disappointing lately. 31/08/2020 No response from app development to grievances. App doesn't work like earlier. Please respond

author: Kelly Walker
content: I really like Google photo's as it will back up from my phone automatically. It offers options on occasion, of similar photo's, grouped events and photo book suggestions. It will also archive things for you, but I wish it had an archive OR delete option. Sometimes I may take a photo to remind myself of something when shopping and don't need it but forget to delete it after. Then it is wanting to archive it and I would rather just get rid if it altogether.

author: A Google user
content: I like this app very much, makes for easy access to move photos to albums or share. have just now experienced the colleague feature, nice option. Made a photo book of a recent event, was easy to put together and not too expensive for a hardcopy to share. Check it out when you get a chance!!

author: Carolyn Holston
content: Other a LOT of blank spaces, excellent! However, that problem only occurred shortly before my divorce, & he was very vengeful, including crippling my left arm. He may have done something. But the app is otherwise fabulous, & has always met my needs, with 1 exception. I am not able to access all of my photos in order to post on Facebook/send to a friend via email. Would LOVE to find out how to fix (if possible) that!!! 😭

author: Angela Dearinger
content: I am about to do what you've explained. Yes, I have lost photos due to the storage issue. If I had known about this before I downloaded the app, read the information given, I probably would've used it to begin with. I am now about to empty the app, put all videos and pictures on my Laptop, and keep using it. I will be More careful with the app from here on out. It is a good app. Giving 4 ⭐. I wish we didn't have to pay for extra storage, but I do understand you have to make some kind of profit.

author: A Google user
content: great photo app. organizes my photos well. would have given it 5 stars but it will not allow me to store high-res raw photos on my SD card and view them through google photos at the same time like a thumbnail. so each photo taken has to be downloaded to SD card separately... not convenient for a professional photographer shooting on the fly out in nature or around town just for fun.

author: Sassy Devil
content: UPDATE: I'm happy with the app, and it's added some features, but I still worry that when I go to transfer to a new device, it will undo all my folders. I really like the quick edit options, for when I don't want to spend a lot of time just to add a note or caption on an image. PREVIOUS (07/25/20): It's pretty good. It seems to do well. I wish there was a way to accurately organize a huge number of images easily when you haven't in the past, but that's my fault.

author: thessa rose valor
content: Almost perfect! I hope that you will upgrade the app where the synced album will be saved as album so that the photos will be easy to locate. When I save my album and cleared the device, it is very hard to find the other photos on the specific album because it will be saved depends on the date it was taken not by the album where it came from. 🤦🏻‍♀️ Looking forward to your solution for this issue.

author: A Google user
content: I don't this is a bug or not, but when I view the pictures from my album, some of images are blur/most likely cannot reload the high quality image (only the photo I have taken using my phone (photo taken from other user is ok), already backup and already cleared from my phone). However, i can view the high quality images using google photo on the website.

author: Sherry Danielson
content: Easy to use, but would like more editing option" when making book s, hard to move picture once Google photos had lays out the suggestions. I ordered 2 different books for my daughter and had a more than afew duplicate pictures because 1) I couldn't access the pictures from the first book I just made/purchased. 2) it's difficult to drag/drop or move the suggested picture by the app, sure you can change the lay out, which is nice. After 3 book purchases still trying!

author: Maria Xena
content: Not crazy about the layout of the photos as of today. Since the updates (past) the layout of the photos are all over the place. They are not in sequence from the first added to the latest added! Ex some photos that i uploaded last year now show as recent, it should of be the opposite! Whatever!!!! Grrrr...

author: A Google user
content: this is the app that my phone came with and of course you can't delete it so I use it. it actually surprised me by being very good. I wish there were more editing options though. the unlimited storage for pics and videos is truly awesome. I can take picture after picture and don't have too worry about running out of memory. I love three assistant. most other apps don't have that. and it's very easy to share photos with my friends and family. I really do love this app.

author: Ayomide
content: This is more of a suggestion though, I feel itll'd make this app to stand out if you could add a feature to the library page where backups are segmented according to the folders from where they were backed up. Idk if I'm making sense, but it helps with location of specific pictures. And i know its possible because photos backs up pictures with paths also attached and I think that's more than enough to group pictures and would help people who change mobiles frequently Thank you!!

author: John Wiebe
content: Works fine for a while, then all of a sudden won't. Gets stuck on "getting your photos" I tried all kinds of solutions recommended and nothing really works. Then the next day all the sudden it works again. I've wasted so much time on this app! It should just work! Updated post: seems okay now as of July 10 2021. We'll see if it stays good...

author: Sally Levesque Phillips
content: Great app. I like that you can create album and name people (and pets!). Also enjoy the spotlight on a day feature. Only complaint is that it would be nice to be able to delete photos when they come up in the spotlight on fay, would make it easier to get rid of random photos you don't want to keep.

author: Marta Fonseca
content: I really love this app in terms of organization. I will never lose my photos when I switch device and it's easy to search them when you organise them by albums. I just have a problem with it, it's the non existence of a way to remove similar photos instantly, instead of deleting them one by one. Please Google, find a way to simplify this.

author: Eric Geiger
content: The collage is terrible. Don't use this for collage(s). I would recommend Cymera for collages. It allows you to be able to edit and manipulate your collage before you finalize it. Unlike this, which is made for you with no/without any editing available, after it's made, for you.

author: KHALED ALTUWAIJRI
content: Really good app specially with AI grouping of photos by place, person, etc.. however, i am unable to edit in some of the videos and people who appears in the video or misrecognized by AI, Unlike the photos but with photos"still images" the i would have to keep changing/editing if the AI keeps missing between looking similar people. Over all great app and has great potential. But there is always room for improvement. With new technologies and integration.

author: Donna Phillips-Keaton
content: Update I did LOVE my Google Photos!! But with updates the editor has changed, had to subscribe to Google one for edits. I take high end landscape photography and preferred it over costly software.. Now its so cliche' I hate it. I am lost! Makes searching for particular photos easy. The only thing I would really love more is a duplicate photos feature so they could be deleted or to get a notification if the file already exists, give you a choice of whether to replace or to add as a copy etc.

author: A Google user
content: I like the app and all for saving my photos however since I have the Google pixle 2, it takes live fotos, the thing that's really getting on my nerves I'd that I can't select the frame of the image that I want to use, and this phone usually picks the middle worst, it's neither good nor awful, however at times it can be, I'm also finding that the new phone is quite slow compared to my old iPhone.

author: A Google user
content: When I zoom into my photos on the Google photos app it isn't crisp quality anymore, I have a Google pixel 3a with an excellent camera and it doesn't show the full quality until I go to zoom in from a desktop computer or by zooming when making the photo my background. I know I'm weird for noticing but this stuff matters to me. I wanna zoom in and see the crisp quality again when looking at my photos.

author: Tofu
content: Love the way I can pinch to zoom in/out for photos also create albums and collages to keep numerous photos organized. But when adding your own music to the videos made by google photos doesn't work, it always loads to 40% and the app freezes. Update: adding your own music works perfectly! (10.25.2020)

author: Ramakrishna Potluri
content: Awesome!!! Not just having your photos on cloud... Face recognition, organizing them automatically, memories from past, correcting the quality of photos, suggest auto created movies etc.. Superb. Only problem I see is adding a photo to an existing album when you have many albums.. Strangely there is no search in album selection screen Hope to see Google search and AI use in albums management.

author: Michael Dunlap
content: I've been using Google photos for a few months now and am increasing my original rating of 3 stars to 4. Google photos does many great things with my pics that I don't have time for. I need quick access, make adjustments, rename, move or photo edit. Then on to the next file. This app takes care of the other stuff making tasks quicker & easier.

author: Mary
content: I HATE the new format for movie maker! I enjoyed making videos from my pictures to view on my Google chrome, now it no longer fits the TV screen. If you must change things, why can't you give the option of vertical or horizontal?? It can't be that complicated! PLEASE go back to the old format! Update: now that I've gotten used to it, and figured out some roundabouts, the app is working well for me.

author: Zandisile Howe
content: Good app. I had deleted it before and when I got a new phone all my pictures from my old phone came back. It keeps all my memories safe rather than having an external memory card. Helps give recommendations on how to edit pictures and videos. Plus it also groups pictures together or recognized faces. So there's a folder for "mom, dad, sister and etc"

author: A Google user
content: i love the unlimited photo space, i got the pixel 3 phone because of it. but there is a few bugs i keep getting them. its abit annoying. i cant upload my photos to social media and sometimes i cant edit the photo due to some connection issue? i wish there is a 1 click rotate to many photos at once. rather then 3 click per photos. overall still love it.

author: A Google user
content: The only thing I don't like is that it doesn't always pick the right picture. For example, you take two similar selfies. The first one is blegh, but the second is great. So you put the second on social media, but Google photos chooses the one you hate to make a color pop edited picture. Eh. it'll do that one time out of 15 maybe.

author: A Google user
content: I typically use this app to view and back up photos. I prefer Snapseed for editing. (also a Google product). Love it! I wish Photos would enable me to rename files and copy or move files to SD card. I also have several files with the same filename, but the photos are different. How is this possible?

author: Ken Ang Yeng
content: It helped me by alot, when I want to find source of the picture of an anime,meme or etc I just search using photo, the same goes for translating, there were memes from other languages and I translate the texts of the picture using the photo translate, although there are some problem like really slow backing up, photo/video links appear to be broken or nothing shows but over all, it's a great companion.

author: A Google user
content: it's a great app but I have a problem, I reset my phone and when I got my account back I realized that all of the folders of photos that werent from the camera (screenshot, downloaded photos, ect) weren't there anymore, I don't know if the backup and sync for each folder wasn't active or if it was. Is there anything I can do to recover all of those photos?? please help me

author: A Google user
content: I can honestly say that I do like this app, it saves all my precious memories in one place and even creates collages and gifs for me with the option to save them. I can have any photos delivered to my home plus u can create photo albums/ books that can be delivered right to ur door, (however there is a fee for photo printing + delivery) but I think it's worth it as u can personalise ur book with anything u like write what u want & create own book style/colour, font, write what I want ect..

author: Carlos Prada
content: It is great since it allows you to make movies, collages, and reminds you of nice moments and places you visited years ago. And the feature that automatically clasifies your pics in categories of food, parks, etc. Keep up the great work. However, it doesn't mark automatically the location you are visiting. I have to manually add locations.

author: A Google user
content:
Overall very good app, but since I've activated the face recognition 
feature, it hasn't taken into account all of my previous photos, just faces 
appearing in new pictures. Also, the assistant randomly suggests a 
panorama. One should be able to select a set of pictures for them to be 
processed as such.

author: Tish Gillette
content: I like Google Photos except for 1. New past updates eliminated some editing features 2. This is my biggest complaint and always has been. When I create an album and move pictures to it the pictures stay in photos and the album. I don't want or need the pics in both places. Since deleting either place it deletes both places. Please fix this. Again, I don't want the same picture in two places, they are already backed up and in the cloud. Also editing changes original date to edit date.

author: Theo Richardson
content: From a pixel phone, the experience is amazing - smooth easy integration with the camera, and easy, intuitive tools (like magic eraser) which make editing a dream. Having had an iphone in the past, I wouldn't recommend it for IOS, as it is a little more clunky and annoying to use. The familiar faces feature can be incredibly useful for finding a specific photo of someone, and so far ( in my experience) has been 100% accurate.

author: A Google user
content: When I use Google Photos, I often search for photos I can't find, because the app chooses the 'best' shots, which don't always include the ones that are important to me. And I'm wondering, if I share an album, does it mean others can delete things from it or not? I'd like to be able to share photos without having others change the album. Please let me know if this is possible. Thanks. Otherwise, I think it's a great app.

author: A Google user
content: Negative: Albums don't appear within other apps on my Android device. If I select Google Photos as a source it only lets me pick from the device albums and not the cloud albums. I have a detailed folder structure on my computer which does not translate either using backup & sync. Can't delete photos inside of an album, only remove from album. Positive: I love the ability to search by keyword and facial recognition which for the most part helps me find photos of family and friends.

author: A Google user
content: I love this app, having the peice of mind that if anything were to happen to my phone, all my photos and important memories will always be safe. Pros *Cloud backup comes free with 15gb of space. *$1.99 for 100gb of extra storage. *App is simple and easy to use. Cons *Facial recognition needs some work. *Navigating the app to find something can be difficult. *No Dark Mode!

author: Nurse Betamax
content: I'm bizarrely satisfied with this program yet I'd like to see more, random movies and stylized pictures pulled from years past. Maybe slideshows of pictures from different years. I can tell it's a more powerful system than I understand. I wish the algorithms would do more creative things with my content, unscripted.

author: A Google user
content: The amount of work done is amazong... The face detection amd grouping being my favourite. I want to know which algorithm is being used to detect and display the faces so fast and amazingly it is working on pics back from 8 9 years. Ofcourse its from google 😃 Just one thing.. and you can add it easily. When we are backing up the photos, why not back up folder wise? Now when i am backing up my pics, it is merged with all pics so i need to search the whole photo gallery.. but as in device gallery w

author: Cody Silfies
content: Loads better than my initial review back in 2017 - but still SO frustrated that I can't manually tag my photos, adjust the date of the photos, or edit the location of photos. This has become my primary photo organizer - but it's a chore to organize older photos when I can't do it from my phone.

author: A Google user
content: I like the way it organizes and saves, and the assistance catds are very helpful. The cons are to do with sharing to messages and other apps, sometimes i have some issues but irs likeky me and my devices configuration. And the edit feature can be so much more than it is, wish it had features like pixlr. But all in all a good app.

author: Greg Kiteos
content: Good app; it's nice to have my photos and media backed up like this. One thing I would like to see in future is easier navigation to months and years. Whenever I want to get to a particular day I have to scroll down - it's so hard to stop exactly where you want to!

author: Ana Paula Herminigildo
content: It's very useful but i do hope in the future they will add a feature where you can turn OFF the backuping of videos only but not the photos, because currently while i'm posting this, there's only one switch, it means when it's ON both photos and videos will be backup and it's a bit annoying in my current situation, so i do hope in the future updates they will have a separate button (Also sorry if my grammar or punctuation is wrong, English is my third language)

author: A Google user
content: Good app for viewing, and photo storage.Meta-data on each photo a useful feature. I strongly suggest that you choose "Original Photo" in the storage options if you are wanting to print at any point. Otherwise, the quality is significantly downgraded which is also the case in using "Google photo editor". I find it useful to use a different editing app, making sure to preserve the original...

author: Spoiled Brat Missing
content: I really like this app. Mostly easy to use. Great Adjust options. Eyedrop color copy would be a great addition. But option to Rename file photos themselves would make organization much easier. Even w/ the recent update (Dec. 2022), my phone is LITERALLY OVERLOADED w/ files, photos, etc. taking up 95% storage. Locked Photos replacing Archive adds to the confusion. It's taking me HOURS of going through EVERY SINGLE PHOTO & trying to free up space using Drive & Backup.

author: Skyler Spectrum
content: This app is great for my photos! It makes it super easy to get them from my computer to my phone and vice versa. If there's anything i could suggest, it would be a flip photo option for transforming. I can rotate and tilt the image in the editor, but it's very frustrating when i have to find another app to flip it! Just a suggestion :)

author: A Google user
content: Google app is good because of the accessibilty of my photos. I am never afraid of losing my memories because of how they are stored. I love being sent videos and collages made by Google. I didn't give it 5 stars because when I try to organize my photos by adding them to a folder, the pictures still remain in a general location. This makes filtering and organizing photos difficult as the number of photos increase. I have to constantly recall which photos are already in folders and which are not.

author: A Google user
content: Fab, free reliable storage for images. Couple of problems i have is that there us no way of forcing GP to sync, i.e. You have done it once that day, then you want to sync again... It doesn't let you. Secondly, the share url generated does not work for website images. You have to rught click and copy imsge address to link on a Web page. This only seems to last for a short amount of time and sometimes not at all which is a shame. But its free, so i don't feel i should complain too much. All good !

author: A Google user
content: One of the best app on play store the very best, really smart and helpful Google has given all that it needs in it but, there is always a but, so sometimes it doesn't recognize certain pics and videos and kinda never show them so you will be like, i just had that pic where did it go! And then you will have to again save the picture to another location try that a few times or open it on drive then save it, that's a hell of a work to do, well other than that the app is just awesome keep it up!

author: Ryan Aucoin
content: Hi, Google! It would be really cool if by default the AI in Photos would automatically De-noise and sharpen photos by default so when you take a pic using the front camera it's a little clearer and sharper. Since it would be cool if it did this by default there could be a pop up when you press on the photo that says "photo automatically sharpened and De-noised for extra clarity." Then you go under edit to undo the changes if you want. Just an idea😁😁

author: Kevin Kearney
content: I use this to take pictures at events, upload the pictures without running out of space, and share them in an album with the people who want them. Then, I add in any good things the assistant has created. My phone doesn't have the storage to do all of this. I love this app. Update: I'm not happy about the storage limits, but I still like the app.

author: A Google user
content: Collects your photos, categorizes them, keeps them private unless you share them, creates very cool, shareable stories and requires very little effort by the user. I would give it 5 starts if you could edit the locations in the story. Overall, very nice, very easy and i use it all the time.

author: A Google user
content: I can store all my photos and videos on the cloud, including ones that I have taken on other devices. However, the face recognition isn't perfect, I can't manually tag people, and one time the app thought all my photos were taken this year, although I have photos from 2014. Great app, but far from perfect.

author: Jamina Lopez
content: Normally a good photo storage tool, and I enjoy having the ability to have shared albums, but it'd be nice to be able to rearrange items within the album or have like sub-album options for the larger collections that need organizing. At least let us rename files?

author: blake johnson
content: Great features, fluid UX, and tons of editing aspects make this one of the most well rounded photo gallery apps on the planet. Add in a Google one subscription and you've got access to even more features. Really good job Google 👍 My only gripe is with the video features, most people may not upload movies but I use my Google photos gallery to hold my digital library of films. I'd love the option to add closed captions or change the language as long as the file is present. Great app otherwise.

author: Tr Burns
content: Great to keep photos and store them as to not take up valuable phone memory. Having the capacity to create multiple folders as well as recognizing what files have been shared is a plus. Would be nice to have a personal lockable folder that sensitive photos or those that are important and personal would be nice to have. This would keep someone from accessing pics that would normally have full access to if able to open app. Thank you

author: Medha S
content: This is a nice app for storing photos. The thing which i don't like os movies option as the photos we select appear very small in size and blur. The second thing which i don't like is collage as we can't arrange it by ourselves. I hope you pls change these things.

author: Duna Mielgo Cánovas
content: Its so usefull to free up space on your phone, but it would be bice to keep the pics organized in the same way as they were en the phone gallery. For example, to separate screenshoots from the pics made from the camera and the ones shared with you. And also the ones that are resalted as favourites. Apart from this, so usefull.

author: A Google user
content: I'm having an issue where I can no longer "move" photos from one folder to another on my Android device. Every time I try, the photos now "copy" to the folder I wanted to move them to.
