So now I have duplicates. And if I try to delete one, they both get deleted. Please fix this Google!!! Other than that, I have no issues with the app.

author: Sally Olinger
content: Love Google photos but there are improvements I'd love to see happen. Wish facial recognition was either better and/or had an option to manually tag. I do a lot of work to improve results but it doesn't always pick up every face. Multiple search options would be great! The sharing area is cluttered and unorganized. Grouping or sorting shared albums and pictures would be a huge improvement. I spend a lot of time in Google photos and mostly enjoy all it's features.

author: Agnes Simay
content: All my life is up there, I'm backing up all memories of our babies and family. I hope you have a solid backup in place. What I truly miss: to be able to sort the photos, like I used to be able to. Now it's random and very annoying whether the newest or the oldest photos show up on top in an album. Please give us back the option to sort!

author: Starr Vannah
content: Stores a lot of pictures but limits the "Total" storage used for everything Google...unless you purchase more room from Google One. I would like to be able to be able to file my pictures into categories (ex: Family, Friends, pets,etc) AND by date. This will make it easier and quicker to find a picture.

author: Tactical Design Branding Advertising (Hak)
content: Great app. Suggested enhancement and animations are quite attractive. Tools to reduce shadows and grey areas are quite useful, especially for instances where it ain't possible to retake a photo. If I could edit downloaded images without having to export them to photos, I will happily give all the five stars.

author: Beelzebufo ampiga
content: I'm stuck at "Setting up your Photos gallery" after redownloading the app. It's showing me my not backup photos, the backup photos are nowhere to be seen. I can't access them from the app. However I can see them in a computer and the space is still being taken so they are there, the app is just stuck at getting them back. Otherwise, it's a good app overall --- EDIT: Problem was solved by doing what was suggested in the reply! Just the clear data and restart the app to get all your photos back :)

author: Michelle Blatt
content: Often, i see the pictures that google has picked for me to archive are actually ones Id rather delete. Since the choice to archive them is pretty much all or nothing, i opt out when i would actually prefer to do it, except I dont want to save them all! I would like it very much if when viewing the pictures, i could choose to delete OR archive them. Because there are so many pictures to sift through, these are usually the ones Id forgotten about. I never do get back around to it later.

author: S.D. Trash D.
content: I just downloaded the newest update, haven't used it yet so hopefully some of these will already be changed, but - Would be better if A) you could edit photos and have them save in the album instead of having to hunt them down to re-add them B) ability to delete a photo in an album instead of only removing them then having to search to delete C) photos were removed from main screen as they are added to an album so it was easier to see which photos still needed to be sorted.

author: Ariel Johnson
content: Easy to use. Automatically syncs my photos so I can grab them on another device or share through email with no problem. Not difficult at all to sort my photos or delete unwanted ones. Does auto rotate some of my photos, and has more notifications than I'd like for adding filters or puchasing prints, so can not give a full 5 stars.

author: Clarissa Gallagher
content: I love using Google photos, but I honestly miss the old photo format. It had the side bar menu for the other folders, instead now I have to click on a bottom panel to find my other folders. It just seems like a longer process to me, and efficiency is key. Everything else is great though honestly!!

author: A Google user
content: Wish the app was compatible with Instagram's multi-photo uploads. Minus a star for that. Also, it's sometimes unclear if an image is downloaded onto my device or not. Favorites feature is nice but it cant be accessed through other photo apps :( Being able to share albums with others at high quality is a huge plus.

author: Nick Stanford
content: One of the most reliable apps I have ever used. Got a Samsung and it was preinstalled, and I found it much more useful than gallery. It had an easier platform and it synced a majority of the photos I would have lost otherwise. Better than the cloud in my personal belief as I never liked iPhones I only ever had them because I had them. But one thing this app is missing (which I'm sure it did have in the past but then the setting disappeared) is an editing setting.

author: Karin Sõstar
content: (Pixel 7, not having sync on) I favourited 1k photos to back them up to cloud. Backed up 200 of them which worked BUT the favourite star on photos on my device disappeared. Figured it's better to add favourited photos to an album to keep them in one place after backing up. Wasn't able to to back the album up directly so created album link to download it to mac and upload to photos from there. Most photos disappeared from album and the favourited stars disappeared. Hours of work lost...

author: Toy Green
content: I've used Google photos for years. Always a solid source to back up my photos. As technology advances so must the app. I love features like face recognition, the curated collages and animations, etc. Sometimes there are features that throw me for loop. Like the new or new to me photo editing feature that costs $1.99 or issues with downloading photos back to my phone. Overall I'm happy with this app and have been for years.

author: A Google user
content: Took them years to have basic search to include searching through the description. Without that, it was basically impossible to tag photos unless you create an album for everything. They still do not have proper tagging but with this search, we finally got a well rounded product

author: David Eichler
content: Freezes when backing up folders, photos lose quality with unlimited 8k photos drop to 1080p or 2k(noticeable when zooming in, and videos have filled the free space with less than 2 hours of 4k. I loved this app till they took the unlimited from it. I am not a photographer and this app can't keep up. It took 2 hours to back up 1gb on a 5g connection. Amazon 5 min. I am tired of subscription services so I won't pay for more storage, so I think we have come to the end of me using your app.

author: A Google user
content: Love the software, it is the best Gallery App for both Android and IOS period (love the integration) only one issue that i wish and hope can be fixed ASAP, some of my photos or albums when doing a backup the dates get mixed up, so I have old and newer photos that are not organised, fix this and I have all 5 Stars

author: A Google user
content: I love everything about Google photos, EXCEPT the lack of automatically generated albums similar to the ones on my device. Sure, they have those albums under "Photos on Device," but only until the photos are backed up into GP and removed from the device. Once that happens, they're scattered! I think it'd be great if the photos I back up into GP would automatically sort themselves, similar to my phone. It can take forever to go through all of the photos through GP, even with self-made albums.

author: Jill Keefe
content: They keep your screenshots in a separate list, so you kind of have to search a little to find them. Other than that the app is pretty thoughtful, makes story slide shows out of the pictures you have taken in the month. You can keep the slide show or discard it. Face recognition makes it easier to search all your photos. You'll be surprised how much easier it is to find that, one, picture your looking for, when, all you have to do is look through the pics of the person you are trying to find. :).

author: A Google user
content: This app is simple and easy to use(my opinion). Backup feature is very good! I thought i lost my old photos but no! It was all auto backed up and i didn't know. In app photo editor is one feature which saves alot of RAM on the device. Rated 🌟🌟🌟🌟 because it doesn't have privacy for photos. If the developers of this app could provides private photo album then i think it's all set to receive the *Best Photo App*

author: A Google user
content: I think it is great some of the things that get created for me. I come back from a nice weekend away and my phone creates a movie of my adventures. I take some great photos and it edits them to look even better without me having to do anything. The only thing that does concern me is that someone may be viewing all my personal photos as it almost seems like someone is actually doing. However creepy it may be, it does actually give me some awesome slideshows or edits which I will keep more often.

author: squid gamer
content: Ability to run "Assistant" such as the Rotate Suggest on-demand. A large number of pics, especially those backed up via the the desktop need to be flipped right-side-up. The "assistant" suggestion to rotate are sporadic and infrequent. Otherwise great tool and feature set.

author: A Google user
content: Wish I could give it 5 stars but could really use a way to lock up & password protect certain albums so not just anyone with phone in hand can access them. Also I'm dissappointed that it doesn't have ALOT more basics to offer in editing but👍app. Auto backs up photos as you take them, Has google lens & I love how it offers u a stop motion gif type of animation outta all those "several of the same only slightly diff pics" we take in hopes of one good one but never know what to do w/the rest of.

author: A Google user
content: Hello team, Ill actually make it very short there are two things I'm really upset about. Firstly this app dosent have a black or dark UI like most of the other google apps (like youtube, contacts, messages etc), it would actually be great if you could include that in the next update. And secondly, in the new update when I try to zoom-in a photo the app becomes unresponsive and there's no other option other than force closing it. (Previous version never gave me this issue) Great work overall. 😁

author: Christos Savvides
content: Only syncs when I have the app running and open. As soon as I minimize it stops syncing. Samsung Galaxy S8. When uploading from my Mac it gives a timestamp of 'today' for all the photos rather than the date and time the picture was taken. Free up space doesnt seem to remove whatsapp images and videos from phone even though they're sync'd.

author: Kirk Z
content: Good but to get to five stars, in my opinion, of the app should recognize similar photos quicker & deeper back in time and organize those once you've started a folder in your archive. Other than that editing/drawing on photos could use a tweak. For instance, being able to draw finer lines, brighter fluorescent colors, add emojis/stickers as markers in photos, etc. Also video editing needs to be easier. Cropping out a middle section of video shouldn't be such a huge pain like it is now

author: A Google user
content: Great app, I just wish there was a more PRIVATE option. Example; after taking a photo being able to store certain ones in a private photo storage space which is locked and secure. These seem to kind of just be floating everywhere out in space with no security. I do, however, LOVE the ability to keep photos from other phones. Also the one year ago today option is useful. Overall GREAT JOB! Keep it up Google😃!!

author: A Google user
content: I love to use Google Photos. The "Assistant" creates awesome movies, albums, stylized photos on its own. The app adds background music automatically to the video and we can even edit the video (remove any photo video that are not needed, or change the time for a particular photo). The editing features are also good, however I have edited only photos with this app. Not sure about video editing. One thing I miss in the app is the ability to quickly tag photos and videos so that searching is easy.

author: Lacy Testa
content: I bought an iPhone with only 64gb of storage and I love taking pictures. I capture the beautiful views and cherished moments. This app allowed me to have many more photos than my phone storage could hold. I was very happy to know I could back up all my photos and have them kept safe somewhere forever.

author: Speed Cleaning
content: Still can't use this app for years! So disappointed but love it at same time. Heres the disappointment: I have to share lots of video every day! Like some times 10 to 20 photos too. It one time has let my videos be copied links to paste to my website. This Christmas and January I couldn't do anything because of this. I have lost so much because of this darn problem fix it again. I'm really about to move on I pay for this apo too like hello? The part I like : Every photo goes to there cloud. 🤯

author: A Google user
content: I wish the albums looked like real albums, i.e. in a book-like form and not just one page with plenty of pictures; and also that it was possible to use different styles to display the pictures from which I could choose from. This is my only wish; other than that, everything is perfect for me 😊

author: Matt Collinge
content: One of the most essential apps.. But slowly takes up tonnes of device storage with no way to clear the caches. Eventually have to uninstall & install again to get my space back. It's been reinstalled for just a week and has already crept to 7gb! Needs a way to keep the cache size under control.

author: A Google user
content: its fantast in terms of the AI that it applies to group photos and also create memories. the sad part however how do we get easy access to the camera photos and keep them segregated from the other back ups. if there is an easier way to hunt them, its not very clear.

author: A Google user
content: Love this app as I can look back at all my pics over the years and I absolutely love the little videos and styled photos its makes for me of special events such as Christmas and holidays. I only gave it 4 stars as they have taken the feature of being able to download the pictures back to my phone. Other than that its fantastic!

author: A Google user
content: I recently started to use this again after swearing against it years before. The recent changes and added options has made it a MUST for me nowadays. So, I do recommend this app for anyone who has to much photos and to little of free space left on their phones or tablets. To anyone who frequently uses social networking sites or anyone that dabbles in creating artwork of their own. Thanks Google for making GPhotos more of an essential part of the "Google experience!"

author: Jevin Ramjattan
content: Amazing AI capabilities. Memories nice & perfect for fully utilizing past forgotten photos. App could use improvement. Better album organization, more web features on the app like editing dates & info. Better people recognition needed. Ability to apply "Enhance" editing features to multiple photos instead of 1 at a time. Ability to search for album when adding photos to album. Doesn't show what album a photo is in on app but on web it does. Unlimited Storage stopped but better for environment.

author: A Google user
content: I love Google photos sometimes, other times I get frustrated at it. But it allows me to organize my photos, and make all different stuff for them. Sometimes I have to delete stuff several times before it's really gone but other than that I'm perfectly satisfied with it!

author: A Google user
content: Really great App, is lacking a few features for me personally: - "available offline" function like in Google Drive, Docs, Sheets... - The ability to have more pictures suggested for Archiving, as far as I know you have to wait for the "Assistant" to suggest moving a few pictures to the archive - The ability to pick a standard photo editor directly and not having to wait for the build in one to load before choosing a different one - Better zoom implementation, (bug: Zoom resettes after touch)

author: william abbott
content: This app really is great. But I'm unhappy with how you organize on here. I want to take all the pics and when I move one to a folder it's only in that folder. That way I can know what I organized already. It's all grouped together for every album I make and I have to go through every picture again even if I already moved most of them to a specific location. Please help if there's a better way.

author: Mitchell Smith
content: Love google photos! Let's me access from anywhere!! However, I'm not happy that the movie feature they put together for me will not let me edit the movie! I took lots of time adding and switching photo around as well as switching up the music but when i tried to save the edits, it wouldn't!!!

author: Gabriel Hall
content: Adds only to the ease of everyday life. Supported, secure, and reliable. I love not having to find a disk, hard/flash drive, or CD to archive everything on. Even when you do have those things, they can become lost, destroyed, or worse. The downside. They only give you 15 gigs of space?! I swear it used to be soooooo much more. Wasnt there a brag for a while about ALL the free space for digitizing your archives? Hey Googs!!! Wheres my space.

author: A Google user
content: Great App. issue- app frequently crashes!! ALOT! issue- when it says ? Move to archive? but there's no button to push to do so. issue- has preset movies to offer..it doesn't allow you to create your own. issue-collages doesn't allow you to manually move pics into position, to Amplifie there best position.

author: Andi Wheeler
content: Can't set time to back up😢 It's great that the photos I take on my phone are backed up, and I can easily access photos my hubby takes on his phone on days out and stuff but it would be nice to be able to set a time for this back up to happen. If you take a screenshot, share it and delete immediately it still gets backed up which is a pain as you have to keep deleting stuff twice. If you could set a time for back up it would solve this problem

author: A Google user
content: The problems I have are one, you can't delete a picture in photos without losing it in you albums as well. I also wish you could lock the app with a separate security code from other people viewing your photos and possibly stealing them if they should get into your phone without your permission

author: Nikos S
content: I am using it many years. Every time becomes better. It has still some bugs in synchronization (especially trouble is the duplicates in phone when I change folder of the photos with other app, and some other minor synch problems). Also I am waiting to see into the app, the feature " edit photos and change date and place of the photos".

author: A Google user
content: I love google photos and backup all of my devices using this service. I would have given it 5☆ but am very dissapointed that years after being launched there is still not the basic feature of being able to manually tag photos & videos. My kids, two years apart, occasionally are auto tagged as the other one and it is frustrating that it can't be corrected, only removed.

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is an easy-to-use, multi-platform app that functions as a cloud storage for photos and videos! The app makes it easy to share and connect with friends and family; and it even has options for ordering photobooks and prints. I think I would be happier with the app if it offered more ways to edit your pictures! Other than that, it's efficient, user friendly, and accessible!

author: Jennifer Crandall
content: Easy to use. Auto sinking is the best, I never lose pictures when my phone , tablet, or computer breaks. All should use this in my opinion. Thank You for your time and have a nice day. Sadly lately my photos are not saving in the quality I take them, they are messed up in color and have lines in them. Not all about 40% of them.

author: GURIYA KUMARI
content: I thik it is a great app. However it does not recognise all the files in my gallery. Mi 5A Eg.gift there are pictures that i download from the part that i want to keep on my phone. When i relase image on my phone that have been backed up, they all disappear again . That is a pain . Apart from that it is a very good app.

author: A Google user
content: A recent change emphasizes ordering prints over saving photos when the assistant generates a stylized photo. I understand the desire to bring in revenue, but our primary action with the photo will probably be saving it - not purchasing a physical copy. Adding a second press for this common task is not user friendly.

author: Lady Shay
content: I really really really do love this app except for one thing . And that is when I create a new folder say for flowers and I go through all my photos and pick out all the flowers photos it doesn't transfer them it just makes a copy to the folder so I have duplicates the whole point of making folders is to organize the photos in general in different files

author: Joe Lipson
content: Please return the old photo editing controls, they were awesome. The new ones are so difficult, they require multiple toutches to do the same simple adjustments and you can't see the photo settings at a glance like the old version, you need to go into each individual setting and all the way back out again. Revert pls!!

author: Laura-Lee Rahn
content: Works really well for me both for viewing and basic editing/enhancing photos, organizing them and downloading web content. Draw back is adding info to my photos. Whenever I write one it seems to bounce over and is applied to a different, unrelated photo. VERY FRUSTRATING. I eventually just stopped describing my photos. Also, I would like to have PRIVACY options directly available to my Albums so I can create & add to albums but can make each one either PRIVATE or PUBLIC. LLR

author: Kollett Cooper
content: The Google photos app is alright, I use it alot. Downloading images & quotes then sharing them with friends in messages(texting). Butt, won't let me access my photos when I am offline. (the ones from last year or a couple years ago) so I gotta go find a wifi . & I can't use previously taken pics from a year ago & up for wallpapers when offline. That's my only issues ...

author: Steph Foundos
content: Two problems, the rest works very well and intuitively. ANDROID 1.) There's no obvious "videos" section separated in "Utilities". It's difficult/non-intuitive to find the folder that is only videos. Is this bc I integrated my Google acct with the app? 2. This version of "Collages" isn't as good as the last phones version.. You can't reorder the algorithm if where on the frame each photo gets ordered, or where it shows up...even when I manually copy & reorder in my photos file.

author: Richard Mosher
content: Great app, save for the inability to identify duplicates for deletion. I mean, c'mon! Yer Killin' Me! The ability to search photos with keywords, (even color), and the interactive map are fun ways to browse forgotten memories. Also the editing features are sufficient for most editing jobs. If you can get past the fact that you are a willing and eager participant in helping Google map every aspect of our reality in preparation of...of...

author: Luke
content: The last update made the interface more convenient. I can share several photos that i couldn't before. A perfect gallery app, i must say. But despite all of that, there is still this app lacking to deliver to most of its users. The ability to transfer data from cloud to the phone's storage :(

author: A Google user
content: I would like to see a few more sort and search options for the photos. Things like Folder in Folder sorting, so that I can group my albums better. It would also be nice to see my photos on a map and be able to zoom into a location then see just my photos for that area on the map.

author: Mystaya S
content: Im usually satisfied with the photo app, but after this recent update to it, i am no longer allowed to edit any of my photos. I can take photos and open the app, but when i hit edit, it crashes and closes it without any prompt. I've tried to clear my cache, restart the app and uninstall, and re install it, and it's still crashing.

author: A Google user
content: Easy to use. Has all the basic features to make a great photos app. I'm picky though, and it doesn't have all the features I'd like compared to the Sony app. In trying to make it simple, they buried some useful features behind 3+ clicks. Oh well - still good enough I use it for everything.

author: A Google user
content: The online PC version is a little more user friendly when it comes to uploading a full album as an album and not just a collection of random photos. I wish the option to select a large quantity of photos, or full album from phone was easier to upload to an album.

author: A Google user
content: I really appreciate the fact that I have a place to back up my photos so that I don't lose them. My only issue is when it comes time to clear up space on my phone that it moves the newer more recent pictures on my phone rather than from the older photos. So I wish there was a way to choose if you want to start removing & back up old pics first or newer pics to my Google photos. If there's a way to do that already, could you let me know because I am not aware of how to do that.

author: A Google user
content: I don't know how I'm supposed to use this app, but it surprises me with lovely photos that it has automatically generated from my shots, and so I consider it a keeper. Now if it will also present me with fully organized and indexed photo albums. I'll join the marketing team!

author: Nicola Manini
content: Similar to the android default picture viewer, it adds the possibility to cloud-share and backup pictures taken on several internet-connected devices (smartphone, tablets, PCs) and view them all on each of them. The automatic backup of pictures to the cloud is nice, although the Google defaults are bad. It provides a rather cumbersome mechanism for sharing with friends & relatives.

author: A Google user
content: I love the organization, the ability to automatically add to a live album that family can access, and the recommendations and lookbacks to previous years. i just wish it was easier to order prints for framing. i don't always want a photo book.

author: A Google user
content: Amazing app. i use it for all of my pics and videos. unlimited storage is also fantastic. two issues though: 1- can't view amount of media in an album 2- no select all button so even if i wanted to solve problem (1) by selecting everything it still is difficult. other than that its flawless, i could lose my phone any time and wouldn't care

author: Noelle
content: It's pretty good, and I'm glad they updated it with a lock feature. However, it didnt keep most of the folders from my default gallery app, and of the folders kept, it left only 5 pictures in it. I really wish you could filter pictures by file size and maybe color though. Face grouping is nice, although it doesn't work perfectly and sometimes lists one face as two people (facial recogition still sucks for Asians though, if you're gonna steal my data at least use it to improve face recognition)

author: Shantanu Singh (Shan)
content: Everything is good.. But it would be better if one cluld open their gallery of brand account in the phone itself... For that we have to especially visit on the website... Which just seems like a total waste of time to me... So it would be better if we could just open the brand account gallery on the phone.

author: Vlad Moiceanu
content: I'm going to be straight forward about it. The app is awesome, I really like the that I stored photos since 2014 and I can go back and see them and laugh with my friends about good old times. The only problem is that videos from, let's say, 2016, they sometimes don't load or take too much time to load, which is usually very unpleasant. So, 4 stars it's the best score I can give.

author: Izaiah Florés (Anthony)
content: I usually apply additional notes to my photos to help streamline searches - as a lot of my albums are too large to search for the photo I want in any reasonable time - but the search function is very inconsistent: sometimes, it fails to find the photo I'm looking for despite typing down the additional notes (such as numbers, photo contents, or artist names). Btw, a function to search for duplicate photos would be nice.

author: lorbern2
content: After November update, WhatsApp images and videos wont automatically store in app or gallery, can I uninstall update cos this is useless now, and I subscribe for extra storage 😡 UPDATE Well after trying everything it ended up my debit card had expired so nothing was being stored, this took 2 days to figure out and several attempts to add a new card and a backup account it was a nightmare. Why can't you send an email asking to update your payment details 🤔 Fix your communication for 5 stars

author: Jason mcgill
content: Over and over again I am satisfied with this app. Pictures are how we capture the moments of our lives. These moments of life paused for just a moment for each of us to look back in time. Sometimes we see something we hadn't before, or sometimes the picture in our mind is just as vivid as as the ones that my Google Photos have stored. Regardless life is better kept because of this app. Thanks Google.

author: Matthew Armstrong
content: The free storage is def a plus. I wish it was a little easier to organize the pictures. Also a way to selectivly upload to google photos in either original or high quality would be helpful. For instance pictures taken from the phones camera would upload in high quality to a phone library and photos sent frim my camera would upload in original.

author: Markiesha T
content: I love that I still have all my photos but I have two suggestions. Maybe sync photos in the folders we have set them up in so that they stay organized like we have them on our phones. Also, since phones are updated and content is transferred from old to new, maybe alert or notify of duplicate photos so we're not using too much of our space inadvertently.

author: Richard Moore
content: Recently I have been exploring this fine photo app. I think it's coming along nicely. The Magic Eraser with the erase/camouflage feature is not fully defined but becoming more useful. O would like the camflg to solidify the colors more, to help define what the eraser can and can't erase easily. It seems that added versatility would make the photos I've practiced with, easier to edit. Also the left swipe gesture should be disabled while editing. RM

author: Sunita Patil
content: Nice app, and I liked the 7 years old, 6 years old memory folder the most!!!! The albums are also nice, I have fun creating albums and looking at some good memories! Also, the things folder like food, mountain, cars etc. is also nice, but sometimes it adds some things that don't match with them, like in baking folder, they add celebration of a birthday party, in birthday folder they add flowers etc. Still, great efforts are put to make this app super! Really liked it, it's better than Gallery!😁

author: A Google user
content: this app is really great! speacialy for pixel user it gives unlimited storage for full resolution back up. the only thing that i want for the developers to add is that it gives us a notification about a photo that was captured a year ago so we can look back at it and remember that time, just like a function on facebook that we can look back from a post a year ago. i think this is essential since we are uploading our photos wich serves as a memory of an event that we dont want to forget. ♥️

author: Olivia
content: I love the search feature and use it regularly, but I wish I didn't have to. I have a Pixel, so when I open the app it shows me all the folders in my phone, so I assumed that was how they would be organized in the cloud. After my phone randomly died, I got a replacement and realized backing up a folder just meant the pictures *in* the folder, and they will be organized into "chronological" order if you view them from the cloud. (Saved images are only sometimes organized by when you saved them.)

author: A Google user
content: 1. Comments/updates on shared photos often don't update realtime while still in album, have to exit album & reselect comments/photo to show. 2. Clicking push notifications often doesn't load newest comment they are annoucing to you. 3. Can't arrange collage photos in custom order. 4. Can't have more then one linked partner account at once. 5. Can't comment/favorite/star partner shared library photos within their library & not in a separate album. 6. Can't comment/tag own library photos.

author: mike Patterson
content: I like the app a lot. I'd like to make it my primary app to save my pictures/videos under but I don't see where the option is to make it my default app. I'd be happy to give 5 stars if there's a way for me to do that. It used to be my default application for years and Gallery became my new primary default app. I didn't change it but my new phone automatically had it pre downloaded and defaulted to using that instead if photos so now I have to search 2 apps to find a picture instead of one.

author: Lauren Bain
content: Everything is pretty alright except it won't recognize certain faces. Is there not a way to manually select a face? Not just having the ai recognize a face being there but to where you can draw a circle around said face and Google searches through your photos for similar faces. And can there be an option of "Photos like this" in your own Google photos. It would make categorizing into albums much more convenient

author: A Google user
content: There is always a room for improvement, but this version is really useful. UPDATE (after some time of usage): I would say that usability counts, but some features still missing. no need in very smart tools for editing, but at least simple marker or finger tool with arrow would help to edit a screenshot which I would like to share.

author: A Google user
content: I know that Google photos has their own folder so we can file pictures. However I think it would be really nice to see the photos actually go in there. I would like to see the photos move from the main screen and actually put and transferred into the folders. currently, it feels like your photos are in two places.

author: Jim Wilson
content: I like this app except your written part, needs more options, color control, variable fonts needed, with various background plates. And better organization of photo options, I would like to see for instance....the ability to pick up a photo and place it with another in sequence, like a dated photo next to another before or after a particular date...thanks for listening, Jim in Jamestown California.

author: A Google user
content: Always good. Ive been using this app for years. Google have a very generous amount of storage space for free so safe in the knowledge all my pics are backed up. Easy to organise into albums and the app will offer suggestions to improve the lighting or colour. Yoh can create video clips or collages veey easily. Would recommend without a doubt.

author: Prachi Arya
content: I had all the photos sorted in different albums in my phone. I created different categories for different kinds of photos as per my convenience but when I took backup of the photos, it catagorised them in its own way and I found it really annoying to search for one particular picture. Try to backup the photos as they are in my phone albums. That would be really helpful.

author: A Google user
content: This is a photo storage app that USE TO work. Seamless integration with my lifestyle it was until the phone was updated to Android 8 by the provider. Since then photos crashes randomly. It bugs the bite out of me. 2019 got a new phone and it works like intended. Best way I have found top manage photos and video.

author: Raymond Lowe
content: This has been amazing as my main photo storage. Excellent update with map view. The only bad thing is the buggy face tagging. Every time I add new photos to the library, photos with faces I've already tagged get untagged. Faces of statues and paintings that I've hidden/reported as not people show up again to be tagged. Faces of blurry people in the background that I've hidden/reported as not subjects show up again to be tagged. This happens on all platforms (iOS, Android and Web).

author: A Google user
content: Excellent photo storage sometimes, photo editing app. I like how the assistant works in terms of popping memories, rotation recommendations, auto created albums and mini movies. It'll be even better if we could have more control on the options done by the assistant like mass rotation in cases when it doesn't work or even the stylized image.

author: NormaB
content: So far I like Google Pixel but I'll never going to give it a five-star review. Right now I have a Samsung phone (no Google Pixel phones were available at the time I had to have a phone) and I like a couple of their features of their photo app. I take pictures sort of with their app but I do everything else with the Google app! Lol! I love the Google books and being able to send my pictures to Google print and make wall pictures and art from my own pictures. I just don't like the storage issue.

author: Ian
content: Best photo viewing/storage app out there, but it's not perfect. Missing some easy features - (make it easy/possible to save entire memories/share entire memories instead of only single photos, for example). For how much $ I'm sure they're making off all of our photo/video data, they should throw more budget at feature development.

author: A Google user
content: well designed software. Animations are good. Speed needs to be controlled and the average length of animated video should be more. However, the idea of making speedy videos from an existing one is not always something new. Still photograph to animated movement (e.g., as in I-pad) will be much more attractive.

author: Richard Slipper
content: A bit of a curate's egg - some bits good - very good in fact, others seem bad - very bad. For example: Facebook Stickers (I didn't even know I had them!) such as 'Meep' stored deeply in the Android root directory as individual jpg files in unique folders are pulled into 'Photos.'  Solution for me was to delete the stickers from Facebook then uninstall Photo's and reinstall.  Today for some reason there are now some duplicate photos showing up - again apparently in the /storage on Android and some pictures I believed I had deleted. Then I discover the limitations on deleting photos. At this point the app and Google's handling of photos between this and drive seem to be 'too clever.' But maybe it's not meant for people like me who like a bit of control over their data. Looking for alternatives.

author: A Google user
content: A great app!! I love it, but recently it made some mix-up with the photos dates. It included a big number of photos in one month which is not the month ghose pictures where taken in, and this is annoying! Hope this bug to be solved as I see some other reviews struggling with this issue too.

author: A Google user
content: It's pretty good. It would be nice if you could share an album and select who can add photos and who can't. It'd also be useful to be able to create a new "continuation" album shared with the same people as a current big album. Apart from missing some pretty obvious features like this, it generally works well.

author: Squissle
content: Honestly, this is a great app and it comes free, but there is something that I have a problem with. All of the reviews don't seem to mention this, but whenever I try to add a description into one of my photos, it keeps on deleting the description or it replaces it with the same description I put on different photo? You should definitely fix this as this is literally infuriating to me. Despite this problem, it is still a great app to use.

author: A Google user
content: Overall great app, that I use very frequently and reccomend to all Android users. Though, I would like if two things could improve: 1. Better facial recognition and identification of those tags with saved names. 2. Broader search terms, in reference to searching for uploaded images/content as the search options sometimes feel quite limited to a few generic keywords.

author: A Google user
content: I wish it would stop randomly ask which folders to back up and then unselecting these folders. A bit irritating. Think that's something that needs to be worked on (could just be my phone) but other than that I like it. Easy to to use, never had problems with it before.

author: A Google user
content: Allows for easy back-up of any photos on your device. Easy minor edits like cropping and rotating. Syncs across all platforms so you can easily save photos to your desktop or to share. Can make albums, however this is the only method to sort photos the default method is date which can be overwhelming with large collections.

author: A Google user
content: Love Google photos. My only complaint is not being able to have subfolders according to date taken. Yes, I know I can use albums but I would also like to see my photos organized visually by date. I know there is the side scrolling date marker and the photos are in chronological order but I would like there to be subsections-or at least the option for it.

author: Peter Clayton
content: One star removed because of a niggle. Please make the app open ready to search - it used to do this and it made finding things just a click away at 'eye-level'. Clicking on search at the bottom of the screen and then jumping up to the top to click again is rubbish, ergonomically. Finding photos is one of the real strengths of Google Photos, so why isn't it front and centre? Oh, and the Google timeline uses a calendar tool to search by date, so why not this app?

author: Charlton Bilow
content: I love how I have just sync my pictures with Google photos and it automatically creates a videos, collages, memory tracks, etc. I get to experience life as how everyone always dreams of, but doesn't have enough time to put together. This app does it for me. -1 ⭐ because of Google's monopolistic tyrannical behavior.

author: Terry McArdle
content: Superb search function, of course! Love the new tools that have been introduced recently, especially magic eraser. It's amazing to see family photos flashing on our Google Nest screens throughout the house. Would love to see ways of editing specific parts of each image, not just the image overall. Collage function is meh, get yourself a dedicated app if you like to do that sort of thing.

author: Stefano
content: Cannot share with others any slowmo video recordered with my Pixel 3a because they are show enterely in slowmo speed instead as set in Photos app. The same if watch the video with PC in my Google cloud. The solution is to load the video on Drive, download it on the device storage, then send it to others. Very uncomfortable! There is no automatic photo straightening. Most of the filters are a mess they don't permit an "elegant" finishing of the pictures, just for kids. AI search is amazing.

author: EnderWin Gaming (EnderWin)
content: It's pretty good for organising pictures and videos into a neat pile ordered by date. Although the AI facial and object recognition can be improved and so do the issues relating to it (some faces unable to have names attatched to them or ones with names that were written do not appear, etc.) Google Photos can definitely be improved had it get more options for personalization and improvements to the AI-related systems. Oh yeah and this app deleted most of my photos from syncing and stuff.

author: Mike Loeffler
content: I get a message saying account already exists on device. Tried removing account from device and then re-adding but no luck. If I bypass the initial login then attempt to log in from inside the app it says couldn't connect to the server. Looks like I'm not the only one with this issue. Please fix.

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is a great app for organizing and editing photos. The face grouping feature is really nice. I also utilize the automatic keywording, finding photos by searching for the subject in the photo. Google support leaves much to be desired, and is kind of an oxymoron.

author: Rifat Islam
content: Great app, but you guys really need to add an option for playback speed. Even google drive has it. So many videos here. Some of them ar too slow. Playback speed can help us save some time and get rid of the boredoms of watching lengthy videos. I hope you guys will consider adding playback speed in the next updates. Please its a request, make it count.

author: Bogdan Vaglarov
content: What did you do! Trying to be Instagram? A 6 star service downgraded to 1! I add 2 stars just for the unlimited backup! Where are the settings? It's a mess! The bellow coment was valid till last week! Great offer - unlimited storage, accessible from all platforms, no major problems!

author: Tonny Owino
content: Its very nice, easy to use as well back up photos incase to your new phone incase you lost your phone. The only problem is that it uses data to open some photos and in some cases make it difficult to see a photo without a mobile data or wifi. Otherwise very nice up. Please improve it for more greater experiences!

author: A Google user
content: I'm using Nokia 5.1+ (Android One 9.0, Feb 5 security update) and the main issue I'm facing is that even when the thumbnails are hidden in Google Files then also they randomly comes in the photos app in a separate ".thumbnails" folder and "camera" folder too, and appears in "Photos" tab too which makes it difficult again and again to find photos

author: A Google user
content: Great app from Google to manage your photos but I do have one problem with the app which is really annoying. Face recognition is supposed to be working in background to group photos of the same person but I have plenty of photos of people that aren't recognized so I can't quickly pull up their photos.

author: A Google user
content: This app has made organizing my photos fun again! Google Photos takes the guess work and the overwhelming, time consuming need to sort my photos by location, people and date and does all of the work for me! I finally have time to enjoy my photos instead of feeling like another chore waiting for me when I go to look at all of the fantastic memories that are all my pictures and videos! Also Google Photos makes it super easy to search for any picture or video! Simply convenient!

author: Daren Coon
content: Frankly I am puzzled why some things change, I wsh that when software works that developers leave it alone and only after a very thorough vetting that then and only then does the software change. I suppose that is a lesson taught by and learned from Apple, but my comments simply will not move the needle, but thanks for asking and allowing me to answer. This version as of 27 September is greatly improved.

author: Omar
content: As far as Photo apps go, this is my favorite as it easily backs up photos and albums with the toggle of a switch, and is connected to your Google account, so transferring between devices is a breeze and can be easily accessible through various devices. My only issue is that it uses the same storage as Gmail.

author: A Google user
content: This is a very good great app!! 😁 Well every man made sometimes is a little hard to understand right. So I uploaded my photos, videos to Google photos then it said I can free up space on my device. I truly don't know that I could still watch and see my stuff offline because the time you could see them was when you still had that very same media on your phone anyway thnkz Google. Nice app

author: A Google user
content: Everything's fine, until recently I try to move all photos of 1 person to trash, then retrieve it again, I'm having a hard time finding photos tagged with that person again. Maybe it needs time to re-recognize? Should be an option to manually sync the photos, so when we need it, it can be done immediately.

author: A Google user
content: Always improving, big fan of the app. Only things I have issues with is saving pictures down from the internet don't always appear in the app (even though the folder is selected) and the other one is making movies, sometimes it will drop out and you'll lose the progress on what you have made or added to the movie.

author: Carl Maraspini
content: I've been using the app for a while over several phones and have not had any real issues to date, although I, generally, don't keep many photos on my phone at any one time and tend to download them periodically to my laptop. I've recently changed my phone and am using this app as my default app for photos. Early days yet, on this phone, but so far, so good.

author: B.A. Grissom
content: It keeps telling me I need to update to the latest version but when I click Download it keeps telling me it has to wait for Wi-Fi which I do not have. My phone is set to mobile data ONLY so I guess if this app only downloads over Wi-Fi I'll never get the latest version which is actually fine by me because I love the editing system that came standard on this phone and you guys always screw it up with the horrible, cheap editing system on this app. You should really improve the editing system.

author: A Google user
content: The only reason I spent more time in this app than expected was because IT DOESN'T WORK. Can't back up photos from device. Update (12/25/19): I've been using it for several months now because of the unlimited storage and it is working. Not 5 stars because of the sometimes annoying "creations for you."

author: A Google user
content: App serves it's purpose reasonably well. I would suggest the ability to manually select faces to add to the AI grouped ones since all of an individual's pictures aren't captured. Also the ability to back up individual media from a folder, as opposed to the entire folder would be great.

author: A Google user
content: 2016- After using it for some time I realized that photos from 1-2 yrs ago are blacked out. That Sucks. 4/5/20- I find it improving, many different features. I love the feature of the app recognizing people's faces and grouping them all together and it asks you "are these the same people?" For two photos so it adapts to people who may look very similar (my brother and sister) but learns how to tell them apart.

author: Tore Magnussen
content: Great! I love it. I particularly like searches and the utilities, like how it creates panoramas from my various pictures. Only thing I'm missing, and maybe it's because the feature is not yet rolled out in Norway, is the ability to add or change people/face tags. If I could do that, it would be an easy 5-star rating.

author: A Google user
content: It is prety awesome... Its 5 stars compared to standard photo apps for sure. I gave it 4 because there is some room for improvement, for example i cant force tag faces in photos. I'd like to add face tags to photos where it doesn't recognize faces, or faces of people who it hasnt already started tagging. .... But overall, i really like it. Especially the assistant.

author: Gecko Pico
content: An excellent way to manage your memories, if you don't mind sharing them with big brother Google. Aside from this, it's a well thought out, easy to use app that has features that go above and beyond what is expected. The auto generation of albums and collages and animations are a nice touch. Auto upload to cloud is also excellent, allowing access to your cloud photos on your PC via browser and on other devices.

author: Arc Cortez
content: My Stauer wr50 is the coolest digital chronographic watch ive had the pleasure of owning. Ive only seen one like this before. It does everything but take pictures. Not like i need it to do that... And to be honest... Im impressed woth it. Wasnt sure it was gonna work at all because it needed a new battery when i got it. ( really it takes two batteries) but it worked after replacing both batteries.

author: Richard Clacksman
content: Nice clean UI. Shared albums make sharing photos convenient. Being able to use shared albums among your Chromecast backdrops is a nice feature. Update: The UI has changed recently making feathers like showing you pictures from this time N years ago and new automatic creations from your pictures much less intuitive and usable, but most of the other features are as good as ever.

author: A Google user
content: Pretty awesome i must say. Don't feel I've managed to fully utalise it yet but love the creations they make. Reminds you to look over the photos you have taken recently. Easy to download from too unlike other sharing and storing apps. I would like to use it as my main photo app but obviously your phone likes to use is own gallery.

author: Pherabee Breece
content: For as long as I can remember I've always LOVED this app. When the archive recommendation review became part of the utilities I was thrilled! However, I gave feedback years ago that it would be very helpful and more efficeint to also have the option to delete photos from the recommendations. Much more often than not, the photos that are recommended from my app are ones that I don't wish to keep at all.

author: A Google user
content: Overall I enjoy using the app to make movies. I would like to see an update to include more moving making options. It's been the same for well over a year and would be nice to a few options. A lot of families and friends are different. Even movies for special events or date nights would be nice to see there.

author: Stewart
content: Needs automatic photo adjustment for the taken picture like Microsoft Camera, Nokia Camera or Microsoft Photo app. We should be force to chose between optional filter, do it manually or import it into a third party of which all are more time consuming. Auto adjust works great for almost all pictures and happens instantly when you choose that option. In the few cases where those results need improvements, only then do you need to take the time to use the above mentioned methods.

author: Peter Towler
content: Very good app. One missing feature (from the functions, or from the description...I can't find it..) is the ability to download a block of pictures rather than individually. I've lost a few months from a failed phone. It's great to have them backed up but a pain to select and download individually. 👍

author: Christie Owens
content: I love the app, the only complaint I have is, if you have the same email address for many many years then you're limited to how much Google Photo space you have for free, You will definitely run out of space quickly especially if you're like me and take a lot of photos. Then the photos just quit backing up.

author: A Google user
content: I like photos and the automatic creations are cute and fun, the little movies it makes are sometimes great, but I photograph and record everything so sometimes boudoir shots seem strange in a compilation of city or vacation shots around town. Also the phone keeps telling me to delete photos since they are backed up, but if you delete them from the app, it deleted the backups as well so take care how you remove your photos from your device. Overall I love the photo app.

author: Wenson Bonifacio
content: My experience with this app has been good, I'm able to capture memorable moments, and store so many photos over the years. I didn't like that I couldn't get my Gmail no more unless I deleted videos as I had so many of them. I had to sacrifice memorable videos and delete them cause they were taking up space. O miss when it use to be unlimited I guess everything has its limits

author: A Google user
content: I love the app it does a great job storing and then relocating my photos. It will sort and resort them into albums easily based on any criteria I chose.It searches the cloud and finds what I am looking for with amazing speed and acuracy.It is the photographer that is the weak link and I am having trouble replacing myself.

author: Jamie Danzer
content: My best friend and I used it to communicate and share photos. Last update has it randomly deleting texts I send for an undisclosed amount of time before functioning again. Please fix this issue. Edit: we both had to completely delete the shared album we had and he was able to make a new shared album for him and myself for it to work. Clearing cache and data didn't help. Restarting the phones and app didn't work either any of the numerous times we tried. Seems to be working okay now.

author: A Google user
content: great app and the assistant is great at tweaking photos for you, just really wish there was a 'view all' option, like you can only see photos taken by camera, or screenshots or downloads etc, but my old Samsung phone used to just let me view all photos I had in the same place. Hope they can bring this feature to the google version then it would be a ten out of ten for me!

author: A Google user
content: I love this photo app! It's freed up space on my phone and allows me to edit photos and make collages and videos! I do wish I could edit my photos once I put them in a collage or change the layout of the collage. I hate that it decides how to set it up for me. Also would love to see more video editing tools!

author: A Google user
content: Just auto uploaded all my phone and desktop pics going back years which seems to be great. However after using for a while the app is taking up 580Mb of data storage on my phone. I've cleared the cache and emptied the deleted photos from the app, but still takes 580Mb, not too clever considering it is supposed to store everything in the cloud.

author: David Foster
content: I can't find any of my photos, but with this app, compared to othersI Google has done a great job at making an app that lets me back up my photos for free. It's the best way to backup my photos and the amount of photos I have backed up for free... You can't beat it, I've changed my mind completely about this one. Thanks for the great work, I'll continue to use Google Photos to organize my photos.

author: Pegah S
content: I love this app, specially with extra storage room. I wish the locked folder would back up into a locked folder. I put a lot of important documents in there and had to change my phone, when I replaced my phone I lost all of them. Maybe an option to get it backed up or not would be nice.

author: A Google user
content: Needs better features like deleting only from online library rather than deleting from the device and vice versa. Also would be great if we could have an ask at the end of each day or 2-3 days before backing up photos, to confirm backing up, so that we can delete the ones we don't want it to back up.

author: kerri
content: Love how it backs everything up in case u lose ur phone,etc. The memories and collages it makes for me are awesome. So easy to manage everything and free up room in ur storage. Only thing I dislike is since updating the app I can no longer draw on my pics. The pencil option is there but when u click on it now there's no way to do it anymore.

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is generally a pretty good way to access pictures I've taken on my phone. my one pet peeve is at all photos required downloading in order to print and if you download more than one they come in a zip file. it would be great if there was a way to print directly from a browser on the desktop app.

author: A Google user
content: this is great app, however I am facing issue with synch between app and web client, i have shared couple of album and its visible in web client (since last 2 months), but not visible in App! author: A Google user

But there's a small request to the developers of this app→please add a doodle(pen/brush to draw over an image) option in photos' edit section, it is often needed to edit screenshots, mark something on a picture etc.

author: A Google user
content: This is a really good app! I give it four out of five stars since it's easy to use, looks nice, and has neat features such as image to text or facial identification. The only thing I'd request adding is a lock feature on some folders that encrypt the folder and not allow it to be seen (even with other apps) until a password is given.

author: Goodnews Benjamin

Pls fix it!

author: Devin Merkel

author: A Google user

author: Uday Gaitonde
content: An excellent app, great for most of my work and requirements. A few features are not fully baked. For example, I am unable to flip a photo, or mirror it. Also, features like face collections and this day N years ago do not include archived photos. To keep my main Photos page uncluttered, I used to keep almost all my photos archived. But then I missed out on these facilities. Including archived photos in these is a STRONG SUGGESTION.

author: A Google user
content: It's a good app, but it's a little slow and has a harder time backing up your videos. Besides from backing up videos, this app works very well and has saved me a ton of storage. It's fun to go back and look at your photos and see them several years later. All of my photos are in one place, which is super helpful and overall Google Photos is a great app and I would suggest using it! :)

author: Kelli Howe

Annoying, but not exactly earth shattering for usability.

author: Trin LaBuff

author: A Google user

author: Saman Bimar

author: A Google user

After selecting multiple files and adding those to an album, please set to keep the selection on so people can add to a different album or archive. 2. Search and sort albums. 3. author: Patricia Robson
content: Takes bit of working out but pretty good. The more you do, the easier it gets. All round good app. with loads of storage and assistant to create simple animations and collages. I have not used the social media side of it. Great as a back-up folder.

author: A Google user
content: It's really great fir keeping all your photos in one place, whether ok offline or online. The cloud storage aspect is really great, i really love the sharing features, being able to share your libraries seamlessly with your partner. What i think the app for Android is missing is being able to choose selectively, whether you like to upload or sync, the quality in which they are uploaded to the cloud. Also it would be nice to have albums to which photos are uploaded automatically based on criteria.

author: Adetomiwa Olubajo
content: The app recognizes faces and places, making it easy to find photos. it creates sharable slideshows from your photos and has nice editing tools like video stabilization, and magic eraser. But the app's grouping of screenshots with regular photos creates an unorganized appearance. Also, the unintentional backup of these screenshots quickly consumes my cloud storage. Lastly, the absence of an HSL editing tool necessitates the use of other applications for precise color adjustments.

author: A Google user
content: it's a great app, but between Google Drive and Google photos I have hard time deciphering switch app will permanently upload/ Save my photos and documents. Fear of deleting photos is huge to me. I upload / access my Google photos / Google drive/ Email, on 3 different devices daily. so I really enjoyed being able to link up everything as one user.

author: A Google user

author: A Google user

author: A Google user

author: Michelle Boatman

author: Samuel Schmidt

author: Lolli Whitaker

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is quite helpful. You can store and organize many photos within the app. They allow you to edit your photo such as adding lively filters and drawing with electric colors. Google photos helps you with so much, AWESOME APP, totally recommend it.

author: Tiffanie Smith

Its a great app just needs more free storage.

author: A Google user

I would give this app 5 stars if it could also serve as an ordering service for prints, canvas photos, and things of the like.

author: Alex Pearlstein

author: A Google user

author: ARIJIT _11 xD (Serpentine)

author: A Google user

Changing my rating from 1 star.

author: Peg

For another trustworthy, uncomplicated, and virtually made to and for your precious data of all media types along with my Motorola Power .. together they compliment, and smiles for all.... cheers!
