content: I guess I'm not real savvy with some stuff. I have a problem with accessing the ☁️ cloud. I have followed the instructions and faq info... I still can't seem to get my pictures stored either on the cloud or in my own computer. I've tried via cable, via WiFi, no luck. I'm going to try some other photo thing even tho I don't want to. I like to use Google stuff. Usually I don't have a problem. But I have to be able to get the pictures off my phone, it's getting clogged.

author: BRYAN BULUSAN
content: Latest update seems doesn't sync/backup anymore. It's taking forever to setup or in 'getting ready' status. I cleared the cache and data, restart the phone but to no avail. I uninstall the updates (back to phone's stock version) instead. Fortunately, now it's working perfectly fine. I'll just disable the auto-update. UPDATE (2021.11.10): Thank you team! Latest update resolved my sync/backup issue. Changing from 3 stars to 4. ;)

author: Nicole Vasileva
content: Overall ok and easy to use. However: - there is no meaning behind the "like" feature, as you can't see all liked photos like with "favourite" - how is it possible to NOT have the option to download a bulk of photos locally to a mobile device? you have to do download them one by one.. such a nuisance...

author: Alice Howe
content: Google photos has so many options that it makes the entire app limiting and restrictive. But I thought I'd try it again...I am, after all, a Luddite. Perhaps I 'just don't get it.' and now...more than a year later I had lost most of my photos when a 'helping' friend hit factory reset. But some of them are here.

author: A Google user
content: Helps to save a lot of time managing all the pictures configuration. However, I don't like that once you add some pictures to the albums, you can still see them all messed up in pictures, so it get confusing to know which ones are already on albums and which ones aren't.

author: Jordan
content: It's fine, I don't like the way they changed how your pics are stored, but I'm too deep in to switch apps at this point. It's just clunky and annoying to have one tab you click, then having to click a folder, and then finally click whatever folder you actually wanted. Before you just changed tabs and all your albums were right there. Definitely a downgrade imo

author: Robert
content: difficult to navigate especially when you're making albums cannot delete pictures from albums. Well I figured that out now I'm trying to do animation and can't figure out how to change the order of pictures some of them won't play if you send them to somebody you know Again difficult navigate it took three weeks to figure out how to take a photo out of an album. Happy Googling They also take the bulk amount of your photos after you get full and place them wherever they want without telling you

author: Abhijyot Aakash
content: I've been using this app for a long time to manage and edit my photos, but it hasn't been working properly for the past few days. It keeps lagging a lot, and when I click on the edit option, my phone's brightness automatically increases. I've tried reinstalling and uninstalling updates, but the issue doesn't seem to be resolved. Additionally, it should add an option to "save" images after editing instead of 'save copy' option, or simply let the user select the option they want to use.

author: A Google user
content: It was never my primary gallery app, but still it's a good app for it some pros. But recently there is an issue. I am always syncing my camera folder, but now i am using cymera app for editing some pics. All the images which are edited by cymera, goes to separate folder named "cymera2" by app default. But Google photos syncs those images in "camera" folder. I really don't know what kind of bug this is..?? Those folder are totally separate in my device but this app is taking them as one..and now my camera folder in this app has memes instead of my own captured pics..😒

author: A Google user
content: handy for backing up important pics and so on, especially when changing phones as simply changing the memory stick from old phone to new isnt always as simple as it sounds and sometimes your left disapointed as that important picture wasnt saved to memory stick and then theres the handsets without memory sticks . nice features too, animation etc.

author: A Google user
content: Good for photo storage and I love the things the assistant creates, but the assistant has been creating the same story over and over again! More than 30 copies of the exact same album. I also wish it wouldn't cut off people's faces in collages or use blury photos.

author: A Google user
content: i really find the app is useful, good place to store our memories and arrange all the pictures, on and off will pop out collage to recall my memory, it will be even better if can sort out the way of looking for picture, for example, search the album according to alphabetical order or date taken

author: A Google user
content: This application is absolutely fantastic! I love the automatic effects it does with various pictures and videos. You can save & keep the ones you like and discard the ones you dont. I also like that this application helps me to keep plenty of open storage space on my cellphone by backing my photos & videos up automatically to my google account. My only issue with the application is it uses WAY to much data, which is a total bummer. Otherwise, like I said before, it's fantastic!

author: Kelly Stolp
content: I really love that all the photos from my phone are backed up to my Google account and I love the collage and video features where the app makes them for you. I would like a more in depth editing function to edit photos such as adjusting colors and covering blemishes. If the editing feature is updated I would be happier.

author: A Google user
content: Amazing... It is much better than i expected, the only reason I cut 1 star is because of the absence of a manual method to get colour pop images which are provided through assistant automatically and on rare ocassions only. A manual button is long overdue for the feature, even an online AI enabled service would be appreciated if having it offline seems difficult though that would be more preferable.

author: Skylar Walker
content: I really love this app, like having all the photos in a single app and being able to watch videos and see my pics are really great.. however, some videos won't play like ones made with old iphone. And some pics and videos are blacked out and u have to download a pic/video editor to get them back and the quality is poor. I wish Google Photos had two things 1. Duplicate Photo Removal cause I have 3,4,5 of the same photo cause of moving the photo or because I back up to numberous email. 2. Drive pr

author: A Google user
content: It's the best app to save ur memories without any doubt... And the reason why I gave 5 stars instead of 4.Caz when I backup a folder the pictures and videos are backedup in random order and they don't display in folders when I try to retrieve them back... IT FEELS LIKE searching for a neddle in ocean since they aren't categorized as *FOLDERS*.. I Hope they'll provide this feature in upcoming UPDATES... Apart from this the app is KWEL.. I'll recommend it for Sure

author: Casey Gorman
content: Needs options to remove duplicate photos. The desktop app that I used to sync my photos from my desktop to the cloud duplicated everything 10 times making it a bit of a mess and there is no way to fix it other than manually going through 10k photos. Ain't nobody got time for that. That's why we use these convienent apps... To save time not create more work.

author: Kevin Mena
content: Okay, so this is my icloud. I use iphone and Android alike so having a way to seamlessly take content from one end to another is important to me. One per peeve of my mine with the app is the way that you can only download from Google photos to your phone, one video or piece of content at a time. It's sooo time consuming. BUT just noticed a small but GREAT feature has been added and wanted to thank whoever did. Now when you download a file, it auto switches to the next one to download. 🙌🏼

author: Stephanie Darnell
content: Absolutely Love the google photo app! Makes things easier, & all the extra stuff like storing photos, video & clip making using your own pictures is awesome!! only a couple of issues I've ran into. 1 is you have to search for photos by the date because if you try searching for a specific picture by the person's face... it sometimes will have other people's face and/or mixed photos. There are definitely a couple little improvements that could be made. Overall I love the app tho!

author: Michael Gibson
content: My opinion of this app has changed w various updates. Started at 5 dropped to 3 and now it is back up to a 4. I really like all the things it's possible to create from various photos or even a single photo w a bit of creative editing. With this app and the gallery editing features I've been able to make some really great animated photo features from but a single photo. If I could only manage the speed of these animated creations as they played back I'd give this a 5 star rating .

author: Darktaro
content: It is nice, but overall it does have some issues 1.) Randomly Crashing Due to download time misplacement (Misplacing Photos At Random Times As Far Back As 1999) 2.) Misreading Files/Unable To Read Perfectly Fine Files Most likely misplaced downloading as well That's all I have to say, other than that the app is fine and a great app.

author: A Google user
content: Considering my daily driver is a Pixel 3 XL, using Google Photos is easily and obviously my preferred media storage app, I can't pass up unlimited full resolution storage. I wish they had features like a "select all" button and the ability to easily combine albums, but overall my experience with Google Photos is pretty damn good.

author: A Google user
content: It's a great app but i found one inconvenience about same app. When we upload photos on drive through phone it's get uploaded in single folder but our phone has in different folders. So while searching on photos it's very inconvenient and annoying to find particular photo. I want if we are uploading photo it get uploaded in format or catagory which phone or system consist.

author: Mark Raimo
content: Something weird is going on with my albums. I had something pop up at the top of my gallery that said about hiding sensitive photos. I clicked dismiss. Not long after that. I'm missing a lot of my photo albums now. All my photos are still on the Google photos and I can see them when I scroll. But the albums that some of them are in are missing. I tried using the search tool to locate them that way and it says they can't be found. I hate this. This is the second time this has happened. Please fix

author: Colin MacNaughton
content: The user interface had gone downhill recently especially around shared albums: I still can't get used to shared albums being hidden under the chat icon, I still try to share photos using the share button despite that functionality being moved to the plus icon, and there is an unintuitive proliferation of shared albums with combinations of people.

author: A Google user
content: I really enjoy Google. I use them as my browser as well as for my email and honestly just everything. I wish Google Photos had an editing option for when I upload my pictures and all that(to be specific editing options like being able to write or put text onto a picture or just making selfies "prettier" so maybe I can facetune a little if you know what Im saying lol) Anyways 💜 GOOGLE

author: Fred Dobbs
content: I couldn't find how to align video axis with horizon for videos that were shot crooked. But, it did a good job of stabilizing a very horizontically-shaky commercial VHS video into one whose vertical borders bow in and out a bit while video is playing...much easier on the eyes. File doubled in size, and audio remained in synch, unlike another well-known app that saved in GB's size, with out-of-synch audio that had to be corrected in VLC Player. Google Photos video was also enhanced in editing. 👍

author: A Google user
content: fairly easy to use, but not all my photos in my library get synced online. It is very hard to know which ones have and which ones haven't. I manually delete my photos from the device and since I have soo many photos I delete them by month. Sometimes it will come up with "you are permanently deleting these images" or something along those lines.

author: A Google user
content: It's a very good App and very easy to use and I find clustering the images into different folders is very helpful and I would rate it 5 stars except the free up space function, doesn't work for the SD card, but everything else is perfect I would definitely recommend it.

author: Alexey
content: 1. The app uses too much traffic when editing photos. Each time a photo was corrected and saved, the app reloads it from the cloud. This drains the battery and mobile internet which is especially painful when travelling. 2. It is impossible to prevent automatic space free-up. I want to lock albums from being deleted or allot space for offline usage.

author: Grandma Cherrie Vrabel
content: The app works good, my only real complaint is that even after I have selected which albums to upload pictures from my phone to the app - the app changes my selection. I have so many photos in my account that did not need to be SAVED. I don't want a bunch of photos of clothes, or artwork that I have saved for creative inspiration stored in this app. Then these photos are shown on My Alexa Show, and my Chrome cast Screensaver- it is embarrassing. Just save my Family Photos!!

author: William Wright
content: Does more than you may realize. Some functions require exploring before it's clear how they work. UPDATE August 2020 Having lots of time on my hands has given me a chance to explore nearly all the functions. I'm blown away! The search options are very impressive! They use an intuitive approach to find what you need. All the editing options are great. It would be even better if the developers could add a "layer" and "merge" function to facilitate "combining" photos.

author: Tony Hungate
content: I've been using Google Photos now for 8 years. I originally used it to ensure I didn't loose any of my pictures if my device had an issue but having the ability to edit, share, review and search is why I've kept using it. You can search by location, date, tags, and even a person if you tagged them making it so easy to fine what you are looking for. My only issue is that I have lost pictures due to synch issues and auto delete functions that were tested.

author: Emma-Karoliina Kiviluoma
content: I've been using this to store my photos way before I was even aware of it. My Samsung Galaxy's have transferred my photos on the app for years - and yes there are some problems with that, but nothing too hard to handle. And sometimes I wonder if it really saves every photos its supposed to, cause I seem to missing some every once in a while. And the biggest con is that you can't add folders inside folders.

author: A Google user
content: I really enjoy google photos but wished there were a few more tools like editing multiple pictures at a time or saving an original and an edited photo. Also settings that would allow you to share or save only selected photos would be great. Being able to lock albums would be helpful as well. Just my thoughts.

author: wateva
content: Recently I discovered that my photos from like 2019 weren't showing up on the home page and I can only find them if I search up a date. Something I really annoying is that I added the photo to my favorites and when I scroll down to click on it, it takes me all the way back to the top and won't let me see anything. I had uninstall the app for it to work again.

author: Katie S
content: I'm not computer smart at all but the ease and clarity of using this app makes it easy for me to get things done. I especially like the ability to take a picture of something even if a screen shot and go shopping for it. Try it for this feature alone makes life easier and you might even get educated in the process. For further explanation you'll have to try it!

author: A Google user
content: It would be a lot better if it didn't freeze every time I try to make a movie or create a link. Sometimes it takes up to 5 tries to do either. Edited to add* It's gotten a whole lot better. It no longer freezes and is now the only photo backup I use.

author: F Scott
content: As an acrylic abstract painter I use Google Photos every day to edit and enhance images I use in my paintings. when I've finished a series of paintings I then add+ them to a dedicated album. my one criticism: *when photos are added to an Album...then when those same photos are Deleted from Camera or Photo sections...the Photos in the Album are also deleted...the Album is Empty! *please consider making an update so users can create order out of chaos of thousands photos in those sections.

author: Sumo Bear
content: It's alright it's just missing the color inversion table. I found some old negatives I'd like to regulate but all of the other apps are so riddled with ads and so dysfunctional that I find, downloading them is about as useful as cooking with a cardboard skillet so I have to do without until I can afford Photoshop.

author: A Google user
content: Ever since I first used this app with my Google Pixel, I've loved it. Even after switching to my Razer Phone 2, I've continued to use this app consistently for years. Unfortunately, something appears to have gone wrong in one of the most recent updates. Albums simply do not save, nor do photos properly delete. I've tried to troubleshoot, but the only solution I've found is to revert the app to the factory version. The downside is, you're stuck with the 2000 file limit for albums.

author: Justin Chen
content: A lot of bugs. For example I can't access shared folder from Google Pixel and have to use my iPhone and download google photo there. Also the last time I archived a few screenshots, I can no longer find them by searching screenshot. I have to go through photo by photo to locate them. It's pretty inconvenient. Added review- their team left a message and the shared 📁 issue magically resolved

author: Davis Foulger
content: I've loved Google Photos for a while now, but I'm downgrading my rating from five stars because you've managed to make it harder to use while trying to simplify it. I really like seeing stylized photos, but you've made that hard to find. And albums are nowl buried inside something else. And that is just the tip of the problematic future storm. It is not simpler. I truly preferred the old version.

author: A Google user
content: i enjoy google photos but anyone I send more than one photo to who doesn't have an android struggles to access them because it is sent as a folder and not an individual image. Additionally, i wish it was indicated when selecting individual photos to send whether the image is the portrait or non portrait mode version when sending them through the messaging application.

author: A Google user
content: I recently let this app take over all of my photos, and it went ahead and sorted everything for me, but I have spent more time trying to research and figure out where everything is than I ever could have imagined. It didn't do a very good job and things are lost and in the most ridiculous places.

author: Jerry R
content: Google photos is a great app but often a handy feature will appear, like the option to crop straight from zooming into a photo without going into the editor first, then suddenly it disappears. The whole "save a copy" thing is an ache too...I usually end up deleting the original after I've edited it. it would be so much better to save and be able to revert rather than have multiple copies.

author: A Google user
content: I do like the animation and backup features. The animation feature does tend to find some irrelevant images and attempts to put them together with weird results. Navigating the app is a clunky chore and a learning curve. I do still prefer the HTC Gallery app. Google Photos serves its function well enough. No major upsets or glitches. Update: I would like to see as a feature the ability to search for photos by colors or similarities in subject matter or image.

author: A Google user
content: I love Google Photos, so easy to use, easy to back photos up automatically, brilliant Assistant features creating collages and videos, auto-rotation etc. The only thing missing is a widget to show off my photos! Please, please, please develop a widget for Google Photos... That would make it a fully 5 star app.

author: Melodie Thomas
content: Very easy to use and user friendly. Search options are way more advanced than other apps I know. However, Google is always trying to sell additional storage. I just bought the 100 and I already received a notification that my storage is 15% full. If we could have an option to see duplicates, WhatsApp videos or blurry photos, it would really help in clearing our galleries. And storage would be bought only when really needed and not when pushed to buy. Not as if these $$ made Google's profit😅

author: A Google user
content: This app is a great way to view, store, share, and even print photos. There is a photo editor but it's very basic and mostly uses basic filters, standard cropping, and photo rotation. So you may need a separate photo editor but as far as sharing pics or being able to access them from anywhere you can access Google

author: Emmett McCarthy
content: I love how it puts like photos or times photos together. I just wish that there was a better editing feature to cull out photos that you didn't want and then be able to send the modified Album to family and friends, thus eliminating downloading the ones that you want and having to send them individually...

author: A Google user
content: Has had some interesting improvements over the years to the point of now being able to mark particular person once & automatically checks if they are in any others as well as being able to sync across a wide variety . Unfortunately it has not gotten smart enough to not duplicate EVERY picture every time those devices connect up.

author: A Google user
content: Can we get a feature to search for albums when you are adding photos to a an album? If you've been using this app for ages like I have been, I have lots of albums and I want to be able to search for them when I have selected photos I want to add. I am aware of the option to start searching the album concern, threreafter add photos from there - but this is a lengthy process!

author: Uriah “Ryah” Reynolds
content: This app is very good for photos. Any bugs I have had with it have been fixed, or turned out to be my fault. Great quality edit work, much better than snapseed, or other editing apps ive used. And Google one gives you lots more storage, and editing capabilities... I would say tho, if you don't have Google one, your storage will fill up fast, especially if you are a parent.

author: A Google user
content: It would be a 5 star because it's awesome ... but ... I ha mve a recurring problem where for some reason it intermittently won't let me share, laptop or phone. For me, the whole point of this app is sharing albums. That is hugely disappointing. Please fix it, Google.

author: A Google user
content: The straight forward display and streamlined formatting are ideal for the always-on & on-the-go. It's also intuitive enough for the tim-techy's* among us [*timid about technology], making the app easy to navigate & blunder resistant. It's almost impossible to permabotch or lose a pic since theres limited options for editing & projecting, &, built-in prompts requiring confirmation of changes before you move on; and, as is the Google way-b4 u save-you can undo whatcha did so you're not left undone

author: Brendalee Harris-Hills
content: I use it all the time, but I really wish the timeline on the right side of the screen was set up differently. You can't get to a date without flying past it, back up, go too far again...then finally get to the month and day, look at a picture...and lose your place in the timeline and have to find it again. Very frustrating!

author: Yelsel
content: This is a good little App to help with your photos. I don't know why Google took away camouflage, it was a great option & it's missed! The email from Google on 4th August 2025 announcing this new version had pretty boxes & a great precis of what the function was. BUT the links only took you to your photos with no explanation of where you went next. Poor show Google, if you want people to use features at least explain how to replicate it!

author: Mishy
content:
Update speed between devices is far too slow. If I save a photo and ensure 
it has been "backed up" to the service, I want to see it on other connected 
devices that are logged in to my profile in an a timely manner after 
synchronizing the secondary device.

author: Xeng Vang
content: Good gallery and great storage but limited. Could you add a memory card options for sending my pictures and videos to save in the micro SD memory card and help saves memory on the internal drive and instead of relying on Google memory data storage spaces and upgrading. Only for those who want to do more with their program and work productivity. Thanks.

author: Erica Hayslip
content: I used this app for many years now and haven't had any trouble until now. My phone is out of storage and when I try to free up space it doesn't work. I click it and it does nothing. After clicking over and over it says freeing up space but says 0 was freed up. The photos say they're backed up but clicking free up space won't remove the pics from my phone. I've never had this problem until recently. Please fix this!

author: Jim Wiehe
content: Excellent for the most part. As a long-time Picasa fanatic, I miss the ability to manually add faces that are not detected in the current software. On the other hand, I'm very happy with the ability to search by place or topic. Finally, I *really, really, really* wish there was an easy way to identify duplicate photos. Always something to work on, isn't there? :-) Over all, though, I'm so impressed and grateful to the brilliant minds that can put a program like this together. Thanks!

author: Daisy Dey
content: The Google Photos app has been a boon indeed. It contributes greatly in reviewing old memories which in a way very self satisfying. It would be very heartening if there are subfolders wherein photos of one subject say a particular person / object can be stored together in one folder so one needs to select a particular picture it can be easily accessible for sharing with others or would be make a wallpaper etc. This would be of great need to the end-users.

author: Vicki Williams
content: Good app and now thankfully getting rid of the drive/photo palaver - bring back picassa!!! Update... Uploading is good -very quick But Clear space - doesn't clear everything that has been uploaded Editing function - poor People and pets - no pets identified (even though 500+ photos of my cat!) Same people suggested - now have 4 albums for husband and kids as it won't merge!!! Adding to albums : would be good if there was a search function rather than having to trawll through the long list

author: Kecia Schmieg
content: This app has great storage and easy photo-finding features based on any subject, theme, location, or date. I can find a photo of a puppy we had 10 years ago in seconds. It's so quick and easy. What used to take hours now takes moments. My mother thinks I spend hours putting together the clips I send her. 🤣 I literally tap to open my notifications and instant daily memories that will make me smile, it's that simple.

author: A Google user
content: I loVe tht this app automatically uploads most of my photos off of my device(s) AND I especially loVe tht this app has the ability to clear up space on my phone by removing photos from my device tht have already been backed up & saved to my Google Photos account!! I just wish I cld add and/or remove any albums on my device for auto upload etc bc a lot of other photo albums I hve to do individually by selecting a limited # of photos at a time, & that can eat up a lot of my time & becomes tedious.

author: A Google user
content: I love it. It's definitely saved me a lot of space. I really wish there was a feature that told us what two pics look the same though that were backed up. Because I find a lot of duplicates, because I tend to take screenshots of the orginal pictures and those get backed up. That would save me even more space.

author: Sephirothsgirl 1789
content: Most of my photos are unable to be viewed as it has a cloud symbol with a slash through it. Done everything that the devs said and still unable to view them. They've been working on this for months snd still no progress. Hoping that it gets taken care of as these photos are from my vacation and I don't want to lose them.

author: A Google user
content: Great app I love how it turns photos into animations and it creates a collage out of your photos. It even asks if you want to archive certain pics. I just don't like that it saves everything virtually immediately so you have to delete from your phone and also the App. Great App though, no more lost photos.

author: lisa woodburn
content: pretty awesome. could use a bit better programing like an option to NOT continually re load triplicate..quad...pictures upon sync. this happens when you have more than a couple accounts and do backups. over and over. being a photog myself..i find it pleasing and easy to use. better design options for editing would be very awesome.

author: A Google user
content: Feature Request I hope you can show the backuped photos and videos according to the folder they were in. I.e. each folder has a cloud folder twin whatever photos and videos being uploaded is going to its cloud folder : Chrome Photos (phone) goes to Chrome Photos (cloud) in this way the search for an image or video will be much easier since we know which folder to look at instead of searching for a date.

author: Michelle Gracias
content: I love this app. It's a hassle free way to store and sort pictures. It helps with creating movies, animation and collage. It's also great with decluttering as it suggests the pics that could be archived. There is always room for growth and improvement hence I rate this app 4 star.

author: A Google user
content: I wish it would delete multiples and keep originals. But there isn't an option for that. It would make organizing much easier. Better yet help organize the photos better. That's my request. It gets overwhelming trying to go through all the photos.

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is helpful because it uploads all your photos so you can remove them from your phone storage and have more space. Google photos offers fun stylized photo mixes where you can make collages lighten up your photos and it also creates little videos and have face recognition for the people that you take pictures of more often and gives them their own profile if you want to call it that.the only thing I wish it did was offer more unique video or image editing tools.

author: Usene
content: It is terribly slow the moment wifi is connected. I noticed my backup is terribly slow until I update. Talking about 10 pictures in 3 days. Then after update, it could run fine again for not more than 24 hours and back to default: ...Slow!! Until next update. I'm beginning to lose faith. It's not funny anymore.

author: Florencia Ré
content: I love to receive notifications from the app with a new clip, movie, or collage that are made with my pics from years ago. l really really like this app. I also like that it saves all my pictures whenever WiFi is available, so I don't have to worry about that. There are things that can be improved (like the editing feature, pretty boring or you have to pay to access better options), but I definitely recommend this app.

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is amazing, but it does this one annoying thing. Occasionally for reasons I can't determine (operating system updates? App updates?) it changes the way I save photos from "Original size" to God quality or whatever it is that Google calls its compressed file size for photos. The truth is, if you want printable-quality photos from your Google Photos account, you had better hope that your phone uploaded the original quality image that your phone captured with its camera app.

author: Anaheeta Sadri
content: Try and give us an option "move to" photos to various albums and not just "add to". That way we can have the photos organised as per requirement. I have being doing "add to" followed by reselection of same photos to "archive to", so that "my photos" are all cleared and kept away in the folders which I have made. Thanks

author: Antonet Kruse
content: Love this but could you please add the ability to save your edits as presets! I use this app to edit my photos and I really love it but it would be so much better if we could save edits as presets to use on multiple pics. Or have the ability to edit multiple pictures at once that would be awesome too! I also really love the pop edit for photos...would love that on video as well!

author: Judy Paden
content: I really like that I never lose my photos when I switch phones. Some features are awesome, like being able to search or select who or what I want to search for. So reassuring that my pics are all readily available even from when I first installed the app in 2013. I only wish I had installed it earlier.

author: Danielle Henare
content: Awesome app, MUST HAVE! Can access photos anywhere anytime, saves photos from mine, my partners phone & any other device we add the app to :) love that you can search what you're looking for thru your photos eg: baby, dog & it shows all of that topic(: fast & doesn't need data to view photos only to upload them :) - Cons: - Not free anymore/costs - For some reason doesn't auto upload so I have to go in and make sure it's uploaded everything (whenever I remember)

author: Craig Fofang
content: Simply amazing. Store your photos here so your phone has space. Does so many useful things! Recognizes faces and compiles collections of that person. Even pulls from your photos and creates your own personal GIFS, animations, creations, etc. Small critique. I would like to be able to add a single or group of photos to more than one album at the same time

author: A Google user
content: Very convenient and easy to use. Missing some of the more fun photo editing capabilities like stickers and needs more filters. Minor issues though considering all the free cloud based storage and decent processing abilities built in. The search is also very powerful as it understands what is in the photo without the need for manual tagging. Wish the collage feature was better. Minus one star for still needing to use other editing apps to do those things.

author: A Google user
content: Google Photos makes organizing photos easy. The intuitive search feature is especially helpful. The commonly-used editing features work well, but I have to use other apps for features like collages. Overall, the simplicity of use makes this the best photo app, in my opinion. My only concern is privacy. While the facial recognition and tagging is convenient, I find it difficult to trust that Google is protecting users' personal information.

author: Jack B
content: Overall love the app. Small bug to report: a photo will say, for example, April 26th, 2023 in its data section and it'll show up under another random date usually close by like April 8th, 2023. Changing the date doesn't fix the problem. I think it's a server issue because it's happening both on the app and on the computer.

author: A Google user
content: Love it! Especially the "rediscover this day". Most times we take pictures and rarely see them. It always puts a smile on my face to remember a beautiful memory. It also does little PowerPoints of pictures from your entire year, for example, that's another cool touch.

author: scott devaney
content: I rank this in my top 5 apps of all time. An app rarely gets a 5 star due to always being able to improve. I enjoy the ease of updating photos to cloud, choose quality, edits and the visuals they put together. Creating new folders and organizing is a breeze. With this being said the facial recognition feature, as great as it is, could use some work. I don't feel it goes through the entire library of images. Most certainly user error. Great job for the developers and all involved.

author: A Google user
content: It's good in many aspects like it backup the photographs and also sync them across devices which really useful when I don't have the exact device I took the photographs on...but the flaws are annoying as on the older version of Google Photos, it is really slow while loading pictures andvideos as well as it does not show the filtered effect well while editing the picture on the application...it gets irritating sometimes but since I haven't used the newer version of it, I can't say anything...let's see...

author: Brandon Concepcion Roman
content: I think this is a great app to store photos and to keep them backed up. The only reason I don't give 5 stars is because I wish I could have the pause and play button on videos next to the bar were it shows the time lapse of the video. The reason being because whenever I try to find a specific frame pressing the pause and play button makes it disappear on the screen and it kinda gets annoying. But other than that it's a great app to store your photos and videos.

author: A Google user
content: i love photos cause its synced, backed and every thing is awesome however it super irritating that photos can not be sorted so i can make folders its all just there. i cam make albums but in photos i cant segregate which is why i also use one drive of Microsoft. :) but like this app as i can access my photos with my gmail wherever and whenever i want.

author: A Google user
content: Great way to manage your photos. It could still use a few more features: blemish removal, color cast (white balance), and stereogram merge. I would also love the ability to set EXIF caption/description. That would improve searching and could be an option to overlay when sharing

author: Chukwuebukaelvis Chukwuebukaelvis
content: Well great app and nice experience so far but here is my suggestion. I think the app should be able to gather all the pictures in one place once u click on (photos) so users can be able to see and view all pics on their phone on a click rather than going through the library to start opening folders and checking them out one by one that's kinda boring for me. But with that been said, app is dope but am gonna hold back the one star ⭐ for now. Peace

author: A Google user
content: Pretty good but a few issues here and there. edit: to be more precise ive had a few random crashes here and there. and an issue with deleting a photo when my phone isnt connected to the internet and it appears again once i am connected. im guessing thjs is because the request is never recieved by the server to delete. but it would be good it the app could cache the delete photo requests and send them when im next online so i dont keep deleting photos.

author: Satyendra Kumar
content: 👎👎👎I've been using this app for more than 5 years, never had any issue with the app. But last week I saw that almost half of my backed up photos are not there, the contacts that shared photos with me, are also not there and everything was also saved in the library but it's empty now. Everything got deleted by itself. And I never delete any backed up photo. They say everything is safe, secure and private to you, how can this happen then?👎👎👎

author: Rashmi Anand
content: This is a fantastic aap for your photos...it can do it many ways...like collage and even movies...this is so nice that u can see ur photo in numerous ways...i would recommend to all...the best part is it even shows..ur earlier memories on the following date...it manages well...i really like this app....best for photos.

author: A Google user
content: Google photos puts together photo books, collages, improved photos, saves memories and makes sharing photos and photo albums easy. It could use IMPROVEMENT in the area of editing photos, especially in regard to simple tools such as cropping a photo, and intermediate but simple ones including blur. Having more advanced features such as object deletion would be a real help. Also skew, manually adjust corners, manual free crop & image text. (Google Lens) when working with and saving documents.

author: Dominic
content: It's a great place to back up photos and videos but I noticed while uploading some photos and videos, the app changed the time of when they were actually taken. Idk if it's just cause I hadnt updated the app yet, but it might be something to look into to fixing.

author: A Google user
content: Seems faster. Editing UI is nicer for movies. My only gripe is the disappearance of effects themes to go with the variety of music choices when editing video. The previous effects could have been better, but I appreciated having them. Hope it comes back.

author: Joshuah Noel
content: Convenient and Simple photo cloud storage app especially if you're a big user of Google's other apps and Products. A few things that i would like to see changed or added is a better way to select multiple or All photos at a time and more Security and Privacy options, like the ability to lock and/or hide albums behind a pin or fingerprint lock.

author: RazzleDazzle Sanfilippo
content: So, there I was, phone maxed out on storage place and I still wanted to take more pictures and save them for editing and printing. Google photos came to my RESCUE! I was able to buy the right amount of space I needed and lucky me, my photos were being already being backend up by Google photos so I already had them set up on my phone. If you do need extra storage Google photos is the place to go!!

author: A Google user
content: Takes great photos and videos. Simple interface and optional features for adjusting same. However, I have added Snapseed app as I find it has many more options for enhancing the Google photos app pics and videos. Maybe Google could have something similar (better) wthin the Google Photos app itself? Update?? Otherwise as I said, I am quite pleased.

author: Sarah Pifer
content: Some instructions are oddly unclear but other than that I LOVE it. My sisters and I share photos in a family album since we live away from each other. The adjustment options are spectacular. I would like to be able to back up ALL OF MY GALLERY not just the albums they choose and being able to detect duplicates for me to verify would be amazing!

author: Subramani S
content: Overall application is good but two things need to update. First thing is Introduce folder option in Library that can help us to move few or all albums to in one folder. It is very important and useful for access photos by planning and fast. As well as second thing is pics once move to album from photos section that should be disappear in photos section. It is best for view and avoid confusion in all pics at photos section. If any issues introduce this two things kindly let us know the reason

author: Mervet Taha
content: Love my Google Photos app. I'd make one change however (and this feature might actually exist). When the archive suggestion pops up, it would be great if there was a way you could delete some photos as part of the archiving process instead of simply reviewing them.

author: Lynne Lusaka
content: Your improvement gives you 3 stars. You need to work on albums. I created albums then deleted what was on camera(photos), only to end up losing my precious pics from the albums. author: A Google user

author: A Google user
content: Great app for managing pictures and videos created on the phone, some easy to use editing features. Occasionally creates great collages, albums, and stylized photos from recently added pictures. Animations could use some work and clearly simply include a 'rewind' of a short clip (my dog never walks backwards 🤣)

author: Colm Burke
content: 2019: Really great app, I use it a lot. Mar2021 update: recent updates a bit annoying. Lost the "Assistant", so harder to locate special memories which the app prompts you for. You used to be able to share those highlighted memories as an album, but that appears to be gone. If it ain't broke... dropped it by one star

author: Ciji Fortner
content: I absolutely love Google photos! The only things that could make it better is if you got just a little bit more storage wothout having to buy Google one and if when you created a folder the pictures you put in it came out of your library. Only to be found in said folder. That would make it a 5 star app in itself.

author: destructo08
content: Setting up the people albums and other such albums seems a bit confusing and vague. You can't manually add people I think and the system does it for you, but you can vaguely help the system. I just think it could be faster if we could manually add people as well.

author: A Google user

Again I'm very grateful for this app...

author: Julius Ivan Quedor

author: SvetlAnna KNUDSON

author: Dara-Lynne
content: Needs more editing options but I love having an app that stores all my pictures and reminds me or suggests what I should do with them when space is getting low. And for the family plan the storage is fantastic. I can recover a lot of images and memories if I ever need to and I'm pretty satisfied with how Google photos works.

author: Alex Savchenko
content: I can't upload my photos into the album I created. Just black squares appear instead of photos. The photos can't be reviewed when clicking on thees squares. Tried 5 times. The issue is fixed by updating the App. Changed my mark to 4, as there was no information about the needed apdate.

author: A Google user
content: This is a powerful app for backing up all my media - over 50 years worth. It does have some problems like skipping video files if I drag and drop more than four, or losing a date I enter online. However, it's the best for sharing with family and friends! You can even enter location data if the file doesn't already contain it.

author: Jeremiah Oluwaseun Akpan
content: anytime i try to edit a picture on my photos, after clicking the edit icon, after 1 to 2 seconds, the picture I'm trying to edit just go black blank and so i can't see what im trying to edit anymore but after editing, despite the fact that i can't see what I'm doing,the things i added while editing would appear after saving it, but in the process of editing it, it doesn't, all i see is just blank and it started exactly after i updated my photos app on Sunday.

author: Júlio

Even when the video loads and it starts to save it sure does take it's time to do so.

author: A Google user
content: Great pictures, Great Effects, Good to have somewhere where my photos can be, but wish that it didn't have to update into something that doesn't really fit in my phone, like if they had a lite version, I'd gratefully use it, or if it could go into my 16 GB SD card... yeah, I haven't even explored all the app yet.

author: Ashish Binu
content: The app is great but it could be improved by drastically simplifying the ui. The default gallery apps in most phones are simpler to use for most people. Also, the Dev's could add an artisitcs slideshow option like that in iOS devices. But in general, it is a good app and can be used as a substitute for default gallery as far as I'm concerned

author: Cathy Watkins
content: Love so many features. Especially the map. Would love it if there were 2 upgrades. Being able to see what photos are not already in an album. Being able to choose different times to use original quality upload vs a lower quality. Like all screenshots upload at a lower quality than photos. Or being able to select a bunch of photos already uploaded and downgrade their quality.

author: A Google user

Please move the memories bar back to the menu, or, give the option to switch this annoying feature off, rather than showing it at the top of the screen every time you open the app. And I definitely do not like the oversized 'photo book store' advert as the first item on the menu.

author: A Google user
content: Generally a good all around app for synching pictures and doing some basic editing and corrections. Search works fairly well. Wish I could tell it when to build a panorama, as it misses some of these opportunities in its "auto awesome" feature or doesn't use all of the pictures in the creation.

author: A Google user
content: This app is what everyone needs. Finally a way to sort through all of your photos with minimal effort and the assistant comes up with some crackers. The only thing I think is missing is the ability or create "folders" or "collections" in which you can group related albums.

author: Eric Pacchioli

And it don't this app don't use your phone storage

author: Safe Journey
content: There are several improvements I would make... Like when you have a notification of an animation made .. if you don't save it right away - where do you find suggestion again? Again maybe it is just how I am using it...thank you though for an overall great app.

author: A Google user
content: Awesome app! I get to keep my photos even if I lose or break my phone. I like some of the photo enhancements, they give a choice on if you want to keep the enhanced or the original. Plus you get to choose which photos that you want to publish. Overall it's a great experience.

author: A Google user
content: Pretty much does what you'd want a photo app to do. Most of the stylized photos are nothing more than really bad-looking, over processed filters, so that could be improved, IMO. Also, searching and sharing options are not the best.

author: Åsa Alfred
content: Update: Got it working again by uninstalling last update and then installing it again. author: Parmjeet Singh
content: It was working fine until recently, now photos are not getting backed up on my wifi connection. It keeps getting piled up. The way it reminds you that beautiful memories from the past of your loved one have become part of daily life. Search has become better but AI search isn't that effective still. I couldn't find find what I needed by describing it, still classic search works better

author: A Google user
content: Only reason you got 4, couldnt do 4.5 and i feel like perfection is impossible. However, my wife and I love this "app", ever since it started creating collages and animations. author: Snow Doggie
content: Having a hard time "verifying my info" to start the 100gb free trial, now that I've ran out of storage. Not happy there's no way to actually call and speak to someone. Other than that haven't had any issues- been using Google Photos for years. I'm glad I never need to worry about my photos being lost again! Thank you for that. I had lost all of my son's baby-3 year photos prior. Never again!

author: Zach Pearce
content: The possibilities & tech support are great. The "suggestions" option is handy & the stylized photos turn out pretty amazing. Some turn out a little unrealistic but still cool & would look good on canvas. Google Photos did great making the organization possibilities practical & easy to use. Including putting together photo albums/books that I can edit with the option to order & buy. I just wish they had more editing options within the app, options you get on editing apps like making collages.

author: Kurtrina Dennis
content: Great photos app. Wish it had options as far as making collages, different backgrounds for editing photos, and the option of getting your deleted photos from the trash if you accidentally deleted photos. Love how it stores thousands and thousands of photos regardless of the time line of when the photo was taken ( I literally have over 20k pics since 2006-2021). They are always safely backed up and can be easily found in my Google photos app. Amazing app, thanks💗!

author: Jamie Hayes
content: I love Google anything, makes my life alit better n easier! Same for Google Photos! I love the the different surprises they make me of some of my pics and the face that I can add my family and we are still connected. All my photos are in one place and I can divide them out into albums, plus order prints or other photo gifts easily! Organizing pics and it even clears up space by deleting already backed up pics! Only 4 stars because for watever reasons my Snapchat folder doesn't show up!

author: A Google user
content: The app got better. It has taken action for the previous suggestion that I gave and it really works well. I just have one more suggestion. To please add an editing feature that can save preset of editing settings that can be copied and pasted later on to future photos. I hope this would be heard and read

author: A Google user
content: The app works generally well. But since it is developed by Google, I expected better. Tagging people is cumbersome at best. Why can't I edit the auto tagging to add more people is beyond me. Changing location from a series of images is tiresome. It should let me batch change them.

author: A Google user
content: I love to be able to see pictures from last year and back. Wish they would stay in photos when you open the app. The collage is nice. You can see pictures of the same person. Like first day of school etc... I still recomend printing all pics you never know if they will disapear! Nice app though.

author: A Google user
content: it's totally awesome and i love how they automatically create albums for faces and places. And also the feature where we can search for things in the picture. author: Solomon Dunkley
content: It's a fantastic app overall. My only real gripe with it is that I can not often enough tell when photo has already been saved onto my phone or uploaded. author: Desi Alvarez

author: A Google user

author: Bob Wilcox

It already has a lock on the Locked Folder, just make that available for the entire photo gallery and it would be 5 stars from me.

author: Alexis Lee
content: For all the devices and accounts I have been using this Cloud Save, it is just ordinary Data Backup; but indeed it does it's job fine; and recently adding few features helping to organize the messy folders (I believe most users experience the same); *One Suggestion: plug in the Image Search, the one in Google Search; I think I will turn more often to this Saving Platform! Thanks!

author: A Google user
content: I like Google Photos as I can categorise my photos into albums and store them online. I also like the edit feature. It would be better if it had more functions like a date stamp and draw feature though. Google Photos made a nice panorama photo of the recent photos I took at the beach. That was nice.

author: A Google user
content: Easy to share photos with my family. Quite convinient to have all photos at one place. Cloud storage is also free of charges. One can also cast the photos easily on TV. I use Chromecast to do this. I also like the assistance function in Google photos which suggests interesting compilations particularly 'rediscover this day' from the past.

author: Brandon Ely

Guess Google is low on funds, FREE IS GONE

author: A Google user
content: Good, but doesnt enable sorting in alpha for albums. As such, it still has a long way to go before it compares favourably with Picasa. Photo editing does not allow for the subleties possible with Picasa either. So....all things considered....not a particularly good move.

author: A Google user
content: The app improved in every way except the new crop system is too difficult to use. The mechanic of zooming and cropping is way too hard on a phone screen. UPDATE Would love to see better options for just deleting photos when archiving is suggested. Often times the suggestion for archiving is simply unnecessary and an option to delete all the suggestions would be more useful.

author: Jonathan T
content: I like this app for the memories it aids in us capturing. I don't like this app because of its limited storage space and how it requires us to pay for extended storage space. Isn't that like double-dipping?

author: Alex Magness
content: The core features of the app are great. Uploading the photos is an easy thing to do and is great for freeing up space on my device. The only issue I've encountered is when uploading photos to google photos the upload speed can be very slow. I've tried it in multiple places with great wifi and this remained the case. Apart from that the app is great!

author: Arindam Basu
content: In my personal opinion, 'Google Photos' is supposedly one of the most widely used and universally accepted Photo & Video editing/storage applications that is out there on the Internet, yet it is the most 'underrated App' that is conventionally used for the aforesaid purpose. author: Robert Katz

So if I took 5 pictures of a bridge, I would like to be able to select those 5 pictures and just type in the bridge description & location once and apply it to all the selected pictures. Web version also needs this feature.

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is a great place to store your pictures on the cloud. However, I used to have an Apple phone and would often have trouble uploading pictures to the cloud. Now that I have a Google pixel I've had no problems at all! It makes sense but I'd still like to see improvements to the iOS app.

author: A Google user
content: Like it but I'm about done with the full screen notification to update the app whenever there's a new update and I go to open the app. I didn't want to update the app and I wish there was a way to opt out of that notification because it's very annoying to have to close it before I can access my pictures.

author: A Google user

author: sirnicolai
content: This is a good tool, but it says it can "Backup and Sync". And yes it backs up, but it's not really a sync. If I delete a picture from my device it stays on Photos, If I delete from Photos then it deletes from my device. If I take a screenshot (which goes into the camera album) then Photos will back it up. If I move that screenshot on my device to a different folder to save it, and then delete it from Photos (because why do I want screenshots in my backup), then Photos will just go and delete it from where ever I moved it to on my device. So I either have a cluttered Photos app with pics I don't want in there, or the pics I don't want get deleted from my phone with no option to keep it. The only way I can keep them is to move them to an SD card and make sure Photos doesn't have permission to delete from an SD card. I could live with this app better if it was more consistent and actually did a "Backup and Sync" like it promises.

Is there any way I can access certain files to recover them? Is it possible to extract the hard drive from my old phones to be able to store these items on a USB storage chip if all else fails? author: Cyrus Irani

author: Peace Benson Nwaoruruaku

When you switch or, change phones, so long as there's Google Photos app in the phone, rest assured, your pictures remain intact and accessible.

author: A Google user

With Google Photos not only do you get amazing photos, but it creates montages, films and animations which truly highlight a productive day. Google photos also surprises you with a flash back comparison. I also love it's editing features and the amount of control you have on your photography.

author: Sammy Shaikh

author: Pratiyush Singh

author: A Google user
content: I'm so glad I had Google Photos back up all my snapshots. I have had one of my linked devices stolen and I would have lost those irreplaceable photos forever if I hadn't. Google Photos & Google Drive are very handy apps to have when running low on space in your phone. Once your items are backed up on these apps there is no need for them to be stored on your phone, freeing up your phones memory.

author: A Google user
content: The absolute best gallery/photos app for Android. It has tons of wonderful features, I'll try and list some of them in my review - I'll start with my favorite. The free UNLIMITED backup of photos in HD! No other gallery app offers this and it's really convenient, you can access and download your photos on any internet browser! Some more of the great and unique features - Trash/Recycle Bin, Picture editing, Lighting fixes (and others) and the assistant that makes videos and collages for you. 😀

author: A Google user
content: I love the fact that all my photos are backed and can be accessed from any computer or phone. I store a huge number of fairly high quality images that can be printed. I can edit the photos anf albums easily. Slideshows limit the number of photos that can be added. Fairly recently, face recognition software has been added which means you can look through all your photos of a particular friend or family member (a great help when preparing a photo book to celebrate a major life event).

author: Debbie S Potter
content: At least I don't have to worry about losing my photos, they're automatically backed up on here as some peeps & pets are no longer alive so this app saves them for me. author: Rohit Santa

author: Tracey Janes

I have made little videos of my pets, and my Grandson. This app is easy to use and you can scan pages and add them to albums like a book. I keep all of my info about fixing my house and receipts in it incase the book is lost, it is all saved there, and my family I add can follow.

author: Mohammad Usman sunlati

author: Daniel Natoli

author: A Google user
content: This app is the BEST! Now, i don't have to scroll through hundreds of photos to look for a specific one. If you just take the time to create an album, all the photos are there! Also, it allows you to share photos, customize them and also makes animated gifs and recommends ways of clearing up space on your device. You can save the names of the people in the app and find all the pics with them! You can do all of this with Google Photos and so much more! Highly recommended!👍

author: A Google user
content: I think this is by far the best app for your pictures collection. For one, all the pictures are backed on the google cloud. Secondly, there are nice preset edit options which are very usable and add more life to the pictures. Then there are some nice surprises by the assistant in the form of collages/ pics with effects/ pictures to archive, etc. etc. The assistant is very intuitive, I must say, one can definitely make this their primary photo app.

author: A Google user
content: i love this app because if you accidentally deleted a photo it will be in achrive. you can free up more space but still have all your photos on your phone. i love that it suggests albums to put image into. it creates collages and other features like this. you can create your own albums so you can put everything into individual categories making life easier when someone asks to see a particular photo but doesn't want to see you messing around. it has features where you can adjust/ play around...

author: A Google user

The assistant is a nice feature that most other apps lack & it's pretty helpful too. Plus, it allows me to easily share pics & videos with my family friends.

author: A Google user

author: A Google user

author: A Google user

author: A Google user

You can edit and set styles to pictures, there is still so much i have not discovered on this app. Massive amount of storage space for free with the option of upgrading for a fee. Not really used Lens yet but I'll get round to that soon. Looking forward to that. Thank you Devs.

author: Kartik Koli

Face recognition and grouping of pictures is amazing. Love that you can easily add photos to multiple albums.

author: A Google user
content: Really good photo/video opener, backup from your phone or using the PC program which backs up all photos/videos in selected folders or individual photos/videos. AI assistant which makes photos look alot better and even makes animations using similar but different photos. Simple album creator and can even make albums into physical photo books. Easy editing of photos (filters, crop, brightness, gamma etc).

author: A Google user
content: By far the best gallery application ever. Granted I use it because it's always been on Nexus/Pixel by default, but the layout and features it has are simply outstanding. Especially the way it automatically creates albums per location or contents of your images is the best. The location albums make it way easier to find a certain picture I am looking for since I know where I took them, and the object based albums are very interesting themselves. Keep up the good work big G.

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is one of the best apps ever. It is very smart ans does everything for you all you have to do is be connected to wifi and it uploads all photos to a server with anyother of your phones with the app. No need to try to spend hours transfering your photos from your old phone to your new one its so easy. This app is extremely helpful. It also gives you the options to name people in your photos and you can view all photos with them in it.

author: A Google user
content: Great! but could use a few improvements. it lags a lot and seems to have a hard time handling lots of photos and videos. it will crash sometimes on the computer. I do love that it syncs well and has some basic photo adjustments you can do to improve your photos without having to learn Photoshop or Lightroom. Perfect for what i need it for.

author: Re BHGBH
content: Easy to use, links to Google account, has a decent amount of storage, automatically recommends which files are duplicates, blurry, or otherwise identified as appropriate for sending to the Bin or for the Archive to free up storage space. HOWEVER, by far my favourite feature is the Search function. It's SO helpful to get easy, fast, relevant & accurate results from years worth of pics. I also love how it's so easy to group pics together with the automatic suggestions using facial recognition.

author: A Google user
content: There are so many photos that I never look at, Google photos makes it so easy to relive some long lost memories. Also allows you to create cool edits or collages of your photos. Very simple to share photos with other Google photo users and any other app on your phone. Oh and the search function is quite impressive! Have been using this app since it released can highly recommend.

author: A Google user

One suggestion would be a way to make screenshots automatically archive after a week , or delete after three months, unless they're flagged. Just a suggestion but that would be useful so I don't manually have to go and delete everything.

author: A Google user
content: Nice App - I only miss three opportunities: 1) There is just one level of Album, I would love to add a hierarchy to merge some Albums -> cleaner, faster and easier to find fotos 2) Often there are 3-10 Photos looking nearby exactly same. It would be nice if those pictures can be hidden behind one of them and if you think the one in front isn't the prettiest, it should be able to choose one of the others - UPDATE: NOW AVAILABLE 3) It should be easier to sort the Albums

author: Ivan

At present terms you're supposed to buy this every single year. Thats not ok.

author: A Google user
content: Great to have your entire lifetime of photos instantly accessible on your phone (in wifi/data range) with an easy-to-use browsing interface. You can search key terms like 'car' or 'beach' and relevant photos will be displayed. Great for phones with limited storage capacity such as my Galaxy Note 5 (32GB) as the clean up wizard prompts to remove local photos that have been backed up/synced to the cloud. This the model of 21st century photo management.

author: Alice Bathory
content: The ONLY photos app I use. Always. Easy to use, quick search to all my pictures, very useful INDEED! Quality images. Crop/draw/tint available too. Handy sections to find each individual or group photos, with very easy Email address options that offer you to fill in and save immediately. Google Photos is absolutely necessary to myself and my hectic social media life 😁😁👍👍

author: Van Khanh

I guess I will be using this app for my lifetime with the kind of updates and the advancement it pulls up everytime. Thank you Google.

author: A Google user
content: Despite the fact that this app is stock with Android, it's really well done. Reminds me of the awesome places I've traveled to!

author: A Google user

Will forever be grateful for this.

author: A Google user

author: A Google user

content: The incremental improvements are excellent. Please add mote granular control over how photos are deleted, added and where. I really just want to dump some old photos into Google photos, delete it from my hard drive and it is still in Google Photos as well as the Google Photo folder on My Drive. [Edit - Ok so just using the Google Photos website instead if the Back & Sync app achieves this, minor hassle] Ps. Yes your are tired of hearing this, but please bring Picassa back from the grave.

author: A Google user
content: I absolutely love the fact that I can easily backup everything on Google Photos. It's literally a godsend. I can't believe people pay for icloud storage when this is a free option. The functionality is super simple, though i would say people with slower connections might struggle to upload videos sometimes. I've convinced all my colleagues and family to use this for their storage and so far I've had no complaints. I also sometimes like the automated edits and animations in the For You section.

author: Tomas
content: Back ups are so important, I accidentally deleted 500 pictures on one drive thinking they will only be deleted on the app, but they all got deleted from my phone ! After trying to get them back for an hour I just opened Google pictures ..and there they all were safe and sound. I'm so happy that I have more than 1 cloud backup! When it comes to the app itself I like it, easy to use and creates albums and stories for me which is very convenient!

author: Chelsea J
content: This has been the single best photo/video storage solution I have every tried. I've been using Google Photos as my exclusive storage solution for many years now and recommend it to friends and family whenever I can. All of the little extra features make this app stand out: the photobooks, the memories, the tagging faces and searching through your photos by keyword. Just an overall fantastic Google product that I would highly recommend if your photos and videos are important to you!!!

author: A Google user
content: It's great on iOS and used it to backup my photos before I switched to android (5 years worth of iOS photos). Worked great until I started taking pictures on my G5 and saving them to the SD card and now can't delete them using the app and have to use the default app to manage them which means I'm doing everything twice. Please sort it out as it's a great app otherwise. EDIT all these have been fixed. It's amazing now

author: A Google user
content: Google Sevices have always been top notch, Google Photos? not an exception. Very simple, very friendly interface, with a wonderful sorting system. From person specific Albums to a search bar for location based information, this app has it all! As a photographer, Editing photos has never been easier, I've been using to for years. (Huawei User; P30 Pro)

author: A Google user
content: Can't beat "free" storage for all my photos. Default size is good enough for almost every photo and you can always save special ones in original size. Duplicates do get uploaded because I often edit or resize my pics. ***update - Well they took away the unlimited storage of photos for free. There's still a lot of storage if you are careful to curate what to keep and what you delete. Do the same for Gmail.

author: A Google user
content: Hands down the best photo gallery app ever! I've got all my pictures backed up and it's so cool knowing that I'll never lose my photos even if my phone gets stolen. I really wonder how Google manages to let users back up unlimited photos to their servers for free. 🤔🤔 What I like most about this app is how easy it is to search for pictures of a specific person with name labels, and also how easily one can share pictures instantaneously with the help of a link. Simply the best!

author: Benedikt von Butler
content: Have been uploading several hard drives of photos, 100,000+. You would never look at them if not online, let alone find pictures to suit occasions, eg an anniversary or a holiday or relatives. Google photo's face recognition is scarily astonishing and works very well. I wish I could organize my folders better or at least sort alphabetically, but other than that incredibly useful.

author: Super Ja
content: The app is great as a cloud service. My problems with it are that when you delete photos they sometimes come back, the fact that my phone's normal gallery has more editing options and that you can't edit the date of more then one picture at a time outside the web. I like how easy it is to understand the UI and that every photo loads fast.

author: Sagar Lokare
content: Google photos is by far the best app I have experienced for storing photos and videos. 10 on 10. I like all the features like styled, cinematic photos, animation, collage and movie. I Love the music they add to the movies, it nice. I also like the memory feature which makes me nostalgic. Great work team. Hoping to get more and more features to enhance many more experiences.👍😊

author: A Google user
content: A great place to store all your photos without losing any quality of the image or video. One of the best thing about this app is it groups images and videos based on location and date. So when want to check the image later after a long time just type in the date or location and there it is. The assistant in google photo automatically generates stylised photos, animations and videos from the images or videos we upload. Another awesome thing is face grouping.

author: A Google user
content: Essential for the phone photographer. Backups, editing, albums, Google-made movies set to music, burst-mode animations. All that's missing is more choice making video slideshows. But there are ways around that. The archiving selections are not to be trusted; Google Photos can't tell when images are the right way up (gets this 100, per cent wrong, in fact).

author: Stuart
content: Easy to use and of course is always linked to your Gmail account and therefore the cloud. It's not perfect - not always easy to find something other than scrolling down looking for the day or month. The app does create albums all on its own but they don't often "get it right" with their choice of titles or photo inclusion. I guess a perfect AI isn't here just yet...
