author: Holly Shanahan
content: I honestly love this app. So handy to have!!!! I wish there was a feature however to scan for duplicate photos, because everytime i redownload an old photo, my Google photos uploads it again as a new photo, and have ended up with multiple copies of the same photos. Either way I love this. Being able to always have my photos from multiple devices, sharing albums instead of sending them over etc. So useful

author: A Google user
content: This app helps a lot to organise all my photo. Actually, Google does :) Just wanted to add, it would be better if you allowed adding people's faces manually for a photo. And also, to be able to see the list of people in a photo. EDIT: Yeah, the latter suggestion was added. Please look for the former one.

author: Temitope Baoku
content: I love the throwback pictures it brings to relive your memories, the collage, the wide range of options you get using the app too. I would love Google photo to add a feature that can enable you group your pictures according to a type, for examples faces together and bags or shoes together, automatically, without having to create an album, and selecting manually.

author: A Google user
content: Absolutely fantastic the A.I. power of this app makes it so useful! I love how it automatically sorts all your photos, labelling them without you having to do anything. With the thousands of photos I've taken I need a tool like this. It's also really great for sharing, I frequently create shared albums and add people to them after we've been on holiday together.

author: A Google user
content: To be honest, Google photos has a bunch of options to stylise your pics, which I never use x) My 5* review comes from the fact that it worked perfectly for what I wanted and needed: backing up all my photos and memories free of charge! Yes, the phtos are downgraded to 16Mp, but it still keeps a great quality, so I'm happy with that. Maybe in the future we might get lucky to back up 20Mp+ pics for free, but so far so good. Keep it up team!

author: jonel bataller
content: This app is great for organizing and managing your photos. You can separate them by date, event, place, and even the people in the photo. Google Assistant also gives you free animations and stylized photos randomly. I love this app and I dont think Ill ever go back to my regular phone gallery. It lets Me keep thousands of my photos ranging all the way back to 2015 It is absolutely free storage and allows you to share images and albums with friends. I Download it and you won't be disappointed!

author: A Google user
content: I used to store all of my camera rolls on OneDrive as I already have a 1TB O365 Home subscription. Until I started searching for photos in the past, I realised how hard it is within OneDrive to search for the right photos especially by faces. That's when I tried out Google photos. Yes photo resolution has to be capped at 16MP, and that made me hesitate for a while, but if the trade off is >16MP photos vs ease of finding the right photos of your loved ones just when you need it, I'd go latter.

author: A Google user
content: This app doesn't arranges in the proper DATE when the photo was clicked. Only gets sorted at the time when photo was UPLOADED. Should be capable enough to customize as per the system camera timings, for exact date been there on the photograph. Awaiting to be updated soon in the App settings. Edit as on 04/24/20 : The above problem listed is sorted. 😊

author: gody fon
content: It's a very good app. I mean, it's one of the best photo app ever. With recent updates. But Concerning the case of picture EDITING,we the users would prefer the previous format. I mean with the LIGHT, COLOR, & POP options.i would say It was better than this recent update because the user could manually adjust his\her photo to his\her taste unlike the latest update which only has the option to ENHANCE an image. Thanks for understanding.. I raise my case.. 🙌

author: Mohan Doss Kuberan
content: This one of my oldest favorites which also keep some of the expected features at bay for a long time. Still, searching, tagging, grouping and sharing photos is way easier. The way it reminds you of past moments at the exact time and stylizing photos selectively is just awesome. If you're an android user, you'd be missing a lot if you aren't using this.

author: A Google user
content: I am liking the App when I get to know the auto saving option for photos with high quality. This will save all the hassle of transferring the photos to physical drive, instead, to the generous Google Cloud. Thank you. Mr. Google. Feedback for improvement? Why is the drive storage of my friend and I is different? mine is just 15GB, and his is 150GB.

author: A Google user
content: Love it. With over 100,000 pics and videos uploaded, I have yet to find a better alternative app that do what it does. The auto indexing is what sets it apart from me .. instead of trying to remember in which album a certain photo is stored from 10 years ago, I can simply search by a name or combination of names or by location or by date or by all this strings at the same time. E.g. I can easily find pictures of my cat (yes GP indexes pet faces) taken with a particular person for the past 10yrs.

author: A Google user
content: wow...just deleted a video that was really important, i went hunting to find if there was a way to get it back, ended up on Utube but it didn't work for me I couldn't find the app mentioned to download, went on the photo icon on my phone where you can now organise and archive clutter and bingo, got my video back. absolutely excellent, well done Google.

author: A Google user
content: After the latest update, I really hate this app. There used to be a little function (but for me very essential), where I could see which photos had been uploaded or not (the small cloud in the right corner on each pic). See, I've got lots of pictures in my phone, such as photos taken with relatives or friends, screenshots, funny stuff from the internet, Line, Whatsapp, Facebook etc. By using Google Photos, I could sort all my pictures out, separate the important pictures from the less ones. But that's impossible now. Please fix that and I will rate it 5 stars again.

author: Babak Hamedani
content: Great tool for back up and viewing pics, unfortunately the free unlimited version ended but still I prefer the photo video back up capabilities to other cloud services. You pay for a premium service. Google one, Google photos and their apps are very smart in organizing your photos and videos. Make the best memory books and other nice things out of your photos. It organized by face/person very neatly and you can find someone's pictures quick and easy.

author: The Yack
content: I like this app. It's brilliant for backing up my pictures and knowing that if anything happens to my HD or phone they are there ready to download or view at anytime. Just a shame Google are changing their policies on free storage and services this coming June. For anyone else interested, download the Sync app and set it to back up your photos and anything else that's important to you straight to your PC and/or external hard drive. Makes it easier to manage when you hit max storage on Google.

author: A Google user
content: Started using before even getting the pixel phone. easiest photo storage that csn be used seemlessly on all platforms. Shared album is the feature i use the most and could not get easier to share photos with my partner. No more "can you send me the picture please"! The assistant is really good and has helpful suggestions. Overall love the app!

author: Gita Prasetya Adiguna

The app can even combine some photos into panorama photo, and automatically (Seems like i took many panorama unintentionally and google remind me that my photos can be used to make one). Also my couple videos get combined and enchanted with effect and music, and add a few related photos, that is why i called it creative.

author: A Google user
content: Don't know anymore how I lived without. Perfect way to store and organize photos without any hassle by doing pretty much nothing outside of uploading them to cloud. The app will do the rest and name them searchable, organize them in albums etc. without you having to do anything. I certainly don't miss all the trouble of manual organizing, metadata addition, random filenames etc.

author: Tim Sousa
content: I do not have words to describe how I feel when I clear 5Gbs of memory at once with just one click. This app is just amazing. The feature that I love the most is the backup option. It's free, good quality, and when the backup's done you can just wipe everything off of your phone with just one tap. I currently have 0 gigs of memory occupied with photos. Great app for people with low storage and that want to transfer their photos from one phone to another. Great job google! You're the best! <3

author: A Google user
content: It's fantastic to have the peace of mind knowing that any memories I capture are backed up as frequently as I access WiFi. Being able to access them anywhere and on almost any device is extremely useful as well. It is slightly disturbing how it analyses your photos, but as with all things Google the benefits generally outweigh the intrusion.

author: A Google user
content: Please make the zoom in/out more user friendly, especially in the landscape mode. Also, add an option to access the folders page upon opening the app. Since rotating the picture is a very common thing to do, make option more accessible. All in all, the app is super convenient and intelligent.

author: A Google user
content: Extremely convenient app, so happy that I can use it. It automatically uploades all the media files and not only stores them, but keeps the folders, and sorts them out for even further convenience! Moreover, it makes collages, videos, etc all on its own, and I don't even bother to recheck what's stored, or not, it suggests to delete the files that are securely stored from the phone memory automatically!!! That's dope indeed! So thankful to the developers! (*˘︶˘*)

author: Jona San
content: seamless experience years ago until now.., best ui ux, easy to navigate even at first use, best app to backup (all) your photo, also i like the surprises (for you) that magically edited! and we can auto tag person with 90% accuracy, then we can search/filter photos/videos that we want to see, i think it's make it easier for us to find! just AWESOME!!

author: A Google user
content: One nifty feature I like in Google Photos is the "Info" option. Once you have uploaded the photo you can edit the Info field of a photo. I use it to label or tag certain photos I might need to look up later such as big purchase receipts, photos of instructions, or 'Christmas card from Bob 2019'. This makes it a great archival system by making it searchable.

author: Natalia Villafane
content: I've been using this app since 2016, don't regret it. It's great because you can free up your phones space by having you pictures backed up. Another great thing is you can have everything back in your phone by downloading it again. It's great for email back ups and google docs or sheets. By having things backed up you can access them in any device just with you google account. And the search engine are great to find specific thing you can search by facial recognition, or by date it's great .

author: Luca G
content: It's amazing, especially the AI futures. Some improvements: -I would like to choice the order rate of the photos, not just by date but also by size ecc. -I would like to have a normal grid when I open the gallery and not a random different format. -I would like more matching with iOS media, sometimes there's error system and difficulty in sharing.

author: A Google user
content: Google photos is a very convenient app. It saves photos, automatically edits a few of them, has good memory space, most importantly it automatically uploads photos from your phone gallery. It is very organized, and simple to use. Google photos not only sorts your images date wise but also gives you the option to tag your family and friends for you to easily find any image. You can even share a full album with someone without reducing image quality directly from the app. I definitely recommend it.

author: chantalle shae
content: This is honestly an amazing app. I have had my memories mysteriously wiped multiple of times or deleted due to lack of space and it used to be really annoying tbh.. But since this app i have been able to relax and have as many memories as i like, without having to worry about my storage and loss of files.. I have no regrets downloading this app..

author: A Google user

The backed up quality to Google is still of good quality.

author: WeirdOo

And what's better if you have photos on your pc, You can upload them here. It can recognise Peoples faces very well, it can tell if a certain picture were taken in a ceremony or event, and it reminds you that during this time a year or more ago, this picture was taking. Truly amazing

Maybe you can add a much better portrait photo option than whatever we have now. Note: Hey guys, after the recent update I couldn't find an option to reduce my pictures (Portrait blur) amount. So, put your magic there too.

author: A Google user
content: Aside from the fact that Google has a lot of our personal datas, the app and its integration in the Android ecosystem is amazing (especially on a Pixel 2 XL). I have shared albums in which pictures are added automatically with face detection. The assistant makes collages and funny videos regularly (yes, including with your NSFW content which makes them even more hilarious) and even shows you the pictures you took on that day years ago! I personally love using it and it makes having a photo library easy (otherwise the pictures would just sit on my hard drive).

author: Samuel Loveridge
content: I've had Google photos for some years now,it's fantastic in my opinion, never had any issues, have always found photos quick and easy some go back years! Like how it lets you pick what photos represent what so it can organise them, with sky being in sky etc, I like I can share an album by a link then unshare when I want. Like that I can sign in on any device and bang there they all are. Safe and secure and with a locked folder available. Altho I wish I could have more than one locked folder.

author: A Google user
content: This app has gone in a wonderful new direction. I just hope they keep improving it in the same vane and not go of on some wild tangent. Search and photo id are awesome (Except for gorillas, obviously ). Manual photo tagging needs an implementation. And general photo sorting should have more options and deeper integration with knowledge graph.

author: Pat Hunter
content: A fantastic way to store your photographs in high quality format. I like the way you can access the pictures from any device you authorise (keeping your data secure). The photos are easy to share with friends and the general public and I really love the way the app reminds you where you were and what you were doing and who with, 1, 2, 3... Years ago. One of the apps that you use without effort and is almost woven into the fabric of life. A go to app for photos and videos. KEEP IT FREE!

author: A Google user
content: For what it's worth, what makes this app different from.othwr apps is the Google Assistant and Google's machine learning algorithms running in the backend for you. I no longer have to sort or categorise photos, keyword searches are more than capable. The timeline based navigation is also another feature. Really love the way we can zoom in and out of a photo collection.

author: Jim Mitchell
content: I've surprised myself how much I've come to depend on Google Photos. I photograph, access, store, edit and post from four different digital devices so being able to view and post synchronously, so easily, I find amazing. I'm still learning how to utilise all the 'tricks', and the quirks of Photos, but I am getting there. I've been photographing for almost 70 years starting with a Brownie box, then an Agfa Isolette, and even resorting to matchbox pinhole cameras when I taught science.

author: A Google user
content: Probably the best place to store photos on the web. The app has unlimited storage for high-quality photos, Google assistant integration which helps you track and manage your photos and the app allows you to share albums with other Google users with a few button clicks. Unlike other photo storage apps you can actually use the web version to manage your photos. Now I have a lot of free storage on my Android phone and I don't worry about my prescious memories.

author: A Google user
content: Absolutely brilliant app, the algorithm that makes the videos and GIF's from pictures, videos and albums is wonderful. Truly a great app that i didn't realise had so much more than just a picture store. Since using it I've won over my daughter and wife to use on their phones too. The fact all of the videos and gifs are made automatically is a really nice suprise every other day or so. Thank you!

author: Valerie Osment
content: HELP PLEASE! I've always been very happy with this app, hence the 5 stars, safely storing all my photos in one place. But since the latest update, it's been very unstable, I can scroll through my photos, but when I try to find out any info about them, it crashes. Then I get a message saying to reinstall the app. I have done this, several times, but it doesn't work!

author: A Google user
content: I've used this app for a long time since Picasa was laid in the Google graveyard, and it just keeps getting better. Automatic backups are almost essential these days, as most new phones don't support micro SD cards. The editing functions are great, even just the basic "enhance" or "fix lighting". A Google One membership unlocks not only way more storage, but extra useful features as well.

author: Kianne Ramos
content: A really good app, It's not your regular gallery of your photos it gives you a slide of the photos you've taken which honestly make you reminisce of all of the experiences you've had in your life. Not only that, you can back-up your photos and videos that makes worrying about how you should save your photos and vids nonexistent, so whether if there come a time that you need to restart your phone or have a new one,your photos will still be saved. I highly recommend this app as your main gallery:)

author: A Google user
content: I love the convenience of it backing up from my devices and staying with my Gmail account. That's phenomenal that they can be accessed at least when something breaks or does bite the dust. Next off I find the "stylised" filter it does automatically awesome, the rest I could do with/without it doing automatically 💁 but it doesn't hurt any. Saves tons of space on my phone in the end.

author: A Google user
content: Best photo app out there, unlimited storage with decent quality (it would be perfect if they increased the video quality to 4k60, but that's fine tho). Assistant does a great job creating short movies, collages, etc. Albuns organized by people via face detection is great when you wanna search for a photo of someone specifically. Couldn't recommend more.

author: A Google user
content: Great app for media management and backup. Recent integration with assistant helps keep clutter under control and "rediscover this day" features constantly delivers pleasant memories. I also like that there's an option to make unlimited backups for people who can't afford buying extra storage or those who doesn't need media in the original resolution and are happy with just "good enough" quality.

author: A Google user
content: Never been so suprised...! And just so happy...! All at the same time!!! I've just recovered hundreds of photos I had backed up using a phone that I later lost in December last year!!! I've now decided to scan all my old photos that are safely kept in the family albums, and back them up in the google photos' free 15GB cloud drive. I LOVE THIS APP! Strongly recommend it to one&all. Thanks Google.

author: A Google user
content: Google Photos: is arguably the best photo gallery out there, and that includes every devices own photo album's / galleries!! I know that the "CLOUD" Is a cloud??? And there's Amazon, icloud, Dropbox, Google drive, etc, etc, but Google photos has lots of different amazing features, great free 15gb storage, personal collages, videos, pdfs, and all backed up too! Etc, etc, I would be lost if I didn't have it. Well done and keep up the good work. Mr T Nicholson Edinburgh uk

author: A Google user
content: This is the bomb! I travel a lot and take a lot of high res photos for work and personal use. It is THE quickest way to access and download photos across multiple devices and costs me $0. Whem my husband was travelling across remote Australia with intermittent signal, his phone would upload the photo's as he passed through an area with signal. I viewed them on our smart TV and knew where he was and the terrain he was travelling through instantaneously. So versatile!

author: Michelle Chantler
content: I find it a superb way to create short movies. Plus plenty of unlimited space. Sometimes a snag in the download but easily fixed. Amazing Having the ability to keep so much space by keeping your photos at the right size truly helps save money. Plus archive is amazing you don't loose anything but again you are left with plenty of extra space. A very easy to use app with little complications. Google.

author: Adhy Prasetiya
content: Easy to selective sync across platforms, unlimited space, (not) free (anymore), superb algorithm for organizing and search for pict (tried to type keyword 'table', and all my pics that contain table shows up!). Easily share albums with my family. Auto add photos of certain people into certain albums. Couldn't expect more.

author: Sarah Mek
content: Google photos is the best because you are able to keep your photos safe on it. Another good thing about it is that, your photos are well organised into categories which makes it easier to locate certain images. Lastly but not the least is, it reminds you everything when your phone turn another year old...good memories to ponder upon after a long time.

author: A Google user
content: Great application to manage your photos. it allows you to organize into album, share with anyone through whatsup, facebook, shareit, gmail etc. You can make collages, videos. Photos are put together year wise, which makes it easier to remember.Allows uou to backup your photos to drive will help you to save space and helps you to retrieve photos anytime, anywhere. Great app and recommend to use.

author: A Google user
content: When i switched to photos i was quite unfamiliar with the app i had never used it before, but after some time it is the only app i want to mange my photos with, the way it classifies photos according to people's face and location is amazing. You don't need to scroll and look for a single photo, all you need to do is say about the photo and its here. Loved it

author: RVA The Reigning Queen

You can save all your folders and have no problem downloading them back. Its a whole package!

author: A Google user
content: I love the Assistant feature. It automatically makes videos of my trips when I upload photos, based on the timestamp of the pics l. It also makes animations picking up images with small varience in elements, sometimes you endup with funny GIFs, it also creates panoramic views based on the latitude and longitude of the images, which I was very surprised, it's incredible the precision with which the images are made. it also stylize your pics, by fixing brighteness and putting some filters.

author: Neil Horowicz

author: Rahul Haldar
content: Google Photos is the best Android app for managing and sharing photos. It's easy to use, reliable, and secure. I can easily organize and edit my photos, and the app automatically creates collages, animations, and other fun creations. I also love the ability to share my photos with friends and family with just a few taps. Overall, Google Photos is the best Android app for photos, and I highly recommend it to anyone.

author: Chris Key

I also enjoy that they group my children so you can see how fast they grow.

author: A Google user
content: It works well. my only complaint is the push to buy photo books which doesn't seem to pop up nearly as often as it did at first. The back up and storage is great. I lost my phone but still had all my photos of my baby girl's first day and first steps.

author: Diana Chambers
content: This is a worry-free backup system for my photos. I don't have to wonder where they are because I know Google Photos has them. I love how easy it is to make albums and share them with family and friends right away. You can even pick photos and order photo books and/or share them as memory keepsakes. Thanks Google for making my life easier.

author: Benjamin Holloway (OK_BigBen_OK)
content: I love this app again. So many great features. And the Ai search is working better. This used to be my favorite app. The recent update removes the shared folder access on the landing page. Now I can't find the shared folders. Response to dev: yes, but it's not the same. There's even still room at the top for the old shared album icon to go right back where it was.

author: brian anderson
content: I REALLY REALLY LOVE THIS APP!!!!! My wife kept telling me she wants us to make a album of the kids but i never have time but with this app i just picked the pics, the order of them, and the cover after that i paid and about a week later the perfect family photo album came to my door. Kept the wife happy without having to juggle or stress about time. What more could i ask for?

author: Heaven Trayal
content: Would like to be able to have better editing tools...and to be able to pick what photos I would like stileized...but mostly l love not having to worry about losing photos!!!! I lost most all my family photos from early years and it's still heart breaking...glad there is something I can do about it now

author: Marie Ange Mukagahima
content: I truely like memories and pictures organisation. But may be if possible make it easier to find a picture to put on watsap status .. Because it is difficult to put a picture on watsap from storage due to the way requires to search a picture in one folder. So if it is may be from over one month picture, it require a realy painful search

author: A Google user
content: Well, first time using Google photos app was like the super great thing for me when I was realising that there's storage that I can just keep my moments and pictures and now you can be able to even share the photos after getting them back to your device with provider rates,if you like to other social media platforms, it's working great for me as my pic info is kept safely but I get it with my authentication details...

author: A Google user
content: Great app, which is compatible with mobile devices (android and iOS) and computers. Have some features in common with other photos apps, but it's the only one I've know that allows storage pictures on the cloud, for free. This is GOOGLE!

author: A Google user
content: Google photos automatically downloads all my photos so I never have to worry about losing a photo. It also makes storybooks that I can share which is awesome! I'm so busy I never have time to do this things. I highly recommend this app. I've been using it for over a year with no issues. 4 years later, still the best app on my phone!!!

author: A Google user
content: This app is great! You can set it to automatically backup your photos online in the cloud from your laptop, tablet, and phone. You get unlimited space to store high quality photos (slightly smaller than full resolution) and also get a large amount of space to store high resolution photos. This app makes it easy to create albums and share photos with friends who can also add to the albums if you choose. App can also be accessed online. This is the best photo storage/sharing app out there IMO.

author: Kisal Keheliya
content: Google Photos is simply the best photo app out there! From seamless backup to amazing editing tools, it covers everything you need. Its AI-powered search makes finding memories effortless, and the sharing options are top-notch. The storage management is a lifesaver, helping to free up space without losing a single moment. The Memories feature is heartwarming, and the ability to create albums or collages is superb. Truly a 5-star app that goes above and beyond expectations!

author: Vishal Ramnauth
content: One of the tools I've on my phone. If you know how to use it properly, it is usefull as fuc*. Simply with a few tabs you may create unbelievable thing. Ontop, being a professionale photograoher this app allows me to store and deliver pictures to my client easily. Storing my own memories for a decade already, makes me emotional time to time and gives me the chance to cherish those wonderful moments. Some people are still here, with whom I get the chance to do it while some left or no more.

author: A Google user
content: Great app, 5 stars, but I would like to have a setting that would stop that "Clean the device" from appearing 'cause I want to keep the originals too. I clicked it once and it didn't even ask if I really want to do that. Hopefully I think it got only to trash so I could recover them. Anyway, I love the assistant part.. it just made the funniest Movie out of my videos and photos taken today. Love it!

author: A Google user
content: I absolutely LOVE Google Photos! I love capturing memories with pictures and videos, and Im not the most organized person. Thanks to this app i can capture all the memories possible, keep them all, and be COMPLETELY organized! I love how it suggests things to archive, and it seems to choose the ones that wouldnt be kept anyway. I could honestly go on and on about why i love this app, but if you dont already use it...you should. You wont be disappointed! Hands down, EXCELLENT app!

author: Michael Bosslet
content: Hot take incoming - This tech company Google, makes good products for my life and needs. I really like having everything synced up amongst them. I think there are always features that could be cooler, or some of the UI might be improved in some ways. Ultimately I need my products to work consistently, and do what I expect them to do. Photos does that for me 100%. And IMO every UI that's ever been created, has been one's favorite thing, and another's worst ever. Not a factor for my rating.

author: A Google user
content: A must have app for anyone who takes lots of photos and keeps running out of space on their device and/or struggles with organising their photos. This app isn't for businesses or professional photographers, but rather the mums and dads, friends and happy snappers in the world who take pics on their phones of the things and people in their lives. It's easy, smart, runs perfectly on IOS and Android, Web-app and desktop... and free. It also always gives you something to share. Perfect!

author: Terry V Bush (The Veritable Bugeater)
content: I'm impressed! I complained to Google Support that I had a photo always trying to upload but never making it. This caused it to always say there was one photo preparing for backup. Fortunately a recent update has a feature where if you click on the message that says there are photos uploading it will show you which ones! I found the offending photo which was messed up and deleted it. Now the backup is complete! Thanks!!! I still wish I could request a panorama of pics of my choosing... Wishing!

author: Rebecca Northcott
content: Makes memories fun again! I loved the memory reels, the collages and animations. They do the work for you and it was a lovely surprise when I first saw it. Really makes things easy, shareable both digitally abd physically (you can even get photo books printed). Best photo app in a while. Thank you!

author: Amber Miles
content: I've always really enjoyed Google Photos. It's great! It has so many wonderful features. It's easy and convenient. From storage to easily finding things to sharing pics with loved ones, this app does it all! Absolutely amazing! I ordered my Mom a photo book for this upcoming mother's day and it came out fantastic! She got it early and loved it! This app is top notch in my book. Btw Photos deleted go to the trash for 60 days it always asks if I'm sure too if they're backedup you can get them out

author: A Google user
content: I love all the wonderful extras that it offers without even going in and doing em myself, such as little animations when you do multiple photos in a row. Being a new mom I don't have the extra time to open another app and scroll through it to fine tune images and make little extra changes with my pictures. It's so amazing to take a pic and then have the same app suggest and then do all the little retouches for you. I absolutely love this app and use it almost everyday with my families pictures.

author: A Google user
content: I was pleasantly surprised at how good this app is. You just open it and your photos will start backing up. Its REALLY smart and can organize your photos based on what/who they are. (Face recognition is great, and it can also organize things like sunsets and "palaces" instead of "sky" and "building." Face and object recognition is perfect) One of the nicest features to me is that itll send notifications of "__ years ago today/this week" & you can look back on old memories. I love it.

author: M.D.K. De kay
content: I am very pleased with the app. It is easy to use and does everything that I want to do with my photos, videos, and screenshots, as well as setting up albums and sharing. Although there are some exceptionally good apps for editing, special effects and other features, Google Photos is by far the best for all the basics.

author: Liza
content: Google Photos is the only reason I have many important and sentimental pictures from throughout the years. I always have access to all my content through Google Photos on any device I have ever used. It automatically syncs with your device to upload and backup all the photos on any device. Google Photos has access to options from editing photos and videos, creating collages, slideshows, creating an Album, sharing your content with family and friends and etc. I would highly recommend this app!

author: Ikenna Anabor
content: There was a time when I would amass pictures on my phone and would have to back them up to my PC before deleting excesses to free up space. Google photos simply sends a notification that allows me delete photos that have already been automatically backed up to google. I confess I don't use the app much but this feature alone is golden for me.

author: A Google user
content: Long time Google customer. Great tool. I would, however, like to have an option to clean up duplicate photos. Between different inputs (Google Photos mobile/PC and Google drive on PC/mobile), moving images can be duplicate them. Thanks Google. I'm glad you haven't been associated with nefarious personal data selling. I'm happy to hear it. :)

author: Kelly R
content: I wish there was a way to change the date/time within the app and an easy way to delete similar or see delete duplicate images, but otherwise its a great app! I've uploaded photos that were on old CDs, and scanned in photos from albums. My google photos timeline now goes back to 1977! Some of the creations of the google photos assistant are awesome!

author: Trauma Healing Prevention Services
content: Aside from the fact that Google wants everyone to have their own phone (and therefore no way to select which account photos need to go to) satisfied. Disappointed it started out free with unlimited storage.... and like everything else, "free" and "unlimited" are repeatedly redefined. Not shocked or surprised, just disappointed in the lack of dedication to original customers. Quality is good, dependability and consistency have room for improvement.

author: Ankur Jaiswal
content: Google photos is BY FAR the best photo storage and management app that I have used. I have over 300K photos on the Google Photos/Google Storage account and yet I am able to organize the photos in a variety of logical ways. The new features rolled out in the past couple of years, e. g. Memories, etc. have made it easier to enjoy the past photos even more. It is also easy to locate the photo in the storage by simply asking in the search. I would highly recommend Google Photos to every one.

author: A Google user
content: Just click n let it handle the rest of the things..DNT bother At all..it will suggest u automatically, will make animations itself, will remind u what u were doing last time on the same date.. I can say it honestly that editing n saving the photos have never been easy.. I shoot a lot.. n rest it does for me..my best companion.. I DNT have to worry at all.. n I can promise u would also fall in love with it..❤️❤️

author: Dequina Nicholas Alvarado
content: Once you start using Google photos you'll wonder why you ever didn't. You can keep your phone storage free and will always have space for videos. The best features is that the photos are searchable and easily organizeable. Also you can share photos, albums, or even your entire library!

author: Vanessa Medina
content: I've been using Google Photos for years now and it's one of the best things ever! I never have to worry about losing my photos OR videos From my phone, tablet, or COMPUTER! People are always amazed I have photos from 1996 in my phone. I don't! It's Google Photos!!! I love being able to search through my thousands of photos and videos easily By name, by thing (like dancing) and sometimes by pet. Unfortunately, face recognition no longer works for pets very well. That was great!

author: A Google user
content: I'm a photographer and I love the ease of performing basic editing. techniques that can be done in the field using my phone, when I don't have my cameras. plus all your editing and original content are synced to all devices. sharing privately, to social media, or even to Google maps is a simple task that looks very professional. just add a few filters and add-ons to your camera apps and you can get quality pictures. It even has a link button to continue editing in other prefered apps. sweet.

author: Robert Noble
content: I LOVE this app. I use it multiple times a day. It's such a convenient way to find old pictures or videos of certain people or places or things. I esp love to make birthday cards for people that show old picture memories with them. I don't know how I lived before I found this app! Seriously, every picture you've ever taken all at your finger tips.

author: Deb C.
content: I love Google, I love and appreciate the photo storage & many featues in Google photo app. It's very helpful. I am grateful, thankful. The only issue I have is when I delete a photo from Google pictures it also deletes them from Samsung Gallery and vice-versa. I didn't choose or want cross deltions to happen. I am keen to find a fix for this problem. If you would help me find a fix that'd be wonderful. A+ Google photo app. I highly recommend your app. Thank you.

author: Jamie Leigh Sassaman
content: All my pictures in 1 place, all dates, all arranged, not to mention the memories Google photos. You can pick pictures off the phone and they print it and send them back! There are so many cool things to change the pictures, editing on the app. This is the absolute best app ever made, at least I think but don't take my word go see for yourself!!!! ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS APP BEST APP EVER INVENTED!!!! 💯%

author: Kleber Silva
content: It is a really good app. It is sometimes confusing about what photos are online and what are on your device, but this could be just me hahaha. The auto collection is my favorite feature. It creates a collection of your best photos automatically (from a trip for example) when you take them with GPS tag enabled. Saves lots of work. Today I discover the auto panorama feature. I took 3 separated photos from places that are physically side by side and the app make it one panoramic photo. Really cool!

author: A Google user
content: UI is becoming very user friendly with new updates, and is now easy to use. Better syncing with Google Chrome in desktop (as i had turned on backup), which is actually pretty handy when you do not have your phone currently with you. Over all a pretty nice experience, and till now I haven't found any problems. I'll notify, if any, in the future updates. Good work GOOGLE TEAM.

author: Shan Kurschinski
content: Im not real tech saavy but it seems to take more than needed steps to take pictures and attach the pictures to the messages. It could be my phone or the operator of course. Pictures are good but sometimes wished I could zoom in for closer shots. Again could be me or my phone. One day Ill figure it out. Google photos have been good to me.

author: Susan Conway
content: I love the fact that all my photos are there at 5ge touch of button. All making them easy to find. I also like the collage suggestions, I don't save all of them, but I do see most. I also like þhe way periodically I'm shown pictures that may want deleting, but it's my decision whether I do or not

author: A Google user
content: Lovely! I love how it gives you options and sometimes edits a photo and you can go to Assistants and check them out! Sometimes it will edit a picture and add a filter or something. Others, it will make an animation from a video. It's very cool! I definitely recommend. ( not bot )

author: Shadman Wasi
content: The best photography storage Apps you can rely. I have purchased the subscription of Google just to store my valuable photographs. Yes I mentioned valuable and it's right, as I love to take pictures. Every single shots of mine is precious to me. I love to take pictures and for storage them, I rely on Google Photos. The assending and dessending selection method and the geo location wise categories makes the apps more easy to use. You can set the resolution that you want to store. Happy clicking.

author: A Google user
content: It allows you to store all your photos in one place and create folders, which you choose to name and then make into albums. You can choose from several styles of filter, that can highlight or lowlight your photo giving you the option of saving it, but in several styles. You can also crop them to your desired size. This ease of storage is a bonus as you can free up space on your phone. I really like this app and enjoy using my photos in various different ways. Would recommend it.

author: Owen Cyril
content: Two words , amazing app. I really love the editing features and it's clean and easy to use look but I would really love if there could be an option to choose which folders you wanna see in the library home page instead of them just being lined up in order following your most recent photos. Thank you , it's a great app nonetheless.

author: Robert Becker
content: I am taking pictures every day and this app has slowly become my defacto method of centralizing these pictures and it is great. You can count on it, and the compressed version is amazing. I just heard that Google is capping the drive size for files associated with this process. This is why I never trust anything free. You almost changed that Google. Obviously zero stars when the cap happens, and I'll start planning how to stop utilizing anything else I depend on that you make.

author: A Google user
content: I have been using Google photos since it was started. I've always bought Google equipped phones, which as many of you may or may not know, have a lack of the "gallery" app. Google photos is great bec. I can access my photos using my account credentials on anything with an internet browser, I can share private folders to friends and photography clients with a breeze! If you're hesitant I don't know what to tell you, Google photos is great!

author: A Google user
content: When I first got the app it was a great conxept and very useful. The only problem was the image quality and this was a few years ago. Now that they fixed it, the app is great. The only problem is that if you use a high quality camera, you may have to use storage that counts against your quota(certain amount of storage that matches original image quality), if not you'll be able to use unlimited storage backup with many features. The little stuff that the assistant does is really interesting.

author: Aria Griffin
content: Best photo app yet. Great for transferring photos from one phone to another. They even provide a share invitation. All you have to do is type in the email of the person you want to share with. Definitely recommend noting your email [ that you used to make an account ] and password. Another cool thing about this app is that it organizes the photos based on when they were taken. Overall, it's a great app. It's definitely worth the time.

author: ANYANDA “APOSTLE FUNDI” JOSEPHAT
content: Is good to have records of memory of pictures and videos so it easy to keep it on your docket, thanks for your help to create such NB chance , the photos are clear and well maintained throughout on the app than in other places, like my experiences is so many times i have found myself having a high time to keep albums in the house and sometimes my friends and family members they stole my photos so it gets better to keep in Google than in albums, when i kept my contacts in the Google i found them

author: A Google user
content: I'm adding words to my 5 star review because Google Photos has been outdoing itself lately. On it's own, this app has put together collages, slideshows, and movies out of all my photos and videos. It made a movie out of all of my small recorded moments of my baby that I have taken over this past year. It put the videos to music and everything and I basically got to see the highlights of my baby grow up this past year and I didnt have to do a thing. This is one of my fav apps by Google for sure!!

author: Juvanie Mesidor
content: Best photo app I have ever used it is easy to use and the moment thing that they came up with is amazing , basically reminding me about the past . I recommend it to any one who needs to organize there photos , videos and screen shots. You can also send photos and videos in a chat so you don't have to go back on forth on apps. 100% recommend.

author: Mark Karma
content: I cannot even begin to explain how much I love Google photos. It's super easy to use, very fast with uploading, easy sharing ability, and is super generous regarding the amount of free storage space from the start. Apple gives you barely any storage and then takes you hostage and charges ridiculous amounts for more space. I have years of photos on here and haven't used up my space yet and it's incredibly easy to setup on any new phone and keep your photos. Thank you Google!

author: A Google user
content: Of course it's the absolute best. No more lost photos when changing devices, no more running out of space on mobile phones, no more fears whether the external drive that you stored the photos from 2003 will work. Doesn't duplicate photos, unlimited space. Decent editor, assistant is great. Could go on and on.

author: Nimra Afzaal
content: I love this app because it stores all your photos and it also puts your photos in the right order,for example, what date you took certain photos on and you can have different albums like if you take a screen shot then yer sreena shot will be saved in an album called screen shots. This app has been working foe me for almost 5 years now so I think that I speak from experience. If you download thus app I hope that you will like it as much as me and enjoy storing and managing your photos on here.😊

author: A Google user
content: My favorite part of this app has to be the animations. I love getting the surprise of a cool animation every now and then. It makes for awesome content. I just wish they were shareable (easily). Great storage for my photos with dates and locations. I love how accessible my photos are; it's very much what Google is to me as a user.

author: Devin
content: Best cloud backup I've ever used, it's easy enough for my grandparents to understand and use, and that speaks volume. Built in photo editor and the ability to order pictures is amazing. Overall love the app. The cap of 15gb is not enough for the free version but at only $2 for 100gb per month. It's the best price for the amount of storage you can get.

author: Teresa D'Alessio
content: I love how it automatically backs up all my photos within minutes of taking them and periodically, without my initiation, makes cute animations and collages that I almost always save. I l don't know how it knows what pictures are flattering and what ones aren't, as it always makes animations/collages with said [flattering] photos. Also, I can access the photos from anywhere, even if I lose my phone and/or sd card, as the app stores them in cloud fashion. Cant live without it!

author: A Google user
content: Google photos app has never let me down. All my photos have been safe once they've been backed up. I'm a novice photographer and I have 10000 plus photos stored there at any given time. Easy to access and edit. Thank you Google for this app. I have used it with confidence to keep my photos safely stored for a few years now. It's not only kept me organized but helps me take what I do to a higher level as a photographer.

author: JennieLeigh826
content: Please make it easier to delete Spam & old email so it's not using up valuable space! Without having to use a computer cuz many people just have a smartphone or tablet now! And after 10+yrs of Gmail I have tens of thousands of spam emails taking up space I wish I could have for my pictures! I'm a huge crafter & save craft pics, not just pics of people. I'd love to be able to organize them so I can create each folder for each craft type & use this app more! 💜🙏🏽🦋

author: A Google user
content: it's amazing using it for years now... it completely solves the internal phone memory shortage problem.... once photos are uploaded they are cleared from phone freeing up phone space.... and you still get the photos anytime anywhere on any device that can access photos.... super.... Google photos team is doing awesome job here... just a constructive suggestion... not sure if that is possible.... if there could be a way that it takes lesser since for app data.... then it can be used everywhere.

author: zainabnotfound
content: Really amazing app! If you take lots of photos you can back them up, and you can find your photos really easily! I make albums which is another thing you can do in this app just in case you lose your pics. I also really love how you can share pictures with other people on this app and also that you can chat with other people on it too! You would think that this app was just for pictures, but Yu can make movies, albums, photo books, and more! This app is awesome! 100% recommended!

author: Isaree1102
content: **Update** I don't think I could function without this app very well now. It is a backup, reminds me when I should archive pictures and allows me to deselect any photos I want to keep in my active folder. It makes panoramas, gifs, and short videos of my pics, and lets me decide if I want them. I love the hands off option to them being uploaded to the cloud! I take tons of pictures, and this helps me keep my phone storage free. I also love the assistant option!!! The animations are fabulous

author: Adam Hansen
content: The best photo viewing/editing app I've found. Also, super awesome that Google stores them for you! Not only that, while google is trying to go to bed, he browses through all the pics to get tired. While snooping, he fixes lighting, makes collages, panoramas, all sorts of great ideas! And then randomly reminds you of back when you were with your ex... Four years ago today would be your anniversary!!! Or back when you still had a front tooth... Look how good you looked just a year ago, today!

author: Wendy Louann Klingele
content: Google photos is awesome! It has literally been saving my memories for me throughout the last 2 decades almost automatically each time I take a picture of something per each phone I have ever owned during that time frame. Honestly I don't know what I would have done without the Google photos app. I guess I would have had to suffer any time I simply lost or had stolen from me one of my many phones.

author: A Google user
content: This app was the default gallery app on my old HTC 10 and I haven't looked back. It is absolutely wonderful for managing photos and videos in archives and albums or on the fly. Its editing features are getting more sophisticated every month. Google Photos has truly has made a material difference for the better in my life. Great work.

author: A Google user
content: Seems to me that this app is intuitive. Learns my styles over a period of time and im sure it continues to adapt to my personal taste. I like that you can order prints on the fly. Easy to navigate options and helpful suggested ideas all for a fair price. I ordered a large canvas print as a Christmas gift. The print arrived on time and the packaging was just right for what I ordered. Intuitive, adaptive and ease of operation is why I continue to use this application. Im a believer in Google!

author: A Google user
content: I love being able to take, store, and organize my images in Google photos. I love the collages and videos that it makes for me--the "then & now" ones of my daughter over the months are so sweet. I also love the search feature that allows me to find all my pictures of a certain person, place, or even a specific date. The only thing i wish is that I could save motion photos as videos to share with non-Andriod friends.

author: A Google user
content: Love this app!! It takes photos, sometimes edits them itself, but you get the option to keep, same with videos with your photos and uses music in conjuntion with them and they are so cute! I love having my photos organized and in a cloud storage. This app is perfect for all of that. Not to mention you can edit your own pictures, make collages (it does that for you too ;) ), and make videos! Just loving this!!!

author: Donald Robinson
content: Not bad so far, but needs tweaks to enhance ease of usability and efficiency. Like why aren't my pictures saving properly, or to somewhere where I can retrieve them easily and quickly?*x. I haven't found out how to make a proper album yet, or where the branch tree directories are; so I suppose you could say I'm a little bit boned, as far as that side of things is concerned.*x.
